dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib la jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā snyela'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad snyel mdzad pa ta cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsunga'abum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhud sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung ge'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshes/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag rwakyi

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las skar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ga khu gnang bsan dpe rnying 'chos bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba6pa'i tshes 7la/

ba〉〈sgrig gsal sand/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang bcal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum ming gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du 'i bzhugs pa gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags zhan 6) rtoganartong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar bod rtags 6) 6) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja she (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) storgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod snang nams mchag ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags rta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags (tha)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags khom na (mi 'on ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deng khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza/ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zhin ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (ba)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma (nga)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mong cam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza 'a yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/(kyi

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ rmad la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ra khrig nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyogs sgrig khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal lngan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhud chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ g.yin yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig 'gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos ma ngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs ga khang nas//()

dkar chagargyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang nyi ma'i snying po/ (1)thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs kyi las byang dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod/ (12)thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi las byang 'khrugs pa sdebs su bkod pa bklags pas don grub/ (15)thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / (29)byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gyi las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ (105)byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi las byang gi don tshang zhing 'khyer bde ba phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ 5124)pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rigs 'dzin zhal lung / (128)pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ (137)dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang snying po bcud bsdus/ (182)pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ (189)pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub bsnyen la nye ba mkho ba'i dngos grub len chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ (206)pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i sbyin sreg gi chog sgrigs ye shes snang ba rab 'bar (210)dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ (222)

gter kha 'og ma'i rta nag lcags ral can gyi las byang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ (248)dpal rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub chen gyi chog sgrigs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar/ (254)rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ (275)lha brag gter byon gyi phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje pha lam/ (300)byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ (325)byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ (335)byang gter gyi phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud sde phyer 'thag (348)dpal chen phur bu'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gnam lcags thog mda'/ (364)khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ (369)khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ (488)gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa'i las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ (504)dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ (533)rje btsun bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin cen do shal/ (589)

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganar༅༅//rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang nyi ma'i snying po bzhugs so//na maḥ.ārla lo ke shwa rā ya/ka dag chos sku bde ba chen po'i slong //lhun grub 'od lnga zhi khro rab 'byams gar//thugs rje'i don mdzad sprul sku srong btsan zhabs/kha ba'i ljongs 'dir phan bde'i dpal stsol zhig/gang de'i rdo rje'i tshig gi tshangs pa'i gsung //mi 'gyur phyag rgyas btab pa gsang ba'i gter//sgo 'byed sprul pa'i gter ston rnam gsum sogs//rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams phyag gi yul//dpal ldan sku bzhi'i 'byor ba lhun grub pa'i//'phrin las srid mthar rab rgyas rdo rje 'dzin//bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i kun dga'i dpyid//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug na mdzes//gangs can phan bde'i 'dab stong 'dzum byed pa'i//'jig rten dbang phyug grub thob nyin byed dbang //rnam dpyod shing rta bdun pos nyer drangs tshe//srid zhi'i rgud pa'i mun tshogs da ga ra//mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis 'khor ba las//rnam grol nyams su blangs na tshe gcig la//rang rig kun bzang go 'phang mngon byed pa'i//las byang nyi ma'i snying po deng 'dir spro//de la 'dir chosaskyong 2na tha'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum las byung ba'i thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs lha nyer gsum ma'i las byang ngag 'don 'khyer bde ba brjod par bya'o//skyabs sems tsho gos zhing tshad med bzhi//srung 'khor bsgom zhing byin dbab pa//phyi mchod sman rag gtor ma rnams//byin brlabs sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o//dang po skyabs 'gro ni/bdag sogs nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun//deng nas rang rig kun bzang mngon gyur bar//bslu ba med pa'i dkon cog rnam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pogasum la/ /mi phyed gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ gdod nas dag pa'i rig pa kun tu bzang / /ma rig 'byul ba'i rnyog mas rab sbags te/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por bying ba rnams/ /sgrol phyir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /gsum pa tshogs zhing ni/rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba yi/ /thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang / /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng / /hrīḥyig dkar las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma rigs bdag rnam par legs bzhugs pa'i/ /thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /(2ba)sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas rab bskor ba/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasabyang sems sras dang bcas/ /sems can 'khor ba'i sdul bsngal bsal ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ /tshe rabasasngon nas da lta yan chad du/ /sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis so sor bshags/ /skye bo nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /dus gsum dge rtsa bgyis la rjes yi rang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal nas gsungs pa yi/ /chos 'khor sems can rnams la bskor du gsol/ /'gro don mi mdzad mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags pa/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob shog /bzhi pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs bya/ lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ rang gi snying gar raṃ yig dmar po las/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du gyi yig dmar/ /de las 'od zer dmar pos lus kun khyab/ /rnam smin lus bsregs 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ /de yi ngang las rang sems saḥyig ni/ /yongs gyur dpal chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa be con dang / /g.yon pa rdo rje'i tho bas gdug pa 'dul/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs/ /—2

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2genus pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sems la ye shes 'char bar byin gyis zla mes/ /phung po 'od sku grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsir 'gyur bar byin gyis rlomes/ khru 'dzin gnas su bgrod par byin gyis rlomes/ /'phags pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog thun dngosagrub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ sa ma ya/ e be sha ya a āḥbadun pa phyi mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ku'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i/ /raṃ las me byung ma dag skyon rnams bsregs/ /waṃ las rlung byung ma dag skyon rnams gtor/ kho las chu byung ma dag skyon rnams bkrus/ /ngo bo kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la/ /rnam pa nyer spyod 'dod yon la sogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /sa gzhi bar snang khyon kun khyab gyur cig /ārla lo ki te sa pa ri wā ra ji/ pā thu/ puṅge dhu pe/ dī paṃ/ nga/ ni li bye/ shasta/ sarba pā dza me gha hūṃ/ rā pa/ sha lta/ ga/ rā sa/ (4nasgo/ badz+ra lā se/ badz+ra shasta/ badz+ra lha pe/ badz+ra ni wi bye/badz+ra pañtsa li ka /badz+ra dharma/ badz+ra pu dza sam ya maṇ+ḍal/ a la la ho/ brgyad pa sman mchod byin gyisabarlab pa ni/ āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs su/ /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ ta/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kun bstim nas/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ dgu pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /rab dkar mtshan ldan ban+ta'i snod yangs su/ /ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi la/ /rnam pa rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab 'khyil ba/ /rlabs phreng lha ba'i do shal rgod gyur cig /ma hā rak+ta a khra tā hūṃ saḥṭha/ bcu pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /si r+ṣa thod pa'i snod du gtor ma ni/ /ngo bo thogs pa med pa'i bdud rtsil/ rnam pa 'dod pa'i yon tan kun ldan pa/ /mtha' klas nam mkha'i khyon kun khyab gyur cig /ā+oṃ ma hā ba li ta hūṃ/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum rten brten pa/ /snyan gsan spyan 'dren bzhugs dbang phyag /phyi mchod sman raka gtor ma bstod/ /'dzab dang dngos grub dngos gzhi'i khrigs/ /dang po chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ sna tshogs snang ba'i sems kyi rol pa'i —4

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganartsal/ /snang ba'i ngo bo ka dag stong pa'i gshis/ /spros bral brjod du med pa chos kyi dbyings/ /dbyer med rig pa'i ngo bo kun tu bzang / /gnyis pa longs sku kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'brul ba'i 'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje yis/ /rig pa'i rang mdangs 'od lnga'i klong shar ba/ /dngas pa'i mtsho nang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /mi (4ba〉gyur bde ba'i rang mdangs gzugs su 'char/ /gsum pa sprul sku rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang bzhin mi 'gyur kha dog sna lnga pa/ /gcig tu rab 'dus gyi yig dkar po ni/ /'jigs med stong pa'i ngang du rab snang ba/ /skar chen thang la phebs pa lta bur gyur/ /bzhi pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ de las〉 babs rdo rje'i rgya gram gyur/ /: yig ser po babasalas 'od 'phros pas/ /bde gshegs zhing khams kun khyab de dag gi /bcud rnams kun bsdusayongs su gyur pa las/ /phyi bltas nang gsal rin cen gzhal yas khang / yi/ bzhi sgo bzhi gru chad bar khyams bcas/ /rin cen rnam pa lnga yi rtsig pa'i steng / /pha gu dra ba dra phyed da ru skad/ /rta babs bzhi'i steng chos 'khor gdugs ri dwags/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes shing yid du 'ong / /steng na 'khor lo rtsibs stong rnam pa la/ /'og gzhi pad+ma stong gi dbyibs su mdzes/ /rin cen gzhal yasakhang gi dbus nyid na/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte ba dang bcas pa/ /de yi phyi rol 'dab ma bcu gnyisadang / /sgo bzhir pad rkyang gdan bcas gsal bar gyur/lnga pa lha bskyed pa ni/ gong gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma bcu drug steng / /paṃ las sna tsho gos pad+ma 'dab brgyad khar/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang pa'i/ /dbus kyi gdan steng khyuḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ /don gnyis byas shing tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ /de nyid pad+ma dkar por gnas gyur las//'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs gyur bdag nyid ni/ /thugs rje r+pā po 'phags mchog spyan rasagazigs/ /sku mdog rab dkar zhes gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /rtsa phyag thal sbyar g.yas 'og shel phreng dang / /g.yon gyi 'og na pad+ma (5na skokar po 'dzin/ /zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa la/ /rin chen dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dang / /dpung rgyan ska rags phyag zhabs gdu bus mdzes/ /mgur —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gechu do shal se mo do yis brgyan/ /lha rdzas dar gyi na bza'i lhab lhub mdzes/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ /mtshan dpes spras pa 'od phung dbus na bzhugs/ /mdun gyi pad steng gyi yig yongs gyur las/ /lha mo yi ge drug ma sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /rin cen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes/ /lhag ma'i phyag gnyis shel phreng pad+ma 'dzin/ /rtsa phyag thal sbyar gtso la 'dud tshul can/ /g.yas kyi 'dab steng sras mchogo nor bu 'dzin/ /phyag gnyis g.yas pa nor bu rin cen dang / /g.yon pa phreng 'dzin gtso la 'dud tshul mdzad/ /g.yon gyi 'dab steng sras mo rig sngags 'dzin/ /sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas shel phreng dang / /g.yon pa pad+ma 'dzin zhing gtso la 'dud/ /rgyab kyi 'dab mar snang ba mtha' yas ni/ /dmar po phyag gnyis ting 'dzin phyag rgya can/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /bzhi ga'ang zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /de yi phyi rol 'dab ma bcu gnyis la/ /mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor rim pa bzhin/ /rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo bsnams/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod sngon po rdo rje bsnams/ /rin cen 'byung ldan ser po nor bu bsnams/ /snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma bsnams/ /don yod grub pa ljang gu rgya gram bsnams/ /thugs rje chen po dkar po (5ba)pad+ma bsnams/ /sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo bsnams/ /mā ma ki ni sngon mo rdo rje bsnams/ /kun tu bzang mo ser mo rin cen bsnams/ /gos dkar mo ni dmar mo pad+ma bsnams/ /sgrol ma ljang gu rdo rje rgya gram bsnams/ shes rab pha rol phyin dkar pad+ma bsnams/ /rin cen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes/ /shar sgor lha yi thub pa brgya byin ni/ /sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis yi waṃ 'dzin/ /lha min thub pa thags bzang ris sngon po/ /phyag gnyis sra ba'i go cha 'dzin par byed/ /lho sgor mi yi ston pa shākya thub/ /sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis gseg gshang 'dzin/ /nub sgor byol song thub pa shākya seng / /sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis po ti 'dzin/ /yi dwags thub pa nam mkha' mdzod dmar po/ /phyag gnyis 'dzad med gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin/ /byang sgor dmyal ba'i thub pa chos kyi rgyal/ /sku mdog nag po phyag —6

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganaganyis me chu'i 'dzin/ khyams la dus gsum sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /drug pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ chos dbyings bde ba che las ma g.yosakyang / /'gro ba'i don phyir gzugs sku'i rnam rol du/ /mngon par bzhengs shig bcom ldan thugasarje'i lha/ /phyag na pad+ma 'khor dang bcas pa kye/ /bdun pa spyan drangs pa ni/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul ba/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ e khyu hi/dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ/ brgyad pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ thugs rje chen po 'khor dang (6na tha cas pa rnams/ /'gro ba ma lus sems can don mdzad phyir/ /bdag la thugs rjes nye bar dgongs mdzod la/ /thugs dam dbang gis bzhugs la byin gyis rlomes/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ /sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ dgu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ sku lnga ye shes lnga yi skur bzhugs nas/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga rang bzhin gnas nasabazhengs/ /rigs kyi bdag pos dbang bskur byin gyis rlomes/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā/ ā+oṃ ha a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dus gsum sangasargyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med phyir/ /sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs nas/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas gdab po/ /kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi āḥtsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ bcu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ chos kyi sku la gnyis 'dzin mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don phyir longs spyod rdzogs sku bstan/ /thugs rjes spyir yang sprul skur 'gro don mdzad/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ āt+pa na ni rla ta yā mi/ bcu gcig pa phyi mchod ni/ thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /nyon mongs skyes grol gdung ba mi mnga' yang / /bdag cag bsod nams ye shesatshogs bsag phyir/ /pu dza'i tsho gos kyis mnyes shing bzhes su gsol/ — wa lo ki te/ ji/pā gi/ pu sge dhu pe/ di paṃ/ ga rnye/ ni wi bye/ sha snya/ sarba pā dza me gha hūṃ/ hūṃ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chosal sogs/ /bkra shis lha mos nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po(6bsgo cho de pa 'bul/ /dgyes shing bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /badz+ra lwa se/ badz+ra shasta/badz+ra sgyu pe/ badz+ra ni li dre/ badz+ra pañtsa li ka /badz+ra dharma/ badz+ra pu dza sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal/ a la la ho/ bcu gnyis pa bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag stong sbyar ba'i/ /gdod nas rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchog /myong grol sman gyi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /mas wa lo gi te/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje chen po dang / /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po pad+ma 'byung / grub thob dngos grub mnga' bdag myang ban la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ tshig rkang phyi ma dang sngags 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre /mi bskyod rdo rje rje btsun shākya bzang / /lha rje dge 'bum sangs rgyas lcam mo dang / /chu sgom zhig po mtha' bzhi bya bral la/ /ཿ bsod nams seng ge bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / /blo gros rgyal mtshan 'phags chen nor bu bzang / /rgyal mtshan bzang po mdo sngags chos rgyan la/ / tsha rin cen rdo rje bkra shis rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /kun dga' tshe mchog ngag dbang ye shes grub/ /pad+ma badz+ra zil gnon drag rtsal la/ /— thugs rje chen po yi ge drug ma dang / /nor bu 'dzin dang rig sngags 'dzin ma zung / /bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas bcas pa la/ / ཿrigs lnga yab yum thugs rje chen po dang / khres rab pha rol phyin ma thub pa drug /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs bcas pa la/ /ྈ dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma yi dam (7na)srung mar bcas rnams kyi/ /mi 'gyur gsang ba gsum gyi dngos grub kun/ /dus 'dir rdo rje'i mched lcam spun grogs la/ /thogs pa med par myur du stsal du gsol/ /oṃ kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ bcu gsum pa rak+ta ni/ 'byung ba'i rtsa bcud mkha' dbyings pad dkar sogs/ /gcig tu rab 'khyil mtshams sprin mdangs 'dzin pa/ /'gro la rjes su chags pa'i snying rje'i mdangs/ /dbyer med ngo bo gcig pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ a wa lo ki te su ra sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ bcu bzhi pa gtor ma ni/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i rdzas/ /ngo bo ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa bdud rtsi'i rgya —8—

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje r+sā po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganamatsho chen po 'di//bcom ldan lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//oṃ a wa lo gi te sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba li ta kha raṃ khā hi/bco lnga pa bstod pa ni/gyi 'phags pa thugs rje chen po lha yi lha//yi ge drug ma shesarab dbyings kyi yum//nor bu 'dzin pa sras mchog thabs kyi tshul//rig sngags 'dzin ma shes rab sras mo'i tshul//ye nas ma grub rang dang gnyis med lha//ye shes lha yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs rje ོ po'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs//rnam par snang mdzad chos dbyings ye shes dang //mi bskyod rdo rje me long ye shes dang //rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam nyid ye shes dang //snang ba mtha' yas sor rtog ye shes dang //don yod grub pa bya grub ye shes dang //sku lnga ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod//pha rol phyin ma chos sku dbyings kyi ngang //sangs rgyas spyan ma bsam gtan pha 7ba khol phyin//kun tu bzang mo brtson khrus pha rol phyin//na bza' dkar mo sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin//mā ma ki ni tshul khrims pha rol phyin//dam tshig sgrol ma bzod pa'i pha rol phyin//pha rol phyin drug yum gyi sku la bstod//dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas stong dang gnyis//'gro ba'i don du byang chub thugasabaskyed nas//byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro kun 'dul//bskal bzang sems dpa' stong la phyag 'tshal bstod//lha yi thub chen brgya byin lha rnams 'dul//lha min thub pa thags bzang lha min 'dul//mi yi thub pa chen pos mi rnams 'dul/'i kya seng ge thub pas dud 'gro 'dul//thub chen nam mkha' mdzod kyis yi dwags 'dul//thub pa chos kyi rgyal pos dmyal ba 'dul//'gro drug soso'i skad du chos sgra sgrog/so so'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad skye sgo gcod//thub pa chen po drug la phyag 'tshal bstod//bcu drug pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos rnams kyis sngags kyi sgra//bzlas pa'i sngags phreng dag las 'od zer 'phros//sangs rgyas rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul//sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib ma lus sbyangs//snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang //bcud kyi sems can spyan ras gzigs su gyu///zhes dmigs pa dang bcas te yi ge drug pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geci nus su bzla/ /bcu bdun pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ thugs rje chen po yab yum sras dang bcas/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga pha rol phyin drug yum/ /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' ting 'dzin sbyong / /sprul sku thub drug 'gro drug thabs (8na)kyis 'dul/ /'gro ba 'dul phyir thugs rjes sku bskyod la/ grub pa rtags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ kwa ya wā ka tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ye shes kyi lha rnams kyi sku mi 'gyur ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub gsung mi 'gyur 'gag med snying po lung gi dngos grub/ thugs mi 'gyur ba spros bral chos nyid rang gsal gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ tshogs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga dang / /gtang rag btang zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu/ smon lam shisapa brjod pa ni/ mjug gi bya ba'i khrigs rim mo/ /dang po tshogs mchod ni/ gzhung du mi gsal zhing phyag len du par bkab mi mdzad la/ phun sum tsho gos pa'i yan lag tu byed par spro na/ chos dbang dang byang gter sogs thugs rje chen po'i chos bka' gzhan nas 'byung ba'i tshogs mchod kyi kha bskang na legs par sems so/ /gnyis pa gtang rag ni/ thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas legs 'bul na/ /brtse bas bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'od zhu 'khor la thim/ /de yang 'od zhu gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ /gtso bo 'i thugs ka hrīḥr bsdus khyiḥyig kyang / /mi dmigs spros bral ka dag ngang du gyur/ /bzhi pa smon lam ni/ 'di ltar bskrun pa'i dge tshogs ci mchis pas/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las rab bsgral nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang mngon gyur te/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dpal (8bsgo spyod par shog /lnga pa shis brjod ni/ chos sku'i bkra shis mgon po 'od dpag med/ /ngo bo 'gyur med ka dag bkra shis shog /longs sku'i bkra shis 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /rang bzhin lhun grub 'od lnga'i bkra shis shog /sprul sku'i bkra shis srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs/ /thugs rjes 'gro drug — 10

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtogana'adren pa'i bkra shis shog /yang sprul bkra shis rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /'gro kun bde skyid 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /byin rlabs 'byung gnas rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi/ /dngos grub char ltar 'bebasapa'i bkra shis shog /mthu stobs dbang phyug chos skyong gter srung gis/ /bar chad g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o/ /smras pa/ bsams pa tsam gyis 'dod pa yi/ /re ba ma lus skong byed pa'i/ /sngon med dpag bsam ljon pa yi/ /las byang 'di ko yid bzhin nor/ /srong btsan thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /sgo 'byed gter ston rnam gsum dang / /brgyud ldan bla mas nyer drangs pa'i/ /zab don 'byor ba kho bos rnyed/ /so so'i gzhung bzhin ma sbyangs par/ /rgyas 'gebs rang bzo'i zol sbyor can/ /cher rlom stong pa'i 'ur brgyangs mkhan/ /mi smra'i khri la ngal sos shig /phyogs 'dir mkhas par rlom 'ga' yang / /gab dkrugs dgongs don ma rtogs par/ /gya tshom brtsams pa'i chog sgrigs dag /brtagasatshe g.yar khral kho nar bas/ /dkrugs bsdebs gab pa mngon byung zhing / /ma tshang kha bkang 'khyer bde ba'i/ /las byang (9na)nyi ma'i snying po 'di/ /rnam dpyod nam mkha'i ngos la shar/ /dge 'disabadag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /'khor ba'i chu gter las bsgral nas/ khru 'dzin rin cen gling bgrod de/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /de ltar bod yul gyi phan bde'i srog shing skyid shod nyang bran pha bong kha zhes sprul pa'i rgyal po'i gnas khyad par can der 'di nyid kyi sgrub pa nyams len gyi rim pa tshugs na bod yul bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i srog shing du 'gyur bar nges nas 'dzugs pa'i 'dun pa mngon du gyur skabs/ mkhas grub gong ma dag gis mdzad pa'i yig cha yod med brtags shing btsal ba na/ paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal mched gnyis/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog sogs kyis mdzad pa ni mchis shing / sde pa snang rtse gter ston pas mdzad pa zhig 'dug na'ang / sngar 'gyur rang skad la dgos pa'i kha 'gengs med cing / dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste sogs gsar ma'i kha bgengs sna tshogs 'dug pa dang cha lag tshang bar yang mi — //

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'asnang bas tshul 'di nyams su len pa'i skal ldan rnams la phan pa'i phyir du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig byung na legs sam snyam pa'i blos gsar du bskrun pa'i las byang nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni brgyud pa'i gsung 'phros dang man ngag la brten nas rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs dam pa du ma'i bka' drin la brten nas/ snga 'gyur gyi brjod don phyogs tsam rig cing chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos rjes su bzung ba'i za hor brnye ngag dbang blo (9ba)bzang rgya mtsho ming g.yin zil gnon drag po rtsal du 'bod pas chu 'brug nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu'i dus kyi mchod pa'i nyin dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni slob dpon smon 'gro paṇa wo blo bzang 'jam dbyangs lhun grub bo/ /bkra shis/thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs kyi las byang dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod bzhugs so/ /thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs kyi las byang dang 'brel ba'i tsho gos mchode ni/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtser/ /raṃ las ye shes me yis rdzas rnams kyi/ /ma dag nyes pa'i skyon kun ma lus bsregs/ /yaṃ las chos nyid rlung gis rdzas rnams kyi/ /ma dag nyes pa'i skyon kun ma lus gtor/ kho las mtshan med chu yis rdzas rnams kyi/ /ma dag nyes pa'i skyon kun ma lusabakrus/ /ā+oṃ gyis kun rdzob chos kun stong pa'i ngang / /thabs mchog ā:las pad+ma'i snod yangs por/ /shes rab hūṃ gis tsho gis kyi dngos po kun/ /zung 'jug hrīḥlas zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ /slar yang 'od 'phros yang bzhi lha mi sogs/ /snod bcud kun gyi yon tan thams cad dang / /rgyal ba zhi khro'i sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi ro bcud nus pa'i tshogs/ /thogs med bkug nas dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ /raṃ yaṃ kho/ oṃ āḥsnyi lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ spyan 'dren pa ni/—12

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganarang snang dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi lha (2na 〉 shas rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas khang 'di ru byin gyis rlomes/ /tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob/ /'dir tshogs mgo lcam nyams rtogs spor/ /snang srid bde ba r+ṣa por mdzod/ /ā+oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sgrub pa'i rten dang gtor ma la/ /gnyis su med par brtan par bzhugs/ /pad+ma ka ma lā ye sto/ yi ge bcu pa lan bdun bzlasanas/ gnas mchag 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar ho sol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /tshogs dang po 'bul ba ni/ 'phagasamachog thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs/ /'dod yon phyir mchod nam mkha' gang / /bdud rtsi sman phud rak+ta dang / /dam rdzas rgyan ldan nang mchod bshams/ /mdzes sdug phyag rgyar mnyam sbyor ba/ /gsang ba bde chen mchod pa'i rdzas/ /kun kyang rig pa'i rang gdangs las/ /mchod bya mchod byed dang (2ba)bral ba/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /thugs dam skongs la dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā gi nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra gha ṇa tsa kra pā dza khā hi/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa /rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la bshags/ /tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma satwa sam ya sogs snang ba mtha' yas kyi yi ge brgya pa gsum mam bdun brjod/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ e las thar med 'brub khung 'bar ba'i nang / /rtsi dang tri las gnod byed gzugs phung la/ /pho nya rnams kyisadagra dang bgegs kyi tshogs/ khug cig dzaḥ& baṃ sngos gnyis med gyur/ /dbang chen rab khros sku smad phur pa'i dpal/ /snying gar btab pas srog bcad rnam shes spar/ /spu gri 'bar bas yan lag sha khrag rus/ /nang khrol ma lus phye ma dum bur gtubs/ /hrī badz+ra kro dha ha ya gi ba hu lu hu lu dgra bgegs kyi bla tshe srog gsum thams cad mā ra ya rbad ces bsgral/ stob pa ni/ phyi ltar dgra bgegasabasgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /nang du tshogs brgyad dag pa'i phung po lnga/ /gsang ba bde stong ye shes lnga'i —13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gerang bzhin/ /gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i ngang nas 'bul/ /gong gi sngags gsham du/ ma hā me sarak+ta ke : ti kha raṃ ji hi/ lhag ma ni kha chus sbran la/ phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /thugs rje chen po'i bka' skyong tshogs/ /yang 'khor sdebargyad pho nyar bcas/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bstan gnod dgra bgegs 'joms (3na)pa dang / /rnal 'byor stong grogs bya ba dang / /'gro kun phan bde sgrub par mdzod/ /ā+o u sbyin ba kla ta bhak+ṣa se swāhā/chad mtho ni/ sngon tshe 'og min bde ldan zhing khams su/ /dpal ldan kun bzang gar gyi dbang po yis/ /rang las gzhan min dag pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /byar med ngang nas chos kyi gnas lugs kun/ /tshig dang yi ge med par bstan pa'i tshe/ /gsang ba ye shes la sogs mkha' 'gro yis/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la/ /ra sa 'phrul snang dpal gyi gzhal yas su/ /srong btsan sgam po skyon khri srong rjes/ /'phags mchog zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /gter kha gsum du zab gter sbas pa'i tshe/ /dung skyong ma sogs chos srung gter bdag gis/ /ji ltar:/ /gtor ma 'di:/ /de 'og rtsub 'gyur bskal pa'i tha ma la/ /laṅka'i rgyal khab dpal ri'i pho brang du/ /slob dpon thod 'phreng slob ma dngos grub nyang / shwakya bzang po gter ston rnam gsum gyis/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /ma sring dregs pa dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar:/ /gtor mtsha / /da lta bkra shis byin chags gnas mchog 'dir/ /dam gtsang rdo rje spun grogs mched lcam gyis/ /'gro 'dul thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag don byang chub nar mar bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /yar gnasamachod cing mar gnas skyong ba dang / /bstan srung dam skong g.yar dam gso byed na/ /ji (3ba)ltar:/ /gtor ma:/ /bstan ma bskyang ba ni/ bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi/ /gangasadakar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi/ /kong btsun de mo la sogs sman btsun bzhi/ /'khor bcas dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la/ /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i nad rims dal kha chod/ /sad ser — 14

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganabatsa' than lo nyes dmag 'khrug sogs/ /nyer 'tshe kun zhi chos srid legs tshogos rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bro brdung ni/ gtor gzhed ri rab gsal ba'i 'og /gnod byed dgra bgegs dam sri rnams/ /lus ngag yid gsum mnan byas nas/ /thar ba med pa'i bro brdung ngo / /dbang r+ṣa rta skad tser re re/ /rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem/ khro bo rnams kyis bro brdungs par/khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs so/ /dbang drag zhi rgyas bro brdungs bas/ khams gsum dbang sdud gnod byed bsgral/ /nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas/ /las zhi thams cad lhun grub shog /pā she ku sa mā ra ya/ shan+ti ku mā pu nyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes rgyal po bka' 'bum du tshogs 'khor gyi tshig zin med cing / gangs ri ba'i yig char phyogs tsam snang ba ha cang tshang ba mi 'dug pa/ nye char 'phrul snang bya 'dabs kyi ma ṇi ba skyon can spyi sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de byang sems myu gu rtsal gyis lcags bya glu dbyangs kyi zla bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog go /sarba maṅga lo// //thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi las byang 'khrugs pa sdebs su bkod pa bklags pas don grub bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i dngos brgya shar ba'i mod/ /'dzam gling sdug bsngal smag rum mthar mdzad phyir/ /phyag na pad dkar 'dzin khyod brtul zhugs rtsal/ /grub pa'i gar mkhan mtsho skyes rdo rjer 'dud/ /gang gi rnam sprul bka' gter bstan pa'i bdag /gter chen chosakyi rgyal po legs ldan rje/ /nyi zla 'od zer rtsod dus gangs can gyi/ /phan bde'i snang ba ster mdzad gtsug na mdzes/ /zan g.yang rnam snang thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /'phags ma chag snying rje'i —15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2polcags kyis lus can kun/ /'khor ba las drangs thar pa'i dbyings chen por/ /sgrol ba'i zab gter sngon med legs pa'i lam/ /skyid shod mi bdag gnyen mdun she mong gis/ /'phrul snang bar khang nas brta zhe 'phyon ma'i gar/ /ma zhig zhig pos 'gro mang 'khor gling las/ /mi sgrol nyes klong bskyur dang 'di mi 'dra/ /de phyir 'phrin las sgom rim (2na〉ltig bsdebs pa'i/ /ngag 'don bklags pas don kun grub pa 'di/ /snyigs dus pad+ma'i rgyal tshab gter bdag gling / /bzhed skong slad du yi ge'i phreng bar spel/ /de la 'dir sprul pa'i gter chen nyi zla 'od zer legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje dpal bzang pos zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i bar khang gi rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas gdan drangs pa'i zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgrub thabs dang 'phrin las ma bu khrigs chags su 'dri ba la/ bde ldan zhing na chos sku 'od dpag med/ gru 'dzin rtse mor longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ /rnga yab dpal rir sprul sku thod phreng rtsal/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so bdag byin rlobs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun yum 'tsho rgyal ma/ /sngags 'chang sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dpal/ /zab gter sgo 'byed sprul sku legs ldan rjer/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so bdag byin rlobs/ /bka' babs chos bdag rnam rgyal (2ba)dpal bzang po/ /mkhas btsun grub brnyes ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog bkra shis dpal grub la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so:/ /khyab bdag sman lung blo mchog rdo rje'i zhabs/ /za hor rigs 'dzin byang sems myu gu rtsal/ /snya nam zlos gar pad+ma pho nya'i sprul pa gter rog gling pa la zhes 'don pa bsgyur chog /'phrin las la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so bdagaḥ/ /byin snam rlabs stsal mdzad rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /bar gcod kun sel mkha' 'gro gter srung la/ /snying nas gsol ba / /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid dkyil 'khor du/ /bum gsang shes rab ye shes rig pa'i rtsal/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bos bdag rgyud kyi/ /zab lam rtogs pa'i myu gu smin par shog /thun mong sngon 'grosargyud sbyangs rdul tshon gyi/ /dkyil 'khor la brten ye shes 'od lnga'i klong / /yi dam thugs rje chen po zhi khro — 16

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtogadayi/ /ma hā yo ga'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /snying ga'i rtsa 'dab zhi ba rigs lnga dang / /dung khang 'khor lo rta mgrin khrag 'thung gi /lha tsho gis yongs shar spro bsdu'i sbyor ba sogs/ / a nu yo ga'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /phyi nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /me long gzugs bzhin gsal stong 'dzin pa med/ /blo 'das rig pa'i rtsal du yongs shar ba/ /a ti yo ga'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog khyu ti'i mar sna'i a thung gtum mo'i mes/ /lha yig (3na tha zhu ba'i byang chub sems kyi rgyun/ /'bar 'dzag drod kyis ru bye dngas ma rgyas/ /lus kun khyab pa'i bde stong skye bar shog /rigs bzang bcu drug lon pa'i mtshan ldan mar/ /mnyam sbyor thig le dbab dang ldog pa las/ /dga' mchog khyad par lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /mchog gi bde stong lam du longs par shog shan 'byed mnyen btsal byung gnas 'gro gsum 'tshol/ /gnad du dbab pa'i sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs nas/ /chos kun sems kyi dbyings su ka dag pas/ /rig rtsal chos sku rang ngo 'phrod par shog /sgron ma rnam bzhi sgo gsum gsan thabs gsum/ /gnad bzhi la brten 'od gsal snang ba bzhi'i/ /lam bzang ga gil pa med par nyams blangs nas/ /tshe 'dir zung 'jug kun bzang mngon gyur shog /dbang 'bring rang bzhin 'chi khar chos nyid kyi/ /bar do gnad kyi nyams len la brten nas/ /ma bang bu rgyug lta bur rigs lnga'i tshogs/ /ngo 'phrod rdzus skyes chos kho grol bar shog /brtson 'grusadaman pas dbang po rab 'bring gi /zab lam rnal 'byor nyams 'og ma chud dang / /sdig can btsan thabs 'dren phyir bdag g.yin sems/ /'od dpag med kyi thugs kar 'pho bar shog /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas chos lngar grags pa las/ /dam rdzas ting 'dzin sngags kyis nyer bsgrubs pa/ /myong grol bdud rtsis 'gro kun ༅ song sgo /rab (3ba tha cad thar pa'i lam du 'khrid par shog /rtsa gsum byin rlabs rten 'brel slu med mthus/ /rang sems don gyi 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang / /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod nas lus can kun/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon wo por bdag 'gyur shog /ces 'byul med kyi gter ston nyi zla 'od zer ram rdo rje gro lod du grags pa mchog sprul mnga' —17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2poris pa legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje'i gter gsar thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi brgyud 'debs lam gyi rim pa dang 'brel ba'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po'i sprul pa'i sku blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi rigs las sngags dkar ma ṇi ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /tā tha ru ṭa/ taḥbya ṭa chen ṭa ne skye: /mi 'gyur don dam thugs rje chen po la: sgo gsum dam 'dres don gyi phyag 'tshal lo: sgrub pa'i kha skong las kyi khrigs su sdebs: ma 'ongs las 'phro can gyi dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang po ni: skyabs sems bgegs bskrad srung 'khor byin dbab cing : mchod byin brlab dang bshags pa sngon 'gro bdun dang po skyabs su 'gro ba 'di skad do:na mo/ bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can rnams: 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar:rgyal ba yongs rdzogs thugs rje yi: lha tsho gis rnams la (4na)skyabs su mchi gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hrī: srid mtsho 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir:rigs 'dus thugs rje chen po yi bskyed rdzogs don las mi 'da' 'o: gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: hrī: bdag nyid thugs rje khros pa'i sku: dbang chen yongs rdzogs he ru ga: sprul pa'i khro tshogasaskar ltar 'khrug dam sri log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: nam yang 'da' bar mi nus pa'i mkhyen gnyis bar du mtshams bcad do tshwa ha ya shrī wa ma hā kro ta sarba du gin bisnan mā ra ya lha phaṭa: bzhi pa srung 'khor niḥ khyuḥ gdod nas rnam dag rang byung gzhal yas khang ཿ rig pa'i ngo bo pad+ma he ru ga:dngas ma'i thugs srog ye shes rnam lnga yi: rang 'od zer grub chos dbyings 'khor lo dang : me long ye shes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbyibs mnyam nyid dbyings las rin chen 'bar ba ste: sor rtog skyon bral pad+ma'i gur khang dang : bya grub rang byung ral gri 'bar ba'i tshul: sna tsho gos mtshone cha'i 'od zer — 18—

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganame 'od 'phro: steng 'og phyogs mtshams mi shigs srung 'khor grub: zho badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa snya/ lnga pa byin dbab pa ni phyi chos dbyings rnam dag dkyil 'khor nas: rang byung thugs rje'i lha tsho gos rnams:'gro ba'i don du sku bzhengs la: dbang bskur byin phob dngos grub stsol) tshwa badz+ra a be sha ya a:drug pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: ma su bhā wa bi shurnya sarba dharmā swa (4ba)lha wa bi shurnyo3lha/ raṃ yaṃ kho/ā+oṃ āḥ&/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pulgi dhū pe/ ā lo ke /ga rje/ nai li du/ sha lta pā dza dha chu āḥ& ma hā pañtsa pā dza ho.ā+oṃ āḥ// bho dhi tsit+ta ga na gu pho ma hā gu dza ho: chu āḥ& ma hā sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta rak+ta ba smra ta hūṃ hri ṭhaḥbadun pa bshags pa ni hrī rtse gsum thugs rje zhi khro'i lha: ye nas rang byung dbyer med las:gnyis 'dzin rtog pas so sor bzung : mnyam nyid rig pa'i klong du bshags tshwa badz+ra sa twa a/de ltar sngon 'gro rim pa bdun: skal pa can gyis shes par bya ta rga:rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa dngosagazhi'i las rim ni: dam tshig bskyed dang spyan 'dren dang : bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod: 'dzab bzlas bdun ni dngos gzhi'o: dang po dam tshig bskyed pa ni yo ga gsum gyi mgo rtogs bsgom tā tha gsang chen lam zhugs thugs rje'i rnal 'byor pas zab mo'i sgrub thabs yo ga gsum gyi tshul dkyil 'khor gsum la brten nas bsgrub par bya: dang por ma hā yo ga'i sgom rim ni: ting 'dzin ma yengs yid kyis 'dzin phur gdab rtswa stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rang rig gyi de las 'od zer thig 'phros 'byung lnga'i steng : lha las bde chen lhun grub gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan: rtsig pa lnga ldan pha gu pa trar ldan dra phyed shar bu mda' yab phibs tog mdzes: rdo rje'i ra gur ye (na gis me 'od 'phro: phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor:de dbus pad+ma 'khor lo phyi nang spel: lte bar thig le zung 'brel mu khyud bskor mdun gyi thig ler rang rig lha yi sku: thugs rje chen po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis shel phreng bum pa bsnams rin chen rgyan mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs gsang yum dmar mo pad+ma bum 'dzin 'byud:— 19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobadag nyid spyi gtsug rigs bdag 'od dpag med zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bsnams mas dpe yongs rdzogs chos gos rnam gsum ldan:g.yo med rdo rje'i skyil krung drang por bzhugs:shar du mi bskyod thugs rje shel gyi mdog:zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje shel 'phreng bsnams:rin chen rgyan mdzes//mā ki dkar mo pad+ma bum //lho ru rin 'byung thugs rje gser gyi mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen shel 'phreng bsnams rin chen rgyan mdzes spyan ma ser mo pad+ma bum 'dzin 'byud nub tu snang mtha' thugs rje byu ru'i mdog:zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma shel phreng bsnams:rin chen rgyan/gos dkar dmar mo pad+ma bum /byang du don grub thugs rje in+da'i mdog:zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgya gram shel 'phreng bsnams:rin chen rgyan/sgrol ma ljang gu pad+ma bum /de ltar rang byung zhi ba'i lha tsho gis rnams mnyen lhag 'khril ldem zhi ba'i chas dgu gsol gzhen tshul gzi ldan ye shes 'od lnga'i klong :rang snang ma 'dres thams cad skyil 5bkrung bzhugs zho āḥ/ bswo ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/hūṃ/zhi ba'i ngang las khro bo'i skur bzhengs par 'bar ba'i dbang chen lha tshogs rang byung shar:bcom ldan sku rgyab 'od zer thig le'i dbus:dbang chen yongs rdzogs pad+ma he ru ga:sku mdog dmar nag spyi gtsug rta gdong 'tsher:zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams dur khrod chas gsol bam chen steng na 'gying :phag mo rang 'dra'i 'khril sbyor phag gdong dur shar rtsibs dbang wo badz+ra he ru ga:sku mdog dkar po spyi gtsug rta gdong 'tsher:zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje thod khrag bsnams dur khrod chas gsol bam chen steng na 'gyeng :phag mo rang 'dra 'khril sbyor phag gdong dur:lho rtsibs dbang wo rat+na he ru ga sku mdog ser po /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen thod khrag bsnams:dur khrod chas gsol/phag mo /nub rtsibs dbang chen pad+ma he ru da:sku mdog dmar po/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma thod khrag bsnams:dur khrod chas gsol/phag mo /byang rtsibs dbang chen ga rma he ru da sku mdog ljang gu /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgya gram thod khrag bsnams/dur khrod chas gsol /phag mo rang 'dra /shar

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtogadasgor rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dkar lcags kyu thod khrag 'khril sbyor tshul du 'gying : lho sgor rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum ser zhags pa thod khragaḥ nub sgor pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dmar:lcags sgrog thod khrag ca byang sgor las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum ljang : dril bu thod khragaḥ de ltar rig (6na sol mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: brjid pa'i sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan 'bar ba'i gar dgu rngam brjid khro tshul ldan: bskal me rab 'bar bam chen steng na 'gying / swo pad+man+ta krit+ta ya shrī wa hūṃ phaṭa/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren spos rol dang : gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: khyoḥ dbyings kyi 'od khyim rnam dag po ṭa la: rig pa'i rang sku bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje mtshungs med yab yum gnyis med sbyor: gnas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs su gsol: rig pa'i rang rtsal 'od phung skur snang ba thig le lnga rdzogs tshol ba'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes bzhi sbyor rigs bzhi yab yum rnams: tshad med thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs su gsol dbang drag zla gam 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas ye shes rang rtsal dbang chen yongs rdzogs lha dmigs med thugasarje'i dbang gis brtser dgongs la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su gsol: lasabazhi lhun grub sgo ba yab yum rnams: rtag chad mtha' bral dbyings nas sku bzhedas la tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol:ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni gyi chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen gzhal yas 'dir dbyings kyi thig le 'od phung 'khyil ba'i dbus: rig pa rang shar thugs rje zhi khro'i lha:mnyam nyid don gyi dbyings su brtan par bzhugs tshwa (6ba tha dz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ni: khyu: rang rig thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tsho gos la snang stong skye 'gag med pa'i dbyings nyid du:bzang ga gnyis 'dzin ye nas bral ba yi: mnyam nyid don gyi ngang du phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya 〉 lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: rig gdangs thugs rje'i lha tsho gis la: mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sgra snyan lha mo rnams: so so'i kha dog phyag rgya —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebasgyur: rab stims na ma mkha'i khams bkang nas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod par bya rtswa āḥ& badz+ra pu 〉 nas shasta pā dza sngo hrī: rig gdangs zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: rang byung bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang : sha lnga dam tshig mchog gi rdzas nang gi bdag nyid dag par bzhes: ma hā a khru ta me sa pañtsa phu dza rde sa: thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tsho gos la: snang stong bde chen yab yum mkhar dga' bzhi ye shes thig ler 'khyil: zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa bzhesaḥ ca bho dhi tsit+ta pā dza sngo hrī: rang byung gdod nasarnam par dag pa'i rdzas: rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag stong sbyar ba myong grol bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'di bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung mar 'bul: zho ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā sti 'od dpag med dang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ phyon pad+ma thod phreng mkhar chen bza'/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms gter ston legs ldan rjer/ /myong grol bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ ma hā sarbaḥ /rnam rgyal dpal bzang ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /bkra shis dpal grub khyab bdag sman (7na)lung pa/ /za hor rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa la/ /myong grol:/ ā+oṃ ma hā sarbaḥ/ yi dam thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i lha/ /mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can gter skyong dang / /yul lha gzhi bdag rdo rje mched lcam la/ /myong grol:/ ā+oṃ ma hā sarbaḥ/ gyi thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tsho gis la: rtsa brgyad bdud rtsi mchod pa dang : bde chen rak+ta'i mchod pa dang : dam rdzas gtore ma'i mchod pa rnams: don dam dbyings kyi mchod pa 'bul mthun 'jug mchog gi mchod par bzhes: zho ma hā pañtsa a khra ta rak+ta ba lo ta kha raṃ khā gi drug pa bstod pa ni gyi dbyings kyi 'od phung ye shes chen po las: rig pa'i skur bzhedas thugs rje chen po yab bde chen dgyes pa bskyed phyir yum dang sbyor gnyis med don dam rig pa'i sku la bstod: rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' 'od dpag med rjes su chags pa sku mdog rā ga'i mdog mnyam gzhag mi 'gyur g.yo med skyil krung bzhugs rigs mchogo yongs rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbyings kyi 'od phung ye shes chen po las: rig pa'i skur bzhengs rigs bzhi spyan ras gzigs: khams bzhi rnam dag yum bzhi 'khril sbyor tshul: rigs bzhi yab yum sku —22

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje r+sā po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganal phyag 'tshal bstod khyi:rig pa'i rang rtsal ye shes 'bar ba'i sku dbang chen yongs rdzogs pad+ma he ru da shes rab dbyings kyi phag mo dgyes pa 'khril gnyis med bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:chos nyid dbang drag lhun grub rol pa'i sku:ye shes rang shar rigs bzhi ha ya gi rang rig phag 7ba〉du sde bzhi mnyam par sbyor:rta mchog rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod tshad med rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi phu 'phrin las bzhi ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad sna tshogs rab mas las kun lhun grub pa'i ti kra ta sgo ba'i tsho gos la phyag 'tshal bstod phyi rig pa sprosabral ngos bzung med pa'i lha cir yang ma grub ngang gi gsal ba'i lha:ye nas rang grol rdzogs pa lta ba'i lha ma bcos cog bzhag rang 'gros sgom pa'i lha:blang dor rang dag zung 'jug spyod pa'i lha rang byung ye dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i lha:thig le chen po gra zur med pa'i lha phyi dang nang med kun tu brdal ba'i lha snang srid rnam dag gzhal yas lhun grub pa'i:chags snang rang grol zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor shar:ye shes sku mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod bdun pa 'dzab bzlas dgongs pa ni:yo ga gsum gyi mngon rtogs yin de yi 'phrin las 'di ltar ro:hrī:rang byung rnam dag gzhal yasa'adir:chos sku thugs rje zhi khro'i lha:sna tsho gos sku dang cha lugs la:thugs srog 'dzab kyi rang sgra sgrog mi 'gyur thugs las 'od zer 'phros phar 'phros sems don rnams rdzogs tshur 'dusadangos grub bcud du bsdu rtags mthong bar du rgyun mi bcad:de ltar ma hā phyi grub bzlas ba'i tshe:bdag nyid thugs gar nyi steng hrī:yig dmar/de mthar sngags bskor 'od zer spros pa las:rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs 'od du bsdus:bdag nyid zhal zhugs thugs kar thim pa yis sku gsung ye shes lnga yi dbang thob bsam/bdag gi rigs8na ) 'gres lha rnams kun la sbyar:phung po lnga la rigs kyi spro bsdu dang :zhi sogs las la rigs bzhi'i spro bsdu bya:brgya stong khri 'bum thun sbyar bzlas pa ste:de yis dngos grub yid bzhin 'grub pa dang :zhi sogs las rnams thogs med mthar phyin 'gyur rigs 'dus phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di ma 'ongs las ldan bu dang 'phrad

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganadabyings su sbyor cig ki wā ya:zho pad+ma kro ta gī lā ya rje tri hur ṭaṃ mā ra ya rbad:྅/don dam chos nyid zhal phye zhig:khams gsum 'khor ba zhal du stob ye shes rnam lnga zhal phye zhig:dug lnga gzung 'dzin zhal du stob dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phye zhig:bar chad dgra bgegs zhal du stob:ma ra tsi khā hi tshogs la rol cing rdo rje'i glu bya:tha ta3tha/༷ṭa tam hā mo ṭa/'iḥtan:9na ) bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir gza' bdud dug gi spu gri yi:gsol mchod rim pa bstan par bya:'di la shis pa'i mthun rdzas rnams:tshang zhing bkod legs bshams nas kyang :rgyu dus dag dang zer gnyis dus:sngags 'dis dgug cing phud kyis mchode(tshwa ha ya shrī wa hūṃ/badz+ra rā hu la tsit+ta shaka ru rim ma yod za 'gram ha he dza dza:rdzas bsreg rol dbyangs bcas te bskul:྅/sngon tshe dbang chen pad+ma he ru gas dam la btagasapa'i chos skyong mthu rtsal can:drang srong chen po gza' mchog rā hu la:thugs dam dbang gis gnasa'adir gshegs su gsol drag po'i cha lugs dud kha mun pa'i mdog dbu dgu spyan stong bstan la bya ra mdzad:zhal bgrad mche gtsigs nad kyi na bun 'khrug phyag g.yas chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar ba yis:'gal byed khyur mid thar pa'i dus skabs med g.yon pa mda' gzhus nyams pa'i snying la gzer sku smad sbrul mjug klu bdud pho nyar 'gyed:'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo dkrugs bsdebs srid gsum g.yo sprul pa gza' brgyad gdong mo kha bzhi dang :lha srin sdebargyad rgyu skar nyi shu'i tshogs:rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la:rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pad+ma he ru ga:shrī sidha pad+ma'i spyan snga phuji ltar khas blangs dam bcas dran mdzod la bdag la sdang ba'i lasang na dgra bo 'di:chos skyong khyod la gsod pa'i gnyer du gtad:lo zlar ma bzhag myur du sgrol bar mdzod pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud mngal nas skyoms dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar 9ba ) bo don snying bcas:khyod kyi zas skal mthun rdzas ma yin nam srog chod snying phyungs sha rus dum bur gtubs bzhes shig rol cig dam nyams dgra la rol pha tshan bdun rgyud thams cad rtsad nas cho de:ming tsam med par thal ba'i rdul du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2poltogs: zhes bskul yi dam nga rgyal gyis mchod la gang 'dod 'phrin las bcol dam tshig nan bsgrags gong gnon gces bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:rno myur khyad 'phags thog 'dra ba'i chos skyong khyab 'jug mchod bskul 'di: yang zab chos kyi srung mar sbas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar sgo/ga: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:gnyis pa lhag gtor ni/ hūṃ/ dbang chen thugs rje zhi khro yi: rig rtsal bka' yi lhag sdud ma: rtogs tshogs dbang sgyur 'phrul mo che: 'dod yon rol pa'i lhag gtor bzhes: skye 'gag mtha' bral las mdzod cig gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: ྅/ rang byung dkyil 'khor chen po nas rig pa rang shar lha yi tshogs zhi khro yongs rdzogs sku bzhengs la: shar grol rang mtshang gsal bar mdzod re dogs mtha' las grol bar mdzod: gnyis 'dzin log lta rgyun chod la rtag chad mu mtha' bral ba yi: chos nyid klong du thim bar mdzod sangs rgyas re ba'i pho bdud dang :'khor bar dogs pa'i dam sri dang : tshogs drug yul gyi sde brgyad rnams skye med chos sku'i klong du grol: a phaṭa/ bzhi pa chad mdo ni: hrīḥ 'od gsal lhun grub pho brang du gdod ma'i sangs rgyas thugs rje yis rang shar dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: 'gyu snang bka' sdod thams cad kyis: rang dam (10na)shar grol mtshang bstan pas bdag 'dzin bral bar ma chad dam: snang rig don gyi gtor ma long : chos nyid ma la bu thim mdzod: de 'og bskal pa bar ma la: mi 'gyur dpal gyi steng khang du rigs 'dzin pad+ma saṃ bha was zhi khro zung 'jug zhal phye tshe ma sring dam can rgya mtsho yis ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: mchod gtor bzhes la 'phrin las mdzod de 'og bskal pa'i tha ma la dag snang dpal ri'i rtse mo sa mos gzugs pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : thol byung nyi zla 'od zer gyis rtsal snang dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: 'od snang bka' sdod thams cad kyis: 'gyu dran bral bar ma ho dam 'dod yon rang shar gtor ma long : snang stong zung du 'jug par mdzod lnga pa bstan ma skyong ba ni: bh+yo: dam tshig dbang gi las mdzad ma rten 'brel bcu gnyis rang dag pa'i —26

rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang sogs/ nang ma rtoganam mo bstan ma bcu gnyis po: dam las ma 'da' gnas 'dir spyon: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhesal: bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod drug pa gtor mnan ni: ྅/ lhun grub zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gnyis 'dzin dam sri bsgral ba yi: lnga phung snyigs mar gyur pa la: dngas ma ye shesabro brdungs pas: rang grol chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i skye med rgya yan lhun gyis grub: bdun pa dngosagrub blang ba ni: / hrī: skye med chos dbyings pho brang nas: thugs rje 'gag med zhi khro'i lha: mnyam nyid dbyings nas sku bzhengs la: sku gsum yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol: zho āḥ// ma hā sirnyi snrobargyad pa bsdu chog ni: ho/ rang rig (10ba)rnam dag sgrub gzhung las: sems snang 'khrul pa'i nyesapa rnams gnyis med don dam ngang du bshags dri med rjen par rtogs par shog: skye med ngang las gzugs sku'i rol par shar: rang rtsal lhun grub zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: rnam bzhi'i 'phrin lasadagongs pa mthar phyin nas: cho ge sku rnam dag skye med dbyings su gshegs: 'gyur med dge ba rnam dag bsgrubs pa las gdod ma'i mgon po kun gyis rtogs par shog sgyi dgongs pa rang shar thugasarjes 'gro rnams 'dren: rtsa brgyud rigs 'dzin bla ma'i bkra shis shog dgongs pa rang shar ye shes 'od 'bar sku thugs rje yongs rdzogs zhi khro'i bkra shis shog: rang rtsal 'gag med sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston: dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog: ces brjod dga' ston glu gar bya lasarnams kun gyi kha skong ba'i las byang ye shes 'khor lo 'di las 'phro can gyi dpal du shog: sam ya: rgya rgya rgya:'dir mkha' 'gro'i brda yig zhig 'dug kyang bri thabs mi 'dug pas ma dper gzigs mdzod/ de ltar las byang sgrub thabs gter srung rnams gter byon rdo rje'i tshig lhad med la/ brgyud 'debs dang sman mchod kyi lhan thabs gsar du sbyar/ 'don cha min pa thams cad ser gyis phye nas bklags chog tu bkod pa'o/ /ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo'i pur rgyal 'gror/ /rjes chags pad+mā ka ras zab gter sman/ /grangs med sbas kyang yid srubs kyis brlams 'gas/ /ha la'i rkyal pa phyi nas phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /—27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gerdzun pod gzig shun gos mdzes rang che skad/ /mgrin mthor bteg nas gzhan 'drid snang 'od rkang / /skal dman ral rtser 'dzegs (11na)pa sngon byung ding / /snga phyi'i spo khams zog rgyal des mtshon mang / /chos min chu dang dam chos 'o ma'i bcud/ /dbye ba'i dpyod ldan lus dkar dbang po des/ /bltas tshe ra gan gser 'khrul rin gzhal ba'i/ /tshod blun rnams la khrel ba'i mgrin rnga 'bro'// /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin 'brul med zab gter sgo/ /'byed mdzad mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched kyi/ /smin grol gdams pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /skal bzang rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod de spro/ /de phyir mi zad 'khor ba mtha' can du/ /byas nas chos nyid zad sar 'byol ba'i dbyings/ /sgrol nus lag na pad dkar 'chang ba yi/ /'phrin las bklags pas don kun grub 'di bkod/ /dge 'dis nam mkha'i tshad mnyam ma rgan 'gro/ khru 'dzin ri bo'i gzhal yas khang bzang du/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sku ru sangs rgyas nas/ /don gnyis 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bkra shis shog /ces thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi las byang zhakhrugs bsdebs su bkod pa bklags pas don grub 'di ni bdag gi pha rgan zhabs drung hor bdud 'dul rab brtan gyi dgongs rdzogs sgrub mchod skyon smin grol gling bar 'dzugs pa'i sta gon gyi tshe sprul sku rin po che gter bdag gling pas chog sgrigs shig gis gsung ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi sngags dkar ma ṇi ba byang sems myu gu rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /—28

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtogan༄༅gyi//thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal sdo/nga bsdo/gas/namaḥpa dha kar su lhum d+mar dwa ra ṇa badzā ya/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal dang dbyer ma mchis pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi'i zhabs kyi pad+ma ra gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o//brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/bde ldan zhing na chosasku 'od mtha' yas/khru 'dzin la dgyes longs sku pad dkar 'chang //da rgya mtshor sprul sku pad+ma 'byung //dbyer med byang chub bar du snying dbus bzhugs//sna nam sngags kyi rnal 'byor sgyu dra'i gar//gter chen nyi zla 'od zer chos kyi rgyal//legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje dpal bzang po//slu med gtan gyi skyabs khyod gtsug na mdzes//dpal brtsegs yang srid bsod nams rnam par rgyal//dz+nyā na'i rnam sprul chos dbyings rang grol rje//bi ma'i zlos gar blo mchog rdo rje'i zhabs//be+e ro dngos byon gter bdag gling pa rgyal//'khor med drin las khreg chod thod rgal gyi//zab mo'i lam bzang mngon sum bstan pa'i mthus//sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang rig tu//'phrod pas dad pa dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel//de phyir 'khor 'das gnyis su rang 2na grol ba'i//bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i dmar khrid gzhung //bdag dang skal mnyam mang por phan pa'i ched//nyams len gsal byed rigs 'dzin zhal lung spel//de'ang thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid nyams su len pa la rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang /rdzogs rim 'ja' lus mchog sbyin/de'i dgongs 'grel chos bdag pa le ba rnam rgyal dpal bzang gisamadzad pa'i gsal byed nor bu'i phreng bar lung skyo/ yang shin tu rgyas par snang bas rdzogs chen mang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepor blo sbyangs pa'i rigs la logs su dgos don mi 'dug kyang gang zag las dang po pa rnams la kha skong dang mi gsal ba rnams tshang na nyams len 'byer bde zhing rang nyid kyi dran pa'i gsal 'debs su tshig nyung don gsal gyi tshul du bkod pa la rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gangs khrod lung stongs ri rtse dur khrod sogs/ /rab tu dben cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i sar/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin spyi'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid skyo shas 'phel phyir gangs khrod/ dge sbyor 'phel phyir lung stongs/ dbyings rig gsal phyir ri rtse/ mi rtag pa skye phyir dur khrod/ rnam g.yeng du mi 'gro ba'i phyir dben gnas/ (2ba tshen nas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir dam pa gong mas zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas rnams gsungs pa phal cher snang
