'khrid kyi dus su bsngags la/ bye brag mun 'khrid kyi dbang du byas na mun pas brgyan pa'i khang bu'am rdo rje chos 'byung gi khang bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mthong brgyud kyi man ngag ltar 'du bgyid dgos shing gnas de lta bur lam nyams su len pa la/ brgyud ldan lta dgongs mtho zhing dngos grub lam/ 'khrul med ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la/ /zhes ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon brgyud pa lnga'am drug 'dus bar ma chad cing dbang 'khrid man ngag la mkhas pa/ lta sgom klong du gyur ba'i dngos grub brnyes pas zab lam 'di nyid la nang byan chud de 'khrul med du ston nus pa zhig la/ dad brtson snying rje che zhing dbang po rno/ /blo yangs dam tshig ldan pa'i las can gyis/ /zhes slob ma dad pa dang ldan pas byin rlabs 'jug pa/ brtson 'grus che bas nyams rtogs myur du skye ba/ snying rje che bas theg chen las mi 'da' ba/ dbang po rno bas lta spyod zab mo dbye nus pa/ blo yangs pas spyod pa rlabs che ba/ dam tshig gtsang bas nyas ltung dang bral ba zhig gis/ lo'am zla ba'i bar du gsol ba btab nas/ /chos 'di'i snod gyur rig nas gnad byin te/ zhes lo dang zla ba'i gong nas 'bad pas gsol ba btab par snod du rung mi rung brtags nas rung ba la ster ba'i dus kyang / dbyar ma ston dang dgun chung dpyid kyi dus/ /zer gnyis dus sogs skabs la babs pa'i tshe/ /zhes dbyar ma ston dang dgun chung dpyid ka zer gnyis kyi dus sogs gtso bor thod rgal ngo sprod dang mngon sum —30

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganagyi ye shes myur du skye ba'i tshad la dgongs shing gza' skar tshes grangs dus la nges pa (3na thad par yang gsungs pas dus skabs dang bstun te/ tshogs gtor dbang yon khams kyi 'tsho ba'i rten/ /yo byad ma tshang med pa sta gon bya/ /zhes rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i tshogasakyi 'khor lo dang dbang lung 'khrid kyi yon/ khams 'tsho ba'i zas mal sogs mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams tshang bar gsog /dam ldan dug lnga shugs chung dag snang che/ /blo brtan ngang ring brtse ba'i grogs bcas la/ /zhes grogs dam tshig dang ldan zhing dug lnga shas chung ba/ dag snang che zhing blo brtan ngang rgyud ring ba/ brtse sems dang ldan pa dag btsal te gong du bshad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ nges shes bskyed phyir lo rgyus zab mo yang / /brgyud pa rin chen 'phreng ba'i lung sbyar bshad/ /ces chos dbyings kun khyab bde chen lhun grub yangs pa'i klong ka dag rang byung gi po ta la ye shes lnga ldan 'od kyi gzhal med khang du/ rang rig chos sku spros bral las rig rtsal ma 'gags longs sku thugs rje chen po yongs grub bde chen la sna tshogs rang shar gyi 'khor bde chen rigs bsdus kyis bskor ba'i tshe/ chos nyid rang byung a ti snying po'i don dgongs pa rang shar chen por bstan pa lasabazang ngan mtha' grol dgongs pa gcig /gting gsal tshom bu lhun grub chen por phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du bzhugs par ston pa nyid las mi gzhan pa'i byang sems thugs rje chen pos bka' rnams bsdus te slob dpon chen po la gdams pa'i tshul ni/ rdo rje gdan gyi shar po ta la'i rtser rigs gsum mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i mar ti ga'i brag phug tu pad+ma thod 'phreng gis 'chi med tshe'i rigs 'dzin brnyes nas rdos bcas (3ba)ma yin pa'i ye shes rang thal 'od lnga'i gzhal yas su spyan ras gzigs dang dngos su mjal nas dbang gi chu bo rdzogs par phab ste grub pa mthar phyin mdzad pa'i mthar man ngag lhan thabs kyi skor thams cad kha bkang / bod yul 'dir mnga' bdag rje 'bangs kyi don du phebs pa'i tshe gdams pa 'di'i sgo nas dngas ma'i 'khor lnga smin grol la bkod/ chos skor rnams dur khrod brgyad kyis sna las grub pa'i za ma tog tu gtams pa bsam yas —3/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebar khang gi rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs gar rgyas btab ste las 'phro can la smon lam du mdzad la/de'ang rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi lung byang las/ 'di nas nyi ma nub phyogs su/ /yang 'dul pra dun rtse yi lho/ /ge gar klu yi kha gnon byang / /ri rgyal glang chen 'gying 'dra'i 'dabs/ /chu chen drag po 'bab pa'i 'gram/ /glo bo ma thad zhes bya'i phur/ /rje rigs sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa/ /pha ma rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi bu/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong nas bskrun/ /bi ma 'tsho rgyal sprul pa'i sras/ /spun bdun tshigs sam mtha' ru 'byung / /lhums nas hūṃ saḥ'i sgra sgrog cing / /skyes pa'i lo nas bde skyid ldan/ /yul khams bde zhid bsam don grub/ /chu khams lug gam spre'u lo pa/ /bdag gis byin brlabs pad+ma rgyal/ /'tsho rgyal byin brlabs 'od zer ming / /chos rgyal byin brlabs gro bo lod/ /nam snying rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /bdud 'joms byin brlabs rdo rje'i ming / /be+e ros byin brlabasagater bdag gling / /zhes sogs kyis paṇa chen sku mched gnyis thun mong du lung bstan pa'i spre'u'i lo pa dang rdo rje'i ming can ni legs ldan zhabs kyi dgung snying dang mtshan gsal (4na thar bstan la/sgos gter 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi lo rgyus las/ bdag gi smon lam dbang btsan pas/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms skye ba'i mthar/ /byang sems spre'u'i lo pa zhig /las ldan thog 'bab tshul du 'byung / /de yis 'di 'byin 'gro 'dren 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar mnga' ris glo bo ma thang gi phur lha rigs sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i sprul sku gter chen nyi zla 'od zer ram legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjes yab gtso bor gyur pa'i bshes gnyen lnga bcu rtsa brgyad las chos 'tshol ba'i ched du dbus gtsang stod smad kun la byon te dka' ba spyad cing thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin/skabs shig spa gro stag tshang du bzhugs pa'i mnal lam dang mngon sum du slob dpon chen pos zhal mang du bstan cing zab mo'i gdams pa mtha' yas pa gnang / gnas kyi lung bstan ltar spa gro nyid nas kha byang rnyed de/ lugs gsum mi 'gyur dpal bsam yas bar khang gi rten gtso rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas zab gter 'di nyid spyan drangs/ de'i tshe zhang sna nam pa dang rigs 'dzin rgod —32

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganaldem du sku zhakhrungs pa gsal bar dran te gdul bya'i tshogs la bka' stsal/ mchims phu'i yang dben sogs su thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen por nyams len rtags thon par mdzad nas 'bri gung byang chub gling thog kha gser khang gi yang dben du shog ser rnams phab cing lung bstan ltar byin rlabs kyi dbang bka' spros med gsang rgya'i tshul du lo gsar zla bar zhal phye bas bum chu khol zhing kha rgyan gyi ba lu las me tog kha bye/ sgrub khang du dri bzang rgyun du 'thul zhing yig drug gi rang sgra sgrog pa sogs gsang ba bsam (4ba)gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa dang ldan pa'i gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjes zab chos 'di nyid skal ldan gyi slob ma mang por stsal ba'i nang nas/ lo rgyus lung bstan du/ byang nas don grub sna tsho gos dpal/ /dkon mchog phun tshogs 'byung gnas mgon/ /sngo ljang 'dzin byed las ldan 'byung / zhes pa'i bka' babs kyi chos bdag ba le ba rnam rgyal dpal bzang la rdzogs par gnang / de la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin sogs mkhas grub du ma'i yang srid rje stag lung thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang rnal rgyal gyis gsan/ de la rje ba le ba'i sprul pa'i sku mchog mkhas btsun bkra shis dpal grub kyis gsan/ de la paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra'i rnam par sprul pa khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rjes legs par gsan nas chos 'di'i srog 'thud pa'i bka' drin mtha' klas pa la zhes sogs lo rgyus rnams kyis spro ba bskyed cing 'jug pa bde bar byed na skabs 'dir rdul tshon nam ras bris gang rung la brten nas dbang bzhi legs par nod nas 'khrid dngos la/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum gyi/ dang po la thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po la/ thun mong sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs skyabs 'gro bya/ /zhes pas 'di dang po 'og ma'i sa bcad dang po ston par dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag rnams lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa'i rigs la gtod mi dgos kyang ma sbyangs pa rnams la lam gyi ming rdo lta bu yin pas thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i chos spyod lam rim chen mo dang lam mchog rin chen phreng —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pob sogs (ldan thag cha gzhan nas blangs te rdo rus thug par sprod/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la lam log pa las ldog pa skyabs su 'gro ba/ dman pa las ldog pa sems bskyed pa/sdig sgrib sbyong ba yig brgya'i sgom bzlas/ byin rlabs 'jug pa mos gus rnal 'byor/ tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal/ bar chad sel ba srung 'khor/ smin par byed pa dbang bskur ba dang bdun las/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ skyabs yul sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum ste phyi nang gsang gsum la skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du shes nas de las thar bar bya ba'i phyir dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas blangs te/ 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du bgyis nas byang gter gyi sngon 'gro gnad kyi gzer lnga'i/ bdag dang khams gsum sems can kun/ /zhes pa nas/ rtse gnyig gus pasaskyabs 'gro bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi brjod don/ rang gi spyi bo'i mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar brgyud pa drug 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi rnam pa can dgyes 'dzum gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma dang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thamasacad du shākya seng ge sogs sprul sku dang longs sku zhi khro'i tshogs/ lho'i 'dab ma dang de'i phyogs kun tu gsung gi snying po rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu'i glegs bam dang gser dang be+e ḍūr+ya sa dris pa'i btags grol gyis bar mtshams med par khyab pa'i chos dkon mchog /nub tu rigs gsum (5bsgo gon po sogs theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun/ byang du gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro chos srung spyi dang e ka dzā ṭi dang khyab 'jug shing bya can sogs sgos kyi srung ma'i tshogs rnams gsal gdab/ 'og tu bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la de ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis rigs drug tu 'khyams pa rnams thar pa'i sa la 'god pa'i ched du/ kye ma/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can kun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug tshar gcig brjod nas/ yon tan kun 'byung dngos grub mchog gi gnas/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ chos stong dam can rnams la skyabs su —34

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganamachi'i bar lan grangs gsum mam bdun gang rung dang las byang gi skyabs 'gro brgya'am lnga bcu sogs brjod cing yid khyad shes kyi dad pa brtan pos snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro dgos te chos sku blo 'das kyi ngo bo la brtan pa thob na bskyab bya skyob byed dang bral yang de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams 'khor ba las grol ba'i thabs 'di las zab pa med do/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ byang chub sems bsgom bsam sbyor gzhan don bslab/ /ces gsungs pa'i don bzhin rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde bsgrub pa'i theg dman la gol ba ma yin par sems can thams cad pha mar shes nas phan 'dogs 'dod kyi smon sems dang de'i ched du rang lus lha skur 'char ba/ rtsa thig rlung gsum 'byongs pa/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'drongs pa/ spros bral ka dag rtogs pa/ 'od gsal snang bzhi 'char ba'i zab lam rdzogs pa chen po'i don nyams su blangs te rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang mngon du byas nas 'gro ba rnams 'dren (6na)par byed snyam du 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi ched du/ bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug ci rigs pa brjod do/ /gsum pa yig brgya'i rnal 'byor ni/ rgyal ba'i thugs srog yi ge brgya pa ni/ /stobs bzhi'i bshags pa'i tshul gyis rang rgyud sbyang / /zhes pa ltar/ rang gi sgyu lus bem po 'di'i zhes sogs kyi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed lugs/ zhe sdang shas che ba la mthing ga /ser sna dang nga rgyal can la ser po/ gti mug can la dkar po/ 'dod chags can la dmar po/ phrag dog can la ljang gu rnams gang 'dul gyi sku dang / dug lnga spyi 'joms la rdor sems kyi gnas lngar rdor sems rigs lnga rnams bsam/ de yi thugs skar yi ge āḥzhes pa hūṃ du bsgyur hūṃ la yi ge brgya pa rang mdog dang mthun pas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa zhabs kyi mthe bong nas thon/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dud khu/ sol khu/ rnag khrag /srog chags kyi rnam par rkang mthil gnyis dang bshang gci gnyis nas thon te rang gi lus shel gong ltar dag par bsams pa'i dmigs —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2popa dang bcas yi ge brgya pa grag stong gi ngang nas ci nus bzla/ de'ang spyi bor lha bsgom pa rten gyi stobs/sngags dang ting nge 'dzin ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ /sngon chad kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad kyi sdig pa la sdom sems ni slar ldog pa'i stobs te stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas thal mo sbyar zhing don rdor sems kyang bla ma'i bar bltas nas/ bdagagis mi shes pa dang bag (6ba〉yed pa dang ma gus pa dang snyoms las kyi dbang gis sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs ci bsags pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang sems dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i spros bral gyi ngang du cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog cing sems can thams cad kyang sdig sgrib dag bya dag byed dang bral te snang grag thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi sgo nas bskyang / de'ang rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad ka nas dag pa'i gnas lugs kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa rnams spru bsrung bya srung byed sbyang bya sbyong byed dang bral yang / de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la ni mtshams med lnga'i las byas kyang skad cig la sbyangs te 'khor ba dong nas sprug go /bzhi pa mos gus rnal 'byor ni/ byin rlabs dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma'i lam mchog mos gus gnad du bsnun/ /zhes pa ltar nyams su blang ba la 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i gzar/ rang gi yul mkhar khang khyim dang / /zhes sogs kyi don phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig /nang bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba sogs rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bsam pa'i mi rtag pa thun du bcad de bsgoms pas chos la ngam ngam shugs kyis 'jug cing dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad na'ang rang nyid skal ba dman pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'dir de las sgrol ba'i theg pa'i yang rtse 'od gsal rdo rje snying po ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon des tshe 36

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtogan(7na)'dir sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba'i lam bstan pas rang ngos nas sangs rgyas kun las bka' drin che ba'i phyir yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar dkon pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom snyam du bsams te/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs ka dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khrud pa/ de'i pang g.yon du yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal sku mdog dkar mo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can nu ma dang bha ga rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba stob pa/ dbu skra gnag snum rgyab tu nyil ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ yab rdo rje skyil krung dang yum pad+ma'i 'dug stangs mdzad pa/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can ye shes rang 'od 'khrug pa'i slong na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar ā+oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar saḥdamar po dang ma mthing gas mtshan pa skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsams te gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas thog mar las byang gi rgyud 'debs tshar gcig gam mi spro na chad skyon du mi 'gyur bas/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ /longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol bca/ /bdag la:/ /sprul sku pad+ma (7ba〉2byung gnas la:/ /bdag la — / /mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal la://bdag laḥ/ /sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms la:/ /bdag la:/ /gter ston nyi zla 'od zer la:/ /bdag la:/ /chos bdag rnam rgyal dpal bzang la:/ /bdag la:/ /mkhas btsun ngag dbang rnam rgyal laḥ / /bdag laḥ/ /mtshungs med bkra shis dpal grub laḥ/ /khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje laḥ/ bdag la:/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma laḥ / /bdag la:/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs la:/ /bdag laḥ / /mched lcam rdo rje'i spun grogs la / /bdag la : / /dbang bzhis bdag rgyud smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /—37—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebaskyed rim phra rags 'byongs par byin gyis / /zab lam gtum mo 'byongs paraḥ/ /dga' bzhi'i bde chen 'drongs par jo/ /gnas lugs rang ngo shes par / /bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod paraḥ / /zhen med blo las 'das par:/ /ye grol ka dag rtogs par ཿ/ /chos nyid mngon sum mthong b.raḥ/ /nyams snang gong du 'phel b.raḥ/ /rig pa tshad la phebs paraḥ / /chos rnams zad sar 'khyol b.raḥ / /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlomes/ /zhes pa ci rigs dang / rtsa gsum lha tsho gos rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa brgya phrag tsam gyis snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bo dpral ba'i ā+oṃ las 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar po byung ba (8na)rang gi spyi bor thim pas rtse mo rnam bkod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu gang bas lus sgrib dag /bum dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / gos bu sprul sku 'grub/ de bzhin du gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo mgrin pa'i āḥlas: / mgrin par thim pas ro 'dus 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gang bas ngag sgrib dag /gsang dbang thob/lam gtum moḥ/ 'bras bu longs sku / thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo thugs ga'i hūṃ lasaḥ/ snying ga dran pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgyad gang bas yid sgrib dag zhar dbang thob/ lam dga' bzhi cha/ 'bras bu chos sku:/ ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo lte ba'i khyuḥ ma las:/ lte bar thim pas skyed byed 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab re bzhi gang bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas paḥ/ rig pa'i rtsal dbangaḥ /lam rdzogs pa chen po:/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid skuḥ/ de'ang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu rang rig kun tu bzang po gdod ma nas rang la gnas kyang de nyid ngo 'phrod pa bla ma la rag las pas bla ma chos skur bltas te gsol ba btab pas chos nyid kyi don rtogs/ longs skur bltas pas sku dang zhing khams kyi yon tan skye/ sprul skur bltas pas sa lam gyi yon tan skye ba'i phyir rnal 'byor 'di nyid lam thams cad rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /lnga pa tshogs gsog pa na/ bsod nams mi zad rgya mtsho spel ba'i phyir/ /phyi nang gsang —38

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganagasum maṇ+ḍal tshogs 'khor bya/ /zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la/ sngon byung bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang tshogs gnyis gsog par mdzad pas nges par gal (8ba)che zhing pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la dka' ba brgya phrag spyod pa rnams 'dir maṇ+ḍal du bsdus te thabs zab mo'i sgo nas mdzad pas phyi'i maṇ+ḍal la gser dngul/ 'khar ba/ rdo shing sogs ci 'byor ba'i maṇ+ḍal dang tshom bu'i rgyur gro nas kyis mtshon pa sta gon bya bla ma sprul sku'i zhing la gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla sogs dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul te/ na mo/ dbang chen gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la/ /zhes sogs kyis dbul/ bla ma longs sku'i zhing la nang gi maṇ+ḍal sgrub pa po rang nyid tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched du sha khrag rus pa dang gzhan yang 'jig rten khams kyi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gcig tu byas te/ hūṃ/ bdag lus 'byung bzhi 'dusapa'i pho brang du/ /zhes sogs brjod/ bla ma chos sku'i zhing la gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal dngos sam yid kyis gzung ma dbul te/ hūṃ/ pad+ma can sogs yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs/ /rked phra nu 'bur bha ga mngon par rgyas/ /dbang po drug la dga' ba'i dpal ster ba/ /nam mkha'i khams kun yongs su bkang ste dbul/ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu drangasapa'i/ /bde stong ye shes mchogo gis dgyes bskyed nas/ /thabs lam zab mos tshe 'dir grol byin rlobs/ /zhes brjod/ bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi zhing la yang gsang spros pa med pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni/rang sems mkha' la mchod bya mchod byed yul/ /sprin 'ja' ltar snang sems nyid gcig pu'i 'phrul//blo 'das rig ngo 'phrod pa'i mchod pa yis/ /spros bral ka dag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas tshogs bsags nas (9na)mchod yul gyi bla ma 'od du zhu rang sems dang dbyer med du khrug gis 'dres pas/ nang gi 'byung ba bzhi 'od dkar ser dmar ljang du zhu/ phyi rol gyi 'byung ba bzhi yang 'od du zhu ste nang gi 'byung ba bzhi la thim/ 'od des rigasadrug gi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha yi ngo bor shig gi /sgrar grag tshad chosakyi sgrar dir ri/ sems gsal stong du yer re ba'i ngang nas rang babs su mnyam par 'jog /maṇ+ḍal —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (27)phul bas gnas skabs su dngos po la chen pa ldog cing longs spyod 'phel/ zhing khams bzang por skye/ bla ma ngo bo nyid skur bltas nas phul bas rig pa kun tu bzang por ngo 'phrod/ chos skur bltas pas nges don gyi yon tan rgyud la skye/ longs skur bltas pas sku dang zhing khams rgyas/ /sprul skur bltas pas 'gro ba dpag med 'dren par nus pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa rgyud la skye zhing rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la brten nas 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs gsog nus pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /rdzogs chen gzhan la skabs 'dir ku su lu'i tshogs gsog yong ba phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin kyang gter gzhus du mi gsal bas btang snyoms su bzhag la spro na g.yin nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/drug pa srung 'khor dang bdun pa bum dbang gnyis ni/ phyi nang mtshams bcad sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrangs te/ bsnyen sgrub rdzogs nas bum dbang legs par bskur/ /zhes pa ltar dbang bskur ba'i sngon du slob dpon bsnyen pa'i kha gso byed pa'i ched du srung 'khor bsgom zhing gzhung bsrangs nas bsnyen sgrub byas te bum dbang bskur rjes bum dbang gi 'khrid 'bebs/ des (9ba)mtshon 'og ma'i 'khrid rnams kyi 'gor so so'i dbang bskur ba la dgongs shing rgyas par spro na de ltar legs mod la jug pa bde phyir dbang thams cad gong du bskur ba'i lugs su bgyis nas ma spros so/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ brtson 'grus rab tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba/ 'bring bar dor 'tshang rgya ba/ tha ma dang sdig can btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i gdams pa dang gsum gyi/ dang po la/ bum dbang gi 'khrid/ gsang dbang gi 'khrid/ sher dbang gi 'khrid/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang gi 'khrid dang bzhi'i dang po bum dbang gi lam snang stong lha'i bskyed rim gyi 'khrid la/ phyi nang bden 'dzin 'khrul pa dag bya'i phyir/ /gsal stong sgyu 'phrul lha yi bskyed rim bsgom/ /zhes pa ltar skyed pa ma hā yo ga /lung a nu yo ga /rdzogs pa a ti yo ga dang gsum las dang po ni/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rang rig hri: zhes pa'i stong nyid kyi don chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' thams —40

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganacad dang bral ba'i ka dag chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang las de ltar ma rtogs pas don dam par med bzhin du ma rig pa'i dbang gis bden par bzung bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams la brtse ba'i snying rje chen po gdangs 'gag med du shar ba longs sku kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang gdangs de'i ngang nas chu las chu lhar rdol ba ltar rang gi rig pa yiḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa lam gyis shar ba ni sprul sku rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin/ de las 'od zer sngo ljang dkar ser dmar po rnams kyi thigs pa chad pa las 'byung ba lnga rim brtsegs su bskyed/ de'i steng du : yig chad pa las 'og gzhi sna (10na)tshogasapad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba gru bzhi'i steng du rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dmar dkar ser sngo ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu phyed 'byar la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ sgyu 'phrul du 'dod snam gyi kha 'gram pha gus bskor bar bshad pas mtha' gcig tu nges pa med cing snga ma ltar na/ de'i steng na rin po che'i bre phul gyis bteg pa'i gser gyi spang leb kyi kha nas dra ba dang dra phyed 'phyang ba/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i pad+ma'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bris pa gdung zlum gyis bskor ba phye ma sne nang ma dang phyi ma gser gyi ska rags la bkal ba'i bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i mda' yab spyi blugs kha thur du bstan pa'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du pu shu pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i rnam pas bskor bar gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas spras pa/ dbus kyi re'u mig gi steng nas ka chung gis bteg pa'i rgya phubs rin po che'i tog dang bcas pa/ snga 'gyur gyi gzhung las/ 'di yan mchod rten gyi bum pa'i dbyibs 'don pa'ang yod/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bzhi la 'khor lo ri dwags sogs yod pa'i bum mgo can mdzad/ rtsig pa'i 'gram du 'dod snam la mchod lha gar byed pa/ phyi rol tu rdo rwa me ri dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi shar dkar/lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po lte ba stong pa rtsibs bzhi —41

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'asbubs stang can rtsibs kyi rtsa ba las cha phran phyed gsum gyis mtho ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba'i mdun ngos dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir zla gdan/ lte rgyab tu nyi ma dang baṃ/ rtsibs bzhi dang sgo bzhir (10ba)pad nyi zhing rkyang gi gdan re gsal gdab/ dbus kyi gdan steng du rgyu'i sa bon hrīḥyig babs pa 'od du zhu nas lte ba'i gdan gnyis kyi steng du thig le ye shes lnga'i rang gdangs 'od lnga'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba re re bsam/ 'khor rnams ni dper na gtso bo'i chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang gdangs las mi bskyod thugs rje chen po dang byams pa tshad med las shar gyi sgo ma gsal 'debs pas sa bon zur du mi dgos/ de'ang gtso 'khor rnams kyi mngon rtogs las byang nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab ste/ rten brten pa rnams kyi rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin/ bye brag tu sems 'dzin pa ni/ gzhal yas khang la mtshon na rtsig pa rim pa lnga la dmigs te/ ched du gsal btab nas reg mthong gi mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ de bzhin du phyi'i dur khrod nas nang gi gdan gyi bar thams cad la sems 'dzin/ brten pa lha la'ang thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyi mdzod spu dang rta mgrin gyi spyan dbusam la sems bzung ste spyan gyi dkar nag tshun ma 'dres pa gsal 'debs/ rim bzhin shangs dang snyan sogs sku'i cha shas so so dang rgyan cha lugs la brtag /de nas sgo ma'i bar gyi 'khor rnams la'ang dmigs pa spo/ de'ang lo zlar sbrel te nyams 'khrid byar yod na dmigs pa shin tu zhib par ngo sprod ci cing zla grangs dang zhag grangs la tshar dgos pa'i rigs la gtso bo'i sems 'dzin rags pa tsam dang gzhan rnams la mdor bsdus rig pas dpyod/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol de nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po sogs la sems 'dzin du 'jug /bzlas pa'i tshe rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du saḥdamar po la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros (11na〉spyobs gnas thams cad mchod cing rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus/ bdag gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kur thim pas sku gsum ye shes lnga'i dbang thob par bsam/ des mtshon rang nyid lha so so'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal —42

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganal brten nas dmigs pa gong ltar kha spo/ bye brag gi dmigs pa gtso bo'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis bsdus pa'i snang mdzad rigs kyi bder gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa rang la thim pas nyon mongs pa gti mug sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas bsgyur te me long ye shes mngon du byed/ de bzhin du mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal bzung nas mi bskyod rigs kyi 'od zer thim pas zhe sdang sbyang ba sogs rigs 'gre/ yang 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyang ba sogs lasabazhi'i dmigs pa so sor spo'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas dngos grub yid bzhin du 'grub cing zhi sogs kyi las rnams thogs pa med par byin no/ /gnyis pa lung a nu yo ga la stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi gdangs snying rje kun snang gi rgyu las srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang nyid 'khor ba dbyings sgrol yab yum du gsal ba'i yab yum gyi sku phru ma phus btab pa 'ja' dmar gyi gur lta bu'i nang du rtsa dbu ma chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa ste khyad chosabazhi ldan/ lus kyi srog shing ltar gnas pa'i snying ga dang spyi bo gnyis su rtsa 'dab brgyad pa gdugs kyi rtsib ma'i dbyibs can re re bsam/ de'i rgyu mtshan dper na tsan dan gyi dri sdong po kun la khyab kyang rtsa bar bzang zhing khrag lus byings la khyab kyang rtsa chen rnams nas lhag par 'bab pa dang 'dra bas (11ba tshe khor lo gnyis kyi gnad gcun pa'i zab gnad 'di rdzogs chen pa rnams kyi man ngag go /snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gyi lte bar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la 'khor ba dbyings sgrol yab yum rigs bdag 'od dpag med dang bcas pa phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhir rigs bzhi yum bcas/ de so so'i rgyab tsam du sgo ma ḍā gi bzhi zhi ba g.yas lcags kyu zhag bas sgrog dril bu 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa rin po che'i rgyan ldan sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa mtshams kyi rtsa nang gzhi ye shes lnga'i 'od zer gyi dra bas 'brel bar bsgom/ gtso bo'i thugs las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dbu ma'i lam brgyud de spyi bor slebs par brten dung khang gi rtsa 'khor dbus su zla gam dmar por pad nyi —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobadud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng du rta mgrin yab yum/ phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhir dbang chen rigs bzhi/ so so'i rgyu ba tsam du sgo ba ging chen dzi bzhi g.yas thod khrag 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa rnams gsal gdab/ yum gyi sku'i nang du dbu ma 'khor lo gnyis dang bcas pa 'ja' tshon rnam pa ste 'bras bu sku dang ye shes rnam par dag pa yab yum lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ rang gi snying dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ga'i hrīḥlas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dmar po dbu ma'i lam brgyud de dung khang 'khor lo'i rta mgrin gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de las phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs/ 'od kyi rnam par rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs gar thim pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra spros te sku gang / yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs pa do li'i bzlas pa/ ci rigs pa'i mthar gtso bo zhal nas 'od dang bdud rtsi 'phros pa mi bskyod pa'i zhal du zhugs/ (12na)thugs gar thim pa'i bdud rtsi yum gyi mkhar spro bsdu/ do li sogs sbyor ba rigs gzhan rnams la'ang 'gre/ de nas mi bskyod pa'i thugs ka nas 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa shar gyi sgo ma'i zhal du zhugs sku'i nang gang / de las 'phros pa'i bdud rtsis kyang mtshams kyi shar lho'i rtsa 'dab gang ba sogs g.yin gsum la'ang sbyar/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ rta mgrin gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas sras bcas spyan drangs/ 'od zer gyi rnam pa rang gi zhal nas yar zhugs/ spyi bo'i rta mgrin gyi thugs kar thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa sogs 'khor lugasazhi ba'i gtso bo dang mtshungs/ gtso bo las 'od zer spros te badz+ra he ru ga'i zhal du zhugs pa sogs rta mgrin ji lta ba nas mtshams kyi rtsa 'khor bdud rtsis gang ba'i bar snying ga dang 'dra/ de nas snying ga dang spyi bo'i lha las babs pa'i bdud rtsis dbu ma'i nang kun gang / de nas phyi dkyil gyi yab kyi sku'i nang gang / rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra zhugs/ sku gang bas dbu ma dang 'khor lo gnyis 'od zer bkrag mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ de nas yum gyi zhal nas rlung gi gdangs chu yig gi rnam pa —44

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganacan thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs te snying gar ā'i rnam par gnas/ rdo rje'i lam nasa3 gi rnam par thon te yum gyi pad+ma ra zhugs nas khor mo yug tu rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas rtsa khams byin gyis brlabs nas rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i 'go brtsams te bde stong gi ye shes skye ba sogs dngos grub mtha' klas pa 'grub bo/ /gsum pa rdzogs pa a ti yo ga ni/ rang sems(12ba〉skye med chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ rang gdangs 'gags pa med pa kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin/ de nyid zung du 'jug pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te yo ga snga ma gnyis ltar rim bzhin bskyed mi dgos par sku gsum gdod ma nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pas rdos bcas 'byung ba lnga rang sar dag pa'i yon tan de ga lhun grub rten gzhal yas khang dang rig pa rang byung rang shar ba zhi ba dang de'i rtsal 'gag pa med pa khro bo/ /sgra grag stong du bsgrag pa bzlas pa/ 'khor 'das kun rang shar rang grol bde chen du lhun gyis grub pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems la rdzogs te rang sems las gzhan du rten brten pa kun gang du'ang ma grub pas gzhal yas khang dang lha thams cad sems kyi rol par nges pa rnyed pa lam 'di'i gtso bo yin pas nyams su blang zhing phyi rdul tshon lta bu la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ni sems kyis ched du btags pa'i bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor yin la/ de las nang phung khams skye mched rten brten pa'i sgrub gzhi rang byung gi dkyil 'khor bag la nyal ba sems kyis ched du gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor zab/ de las ma bcos lhun grub rig pa rang byung gi dkyil 'khor 'dus ma byas pa de nyid ches zab pas yog gzhan gnyis la'ang 'dis rtsis:na pa gnad du che ba sngon gyi sngags 'chang ral pa can rnams kyi thugs dam gyi snying po yin pas rnying gsar pa rnams dgongs 'tshal lo /gnyis pa gsang dbang gi 'khrid ni/ lus snang bag chags rags pa dag gyur nas/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur rtsa rlung man ngag bsgom/ /zhes pa ltar gnas dben par skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas stan bde bar tsog pur rkang pa gnyis bsnol/ lag pa gnyis mnyam gzhag lte 'og tu bca'/ /—45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2posgal tshigs drang bar bsrang / mgrin pa (13na〉drung zad bkug /dpung pa gnyis phyir brgyang / lusakyi cha bsgrim/ mig gnyis sna rtser phab/ rlung ro g.yon nas dal bus rgyang gis 'bud/ de bzhin du g.yas dang dbus/ yang g.yas sogs gong ltar la drag pa gsum/ yang shin tu drag pa gsum 'bud/mthar mchil ma zhig mid pa dang mnyam du steng rlung chir gyis mnan/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum cung zad dang bcas bsdam yang yar 'then drag pa mi mdzad/ rlung gang thub kyi bar bzung nas mthar sna rtse'i spu mi 'gul ba'i tshul gyis gtong / de 'dra kha yar byas pa'i rjes su lus stong sang lta bur bsams pa'i ngang nas chu las nya 'phar ba ltar rang thugs rje chen po yab yum du gsal ba'i sku stong ra'i dbus na rtsa dbu ma khyad chos bzhi ldan yar sna tshangs bug dang mar sna rdo rje'i rtsa bar zug pa sba lcag 'bring po tsam pa'i tshad kyi g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar ba la dmar shar re ba'i mdangs can mda' smyug phra shos tsam pa lte 'og nas gyes te 'khor lo rnams la 'gyud de klad rgya'i thad kyi steng nas smin mtshams su gug pa sna bug gnyis po'i nang du zug pa/ mar sna dbu ma'i nang du gug pa cha'i dbyibs can/ gsang gnas bde ba'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lte ba skyed byed 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi/ snying ga dran pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad/ mgrin pa ro 'dus 'bor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug /spyi bo rtse mo rnam bkod 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu/ 'dab ma rnams gdugs kyi rtsib ma bzhin phub pa'i lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su rin 'byung yab yum gsal btab/ de'i rtsa dbu ma'i yar snar nya dkar po chu'i rang bzhin mgo bo thur du bstan pa/rang nyid kyi (13ba)gsang ba'i rtsa mdud dbus su a thung shad kyi rnam pa drod kyi rang bzhin dmar hur re ba zhig gsal gdab/ rlung 'jam por sna bug gnyis nas nang du rngubs/ ro rkyang gnyis nas thur du phyin te dbu ma'i nang du zhugs pas sol me la phus btab pa bzhin a shad la phog pas drod je che dang mdog je dmar la song ba'i ngang nas mar me 'bring po tsam zhig tal gyis 'bar ba'i rtse mo rta rnga brgya gshags kyi tshad tsam pa zhig lte ba'i rin 'byung gi gsang gnas nas rtsa lam —46

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganabargyud de spyi bo'i snya la phog pas mar la lcags bsregs bzhin ltem gyis zhu/ des rkyen byas nas yab yum gnyis kyi thugs rgyud la bde chen skyes te sbyor ba mdzad pas byang chub kyi sems thams cad rtsa lam brgyud de spyi bo rnya la thim/ de nas 'o rkyal la lcags thur bsnun pa ltar nya las byang sems babs pa skra shad 'dzings bzhin pa'i ngang nas yab yum gnyis kyi sku gang / de nas phyir thon te dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas rang gi gsang ba'i rtsa mdud kyi bar byang sems kyis gang bar bsams shing bum pa can ci nus su bsgom/ rlung mi thub par nye ba na cung zad rngubs nas 'dzin cing / de rjes sna bug gnyis nas dal bur gtong ba'i tshe dmigs pa rlung dbu mar zhugs te tshangs bug nas sngo sangs kyis song bar bsam/ de ltar zhag grangs ci nus su nan tan bsgoms pas drod dang bde ba cher skye zhing de la brten nas dngas ma 'chor ba'i nyen byung na a shad lte bar spo/ /snying gar mi bskyod pa yab yum gsal btab ste sgom lugs sngar ltar byas pas gtum mo'i me lha 'phog pa sogs gong bzhin la/ byang sems kyis dbu ma brgyud de lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang nas bde drod ma skyes bar bsgom/ yang a shad snying ga dang mgrin par 'od dpag med gsal btab ste me sbar bas snying ga'i bde drod skye/a (14na slond mgrin pa dang spyi bor snang mdzad gsal ba'i 'bar 'dzag gi mthar yar lud pas spyi bo yang gang bas mgrin pa dang spyi bo'i bde drod skye ba sogs ma byung gi bar nyams su bstar ro/ /de ltar bsgoms pas dbu ma kha bye nas rtsa bdud phal cher grol dngas ma rgyas pas bde stong gi ye shes gong du 'phel/ thun mong gi yon tan dpag tu med pa thob cing 'chi med tshe'i rigs 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi 'khrid la/ rang lus thabs ldan ni/ bde drod thob nas shes rab ye shes dbang / /rdzogs par bskur zhid dga' bzhi'i man ngag bstan/ /ces pa ltar gnas shin tu dben par skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i a wa dhu ti'i yar snar snya yig dang mdun du yid kyis sprul pa'i gzung ma mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bha —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geg dang nu ma mngon par rgyas pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can zhig gsal gdab/ de nyid gsang ba ye shes kyi ḍā ki mar bsgom/ yab yum gnyis kyi mkha' gsang spyi ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni bsnyen pa/ 'khyud pa dang tsusba sna tshogs dang bcas te mnyam par sbyor ba ni nye bsnyen/ de nasabasrub cing sbyor ba la brten nas lte ba'i drod kyis spyi bo'i lha zhu ba'i byang sems mgrin par slebs pas dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su ma myong gi bar du bsgom/ de bzhin du snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang gnas su lhan cig skyes dga'i bar bsgom zhing rlung 'dzin pa ni sgrub pa/slar yang rlung gis bskul nas gyen du ldog ste lte bar slebs pas rgyu mthun gyi dga' ba/ snying gar rnam smin/ mgrin par skyes bu phyed/ spyi bor dri bral 'bras(14ba)bu'i dga' ba rnams nyams su myong / de'ang thog ma'i skabs su rlung dang dmigs pa tsam gyis chog kyang bde ba cher skyes na sto ba ri rab la sbyar/ sor mo bskum/ lce rtse skan la sbyar/ nyi zla gyen la ldog /hūṃ ring dang bcas te byang sems yar 'dren/ /dud 'gro'i sprug stangs kyis dgram par bya ba ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ /rtsa mdud rdzogs par 'grol phyir gzhan lus thabs ldan la brten nas las la sbyor ba dngos ni/ bde stong ting 'dzin las su rung gyur nas/ /dme mu dra'i bogs 'byin rtsal sbyong bya/ /zhes pa ltar nyams su blang ba deng sang mkho chung bas ma bris shing spro na sher dbang gi skabs su cung zad bstan cing rgyas par klong gsal dang zab rgya sogs rdzogs chen gyi gzhung g.yin dag las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rig pa'i rtsal dbang la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi/ dang po sngon 'gro la/bzhi pa'i dbang bskur 'khor 'das ru shan dbye/ /rtsal sbyang rgyas gdab mnyen btsal lam gzhug dang //byung gnas 'gro gsum mtshang btsal rnal dbab cing / /mngon 'gro'i yan lag ma lus rdzogs par bya/ /zhes pa ltar la 'khrid gzhung du mdor bsdus tsam las ma gsungs pa 'dir nyams len 'khyer bde ba'i ched du cung zad spros na ru shan dbye ba/ sgrib pa sbyang ba/ sngon du 'gro ba/ rnal du dbab pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po ru shan dbye ba la lus ngag yid gsum las/ dang po lus 'khor 'das ru —48—

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganashan dbye ba la/ gnas dben par 'gro ba rigs drug gi spyod tshul tsha dmyal la me mdag bsgo ba dang grang dmyal la chur 'jug pa/ yi dwags la zas skom gcod pa/ dud 'gro la theg par dka' ba bskur ba/ mi la zhid las dang mkhar brtsig pa (15na〉lha min la g.yul sprod pa/ lha la pi waṃ brdung ba lta bus mtshon pa mdzad srol yod mod/ 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na/ sems can thams cad kyi don du lus ngag yid dang 'khor ba ru shan phye la phyis 'khor bar mi ldog snyam du sems bskyed/ dmyal ba'i lus kyi skabs gnas der dngos su skyes par bsgoms nas/ 'khums pa/ rengs pa/ 'gre ldog /'phra gshag /so tham pa/ 'dar ba rnams dngos su bya/ de nas mi bskyod thugs rje chen po dang dbang chen badz+ra he ru ka sogs zhi khro'i bzhugs stangs sna tshogs byed cing mthar rdo rje'i 'dug stangs lag pa gnyis spyi bor thal mo brkyang sbyar/ rkang pa'i mthil gnyis sprad/ nywa bzhi bsgrim/ sgal tshigs thad gar bsrang / ltag rtsa drang por 'then/ mig bar snang la ha re bltas pa'i yar rtse gsum ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje/ mar rtse gsum sku gsum mtshon phyir rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i dbyibs 'byung ba dang sgom don kha dog dkar po dang rtsa lnga par bslab/ de nas dmyal ba'i lus blangs par sdug bsngal/ da lta'i bde ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i bzhugs stangs rnams la gnyis 'dzin gyi re dogs dgag sgrub sogasa.e 'dug rjes shes rang gi rgyud la bkal nas bltas te sngon chad ma rig pa'i dbang gis de ltar myong yang rig pa ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang dbyer med yin pas/ da phyin chad dmyal bar skye 'gyur gyi sbyang gzhi zhi khro'i bzhugs stangs kyis sbyangs pas slad nas dmyal ba'i lus kyi 'brel thag gcod snyam du bsam zhing goms pa'i dbang gis lus la chags chen tsha grang gi sdug bsngal med pa'i rnam pa shar na ru shan phyed pa yin pas gdengs tshad ma rnyed kyi bar du (15ba tha sgom/ gnyis pa ngag ru shan dbye ba ni/ a tsha/ ā na/ kye hud/ a chu/ ngu ba sogs smre sngags sna tshogs bya/ de nas zhi ba'i gsung dbyangs drug cu/ khro bo'i gad mo bco brgyad/ hūṃ ring thung gi snang glu dang phags sogs mang du brjod/ rjes shes lta lugs sogs gong ltar la ngag la nyam thag pa'i gdangs yod med brtag /—49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegasum pa sems ru shan dbye ba ni/ gshag cing gtub pa/ 'tshod pa/ rtsa rgyus rnams tshig nas 'khums shing dbang po'i sgo rnams nas me 'bar ba/ chu wur rdol ba/ rnag khrag 'dzag pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa sogs la nan tan du bsam/ de rjes bde gsal mi rtog pa lta bu ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du 'jog /rjes shes sngar bzhin bltas nas sems la nyam nga ba'i 'jigs skrag e 'dug brtag /yi dwags la gsum gyi lus kyi tshe khrag dang bshang gci sogs yi gar mi 'ong ba'i zas za ba'i stang ka /rin 'byung zhi khro/ rdo rje ser po/ mjug lus la bkres skom yod med lta ba tsam ma gtogs gong dang 'dra/ ngag la bkres so skom mo sogs bsgyur/ mjug dag la bkres nyams/ yid la zas skom ma rnyed par ltogs pa/ gzhan gyis bsrungs pa/ rnyed kyang zar mi btub pa lta bu'o/ /mjug yid la bkres nyams/ byol song la gsum gyi lus la sgur por 'gro ba sogs/ snang mdzad zhi khro/ rdo rje mthing kha/ mjug lus la ngal dub e 'dug /ngag la rta g.yag bya khyi sogs kyi skad sna tshogs/ mjug ngag la smra mi shes pa'i nyams/ yid la chang dgag gi spang ma ltar g.yo 'gul mi nusapa/ gsod spyod/ rdeg bkol/ mjug dub nyams/ mi (16na〉pa gsum gyi lus kyi tshe logs rgyag pa sogs/ snang mtha' zhi khro/ rdo rje dmar po/ mjug lus la bde sdug /ngag la son ma khe spogs sogasakyi gtam sna tshogs/ /mjug dga' sdug brjod pa'i nyams/ yid la skye rga na 'chi sogs/ mjug bde sdug spel ma'i nyams/ lha min la gsum gyi lus kyi tshe g.yul sprod pa sogs/ don grub zhi khro/ rdo rje ljang gu/ mjug lus la rmas pa'i zug rngu'i nyams/ ngag la rgyob gsod dang zur chag gi skad sogs/mjug zhe sdang gi mthus nga ro'i nyams/ yid la 'thab rtsod byas pas g.yul pham pa'i bcad gtub sogs/ mjug khro sems/ lha la gsum gyi lus kyi tshe bdud rtsi'i btung ba zhim po myang ba'am khrus byed pa sogs/ rin 'byung zhi khro/ rdo rje ser po/ mjug ma rnyed kyi bar du bya/ bshad ma thag pa lasaspros pa chung ba'i nyams len snying por dril bar 'dod na/ klong gsal gyi sngon 'gro ru shan 'byed pa'i ṭīk+ka ltar ru shan dbye ba rdzogs chen gzhan las khyad par gyur pa bsnan na mchog tu 'gyur zhing 'khyer —50

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganabade ba sbas chos yang tig gi stan gcig tu ru shan dbye ba'i tshe lus rdo rje'i 'dug stangs/ dmigs pa hūṃ zhi drag spel nas/ lus rdo rje'i rnam pa des 'phar zhing mchonges te/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i steng du phar 'gro ba dang de nas kyang slar shar phyogs kyi zhing khams mngon par dga' ba sogs blos 'khyud (16ba)tshad la phar spro zhing / tshur rim gyis bsdus te rang gi stan thog tu slebs nas rde'u bkram pa ltar yod 'phro la phaṭa brjod cing dmigs bzlas thams cad rbad bcad de rigs 'dzin rgyal ba de dag dang dgongs pa bsres te dar cig bzhag pa sogs la blo sbyang / de bzhin du rin chen ldan/ pad+ma 'od/las rab brtsegs sogs phyogs thams cad la bslab/ spros pa chung bar 'dod na 'di nyid gcig pus kyang mthus so/ /gnyis pa sgrib pa sbyang ba ni/ rang nyid kyi lus ma rig 'khrul ba las grub pa 'di'i spyi bor a dkar nag /mgrin par su ser nag /snying gar rtsi sngo nag /lte bar ti dmar nag /gsang bar bre ljang nag /rkang mthil du du dud kha ste rigs drug dang nyon mongs drug gi bag chags dang bcas pa'i sbyang gzhi'i sa bon gsal btab pa la/ sbyong byed gnas gsum du ā+oṃ āḥ/ dmigs pa las ye shes kyi me dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas rkang mthil nas rim gyis sa bon drug po bsregs/rang gzhan gyi sgo gsum gyi ma rig 'khrul ba'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thul gyis tshig /'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu 'bras thams cad dag ste lus shel gong phyis pa ltar bsams la 'bru gsum dbyangs dang bcas pa bzla'o/ /'di 'khrid gzhung du mi gsal yang gal che ba'i phyir snying tig g.yin nas kha bkang / dgos pa gsum ni/ thun mong sgo gsum gyi sdig pa'i sa bon dang bar chad zhi nas zhen pa ldog /khyad par de la brten nas phyis 'khor bar mi 'khyam/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje gsum 'grub bo/ /gsum pa sngon 'gro ni/ 'khrid gzhung du 'ga' zhig mi gsal zhing la la 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba dang bsres pa zhig snang ba go bde (17na tha'i phyir logs su bshad pa la lus ngag yid —51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (27/gsum las/ dang po lus kyi sngon 'gro rdo rje'i 'dug stangs dang kha dog sngon po rtse lnga pa me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs te rdo rje khong stong du bsams pas lus khang rul zhig pa lta bu dang khol bur na ba dang drod skye ba dang sems mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas pa ni tshad do/ /dgos pa gsum ni thun mong lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag bar chad zhi zhen pa ldog /khyad par lus 'khor bar mi lhung zhing sprul skur grol/ mthar sku rdo rje'i klong du mya ngan las 'da'o/ /gnyis pa ngag gi sngon 'gro la rgyas gdab/ rtsal sbyang / gnyen btsal/ lam du gzhug pa dang bzhi las/ dang po rgyas gdab pa ni/ so dang mchu ma reg tsam du rlung / shes pa/ hūṃ gsum gcig tu bsres la hūṃ gi glu snyan la ring ba blags pas snang ba thams cad hūṃ sngon du rong rong mer mer yod par bsams pa ni phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab pa ste phyi hūṃ du rong nge shar ba ni tshad do/ /phyi'i hūṃ de dag kha dang sna'i sgor zhugs te/ lus kyi nang hūṃ gis mar khengs snyam pa ni nang phung po la rgyas gdab pa ste lus gang ba dang mi bde snyam pa tshad do/ /dgos pa ni/ phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad rang bzhin med par 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyisapa rtsal sbyang ba ni/ hūṃ drag la ngar dang ldan pa brjod cing hūṃ mthing nag me 'bar ba des ri rab khang khyim thams cad phar thal tshur thal du phug ste khrol ma bzhin song bar bsams la phyi'i rtsal te phyi'i yul khral khrol du song snyam byed pa ni tshad do/ /hūṃ des rang gis lus khrol ma bzhin btab bar bsams pa ni nang gi rtsal te chu zla ltar snang ba ni tshad do/ /dgos pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos rdos bcas su snang ba thams cad (17ba〉sdod gsal 'ja' tshon ltar grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa mnyen btsal ba ni/ rang gi mdun du shing bu khru gang pa zhig btsugs pa la shes pa bstad de hūṃ ring bar brjod pas hūṃ gi thag pa nar ra ra song ste shing bu la dkris nas steng du hūṃ yer rer 'dug pa la mnyam par bzhag /yang nar ra ra grol te tshur byung nas snying gar gnas par bsam/ yang na shing bu'i rtse mor slebs pa dang rtsa bar mar phungs kyis babs te hūṃ rnams khrom tshogs su sngo rong nge yod par bsam/ yang nar ra ra shing bu la dkris/ yang zhig pa sogs la bslab/—52

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganashes pa gang bstad du lham mer sdod snyam pa ni tshad do/ /'di'i dus skyes pa rlung sna bug g.yas dang bud med yin na sna bug g.yon nas 'dren pa gnad yin no/ /des dmigs pa gzhan du bsgyur thub pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bzhi pa lam du gzhug pa ni/ rang gi mdun du shing bu khru gang pa zhig btsugs pa'am bsams la hūṃ zhes brjod pas snying ga nas sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ zhig byung / shing bu de'i rtser yer re bzhag /yang hūṃ rang gi snying gar hril gyis byung / de ltar phar 'gro tshur yong la shes pa bstad/ yang na rang gnas pa'i yul thams cad ri ra ba khang khyim sogs med par kha dog ljang gu me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du snying ga nas hūṃ sngon po khru tshad tsam pa mdun nas phar gsegs 'gros lta bu'i lam phar 'khyog tshur 'byog la ri dang sa mtshams ma zad kyi bar du phyin par bsams la hūṃ ring bar brjod/ pha rol du'ang mtha' med par phyin pa la sems gtod/ de bzhin du phyogs gzhan la sbyor/ des dga' ba dang skye ba sogs byung ba ni nyams skyes pa'i tshad do/ /des lus ngag gi lam srol du tshud pa'i (18na ji gos pa yod do/ /spyi'i dgos pa gsum ni/ thun mong ngag sdig 'dag cing yon tan thob mngon chen ldog /khyad par ngag 'khor bar mi lhung zhing longs skur grol/ mthar gsung rdo rje'i klong du mya ngan las 'da'o/ /gsum pa sems kyi sngon 'gro la gzhi rtsa gcod pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ gnas lugs brtag pa dang gsum las/ dang po gzhi rtsa gcod pa ni/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad de lusang ga yid gsum po 'di gang 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ bde sdug dang dgag sgrub kyi byed pa po gang yin/ tshe snga phyi gang du yang 'phos shing brgyud pa yin/ gtso bo gang du 'dug snyam brtags pas sems gtso che bar shes pa ni rkun ma ngos zin pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba ni/ sems dang de'i yul snang gnyis gcig dang tha dad snyel brtags te/ de'ang lusangag sems gsum po gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na lus ngag ltar sems kyang mthong thos su 'gyur la/ sems ltar lusang ga kyang mthong thos su mi rung / tha dad na lus rdul phran/ ngag rjes med brag ca/ sems bya lam rjes med yin pas tha dad bya dad byed ji ltar yod/ de bzhin du phyi'i gzugs sgra —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedri ro reg bya sogs gcig dang tha dad la brtags pas gcig na lus ngag dang 'dra zhing tha dad na sems de gzugs la sogs pa ltar 'di zhes brjod pa las 'das pa nas yul med rten bral ba zhig tu rtogs so/ /de'i dus na gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod/ gnyis 'dzin gyi mkhar po 'gyel/ bdag gzhan gyi snang ba nub/ dgra gnyen gyi 'khrul 'dzin zhig /dgag sgrub kyi sprin tsho gis dengs pas chosanyid nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i (18ba ji gos pa yod do/ /gsum pa gnas lugs brtag pa la/ dben pa'i gnas su sgo gsum gyi bya ba rnams btang ste rang babs kyi ngang nas sems zhes pa 'khor 'das gnyis ga'i 'char gzhi byed pa rig rig tur tur 'di'i byung gnas 'gro gsum las/ dang po byung sa ni sems gang las byung rtsad bcad pas rang gi lus longs spyod dgra gnyen bar ma sogs dug gsum gyi yul du gyur ba de dag gi gnyen la chags yul/ chags bya/ chags par byed mkhan/ dgra la sdang yul/ sdang bya/ sdang bar byed mkhan/bar ma la snyoms yul/ snyoms bya/ snyoms byed mkhan rnams kyi gzugs sogs 'dod yon lnga la btsal ba/ mi la mtshon na dbang po tsho gos drug phung khams skye mched/ bya spyod sogs dran yul du byas te 'di yin nam snyam pa'i rtog pa 'char yang zhib tu dpyad tshe gzhan nas mi rnyed par tshe 'di'i ma las byung bar nges shes rnyed pa lta bu yod yang de'i lus kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar cha shas phra mo re re nas btsal bas mi rnyed/ sems las sems byung na skad cig rang dus na sems cha gnyis su 'dzin dgos pa la de 'dra blos dpyad mi bzod pa'i phyir sems skye ba med pa gtan la phebs pas chos sku blo bral chen po thog ma'i zad sa shes so/ /gnyis pa bar du gnas sa med pa ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can gyi phyi nang bar gsum dang khyad par rang gi lus nas btsal kyang mi rnyed cing sems la sems gnas na gnas yul dag gnas mkhan gnyis dgos pa ngos gzung du med pa'i phyir gnas sa med pa'i sems nyid longs sku bzhi bral gsal dag chen po'i chos nyid rang babs kyi dgongs par —54

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma (ka)shes so/ /gsum pa mthar 'gags med pa ni/ lus (19na)sems bral ba'i rjes su sems 'dir 'gags zhes 'khor 'das gang gi sar yang ngos zin rgyu med/ 'o na mar me shi ba ltar gtan med du song ngo snyam na sems kyi thog tu rigs drug gi bde sdug rnams myong ba mngon sum gyis grub phyin du de la kha dog /dbyibs/ ngo bo ngos bzung rgyu 'dug gam mi 'dug brtags pas kha dog dkar po dang dbyibs zlum po'o zhes pa lta bu brjod du med pas/ snang dus nas stong / stong dus na snang / gsal dusan gzhi med rtsa bral du gsal le ba/ tshig gis brjod du med pa/ blo'i yul du bral ba da ltar gyi shes rig wal le/ gsal le/ hrig ge ba 'di ga tha mal gyi shes pa'am gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i bzhugs tshul lam ka dag blo 'das skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir chos brgyad kyi rtog pa thams cad sgyu ma'i rta glang ngam rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar nam mkha'i dbyings su ban ma bun bzhin ka nas dag par thag bcad mnyam gzhag gi ngang la rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar yang de'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pa na sbrul gyi mdud pa bzhin zhig 'gro bas mnyam rjes bsre zhing dge sbyor gyi rgyun bskyang / de dag thams cad kyi gzhi ma rig pa'i dbang gis bden par med bzhin du gnyis su bzung bar brten dug lnga rgyas shing kun gyi rtsa ba bdag gces 'dzin gyis lan pas de gar yod brtags pa na phyi nang gi snod bcud gang gi steng nas kyang ma rnyed pas semasakyi 'khrul snang gi 'char sgo tsam du thag chod/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong gang shar 'dzin med kyi ngang la cham gyis 'jog /der ma zad phyi nang gi snod bcung rnams la'ang byung gnas 'gro gsum dpyad pas gzugs snang stong / sgra grag stong / (19ba〉tsems rig stong ste tha snyad kyi chos kun ka dag tu thag bcad pa'i mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu la rjes thog tu 'khrul shes thams cad chu zla ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis nyams 'og tu tshud par byas pas mnyam yangs chen por blo bde'o/ /dgos pa gsum ni/ thun mong sems kyi sdig pa 'dag yon tan skye mngon zhen ldog /khyad par sems 'khor bar mi 'khyam zhing chos skur grol/ mthar thug rdo rje'i klong du mya ngan las 'da'o/ /—55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'bazhi pa rnal du dbab pa ni/ ru shan dbye ba man gyi dmigs skor rnams kyi bar mtshams su skabs dang bstun nas nyams su len pa ni bde ba'i mal du lus 'gul bskyod dang bral/ ngag smra brjod dang bral/ yid so ma dran rtog dang bral bar lhod kyis glod la nyal lo/ /dgos pa gsum ni/ thun mong rtsa rlung khod snyoms pas 'byung ba mi 'brug cing nad med/ khyad par ting nge 'dzin rang babs su skye zhing lus sems bde/ mthar sgo gsum gyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la skyon ye nas ka dag tu ston pa khreg chod kyi lam dang / yon tan ye nas lhun grub tu rdzogs pa thod rgal gyi lam gnyis kyi/ dang po la gdod ma'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa dang / gtan la phab nas ngo sprod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i sngon 'gro spyi dang khyad par byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi mtshang legs par rnyed pa'i gnas cha ma skyes par ngo sprod sngas na dred po g.yul du shor nas nges pa'i don mi rtogs pa'i ngang la 'gro ba'i nyen yod pas nan to du byas rjes rtsa ba gsum gyi tshogs gtor/ gser sogs rin po che/ sman dang 'byu'i maṇ+ḍal bshams nas 'bul/ de (20na skos dngos gzhi'i khyad par nyams len gnad/ /gdod nas ka dag rig pa chos kyi sku/ /lhun grub rang byung ye shes gtan phab nas/ /zhes pa ltar 'khor 'das dang po rgyab gyes pa'i dus su kun tu bzang po gzhi thog nas grol/ sems can rnams 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin te 'khor ba'i gzhi ma rig pa ni 'thom me ba/ 'thibs pa/ yengs pa/ rmugs pa/ 'byams pa/ mi dran pa/ brgyal ba lta bu 'byung / de ni 'khrul pa'i ma rgan mo long ba bzhin yin la/ sems zhes bya ba zi long long ba/ g.yo bun bun pa/mnyam khrig ge ba/ rgyang yed yed pa/ ti 'khor 'khor ba/ nga bdag cher byed pa'i bu lta bu zhig skyesapa de srid pa'i btson rar 'jug bas ma rig pa de la brten nas bdag gzhan 'byung / bdag la brten nas 'dod chags/ nga rgyal/ ser sna/ gzhan la brten nas zhe sdang / phrag dog /de lnga las nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du gyes te 'gyu byed dbugs kyi rta la zhen/ mi dge ba ci yang byed cing sdug bsngal gang yang myong ba/ dus rgyun du 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di rig na de las grol bas gdod —56

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtogananas rig pa'i ye shes thig le nyag gcig gshis kyi 'dug tshul 'di nyid ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu rgya chad phyogs lhung spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad las 'das par ye nas gnas pas dang por 'di nas byung ba med/ rang bzhin gsal ba stong pa byang chad du ma song bar gdangs rig pa'i rang rtsal ye shes lnga ldan yongs spyod rdzogs skur ye nas grub pas 'dir gnasamed bar stong pas gar khyab rig pas khyab/ thugs rje ma 'gags kun la khyab cing snang nus pa sprul pa'i skur ye (20bskos grub pa'i mkhyen cha rang bzhin gyis gsal ba thugs rje ye shes kyi snying po can yul yul can gyi shes pa'i sgro skur thams cad dang bral ba rin po che'i shel gong 'bar ba lta bu mthar 'dir 'gags med pas gzhi gnas kyi sku gsum mam ye shes lnga ldan ni ngo bo stong pa chos dbyings/ rang bzhin gsal ba me long / gsal stong gnyis med mnyam nyid/ mkhyen cha'i ye shes kyis chos thams cad rtog bral du rig pa sor rtog /yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub pa bya grub ste de lta bu'i ye shes lnga ldan de nyid/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyis ma gos pa dri bral du gnas pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur las/ ngo bo ka dag ye shes la/ /ma rig pa yi srid ming med/ /gcig dang gnyis kyi grangs mtha' zad/ /de phyir 'khrul pa gdod nas dag /ces byung bas na yar sangs rgyas la re ba dang mar ngan song du lhung gi dogs pa med pa'i phyir chos sku skyon ye nas dag pas gzhi rig pa ka dag la yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid de btul sbyangs ma byas kyang sa le sbram gdod ma nas gser yin pa ltar thag rbad kyis bcad pa ni rig pa rang byung gi ye shes ngo 'phrod pa yin no/ /de ni kun gzhi gtan la phab ste ngo sprad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtan la phab ste ngo sprod pa la snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa/ sems stong par ngo sprod pa/ snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprod pa/ gnyis med rang grol du ngo sprod pa/ ngo sprad pa'i rig pa cer mthong la nges shes drangs nas gdengs tshad btsal ba dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ khreg chod zab mos 'khor 'das snang ba rnams/ /sems kyi rtsal snang tsam du ngo sprod cing / /zhes pa ltar gzhi 'khor —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (27)ba'i 'khrul (21na) gzugs/ lam theg dgu'i bgrod tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thamasacad sems kyi snang cha ma 'gags tsam 'di'i gdangs sa ma rol pa yin pas na/ kun byed las/ sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes yon tan dang / /sems can las dang bag chags la sogs pa/ /snang srid snod bcud bsdus pa thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ye nas yin/ /zhes pa'i don ltar byed mkhan kun sems la bang ma 'das pas chu las chu lhar rdol ba ltar gzhan nas btsal du med pas snang ba sems su thag chod par nges pa ma rnyed kyi bar du bsgom/ 'di sems tsam lugs kyi lta ba dang mthun par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa sems stong par ngo sprod pa ni/ sems snang sna tshogs ji ltar shar ba rnams/ /rang ngo spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang / /zhes pa ltar sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid chos kyi sku ste de'i sems snang ma 'gags tsam gyi rang rtsal la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'gag med du rang snang yang chos rnams kyi ngo bo stong pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad las bral bas/ ji skad du/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes yang bas de shes na gnas skabs su nyon mongs pas mi gnod cing 'brul gzhi rtsad nas cho de/ rtag lta'i dngos 'dzin zhig nas mthar thug sems nyid stong par thag chod pa dper na rmugs zil dang chu bo rlan gsher du ngo 'phrod pa dbu ma'i lta ba dang mthun par bzhed do/ /gsum pa snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprod pa ni/ snang stong gnyis la bzang ngan snga phyi sogs/ /tha dad med phyir zung 'jug dbyer med dang / /zhes pa ltar chos thams (21bcad sems la shar ba'i snang ba dang 'char gzhi sems rang bzhin gyis stong pa gnyis dbyer med de stong pa'i dusasnang ba ma bkag par dug lnga sogs kyi rtog pa lam gyis shar ba'i tshe de ga'i ngo bo stong nyid du gsal le ba/ snang ba'i dus na gang shar gyi chos rnams sgyu ma'i rta glang ltar don la med pas stong pa ma spangs par snang stong dbyer med du thal ler shes na nyon mongs ye shes su grol bas na/ brtag gnyis las/rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dag /ces 'byung zhing de gnyis la rang bzhin gyi bzang ngan 'dug 58

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganapa tha dar/ /dus la snga phyi med pas ngo bo dbyer med gnas 'gyu'i snang srid gcig tu rtogs pas chos kun zung 'jug tu grol zhing gnyis snang gi gzung 'dzin dang bral bas snang stong gnyis med du thag chod pa bu ram dang de'i ro bzhin 'di zhes so sor dbye mi nus pa gsang sngags kyi lta ba dang mthun par bzhed do/ /bzhi pa gnyis med rang grol du ngo sprod pa ni/ zung 'jug tsam du 'dzin par rang dag nas/ /sems las ka dag rig pa cho so kyi sku/ /zhes pa ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems kyi 'khrul snang ma 'gags tsam yin pa de 'khrul med du shes pa'i thabs su zung 'jug tu ngo sprad na'ang rig pa ka dag chen po'i dbyings su spros pa dang bral ba'o/ /de'ang mu tig phreng ba las/ sems dang ye shes dbye ba ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems dang rig pa gnyis ni rnam pa kun tu tha dad pas kun gzhi'i sems ni glo bur gyi kun rdzob yul snang gi spros pa can rkyen las byung ba'i 'dus byas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa can de gnas sa slo bar gnas shing las rlung gis drangs te dbang po'i sgo rnams las thon nas tshogs brgyad kyi (22nasgo la la longs spyod/byed las bden 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu 'khor bar skye la/ rig pa rang byung gi rgyal po ni mthar thug don dam pa yul yul can gyi spros pa dang bral ba rgyus ma bskyed pa'i 'dus ma byas gnyis 'dzin las 'das pa de gnas sa yang / kun bzang thugs kyi me long las/ tsit+ta snying gi gzhal yas na/ /rig pa zhi ba'i sku ru bzhugs/ /zhes pa ltar tsit+ta rin po che'i gzhal yas khang na ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum 'dus kyi bdag nyid ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bzhugs te chos nyid ye shes kyi rang snang las thon nas chos nyid kyi yul la longs spyod la/ glo ba dang snying gi bar du rtsa gro sog gi sbu gu tsam gyis 'brel nas glo ba'i las rlung cher g.yo ba des drangs te rig pa thugs rje'i las rlung de nyid las rlung gi rta la zhen nas 'phro zhing byas chos kyang / thal 'gyur las/ ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i cha/ /stong gsal bos pa sku yi gdangs/ /zhal phyag —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gerdzogs pa bum sku'i tshul/ /rgyal ba 'od kyi phung por bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bden 'dzin gyi rnam rtog med pa'i 'khrul bral ye shes gsum dang ldan pa de yang ma phye mi 'byed 'byed pa med par stong dus na snang / snang dus na stong / dbyer med du bde cham me/ mkhyen cha nang du gsal zhing ye shes kyi sgom bye ba'i gzhen nu bum sku skyon ye nas dag pa'i ka dag dang yon tan ye nas rdzogs pa'i lhun grub 'khor 'das kyi chos kun rang bzhin lhun grub kyi theg pa 'dir rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ste de lta bu'i gnas lugs la sems rnam rtog gi dri bcas 'dis gdod nas ma gos par ngo sprod (22ba)do/ /rang stong gzhan stong gi dbu ma pa dang gnas lugs phyag rgya ba sogs la ma grags pa'i khyad chos sems rig ma 'dres par cer mthong du dbye ba'i gsang tshig 'di ni rdzogs chen pa rnams kyi zab gnad yin la/ zab gnad du ma zad sngags gsar ma'i dgongs pa'ang dbyis byin pa rtogs na 'di las ga' na du med de/ bsdus rgyud las/ mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje can ni yul dang rnam bral lus dbus dag tu yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ lus la ye shesachen po gnas/ mi shes mun pas bsgribs rnams kyis/ /lus las gzhan du sangs rgyas 'dod/ /lus gnas pa de lus skyes min/ /zhes pas shes nus so/ /de'ang bkod pa chen po las/ rin chen kha dog lnga ldan pa/ /lus can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /zhes pas phung khams skye mched kyi dngas rnams gdod nas grub pa'i lha sngags bde chen gyi ngo bo dang snyigs ma rnams kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i rdzun snang du dbye bas sngags gsar ma ba las zab pa'i khyad chos shig 'dir mchis so/ /lnga pa ngo sprad pa'i rig pa cer mthong la nges shes drangs nas gdengs tshad btsal ba la nges shes drang ba/ rtsal sbyang ba/ bogs dbyung ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rig pa rang shar las/ ye grol cog bzhag ngang las gzhan med pas/ /rang byung brdal ba'i sku de gang bder glod/ /ces pa ltar dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i da lta'i rig pa rang gsal rjen pa 'di la cer gyis bltas pas ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum brdal ba'i chos sku thig le chen po grwa zur med cing gcig tu zlum pa —60—

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma khoganaganyug ma gshis kyi gnas lugs stong pa rig pa'i (23na〉steng po can/ thugs rje ye shes kyi snying po can 'di la rtog pa ma 'phro/ rtse gcig tu ma bzung / spang blang dang re dogs kyis ma bslad/ gshisacir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa la gdangs gang du'ang ma 'gags par stong pas gar khyab la gsal bas khyab pas gsal la 'dzin pa med/ dngas la phyi nang med/ yangs la 'chal par ma shor/ngang dngas la ngos bzung med/ gsal bas gar khyab la rig pas khyab pas zang thal cham brdal ba'i stong gsal rig gsum dbyer med nyag gcig mkhyen cha nang nas gsal zhing rtog pas ma bslad pa ye shes sum ldan de nyid kyi gshis rang bab cog bzhag rgya yan chen por bzhag pas snod bcud nam mkha' la brten kyang nam mkha' la snod bcud kyis ma gos shing nyi ma'i snying po mun pa thams cad dang gtan bral yin pa ltar la nges pa rnyed nas rgyun bskyang ngo / /rgyas par spro na/ snying tig las/ dri med dag pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rang rig chos sku 'gyur ba med/ /gsal le sing nge wal le ba/ /sprin med ston ga'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ri bo bzhin du zhog /mi g.yo dngas pa rgya mtsho bzhin du zhog /yangs dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin du zhog /gang ltar gnas kyang rig pa'i ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i gdangs yin theg /'phrog nas rang rig dngas sangs phyed par zhog /ji ltar bya rnams gang du 'phur na yang / /mkha' las ma 'das de bzhin rig pa'i ngang / /chos rnams rang gsal g.yos pa med par zhog /ces dang /'gro ba kun sgrol las/ dper na rdzings kyi bya lta bu/ /dang po yengs med bskyangs pa na/ /(23ba)bar du yan par btang yang ldeg /tha ma btang yang 'gror mi btub/ /ces sogs kyi don bshad la ngo legs par sprad do/ /snying por dril na dran 'dzin re dogs blang dor thams cad ni sems kyis byas pa'i sgrib rkyen yin la/ 'dzin med rang grol du bzhag pas rig pa ye shes rnyog ma dang bral pa'i chu ltar grol lo/ /gnyis pa rtsal sbyang ba la rang gnas bsam gtan gyi ngang la sbyang ba/ rang gdangs ye shes—61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gekyi rol par sbyang ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la bsam gtan ngos 'dzin pa dang mnyam rjes bsre ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas te khyad par mig cung zad thur du phab pas sems dang sa la mi rtog pa 'char/ de'i ngang nas mig drang thad du har rer bstad pas sngar gyi mi rtog pa'i dngas de zhig kyang byung tshor gyi rtog pa dang dran 'dzin gnyen po med pa'i shes pa rang gsal rgya yan pa gzhi chal pa zhig 'char te de ni rig pa rang gnas kyi bsam gtan du shes par bya/ de nyid ngos zin nas phyis shes pa 'phro gnas/ dgag sgrub/ nyon mongs/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa sogasagang gi dus su'ang de ga'i ngo bor rang rig rang babs la cer bstad pas 'dzin med rang gnas kyi bsam gtan de rjen sangs kyis 'char te 'di kho na ma byas lhun grub kyi sgom chu bo lta bu yin no/ /de ngo ma shes na mnyam bzhag res 'ga' ba'i sgom gyis rkyen mi thub cing bar do'i bsam gtan ngos mi zin pa'i skyon yod de/ klong drug pa las/ rang bzhin gnas pa'i bsam gtan dang / /rtsa rlung semasakyi ngal gso gnyis/ /'dra'o 'dra'o nor ra re/ /zhes byung bas chos 'di'i dka' ba'i gnad 'di rang byung pad+ma'i byin (24na)rlabs las rang babs pa'i shes pa yin zhes kun mkhyen klong chen pa gsung ba don la gnas pas rtsal sbyong bogs 'byin gyi sa bcad gnyis po gter gzhung gi zin so med kyang don gyi thob pa brgyan pa yin no/ /de ltar bskyangs pas/ ji skad du/ gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud pa ma grol gyi bar du brdar sha nang du bcad cing gnyen po'i bya ra bsten/ brtson 'grus kyi 'phrad du bcur na rang sems phyi rol gyi rkyen gyis mi 'phrog /ces gsungs pas mnyam gzhag 'di la goms 'dris brtan pa thob par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mnyam rjes bsre ba ni/ mnyam gzhag de ga'i ngang nas bsdad pa las langs te g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang mig phar 'phrul tshur 'phrul sogs zhi khre'i stang stabs/ gom pa dal bus gya tshom du dor ba'i rgyad kyi dor stabs/ drag tu 'gro zhing mchod pa/ dal 'gros kyi ngang nas sdod pa las skad cig la langs shing ca co sgrog pa'i seng ge'i mchod stangs sogs spyod lam thams cad gong —62

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganagi rang bzhin gyi bsam gtan dang e 'dres blta/ ma 'dres pa 'dug na gong gi mnyam gzhag bskyar te bsgom 'dres na bya byed smra brjod dran rtog thams cad chos nyid rol par shar te mnyam rjes kyi ris med/ nyin mtshan gyi bar med/ blang dor gyi chos med/ bsgom bya'i blo med/ yin min gyi rtsis gdab med par thams cad rig pa'i rang gdangs rol pa gcig tu 'dres pa rgya yan du song yang 'chal bar mi shor/ ched du ma bsgoms kyang ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral/ chos zad kyi dgongs pa dge sdig gis phan gnod med par rtogs pa ni sgom med chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor te/ klong gsal las/ dge sbyor mnyam rjes (24ba〉ri dres dus yul phyin mi 'breng / zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa rang gdangs ye shes kyi rol par sbyang ba la/ gnas pa sems kyi rgyan du shar ba/ 'phro ba sems kyi rol bar shar ba/gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du gnas pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus ngag yid gsum khong slong la sos gdal du gnas pa'i ngang nas rtog pa sna tshogs 'phror bcug /cham gyis bzhag la cer gyisabaltas pas rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar 'gro mkhan dang 'phro mkhan dang 'phro bya ma grub bar gzhi med rtsa bral gyi rang bzhin gzhi'i ngang du gnas pa ni gdod ma'i ka dag gi gnas lugs chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa yin cing der ngo sprod do/ /gnyis pa 'phro ba sems kyi rol par shar ba ni/ sna tshogs pa'i rtog pa spros la dgag sgrub re dogs med par gang shar 'dzin med yan du bcug pas snga phyi dran bsam gyi mdun pa bor nas da lta'i rig pa thol skyes thol nub tu 'gro ba gshis kyi gnas lugs ji ltar 'phros kyang rdzings la gnas pa'i bya rog bzhin chos nyid kyi rol pa las mi 'da' ba rgya mtsho las rlabs po che shar ba ltar rang shar rang grol thugs rje 'gag med du ngo sprod do/ /gsum pa gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du gnas pa ni/ 'phro gnas gnyis su med pa ste gnas bdo ba'i dus su mig bsgril ba 'phro ba rang babs su gnas la/ 'phro bdo ba'i dus mig mi 'gul bar cham bzhag pas gnas te 'phro gnas gnyis su med pa rlabs po chu rgya mtsho'i ngang du zhi ba ltar bzhag go /de'ang gnas pa mi gseng / 'phro —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geb mi dgag /mnyam pa mi bsgrub/ gang shar yang 'dzin med blang dor re dogs dang bral ba'i chos nyid ye grol rdzogs pa chen por ngo sprod pa ni gzhi goms dang rkyen mig la brten (25na) pa'o/ /gsum pa bogs dbyung ba la dug lnga rang grol/ sgo lnga rang grol/ tshogs drug rang grol dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ phyi nad kyi 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug /nga rgyal/ phrag dog rnamasamibazod pa skyes pa'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas nas cham gyis bzhag pas dang po la bde stong gnyis med/gnyis pa la gsal stong gnyis med/ gsum pa la chos sku gzhi bral/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa gnyis la gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su rang grol ba'o/ /gnyis pa sgo lnga rang grol ni/ mig /rna ba/sna/ lce/ lus rnams kyi 'dzin pa gang skyes de'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas la cham gyis bzhag pas chosasku ka dag chen por rang grol lo/ /gsum pa tsho gos drug rang grol ni/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya/ yid kyi byung tshor dran rig gi dgag sgrub/ chags sdang skyes ba de'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas la cham gyis bzhag pas ye sngod rtsa bral chen po'i ngang du la zlos te/ gnas lugs stong gsal mnyam pa chen por lhun gyis grub bo/ /des ni gang shar blang dor re dogs las 'das pa ma bsgom ye shes lhug pa rang bzhin du khreg chod pas/ klong gsal las/ de ltar rgyun du nyams su blangs pas nam zhig na snang sems 'dres te dge sbyor la ched 'dzin med kyang bya rog gzings la 'khor/ gnyen po'i bya ra mi dgos nyams myong zad/ ces gsungs pa sogs kyi shes so/ /gnyis pa yon tan ye nas lhun grub tu rdzogs pa thod rgyal gyi lam ni/ de ltar gzhi don khreg chod gtan la phab nas/ lhun grub yon tan (25bsgo ngo zhe du 'byin pa'i phyir/ /thod rgal snang ba bzhi yi lam la 'jug /ces pa ltar khreg chod kyi lam la gtan la legs par phab grub pa'i rjes su go rim bzhin ston par gsungs pa la dngos dang rjes kyi bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ sgo gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang ba/ sgron ma bzhi gnad du btsal ba/ sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun pa/ gnad bzhis mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa/ snang ba bzhi'i 'char tshul dang lnga las/ dang po ni/—64

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganalus ngag yid kyi rtsol ba dgu phrugs btang / /zhes pa ltar lus kyi bya ba phyi 'jig rten gyi spyod tshul/nang phyag dang skor ba/ gsang ba lha'i gar dang phyag rgya spangs te gcig pur gnas/ ngag gi phyi long gtam/ nang thun mong gi chos spyod/ gsang ba sngags rlung gi bzlas brjod spangs te smra med du gnas/yid kyi phyi 'jig rten gyi 'gyu dran/ nang byams snying rje/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams spangs te bsam med rtog bral du gnas so/ /gnyis pa sgron ma ba'i gnad du btsal ba 'di dang sa bcad gsum pa gnyis tshigs bcad gcig gis ston pas/ sgron ma bzhi la sgo gsum gnad gtsun zhing / /zhes pa ltar rgyang zhags/ thig le/ ngag dbyings/ shes rab kyi sgron ma dang bzhi las/ spyir kun rdzob rdos bcas zad pa'i don dam gyi 'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa sgron ma bzhir smin te las rlung dag cing ye shes kyi rlung gi cha las sgron ma bzhi byung ba dper na rgyang zhags kyi rten chung ngus ri sogs chen po snang ba rlung gi cha'i phra zhib las byung la/ sgron ma bzhi ga rig pa'i rang rtsal yin pas sems 'khrul snang dang tha dad (26na jis rig pa myang 'das kyi cha 'dzin pa dang sems snang 'khor ba'i cha 'dzin pa gnyis snang ba tsam du 'dra yang sngar tha dad pa khreg chod kyi skabs sems rig dbye tshul gyis rtogs pas gnad 'di sgron ma kun la shes par bya ba la/ de'ang dang po ni/ lus chags pa'i gzhi rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang du 'byung ba dang sgron ma'i spyan gnyis las snga mas lus dang phyi mas snang ba ye shes kyi 'od dang thig le sku la sogs pa'i myang 'das kyi chos rnams 'dzin pas de nyid kyi rten lte ba nas snying / de nas sgal tshigs 'dabs nasarna ba gnyis kyi nang ngos klad rgya'i 'khris nas mig gi a 'bras gnyis su zug pa'i rtsa ba men gyi rwa 'dra ba khrag dang chu ser med pa'i 'od kyi snal mas khengs nas sgo chu'i sgron mar zug pa'i rtsa gnyis kyi nang du gnad gcun ma gcun gyi khyad par las ye shes dang zhabrul pa'i rtsa rten brten pa'i tshul du yod pa'i 'od rtsa gnyis ni chu'i sgron ma dngos yin la/ de'i ngo bo ni chu'i sgron ma'i rten gyis gzugs sogs rags pa 'khor ba dang de'i brten pa sgron ma myang 'das ye shes rang snang gi cha 'dzin —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2popas dag snang dang 'khrul snang mthong byed kyi dbang rten yin zhing nges tshig 'od gsal dngas pa'i gzugs brnyan dang 'khrul snang rags pa thams cad rgyang ring po nas 'dzin pas na rgyang zhags dang snang ba la zhen pa med par nang ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba des brlan par byed cing chu'i dngas ma 'dus pas na chu zhes bya la/ gzugs snang dbang shes la gsal ba dang 'od snang gong 'phel du 'char bas sgron ma zhes bya'o/ /de la yang rlung gi dngas ma rtsa ba men gyi rwa 'dra ba 'byung ba'i rgyang zhags/ 'od rtsa dngas pa ye shes kyi kha dog 'dzin cing 'khrul snang mi 'dzin pa ye shes 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags/ dbang po'i dngas ma mig (26ba)gi a 'bras kyi dkyil na dbang rten dngas pa gzugs mthong byed du bskyed pa 'khrul snang mthong zhing ye shes mi mthong ba dbang po 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags gsum du yod pa'i snga phyi gnyis ltar snang dang bar ma dngos yin/ mthun dpe glang po'i snar lcags kyu 'debs pa bzhin 'khor 'das kyi rtsal snang 'dzin pas lcags kyu dang 'dra la/ snang ba bzhi las cho me nyid mngon sum mthong bas grub mtha' 'dod rgyal du 'dzin pa las blo ldog go /gnyis pa thig le stong sgron ni/ ngo bo thig le zlum po 'od lnga'i mu khyud dang bcas pa de las sgron ma phyi ma gnyis yang ngo / /nges tshig ni/ rang gnas 'od zlum po mi 'gyur bas thig /kun la khyab par brdal bas le/ dngos po ngos bzung med pa stong / rang 'od 'char bas sgron ma'o/ /de la gnas pa bzhi'i thig le snying ga ye shes kyi dpal be'u na 'khor 'das kun gyi gyes mdo'am 'byung gnas sam zad par gnas pa/ lusaganas rtsa'i thig le khyad par chen po'i rtsa bzhin rang gsal bas bde sdug rang grol ye grol du gnas pa/ kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le ro ma la sogs pa na lus kyi zungs tsam 'dzin byed du gnas/ don dam spros bral gyi thig le rig pa ka nas dag pas dbyings rig dbyer med pa'i dgongs pa la gnas pa/rang byung 'bras bu'i thig le dbang po'i mngon sum du snang bas nyin mtshan 'od gsal du snang ba ste lngar dbye la/ mthun dpe mdangs zlum po rma bya'i mdongs sam/ dngas cha de'i gdangs gsal ba khra'i mig gam/ snang ba nya mig /'tsher bkrag 'od zer byi la'i mig dper bzung la/ snang ba bzhi las—66

bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rigs 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtogananyams gong 'phel du mthong bas bde ba rang rgyud du 'dzin pa las blo ldog go /gsum pa dag pa (27na)byings kyi sgron ma ni/ phyi'i ngo bo ni nam mkha' dngas pa'i dkyil na gdangs sngo sang nge ba zhig 'char la/ nang gi ngo bo mthing kha las lnga ldan du mched de 'od lnga'i mu khyud zlum po nang na pad 'dab dang bcas pa za 'og ber khyim ltar snang ba ste/ rig pa lu gu rgyud gzer 'debs pa'i ra bar byung la/ thig le'i 'od khyim yin pas 'gul 'phrigs shas chung ngo / /nges tshig ni/ rig pa'i rang yul dang snang ba'i 'char gzhi byed pas na dbyings/ yul du snang yang dri ma med pas rnam par dag pa/ lu gu rgyud go rar bzung nas snang rig gsal bar byed pas sgron ma de la gzhi'i dbyings sgron snying nang na ye shes rang 'od kyi sku lhun grub nang gsal du gnas pa/ lam mu khyud lnga ldan gyi ra ba'i dbus na pad 'dab can gyis thig le dngas ma sdud pa/ 'bras bu lu gu rgyud btson du 'dzin pa ste 'od lnga'i dra ba dra phyed za 'og ris sogs 'char bas gsum du dbye'o/ /mthun dpe ni/ yi ge'i na ro lta bu ste na ro ni gshog pa gnyis bsdoms pas na ro gcig grub pa ltar phyi'i dbyings mthing kha dang de las shar ba'i snang ba gnyis bsdoms pas dbyings kyi sgron ma zhes btags la/ snang ba bzhi las rig pa tshad phebs su mthong bas ma dag pa 'khrul pa'i snang ba las blo 'u/ga tre/ /bzhi pa shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ni/ rang shes rig pa ka nas dag pa ste/ /de'ang ngo bo rtsal gdangs gsum la/ ngo bo ni rgyang zhags gzigs stangs kyi gnad las thig le stong sgron la bstad dus nang gi rig pa dngas sangs rang gsal du myang ba de'o/ /rtsal ni phyi gsal yul shes kyi shes rab rno zhing tshig don klong rdal du 'char ba gdangs rdo rje lu gu rgyud gser skud lding ba lta bu dang bcas pa (27ba than la/ de'ang sgron ma kun shes par byed pa'i dgongs pa chos nyid stong gsal rang gnas shes pa'i rtsal dang bcas pa ste thabs su sgron ma gzhan gsum ma 'gul bar bstad pas nang du rang rig dngas sangs phyed pa rang gnas kyi dgongs pa klong rdol gyi shes rab dang bcas —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepa yin nges tshig ni/ gzhi don ka dag gtan la phebs pas chos thams cad stongs shing bdag med pa shes pa de lta bu'i dgongs pa kun gyis rtogs dka' zhing thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pas rab gzhan nas 'byung min lhan cig skyes pa rang ngo shes pas rang byung / ngo bo stongs shing rang bzhin gsal gdangs 'gag med du shar bas sgron/ thams cad la khyab pas ma zhes bya/ gzhi gnas rang byung gi shes rab ni rig pa'i mkhyen cha ste 'char gzhi dang rten du gnas pa'o/ /snang ba cer 'dzin gyi shes rab ni dbyings rig gnyis med zung 'jug gis rang dus na rang gsal dri med dag pas dgongs pa chos nyid du skyel bar byed pa'o/ /dran pa 'gag med kyi shes rab ni ris med du mar shar yang ngo bo chos nyid du sdud par byed pa'o/ /so sor rtog
