byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtogan༄༅༅//byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gyi las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na ma ār+ya pā ṇi pad+ma shukla dha rā ya/med byung thugs rje chen po'i char rgyun gyis//'gro ba'i phan bde'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa'i//'khor lo'i dbang phyug rje btsun pad dkar 'dzin//'bral med gtsug gi pad mtshor rtag tu bsten//gang de'i sprul pa'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung //gsang chen bka' yi bsdu po mkhar wo bza'//zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed rgod ldem sogs//dngos brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs rnams phyag gi yul/khyad par chos rgyal mtho'i mtshan can gyi//dri med ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rdo rje 'chang //bka' drin mnyam med rje bas pad+ma dbang //snying dbus rdo rje'i gdan la rtag bzhugs shig/mthong thos dran pas 'khor ba las sgrol zhing //nyams su blangs na rang rig kun tu bzang //tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur byed zab mo'i lam//'phrin las mkhas pa'i phyag len bzhin du 'dri//byang gter thugs sgrub rnam gsum las thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gyi 'phrin las 'khrigs su bsgrigs pa la/bum pa mchod gtor sogs yo byad rnams phyag len ltar bshams la/dang po dad ldan skyes bu rnams:'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes:yang dag snying po'i don tshol na:legs par ngan song sdug bsngal bsam:dben pa'i gnas su yo byad bsags:bde ba'i 2na tshe gdan la 'dug par bya:rin chen gnad kyi gzer lnga brtsis dang po skyabs 'gro sems skyed ni:bdag dang khams gsum sems can kun log pa'i lam las bzlog nas kyang :dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro nyon mongs dbang gyur sdug bsngal las thar par bya phyir sems bskyed do:bdag gi spyi bo nam mkha'i khams nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du:bla ma bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan:mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol:zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan par bsam:shar phyogs mdun gyi nam mkha' la:shākya seng ge la sogs pa'i yi dam lha tsho gos thaXs cad kun:kha dog lngar gsal rnam dag bsam:

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2polho phyogs bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung : rgyags bam yi ge'i rnam pa la: dam chos ma lus 'dus par bsam: nub phyogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs: rigs gsum mgon po byams pa dang: 'gro don mdzad pa thams cad bsam byang phyogs dam chos skyong ba yi: chos skyong mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: bka' nyan las byed pho nyar bsam: 'og tu rigs drug sems can rnams: snying rje'i sems kyis kun bsdus nas: las la 'khru1da pas sems skyed bsam rtse gcig gus pas skyabs 'gro bya:kye ma/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i (2ba〉sems can kun: bla med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa'i las ga sbyangs: dag pa ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsol: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: byang chub ma thob bar du thugs rjes gzigs: yon tan kun 'byung dngos grub mchog gi gnas: bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi: gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi: sangs rgyasagasung las sprul pa'i yi ger byon: nyon mongs 'joms byed chos la skyabs su mchi: thugs rje chen pos 'gro don stobs chen mdzad byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: gdul bya'i don du drag po'i skur ston pa: chos skyong dam can rnams la skyabs su mchi: bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yis: 'gro ba ma lus byang chub thob par shog rang byung rig pa rang shar chos kyi sku: yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shog: bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs su 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog:phyi'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ na mo/ dbang chen gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la: ri rgyal lhun po brjid cing 'gyeng bag ldan: gser gyi ri bdun rol ba'i mtsho bdun rnams: gnyen lcug sra brtan rin chen rtsig par bltams gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams bskor: lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rgyan gyis gang : nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa sel: lcags ri mu khyud mtha' nas legs par bskor: phyi ltar snod kyi 'jig rten snang ba 'di bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul:bdag gzhan bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas: yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shog:nang gi maṇ+ḍal ni: na mo: 'jig rten las kyas 'dus pa' bar do phu (3na thad ga lusane /06

byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtoganashin tu gces par bzung ba yi: yul mkhar longs spyod 'dod pa'i ra bar bcas: byams pa'i pha ma 'dza' ba'i grogs dang ni bu dang bu mo gces pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: zas nor gos dang longs spyod rgyan dang ldan bkrag mdangs mdzes pa'i kha dog rang 'od bcas: 'dzin pa'i sems kyis gces par bzung ba yi bdag gi 'jig rten 'di yi gces pa kun: gu ru rat+na sprul pa'i sku la 'bul:bdag gi nyon mongs 'dzin pa'i yul dag nas: dag pa ye shes rang gnas stan du gsol:gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal ni: lha/ bdag lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i pho brang du: sems kyi rten gnas tsit+ta 'bar ba la: dbang po sgo lnga'i rten gyis mtha' rten byas: rnam shes tsho gos brgyad 'khor gyis rab tu brgyan: sha khrag rus pa nang khrol sna tshogs ldan: mig gnyis dngas pa'i 'od kyis mun pa sel: bdag lus longs spyod rgyas pa'i sgyu lus 'di: nges pa'i don ston bla ma nyid la 'bul:bdag gi lam gyi ga hril snang kun dag nas: rang rig ye shes rtogs par mdzad du gsol: rang gi sgyu lus bem po 'di'i spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : āḥlas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid: dung mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin: g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten: zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzad: de yi thugasaspur yi ge ā: āḥlas 'od sa mdangs dang ldan: āḥlas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab bdag gi spyi gtsug rkang mthil bar: phyi nang lus bkrus dag par bsam: zho badz+ra satwa sam ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi sgo me bha wa su to skyo me bha wa: a nu (3ba)ra sto me bha wa: su po stso me bha wa: sarba sirnyi m+me pra la sarba ga me su tsa me tsi sto shrī yaṃ ku ru : ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wa na: sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñtsa badzi bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā: rang gi yul mkhar khang khyim dang : sardo ri brag 'jig rten khams brtsigs dang gnas dang 'jig pa dang : dus kyi 'pho 'gyur legasapar bsam bar du rang gi dgra dang gnyen: srog chags kun dang rang gi lus: skye dang gson dang 'chi bar bsam tha ma 'khor ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rim par brtag cing bsam: thun du bcad la mi rtag sgom mi rtag bsgoms pas chos la 'jug dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang : bdag ni 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams: da lta nges pa'i — 107

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gedon ston pa'i bla ma de ni sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin te sku drin che:dper na yid bzhin nor bu de:'byung ba lnga yi bcud yin yang :'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la:rtsol ba med par grogs su 'byung :rgyal po dgung du gshegs pa'i tshe:sa rdo gzhan gyis mi thub par:'byung ba lnga la zang thal du:gshegs te rgya mtsho chen po'i nang :rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi la nor bu rin chen chags par 'gyur:de bzhin man ngag zab mo'i chos:nges don ston pa'i bla ma de sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa yin bdag la sangs rgyas kun las lhag las byung gang zag yod pa'i sar:rtsol ba med par 'byung bar 'gyur:dad med log lta sdig spyod gnas der ni bzhugs par mi 'gyur sngo dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par 'gyur gsang sngags nges pa'i don 'dod na:bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya:bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni:rang mdun byang chub sems kyi 'od chen nang //yan lag brgyad ldan dbus na legs 4na jis pa'i//rin chen las grub pad stong lo gos rgyas//'od dang 'od zer rin chen du ma 'phyang //de nyid rtsa rtser pad+ma stong ldan dbus//nyi zla 'od lnga kun du 'khrigs pa'i klong //mgon po 'od dpag med pa sku mdog dmar//chos gos sham thabs mnyam gzhag phyag rgya'i steng //rin chen bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bcas//de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od phung dbus//thugasarje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs//dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang //mu tig phreng ba pad+ma rin chen rgyan//sna tshogs dar gyis stod smad mdzes par spras//de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus//u rgyan pad+ma dkar dmar gnyen zhu dang //za ber chos gos phod ka rdo rje thod//rin chen du ma'i rgyan spras sprul sku'i mas//de 'og pad sdong phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i steng //nyi zla 'od lnga 'khyil ba'i dbus nyid du//rgyal yum mtsho rgyal dkar dmar rnal 'byor chas//gri gug thod khrag rin wo dar gyis brgyan/shar du ma snyed rab byung gawo zhu dang //chosagos za ber rdo rje dril bu 'dzin//lho ru chos rgyal dkar dmar dar thod mas//phyag gnyis rin r+sā gtso la dbul ba'i tshul//nub tu rgyal sras dkar dmar rgyal po'i chas//phyag gnyis rin chen gzheng pa bcud gang 'dzin//byang du rdo rje bdud 'joms sngags 'chang chas//phyag gnyis phur pa sdigs mdzub bgegs la gzir//de 'og pad /nga nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus//gter ston chen po

byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtogadadamar smug sngags 'chang chas/ /phyag gnyis chos 'chad glegs bam 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rgyal sras rnam rgyal mgon po rab byung chas/ /dkar dmar rdo rje dril bu thugs gar 'dzin/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /thugs sras sangs rgyas bstan pa rab byung chas/ /dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rje bum pa (4ba 'dzin/ /de 'og bad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rig 'dzin sangs rgyas byams bzang rab byung chas/ /dkar dmar phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgya'o/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rig 'dzin sangs rgyas dpal bzang rab byung chas/ /dkar smug phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa 'dzin/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rin chen chos rgyal bsod nams sngags 'chang chas/ /dmar smug phyag gnyis rdo rje phur pa 'dzin/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /sprul sku shākya bzang po sngags 'chang chas/ /smug nag phyag gnyis rdo rje bum pa 'dzin/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /pad ma dbang rgyal dmar smug rab byung chas/ / phyag gnyis chos 'chad rin chen sbyin pa'i tshul/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms sngags 'chang sprul sku'i chas/ /dkar dmar phyag gnyis mchog sbyin gter sgrom 'dzin/ /de 'og pad stong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rig sngags 'chang ba chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /dbu sgra'i thor tshugs dkar dmar na bzas brjid/ /chos 'chad pad snying glegs bam ral gri bsnams/ /de 'og pad sdong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang / /dkar dmar dbang rtags cod pan rtags rgyas mdzes/ /g.yas g.yon rdo rje tshe yi bum pa 'dzin/ /de 'og pad stong nyi zla'i 'od lnga'i dbus/ /yol mo gter ston smug nag sngags yong chas/ /phur pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /de 'og pad stong nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos zur chen pad+ma dbang / /dkar dmar rab byung chas ldan phyag g.yas pa/ /chos 'chad g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa 'dzin/ /de dag kun gyi pad sdong rtsa ba'i stod/ /rang lus snying thad nyi zla 'od lnga'i dbus/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dkar dmar rab byung chas/ /g.yas pa pad dkar 'dzin (ldan skong rdo rje dang / /phyag g.yon mnyam gzhag steng na tshe bum 'dzin/ /zab don chos sgras 'gro ba'i re ba bskong/ /pad sdong yal ga phyogs kun rgyas pa'i steng / /rim dgu rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs dang / /dpa' bo —109—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (27)mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha dang / /gter dbang zhing skyong dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'khor/ /kun kyang mtshan dper ldan pa'i dag snang gis/ /'gro drug nyams 'og chud pa'i dungs sems kyis/ /phyi nang gsang gsum dngos 'byor yid sprul nas/ /phangs med ltos pa med par yang yang 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba pā dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ /mdun gyi rten gyi mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum/ /sku gsum 'di phyi'i 'dren ston yin bsams la/ /gdung dbyangs ldan pas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab/ /na mo gu ru sbyi/ dang po'i mgon po chos sku 'od dpag med/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid longasasku spyan ras gzigs/ khams gsum 'dren mchog sprul pa sna/ rgyan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyis rlobs/ /dbyangs can sprul pa ye shes mtsho rgyal dang / /hūṃ chen sprul pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / /'jam dbyangs byin brlabs khri srong lde'u btsan zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyis rlobs/ /u rgyan thugs sras mu khri btsan po dang / /gdams pa'i bka' babs rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor rdo rje bdud 'joms la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyisarlobs/ /zab gter brnyes pa'i rgod ldem dngos grub mtshan/ /sku yi sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po dang / /rtse gcig sgrub brtson sangs rgyas bstan pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs byams pa bzang po ba/ /bsams bzhin 'gro don mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas dpal/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chos rgyal (5ba〉bsod nams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog shākya bzang po dang / /mkhyen rab thugs rje ldan pa'i pad+ma dbang / /brgyud pa'i bka' babs rig 'dzin chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyis rlobs/ /mnga' bdag skye sprul chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /rtsod dus pad+ma'i rgyal tshab ngag gi dbang / /rgyal sras yol mo stobs ldan dpa' bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyis rlobs/ /theg mchog chos kyi rgyal po kun dga'i zhabs/ /rig sngags 'chang ba gang shar rang grol dang / /bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin gyis slobs/ /phung khams rnam dag thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'phrin las kun sgrub dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bka' srung dbang gi ma bdun gter skyong la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin — 110

byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma (gnagyis rlobs/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro drug ma lus kun/ /gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag pos skul 'debs na/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las gsang mdzod nas/ /smin grol dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun phob la/ /sgrib dag dbang bzhis sgo gsum smin grol nas/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal srid dag la myur gnas shog /bla ma 'ja' dang 'od du chil li li/ /yi dam sku dang thig le shig se shig /mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i gar nyams khyug se khyug /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum mnyam bzhugs nas/ /thugs rje chen po nyid du dbyer med shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma yas mar rim thim nas/ /rang rang gnas gsum sgo gsum dbyer med lha/ /ma bcos don dag chos sku'i dgongs pa skyong / /rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma ni/ gyi las bdag nyid dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bgrad/ /g.yas pa (6na)dbyug tho g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na brjid/ /gyi pad+ma ta kri ta ha ya shrī wa hūṃ phaṭa/ snro bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas dkar ser dmar ljang hūṃ chen bzhi: 'phro 'du 'od du zhu ba las: ye shes rgyal po bzhi ru gyur: zho dz+nyā na rā dza sam ye swā 1 〉/ ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs na: pho brang wo po spos ngad ldan zab cing rgya che gzigs 'phags po rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : sku mdog dkar po pi wang 'dzin bas mo sras dang blon por bcas: 'khor ni dri za 'bum gyis bskor: sde bo che la stobs po che:mchod gtor 'di bzhes shar phyogs kyi gdon rnams zlog cing phyi mtshams srungs: ྅/ ri rgyal lhun po'i lho phyogs na: pho brang chen po be+e ḍūr+ya zab cing rgya che gzigs 'phags po: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: sku mdog ser po ral gri 'dzin: bas mo sras dang blon por cas: 'khor ni grul bum 'bum gyis bskor sdo bo che la stobs po che: mar gtor 'di bzhes lho phyogs kyi: gdon rnams zlog cing phyi mtshams srungs: ྅/ ri rgyal lhun po'i nub phyogs na: pho brang chen po rgya mtsho'i sba: zab cing rgya che gzigs 'phags po: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : sku mdog dmar po sbrul gas 'dzin: btsun mo sras dang blon por yos: 'khor ni klu dbang 'bum gyis bskor: sde'o che la stobs po che: mar gtor 'di bzhes nub phyogs kyi: gdon rnams sgrog cing phyi mtshams srungs: ྅/ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs na pho brang wo po lcang lo can: zab cing rgya che gzigs 'phags po: rgyal po chen po rnam thos— 111 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posras:sku mdog ljang gu rgyal mas 'dzin:btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas:'khor 6ba ji gnod sbyin 'bum gyis bskor sde'o che la stobs po che:ma rdzo gtor 'di bzhes byang phyogs kyi gdon rnams zlog cing phyi mtshams srungs:྅/rgyal po r+pā po sdebazhi po don gyi sangs rgyas yin mod kyang :gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir:bar chad 'dul bar mdzad du gsol:zho khyu khra ༷ ye swā lhabi ru ta ka ye swā hākhye ru bhak+ṣa ye swā sabe+e shra ma ṇa ye swā lha tā btu ṭa han ṭa tu lha rto3rteta 'phagasapa thugs rje chen po la rtse gcig gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo:thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las ni:phun tshogs bzhi dang ldan pa yis:sngon 'gro'i rim pa tshul bzhin bya:skyabs 'gro sems skye sngon song nasadang po mtshams gcad bya ba ni:྅/nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs:thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir:'dus pa'i lha rnams ma gtags pa bar gcod dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs:gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs:gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na:thugs rje chen po thugs khrosanas khro chen rta mgrin khros nas kyang :sprul pa yang sprul stong gsum gang :gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tsho gos bsnams bar chad thams cad rdul du rlog swo badz+ra ma hā kro dha ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa ṇi tri sha nyu ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa:rang gi gnas de rta mgrin gyi sprul pa mang pos gang bar bsam:de nas bshags pa bya ba ni:bla ma 'phags pa 'khor bcas rnams:mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs byas la:sgo gsum gus pas bshags pa 'bul:hrī:'phags pa 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sngon tshe 'khor ba thog med nas:nyen mongs dug lnga'i dbang gyur te:ngan song gsum gyi las bsags 7na ) pa:lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib rnams:'phags pa'i spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags:tshangs pa khrus kyi dngos grub stsol:pad+ma satwa ā:de nas byin dbab pa ni:spos dang rol mo thogs byas la:hrīḥ.a la la ho:bha ga wa na sa ma ya ho:sa ma ya sa:hrī:chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la:longs spyod rdzogs sku spyan ras gzigs:thugs rje sprul sku pad+ma 'byung :yang sprul thub drug sgo ma bzhi:'gro drug sems can thugs rjesagazigs:dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig:bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs su gsol ka ya wa ka tsit+ta :de nas rang nyid khrus byas te:gtsang ma'i gos

byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtoganagyon me tog thogs gtor ma mchod rdzas thams cad ni: bsang sbyang byin brlab bya ba ni: chu swa bhā wa shug sarba rnyas su bhā wa shuzlo3ṇ+ḍi thams cad stong par dag par sbyangs: zho a ha ra sarba bhe dha ra pā dza te āḥshu chu badz+ra dhū pe ā:lci PROB badz+ra chu āḥs rtswa badz+ra a lo ke āḥshu ca badz+ra ga rje ā:3 PROB badz+ra ni li ju āḥ&: chu badz+ra shasta āḥ& zho āḥ&:de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni: hrī: bum nang pad+ma'i gzhal yas khang : dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: de steng phyi las 'od los pas: gu ru 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar: dang po'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar: phyag g.yas 'og ma shel 'phreng 'dzin g.yon gyi 'og ma pad+ma bsnams zhi ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab ma drug: de steng hūṃ drug rang shar bas shar du lha dbang brgya byin dkar sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis sgra snyan bi (7bsgong sgrog: lha la thugasarjes bzhengs nas chas: lho ru shākya seng ge ser: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol phyag gnyisagaseg shang par bu thogs: mi la thugs rjes bzhengs nas chas: lho nub nam mkha' mdzod dmar po:sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis rin chen sgrom bu bsnams: yi dwags thugs rjesabazhengs nas chas: nub tu seng ge dam ldan smug: sprul sku'i cha byad cho segos gsol: phyag gnyisaglegs bam po ti bsnams byol song thugs rjes bzhengs nas chas: nub byang thag bzang ris sngon po: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis srung zlog go cha bsnams lha min thugs rjesabazhengs nas chos: byang shar chos kyi rgyal po mthing : sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyisasgrib sbyang me chu bsnams dmyal bar thugs rjes bzhengs nas chas: sgo bzhir dzaḥshā baṃ sngo las:dkar ser dmar ljang sgo ma bzhi gtsang ma'i gos kyis mgul chings byas dpag bsam sdong posakha brgyan la: byang chub sems kyi rdo rjes mtshan: thugs rje'i rgyun gyi gzungs thag btags de nasadabyings nas dbang bskur bya phyi dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur byin gyisabarlabs pa dang : rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs su lhun gyis grub rtswa hūṃ tre sngi.āḥ.a bhi 'a ṣañtsa a de nas dbyings nas spyan drang ba: hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs:— 113—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gesras mchogo rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : sprul sku bcom ldan thub pa drug: ye shes lha mo sgo ma bzhi: 'gro drug sems can don mdzad phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lo gi shwa ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: (8na)rin chen bum pa'i gzhal yas su gnyisamed brtan par bzhugs nas kyang : 'gro drug sgrib sbyong 'phrin las mdzod: dzaḥ& baṃ ho sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: 'gro drug sdug bsngal sbyong mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: a ti pu sngo phra ti dza sngo tswa dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi: a lha bdug spos me tog mar me dang : dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa rgya chen 'bul: bzhes nas 'gro drug sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol tshwa badz+ra (po puṅge a lo ke ga rnye ni wi du: sha lta āḥ&: mahā sarba pā dza ho:de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen pos 'gro drug kun la gzigs: byams dang snying rjes sems can kun la snyoms: dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus skyed pa'i yab: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: skye shi gnyis spangs tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: snang srid lha srin thams cad dam la btags: rang byung sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: lha rnams gdul phyir lha yi rgyal por sprul: nga rgyal dag pas 'dod yon longs spyod rol: ma chags chen med chos la mnga' brnyes pa'i: lha yi thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha min gdul phyir lha min rgyal por sprul: phrag dog dag pas 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal sbyong :zhe sdang mtshon dbal zhi la mnga' brnyes pa'i lha min thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod mi rnams gdul phyir mi yi rgyal por sprul: 'dod oṃ/sa dag pas dka' thub nyen mongs (8ba)sbyong : dam pa chos kyi gsung la mnga' brnyes pa'i: mi yi thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: byol song gdul phyir byol song rgyal por sprul: gti mug dag pas shes rab ye shes gsal: ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron me bsnams: byol song thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: yi dgas gdul phyir yi dgas rgyal por sprul: ser sna dag pas dgos 'dod re ba skong : 'dod yon mi zad longs spyod mnga' brnyes — 114

byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtoganapa'i yi dwags thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmyal ba gdul phyir dmyal ba'i rgyal por sprul:zhe sdang dag pas snying rje thabs kyis 'dren srid pa las kyi me long chos ston mdzad dmyal ba'i thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi'i gzhal yas su: dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad: ye shes sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha rnams dgyes pa'i rang sgra las 'gro drug sgrib sbyong gzungs 'di shar: phyi rang nyid skad cig dran pa'i ṣi 'dzin gyis: stong pa'i 4 las pad+ma zla ba'i gdan pad dkar khyoḥs mtshan yongs su gyur ba las: thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar la 'tsher: dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar: phyag g.yas 'og ma rin chen shel phreng bsnams phyag g.yon pad dkar 'dab brgyad yu ba 'dzin zhal 'dzum spyan dngas shangs kyi dbyings mtho zhing : dbu skra lcang lo mthon mthing gyen du 'khyil spyi gtsug sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs rang nyid de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka phu pad+ma dkar po 'dab drug gyes pa'i dbus yi ge gyis mtshan 'bru drug 'dab steng gnas chu ma ṇi pad+me 〉(9na lha de ltar gsal ba'i sku las 'od los pas snang ba thams cad snang stong lha yi sku: 'phags pa'i rgyal po thugs rje chen por dmigs: sngags las 'od los khrung ba'i sgra la sogs: grags pa thamasacad grags stong sngags kyi sgra dran rtog skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral dang : smra bsam brjod 'das dgongs pa'i ngang la gzhag: de ltar gsal ba'i rig sngags 'bru drug po: sgra zur ma nyamasabargya stong khri 'bum bzlas zho ma ṇi pad+me snro ting 'dzin gsal bas snying po bzlas: bum pa ye shesabadud rtsis gang : lha gshegs bum chus khrus bya'o: ('dir mkha' 'gro'i 3 yig zhig 'dug kyang 'god thabs med stabs ma dper gzigs mdzod/)de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni: phyi chos sku nam mkha' lta bu la: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: rang byung rang rig rang shar sku: 'byung ba lnga 'dus 'jig rten 'di: rang gsal chags med gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: 'dod yon pha gu dra ba dang : dra phyed mda' yab rta babs ldan: chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs dang bcas: sha ra na yis rab tu brgyan: phyi —115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gerol rdo rje me ris bskor:rin chen gzhal yas gsal bar bsgom dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba la:pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du:khyoḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs:zhes pa nas/sgo bzhin dzaḥ/ baṃ sngo las:shar sgor dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin:lho sgor ser mo zhags pa 4na:nub sgor dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin byang sgor ljang gu dril bu 'dzin g.yon pa thams cad shel phreng 'dzin rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras:phyi rol khor yug chen po la:gtsang rigs dpal mgon srung mar bcas:bsam gyis mi khyab sprin ltar gtibs 9ba tha stan pa srung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:de nas dbyings nas dbang bskur bya gyi dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa dang :rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang bskur bas:sku gsung thugs su lhun gyis grub tshwa hūṃ lha 1ā:a bhi ṣañtsa ā:de nas spos dang rol mo thogs rtse gcig gdung bas spyan drang ba:sa:sngon tshe bskal pa'i thog ma la:'gro drug sdug bsngal thugs rjes gzigs smon lam stobs bskyed 'gro don mdzad byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs:gnas mchoge 'di ru gshegs sogasol phyi thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas:'od lnga rgya mtsho'i klong du spros rgyu med rkyen med sprul pa'i sku pad+ma lasa'akhrungs ngo mtshar can pad+ma 'byung gnas gshegs su gsol khyed kyis 'gro drug don mdzad phyir gang la gang 'dul thabs sa sprul:rgyun chad med par 'gro don mdzad:bde gshegs sprul sku thub pa drug:thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs sems can 'dzin pas bcings pa rnams:lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i phyir:'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom dgyes mdzad ma sgo srung lha mo chen mo bzhi:gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:lo ke shwa ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza:de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni phyi thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs 'gro drug sdug bsngal sbyang ba dang :bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs bya'i phyir dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol sam ya a ba sha ya a:de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni phyi thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigasa'agro ba sgrol mdzad stobs chen lha sprul pa'i sku ru rang byung ba pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs kyi sa sa gang la gang 'dul thub pa drug:tshad med 10na sko mo sgo ma bzhi:rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la:lusang ga yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal:a ti pu ༷pra ti dza ho de chom nas ma da pa 'bul ba ni phyi

byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtoganadri med yid 'ong gtsang sbyar nas rgya mtsho dngas pa'i klong lta bu gtsang ma'i a lha mchod pa 'bul:tsan dan la sogs spos sbyar nas dri zhim ngad ldan mchod pa 'bul pad+ma yil mdangs ldan pa'i:gsal 'tsher me tog mchod pa 'bul: nyi zla'i snying po mun sel dang : snang gsal sgron me mchod pa 'bul: chu bo rnyog med bsil ba yi: gtsang ma'i dri chab mchod pa 'bul: 'bru bcud snying po kun bsdus pa'i: dkar gsum mngar gsum rgyan gyis mdzes gtor ma lha yi zhal zas 'bul dung dang sil snyan rnga chen sgra: bi wang pheg rdob gling bu'i sgra: snyan pa'i rol mo sna tshogs 'bul two āḥ&:ā ha ra sarba bi dha ra pā dza te āḥhā ca du pe shu zho badz+ra pu khro 〉 chu badz+ra ā lo kai mi PROB badz+ra— 〉 tshwa badz+ra ni wi bya hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sha rto: hrī: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang : do shal dpung rgyan rin chen se mo do: dar gyi stod g.yogs smad dkris sham bu ldan: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen du mas spras 'dod yon ma spangs rang grol rgyan du bzhes: rat+na sarba pā dza 3 gyikun bzang kun khyab bla re gur chen po skyabs mchag gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can: snying po mi nub rtags kyi rgyal mtshan dang : 'gro drug snying rjes skyob pa'i phan phreng dang : shes skyobs dar gur yol ba sum rim dang : pho brang bkra shis yongs rdzogs mchode pa 'bul: hrī: log rtog gcod pa'i shes rab ral gri dang : shes rab thabs ldan ma rig 'bigs pa'i mda' sgrib med sku (10ba)gsum yongs rdzogs dar mtshon 'phur ma rig bag chags kun 'khrud khrus bum dang : rig pa'i snying rje'i thabs kyi gzungs thag dang : ye shes lnga ldan tshon sku dra ba dang : bdud bzhi tshar gcod ye shesaphur pas 'bigs dkyil 'khor rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs mchod par 'bul hrī: chos sku mi 'gyur thabs kyi rdo rje dang : chos dbyings klong yangs shes rab dril bu dang : chos sgra stong gsum khyab byed rnga mchog dang : tshangs pa'i gsung ldan pi wang chos sgra sgrog dngos bshams yid sprul mchod rdzas yongs rdzogs 'bul: khyo: 'khor lo rin wo chos kyi 'khor lo skor nor bu rin wo dgos 'dod thams cad stong : btsun mo rin chen pha rol phyin bcu ldan: khyim bdag rin chen chab srid rab tu spel: glang po rin chen bdud kyi dpung tshogs 'joms: rta mchog rin chen 'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol dmag dpon rin chen nyon mongs g.yul ngo zlog: rin chen sna bdun yongs rdzogs — 117—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gemachod pa 'bul:hrī:sgrub rdzas yungs kar rgyal pos bgegs tsho gos 'joms rdzas mchogo bil bas yon tan thams cad rgyas rtomachoge dur bas gdon gyi gnod pa skyob li khri tshal chen 'gro ba dbang du sdud ghi lha sman gyis nyon mongs nad kun sel:bcud ldan zho yis dbang po'i gzi mdangs skyed:gsal byed me long ma rig mun pa sel:cho ge dung g.yas 'khyil gsung dbyangs drug cu sgrog bkra shis rdzas brgyad yongs rdzogs mchod pa 'bul hrī:gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo me long 'dzan thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs spyan la 'bul sgra yi lha mo sngon mo pi wang sgrog:thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs snyan la 'bul:dri yi lha mo ser mo spos khang 'dzin:thugs rje chen po'i 11na sko tshogs shangs la 'bul ro yi lha mo dmar mo zhal zas 'dzin thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs ljags la 'bul:reg bya'i lha mo ljang gu na bza' 'dzin:thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs sku la 'bul:chos kyi lha mo mthing kha po ti bsnams:thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs thugs la 'bul 'dod yon drug gi mchod pa rgya chen 'bul:phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtsho so mnyes gyur cig mchog dang thun mong dngosagrub stsal du gsol:de nas bstod pa bya ba ni phyi dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas:smon lam stobs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i mthong thos dran pas sdug bsngal kun las grol 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod:de nyid thugs spu'i khyoḥlas 'od 'phros pas rgyu med rkyen med 'irgya mtsho'i klong las 'khrungs:rgyal ba'i sras mchog rang byung sprul pa' sku pad+ma 'byung gnas sras la phyag 'tshal bstod:khyed kyi thugs rjes 'gro drug sdug bsngal gzigs thabs mkhas thugs rjes ngan song sbyang ba'i phyir:gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku ru bstan bcom ldan thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal bstod byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms kyi:tshad med bzhi yis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa:sems can las dang mthun pa'i lam sna 'dren:sgo skyong lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod gyi thugs rje chen po' thugs rka'i snying po las:'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing du thim bde gshegs thugs kyi bcud 'dus yi ger byon nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrog pa'i yi ge drug snying po yi ge drug la phyag 'tshal bstod:snying po 'di nyid8 mthong thos reg pa yis sems can thams cad

byang ga kho thugs rje 'a po'i las byang phan bde'i sting gnas/ nang ma rtoganangan song gnas nas thar:thugs rje chen po'i ba ) thugs kyi bcud 'dus pa'i:gsung mchog yi ge drug la phyag 'tshal bstod:thugs rje phyogs ris med pa kun la snyoms:rang rig ma bcos rang grol chen por shar gang yang ma spangs 'dzin med bde ba che:thugs kyi dgongs pa mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod:de ltar cho ga rnam dag gis:mchod pa 'bul zhing bsnyen pa bya:rab kyis zla gcig 'bum phrag drug 'bring gis zhag bdun 'bum dang khri tsho bzhi:tha mas zhag gcig khri phrag gcig:ma snying 2 yar ngo tshes bcu'i wo bar ci nus bzlas:ā ma ṇi pad+me :'di nyid ci nus bzla par bya:ā+o āḥ& sa rtswa ma ṇi pad+me snro skabs 'dir 'dzab skul ni gong gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs len dgos/ā+oṃ ni sangs rgyas kun gyi :ā: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung :྅ ni sa rgyas kun gyi thugs:hrīji bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku tshwa ni ye shes lnga dang ldan:'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub:ma ni thugs rje chen po'i sku:'gro drug sems can sdug bsngal sbyong :'i ni zhi bas sdig sgrib sbyong :pad kyis yon tan rgyas par spel me ni dbang gis kun la bskur:྅ gis drag pos bgegs rnams 'joms 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol:de nas rtags bstod bya ba ni:hrī:thugs rje wo po spyan ras gzigs:sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro:nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos rtags:zhal gyi 'dzum pa'i tshul ston pa:sems can kun la byams pa'i rtags spyan gnyis zhi bas gzigs pa ni:thugs rjes kun la snyoms pa'i rtags phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba'i rtags:g.yas kyi 'og ma shel phreng bsnams 12na tsher tor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa'i rtags:g.yon gyi 'og ma pad+ma bsnams chags pa'i skyon gyis ma gos rtags:zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs:mnyam nyid don las ma g.yos rtags pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni:chags med 'gro don mdzad pa'i rtags:rin wo rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni:'dod yon ma spangs rang dag rtags:'od zer rnam lnga 'phro ba ni:'gro drug sgrib pa sbyong ba'i rtags:rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbu brgyan pa pad+ma'i rigs las 'khrungs pa'i rtags sprul sku thub drug 'gro don mdzad 'gro drug skye sgo gcod pa'i rtags lha mo bzhi yis sgo srung mdzad:'phrin las rnam bzhi gruX pa'i rtags spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gebastod:de nas zhal zas tshogos mchode 'bul ba ni:tshogs kyi zhal zas ci 'byor bshams re yaṃ kho gis bsregs sbyangs te:zho āḥ&/gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs:de nas tsho gos la spyan drang ba ni:hrī:chos dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas rnams:longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gyis:thugs dam tshul bzhin gshegs su gsol:badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza:hrī:thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas la:zhal zas tshogs mchode 'bul pa ni:spos dang sman dang dri chab dang :bza' btung gos rgyan rol mo dang :dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa 'bul:'bras chan 'bru chan shing thog sogs:bzan bgos 'khur ba'i bye brag dang :bu ram sbrang rtsi ja dar dang :kha mngar skyur ba tsha rtsub snum:'dod yon sna tsho gis mchode pa 'bul:bzhes te dbang dang dngos grub stsol:ga ṇa tsakra pā dza ho:de nas dngos grub blang ba ni:gyi'agro drug thugs rjes gzigs mdzad spyan 2bar sa gzigs:'khor ba dong nas dkrugs pa'i dngos grub stsol:'gro drug gnas su 'dul ba'i thub pa drug 'gro drug skye sgo gcod pa'i dngos grub stsol:tshad med bzhi ldan ye shes sgo ma bzhi:'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol:kwa ya wa ka tsit+ta hūṃ a:de nas lhag ma bsngo ba ni:tsho gis lhag rnams la chab bran la:bsangs sbyangs byin rlabasabyas 'di skad do:hrī:thugs rje chen po'i bka' 'khor na dam pa'i chos kyi srung ma rnams lha wo brgyad dang klu chen brgyad:gza' chen brgyad dang gnod sbyin brgyad:rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu:rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang :ha ri ka dang pan tsi ga 'phrog ma ma bur bcas pa dang :dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang :lha dang lha min mi'am ci dri za gnod sbyin 'byung po dang :lha srin dzibargyad thams cad la:mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsngos pas:ci 'dod phun sum tshogs par shog:ji ltar nus pa'i 'phrin las mdzod:ba kla ta pā dza ho:de nas phyi rol du bstan ma bskyang ba ni::a su ra yi brag phug sa u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i bod yul bstan ma bcu gnyis dang :phyi gtor dbang bar khas blangs rnams:mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di long la bdud dpung thul la zhing bcu sgrol:

byang gter thugs rje chen po'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtoganadal kha chings la 'bru phyugs spel dmag dpung chems la mtshon cha brtul: bcol ba'i dam tshig dran par mdzod: dkyil 'khor bsdub ni/ hrī: snod bcud ma lus gzhal yas khang la thim/ /de nyid thub drug sgo ma bzhi la thim/ /'khor rnams gtso bo thugs rje chen po yang / /ka dag gdod ma'i ngang du 'ja' ltar yal/ /skad cig ngang la chu las chu bur ltar/ /rang nyid thugs(13na)rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /mthong thos dran pas 'gro kun 'khor ba las// rnam par grol ba'i sku ru lhun gyis grub/smon lam ni/ phyi dpal ldan kun bzang chos sku 'od dpag med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam rol spyan ras gzigs/ /sprul sku 'gro ba'i don mdzad pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum yongs 'dus thugs sgrub nyams blangs pas/ /tshe rabs kun du dal ba'i rten thob cing / /tshad ldan rdo rje slob dpon zhabs bsten nas/ /nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /smin grol zab mo'i chos la longs spyod shog /dkyil 'khor sgo srung tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo/ /dkar ser dmar ljang lha mo rnam bzhi yis/ /theg mchog lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun/ /zhi zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i grogs byed shog /gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i rnam rol can/ /bde bar gshegs pa thub pa rigs drug gis/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyam thag pa/ /myong byed las nyon drungs nas 'byin par shog /lhun grub rang bzhin 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /'phags mchog thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /mngon sum byon nas lam sna legs drangs te/ /gru 'dzin dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /ngo bo ka nas dag pa chos kyi sku/ /gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa rig pa'i gshis/ /ye grol kun bzang go 'phang mngon gyur nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /khyad par sa la'i ljongs kyi lha gcig pu/ /'jig rten dbang phyug khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /bod 'bangs 'gro rnams phan dang bde ba yi/ /dga' ston mchog la yun du spyod par shog /pad+ma'i thugs kyi nying khu lha brag gter/ /rnam gsum zab mo thugs kyi sgrub pa yi/ /dbang (13ba)khrid lung dang gdams pa'i chos tshul gyis/ /gangs can 'gro rnams smin cing grol gyur cig /shis brjod ni/ hrī: 'khor 'das thams cad rig pa'i rang rtsal du/ /rnam par grol ba'i — 121 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'chos sku'i bkra shis shog /mkha' la 'ja' ltar ma 'dres rab bkra ba'i/ /lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam par legs ston pa'i/ /thugs rje che ldan sprul sku'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis bsngo ba spyi mthun bya'o: de nas rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnasapar bya'o: thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las u rgyan pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so: nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas sprul sku rig 'dzin chen pos spyan drangs pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:smras pa/ rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan kun du bzang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor le'i mgon por rnam rol ba'i/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma'i thugs kyi bcud/ /'phags mchog 'gro ba kun sgrol 'phrin las gang / /rtsod dus pad+ma'i rgyal tshab mnga' ris pa/ /legs ldan rdo rje'i lugs 'dzin byang pa rje'i/ /zab don chos kyi bka' babs pad+ma dbang / khyab bdag bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod/ /dge des mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus pa/ /mi mthun nyes pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal zhing / /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i nor bu las/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong gyur cig /slar yang smras pa/ gangs can phan bde'i nor bu 'dren pa'i rdzings/ /pad+ma'i chos la smod pa'i stobs ldan 'ga'i/ /skur 'debs rlung gis phyogs lhung mtshor bshig pas/ /sngon chad nyam chung bdag 'dra'i nus pa dman/ /'on kyang bskal ngan mtha' la ma thug cing / /rig 'dzin pad+mas bod khams 'gro ba kun/ /(14na tshe skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung / /slu ba med de yid kyi ngal gsor gnas/ /des na dam sri snying zhugs nag po'i dpung / /pha mthar sgrod pa'i rdzogs ldan nyin byed dbang / /'dren nus zab gter chos kyi rta ljang can/ /gangs can mkha' la rtag tu rgyu bar shog /byang gter thugs sgrub rnam gsum las thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi 'phrin las rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar khrigs chags su bsdebs shing smon lam shis brjod gsar du bsgrigs pa'i las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'di ni slob dpon chen po'i lung bstan gyi dgongs pa ltar bod 'bangs bde ba'i thabs su gnas chen mang por thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa tshugs na snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis bskul cing rang gi kha ton gyi ched du rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs tshad thub kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa du ma'i bka' drin la brten nas theg pa mchog la mos pa'i za — 122

hor gyi rigs las sngags dkar ma ṇi ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan gang shar rang grol du 'bod pa'i sdum bu pas slob dpon chen po pad+mas bstan ma bcu gnyis la gnyer du gtad pa'i ri gdang la dang nye ba'i sar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so// //maṅga lo//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2por༅༅/ /byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi las byang gi don tshang zhing 'byer bde ba phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus phyag na pad dkar la btud nas/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal kun las rang sgrol ba'i/ /nyams len nyung ngu don tshang 'dri bar bya/ /de la 'dir byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol dang 'brel ba'i nyams len rgyun 'byer du byed pa la/ thugs rje chen po'i mchod gtor/ rgyal chen dang / bka' srung dbang gi ma bdun gyi gtor ma bshams/ skyabs sems ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub ma thob bar/ /mchog gsum kun la skyabs 'gro dus gsum dges/ /rang byung rig pa rang shar chos kyi sku/ /yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shog /lan gsum brjod/ rgyal chen mtho 'dzugs ni/ hrīḥ las bdag nyid dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrad/ /g.yas par dbyug to g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na brjid/ /hrī: pad+ma ta kṛ ta ha ya m+bhi wa hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod gtor rnams/ raṃ ye kho oṃ āḥ/ gis byin gyis brlab/ hūṃ/ thugs ka las byung dkar ser dmar ljang hūṃ/ /yongs gyur rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes phyogs kyi gdon srungs la/ /mthun pa'i rkyen rnams (2na thad bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ lha ta ༷ / bi ru lha ka /bi ru pak+ṣa/be+e shra wa ṇa ma hā ba la ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tshar bzhi brjod/ gong gi sngags la/ arnya nas/ sha lta'i bar btags pas mchod/ bgegs skrod ni/ hūṃ/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'dus pa'i lha rnams ma gtogs pa/ /bar gcod dgra bgegs —124

byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma rtogana'abyung po'i tshogs/ /gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ /thugs rje chen po thugs khros nas/ khro chen rta mgrin khros nas kyang / /sprul pa yang sprul stong gsum gang / /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tsho gos bsnams/ /bar chad thams cad rdul du rlog /ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ha ya sgyi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ :stu sha rtsu mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/byin 'bebs ni/ hrī: a la la ho/ /bha ga wa na sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya sto/ hrī: chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhedas la/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rje sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /yang sprul thub drug sgo ma bzhi/ /'gro drug sems can thugs rjes gzigs/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig /bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ /(2ba po ya wā ka tsit+ta hūṃ/ mchod gtor brlab pa ni/ /ā+oṃ su bhā wa shurnyaḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shurnyo3lha/ thams cad stong par dag par sbyangs/ ā+oṃ a ha ra sarba bidha ra pā dza te āḥ// ā+oṃ badz+ra/ pe āḥ// ā+oṃ badz+ra sgro āḥ&/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥ&/ ā+oṃ badz+ra garnye t+yāPROBPROB/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ni wi dre āḥ&/ ā+oṃ badz+ra shasta āḥ// ā+oṃ āḥlha/dngos gzhi ni/ rdo rje'i ra ba me dpung gur nang du/ /zlo las rin cen sna lnga'i gzhal yasakhang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid kun ldan dbus/ /rang nyid skad cig dran pa'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba'i gdan/ /pad dkar hrīḥs mtshan yongs su gyur pa las/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar la 'tsher/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /phyag g.yas 'og ma rin cen shel 'phreng bsnams/ /phyag g.yon pad dkar 'dab brgyad yub 'dzin/ /zhal 'dzum spyan dngas shangs kyi dbyings mtho zhing / /dbu skra lcang lo mthon mthing gyen du 'khyil/ /spyi gtsug sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs/ /'dab ma drug la thub pa rigs drug dang / /sgo ma bzhi sogs ma lus gsal bar gyur/ /spyan 'dren ni/ hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /sras mchog rigs 'dzin pad+ma 125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge'abyung / /sprul sku bcom ldan thub pa drug /ye shes lha mo sgo ma bzhi/ /'gro drug sems can don mdzad phyir/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /lo ke shwa ra sam ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ ho sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan gyis gdan dbul/ a ti pu ho: pra tī ts+tsha hoḥs phyag bya/ /hrī: dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /a lha bdug spos me tog mar me dang / /dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo dbul/ /(3na)gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa rgya chen 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro drug sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra / / ngh+ru pe/ puṅge ā lo ke /nga/ ni wi bye/ shasta āḥlha/ma hā sarba pā dza ho: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du ma hā ba lin+ta khā hi/bstod pa ni/ sa: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad stobs chen lha/ /sprul pa'i sku ru rang byung ba/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs kyi sras/ /gang la gang 'dul thub pa drug /tshad med lha mo sgo ma bzhi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid 'phags par gsal ba'i thugs ka sa /pad+ma dkar po 'dab drug dgyes pa'i dbus/ /yi ge khyoḥs mtshan 'bru drug 'dab steng gnas/ /ā+oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ gyi de ltar gsal ba'i sku las 'od 'phros pas/ /snang ba thams cad snang stong lha yi sku/ /'phags pa'i rgyal po thugs rje chen por dmigs/ /sngags las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i sgra la sogs/ /grags pa thams cad grag stong sngags kyi sgra/ /dran rtog skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral dang / /smra bsam brjod 'das dgongs pa'i ngang la bzhag /de ltar gsal ba'i rigs sngags 'bru drug po/ /sgra zung ma nyams brgya stong khri 'bum bzlas/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla zhing / ā+oṃ āḥlha hrī: e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/zhes yi ge bcu pa'ang cung zad bzlas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros thang lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal dang / bka' srung dbang gi ma bdun 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa ma ya dza pad+ma ka ma lā ye sa/oṃ a lha nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ ā+oṃ a kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā ṭ+wāṃ a du nut+pan+ta (3bkyo ta ā+oṃ āḥ/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ gter srung khyed rnams kyis bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi zhing — 126

byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi las byang phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nang ma khoganamathun rkyen sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs par bsams/nyer bsdu ni/ lha snod bcud ma lus gzhal yas khang la thim/ /de nyid thub drug sgo ma bzhi la thim/ /'khor rnams gtso bo thugs rje chen po yang / /ka dag gdod ma'i ngang du 'ja' ltar yal/ /skad cig ngang la chu la chu lhar ltar/ /rang nyid thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /mthong thos dran pas 'gro kun 'khor ba las/ /rnam par grol ba'i sku ru lhun gyis grub/ /smon lam ni/ 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs khamathus/ /dmyal ba yi dwags la sogs mi khom kun/ /spangs nas skye dang skye ba thams cad du/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang rnyed par shog /der yang bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis gzung / /zab mo'i chos la thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /ring por mi thogs spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /gnas skabs su yang tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal 'byor longs spyod mnga' thang la sogs pa/ /bla nas blar 'phel bde skyid phun tshogs par/ /spyod pa'i skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog /shis brjod ni/ myi 'khor 'das thams cad rig pa'i rang rtsal du/ /rnam par grol ba'i chosasku'i bkra shis shog /mkha' la 'ja' ltar ma 'dres rab bkra ba'i/ /lhun grub longs spyod rdzogasasku'i bkra shis lha/ga /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa legs ston pa'i/ /thugs rje che ldan sprul sku'i bkra shis shog /ces byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi las byang gi don tshang zhing 'byer bde ba phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'di ni sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi rgyun gyi nyams len du dngos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so// //sarba maṅga lo// //— 127

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ger༅༅/ /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rigs 'dzin zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥpad+ma ka rā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum rang bzhin mtha' klas 'gro blo'i rdzing bu la/ /rang rang snang ngor ma 'dres rtag 'char bde ba chen po'i mkha' klong du/ /gcig tu gyur kyang so sor ston pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i 'od dkar phan bde'i sa smos rgyas par mdzod/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i zhi dang khro bo'i gar/ /bka' brgyad lha yi rol par yongs shar las/ /pad+ma gsung gi lha zhes snyan pa'i rnga/ /sgrog mkhas dngos brgyud slob dpon tshogs spyi dang / /dpal stug theg mchog rgya mtsho'i 'byor pa'i nor/ /mkhyen pa'i za ma tog tu lhun grub pa'i/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'khon ston kun du bzang / /'bral med snying dbus bzhugs la brtse bas skyongs/ /nges gsang lam 'di mtsho ltar gting mthas dben/ /dbang chen chos tshul mkha' ltar pha mtha' yas/ /dam pa'i rnam thar gar ltar tshad ge zung bral/ /snyoms las blo gros rto ltar che cher phra/ /de lta na yang snga 'gyur zab don la/ /grub brnyes sngags 'chang rigs las nyer son zhing / /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /gsung gis bskul tshe yi ge'i (2na) phreng bar spel/ /de yang ye gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa'i chos sku kun du bzang po yab yum gyis bde gshegs zhi khro mtha' klas pa'i dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus nas/ zhi khro rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo dpal sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad spyi rgyud dang sgos rgyud sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs shing / de tsam du ma zad theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud mtha' yas pa gsungs/ don dngos po'i gnas tshod la/ ston pas zhal nas ma gsungs par/ /'khor gyis rtogs brjod blo la snang / /— 128

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rig 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma khoganazhes gtso 'khor ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i dgongs pa gcig pa'i dus 'da' ba yin la/ de yang chos sku spros pa med pa'i ngang de nyid las/ longs sku'i rnam par rol pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gsang sngags kyi byung khungs slob dpon chen po'i gsung las/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po 'das pa'i dus:ma tre ru tra bsgral ba'i rdzas brgyad las: gsang sngags byon pa'i gnas brgyad byin brlabs pa'i: tsi ta u rgyan yul du babs pa las rten 'brel khyad par can la zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bkod pa chen po'i bstan pa lam ston pa thub dka' gzhen (2bsi'i drung du/ rgyal rigs kyi dge slong thar pa nag po dang / g.yog po dan phag gnyis kyis gdams pa zhus pas/ g.yog gis tshul bzhin rtogs la/ dpon gyis sgras zin ltar log par spyad pas lta spyod ma mthun pa ston pa la dris par lan drang por gsungs pas/ thar pa nag po khros te slob dpon la gshe bas/ rdo rje'i dmyal ba nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar brgyud de/bskal pa gnyis ldan gyi mtshams shig tu/ srin yul laṅka pu rir smad 'tshong ma bdud btsan lha gsum dang bsgos pa'i mngal du srid bzung bas/ zla ba dgu na byis pa mgo gsum/ lag pa drug /rkang pa bzhi/ gshog pa gnyis yod pa zhig skyes te/ thog mar ma shi ba'i ro zos/ de rjes lusakyi lang tsho rgyas pa dang / dur khrod kyi chos sogs kyis brgyan cing / mthu stobs kyi 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus/ de skad du yang gsol 'debs las/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchogo dam pa phu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bka' bgros mdzad: zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam bzhi yis: log pa bdud kyi bstan pa 'dul bar mdzad: ces pa ltar bde gshegs zhi khro rnams bka' 'gros te/ spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma gnyis kyis 'dul ba'i dus bab tu gzigs nas bka' bsgos pas/ rta mgrin gyis rū tra'i 'og sgo dang / phag mos dus mtshan ma'i bha ga nas zhugs te/ rta phag gi dbu spyi gtsug tu rgyangs kyis thon nas btul bas/ zhum pa'i tshig gis/ dbus la mchis pa'i skal ba med/ /dkyil (3na tshe snyor mtha' la de rnams zhog /phud la rtsal ba'i skal ba med/ /lhag ma zhal chab nged la zhu/ /zhes 'bangs su khas blangs/ de skad du yang —129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge gsang ba'i snying po las/ de nas de dag shin tu 'dar zhing / ra btu bred pas zhum pa'i nga ros/ 'bangs su mchi/ 'bangs sumachi/ 'bangs su nan tan ma bgyis na/ /ma spyodang lus ni brgyar gas shing / /snying yang gas shing gtub gyur cig /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di dag gi lo rgyus bka' gter gnyis tshig 'dra min tsam snang yang / don phal cher mthun la/ de'i tshe khro bo'i gtso bo ni sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi lha tsho gos yin zhing / rig 'dzin rdo rje chos kyi rgyud lung man ngag tu bsdebs nas mkha' 'gro dang sde brgyad la gtad/ de rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i skor gser gyi sgrom bu/ yang dag dngul/ gshin rje gshed lcags/ rta mgrin zangs/ phur pa g.yu/ ma mo bse/ drag sngags gzi/ 'jig rten mchod bstod mchong gi sgrom bu/ bka' brgyad spyi sgril rin po che sna brgyad las byas pa'i sgrom bur bcug ste mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo ches mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par gter du sbas/ nam zhig na slob dpon brgyad kyi gzigs snang mthun par cho 'phrul sna tsho gos snang bas/ 'jig rten phung 'tshengs gang rigs shig yod par dgongs nas/gnas der sdo brgyad kyi thun rdzas dang bcas te bka' bsgos pas/ gter bsrung rnams kyis/ gser bi ma la/ dngul〉 ka ra/ lcags 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ zangs klu sgrub/ g.yu bra bha ha sti/ bsedha na sang kṛ ta/ mchong rom bu bhu spo/ gzi shirnyi ga rba la gtad/ (2ba'i na po che sna brgyad kyi sgrom bu slar gter du sbas pa/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis btone pa yin la/ de yang kun mkhyen ye bzang rtse pa 'jig rten pa'i sde gsum bod ma yin par legs par mdzad na'ang / rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad la bka' babs tshul dang 'gal bas cung zad ma dgongs par mngon la/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis/ phyogs 'di la kha mang du zer na'ang / bye brag smra bas theg pa chen po'i sdesnod la smod pa dang 'dra bas/ rang nyid las dang skal ba dman pas nongs so/ /de ltar bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi ya gyal/ pad+ma gsung gi skor 'di nyid bod du dar bar mdzad pa po yang slob dpon pad+ma yin la/ de nyid dha na ko sha'i gling du pad+ma'i sdong po las rdzus te 'khrungs pa/ u rgyan rgyal po ma hā — 130

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rig 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganab dan bya ba'i blon po te tsa pu ris mthong ste/ rgyal po la sras med pa'i tshab tu 'os par smras pas/rgyal po btsun mo rnams kyis khye'u de sras su mnga' gsol nas/ ming se ha bha tar btags/ nam zhig blon po ma hā a ta'i bu'i mgo la sor brdeg brgyab pa'i rkyen gyis shi bas/ rgyal po'i khrims kyis zla ba gsum gyi pha rol du spyugs/ de nas slob dpon pra bha ha sti'i drung du rab tu byung nas/ sngags kyi chos mang po zhus shing / tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ slar yul du byon pas blon po sogs gros byas te mer bsregs pa na/ me dpung mtsho ru bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis yul de'i 'gro ba mtha' dag yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ lo rgyus 'di rnams yang gsang gi slob dpon rnam thar ltar bkod pa yin la/ myang dang u rgyan gling pa sogs kyi gter kha'i rnam thar rnams dang cung zad/(4nas 'grig kyang gdul bya'i snang ngo'i/ /de nas ring por ma lon par bod kyi lha btsad po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ dam pa'i chos dar ba'i slad du mkhan po rin po che spyan drangs te/ dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug khag khang bzhengs kyang / lha ma srin rnams kyis bar chad mang du btang bas/ mkhan po'i lung bstan ltar/ btsad pos gser dang rta mog dro mgo dmar bskur te/ pho nya ba gdan 'dren du btang bas/ slob dpon gyis mkhyen te/ rdzu hrūl gyis gshegs pa dang lam du mjal/ de nas lam rnam bas su rim gyis lha srin gdug pa can rnams btul zhing / gter kha yang mang du sbas te bsam yas su phebs pa'i tshe/ btsad pos dbu zhwa dang phyags gsol zhing / sku rags ma bcings par bsu ba mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyis stod smad du rgyal khrims cung zad chags la/ bar 'dir rgyal khrims sil bur myur du 'gro zhes gsungs/ thang yig tu/ skabs 'dir mchod yon phyag la ma dan pa'i lo rgyus la/ dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bas/ de mi dag pa'i sgrub byed mang du smra yang / lo rgyus kyi khog mi gcig pa ma gtogs/ sba ba ched du yang phyag la ma dan tshul zur tsam snang bas/ lho brag chos 'byung ba'i de bab chol du zad do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis sa gzhi rnams btul zhing byin gyis brlabs/rgyal po la gshin rje ro gcig /pad+ma ska gcig /bdud rtsi thigs gcig /phur pa srog gcig /ma mo — 131 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2posnying gcig /thig le nyag gcig /yang dag me gcig ste rtsis kyi chos bdun gnang / khyad par slob dpon brag dmar 'om bur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ btsad pos/ dgra bgegs spyi dang / khyad (4ba)par klu 'dul ba'i chos zab mo zhig zhus pas/ pad+ma skad gcig gi nang nas zab pa rta mgrin yang gsang gi chos skor rnams gnang zhing thugs nyams su bstar nas/ man ngag mtha' dag lhas mer pa'i se ba gdong du gter du sbas/ de nas slob dpon srin yul du gshegs par bzhed pa la/ rgyal blon rnams kyis bzhugs par gsol bas/ nga sdod na btsad po'i sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa byed/ bye phrug la gzi 'dogs/gtsang po zangs kyi sbubs su 'jug /gram pa thams cad zhing du sgyur bar byed gsungs pas/ bon blon rnams kyis de dag la snyad re btags te slob dpon 'byon par zhus pa ltar/ nyi zer la chibs nas ru lag ngos la yar byon pas lha 'dre rnams kyis ma bzod par g.yas ru phyogs su bros pas/ da lta g.yas ru ba la mdzo can dang mi'u thung sogs mang ngo / /de ltar slob dpon bod du yun ring ma bzhugs tshul 'di/ yang gsang gi lo rgyus ltar bkod pa yin zhing / de dang mthun par 'o bran lugs kyi phur pa'i stong thun/ lang 'ab/ rong zom/ jo lugs kyi phur pa'i lo rgyus/ rdo rje thog zlog ma'i lo rgyus dang / chos dbang rin po che'i yab mes dbang rje btsan khrom gyis bon po'i thog zlog pa'i skor sogs gung 'grig par snang la/ de dag dang sba bzhed kyang cung zad mthun zhing / thang yig sogs su lha sras kyis rgyal srid mdzad pa'i bar du slob dpon bzhugs par bshad pa gnyis mi 'grig pa'i 'gal 'dzol che bas/ phal cher rang rang gi phyogs su zhin te/ cig shos mi 'thad par smra na'ang /slob dpon chen po 'di nyid kyis dus gcig la sku gsung thugs kyi (5nasgo dzad pa mi 'dra ba bgrang yas pa ston pa'i phyir na/ lo rgyus mi mthun pa de dag kyang gdul bya so so'i snang ngo dang mthun par bstan pa yin la/ slob dpon bzhugs kyang sdig blon sogs 'ga' zhig kho rang rnams kyi las sgrib dang / slob dpon gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus ma mthong bas ma bzhugs par gleng ba yang bsam ngo la ltos na bden te/ nyi ma shar yang brag phug kha byang lta la mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de'i phyir sdig blon sogs— 132

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rig 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma (gnaslob dpon bzhugs pa la mi dga' ba 'ga' zhig gi don du sprul pa gcig gshegs pa ltar mdzad cing / don du sku dngos kyis bzho stod te sgror byon nas mkhar chen bza' la mkha' 'gro snying thig gsungs pa sogs/ yar lungs shel gyi brag phug gis gtsos pa'i bod kyi gnas chen thams cad byin gyis brlabs shing / skal ldan rnams la theg pa mchog gi chos mang du stsal/ ring zhig na bsam yas su phebs te/ bon blon snams kyis lo paṇa rnams gsod par brtsams pa'i tshe/ rdzu hrūl gyis btul bas de phyin chad chos sgrub pa'i bar chad ma byung ba'i tshul sogs byang gter gyi lo rgyus rnams kyang gung 'grig par sems so /de yang thang yig tu/ gter ston sangs rgyas bla ma nas/ bde chen gling pa'i bar lung bstan pa rnams snga phyi'i go rim nges can du ma mchis shing / rdor 'bum chos grags/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem/mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che pad+ma dbang rgyal/ rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje/ 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ 'phreng mgo shes rab 'od zer/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs gter ston grags can shin tu mang ba ma thebs par 'dug pas/ yang gsang gi gter 'di 'don pa'i gter ston yang gsal kha ma mchis mod/ (5ba〉snon kyang ding sang se ra theg chen gling byes grwa tshang gi rta mgrin khang na bzhugs pa'i phur pa 'di/ yang gsang gi chos skor rnams dang gter gnas gcig cing /slob dpon mda' 'phyar gyis phur pa gter nas bzhes pa dang / yang gsang gi bka' babs yin pa la brten nas 'byul pa'i mda' 'phyar chos 'di'i gter ston yin zhes 'chad pa mang yang / 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i byes kyi phur pa'i lo rgyus na/ mda' 'phyar gyis phur pa 'di gter nas btan zhes dmigs kyis bkar bas/ chos gter 'don pa po ma yin pa shugs kyis bstan la/ de yang gter ston dngos ni/ sum pa dbang tshul/ 'bre shes rab bla ma/ rkyang po grags pa dbang phyug gsum gyis lha sa yer pa'i brag nas yang gsang gi skor rnams btan pas/ gter sngur byung nas sum pa 'das/ 'bre spyo/ rkyang po la mdze byung nas shog ser de zhu ston bya ba rta mgrin gyi grub thob cig gi — 133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gelag tu byung yang / las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' ma nyams pa gter ston la bar chad byung ba'i dbang gis spel ma thub pas dbang lung gi rgyun med par yun ring por 'byams/ de nas dus ring mo zhig na/ grub thob mda' 'phyar nags rgyal du bzhugs dus/ slob dpon pad+mas zhang tshes zla grags zer ba'i sngags pa zhig tu sprul nas dbang lung rnams gnang ste/ sngags kyi oṃ de hrī ru sgyur la sgrubs shig gsung ba ltar bsgrubs pas mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'grub la/ gong du gter ston gsum byung ba la dgongs te/ khri srong skye sprul byang pa gter ston bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes/ gter ston grangs nges kyi gsol (6na 'debs su/ grags pa sum pa dbang phyug mtshan mtha' can/ /'bre ban tshul bzang rnam gsum tshogs pa'i gter/ /zhes so/ /mda' 'phyar gyi gter ma'i phur pa 'di nyid kyang / phal cher rta mgrin gyi phur pa zhes gleng na'ang / 'khor ston chos kyi rgyal pos rdo rje gzhen nu'i khungs dang sbyar te gsungs pa yid ches kyi gnas su snang zhing / skyid grong du sa paṇa dang gnas tshang gcig tu gdan 'dzom par/ badz+ra kyi li kyi lwa zhes 'dzab dbyangs mdzad pas/ sa paṇa gyis de ma dag ki li gi lwa yin gsungs par/ ma dag kyang 'di bzhin byed gsungs nas brag la brgyab pas 'jim pa la brgyab pa ltar song / paṇa chen sngags dag par 'dug pas 'don par zhu zhes gsol bas/ 'gul ba tsam yang ma byung bas/ slar slob dpon rang gis gcus stabs kyis bton pas gshog pa gas/ sa paṇa gyis/ slob dpon grub thob chen por dgongs te/ mu stegs dang rtsod pa mdzad pa'i sku rim du 'byon dgos gsungs nas lhan cig tu phebs/ de'i tshe rtsod pa rje btsun sa paṇa rgyal yang / 'phrog byed dga' bo nam mkha' la 'phur bar/slob dpon gyis sngags dang bcas te grib ma la phur pa btab pas sa la lhung / de nas mi ring bar phur pa mu spras gtsug lag khang gi rten gtsor bzhugs shing / dus phyis kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seng ge gzhis ka dpal 'byor lhun por bzhugs skabs/ yab yon tan mgon pos/ pad+ma yang gsang gi chos skor dang / rdo rje gzhen nu'i phur pa 'di gnyis ched gnyer skyel bar btang ba la brten — 134

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rig 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtogananas/ kun mkhyen pas gzhis skar sgrub dbang dang gtor chen gyi phyag len (6ba〉btsugs shing / rim gyis se ra theg chen gling gi byes bla brang du gtor sgrub kyi rgyun btsugs pa da lta'i bar du gnas/ sgar pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang rin spungs don yod rdo rje mchod yon lhan cig par po ta lar phebs skabs/ ser 'bras kyi bla ma rnams kyis mjal du byon dus/ chos rje gnyal ston pas/ khyed mchod yon gyis/ nged rnams gzhis ka snel pa dran mi dgos pa mdzod cing / ma mdzad na 'di rgyag dgos pa yong /gsungs nas phur pa rkang nas bton pas/ 'phral nyams 'char gyi rnam pa 'dra zhig byung yang / don thugs dogs zos pa'i dbang gis mchod yon gnyis ma'i sku tshe'i bar chad du song ba sogs lo rgyus mang du mchis/ pad+ma yang gsang gi bka' sdod ging lnga gza' gdong gnyan pas/ dgra sde'i dpung tshogs gzhom pa'i tshul ches mang yang yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas ma bkod do/ /de ltar dpal yang gsang khros pa 'di nyid/ theg pa rim pa dgu las bdun pa ma hā yo ga'i phyogs su gtogs shing / rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag gter las byon pa rnams dang / slad mar phyogs 'di la tshad thub kyi mkhas pa mu spras pa yab sras dang / gnas rnying chos rje rdo rje rin chen sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos las byang 'phrin las bzhi'i bang mdzod/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi yig cha dang phyag len gyi rgyun nub dgon pa nas brgyud pa'i phyag len/ 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal pos bla ma brgyud 'debs/ bstod pa smon lam snang ba sogs mkhas grub du mas bskrun pa'i yig cha mang du yod mchis shing / rtog ge pa 'ga' zhig gis snga 'gyur gyi dgongs don ma rtogs pa'i phyis 'gyur rgyas (7na)'gebs kyis rang bzo kho na la brten pa'i dbang chog sogs yod par snang ba dag ni/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis dug bzhin du spangs te/ sngags gsar rnying mtha' dag so so'i dgongs bzhed ltar ma 'dres par nyams su bstar ba mkhas pa mgu ba skyed pa'i gnas so/ /ngo mtshar chos 'byung rgya mtsho'i ma ma las/ /dbang chen lo rgyus nyung ngu'i bsil sbyin mkhan/ /rig 'dzin ༄ la dkar po'i dga' ston du/ /blo gros kun — 135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegasal bu mo'i 'gram par shar/ /mthon mthing ral pa kha ba'i mdangs 'dzin cing / /dmar ser ag tshom lan bu'i khyogs 'chang yang / /dbang chen sgrub la g.yel med dka' thub can/ /de 'drar lha chen gyis kyang ci byar yod/ /de ltar sngon 'byung lo rgyus dag /dag cing nyung ngur bgyis pa'i tshig /tshig gi phreng bar spel ba las/ /las bzhi'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i gter 'byung lo rgyus rig 'dzin zhal lung zhes pa 'di yang / rgya sngags 'chang chen po 'jam dpal gsang ba dang / chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i paṇa chen kun dga' bde legs sogs dam pa rim par byon pa'i gdung las son pa/ thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po blo bzang kun dga' bde legs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ zur gsang bdag sgro phug pa chen po'i skye sprul 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin las/ gsang sngags bka' gter gyi don phyogs tsam rig cing / rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs shes nas dad pa thob pa'i za hor gyi sngags (7ba tha tsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan ba 'ad pa rtsal gyis sa skyong gi lo nag pa zla ba'i dbyangs o 'char ba'i tshes la sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni rig sngags 'chang ba ngag dbang dge legs so// //maṅga lo// //— 136

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganar༅༅/ /pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na ma phe ha ya shrī wā ya/ don dam chos dbyings zad mi shes pa'i dbang gi rgyal po'i bang mdzod las/ /srid zhi'i phun tsho gis 'dod dgu'i dpal ster khro chags brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /dbang drag 'phrin las gar gyis rnam rol rta mchog pad+ma he ru ka /gang gi zhabs pad gtsug na bsten no mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /zab gter gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin 'dar char zhabs/ /'khrul med brgyud pa'i bka' babs mus sras pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tsho gos rnams phyag gi yul/ /dbang chen lha yis rjes bzung tshar pa rje/ /'jam mgon grub pa dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /theg mchog bdud rtsi'i dpal ster ā nan+ta/ /drin can bla ma gtsug gi pad mtshor bsten/ /yang zab rgyud sde'i chu gter las 'ongs pa'i/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad nyin mor byed pa yi/ /cha shas dbang chen lha yi 'od zer gyis/ /nag phyogs bdud sde'i mun pa pha mthar sgrod/ /de phyir rta mchog 'phrin las grangs med las/ /zab las ches zab yang gsang khros pa zhes/ /bka' gter zung du 'jug pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i dbyangs su sgrog /rgyud 'debs (2bskyobs sems tshogs skrod mtshams/ /bshags byin mchod kun sbyang dang spel/ /phyi mchod sman gtor rak+ta brlab/ /sngon 'gro'i khrigs te brgyud 'debs ni/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso/ /zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bdag /gsang chen bzang po'i 'phrin las bstan pa'i dpal/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dbyings 'od gsal bde ldan zhing khams su/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos sku'i —137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'asnang brnyan ni/ /dmar gsal mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar 'od dpag med/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs/ /'og min bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde stong gnyis med khrag 'thung khro bo'i gar/ /yang gsang khros pa'i dpal chen dkyil 'khor pa/ /longs sku pad+ma dbang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /nub phyogs u rgyan rnga yab dpal ri'i rtser/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus rig 'dzin che/ /srin po'i kha gnon skye dgu yongs kyi gnyen/ /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /nags rgyal lha chu mtshan ldan bsgrub gnas su/ /pad+mas rjes bzung rab dga'i sa la gnas/ /gangs can khrod 'dir grub (3na)thob 'dar char zhes/ /yongs su grags pa de nyid la:/ dpal ldan bo dong mkhas pa'i chos grwa mā /thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud legs sbyangs nas/ /'chad rtsom rtsom pasargyal ba'i bstan pa spel/ /chos rgyal brtson 'grus rdo rje la / byang phyogs nyan po'i dben gnas brag rdzong du/ /zab dang rgya che gdams pa'i mdzod bzung nas/ /skal ldan gdul bya skyong ba'i mkhas grub rje/ /nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /brag ram dpal gyi gtsug khang chen du//rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mthar son mkhas pa'i mchog /gcig tu sgrub pa lhur len grub pa'i dbang / /mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang laḥ/ gtsang stod mus sras dpal gyis dgon pa mā /gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ khyad par lam 'di'i rtsa lag chag ston rje/ /kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge la / rnam par grol ba'i gnas kyi yang rtse sa /kun mkhyen chen po'i sras kyi thu bo pa/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /chos rje rin chen bkra shis la — /gar bzhugasachos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde stong gnyis med ye shes rol pa las/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i rba rlabs stong g.yo ba/ /rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po la / rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mang gtsug lag tu/ /zab don smra ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog gyur pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal//bla chen chos dpal bzang po laḥ / /dpal ldan sa skya grangs chen bla brang du/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing / /gsung ngag bstan pa'i sgron me mus sras pa/ /byams pa rdo rje rgyal — 138

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganamatshan la / /snye thang bde mchog dpal gyi yang dben (3na〉du/ gsang chen gdams pas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /mthu stobs nus pas nag phyogs phye mar 'thag /mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po la:/dam pas byin brlabs nags phug dgon pa sa /kun bzang dgongs pa'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ /drag sngags grub pa'i snyan grags phyogs kun khyab/ /'khrul zhig rat+na bha dra laḥ/mang 'khar cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ /blo gsal bung ba 'du ba'i pad mo'i tshal/ khyud sdo rgya mtsho'i bcud phyung gdams pa'i gter/ /drin chen mtshar pa smyon pa la : / gtsang stod zhwa lu dpal gyi chos grwa cher/ /gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur spel mdzad cing / /mtshar chen chos rje'i thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'dzin mkhas mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug laḥ/gsung ngag slob bshad chos 'khor yang rtse sa kha'u par grags 'khrul med bstan pa'i rgyun/ /rnam par rgyas mdzad mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /mkhas grub bsod nams chos 'phel la ca/ rje btsun gong ma'i phyogs med gdan sa sa /snyan rgyud gdams pa mchog gi bdud rtsi yis/ /skal bzang 'chi med dga' ston spel mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan la ca/ phun tsho gos slob bshad chos kyi sde chen por/ /gsang chen theg mchog yid bzhin nor bu las/ /legs bshad 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la / bde ba'i rdo rje'i mi 'gyur pho brang cher/ /zab rgyas chos tshul bye ba'i sgo phye nas/ /skal ldan gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can la:/ dga' ldan gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i pho brang cher/ /rang rang gdul bya'i blo dang legs 'tsham par/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub chos tshul 'doms mdzad pa'i/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la jo/ de ltar rgyal (3ba tha dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / /rig 'dzin rig pa brda yi brgyud pa dang / /gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma ste/ /dus gsum rig 'dzin bla ma la gsol:/ bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pas rjes bzung zhing / /yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i mthus/ khrag 'thung rgyal po myur du 'grub par shog /sgrub chen bka' brgyad snying po pad+ma dbang / /gsang las yang gsang — 139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'khros pa nying khu'i rgyud/ /'phags yul grub dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po be+e ro'i zhabs/ /gangs can grub mchog dpal ldan 'dar char gyi/ /thugs kyi nying khu zhal gyi gdams pa 'di/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin 'byul med legs rtogs te/ /rtse gcig brtson pas nyams su len par shog /rnam dag dbang bzhis bdag rgyud legs smin cing / /rim gnyis zab mo'i rtogs pa ldan byas nas/ /gnas skabs las bzhi'i 'phrin las kun grub ste/ /kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du 'gyur bar shog /lte ba'i dbus gnas mchogo gi 'od dmar gyis/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /mun khung sgron me bteg pa ji bzhin du/ /gsal dwangs snang ba'i bskyed rim rtogs par shog /de ltar snang ba'i bskyed rim thams cad kun/ legs par brtags tshe skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /gdod nas bral ba'i sems nyid rig pa'i rtsal/ /stong nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtogs par shog /de nas chu zla bar snang 'ja' tshon ltar/ /snang zhing brtags na bden par ma grub cing / /med cing snang ba mi 'gag gdod ma'i gshis/ /zung 'jug ngang nas sku gnyis mngon 'gyur shog /dregs pa'i rgyal po gying chen sde lnga dang / /gza' gdong drag po gnod sbyin lcam dral sogs/ /ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /gsang chen bstan pa srung ba'i mthu ldan shog /mkha' la rig (4na skodzin brgyud pa'i char sprin gtibs/ /bar la rnal 'byor gsang sngags 'brug stong sgrog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen gyis/ /sgrub mchog phun tshogs 'bras bu 'grub par shog /skyabs su 'gro ba'i rims pa ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ khyab bdag kun bzang go 'phang ma thob bar/ /dkon mchog 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /g.yin don byang chub sems bskyed ni/ mtha' med mar gyur drin can 'gro ba kun/ /bla med sangs rgyas sa la dgod pa'i ched/ /dbang chen yang gsang khrosapa sgrub pa'i thabs/ /zab mo'i 'phrin las nyams su blang bar bya/ /tshogs zhing gsal gdab rnam dag bdun/ rang gi mdun du pad nyi ru dra'i steng / khrag 'thung lha tshogs rigs kyi bdag po mā /rtsab brgyud —140

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganapa'i bla ma kun bzhugs pa/ /mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra bar gyur/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyi nang gsang ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin dbul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig lhung ma lus bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /mgon rnams zab rgyas chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /bskal par mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs ma lus sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bar gcod bgegs dpung phyir sgrod pa/ ā+oṃ swa bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā su bhā wa shud+dhi3lha/ /paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ ru dra baṃ/ gyi sla ra ṇa phaṭa/ gi ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ phyi pad nyi ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /skad cig bdag nyid dbang chen dmar nag mdog /(4bskol gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa be con 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub rtse la me dpung 'bar/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs/ /dbu gtsug rta skad srid gsum khyab par 'tsher/ /thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus gang bar gyur/ /hrī: dpal chen mi bzad dkyil 'khor nas/ /'bar ba'i khro bo me dpung 'bar/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tsho gos bsnams//bgegs dang log 'dren rdul du rlog /dbang chen me dpung dmar nag 'bar/ /bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta bu/ /dbang drag mtshon cha brag ltar gtams/ /gang la bab na gcod cing sgrol/ /dbang chen khro bo mi bzad brngams/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo ye shes 'khrigs/ /dbang chen mtshams las gang 'da' ba/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /ā+oṃ nga ni — hūṃ/ gri ha na gri ha na hūṃ/ gri ha nā pa ya gri ha nā pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wa na/ bi du rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshams gcod srung ba'i gur khang ni/hrī steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus khro bo dang / /rdo rje'i rwa ba bskal pa'i me 'bar bas bar mtshams med par gtams pa'i gur khang gi /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /ā+oṃ raṃ krodha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ snya k+ṣa ṇa bi shwa dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ sdig sgrib nyes lhung bshags pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bla ma sangs — 141

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gergyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /bskor ba mdun du badz+ra sa mā dza: ྅: bdag gis dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin dbang phyug go 'phang du/ /yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon la/ 'da' bar mi bya bsrung bar dam bcas te/ /lasang na dbang gyur skye bo bdag 'dra ba/ /(na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang du gyur/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /yi dam lha yi phyag rgya ma gsal te/ /sngags dang bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i grangs kyang chag /bsnyen bsgrub bkang phyir dus kyi cho ga chag /nya shi dus drug mchod pa lo zla 'das/ khas blangs dam bcas gzhan du ma bgyis te/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /snyan khung brgyud nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lta spyod gsang ba'i man ngag gnyer gtad pa/ /spyod pa g.yel bas man ngag gnyer ma thub/ /nyams shing tshogs chag nyams pa'i tshogs dang 'dres/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /snang gsal sgron ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / /dam tshig zung gis 'brel ba'i yum rnamasal/ /snying nas smod cing thugs dang 'gal gyur pa/ /bka' chad gnas su gyur pa mthol lo bshags//dam chig srung bas 'brel ba'i mched lcam la/ /sku brdungs 'gran sems zhe sdang bsdigs la sogs/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /lhung ba'i lu gu rgyud de rgyun thag chod/ /dbyings nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma he ru ka twe no pa nga ḍi rdo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/a nu ra sto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ sarba ga rma su tsa me/ tsiste shrī yaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wa na pad+ma shrī he ru ka ma me muñtsa pad+ma shrī he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa a hūṃ/ ye shes byin chen dbab pa ni/ a la la ho/ /bha ga wa na sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya skye: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par ston pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /nyams chag bkong ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthu stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen phob cig bcom ldan 'das/ /— 142

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnadangos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag rnams la/ /las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ mchod kun sbyang ba'i rim pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ga'i sa bon las/ /spros pa'i raṃ las ye shes me dpung 'bar/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs ma lus pa'i/ /ma dag nyes skyon bsregs shing byang bar gyur/ /mchod kun spel ba'i rim pa ni/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i/ /a yig 'od zer 'bar ba'i nus mthu yis/ /chung dang nyung ngu'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyang / /mang por 'phel zhing rgya cher rgyas gyur cig /phyi mchod byin kyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ ṇaḥlas me rlung chu gsum byung / /phyi yi mchod pa'i dri ma bsregs gtor bkrus/ /a dhu pu a ga na sha: sam ya sa: sla ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ sa bon las grub mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /chu dang nyer spyod rol mo legs thogs pa/ /dam tshig dbang gyi byon zhing 'od zer 'phros/ /'phags pa mchod cing sems can don kun byas/ /srid zhi'i 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs kun bsdus/ /kun du bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung spros/ /ā+oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra / rtswa badz+ra dhū pe lha tshwa badz+ra sgro / rtswa badz+ra a lo kai ྅: rlu badz+ra rjo ྅: zho badz+ra ni waṃ du ྅: zho badz+ra sha lta ྅: sman phud byin gyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bdud rtsi sman mchod kyi/ /snod dang bcas pa bsregs gtor bkrus shing sbyangs/ /dra bhi sha bi shud+dhi: sa ma: su rla: rat+na tsan+d+ra e maṇ+ḍal : / 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i lte (6na thar pad+ma ni/ /'dab brgyad rtsibs kyi shar du nyi ma dang
