/ /lho ru rin chen zur brgyad nub zla ba/ /byang du rdo rje rgya gram dag gis mtshan/ /dbus nas rim bzhin g.yas skor rak+ta dang / /dri chu sha chen dri chen klad pa lnga/ /e sum̐/ hūṃ thu su mo: zho lo: ha re: sla ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa snro sa bon brgyalas 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus 'od du zhu ba yongs gyur las/ /pad+ma gardzabadz+ra gaṇ+ḍa rat+na gaṇ+ḍa tsakra gaṇ+ḍa kha ṅga gaṇ+ḍa sa ma ya skye spra ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ dbus nas brtsams te rim bzhin g.yas skor du/ /snang mtha' dmar po gos dkar mo dang spyod/ /mi bskyod mthing ga dbyings phyug ma dang sbyor/ /rin 'byung ser po rin chen sgrol mas 'byud/ /rnam snang dkar — 143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2popo sangs rgyas spyan mas 'khyud/ /don grub ljang gu dam tshig sgrol mas 'khyud/ /yab rnams g.yas pa rang rtags g.yon dril bu/ /yum rnams g.yas 'khyud g.yon pa dril bu 'dzin/ /snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems gsang gnas phab/ /'od 'phros don gnyis byas shing 'bru gsum gyis/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das snod bcud kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i snying po bsdus te yum lngar thim/ /yum lnga 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur/ /mu tig dkar po dri ma med lta bu'i/ /steng du zla ba'i gdan la ā+oṃ dkar po/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i mtshan ma can/ /ma hā sur+ya maṇ+ḍal hūṃ phaṭa: tha pad+ma maṇ+ḍal e e/ sam ya ho/ sa ma ya sa: a nu rā ga mi: a nu rā ga ya ho: dzaḥ& baṃ ho swo a: ma po: hrī: sur+ya: tsan+d+ra pad+ma dha ra hā: g.yon pa'i mtheb srin bar du a yig dang / /ma las nyi zla kha sbyor gur khang dang / /bdud rtsi'i steng du pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /rta mgrin dmar nag pad+ma rgya gram (6ba 'dzin/ /phyogs bzhir gsang khru mi pham khro gnyer can/ /ral gcig ro langs dkar ser dmar ljang mdog /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin/ /bzhi rka'ang rgyab mdun zur nas yab dang sbyor/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ/ rta mgo'i steng gi sgyi las 'od 'phros pas/ /'og min gnas kyi sangs rgyas yab yum mchod/ /mdun du spyan drangs snyoms par bzhugs pa yi/ /byang sems yab kyi zhal zhugs sgal tshigasargyud/ /yum bzhi'i bha gar thig le dus gcig babs/ /yab yum lnga po bdud rtsir zhu nas 'dres/ /bdag grogs rdzas la gtor bas nyes pa kun/ /ma lus dag pa'i byed las ldan par gyur/ /ā+oṃ su bhā wa bi shu : snri sto a mṛ ta hūṃ/ raṃ kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa: re re swo āḥ/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ kho gyis gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin rnams/ /bsregs gtor bkrus te rnam par dag par gyur/ /lha pad ma ba kla ta bi sha tsakra:/ ma hā su rlu maṇ+ḍal sno sam ya sa snga ra ṇa phaṭa: so ha ra ṇa sno 2 pad+ma maṇ+ḍal āḥ sam ya sto sla ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal e/ sam ya rto sla ra ṇa phaṭa se ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ gtor ma gzhal yas khang du gsal ba yi/ /nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /don gnyis byas shing tshur 'dus yongs gyur las/ /gtor ma'i dngos po chos 144—

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khro pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnanyid ngang du sbyangs/ /slar yang gtor ma'i steng du pad+ma brgyad/ /dbus su a yig dmar po gsal zhing dngas/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi ngo bor 'bar/ /slar yang gtor steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /ā+oṃ yig dkar po'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ /'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyas gyur cig /(7na〉gyi ma hā ba kla ta pu dza te dza hūṃ/ rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ kho gyis rak+ta'i dri ma kun/ /ma lus sbyangs shing yongs su dag par gyur/ /rgyu bi na dha sha ga: ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ raṃ sa ma ya sde: sla ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ nang dmar phyi dkar thod pa'i gzhal yas su/ /ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar ser steng / /thugs ga'i saḥlas 'phros pa'i raṃ dmar po/ /'phro 'du 'od zhu yongs su gyur pa las/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtshos stong gsum khyon kun gang / /rlabs gzug zhing 'phyo tshil chen dar chags pa/ /phyi ltar khrag mtsho nang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /gsang ba yum gyi pad+ma rak+ta 'khyil/ /ā+oṃ ma hā pad+ma rak+ta hūṃ/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum rten brten pa/ /snyan gsan spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag /nyer spyod 'dod yon sman dngos grub/ /gtor ma rak+ta sbyor sgrol mchod/ /klu mchod bstod pa 'dzab de'i bstod/ /dngos grub blang ba dngos gzhi'i khrigs/ /de ting kun ting rgyu ting gsum/ /hūṃ/ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong yangasanas/ /chos rnams sna tshogs rang shar ba/ /rang bzhin med de chu zla 'dra/ /thugs rje chen pos kun la khyab/ /snying po ye shes/ gi dbyings/ /ā+oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nyā na sam ta hūṃ/ ā+oṃ dharmā khyu tu sam ti hūṃ/ ā+oṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra sa ma ti hūṃ/ brten bya gzhal yas khang bskyed pa/ e yaṃ raṃ kho thu ke :: sa bon sngags rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ /'byung lnga ri rab ga 'kha yas lhun 'gyas grub/ /e a /sha maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ e las nam mkha' sngo skya gru gsum steng / /yaṃ ba ya be maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ yaṃ las rlung dkyil zla gam dud kha g.yo/ /raṃ dz+wa maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ raṃ las me dkyil dmar po zur gsum 'bar/ kho rak+ta sa mu dra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/kho las khrag mtsho dmar nag zlum po zhabrug // bri thi li maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ / las sa dkyil ser (7ba)po gru bzhi brtan/ /rka ni ri ti su me ru maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ ke las keng rus ri rab gru bzhi dkar/ /hūṃ bi sha bi —145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2poshu rje dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal :: : las thod pa rin chen gzhal yas khang / /dbus su gru gsum dmar nag dkyil 'khor la/ /zla gam dmar po thod pa'i ra ba can/ /phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyogs kyi mdog /mgo bo rlon pa'i 'phreng bas zlum por bskor/ /de'i phyir gru bzhi sgo bzhi gzhal yasakhang / /phyogs skyong bcu yis rtsig pa'i rmang gzhi byas/ /nang ni ban dha skam rlon rnying pa yis/ /rtsig pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer gyis btab/ /phyi ni sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa/ /dmar dkar ser ljang nag po'i rtsig pa can/ /bar du lha chen brgyad kyis rtsig pas gtams/ /rtsig steng rin chen rus pa'i pha gu la/ /rgyu ma rlon pa'i dra ba dra phyed 'phyang / /de'i steng rin chen rus pa spel ma yis/ /mda' yab pu shu rtsig pa'i rtsa ba na/ /'dod snam dmar po mchod pa'i lha mos gang / /rgyal chen bzhi dang thod pa skam po las/ /grub pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis legs bteg pa'i/ /thod pa rlon pa'i ka gzhu rab tu brjid/ /klu chen brgyad kyi gdung mas phyogs mtshams bres/ /de la mdzes pa'i me tog rgyan du spud/ /gza' chen brgyad kyi bad phur btang pa la/ khyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dral lcam byas/ /bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i zhal ba can/ /dbus kyi lte ba phyur bur mtho ba'i rtser/ /pad+mas bteg pa'i tsit+ta'i tog gis brgyan/ /sgo bzhi ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa yi/ /rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng / /pad+ma chos 'khor bcu gsum gdugs ri dgas/ /mgo snying tog mdzes zhing chen rgyal mtshan dang / /lag pa'i 'phan dang skra yi rnga yab can/ /dbang po'i me tog spel ba'i phreng ba g.yo/ /mdor na rngam brjid mdzes pa'i rgyan (8na)gyis spud/ /phyi rol pad ra dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /rdo rje'i ra ba bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar/ /dbus kyi gru gsum dmar nag dkyil 'khor steng / /paṃ pad+ma bo: de las sna tshogs pad ma mdzes pa'i gdan/ /a tsan+d+ra bo: de las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang pa/ /ma su rla bo: de 'a las nya ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar/ /ru tra bo: de las ru tra pho mo bsnol pa yi/ /gan rgyal kha sbub brtsigs pa'i gdan steng du/ /brten pa lha tshogs bskyed pa ni/ khyuḥmo/ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa : tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra tshwa badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ gdan steng rgyu ting — 146

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma khoganahūṃ yig babs pa las/ /khyoḥ yig dmar nag baṃ yig sngon por gyur/ /de las 'od 'phros 'phags tshogs mchod pas mnyes/ /sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib ma lus sbyangs/ /slar yang 'dus shing brtan par byas pa las/ /rang nyid rta mgrin pad+ma dbang chen sku/ /zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar nag /spyi bo'i gtsug tu rta mgo ljang gu'i zhal/ /rngog ma dmar po / / ser po dang / /zhur dkar rta skad sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur 'tsher/ /zhal rnams kun la spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum/ /smin ma sma ra ser po glog ltar 'khyug /dbu skra ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes/ /phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma bsnams/ /g.yon gyi dang po khrag gang ka pā la/ /bzung ste bde chen yum gyi mgul nas 'khyud/ /lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu be con dang / /g.yon gnyis thegs pa ral gri me 'bar 'dzin/ /sku stod zhing lpags glang chen ko rlon gsol/ /sku smad stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs klubs/ /thod skam dbu rgyan rin chen rtse phran can/ /mgo bo skam rlon rnyid pa lnga bcu yi/ /tshar gsum 'phreng ba'i do shal sku la (8ba)gsol/ /rus pa rin chen sprul rigs bzhi yis brgyan/ /zhag gi sor ris rak+ta'i thig le dang / /thal chen tshom bu sku yi gnas su byugs/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i khyung gshog can/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs bzhi brkyang bskums bzhugs/ /ā+oṃ mahā kro dhi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ gtso bo'i g.yon nas sku la 'khril tshul can/ /gsang yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /spyan gsum gdangs mig zhal bgrad mche ba gcigs/ /dbu skra ral pa nag po mun ltar btibs/ /phyag g.yas tsit+ta thogs nas yab la 'byud/ /g.yon pa dung chen khrag gis gang ba'i mtsho/ /dpal chen gtso bo'i zhal du 'debs tshul mdzad/ /yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor zla ba dang / /mgrin par pad+ma thugs dar nyi ma'i steng / /ā+oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ sngon yi ge yis/ /mtshan pas sku gsung thugs rnams byin gyis brlabs/ /dbu la thod pa'i khang bu lngas brgyan pa'i/ /spyi gtsug hūṃ sngon mtshog mar ā+oṃ dkar po/ /rna ltag g.yas su swā ser ltag pa na/ /e dmar rna ltag g.yon na lha ljang gu/ /de rnams skad cig yongs su gyur pa las/ /hūṃ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi — 147

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gekhiñtsa hūṃ/ rdo rje khrag 'thung sngon po rdor dril 'dzin/ /ā+oṃ kyā he ru ga a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ /sangs rgyas khrag 'thung dkar po 'khor dril 'dzin/ /swā rat+na he ru ka a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ /rin chen khrag 'thung ser po rin chen dril/ /e pad+ma he ru ka a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung dmar po pad dril 'dzin/ /nya kurma he ru ka a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ /las kyi khrag 'thung ljang gu ral gri dril/ /rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dag dang mthun/ /khrag 'thung rigs lnga dbu yi rgyan du rdzogs/ /yab kyi gsang gnas yi ge hūṃ yig ni/ /yongs gyur rdo rje (9na)rtse lnga'i rnam pa can/ /yum gyi gsang gnas paṃ las pad 'dab brgyad/ /snyoms par zhugasapa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ /yab kyi zhal zhugs thugs gar 'od du zhu/ /rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i/ /thig le yig 'bru brgyad kyi ngo bo gyur/ /hūṃ snrosnri snri dza hūṃ paṃ 〉 shar gyi rtsibs steng de wa baṃ yongs gyur/ /dri za dkar po pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra shwa ri kro dha hūṃ phaṭaḥ/ de las rdo rje dbang chen sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje dang / /g.yon pa dbyug tho bsnams shing 'gying ba'i tshul/ /lho yi rtsibs steng ya ma baṃ yongs gyur/ khrul bum sngon po pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /ā+oṃ rat+na shwa ri kro dha hūṃ phaṭa:/ de las rin chen dbang chen sku mdog sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rin chen dang / /g.yon pa lcags kyu 'gugs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin/ zhub kyi rtsibs steng na ga baṃ yongs gyur/ /klu rgyal dmar po pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma shwa ri kro dha hūṃ phaṭa: de las pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa pad+ma dang / /g.yon pa zhags pa 'chang ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin/ /byang phyogs rtsibs steng yak+ṣa baṃ yongs gyur/ /gnod sbyin ljang gu pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /ā+oṃ ma me shwa ri kro dha hūṃ phaṭaḥ/ de las las rab dbang chen ljang dmar mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa ral gri dang / /g.yon pa rtse gsum bsnun pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin/ /kun kyang spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes sbrul gyis bcings/ /dur khrod chas rnams ma lus sku la brgyan/ /me dpung (9ba)klong na gar stabs tshul gyis bzhugs/ /sgo bzhin — 148

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang 4 (gna.a dang tsan+d+ra baṃ yongs gyur/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dza: de nyid yongs gyur sgo ma lcags kyu ma/ /dkar mo khrag ral lcags kyu slo snying 'dzin/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /de nyid yongs gyur sgo ma zhags pa ma/ /ser mo g.yu ral zhags pa glo snying 'dzin/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra spro ṭa 2: de nyid yongs gyur sgo ma lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar mo mthing ral lcags sgrog slo snying 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ho: de nyid yongs gyur sgo ma dril bu ma/ /ljang gu gser ral dril bu glo snying 'dzin/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag dang zhabs gnyis pa/ /dur khrod chas brgyan me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /ye shes lha la snyan gsan dbab/ hrī: ye nas ka dag chos kyi klong yangs las/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid longs spyod rdzogs/ khrag 'thung dbang chen lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar gyis dbyings nas bzhedas/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma yā hūṃ dza: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drang ba/ hrī:chos kyi dbyings las sku bzhengs pa/ /dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po bzhengs/ /dbus nyid ye shes gzhal yas nas/ /pad+ma rta mchog gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' dbyings yum gyi gzhal yas nas/ /yum chen khro mo:/ phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas/ /sprul pa'i khro bo / sgo bzhi gnas kyi gzhal yasanas/ /sgo ma bzhi rnamasaḥ/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ /dbang chen bran g.yog ca/ e tho hi bha ga wa na ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha ho/ /sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya skye: brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba ni/sa: dam tshig dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /ye shes dbang wo dkyil 'khor mchog /pho brang dam (10na skoyi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dzaḥ ྅ paṃ ho: sa ma yā sa: sgo gsum gus pas phyag bya ba/ hrī: dpal chen khro bo mi bzad pa/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo srung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho/ nyer spyod rol mo 'bul ba ni/ hrī: gdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra/ /zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang / /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pad+ma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a : pra tī ts+tsha pā dza — 149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geme gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sam ye āḥlha/ de bzhin du arnya gyi gnas su badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra pu po badz+ra ā lo glo/ badz+ra gan : / badz+ra ni li du/ badz+ra sha lta hūṃ/ 'dod yon sna lnga'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ gzugs kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar/ /phyag na mdzes sdug longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi spyan la 'bul/ /gzugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /sgra yi lha mo sku mdog sngo/ /phyag na sgra snyan ཿ/ dbang chen lha yi snyan la 'bul/ /sgra yi:/ dri yi lha mo sku mdog ser/ /phyag na dri yi:/ dbang chen lha yi shangs la 'bul/ /dri yi / ro yi lha mo sku mdog dkar/ /phyag na ro yiḥ/ dbang chen lha yi ljags la 'bul/ /ro yi:/ reg bya'i lha mo sku mdog ljang / /phyag na reg bya'i / dbang chen lha yi sku la 'bul/ /reg bya'iḥ/ chos kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar/ /phyag na chos kyi po ti bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi thugs la 'bul/ /chos kyi za/ bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ / rigs lnga (10ba)dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs sgrub pa'i rdzas/ khyud drug sems can kun grol ba'i/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen la/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /thugs rjes dgongs la ba che khagasu gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi khā hi/ /snga rabs 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang / /da lta bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang / /slad nas lho na pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ /chos sku spros bral snang ba mtha' yas dang / /longs sku bde chen khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes —150

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganamachod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/lo chen be+e ro mnga' bdag khri srong rje/ /gter ston gsum las sum pa dbang phyug dang / /'bre ston chen po shes rab bla ma la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ /rkyang po grags byang rnam gsum las 'phro can/ /'bru tshad gnyags ston chen po gzi brjid 'bar/ /rta nag bla ma rgya yi mtshan can la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchode 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngosagrub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa.a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /rab dga'i sar gnas grub thob 'dar char dang / /chos kyi rgyal po bo dong rin po che/ /mkhas grub chen po bsod nams brtan pa la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a gri ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal dpal bzang po/ /kun mkhyen chen po dpal ldan seng ge dang / /mtshungs med chos rje rin chen bkra shis la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ /rtogs ldan chen po yon tan mgon po dang / /'gro ba'i bla chen chos kyi dpal bzang po/ /dkon mchog (11na po sum dngos rdo rje rgyal mtshan la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rnam rgyal bzang po dang / /zhabrul zhig chen po dkon mchog bzang po dang / /rdo rje 'chang dngos blo gsal rgya mtsho la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa.a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /lha rigs 'a zhu'i sngags 'chang mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ /sngags 'chang chen po gzhen nu stobs ldan dang / /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor byams pa rdo rje la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongasate dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ /slar yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen —151 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebartses rjes bzung ba'i/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel dang / khu spyab pa mchog rnyed dbang phyug rab brtan la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ /'khor lo'i mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed po ā nan+da/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ /bcom ldan rta mchog pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen khro mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /rigs bzhi'i khro bo sgo ba bzhi rnams la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mi ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /ging lnga gza' gdong beg tse lcam sring dang / /gnas gsum dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs te dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /sman gyi dngos grub blang ba ni/ snro ye shes khro rgyal dbang chen gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /gnyis med gyur nas brtan pa che/ /kā ya sirnyi 'o:wa ka sirnyi ā: tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ ba kla gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ /: khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa mchog sha khrag keng rus gtor ma yis/ khro rgyal dbang chen thugs dam bskang / /ma hā ba sla ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad paraḥ / sha khragaḥ / yum chen khro mo'i thugs / ma hāḥ/ khyad par / sha khrag:/ khro rgyal bzhi yiḥ/ ma hā / khyad paraḥ / sha khrag / sgo ma bzhi yi / ma lto/ khyad par / sha khragaḥ/ gying chen lnga'i / gza' gdong lcam dral / ma hāḥ/ khyad par:/ sha khrag / be gdong lcam dral:/ ma hāḥ/ ྅ sha khrag rus pa nang (11ba)khrol mkhris/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog mchod par 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /'phrin las dngos por bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā me sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta 'a hi/ ma hā ke ni ri ti khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta ji hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi: rak+ta'i 152

pad+ma dbang r+ṣa yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogadamachod pa 'bul ba ni/ snro sna tsho gos khrag gi mtsho 'khyil ba'i/ /rak+ta dmar chen mchod pa 'di/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/bde chen sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ gsang ba thabs dang shes rab las/ /pad ma nor bu mnyam sbyar nas/ /dgyes pa chen po'i bde chen dang / /byang chub sems kyi mchod pa 'di/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā su ka bo dhi tsit+ta swāhā/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yis/ /zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang / /'khor ba nyon mongs rgya dral nas/ /dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya'o/ /a mu ka ma ra ya phaṭa: snyi/ zhing gyur thams cad rang bzhin bsgral/ sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā me sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ke ni ri ti/ ma hā pañtsa a khra ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ye shes glu yi mchod pa ni/ phyi dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /pad+ma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan steng du/ /rnam shes gnas gyur pad+ma he sa /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dang / khyud drug nyen mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ khro rgyal rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /med byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dga' bzhi bde ba (12na thib po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thamasacad skyed pa'i yum/ /bde stong zung 'jug shes rab thabs la rol/ /dbang dang ye shes dbyer med khro mo'i sku/ /rgyud drug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ma/ khro mo gar dbang yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol pa las/ shar phyogs 'khor lo dri za'i gdan steng na/ /gzugs phung dbang gyur rdo rje dbang chen sku/ /gti mug gnas dag me long ye shesang nga / khyud drug nyon mongs gti mug 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol pa las/ /lho phyogs 'khor lo grul bum gdan steng na/ /tshor phung gnas gyur rin chen dbang chen sku/ /nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes dang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs nga rgyal —153—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po'ajoms mdzad pa/ /rin chen dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol pa las/ /nub phyogs 'khor lo klu dbang gdan steng du/ /'du shes gnas gyur pad+ma dbang chen sku/ /'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog ye shes dang / /rgyud drug nyen mongs 'dod chags 'joms mdzad pa/ /pad+ma dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol pa las/ /byang phyogs 'khor lo gnod sbyin gdan steng du/ /'du byed gnas gyur las rab dbang chen sku/ /phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes dang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs phrag dog 'joms mdzad pa/ /las rab dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol pa las/ shar phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /sa khams rnam dag sgo ma lcags kyu ma/ /byams pa tshad med zhi ba'i las rnams (12ba〉skrub/ /rgyud drug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ma/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol pa las/ /lho phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /chu khams rnam dag sgo ma zhags pa ma/ /snying rje tshad med rgyas pa'i las rnams sgrub/ /tshe dang ye shes ma lus rgyas mdzad ma/ /rdo rje zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /nub phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /me khams rnam dag sgo ma lcags sgrog ma/ /dga' ba tshad med dbang gi las rnams sgrub/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud mdzad ma/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /byang phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /rlung khams rnam dag sgo ma dril bu ma/ /btang snyoms tshad med drag po'i las rnams sgrub/ /dgra bgegs mngon spyod las kyis tshar gcod ma/ /rdo rje dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing khams thams cad dbang drag dkyil 'khor nas/ /phung po khams dang skye mched ye shesalnga/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /tshad med bzhi dang 'phrin las rnam bzhir ldan/ /thugs rje khros pas khro ba 'ad brngams pa'i zhal/ /yab yum gtso 'khor bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang drag phyi yi dkyil 'khor bka' srung ni/ /srog la dbang sgyur gying chen lnga rnams kyang / /las su sangs rgyas — 154

pa bla dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganabastan pa srung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bgegs sha khrag tshogs rnams gsol/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal bar rlog mdzad pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas/ /dam can bka' sdod gza' (13na tshe na dong lcam dral yang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bgegs lo thog nar mar gsol/ /dgra bgegs yul khams thal bar rlog mdzad pa'i/ /gza' gdong dregs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bstod pa/ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /zung 'jug bde chen rnams sprul pa/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros pa kun las rnam grol yang / /chags can chags pa gdul ba'i phyir/ /bud med sgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa/ khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag bcas phung po gnas gyur pa'i/ /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi yongs rdzogs mdzad/ khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag chad bdag mtshan rnam dag cing / /bsdu dngos tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang mdzad pa'i/ /sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa can rnams gdul ba'i phyir/ /rab khros brngams shing mi bzad pa/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng ba rab 'khrigs pa'i/ /bka' sdod rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing / /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po legasardzogs pa'i/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /sa gzhi ra ba bla bre gur/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can/ /srung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed la bstod pa'i dge ba des/ /lam gyi bar chad legs bsal nas/ /tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas shog /bsnyen pa 'dzab kyi rim pa ni/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /thugs gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar (13bsgo ni snying po hrīḥ/ /'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs — 155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pokyi dngos grub bsdu/ /sems can sgo gsum dri ma sbyangs/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la bsdu/ /hrīḥbadz+ra krodha ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ma hā kro dha shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa: chu badz+ra shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa chu rat+na shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa: zho pad+ma shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa tshwa rkarma shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa tshwa badz+ra e ku sha dza tshwa badz+rapā sha hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra spro ṭa bo: zho badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ho:'dzab kyi bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūṃ pad+ma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /mi bzad khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /dbang drag stobs chen brngams chen yi tum/ /sku mdog dmar nag brjid cing 'gying / /dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston/ /phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gtsod/ /zhabs bzhi 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /brngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrog /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos grub blang bar bya ba ni/ /hūṃ/ khro rgyal brngams pa rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'ar rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma ta kri da pad+ma shwa ri mahā kro dha ha ya shrī ba ma ma drag mo dun sta hrī hrī hūṃ dza/ ā+oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya wa ka tsit+ta sirnyi a la la ho/ bka' srung mchod dang bkang ba'i rim/ /tshogs brlabs spyan drangs spyir 'bul ba/ /bstod bshags bskyed 'gugs khro bo yungs/ /dbye phur gri btab tsho gos dbang bskur/ /yar chom gnas mad la mar gnas btang / /sgo dbye gser skyems zor 'phen pa/ /chad mtho bstan skyong rta bro brtsad/ /(14na gis la gdab mchod bstod nongs pa gsol/ /rtag chad mtha' gsal smon lam dang / /bkra shis bya ba'i rim pa rnams/ /la jug pa'i sdoms su tshul 'di la/ /sbyangs pa'i dpyod ldan tsho gos rnams smra/ /ging lnga gza' gdong mchod pa ni/ /raṃ yaṃ kho/ lha ā+oṃ āḥ// ā+oṃ ma hā ba sla ta pā dza te dz+wa snro lan gsum gyis gtore ma byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod rol pa'i sa gzhir ra tsa tri hri shu rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po 'od kyi mi bo che dkar po zhal —156

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogadagacig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon 'od kyi zhags pa thogs pa/ sku la seng ge'i slog pa gsol zhing dbu la jil dar dkar po bcings pa/ nam mkha'i 'ja'i ske rags can/ lcags kyi sder mo rnon pos dgra snying 'byin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i seng ge dkar po rlabs sgra sgrog pa la chibs pa/shar du tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang / g.yon zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral gu gsol zhing dbu la dung gi cod pan bcings pa/ rta dkar po ngang ring la chibs pa/ lhor dam can rdo rje legs pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang / g.yon tsit+ta dmar po thogs pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol zhing dbu la bse men gyi 'gying thod bcings pa/ rta khams pa lag dkar la chibs pa/ nub tu bdud po ri nag dpungs pa sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis(pa/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing dang / g.yon zhags pa nag po 'debs pa/ sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol zhing dbu la bdud zhwa nag po gsol ba/ bdud rta nag po la zhen pa/ byang du srog (14ba〉bdag yaṃ shud dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang / g.yon zhags pa dmar po dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gsol ba/ bse'i ra skyes kham pa la chibs pa/ lnga ka brngams shing khros la drag cing rtsub pa'i rnam pa can/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu mang po 'phros pas pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ rgya yul nam mkha' chad chod nas tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ nub phyogs pha waṃ long bu'i mkhar nang nas dam can rdo rje legs pa/ bdud yul kha rag sgo dgu nas bdud po ri nag spungs pa/ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas btsan rgod yaṃ shud dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig yud tsam la e spo hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzas spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ rā tsa tri hri sda/ sa ma ya sdo zhes pas dam la bzhag /rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i — 157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gemathar se gol gtog cing / ā+oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rā dza srog la hrī: ya shug me tri srog la dza tsa pa la a shug/ tri li dza/ badz+ra sa du khyoḥ dun dun shu la gri wa i rda ba smra :sna sa ma ya rak+ṣa n+tu ma ma sarba sirnyi me pra ya tsā n+tu ya ze baṃ ya the /snu ñtsa tha dzi gha tha pi pa tha ma ti pra ma tha ma ma sarba garnya ya sa da su re bi shud+dhi sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: ces lan gsum dang / rā tsa tri hri shu ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta khā hi 'a hi ma rak+ta la khā hi khā nyis sman rag phul/ snro dbang drag dkyil 'khor spyi yi bka' stod ni/ srog la dbang sgyur gying chen lnga rnams kyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed cing / /zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad (15na)pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /med byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bstod cing 'phrin las 'chol lo /ra hu la yi gtor chog ni/ yang sngar ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ /rang gi mdun du rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'byug pa'i dbus me dpung 'bar zhing sprin dang rlung nag bu yug 'tshub pa/ thog dang ser ba drag tu 'bab cing 'brug dang glog dmar 'khrug pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ gnam sa cha lang sdeb pa lta bu'i klong dkyil du ra ma ra tsa sha rnams las 'od 'phros yongs su gyur pa las khro rgyal pad+ma he ru ga'i thugs kyi sprul pa gza' rgod drag po ra hu la sku mdog dud kha srin po khros pa lta bu'i mgo dgu pa/ phyag g.yas kyin thang gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar phyar nas dgra po'i yul du 'phen pa/ phyag g.yon chu srin gyi zhags pas dam nyams 'ching zhing za ba/ lus po thams cad mig gis gang ba/ lte ba man chad dug sbrul nag po'i gzugs kyis rgya mtsho'i gting nas dkrug pa/ de'i shar du zor srin dkar mo stag gi gdong can/ lhor baṃ srin ser mo dred kyi gdong can/ nub tu kong srin dmar mo ba lang gi gdong can/ byang du 'brog srin ljang gu chu srin gyi gdong can/ bzhi ga'ang srin mo khros pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yas zor ba dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa/ snang srid lha srin sdobargyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ skad cig nyid la dgra bo'i yul khams thal bar rlog par byed pa/— 158

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganagatso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar ā+oṃ/ mgrin par ā: thugs dar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lho nub mtshams kyi srin yul lang ka pu ri'i grong khyer nas dregs pa gza' gdong lcam dral lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa ā+oṃ (15ba)e tho hi badz+ra sa ma ya dza:sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ ra hu la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā ya sto/zhes pa ba'i dam la ga 'ag /ā+oṃ kha kha khā hi 'a hi/ ra hu la ma ra tsa sha yaḥ i rda ba li ta gri ha na sa ma ya rak+ta ma ma sarba sirnyi me bra ya tsān+ta ya the baṃ ya the sti bhañtsa tha dzi gha tha pi pa tha ma hi pra ma tha ma ma sarba sna ya sa da su kho bi shud+dhi sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: lan gsum dang / ra hu la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha his sman rag phul/ : phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ dam can bka' sdod gza' gdong lcam dral yang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bo'i lo thog nar mar gsol/ /dgra bgegs yul khams thal bar rlog byed pa'i/ /gza' gdong dregs pa can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /med byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ces pas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ /beg tse lcam sring gtor chog ni/ rang gi mdun du rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dngas pa/ /klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrug pa'i dbus su zangs kyi ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du rta ro dang mi ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la pre dang zangs kyi ral gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing / g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs kyi glo snying thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon du bse'i ru mtshon dmar po bsnams pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba rno ngar gtsigs nas ljags rnam par skyod pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/smin ma dang sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar (16na)rab tu 'bar zhing dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings pa/mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la zangs kyi — 159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'beg tse dang dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan cing zhabs la sag lham dmar 'bob gsol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du me las srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma sku mdog sngo nag /gdong pa bse/ so dung / smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan cing gser gyi sna rgyan 'phyang ba/ gcer mo spyan dang zhal bgrad pa/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la 'phyar ba/ g.yon lcags kyi phur bu bgegs la 'debs pa/ dred mo mi zan la 'on pa/ gtso bo'i g.yabang su spra las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas mdung dmar 'phyang zhing g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon zhing lte spyang la zhen pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgegs la 'o dod 'bod spro / gtso 'khor gsum gyi shar du mi dmar phra ma/ lhor ri tsi mi dmar/ nub tu kro ti mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag ko sha shar lhor e kri mi dmar/ lho nub du ro kri mi dmar/ nub byang du ha shang mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste gri thogs brgyad dang / bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon la la rgyu ma lag bsdogs byed pa/ la la glo snying mchin pa 'drad pa/ la la snying khrag klad pa bldag pa/ la la sha khrag sbar gyis 'debs pa/ la 'a(rus pa rkang mar 'cha' ba/la la (16ba)pags pa dmar yas byed pa/ la la sha gdan dmar po 'dings pa/ thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog len pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / ba glang gi ko ba rlon pa gyon pa/ gzhan yang btsan dmar stong / bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong / ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong la sogasapa dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar ma ru rtse'i dur khrod brag dmar po mchong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis badz+ra sa mā dza/ kyai/ yul cig mya ngam 'das pa bdun gyi pha rol na/ /mda' na — /60

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganakhrag mtsho phu na zangs brag brtsegs/ /mi ro rta ro mang po gcal du bkram/ /mi khrag rta khrag du ma mtsho ltar 'khyil/ khor yug zangs ri'i phreng bas kun nas bskor/ /bse mkhar smug po mchong gi ba gam can/ /thod pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas/ /chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring gshegs su gsol/ /'khor tshogs bshan pa'i tsho gos rnams gshegs su gsol/ /zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dul ba dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gis las bcol bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /rings pa'i tshul gyis mchode gtor 'di bzhes la/ /nag po'i phyogs dang gang la dmigs pa yi/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /ra klo pra ṇa pad+ma sa pa ri wā ra a ka rā ya dza: dzaḥlha baṃ ho: dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ pad+ma ka ma la ye sto/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /ma rung gdul phyir drag po'i skur bstan (17na skos/ /mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i/ /sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po la phyag 'tshal/ /bka' yi 'khor gnas ye shes srung ma'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde ster gsang ba'i yum/ /las byed bshan pa gtum po sdo lnga dang / /ma mo the'u rang tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /ces phyag bya/ oṃ ra smo pra ṇa at+pa sa pa ri wā ra a: bra tī ts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du shasta'i bar sbyar la mchod pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& btags la nang mchod 'bul/ chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can du gyur nas gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la rma ra smo pra ṇa at+pa sa pa ri wā ra sarba bi gha nan sha hūṃ i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ slar yang mchod pa dang nang mchod phul nas/ kye/ rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru ce'i gnas srung / li yul chos kyi srung ma/ ma hā de wa'i bka' nyan/ gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can dang yum srin mo khrag gi ral pa can gyi sras gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ 'khor srog gcod bshan pa'i tshogs dang —161 —

rgyal dab ri lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebacas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang /bsams don chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung skyob sba ba'i phrin (17ba〉pas stongs grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ kyai/ dbang ldan ma ru tse yi dur khrod nas/ /mchong dmar brag la brten pa'i gnas bcas pa/ /sgrol gying chen po srog bdag dmar po dang / /srog bdud chen mo bse yi lan phran can/ /lcam sring khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po 'khor dang bcas/ /sgrol byed bshan pa gri thogs brgyad po dang / /ro bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor dang bcas/ /bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong dang / /btsan dmar stong gi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /ma mo 'bum dang the'u rang stong la sogs/ /ston pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i srung ma'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dgra sha khrag gi mchod gtor 'di bzhes shig /gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems 'di bzhes shig /rab dmar khrag chang mchod yon 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen po 'bul/ /da 'chol legs pa'i gsal 'debs rten du 'bul/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gces par skyongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gnas lus longs spyod dang / /'khor dang yo byad bzhen pa la sogs pa/ /bcol lo gtad do srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /zhin gsum bya ra rgyang nas ma g.yel cig /mtshan gsum mel tshe drung nas ma g.yel cig /rtag tu sgrub po'i stongs grogs ma g.yel cig /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra la mngon pa'i rtags ston la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang / /rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe/ /ma nyes log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /dpal mgon khyod kyis sgrol la bstan pa srungs/ /zhes brjod la btab bo/ /(18na tha dam chos srung bkang ba ni/ gyi badz+ra — 162

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganakro dhas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ hūṃ las gnas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che'i nang du chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon srog chags go mtshon sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs spyi dang khyad par dbang chen khrag 'thung yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bka' sdod ging lnga gza' gdong chos skyong beg tse lcam sring la sogs pa srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam ma lus par skong bar nus pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan par gyur/ ā+oṃ sarba bid/ pā ra pā ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ badz+ra lpa ra ṇa kho swā ༈zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ hrī: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /longs sku khro rgyal rta mchog dbang gi lha/ /sprul sku sna tshogs gar gyis 'gro rnams 'dul/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs rnams la/ /dgyes pa skyed nus phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dngos bshams yid sprul sa dang bar snang khyon/ /ma lus bkang ste 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ khrag sna'i rba klong 'byug pa rak+ta'i mtsho/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor ma dang / /bza' bca' btung ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /med byung gser skyems dza gad sman gyi phud/ /mnyam sbyor bde ba chen po'i mchod pa rnams/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed phyir bshams/ /dmar chen khrag gi a: rba klong 'khrug /dbang po sna lnga'i me tog phang phung g.yo/ sha chen gu gul spos (18ba)dkar dud sprin 'khrigs/ /tshil chen mar me nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal/ khrag zhag sman gyi dri chab chu rgyun bsgrengs/ sha rus ro brgya'i bcud ldan zhal zas dang / /rkang gling thod rnga sil snyan dung chen sogs/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir bshams/ /rta mchog rlung gi thugs can glog ltar 'byug /'byong g.yag rdo rje'i rwa chen mkha' la gdeng / /'jam pa'i spu ldan ra bzhi 'khyil ba'i lug /'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /mdzes pa'i spu ldan bse yi ra skyes dang / /bya rog srin bya lug pa mkha' la lding / /khyi nag — /63

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khro pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jig med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganarnams spyan drang ba/ hūṃ/ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las/ /sprul pa'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha/ /longs spyod tsho gos la gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ e gye hi bha ga wa na ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ma hā pad+ma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza: pad+ma ka ma la ye sto/ tsho gis kyi 'khor lo spyir 'bul ba/ hūṃ/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā pad+ma shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra a lha dhū paṃ sgro di paṃ gan : ni li du pra tī ts+tsha ya swā hā/ hūṃ/ 'di na sna tshogasagazugs mchis te/ /gzugs kyi lha mo me long (19bsgo/ /me long las kyang gzugs rnams byung / /mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang ste/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la 'bul/ /gzugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ /'di na sna tshogs sgra mchis te/ /sgra yi lha mo pi wang ma/ /pi wang las kyang sgra rnams 'byung / dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la 'bul/ /sgra yi ca/ 'di na sna tsho gos dri ma mis te/ /dri yi lha mo spos khang ma/ /spos khang lasakyang dri rnams yang / /dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la 'bul/ /dri yi:/ 'di na sna tsho gis ro mchosate/ /ro yi lha mo zhal zas ma/ /zhal zas las kyang ro rnams byung / /dkyil 'khor lha yi ljagasal 'bul/ /ro yi:/ 'di na sna tshogs reg mchis te/ /reg bya'i lha mo na bza' ma/ /na bza' lasakyang reg rnams khrung / /reg bya'i / 'di na sna tshogs chos mchis te/ /chos kyi lha mo po ti ma/ /po ti las kyang chos rnams 'byung / /dkyil 'khor lha yi thugs la 'bul/ /chos kyi bye brag thog mar bstod de 'bul/ yi sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang / /dgod dang gshed dang 'jigs par byed pa dang / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu sgyur ba ni/ /gar bcasasgrub po rnal 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che/ /zla ba la sogs snying po can/ /mo sa la sogs ro mchog bsil/ /me tog la sogs tsan+dan dri/ /bzang rgu 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mi mo rnamasakyi reg bya mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang — 165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gephaṭa kyis ldan pa mdzod/ /mahā pad+ma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pā dza kha raṃ khā hi/bar pa bshags te 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos dgongs(20na〉kyi gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rnams ci bgyisapa/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol te tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka sam ya/ ma nu pā la ya/pad+ma shrī he ru ka twe no pa rjo ḍi sgo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra sto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi me pra byu sarba nan+da su tsa me/ tsiste shrī yaṃ/ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wa na/ pad+ma shrī he ru ka ma me mulga pad+ma shrī he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa a sno mthar 'bul ched du bskyed cing 'gugs/ e raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ/ dz+wa la raṃ/ ṇi dza/ tri dza/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / /chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogasaḥ / khyad par bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i spyi dgra /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byed pa/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag chosasgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad ri rab kyi khong gseng / nam mkha'i mthongs/ rgya mtsho'i gting / gling bzhi gling phran gang na 'dug kyang rung ste/ skyob par byed pa'i lha dang phrol la/ ling ga dang / tshogs tha ma (20ba 'di nyid kyi nang du khug cig /pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a/ khro bo'i pho nya spro ba ni/ hūṃ bh+yo/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ nga dpal khrag 'thung he ru ka /thugs rje thugs dam rgyud skul ba/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral ba'i zhing / /— /66

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogana'ajig rten thams cad dur khrod 'bar/ /bza' rgyu thams cad sha khrag tshogs/ /gzugs snang thamasacad he ru ka /mi rtog thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /thugs rje thugs dam rgyud bskul bas/ /ye shes rol cing gshegs su gsol/ /dza: yab gcig sku mdog dmar po ni/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu la rdzogs/ /phyag rgya thugs kyi dkyil nas skyong / /lcags gri nag po phyag na bsnams/ /sgrol gying chen por dam bcas pa/ /nag po 'bum gyi bdag po ste/ /mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus na 'gying / /mi ro 'bum gyi khri steng na/ /rta ro 'bum ni gcal du bkram/ /zas su de ni sha chen za/ /sgom du de ni rak+ta 'thung / /mtha' dag bsgral ba'i rgyu yin te/ /'di yi snying po 'bum bzlas na/ /gcig tu de ni dgra la 'jabs/ /gnyis su de ni bgegs la 'jab/ /skyes bu chen po'i 'phrul gyi sras/ /gnod bgegs la ba'i dus la bab/ /hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ /phyag gnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ /bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung gsong pa/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang / /dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ /mngon spyod tshul (21na)bzhin bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag rdul du brlag par mdzod/ /zung zhig sdoms shig rnam par chings/ /rtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ /'di la byang chub sems med kyis/ /gzhan du nam yang gtang mi bya/ /byang chub sems su gtang bar bya/ /nga yi dbang du bsdus la 3|ga /yungs kar pho nya spro ba ni/ /bh+yo: gnod sbyin rgyal po khros pa'i sras/ /yungs kar ye shesasprul pa'i mda'/ /thugs rje'i klong nas phar 'phangs pas/ /dgra bo'i gzugs phung 'ben la rgyob/ /dkar nag snying gi dkyil du phyung / khreg shig dum dum nyil nyil rgyob/ khro chung gtams pa'i —167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geyungs kur 'di/ /yid kyi ye shes sprul pa'i mda'/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /yengs pa med par 'phangs pa yis/ /dgra bo'i nang khrol 'ben la rgyob/ /dum bu rul rbad dum bu nyal rbad/ yan lag 'ching ba'i yungs gar ni/ /phyag rgya rol pa'i mda' rgyang ste/ /'phro 'du cir yang 'gyur ba'i mda'/ /dgra bo'i yan lag 'ben la rgyob/ /thum thum ril ril/ dbang po len pa'i yungs gar 'di/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i thugs kyi mda'/ /rig pa'i dbyings nas 'phangs pa yis/ /dgra bo'i dbang po mig la rgyob/ /thibs ya thibs ya/ bh+yo bh+yo/ rnam shes gcod pa'i yungs gar 'di/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bram ze'i mda'/ /'gugs 'dren pho nya'i mda' rgyang ste/ /dgra po'i rnam shes 'ben la rgyob/ /hu ya hu ya/cag cag /skyob byed lha dang 'phral ba ni/ ma hā gu gul pra ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bh+yo/ gnyen po kun sgrol dam tshig can/ /mgo ba'i lha rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis/ /srog lha gnam du yar du chug /dgra lha rgya mtsho'i gting du skyur/ /pho lha (21bshog pa'i 'og tu gnon/ /zhang lha rgya mtsho'i 'khris la skyol/ /pho lha srog lha myur du chod/ /gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog 'dis/ /le dgu lha dang phrol la shog /'bob dud pho lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /rgya tshil dgra lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /yungs gar srog lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /ra ru mo lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /zhabs mas 'ang lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis/ /dgra bo'i dam tshig nyams su chug /phur pa bskyed cing gdab pa ni/ /ā+oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ad+ma ko ྅ 〉 po pad+ma maṇ+ḍal:ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal:phyi snga ra ṇa phaṭa: sing ha ra ṇa : zho pad+ma gī li kyi la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ stong pa'i ngang lasaphur pa skad cig gi /dbang chen khrag 'thung pad+ma ki la ya/ /dmar dkar ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis kyis pad+ma bhan dha bsnams/ /bar pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin/ /tha ma'i phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu sgril/ /dur khrod chas brgyan sku stod khro bo'i gzugs/ /sku smad zur gsum rno ba'i dpal dang ldan/ /sku la bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar/ /ā+oṃ ā kli gi yi shes gnas gsum mtshan/ /ye shes dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bstim/ ā+oṃ tib ta tsakra ha na ha na ā+oṃ hrī:—168

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaphur pa a/ ā+oṃ badz+ra satwa 〉 tshwa sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wa ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ bdag dang phur pa'i gnasagasum yi ge las/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs sku yi byin rlabs bsdus/ /sku yi sgo nas khams gsum ma lus pa/ /dus gcig sgrol ba'i nus pa thob par gyur/ /bde gshegs gsung gi byin rlabs thamasacad bsdus/ /gsung gi sgo nas khams gsum ma lus pa/ /dus gcig sgrol ba'i nus pa thob par gyur/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus/ /thugs kyi sgo nas khams gsum ma lus pa/ /dus (22na po cig sgrol ba'i nus pa thob par gyur/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma gī la ya pe ta li maṇ+ḍal la rak+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ pad+ma gī la ya ma hā gu gul pra ta la a tiṣ+ṭha na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ pad+ma gī la ya ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra ra kri ta/ ā+oṃ le hūṃ lo sa bha ya nan/ mo ha ghā ta ya bha ga wan/ hri sna wi kri ta badz+ra hūṃ ka ra hūṃ/ badz+ra kyi li ki la ya dzaḥsnyi baṃ ho sarba bigha nan/ badz+ra kyi li gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phyogs lasarnam par rgyal ba'i mthu dang ldan/ /pha rol gzhen pa'i gzi brjid bkrag mdangs rgyas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes chags gyur/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor phur pa'i gnas gsum las/ /āḥyig phra mo grangs med los pa yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas/ /ā yig rnam pa 'od zhu zhur 'dus ma/ /sgrib sbyangs sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ /yang 'phros 'phags mchod sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /srid gsum thams cad a yig rnam par zhu/ /dngul chu ltar gyur zes po la thim pas/ /rnam shes ā yig dkar po'i rnam par gyur/ /tshe lhag tshur bsdus rnam shes zhal du zhugs/ /hūṃ gyur 'og min gnas su rigs lnga yi/ /mnyam sbyor khar bskrun rigs kyi sras su gyur/ /ral gri gshin rjer bskyed pa ni/ ā+oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ad+ma ko ྅ lha/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ hūṃ ྅ ra ṇa phaṭa/ sing ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ya mun ta ka hūṃ phaṭa: skad cig stong pa'i ngang las ral gri ni/ /gshin rje gshed nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /me dpung dbus bzhugs gnas gsum yi shes mtshan/ /ye shes dzaḥ/ baṃ sngos gnyis med bstim/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan gyur/ /gshin rje gshed —169

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogadatshe/ /sgrub gtor yod na sngar bskyed pa'i/ /lha tsho gos sngags kyis slar gsal 'debs/ /sgrub gtor med dam yod na yang / /gtor ma zur du bshams pa na/ /sngags kyis lha tsho gos legs par bskyed/ /yar gnas mchod pas mnyes par byas/ /de rjes mar gnas lhag btang rnams/ /lhan cig zor du byas nas 'phen/ /'di yang gsang sngags snga 'gyur la/ /grags pa'i man ngag zur pa ste/ /rgyas bkab rang gzo'i 'dra chos min/ /de'i phyir yar gnas mchod pa ni/ /zlo bi sha bi shudhe dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa: zho badz+ra shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa: chu rat+na shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa: zho pad+ma shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa: zho dmi shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dza: zho badz+ra pā sha : zho badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi)gyi badz+ra krodha nas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi sngo yar gyi gnas rnams kyi zhal du ma hā pañtsa.a skṛ ta ji hi/ ma hā ba kla ta khā hi/ ma hā raka ta 'a hi/ snro dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /'khor du dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /dbang chen rngams pa'i gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /thun mong mchog gi (23brko ngos grub bdag la stsol/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /dbyings nyid rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yum chen pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /'khor du ma mo chen mo 'bum gyisabaskor/ /ma tshogs gnas nas 'khor tshogs sku bzhengs la/ /caḥ — gar phyogs 'khor lo dri za'i gdan steng du/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal rdo rje dbang chen yang / /'khor du dri za'i tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /dri za'i gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /ཿ :::lho phyogs 'khor lo grul bum gdan steng du/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal rin chen dbang chen yang / /'khor du grul bum tsho gos rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /grul bum gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /::tsha :nub phyogs 'khor lo klu dbang gdan steng du/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal pad+ma dbang chen yang / /'khor du klu dbang tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /klu rgyal gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs/ /::::byang phyogs 'khor lo gnod sbyin gdan steng — 17/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2podu/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal las rab dbang chen yang / /'khor du gnod sbyin tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /gnod sbyin gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /— tsha ཿ :thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /shar phyogs sgo ma chen mo lcags kyu ma/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i dkar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /dung gi sgo khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /joḥngu:thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /lho phyogs sgo ma chen mo zhags pa ma/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i ser mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /gser gyi sgo khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /ཿ 55thams cad dbang du byed pa'i dkyil (24na 〉 khor nas/ /nub phyogs sgo ma ོ mo lcags sgrog ma/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i dmar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /zangs kyi sgo khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /pa — thams cad drag po las kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /byang phyogs sgo ma chen mo dril bu ma/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i ljang mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /g.yu yi sgo khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /mar gnas lhag ma gtong ba ni/ dpal chen po'i pham babs la dbang ba'i lha tsho gos rnams e khyo hi dzaḥdzaḥ/ mu dra sa mā ya hūṃ/ mu dra sam ya phaṭa/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/a khyu sam ya rto/ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ /ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ snang ba mtha' yas yab yum du gyur/ /ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal hūṃ phaṭa/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ e e sam ya ho/ sam ya sto/ a nu rā ga ya mi/ a nu rwa g.ya ho/ dza3bo ho bo dhi tsit+ta lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūṃ/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du/ /bas ldan dpal wo phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol du/ /ma dang sring mo tsho gis la dgyes/ /tha ma lhag ma mi bya sa /dbang chen bran g.yog lhag ma dbang / /lhag ma kha chus mi bran du/ /rje dang 'bangs gnyis khyad par che/ /rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre mā /chos kyi dbyings la bzang ngan med/ /mchod nas las rnams mi 'chol du/ /chos 'khor bstan pa bshig pa byung / /hrī: dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la/ /bde gshegs khyung gis bskor ba ni/ /budhe rigs kyi — /72

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganakhyung chen dang / /rdo rje rigs kyi khyung chen dang / /rin chen (24ba'i gas kyi khyung chen dang / /pad+ma rigs kyi khyung chen dang / /las kyi rigs kyi khyung chen te/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /dpag bsam rtse nas bzhengs pa yi/ /las kyi khyung chen pho mo la/ /rgyan gyis gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /burnya ga ru ḍa/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa/ rat+na ga ru ḍa/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa/ ga me ga ru ḍa/ i rda ba smra grihā kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pā dza hoḥrak+ṣa si paṃ swāhā/ sgyi dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la/ /srin po pho mos bskor ba ni/ /phyogs bzhi nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /gza' mchog chen po ra hu la/ /ngan sngags bdag mo gdong mo bzhi/ shar gyi zor srin stag gi gdong / /lho yi baṃ srin dred mo'i gdong / /nub kyi kong srin ba lang gdong / /byang gi 'byog srin chu srin gdong / /ngan sngags bdag mo khyed bzhi yang / /gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'brug ldir ba/ /bar snang khams nas glog 'khyug pa/ /sad dang thog dang ser 'bebs ma/ /sprin dang rlung tshub nang shed na/ /'ur 'ur thog thog 'jigs byed ma/ /:tshar hu la badz+rarak+ṣa ma ra tsa sha dha ya i rda ba smra grihā kha kha khā hi 'a hi pu dza ho rak+ṣa si paṃ swāhā/ hrī: dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la/ ma mo'i tsho gos kyisabaskor ba ni/ /ma tsho gos rang byung gzhal yas nas/ /stong gsum phung byed ma mo ni/ /nag ser dmar ljang ral pa can/ /phyag na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams/ /sprul dang thod 'phreng rgyan du byas/ /rma bya'i thul la sku la gsol/ /gtor ma len (25na)pa'i len tshul ni/ kha nas gshug pa'i sgra 'bod cing / /lag na thod pa'i rnga chen rdung / /ma tsho gos 'bum sdod ma la sdud/ /:pho ma rag mo mahā kā yis rda ba 〉grihā pā dza ho/ /rak+ṣa gi po swā hā/ /hrī: dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang ma/ /dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /bdud btsan rgyal po la sogs te/ /sde brgyad lha srin thams cad kyang / /gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni/ /stong khams —/73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gethams cad khu sgras 'debs/ sha khrag za zhing dgra la chas/ /mtshon cha dgra la ston cing brngams ཿ rā dza srog la hri/ a shu me tri srog la dza/ tsa pa la ag shu dza/tri li dza/ badz+ra sa tu gi dun dun/ shu la shrī ba/ i rda ba smra grihā kha kha khā hi khā hi pā dza ho/ rak+ṣa si paṃ swā hā/ gtor ma'i lam bstan sgo dbye ba/ /bh+yo/ da ni gshegs so shar ra ra/ /da ni bzhud do sil li li/ /da ni gshegs so dbyings su gshegs/ /da ni dbyings su mi gshegs su/ /gnas ga tha ma dur khrod gnas/ /zasang na tha ma mi gtsang zas/ /gos ga tha ma shun chen gos/ /rgyan ngan tha ma sbrul nag rgyan/ /gnas ngan tha ma ma legs te/ /'khor ba'i mgo bcad gzhal yas khang / /zas ngan tha ma ma lags te/ /dug lnga 'joms pa bdud rtsi'i zas/ /gos ga tha ma ma lags te/ /rnam rtog 'joms pa shun chen gos/ /rgyan ngan tha ma ma lags te/ /zhe sdang 'joms pa sbrul gyi rgyan/ /da ni gshegs so shar ra ra/ /da ni bzhud do sil li li/ /dang po 'bub cing 'bub cing 'gro/ /bar du mchod zhing mchod zhing 'gro/ /tha ma 'theng zhing 'theng zhing 'gro/ /dang po 'bub cing mi 'gro sa /gti mug phung po lhun re stug /gti mug phung po lhun mi sdug sha yi phung po lhun re stug /bar du mchod zhing mi 'gro mā /'dod mags phung po gting (25ba 'a zab/ /'dod chags phung po gting mi zab/ khrag gi rgya mtsho gting re zab/ /tha ma 'theng zhing mi 'gro mā /zhe sdang phung po rtse re rtsub/ /zhe sdang phung po rtse mi rtsub/ /rus pa phung po rtse re rtsub/ /da ni gshegs so shar ra ra/ /da ni bzhud do sil li li/ /sgo ma ma yi sgo phye dang / /'phrang ma ma yi 'phrang phye cig /sgom ma yis sgo phye na/ /bcas su gzugs can dgra 'bul lo/ /g.yas su re shig thal ba re/ /'phrang ma ma yis 'phrang phye na/ /bcas su gzugs med bgegs 'bul lo/ /g.yon du re shig 'bub pa re/ /da ni gshegs so shar ra ra/ /da ni bzhud do sil li li/ /gser skyems gzu dpang bya ba ni/ /྅: byin rlabs thugs rje'i gter mdzod bla ma dang / /dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam bka' brgyad lha/ /dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes gzu dang dpang mdzod cig /dbang chen dkyil 'khor khrag 'thung —174

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pomo bzhi dang / dkar bzang bzhin legs kyi bu mo sman btsun chen mo bzhi ste/ bod khams skyong pa'i bstan ma bcu (26ba)gnyis 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa/ dpal chen po'i pham babs dang sgrub pa po'i stongs grogs la 'dir gshegs shig /dzaḥ& baṃ ho: e a ra li hri hri dza/ mu dra sa ma ya ྅:mu dra sa ma ye phaṭa: bh+yo/ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas pa nyid/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ /'dir gshegs dam skong 'phrin las mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /gsang ba'i yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang //sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /sil sil mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam skong 'phrin las mdzod/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang / kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje grags mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /za ཿ — kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /btsan la rol pa rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sman btsun chen mo khyed bzhi yang / / caḥ — slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phreng dang/ /bshes gnyen lang dkar dpal brtsegs kyis/ /rgya yul de ni brtan bzang du/ /zhing chen 'khrigs pa'i gdan steng du/ /rnam lnga zhing gi mchod bkram ste/ /lag tu rdo rje gtad nas ni/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i dam la btags/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag /thar pa 'thob phyir (27na)ming yang btags/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ dam tshig bzhin las ma 'da' bar/ /bod khams skyong zhing srung ba dang / /sgrub pa po yi stongs grogs mdzod/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /ci las gyur pa'i nad rnams dang / /rims nad thams cad zlog pa dang / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi zhal du ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta ji hi/ ma hā rak+ta ji nyi/ ma hā ba kla ta ji hi/ gtor gzheng steng du — /7(nyi

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganabro brdung ba/ e raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ/ dzā la raṃ/ tsi dza tri/ pra pe sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya ā: khyo: dmar nag gru gsum 'khyil ba yi/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor chen po nas/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /dbang chen rngams pa'i sgra sgrog cing / /dbang gi rta skad tsher re re/ khro bo'i 'brug sgra 'ur ru sa /rol pa'i rta bro chem se chem/ /gsang ba'i gshug glu kyur ru sa /bskal pa'i glog dmar ljib se ljib/ /rdo rje'i thog 'bebs lam se lam/ /hūṃ gis khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /phaṭa kyis dregs pa'i bdud dpung sreg /rngams chen sku yi dkyil 'khor nas/ /'bar chen rus pa'i phung po la/ /gsod byed byams pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /zhe snang me yi tshogs chen bcom/ /khrag 'thung gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /sreg byed rak+ta'i chu bo la/ /rdung byed dbang pos bro brdungs pas/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho'i rba klong bcom/ /dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ma rig sha yi phung po la/ /kun mkhyen gsal ba'i bro brdungs pas/ /gti mug mun pa'i tshogs chen bcom/ /gtum chen yon tan dkyil 'khor nas/ /ngar 'dzin dregs pa'i phung po la/ /bdag med rdo rjes bro brdungs pas/ /nga rgyal brag ri'i tshogs chen bcom/ /'jigs byed 'phrin las (27ba)dkyil 'khor nas/ /'gro rgyud ser chen 'khyil ba la/ /'dod chen snying rje'i bro brdungs pas/ /phrag dog 'dod pa'i tshogs chen bcom/ /ma chags pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rnam rtog bgegs kyi phung po la/ /gnyis med rol pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /gnyis 'dzin gdon gyi tshogs chen bcom/ /nyon mongs rdul du rlog pa'i bro/ /nyon mongs steng du da rdungs shig /rnam rtog phye ru 'thag pa'i bro/ /rtog pa'i mgo la da rdungasashig /skye med slong du chem se chem/ /'gag med klong du khrig se khrig /dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya nan/ dgra bgegs thams cad stam bha ya nan/ /dkyil 'khor gsal gdab gtang rag ni/ /༷ bi sha bi shu khro nas bzung / /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi'i bar brjod/ gtang rag mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dbang chen lha dgu ging lnga gza' gdong dang / /chos skyong beg tse lcam sring 'khor bcas la/ /sman rag gtor ma mchod yon nyer spyod dang / /rol mo 'bul gyi brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga —177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pota ma hā pad+ma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar/ sarba ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta 'a hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba smra ta ji hi/ yang gong gi sngags gsham du a lha nas shasta'i bar brjod/ ging lnga gza' gdong dang beg tse rnams kyi rang rang gi sngags mthar sman rag gtor gsum dang chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams gong bzhin bya/ bstod cing 'phrin las 'tshol ba ni/ hrī: zag med bde ba'i gar sgyur rta mchog dpal/ /stong nyid snying rje'i nyams ldan gar dbang ma/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /ging lnga gza' gdong beg tse rnams la bstod/ khrag 'thung lha dgu bka' sdod srung ma yis/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag dri med rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas rab rgyas shing / /de 'dzin 'dus pa'i sde rnams 'phel bar mdzod/ /'jig rten kun du sad (28na〉tser mu ge dang / /nad rims 'khrug rtsod la sogs rgud pa kun/ /zhi zhing phan dang bde ba'i dpal chen por/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du longs su spyod par mdzod/ khyad par rgyal kun yab gcig tsong kha pa'i/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i yid bzhin nor bu mchog /srid zhi'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor legs bkod de/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs par mdzod/ /sum rtsen yul gru nyang stod gnas snying du/ /chos srid bshad sgrub bstan pa rab 'phel zhing / /'jig rten dbang phyug dri ma med pa'i gdung / /gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar chad pa med par mdzod/ /zab rgyas theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i gling / /nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gsal byed bar/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar mdzod/ /rmad byung snyan grags kyis bos rigs bral gyi/ /mkhas rnams legs bshad nyan par rab 'du ba'i/ /mus sras bka' brgyud rab 'dzin byes grwa tshang / /bskal brgya'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /yang dgos dbang chen gtor mas legs sgrub pa'i/ /dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje'i spun grogs rnams/ /bar chad kun zhi mthun rkyen ma lus tshang / /bsams pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs mdzod/ /nongs pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ pad+ma he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur — /78

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganate/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rtag dang chad pa'i mtha' gsal ba/ /ā+oṃ ma hā (28ba〉nu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ad+ma ko3lha/ khyoḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ha ya gi ba khyoḥgab/ pad mo dha ra khyuḥgab/ pad+ma dha ra hrīḥgab/ tsan dha rak+ta hrī gab/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo snri snod bcud gzhal yas de yang 'khor la thim/ /'khor rnams gtso bo yum yang yab la thim/ /dbang chen sku yang 'ja' tshon ltar yal nas/ /ka dag gdod ma'i slong du badz+ra mu slar yang chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar/ /rang nyid yang gsang khros par gsal ba yi/ /sku las ye shes me dpung rab 'bar ba /'jig med srung ba'i go cha btsan por gyur/ /hrī: badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ dri med smon lam 'tshams sbyar ni/ dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sems can rnams/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i skye tshogs thams cad la/ /rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog /dus kun dge ba'i bkra shis ni/ rmad byung thugs rjes chen po'i rlabs kyi 'phreng / /nam yang yol ba med pa'i chu gter las/ /byin rlabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu'i gter/ /sbyin mdzad rtsa rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las za ma tog /dngos grub 'chi med bdud rtsis legs bltams nas/ /mchog thun don kun 'grub pa rdo rje'i srog /sgrub mdzad rta mgrin lha tshogs bkra shis shog /bar gcod dgra dang bgegs kyi brag gi ri/ /mthu stobs rdo rje'i thog gis phyer 'thag pa'i/ /ging lnga gza' gdong beg tse lcam sring sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /de ltar yang gsang khros pa bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i 'phrin las rang gzhung gtsang ma g.yin dang ma 'dres par bkod pa yin gyis mgon po a sgo ra sogs lugs srol 'di la med kyang byes grwa tshang du gtong srol 'dug pa ma chag pa legs pas yig (29na)rnying gi nang ltar byas la/ 'dir ni tshogs dang 'brel ba'i gtor zlog tsam bkod cing / rgyas par 'dod na rta bod du — /79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogebazhugs ba las shes par bya'o//smras pa/theg kun snying po ma hā yo ga las//bka' gter zung 'jug yang gsang khros pa zhes//byin rlabs nus mthu'i snyan pa dbyar rnga ltar//sgrog kyang tshul ldan shes pa nyin skar tsam//la la rta mgrin gshin rje phur pa sogs//snga 'gyur chos la gsar ma'i rgyas bkab ste/zhal dkar tshon gyis bsgyur pa'i dmar 'od kyis//byis pa'i skye bo zhabrul pa'i lam du 'khrid//mkhas rlom 'ga' zhig gsar ma'i phyag bzhi bar//gsang chen rnying ma'i cho ga dper bzung ste//blos byas tshig gi rgyud mang dang po'i sgras//dbang rtul mang po'i gru rdzings chu mtshor bshig/kho bo rang bzor spyod pa'i shesarab dman/khungs med dpe hrul sdud la brtson pa chung //'gal dum 'phreng bar spel ba'i snying khams zhan//de phyir brgyud pa'i man ngag rang sor bzhag/dal ba'i rten thob bshes gnyen mgon gyis zin//mdo sngags tha snyad chos tshul mang du thos//gsar rnying lag len ma 'dres khong du chud//tshul des legs par bshad pas dpyod ldan mgu/rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar char bzhed srol bzhin//yang gsang khros pa'i 'phrin las bkod pa'i dges//'gro kun sku gsum go 'phang thob gyur cig/ces pad+ma yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang rgya sngags 'chang chen po 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rigs las 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad dkar gyis rjes su bzung ba'i gdung dri ma med pa las byung ba gnas rnying chos kyi rje sku 'bring po'i gsung gis snga gong nas bskul ba dang /nye lam chos sde chen po theg chen 29ba ) gling gi byes mkhas nyan grwa tshang pa'i slob dpon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gtor sgrub par bcas pa rnams dang grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs kyis bskul ba la brten nas/mkhon ston rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs lam 'di'i sgo nas grub pa bsnyes pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas/zab mo'i tshul 'di la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad rgyas pa/ rda hor gyi rigs las ā wa sgru ti pa'i btsun pa

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma khoganangag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan gang shar rang grol du 'bod pa'i sdom bu pas yang gsang khros pa'i rgyud lo chen be+e ro tsa na'i 'gyur yer pa se ba gdong nas gter ston rnam gsum gyis spyan drangs pa'i gter ma grub thob 'dar char la bka' babs pa/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i las byang / mus sras pa dpal ldan seng shes mdzad pa'i 'phrin las kyi sgom khog rin chen 'phreng ba/ bla chen chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgom khog /gnyags kyi ban : rnam rgyal bzang pos mdzad pa'i las byang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i chos skyong skor gyi yi ge rnams la gzhi byas/ yig rnying so so'i tshigs bcad rnams byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba'i phyir rang sor bzhag /gsar du kha skong dgos pa rnams dang tshig lhug phas che ba tshigs bcad du bsdebs nas myos byed kyi lo hor zla lnga pa'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so// //sarba maṅga le/ /— 181 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge༄༅༅/ /dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang snying po bcud bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rigs kun khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi/ /zhabs sen zla tshes gtsug tor rtser bkod nas/ /pad+ma thod phreng gdams pa'i nying khu mchog /yang gsang khros pa'i 'phrin las rgyun 'khyer 'dri/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ khyab bdag kun bzang go 'phang ma thob bar/ /dkon mchog sa 'dus pa' bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed ni/ mtha' med mar gyur drin can 'gro ba kun/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i ched/ dbang chen yang gsang khros pa bsgrub pa'i thabs zab mo'i 'phrin las nyams su blang bar bya/ /tshogs zhing ni/ rang gi mdun du pad nyi ru dra'i steng / khrag 'thung lha tshogs rigs kyi bdag po sa /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma kun bzhugs pa/ /mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra bar gyur/ /rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal sogs brjod/ /mtshams gcod ni/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu rmi sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurnyo3hi paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ ru dra baṃ/ gyisnya ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ badz+ra kro dha ya ha shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ gyi dpal chen mi (2na)bzad dkyil 'khor nas/ /'bar ba'i khro bo me dpung 'bar/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tsho gis bsnams/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rdul du rlog /hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ srung 'khor ni/ /hrī chung 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus khro bo dang / /rdo rje'i ra ba bskal pa'i me 'bar bas/ /bar mtshams med par gtams pa'i gur khang gi /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ raṃ kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ tik+ṣa ṇa bi shwa dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ bshags pa ni/ rang nyid ltar gsal thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /bskor ba mdun du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ hūṃ/ bdag ni dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /grub — 182

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyu rig 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganapa'i rigs 'dzin dbang phyug go 'phang du/ /yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon la/ /'da' bar mi bya bsrung bar dam bcas te/ /las ngan dbang gyur skye bo bdag 'dra ba/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang du gyur/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags kun/ /'thol zhing bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ /byin 'bebs ni/ a la la ho/bha ga wan (2ba〉gam ya ho/ sam ya sto/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par ston pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la babs/ /nyams chags skong ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthu stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen phob cig bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag rnams la/ /las kyi 'bras bu tshims par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dza: mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ raṃ yaṃ kho/ a dhu su a ga na shaḥ/ sam ya / / lpa ra ṇa phaṭa /ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra a ha ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+radhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+rapuspye hūṃ nas sha lta'i bar brjod/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta hūṃ stsi oṃ ba smra ta ma hā ba smra ta te dz+wa ba smra ta ba la ba te gu spo sam ya hūṃ 1 tshwa āḥ: ma hā rak+ta dzā la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum rten brten pa bskyed pa ni/ hūṃ/ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /chos rnams sna tshogs rang shar ba/ /rang bzhin med de chu zla 'dra/ /thugs rje chen pos kun la khyab/ /snying po ye shes/ gi dbyibs/ /sa bon sngags rnams yongs su gyur ba las/ /'byung lnga'i ri rab gzhal yas lhun gyis grub/ /e las nam mkha' sngo skya gru gsum steng / /yaṃ las rlung dkyil 'khor zla gam dud kha g.yo/ /raṃ lasame dkyil dmar po zur gsum 'bar/ — las khrag mtsho dmar nag zlum po 'khrug // las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi brtan/ /kai las keng rus ri rab gru bzhi dkar/ /: las thod pa rin chen gzhal yas khang / /dbus su gru gsum dmar nag
