dkyil 'khor la/ /zla gam dmar (3na)bo thod pa'i ra ba can/ /phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyogs kyi mdog /mgo bo rlon pa'i phreng bas zlum por bskor/ /de'i phyir gru bzhi sgo bzhi gzhal yas khang / /phyogs skyong bcu yis rtsig pa'i rmang gzhi byas/ /nang ni ban+ta skam rlon rnying pa yi/ /rtsig pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer gyis btab/ /phyi ni rin chen sna —183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2potshogs las grub pa/ /dmar dkar ljang ser nag po'i rtsig pa can/ /bar du lha chen brgyad kyi rtsig pas gtams/ /rtsig steng rin chen rus pa'i pha gu la/ /rgyu ma rlon pa'i dra ba dra phyed 'phyang / /de'i steng rin chen rus pa spel ma yi/ /mda' yab pu shu rtsig pa'i rtsa ba na/ /'dod snam dmar po mchod pa'i lha mos gang / /rgyal chen bzhi dang thod pa skam po las/ /grub pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis legs bteg pa'i/ /thod pa rlon pa'i ka gzhu rab tu brdzid/ /klu chen brgyad kyi gdung mas phyogs mtshams bres/ /de la mdzes pa'i me tog rgyan du spud/ /gza' chen brgyad kyi bad phur btang ba la/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad gral phyam byas/ /bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i zhal pa can/ /dbus kyi lte ba phyur bur mtho ba'i rtser/ /pad+mas bteg pa'i tsit+ta'i tog gis rgyan/ /sgo bzhi ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa yi/ /rta babasabang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng / /pad+ma chos 'khor bcu gsum gdugs ri dwags/ /mgo snying tog mdzes zhing chen rgyal mtshan dang / /lag pa'i 'phan dang skra yi rnga yab can/ /dbang po'i me rtag spel ba'i phreng ba g.yo/ /mdor na rngam brjid mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spud/ /phyi rol pad ra dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /rdo rje'i ra ba bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /dbus kyi gru gsum dmar nag dkyil 'khor steng //paṃ las sna tshogs (3ba)pad+ma mdzes pa'i gdan/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ /ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar/ /ba las ru dra pho mo bsnol ba yi/ /gan rgyal kha skrub brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /rab 'bar rgyu ting hūṃ yig babs pa las/ /hrīḥyig dmar nag baṃ yig sngon por gyur/ /de las 'od 'phros 'phags tshogos mchod pas mnyes/ /sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib ma lus sbyangs/ /slar yang 'dus shing brtan par byas pa las/ /rang nyid rta mgrin pad+ma dbang chen sku/ /zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar nag /spyi bo'i gtsug tu rta mgo ljang gu'i zhal/ /rngog ma dmar po phrum phrum ser po dang / /zhur dkar rta skad sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur 'tsher/ /zhal rnams kun la spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum/ /smin ma sma ra ser po glog ltar 'byug /dbu skra ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes/ /phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma bsnams/ /g.yon gyi dang po khrag gang ka pā la/ /bzung ste bde chen yum gyi mgul nas 'khyud/ /lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu be con dang / /g.yon gnyis zhags pa ral gri me 'bar 'dzin/ /sku stod zhing lpags glang chen ko rlon gsol/ /sku —184

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rig 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganasmad stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs klubs/ /thod skam dbu rgyan rin chen rtse phran can/ /mgo bo skam rlon rnying pa lnga bcu yi/ /tshar gsum 'phreng ba'i do shal sku la gsol/ /rus pa rin chen sprul rigasabazhi yis brgyan/ /zhag gi sor ris rak+ta'i thig le dang / /thal chen tshom bu sku yi gnas su byugs/khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i khyung gshog can/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /gtso bo'i g.yon nas sku la 'khril tshul can/ /gsang yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug (4na)ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /spyan gsum sdang mig zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra ral pa nag po mun ltar gtibs/ /phyag g.yas tsit+ta thogs nas yab la 'khyud/ /g.yon pa dung chen khrag gis gang ba'i mtsho/ /dpal chen gtso bo'i zhal du 'debs tshul mdzad/ /yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor zla ba dang / /mgrin par pad+ma thugs gar nyi ma'i steng / /ā+oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ sngon yi ge yis/ /mtshan pas sku gsung thugs rnams byin gyis brlabs/ /dbu la thod pa'i khang bu lngas brgyan pa'i/ /spyi gtsug hūṃ sngon mtshog mar ā+oṃ dkar po/ /rna ltag g.yas su swā ser ltag pa na/ /oṃ dmar rna ltag g.yon na lha ljang gu /de rnams skad cig yongs su gyur ba las/ /rdo rje khrag 'thung sngon po rdor dril 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas khrag 'thung dkar po sto bor dril 'dzin/ /rin chen khrag 'thung ser po rin chen dril/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung dmar po pad dril 'dzin/ /las kyi khrag 'thung ljang gu ral gri dril/ /rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dag dang mthun/ khrag 'thung rigs lnga dbu yi rgyan du rdzogs/ /yab kyi gsang gnas yi ge hūṃ yig ni/ /yongs gyur rdo rje rtse lnga'i rnam pa can/ /yum gyi gsang gnas po las pad 'dab brgyad/ /snyoms par sa zhugs pa' bde ba chen po'i sgras/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ /yab kyi zhal zhugs thugs kar 'od du zhu/ /rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i/ /thig le yig 'bru brgyad kyi ngo bor gyur/ shar gyi rtsibs steng de ba baṃ yongs gyur/ /dri za dkar po pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /ā+oṃ las rdo rje dbang chen sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje dang / /(4bskoyon pa dbyug to bsnams shing 'gying ba'i tshul/ /lho yi rtsibs steng ya ma baṃ yongs gyur/ khrul bum sngon po pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /swā lasarin chen dbang chen sku mdog sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rin chen dang / /g.yon pa —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (27)lcags kyu 'gugs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin/ /nub kyi rtsibs steng nā ga baṃ yongs gyur/ /klu rgyal dmar po pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /e las pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa pad+ma dang / /g.yon pa zhags pa 'ching ba'i tshul gyes 'dzin/ /byang phyogs rtsibs steng yak+ṣa baṃ yongs gyur/ /gnod sbyin ljang gu pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /ha las las rab dbang chen ljang dmar mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa ral gri dang / /g.yon pa rtse gsum bsnun pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin/ /kun kyang spyan gsum zhal bgrad che ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes sprul gyis bcings/ /dur khrod chas rnams ma lus sku la brgyan/ /me dpung klong na gar stabs tshul gyis bzhugs/ /sgo bzhir a dang tsan+d+ra baṃ yongs gyur/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i gdan steng du/ /dza yig yongs gyur sgo ma lcags kyu ma/ /dkar mo khrag ral lcags kyu slo snying 'dzin/ /hūṃ yig yongs gyur sgo ma zhags pa ma/ /ser mo g.yu ral zhags pa glo snying 'dzin/ /baṃ yig yongs gyur sgo ma lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar mo mthing ral lcags sgrog glo snying 'dzin/ /hoḥyig yongs gyur sgo ma dril bu ma/ /ljang gu gser ral dril bu glo snying 'dzin/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag dang zhabs gnyis pa/ /dur khrod chas brgyan me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /snyan gsan ni/ badz+ra sa mā dza:spyan 'dren ni/ chos kyi dbyings nas sku (5na)bzhengs pa/ /dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po bzhengs/ /lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol/ /e da phya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri shu ho: sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya sto/ bzhugs gsol ni/ dzaḥ ྅ baṃ sngo sam ya sto/ phyag 'tshal ni/ a ti pu ṇ+ḍa pra ti dza ho mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a: nas sha lta'i bar brjod/ de bzhin du rū pa nas spar+sha'i mthar dharma dh+wa tu'i bar brjod/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ lha ka sirnyi ā: tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ ma hā me sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ke : ti khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā su kha bho dhi tsit+ta swāhā/ ma hā rma sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ke : ti/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /zung 'jug bde chen rnam sprul ba/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /rta mchog tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ/ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta — 186

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lo rgyus rig 'dzin zhal lung / nang ma rtoganamachog dpal/ /thugs gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar la ni snying po hrī: 'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdu/ /sems can sgo gsum dri ma sbyong / /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la bsdu/ /hrīḥ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ma hā kro : shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+re shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ra sno shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ pad+me shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ dme shwa ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a du sha dza: zho badz+ra pā sha (5ba)lha/ ā+oṃ badz+ra h+pho ṭa baṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ho: ྅/ khro rgyal rngam pa rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchag las/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /ā+oṃ paṅgān+ta kṛ ta pad+me shwa ri ma hā kro dha ha ya shrī wa ma ma trag mo dun ti hrī hrī dza: zho pad+ma kro dha kā ya wa ka tsit+ta sirnyi a la la ho: bka' srung mchod pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu mang po 'phros pas pad+ma dbang gi zhid khams nas srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ rgya yul nam mkha'i chad chod nas tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ nub phyogs pha waṃ long bu'i mkhar nang nas dam can rdo rje legs pa/ bdud yul kha rag sgo dgu nas bdud po ri nag spungs pa/ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas btsan rgod yam shud dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig yud tsam la e gye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dza pad+ma ka ma lwa ya sto/ rdo rje pad+ma kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtog cing oṃ rā dza srog la hrī: a shug mi tra srog la dzaḥtsa pa la a shug me/ tri li pho/ badz+ra su dhu hrī: dun dun shu la shrī wa i rda ba kla rta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūṃ/ dbang drag dkyil 'khor spyi yi bka' sdod ni/ /srog la dbang sgyur ging chen lnga rnams kyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed cing / /zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za/ dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /med byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lho nub mtshams kyi srin yul lang ka pu ri'i grong khyer nas dregs pa gza' gdong lcam dral lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa ā+oṃ e gye hi badz+ra sa mā dza pad+ma ka (6na〉5 lā ya rto/ ā+oṃ rā hu la ma ra tsa sha ya i rda ba sla ta ji hi 'a hi/ hūṃ/phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /dam can bka' sdod gza' gdong lcam dral —/87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gekyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bo'i lo tog nar mar gsol/ /dgra bgegs yul khams thal bar rlog byed pa'i/ /gza' gdong dregs pa can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /med byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bzod gsol ni/ pad+ma he ru rka'i yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /nyer bsdu ni/ snod bcud gzhal yas de yang 'khor la thim/ /'khor rnams gtso bo yum yang yab la thim/ /dbang chen sku yang 'ja' tshon ltar yal nas/ /ka dag gdod ma'i klong du badz+ra mu: /slar yang chu las chu bur brdol ba ltar/ /rang nyid yang gsang khros par gsal ba yi/ /sku las ye shes me dpung rab 'bar ba/ /'jigs med srung ba'i go cha btsan por gyur/ /smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sems can rnams/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig sdongs pa'i skye tsho gis thams cad la/ /rol ba'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog mas brjod ni/ sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las za ma tog /(6ba po ngos grub 'chi med bdud rtsis legs gtams nas/ /mchog thun don kun grub pa'i rdo rje'i srog /bsgrub mdzad rta mgrin lha tshogs bkra shis shog /ces dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i las byang snying po bcud bsdus 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi nyams len du dgos tshul ltar za hor sngags ban gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed smra ba pa bsam mthong pa phun tshogs dbang po'o// //sarba maṅga lo/ / 188

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganar༅༅/ /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru : sto rot+ta ma shri ye/ ye dag mtshan ma'i spros pa kun bral 'od mi 'gyur ba chos kyi sku/ /gtum drag mtshon gyis bdud bzhi'i snying 'bigs khrag 'thung rta mgrin longs spyod rdzogs/ /'chi med 'pho chen 'ja' lus yongs brnyes pad+ma thod phreng sprul pa'i gar/ /sku gsum sgyu 'phrul zhabs pad chun po gtsug tor rtser 'ching bdag byin rlobs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje be+e ro'i thugs gsang mdzod/ /'dzin mdzad 'dar phyar dpal ldan seng ge dang / /rwa ban chos bzang tshar chen rigs kyi gtso/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa phyag gi yul/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug gnas gsar ba/ /mgon po bsod nams rnam kun mchog ldan zhabs/ /rab 'byams rgyal dngos chos dbyings rang sar grol/ /byang chen bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /srid gsum 'byung po'i snying gar rta yi bro/ /chem chem rab brdung pad+ma he ru ga'i/ dngos grub zil dngar snying gi za ma tog /'khyil byed snyan pa'i man ngag las g.yin su/ /de phyir rgyud dang rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal rlangs drod po che/ /(2nasgo nyams rang bzo'i lhad dang nyer bral ba'i/ /yid bzhin dbang gi 'dod pa 'di na 'jo/ /de'ang ye shes rngam glog las/ sgom dang bzlas dang 'phro 'dul sngags/ /ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dra bskyod nas/ /sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /ma rnga zhe sum du ni bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs pa'o/ /zhesabazlas brjod kyi nus pa me dang 'dra bas rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib shing bu lta bu rnams bsreg par byed cing dper na 'jig rten dus la spyod pa'i dbang phyug la brten nas 'dod don sgrub pa'i sngon du sngar zhal 'dris ye ma thogs par 'dris btsal te bsnyen bkur ba sogs thabs du ma'i sgo nas dgyes —189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepar byas pas mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad pa bzhin mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i ched du yi dam gyi lha'i bzlas brjod bya ba ni/ bsnyen pa zhes brda rnying steng dza ba zur chag pa 'dzab la brten nas rang rig don gyi lha mchog rang ngo 'phrod pa la nye bar gyur (2ba)pas dngos nyams rmi lam du byin gyis brlab cing dngos grub stsol bas de lta bu'i mtshan rtags ma rnyed kyi bar du nyams su blang ba yin no/ /ji ltar nyams su bstar bya'i chos ni kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbang chen rngams pa'i rgyal po'i skur bzhengs nas rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa bka' stsal/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal skyon chen pos byang bu drug dang skabs spyod don 'grel sogs dang skad gnyis smra ba lo chen be+e ros sbas pa mig 'byed kyis mtshon pa'i zab chos rnams gter kha gnyis su rgyas btab pa las rkyang po grags pa dbang phyug /sum pa dbang phyug tshul khrims/ 'bre shes rab bla ma gsum gyis yer pa se ba lung nas gdan drangs te 'bru tshang gi gnyags ston la shog ser gyi steng nas tshar gcig bshad rjes gter ston gsum la jur byung bas rgyun chad pa'i grags par brten shog ser rnams zhu ston gyi phyag tu byung rung zhu sa rtsad ma chod cing nam zhig na grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar phya ru ba rin chen dpal bzang jo mo nags rgyal na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpal skyon chen pos zhang tshes zla grags bya bar sprul te smin grol lung gdams pa rnams stsal zhing sngags kyi ā+oṃ de hrīḥr bsgyur zhes gdams shing / grub thob chen pos bla ma gnyags la shog ser chig brgyud yod pa mkhyen nas tshar gcig dang bla ma mnga' bdag chen pos lho brag nas spyan drangs pa she ma 'od 'byung la brgyud pa'ang gsan pas 'dar phya ru bar bka' gter zung 'jug gi gdams pa mtha' dag tshang bar mnga' yang mnga' ris pad+ma dbang rgyal/ mdong ston chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ mnyam med nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs thor bu las snga 'gyur phyogs (3na skos ljags kyi dbang po rkyong ba ches nyung mod mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ge yab sras/ rwa chen chos dpal bzang pos mtshan rdzong chung ngu ba'i mkhas grub du ma dang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje yab sras kyis ekhri yā na'i ā tsārla rgan po dang gan jag thang ta gnyis kyi bzhed gzhung la gsar ma'i lhad dang gter kha gzhan 'dra'i rgyas 'gebs dang bral ba'i srol legs par bzung na'ang rnying ma ba sa lugs dang 'brel che ba la las kye rdor — 190

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganagyi dbang kha bsgyur ba/ tshe dbang gzhan la rdzong chung tshe dbang du ming 'dogs pa/ dge lugs phyogs kyi blo gros rin seng ba sogs kyis las byang snga 'gyur gyis dgongs don ma lon zhing mgon po a sto ra tshun chad zhabs su btags pa/ la lar skye 'chi bar do gsum gyi chos mthun 'bad pas sbyor ba sogs yid brtan tu mi rung ba ci rigs snang ba mtha' ma bkag mod lam 'di la snying nas sgrub pa lhur len par 'dod pa rnams kyis kun mkhyen rin po ches mdzad pa'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu dang bla chen chos dpal bzang po'i dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma zha spud byed gang rung la lha dbang sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i nag 'gros kyi steng nas rdzong chung tshe dbang / gying lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad bcas smin byed/ rta skad thengs gcig ma sogs grol byed kyi ngo sprod/ rgyab rten gyi lung / phyag bzhes man ngag mtha' dag khong du chud par byas te nyams su bstar ba la sgrub chen bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gang la'ang yig nag gi thug phrad tsam la yid brtan du bzung ba'i (3ba)phyogs re'i mig can du ma song bar rtsa brgyud kyi steng du dril ba/sgrub thabs byang bu'i steng du dril ba/ man ngag las tshogs kyi steng du dril shes pa zhig dgos zhes paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs chos kyi spyan ldan rnams gsung la/ de la'ang sngon 'gro gnas dus yo byad 'du bya ba/ dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub zung 'brel du nyams su blang ba/ mjug dngos grub len pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ sgrub byang las/ gnas dang gang zag mtshan nyid dang / /sgrub pa'i dus dang yo byad sogs/ /'brel thag bcad cing dkyil 'khor bri/ /mchod pa gtor ma rgyan rnams dgram/ /phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan pas/ /sāts+tsha chu gtor dpang skong dang / /'dus byas dge rtsa nus tshang bya/ /tsha gsum bgegs rigs gtor ma btang / /zhes pa ltar gnas ni/ rgyud las/ dur khrod ri brag dmar po la/ /nub ni mtho brjod shar ri dma'/ /nags tshal stug po nub tu blta/ /gnam sa 'khor lo pad+ma 'dra/ /nyi zla gza' skar 'od 'bar zhing / /chu bran ri brag kun 'dus gnas/ /zhes pa ltar nub ri mtho ba/ byang ri skyob pa/ shar dma' ba/ lho gzhes ba/ nub nas chu 'bab pa/nags tshal 'thug po phyogs der blta ba/ chu bran mang du 'du zhing ri bo du ma 'dud pa'i dbyibs can/nyi zla rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhing brag ri dmar po dang dur khrod yod pa/ rtsi shing me tog 'khrig — 191

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gecing 'dab chags dang bung ba skad snyan par 'byin pa/ mu stegs byed dang theg pa (4na)dman pa nag phyogs gdon dang 'thab rtsod nad bskyed pa sogs rkyen rnams las ring du gyur pa/ chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing grub thob gong ma'i tshogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang spyir yang gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ shar gyi stag skya bo/ lho'i g.yu 'brug sngon mo/ nub kyi bya dmar po/ byang gi rus sbal nag po ste gnas kyi yon tan thams cad tshang na rab/ 'bring phyogs tsam tshang ba/ tha ma'ang sa bkra ngan pa dang gzugs can gzugs med kyi 'tshe ba med cing mthun pa'i grogs dang yo byad 'tshol sla bar rang nyid dbang ba'i gnas nyams zhig dang bral ba'i bsam gtan 'phel ba nyid gtso bor bya dgos pa/ dra chen las/ bdag dbang bar chad med pa'i gnas/ /der ni ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /zhes so/ /chos thams cad ka dag gi klong du grol bar gza' skar dus tshes bzang ngan med kyang phug 'og gi chu dong las kun rdzob dang bstun pa nyes pa chung zhing phan yon che bas dus kyang spyir rgyas par nyi ma byang bgrod dang yar ngo / /drag por nyi ma lho bgrod dang mar ngo / /zhi bar nyi ma las gdong sogs/ dbang la nub mo bya bar gsungs shing bye brag ji skad du/ lo dang zla ba skar ma bzang / /dus tshodi bzang la 'jug par bya/ /zhes spor thang gtsug lag nas bshad pa'i mche ba can sogs lo zla rtsub pa/ rang gi dgra gshed lta bu ma yin pa'i lo zla gza' skar sbyor byed khyim gyi dus sbyor sogs dang po'i sangs rgyas dang g.yul las rnam par rgyal (4ba)ba'i rgyud rnams las byung ba ltar bsnyen sgrub la shes pa nges par bsgrig cing gza' tshes 'dzom na yar ngo dang mar ngo gang bde ba/ dus tshod ji skad du/ nyi ma chung bar gyur pa ni/ /lha yang byin gyis rlabs kyi 'du/ /zhes lha dbang du byed pa'i rten 'brel gyis srod thun nas 'dzugs/gnam sa'i rgyan/ dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas/ sgrub rten spyan gzigs/ /nad 'joms kyi sman/gegs sel gyi rdzas/ gnod pa las skyob pa'i go mtshon/ bza' bca' btung ba la sogs mtshams nang der nye bar mkho ba'i bdog pa rnams thog ma nas gsog pa dang slad mar 'di nas yong dmigs 'og tu chud pa las zag zog gi zol sbyor mi bya/ bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i ched du cha gsum/gser skyems/ gsung rab/ sus nye 'don/ sbyin gtong sogs 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa ci 'grub bya'o/ /— 192

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganaganyis pa dngos gzhi'i bsnyen sgra zung 'brel nyams su blang ba ni/ rgyas par sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i lag len ni bsnyen sgrub tsam la med du mi rung ba ma yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag de'ang sgrub thabs rgyas pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ 'bring bo yab yum rkyang sgrub/bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa gsum du bshad pa'i dang po shes na lhag ma dag zhan gyis rtogs par nus shing de'ang gnas khang byi dor dang chag chag btab/ slob dpon be+e ro tsa nas/ steng du bla bre phug pa yi/ /dbus su gdugs dang mtshams bzhir 'phan/ /phyogs bzhi ru ni rgyal mtshan gdags/ /zhes pa ltar 'byor pa dang bstun nas dgram/ gzhan yang rtsa ba gsum gyi (ldan)bris 'bur gyi sku dang bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam rten nam/ rgyu byin rlabs bri tshul mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gsar bskrun rab gnas can yang rung bas yang gsang khros pa'i bris 'bur gyis sku bshams/ stegs bu'am cog tse lta bu ji ltar 'tsham par bdud rtsi lnga'i skyang nul dang chag chag gdab/ spyir dkyil 'khor la ting 'dzin/rdul tshon/ ras bris gsum du bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni mos pa lam du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la goms pa gong 'phel du bstar bas rnam pa lam byed la rtsal thon bde'i rgyun bskyangs par brten nas ting 'dzin dngos kyi lam mthar phyin par byed nus pa'i tshe mtshan ma med cing bya rtsol dang bral ba'i ngang nas bsgom pa blo yang rab kyi nyams su blang bya yin pas lha'i spyan dbus ma tsam la dmigs pa mi gsal bar bsam gtan gyi sgrub mchod dang sbyin sreg byed pa skad ni rang nyid kyi zhar la 'gro mang bslu bar byed pa'i rnam thar yin pas re zhig ngal bsos te rdul tshon ni/ rin po che/ 'bru/ tshon te rgyu'i bzang ngan gyi khyad par yin cing lha mtshan du gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan nam gdan nyi zla sogs bris pa'i mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor ni brda tsam gyis rtogs par bya ba blo 'bring po'i spyod yul rang cag so skye rnams kyis bsgrub par bya ba'i gnas yin pa rgyas par spro na sa'i cho ga dang spros pa chung na rnam bcad dang po'i skor dor ba'i thig tshon gyi cho ga tsam la brten nas rdul tshon ni tshogs gsog par bya ba la lhag par bsngags pas legs na'ang bsnyen sgrub yun ring por rlung dang spyod lam mi bzo ba sogs kyis 'jig nyen che zhing / rje btsun rtse mos/ ras bris la brten (5ba)ba'i lugs 'di ni bde mchog a bhi dha nar gsungs pa la brten nas slob dpon rdo —/93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2porje dril bu pa dang slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje la sogs pas gsungs la/ ding sang rgya gar gyi yul na yang cho ga phal cher 'di nyid la mdzad pas bla ma gong ma rnams kyang phal cher phyag len 'di la mdzad pas lugs 'di ha cang ma legs pa ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i dgongs don ltar dus dang gza' skar bzang por phyag tshad dang ldan pa'i bzo bos rgyur rung ba rnams la slob dpon cho ga tshad ldan shes pas rgyud dang man ngag las byung ba bzhin bris te rab gnas tshul bzhin byas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ma/ rtsa ba'i lha'am gtso rkyang gang rung gi sku tsa ka li'i dkyil 'khor ram ras bris zhes grags pa yin la/ snga 'gyur phyogs mang por ras bris la mtshan ma tsam bkod pa dang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mdzad pa mi rung ba ma yin mod lugs srol 'di la/ slob dpon dza ya se nas/ rdul tshon bri bar ma nus na/ dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /nges par bcom ldan he ru gaḥ /phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa bri/ /zhes pa'i don dang mthun par tshad thub kyi mkhas pa rnams ba ched pas nya dang nyung ma mi bsre bar gsol zhing gtso bo tsam gyis skus chog pa ci zhe na gtso bo nyid kyi sku la phung po dang 'byung ba gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ dbang po dang yul sems dpa' dang sems ma/ yan lag dang bya ba khro bo dang khro mo ste gdan gsum tshang ba'i gnad 'gag 'di sngags 'chang dkar ser gyi na bza' mnabs pa mtha' dag pa'i thugs kyi dpal ber bcang 'tshal/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma gnyis la mtshan (6na〉ba dbyibs/ /bsgom pa ting nge 'dzin/ gsang ba byang chub kyi sems/ gnas lugs don gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi ga tshang ba'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos la/ mus srad pa dpal ldan seng shes/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mnyi'i steng du dze bkod/ ces sogs gsungs pa'i don ltar/ man ngag sbas pa mig 'byed las/ mchog sgrub gling lnga'i thod pa la/ /skyes pa bud med dar ma yi/ /don snying lnga dang dbang po lnga/ /bu mo gtsang ma'i rak+ta dang / /sgrub sman dri ldan chang sbyar gyi/ khu ba mtshal dang sbyar ba yis/ /rgyu sngags bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags/ /bzlas pa'i sngags dang las sngags rnams/ /thod pa'i dbus nas rim bzhin bri/ /sngo dmar dar la rnal 'byor bas/ /rang gi mtho tshad gru bzhi pa/ /gong gi rdzas kyis dar dmar la/ /pad+ma he ru gaḥ nyid bri/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum bris nas ni/ /bskyed pa'i rkyen gyi sngags kyis bskor/ /thugs dar pad nyi rgyu sngags la/ /bzlas pa'i sngags kyis — 194

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganabaskor ba bri/ /lto bar lha rnam bas tham bang cad kyi/ /labs sngags spangs pa'i rtsa sngags ( bri/ /phyag drug sngags kyi dgod lugs ni/ /dang po gnyis la dbang gi sngags/ /bar pa gnyis la dgug pa ni/ /dbyug pa 'dzin pa drag sngags bdun/ /ral gri bsnams pa spu gri dang / /'khas bzhi sngags kyi dgod lugs ni/ /brkyang bskum thun dang bzlog sngags bri/ /nang mar gar stabs thog ser sngags/ /gang la dmod pa g.yaba'i su bri/ /(6ba)sngon po dar la yum bris la/ /phyag gnyis dbang dang spu gri bri/ /thebs gnyis thog dang ser ba bri/ /sngags g.yin dgod pa yab ltar du/ khres rab ldan pa'i rig pas dpyad/ /dgug bstim rab gnas legs byas la/ /skyes pa dar ma'i gri snying gi /dbu ni gyen du bstan pa yi/ /srog pa rtsa yi nang du gzhug /gzhan yang nyer lnga'i bcud bcug cing / /g.yas su skyes pa dar ma yi/ /g.yon du bud med dar ma yi/ /rang rang dbang po lnga rnams gzhug /dar sna lnga yis kha bkab la/ /dar dmar dri lnga khu ba yis/ /yang yang spang zhing yang yang bskam/ /tsit+ta legs par gril nas kyang / /dar sna lnga yis legs par bcings/ /mchog gi thod pa'i nang du gzhug /ces thod pa dang sku gzugs la yi ge dgod tshul rdzas sbyor lugs sogs dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las thos pa'i phyag len dmar 'khrid bzhin dang lugs 'di ga'i bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa dang 'brel na dang ma 'brel na sngar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu'am de 'dra dang chos sman lta bu'i phab rgyun gyi ril bu byas pa'ang thod par 'jug /mchod gtor sogs lag pa'i 'du byed kyis bskrun dgos pa rnams tshags su chud pa sngon du 'gro bas stan bde ba la 'khod/ sgrub byang las/ rgyal po bzhi yis phyi mtshams bcad/ /dam sri mnan cing sgo byang gdags/ /dbang chen nang mtshams rnam gnyis bcad/ /ces pa ltar/ las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs kyi skyabs sems dang / rang skad cig gis dbang chen du gsal gdab/ mtshams gcod la (7na)kun rdzob thabs dang don dam shes rab gnyis kyi kun rdzob la rgyal po bzhi la 'phrin las gzhol ba ni bcol ba phyi'i mtshams te rgyal po dbang du 'dus na 'bangs dbang du 'dus pa dang 'dra bas phyogs bzhi'am gnas kyis bskal na sgo drung du tho dkar po bzhi brtsigs pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ byin rlabs bskyed chog spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs phur lha khra'i dkyil chog rtogs par sla ba lta bu nas len/ 'phrin las 'chol — 195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geb ni/ phyi'i sngon 'gro las/ sngon ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe gdan mtshams chen po la bgos te mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i gdan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyi bzhes pa de bzhin du/ bdag cag gi sgrub pa 'di ma thon gyi bar du phyi'i dgra bgegs nang du mi btang ba dang nang gi dngos grub phyir mi yal ba la sogs pa'i phyi mtshams bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ ding sang bsnyen mtshams la dam sri mi gnon pa shas che yang 'di sgrub pa'i gegs kyi gtso bor 'dug pas gnon par 'dod na phyi'i sngon 'gro dang / sgom khog nas bshad pa la phyag len man ngag gis brgyan nas bgyis na bar mtshams yin pas rgyal po btson du bzung na 'bangs kyis gnod pa byed mi nus pa lta bu/ nang mtshams ni rgyud las/ rang nyid skad cig ting 'dzin gyis/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung sku ru bskyed/ /thugs kyi snying po 'od 'phros pas/ /phyogs bcur me mtshon khro bo'i gur/ /zhes pa ltar/ nang gses drug yod pa'i bdag nyid chen po'i mtshams ni/ pad nyi ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan (7bskong du/ /zhes sogs brjod de dpa' bo rkyang gcig tu bskyed/ khro bo rol pa'i mtshams ni rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ma'i hrīḥlas khro bo'i tshogs che ba ri rab nas chung ba rdul phran gyi bar grangs med pa spro/ sna tshogs mtshon cha'i mtshams ni/ rdo rje ral gri gri gug dgra sta sogs dpag tu med pa bu yug ltar 'tshub pa'i rtsa ba nang du bstan nas phyir 'phro ba/ ra ba gur gyi mtshams ni rdo rje'i gur gsum rim/ me rlung chu gsum gyi gur gsum rim ste bcu bzhi/ yang na mtshon cha'i phyi rol rdo ra/ rim bzhin chu rlung me gur te bzhi bzhi po gsum rim du byed/ kha cig rim pa lngar byed pa'ang snang / gsal 'debs tshog gi mtshams na/ dpal chen mi bzad dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs/ bzlas pa sngags kyi mtshams ni/ ā+oṃ raṃ zhes sogs mtshams kyi tshad ni/ gang zag gi blo'i khyad par te dus 'khor gyi srung 'khor la yar klungs pa chos mgon gyis thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che la dri ba zhus pa lta bu'o/ /don dam ni sgyu 'phrul gyi rgyud las/ /rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin te/ /bgegs ni rang gi sems las byung / /sems la rang bzhin med shes na/ /gzhan nas bgegs che kha/bya ba med/ /ces pa ltar nang gses la gsum gyi gnas lugs don gyi mtshams ni/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams chu — /96

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma khoganalas chu rlabs 'byung ba bzhin sems kyi cho 'phrul yin cing sems kyi ngo bo ka dag blo 'das spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin pas don dam par skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i gnas lugs rang ngo shes na snang yun ltar bgegs dang (8na)bral lo/ /glu bro'i mtshams ni/ dbang po rab kyis bro byed de sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las sogs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'phrin las so so'i bro brdungs pas dug so so 'joms pa yin no/ /stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom pa'i mtshams ni/ shā n+ya tā sogs brjod nas/ spyir chos thams cad/ khyad par bcad bya'i bgegs/ bcad pa'i mtshams/gcod byed gdams ngag sogs dngos po dang dngos med gang du'ang ma grub cing blo las 'das pa ngos gzung med pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi rang bzhin can zhig skad cig gis bsgoms pa'i ngang las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de nas stegs bu'i khar sa lha'i mchod gtor bshams nas dbang chu dag pa'i dri ma 'brud byed ltar btang nas de'i shul du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dgram/ dbus su ma zhi'i steng ban+ta gling lnga snying dang bcas pa dar gyis gril ba sogs lag tshags dam pa dbu 'khas ma 31ga pa phyag len ltar bkod/ shar du zhun chen la ro ras sdong bu btsugs pa'i mar me/ lhor ma da na bzang por rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi bdud rtsi a khra ta btab pa dkar ba thabs kyi rang bzhin mtshon pas g.yas su 'byung / nub tu rin po che las grub pa'i pad+ma'i dbyibs can nam thod pa mtshan ldan gang rung gtor ma dbang phyug chen po'i tsit+ta'i dbyibs zhes pa dpal gtor snying gzugs rta mgo ljang gus mtshan pa me ri pad+ma sogs dkar dmar gyi rgyan spros dang mtheb skyus sha sna'i tshul du byas par sha chen sogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa lha rten gyi tsa ka li dang dar dmar po'i cod pan can/ dkar dmar (8ba)thabs shes yab yum zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin mtshon pa dbus su dgod na'ang sgrub rten gyi dbang gis rgyab tu mdzad rung sgrub thod ma 'byor na sgrub gtor la brten dgos pas dbus su dgod/byang du lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+ta 'am gang yang rung bar rtsa ba/ dngas ma/ phal pa/ yongs sbyor gyi rak+ta dmar po shes rab kyi rang bzhin yum mtshon pa g.yon du 'byung / gyi mda' tshon skud sogs dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod kyi rim pa spros pa che bar 'dod na rung yang sgrub chen dang ma 'brel ba'i bsnyen sgrub tsam la ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ de'i phyi la mchod yul gyi g.yas dang las kyi rdo rje'i g.yon nas — 197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobartsams te nang gi chu gcig sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod la khrag chang bsres pa'i chu/ sha chen gyi bdug spos/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ de'i phyir phyi'i nyer spyod la/ dkar gsum sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ dri bzang sna tshogs sbyar ba'i reng bu/ 'bras bu chu dang thang las skyes pa'i me tog /rtsi bcud 'bru mar gyi sgron me/ tsan+dan gur kum sogs kyisasbags pa'i dri chab/ nas 'bras sogs bzang 'bru'i bshos/ nub tu rtsa gsum gtor ma/ gying lnga gza' gdong gnod sbyin lcam dral yul lha gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/ gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu/ thod rnga/ 'thor nas/ gu gul/ a ka sa yungs kar sogs nyer spyod dang nub dang por zhing lngags sam gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i steng du tshogs mchod gya nom pa bsham/ sa'am (9na)'byu dkar gyi g.yung drung gi steng du stan nang 'tshangs can gyi khar bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnyags ban rnam rgyal bzang pos mdzad pa'i las byang chen mo'am rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs gang byas kyang khyad par med cing phyi ma'i dbang du bgyis na skyabs sems nas bzung rta bro'i bar las byang gzhung rgyas par bsrang pa/ de'ang snga 'gyur gyi phyogs su bdag mdun sgrub lugs kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig yod kyang lugs 'di'i bzhed pa rang dang dkyil 'khor sgrub rten rnams tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis gsal 'debs shing 'phrin las 'dir sbyor ba don gyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi tshang ba yab yum gyi sku bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ mkha' gsang brlab pa nye bsnyen/ sbyor ba'i brdas bskul nas snyom par zhugasapa sgrub pa byang sems yab kyi rdo rje nas yum gyi mkhar spros te hūṃ sogs sa bon yongs su gyur nas gdan so sor bkod pa sgrub pa chen por mdzad pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dri ma med pa ste/ dam pa rgyan las/ bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen dang / /sgrub pa dang ni sgrub chen po/ /yum gi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus pa/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /zhes dang / der ma zad/ lha bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ skye mched brlab pa nye bsnyen/ dbang bskur sgrub pa/ spyan drang bsgrub pa chen po rnams su bshad do/ /srod thun nas bsnyen pa dngos gzhi 'dzugs par gong du 'phrin las gyar ba'i mus de ga yin pas ting nge 'dzin gsal 'debs tsam las bskyed drang mchod bstod ma dgos rung thun gzhan rnams la skyabs sems (9ba)nas bstod pa'i bar las byang rgyas bsdus gang rung cha — /98

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganatshang ba re nges par dgos pas bstod bsnyen gyi mtshams su rdzogs rim dang 'brel ba'i dmigs pa tshar re dgos pa thog ma 'dir bstod pa'i rjes su par bkab ma byung yang tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer dngos grub myur stsol du/ rlung ro bus nas 'og rlung gyen du 'then/ /zhes pa nas bzung / 'dzin med du 'jog gi bar nyams su blang / ngag byin rlabs sam bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin dgongs 'dus dang byang gter gnubs lugs sogs man ngag du mar 'byung ba bzhin skabs 'di dang gzhan thor thun la 'os/ phreng ba ni/ ji skad du/ shel gyis rangs dang zhi ba nyid/ /dbang la tsan+dan dmar po nyid/ /lung thang gis ni mngon spyod nyid/ /ri ram shus ni sdang ba la/ /rta yi rus pas bskyod pa la/ /bram ze'i rus pas 'gugs pa nyid/ /glang po'i rus pas char pa la/ /zhes sna tshogs gsungs kyang / /dag po rang byung rang shar las/ rak+ta thod 'phreng ma gtogos pa'i/ /bder gshegs sgrub pa'i phreng gzhan med/ /ces dang / srid pa'i gter khyim du/drag po la ru raka dang thod pa ḍā ki 'du ba'i dngos grub myur bar bshad pa ltar la/ ji skad du/lha dgu la sogs srad bu la/ /lha dgus byin gyis brlab par bya/ /zhes srad bu dgu bsgril rdo rje sems dpa' dang nye sras brgyad mtshon pa bu mo mgo gtsang gis dril bar byed/ rin chen rigs kyi lhar bskyed drang mchod bstod 'od zhu'i mthar sngags nyer gcig (10na)tsam gyis phus gdab cing 'dren lugs ni/ ji skad du/ zhal khro bo dgod par bya/ /rgyas la dbu ma'i de nyid la/ /srin la gshis na dbang du gsungs/ /kun gyi tha mar mngon spyod la/ /mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyu yis/ /bsgoms pasalha rnams 'gugs par bya/ /zhes lung ba ltar bgrad zhing sngags kyang / /lo chen be+e ros/ rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags/ bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags/ bzlas pa las rim mam bsnyen pa'i sngags/ /'phrin las tshogs kyi sngags/ kha bsgyur sham bu'i sngags te lnga tsam gsungs pa'i nang nas gtso bo'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa yum dang 'khor sngags rnams la bsnyen par mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la phyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la 'phro 'du/ nang bdag nyid kyi thugs ka la 'khor ba'i bzlas pa/ gsang ba yab yum gyi zhal nas zhal mkha' nas mkhar 'khor ba'i bzlas pa/ yang gsang de kho na nyid lha sngags dbyer med kyi tshul du bzla ba ste bzhi'i dang po ni/ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /— 199

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (27)zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa'i don dngos grub myur stsol las/ rang gi thugs gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ zhes pa nas bzung / mtsho la ser chen babs pa bzhin du rang la chams kyis thim pasasku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam gyi bar yin la/ las dang po ba dang blo chung ba'i rigs la dmigs pa 'di kho nas 'grub cing blos 'chun na phyi'i bsnyen pa 'di la'ang bsnyen pa nye bsnyen/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po ste bzhin yod pa'i bsnyen pa (10ba)rgyal ba sras bcas mchod pa dang sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba sogs la 'od zer dkar po gser gyi ba thag 'dzings pa lta bu/ nye bsnyen la 'od zer dkar ser mgal me klad la bskor ba lta bus rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub bsdu ba/sgrub pa la 'od zer dmar po mgar gyi lam nas tsha cha 'phro ba lta bus gong ltar bsdu ba/ sgrub pa chen por 'od zer nag po mtsho la char 'babs pa lta bus bsdu ba rnams kyi spro bsdu yang ba spu'i bu ga nas byas te gnas gsum du bstim/ nang gi bsnyen pa ni/ thugs ga'i sngags 'khor la semasang zhug bang pa bzhin du dmigs pa bstad nas yig 'bru klog pa lta bu'i ngang nas bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ sgrub pa/sgrub pa chen po rnams kyi 'od zer 'phro 'du snying ga nas 'phro zhing bsdu/ gsang ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal brgyad pad+ma nas rdo rje'i lam du mgal me ltar 'khor ba'i ngang nas gong gi bsnyen pa nye bsnyen sogs bzhi po gang dang 'dab ma 'phro 'du'i gnas sbyor mtshams nas byed/ de kho na nyid kyi bsnyen pa ni/ lha sngags bdag mdun sogs ngo bo dbyer med pa mchod bya mchod byed dang dngosagrub bsdu bya sdu byed dang bral ba blo 'das kyis rtsis zin pa'i rang gis rang la mched pa dang dngos grub len pa las logs su med par thag bcad pa'i ngang nas med bzhin snang ba chu nang gi zla ba ltar bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen sogs kyi 'phro 'du dmigs med kyi klong nas byed pa gsang sngags 'gyur gyi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin par 'gro zhing de tsam blo yul du mi 'char ba'i rigs la bsgom bya bsgom byed thams (11na7da dmigs med stong cham me ba'i ngang nas bzlas kyang rung ngo / /'di dag gi skabs sangs rgyas sras bcas mchod pa dang dngos grub bsdu ba bdag bskyed tsam la brten na rang bzhin gyi gnas su bzhugs pa rnams la dmigs pa gtod na'ang sgrub pa dang 'brel phyin —200

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganarig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis/ nges don bde 'jug tu/ de'ang chos 'di'i lugs kyi bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams chig chod du sgrub pa yin la/ de tsam blos ma lcogs pa 'dzab khong mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dbye ba'i gnad shes dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dzab bzla khar phaṭa dzaḥ zhes bdag mdun tha mi dad pa las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du phyi nas me ri 'dab 'byar du bsgom/ gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len dang ldan tshe 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems nyid kyi rnam 'phrul las ma 'das pas 'og min sogs dag zhing dang sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams 'dzab khang mdun gyi lha tshogs las logs su med par thag chod pas gong du smos pa'i dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du rnams 'dzab khang gi lha tshogs kho nar bgyis pas chog la/ de tsam blos mi lcogs na dag zhing gi rten brten pa zhig logs su yod pa ltar blos bcos nas bdag bskyed nas mdun bskyed la 'phros/ /de las kyang rang bzhin gyi gnas su spros te bdag mdun gnyis skar dngos grub bsdu ba sogs mi 'thad pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du yum dang 'khor brgyad po so so'i thugs gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i sa bon dang 'dab ma brgyad la sngags (11ba)kyis bskor bar dmigs nas ting nge 'dzin rgyas pa'am bsdu na dngos grub myur stsol nas bshad pa kho nas 'grub cing gtso bo las cha shas te 'phri lugs rig pas dpyad nas bzla/ pad+ma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog sogs kyi 'dzab bstod/ dbyangs gsal zhabs btags ma dang snang ba mtha' yas kyi yig brgya ci rigs brjod nas nyams chags bshags/ /'dzab khang gi lhar dmigs nas badz+ra kro ta sam ya sto lho khya zhes me tog 'thor/khro rgyal dbang chen rta mchog dpal sogs dngos grub bsdu sngags nyer gcig tsam gyi mthar len sngags brjod pas 'dzab khang gi lha'i gnas lnga las yig 'bru 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'ja' tshon lta bu thon nas rang gi gnas lngar thim pas dngos grub ma lus thob par mos/ hrīḥdzaḥ zhes 'dzab khang tshur bstim pas bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsam/ bsnyen sgrub kyi dus bar chad kyi mtshan ma gzhil ba'i slad du sngags kyi dar btags te tshar gcod pa ni/ dngos grub myur stsol las/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas khro chung dmar nag ces pa nas/ bder gshegs gces dril gyi sngags zab mo —201 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pornams thun mtshams su brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig yan bzla bar bya'i bar/ lhag chad kha 'geng ba dang byin rlabs brtan pa'i phyir snang ba mtha' yas kyi yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa kha gsos nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus byed/ ha ya shrī ba smyuḥ gab/ sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas lus bsrung /gung thun la 'byung ba cha mnyam pa'i ched du nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi tshe 'od gsal gyi bar bsdus nas ka dag gi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs ldang bar 'dod pas de'i ngang las rang nyid (12na)skad cig gis dpal gyi skur langs te las byang gyer zhing bsnyen pa gtang rag mchod bstod nye bsdu'i bar srod thun ji lta bas mtshon te g.yin la'ang rigs 'gre/ nyin mo'i thun sgang la rang dbang ma 'dus par khams gseng ba lta bur/ rang dpal gyi thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du thon la spyod lam bya zhing nang du 'jug pa na sngar gyi de la thim par bsam mo/ /'di rigs kyi zhib cha 'ga' zhig la rnying ma ba la las gsar ma nas rgyas bkab snyam pa'i log rtog skye srid mod/ 'phreng 'go gter ston gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar thig par/ 'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyi gsung drangs par/ kho bo'i rdo rje slob dpon mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che de'i mkhyen rab la mtha' med/ de'i bka' las rnying ma lugs mthun zhig byed na gsang sngags snga 'gyur rang gi bstan pa'i babs la bka' gter zung zhig gces/ bka' ma ni mdo sgyu sems gsum la bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi'i sgo nas bshad rgyud rnam par dag pa 'dug pa bzhin bshad pa lag len dang bcas pa bka' ma ltar byed dgos/ chos kyi zab gnad rnams ni brgyud pa dang chos la sel med pas mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs chil le ba de gter ma yin pas gter chos tshad ldan ltar byed dgos/ de ltar byas na rnying ma ba lugs dang mthun pa zhig yong phebs byung bas khyed rang yang nyan 'dod na kho bos de rnams bshad chog /brjed gso tsam du yang 'gro/ zhes pa ltar sngags 'chang mkhyen rab can mtha' dag bka' gter gnyis ga'i dgongs pa len cing sgyu 'phrul sogs bka' ma'i rgyud mang dag cig gsang sngags gsar ma dang cha (12ba)mthun pa'i khog che/ gter mar dngos grub gsal ba rnams kyang brgyud dang man ngag bla ma'i phyag bzhes la brten nas 'khrugs sdeb dang kha 'gengs dgos pa bde 'dus dang mgon po 'bar ma'i dbang chog la mkha' klong yangs pas chog bsgrigs mdzad pa —2()2

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganalta bu yin na'ang la la dag gter kha 'ga' zhig tu gsal ma gsal yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nges kyi pha mes kyi dus 'di kho na ltar yin zhes a tir phug pa'i rdzong btsan 'dzin mod gter kha 'og ma'i phur pa spu gri dang byang gter thugs rje chen po'i dbang chog gi stod cha mi gsal ba rjes 'brangs 'dras shog ser gyi dri ma kha chil li ba byed ces mgo med mjug sdum de ga bskur zhing bu slob rnams kyang smin ma gzengs mtho'i brtul zhugs de gar gnas rung / khrus khang lo tsā bas phur pa spu grir legs bshad kyi yig 'jog dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang chog gi kha mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis bkang ba sogs la sngags 'chang dbu zlum dang dbu ral can thams cad thal mo sbyor ba rigs so/ /dus kyi bsnyen pa rab lo/ 'bring zla ba drug /tha ma zla ba gsum/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa gtso bo la 'bum phrag bcu bzhi/ yum la dgu /'khor rnams la gtso bo'i phyed cha bzla/ las rung tsam la gtso bor bzhi 'bum mdzad pa'ang yod/ rtags kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ gsang rgyud las/ sku nyid dngos su mthong ba'am/slob dpon nyi zla mgal me 'char/ nye bsnyen la/ sgrub rdzas me 'bar 'od 'phro zhing / /sgrub khang g.yo 'gul sgra chen 'byung / /rang nyid khro rgyal sku ru gyur/ /snang srid me tog dmar pos khengs/ /sgrub pa la/ (13na)pad+ma'i sdong por bdag 'dug dang / /snang srid me tog pad+ma khengs/ /nyams su myong la zhe 'dod med/ /rang yid ches la khar mi 'don/ /brjod med bsam med don de rtog /sgrub chen la/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig chos nyan pa/ /phyi yi rtags ni rmi lam dang / /nang rtags nyams su 'byung ba yin/ /gsang ba'i rtags ni dngos su mthong / /zhes pa'i mtshan ma bzang po rnyed na dus dang grangs la ma bltos la/ bzla lugs la/ rngam glog las/ bzlas brjod sngags kyi brtul zhugs kyang / /sgra cher ma yin chung bar min/ /mgyogs par ma yin bul ba min/ /drag par ma yin dal bar min/ /yig 'bru yan lag nyams par min/ /yengs dang g.yel sogs chod ma yin/ /rgyu yi sems dpa' yengasapa dang / /bzlas pa'i skyon bcu spangs nas ni/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma yi/ /bsnyen pa rdzogasapar rab tu gces/ /zhes bzlas pa'i skyon bcu spong bar gal che zhing bsnyen sgrub spyi'i dam tshig rnams la'ang spang blang zhib tu bya'o/ /las sbyor gyi mnan pa sreg zor gang rung bya bar spro na rgyud dang las tshogs las shes par bya/—203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegasum pa mjug dngos grub blang ba ni/ gza' tshes legs pa'i snga dro'i char/ /lo chen snang mdzad kyis/ mchog thod gling lnga kha phye la/ /mdun du dpal chen gtso 'khor bskyed/ /bshags pa mchod pa byas nas su/ /ā+oṃ las dpag med ā+oṃ byung nas/ /bdud rtsi spyi bor thim pa las/ /sku yi dngos grub thob par bsam/ /ril bu lnga bza' dngos grub blang / /ā+oṃ pad+ma (13ba)kro dha kā ya sirnyi a la la ho/ āḥ& gsung thugs gong gi 'gre/ /lha ka tsit+ta rim pas spel/ /mchod bstod byas la tshogs la ril/ /lhag ma kha chus bstan ma bskyang / /bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis brjod/ /tsit+ta rang gi rked la bcang / /chang gis gling lnga yig 'bru rnams/ /dag par bkrus pa'i khu ba de/ /ma nyams rang gisalegs par 'thung / /rdul tshon rang gi lus la byung / /gling lnga gtums pa'i dar la ni/ /bdud rtsi ril bu gtums nas kyang / /dar sna lnga yis kha bcings la/ /nyin re bzhin du rtag par bza'/ /zhes pa ltar sgrub thod zhal phye 'dzab khang gi lha tshogs rnams la ye shes sku mchog ma dang yig brgya sogs kyi bshags pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod bstod rgyas par 'bul/ me tog gtor zhing dngos grub bskul tshig brjod/ lha rnams kyi dpral ba nas ā+oṃ byung ba sogs kyi ting 'dzin dang ril bu bza' zhing sngags sbyor/ de bzhin du gsung dang thugs la'ang sbyar zhing dngos su mi gsal yang gu ṇa dang ga rma sngags kyis kha bsgyur nas yon tan 'phrin las kyang blangs na legs sam snyam/ dngos grub thob pa'i gtang rag tu mchod bstod bya/ thod pa'i sgrub rten med na/ tshe gal/ zla khrom/ zla rgyas/ mthun/ 'jam des/ mo sa/ dza gad/ 'dzag ti/ kun tu rgyu/ spang na skyes/ si thog sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams tshang bar bsham/ dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags brgya rtsa bzla zhing dpal gtor la dmigs nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub gong ltar len zhing rdzas rnams la rol/ tsho gis 'khor dang bka' srung gi tshogs la gtang rag rgyas(14na)par dbul/ tsit+ta lus la 'chang zhing ka pā la'i yig 'bru ma da nasabakrus nas 'thung ba dang ril bu dar gyis gtums te 'dogs pa sogs kyang gzhung bzhin dang gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ yig brgya brjod cing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dkyil 'khor sogs rten yod rnams la brtan bzhugs dang rten med kyi tsho gos gshegs/ smon lam dang shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ rgyal wo la gto rag gtong zhing mtho 'grol/ /mtshams phyi nang gi 'grol —204

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo/ nang ma rtoganalugs lag len dkyus ltar dang / kha skong gi sbyin sreg bsnyen pa'i bcu cha dgos pa mkhas grub rnams kyi gzhung las 'byung ngo / /dus gsum sangs rgyas pa rlu ka ra dang / /drag sngags grub pa snang mdzad lo tsā ba'i/ /srol 'dzin 'dar phyar lugs kyi rta mgrin zhes/ /gsar rnying kun la snyan gyi bu ram mngar/ /'on te rgyas bkab rang bzo'i 'dra bcos mkhan/ /'phyon ma'i zlos gar bsgyur ba mtha' klas kyang / /smin grol gdams pa'i 'phrang la bcur ba na/ /rngul chu'i thigs pa 'gram par 'phyang ba mang / /rus chen pha mes rdo ba lag brgyud dang / /dgon gog grwa btsun tshig gi 'khar ba la/ /brten nas yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor du/ /rlom rnams 'jam po'i stan la ci bder nyol/ /lam 'di'i grub brnyes rigs su ma son kyang / /bka' gter rgyud 'grel man ngag la goms shing / khyad par dam pa'i zhal bcud snying dbus su/ /sim pas smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho/ /ches dkar bskrun pa'i bsod nams nyi ma'i lus/ /brgya phrag 'bar ba'i gzi yis yid srubs kyi/ /smag rum pha mthar byas nas bstan dang 'gro'i/ /bde skyid snang bas khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig rin chen dbang gi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni tong khun mi lhag rgyal po'i gdung las byang bdag chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i zlos gar bya nag gi rigs su bltams pa blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis bskul ba dang nye char mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis shin tu gsal zhing mtha' chod pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar rigs kun khyab bdag zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' drin las chos skor rnams rdzogs par thos shing rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba mgon po'i mtshan can gyi byin rlabs dang gsung gi bdud rtsi snying gi za ma tog tu 'khyil ba'i za hor gyi sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis dmar ser can gyi lo glu dbyangs kyi zla ba'i gral tshes la rang byung 'phas sa pa'i gzhal med khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa'o// //sarba maṅga lo// //—205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po༄༅༅/ /pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub bsnyen la nye ba mkho ba'i dngos grub len chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal bzhugs so/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma khrag 'thung dpal gyi lha/ /dbyer med zhabs la gus pas legs btud nas/ /dngos grub len pa'i cho ga man ngag gis/ /rnam par brgyan nas go bde gsal bar bshad/ /de yang pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub chen dang bsnyen pa la nye bar mkho ba'i dngos grub len pa'i rim pa la/las byang rgyas par gtong zhing tshogs byed par spro na tha ma'i bar dkyus bzhin btang / dngos grub dngosal bsham pa/ mtshams bcad pa/ sgrub rten gsal btab nas byin 'bebs pa/ dngos grub bsdu ba/lha gnad la dbab pa/ bshags mchod/ dngos grub len pa dang bdun/ dang po ni/ slob dpon be+e ro tsa nas mchog thod gling lnga kha phye la/ /mdun du dpal chen gtso 'khor bskyed ces pa/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang thog ma nas dbyer med yin pas sngar yang gsal 'debs kyi tshul du gsal btab nas bshags pa mchod bstod byed par gsungs pas/ mchog thod gri snying ril bu sogs dar dmar gyis gtums pa de zhal phye bsdu na 'di tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas par spro na tshe/ gal/ zla khrom/zla rgyas/ thun/ (2na 'jam des/ mi sa/ dza gad/ dzā ti/ kun tu rgyu/ spang na skyes/ si thog sogs mdor na dngos grub kyi rdzas la 'os pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs ci 'byor pa dang / chu gnyis nyer spyod/ sman rag gter gsum gsar pa'am rnying pa kha gso/ khrag chang gzed zhal dang bcas pa nga pa nam/gnyis pa mtshams gcod las byang ltar/ gsum pa sgrub rten gsal gdab byin 'bebs pa ni/ 'dzab bskang gong nas dbye zin pa slar gsal 'debs skyor dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas dang dngos grub kyi rdzas thams cad la las byang ltar byin 'bebs/ bzhi pa dngos grub bsdu ba ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i —206

pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub bsnyen la nye bar mkho ba'i yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ nang ma rtoganabyin rlabs thams cad lha sngags phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dang 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud lha dang mi la sogs pa rnams kyi tshe dpal bsod nams yon tan thams cad bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'dod yon lnga bkra shis rtags rdzas la sogs pa'i rnam par byon nas mdun bskyed kyi rten dang sgrub rdzas dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams la thim par bsams la/ oṃ paṅgān+ta kṛ ta pad+me (2ba〉zhu ri ma hā kro dha ha ya gi ba ma ma trag mo dun ti hri lha hūṃ dza/ nyer gcig bzlas rjes/ ā+oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sirnyi a la la ho zhes pa brgya rtsa 'dren/ gong dang sbrel nas sarba sirnyi pa la/ ma hā sirnyi ā yu ba ri/ da na mi di sirnyi zhes ci rigs bzla/ lnga pa lha gnad la dbab pa ni/ hūṃ/ pad+ma dbang chen lha tshogs dbyings nas gshegs/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gnas 'dir mi gshegs dngos grub ma ster na/ /thugs bskyed nyams shing dam tshig 'gal bar mchis rtsa sngags mjug tu sa ma ya dza/ sa ma ya sto/ drug pa bshags mchod 'bul ba ni/ ye shes sku mchog ma dang yig brgyas nongs pa gsol/ /hrīḥ bdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra nas rak+ta'i bar las byang ltar/ de nasa3 ring lan gsum dang bcas te rak+ta 'phyar/ hūṃ/ pad+ma dbang chen lha tshogasarnams/ /dang por skyabs mgon ye shes lha/ /bar du sgrubs pas yi dam lha/ /da lta gnyis med chosakyi sku/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /mchod pa bzhes la dngos grub stsol/ /sam ya lho sam ya sto/ rtsa sngags mjug tu/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi zhes bzla zhing / bzed zhal nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du rak+ta lan gnyis 'bul ba phyag len ltar ro/ /rang la yang / ma da na ya mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes tshig rkang lnga pa dang / ma hā rak+ta'i tshab la/ ma hā pa nyung 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gong bzhin no/ /bdun pa dngos grub len pa dngos ni/ me tog 'thor zhing ḍā dril dang bcas la/ hūṃ/ lhag pa'i ye shes pad+ma dbang gi lha/ /rang bzhin dbyings nas rtsol rtog mi mnga' yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rang bzhin byin rlabs ni/ /nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod kun 'byung ltar/ /dus las mi 'da' thugasarje'i dbang gi lha/ /dus las mi g.yel g.yar dam gcog pa'i ngang / /mi zad rin chen rgyan gyi 'khor lo nas/ /mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /skal ldan rnams la dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /—207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobargyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mi 'dzad gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mngon shes rdzu phrul dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol//kun bzang mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bskul rjes/ dpal lha rdo rje'i sku 'chang pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa/ /sku yi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral ba nas yi ge oṃ dkar po 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang bcas thon rang gi dpral bar thim/ sku'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la/oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya sid+dhi a la la ho/ zhes brjod cing ril bu lnga'am gcig sogs gang 'os za/ de bzhin du gsung āḥ lha ka /thugs hūṃ/ tsit+ta/ yon tan/ swā/ gu ṇa/ 'phrin las/ hā/ ga rma sogs rigs 'gre/ hūṃ/ dgongs shig pad+ma gsung gi lha/ (3ba)rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs/ /dbang gyur thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /dang po bsnyen cing bar du bsgrubs/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs/ /smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud kyang sbyangs/ /zhag dus grangs dang rtags kyang thems/ /ding sang skya rengs dang po'ang shar/ /rdo rje'i nam yang langs la nye/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub rin po che/ /da ni 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ /dpal chen rta mgrin lha tshogs rnams/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /lha dang skal ba mnyam par shog /khrag chang gnyis nas kyang gnas gsum du reg /grub rdzas dang dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams 'grim zhing longs spyod/ 'bad dang rtsol ba sogs dang / slob dpon mched lcam tshogs rnams kyis/ /dngos grub rdzas la longs spyad pas/ /tshe ring nad med bar chad zhi/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub gyur cig /tshogs la rol ba nas bzod gsol gyi bar las byang gi dkyus ltar/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang phur pa bris 'bur gyi sku sogs la brtan par bzhugs/ rdul tshon dang rten med pa rnams la gshegs gsol/ thod sku tshur blangs na ma da nas yig 'bru rnams bkrus nas 'thung / gri snying ril bu dar dmar gyis gtums nas lus la bcang / bsngo ba smon lam/ shis brjod rnams rgyas par bya'o/ /lha sngags ye shes rdzas kyi chu 'dzin las/ /mchog thun dngos grub char chen 'bebs pa'i thabs//rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bzhed srol dbyar gyi rngas/ /skal bzang rma bya dga' (4na tha'i zlos gar —208

pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub bsnyen la nye bar mkho ba'i yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ nang ma rtoganabasgyur/ /pad+ma'i thugs bcud be+e ro'i zhal gyi lung / /dbang chen man ngag ma dang mkha' 'gro yi/ kha rlangs zil dngar 'thul ba'i gzhes med srog /'tsho ba don ldan 'di phyi'i gtan mdun 'grub/ /de phyir 'bad pas rab bskrun bsod nams tshogs/ /mthon po ti se'i yab gcig rab brtsegs las/ /'phrin las zad mi shes pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /byang chen zla ba'i ma mar rtag 'bab shog /ces pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub bsnyen la nye bar 'kho ba'i dngos grub len pa'i cho ga yid bzhin dbang rgyal 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bsnyen chen btang tshe bskul ba ltar za hor gyi sngags btsun che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis lcags bya spre zla'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la rgyal khab dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bris pa sirnyi pra la/ //sarba maṅga le// //—209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ger༅༅/ /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i sbyin sreg gi chog sgrigs ye shes snang ba rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs rbesna/ /na mo ma hā wa she pad+ma he ru kā ya/ srid gsum zil gnon mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / /drag sngags bka' babs lo chen rnam snang mdzad/ /gdams pa'i srol 'dzin 'dar 'phyar mus srad pa/ /tshar chen yab sras 'khas rdul gtsug na bsnyen/ /dang ba'i chu gter 'phel byed bka' drin zla/ /rtag tu yid mkhar 'char ba gnas gsar rje/ /kun mkhyen zur chen khyab bdag bla ma gnyis/ /zung 'jug mngon gyur de srid skyabs kyi phul/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug yang gsang lha/ /bsnyen sgrub gsang sngags rta skad nga ro'i sgra/ /dngos grub 'bras 'byin kha skong sbyin sreg khrigs/ /skad gnyis smra ba be+e ro'i gzhung bzhin 'dri/ /de yang slob dpon chen po pad+mas mdzad pa'i sreg byang dang / de'i dgongs don ltar bkral ba'i yi ge phal cher dbang drag la sbyar ba shas che yang / bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg sbas pa mig 'byed kyi dngos grub sdud pa'i dgongs don gsal bar bkod pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ zhi ba'i las la shis pa'i gza' skar dus sbyor bzang po'i tshe/ /sa ma dul ba'i rigs la sa'i cho ga (2na)dang / gnas khang rnying par cha gsum dang / gser skyems kyis sde brgyad cha snyoms/mtshams ma grol ba'i mtho khongs su byed na de dag thams cad btang snyoms su bzhag gnas khang byi dor byas shing bdud rtsi dang ba byung lngas skyang nul bya/ de'i steng bkra shis pa'i sa la stegs bu gru bzhi pa logs re la mda' gang dang dpangs phyag gang pa/ de'i steng du thab khung ni/ dngos grub sdud pa las/ las bzhi bsgrub pa'i thab khung la/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i rim pa yi/ /rgyar ni khru gang mtho —210

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg snang ba rab 'bar/ nang ma khoganagang dang / /mtheb mdzub mkhyid gang dpangs su bya/ /gting na gru gsum zla gam gsum/ /zlum po gru bzhi sor mo res/ /rim pa bzhin du mtho bar bya/ /bshad bzhin ma 'byor shug pa la/ khru gang mtho gang dpangs kyi tshad/ ces byung ba ltar tshangs zur gyi thig btab pa'i lte ba nas mtho gang bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum zla gam/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa chos 'byung gi lte bar lha mtshan gyi pad+ma dang / rtsibs la rdo rje dbang chen sogs dang / rtsibs phyi'i khyams kyi mu khyud la lcags kyu (2ba〉〈gas sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan nam yang na sa bon/ bsdu na tshon spungs tsam gyis kyang rung / phyi rol tu kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi re bskor ba'i mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i phyed dang bcas pa bri/ de'i steng du shug pa'am 'o ma can gyi shing gis rung mod/ 'on kyang bzo dbyibs bde ba'i dbang du byas na nags kyi lci ba skam po srog chags med pa las grub pa'i thab rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed par sa dkar ram 'bras dkar gyi khu bas kha bsgyur/ shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig gi me tshang bca'/ rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol gyi logs la dkar rtsi byugs par gangs ri dang waṃ yig 'dri ba'am/ yang na gangs ri las 'ongs pa'i chu dngos bstan snod du blug pa bzhag kyang rung / gong du bshad pa'i shing gi rgyu las grub pa'i yaṃ shing srog chags kyis ma zos ma rul ba sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad kyi rtsa rtser mar dkar/ 'o ma/ sbrang rtsi/ bdud rtsi/ dri zhim pa'i chu rnams kyis sbags pa/ bsreg pa'i rdzas ni 'di lta ste/ til dang me tog a khru ta/ /byi tang 'bras bu khu byug rtswa/ /ru rta shu dag rgya spos dang / /bri ya du dang lan tshwa dang / /pad+ma ge sar nā ga pus/ /zhib btags dkar dang ra dug gi sbrus/ /ji tsam bsres pa ril bu bya/ /mngar gsum bskus pa'i me tog dang / /mar khu rang gis ci 'byor ba/ /zhes pa'i rdzas rnams btab pa'i me srog 'dzin pa'i mar khu/ rdzas de rnams la ril bur byas pa'i sreg rdzas grangs ji tsam 'os pa ma gtogs/ rdzas chen bcu gnyis dang / nyer lnga sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba rnams dgos pa'i nges pa med pas chad (3na/lhag tu yang mi 'gyur/ khyad par rdzas gu gul dkar po/ tsan dan dkar po/ du rba/ bri ya du/ thang chu/ 'bras —211—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geyos/ tsam pa ka rnams zhi kha mor btags pa'i khu bas gong gi rdzas rnams sbags/ 'dod gsol shing byang byas kyang chog /g.yas phyogs su stan dkar po'i steng du shel lam dngul sogs rin po che dang khams dkar po'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du 'das ma 'das la mang nyung gi khyad par dang bcas te sbreng tshar du bkod/ phyi lnga nang gsum mchod pa bshams/ /zhes pa ltar/ g.yon phyogs su stan dkar po'i steng du rang rdzas bsres pa'i 'das ma 'das so sor phyi mchod lnga/ nang gi sman raka gtor gsum/mdun du nang mchod/ ḍā ma sa rdo rje/ dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ dril bu/ rak+ta/ me tog /ku sha brgyad/spor lde/ rlung g.yab ri mo can/ so rtsi/ gos zung / las bum sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnamasabakod pas mdzes par byas/ de nas sgrub pa po rnams dri zhim po'i chus lus bkrus/ gar chas dngos sam/ ma 'byor na thor tshugs/ stod g.yogs/ smad g.yogs rnams dkar por bya/ stan bde ba lasapad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis kha shar phyogs la bltas pa'i ngag bcad/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ las byang gi gzhung bsrangs/ tsho gos tha ma yan gtong ba'am/ de'i sngon du btang zin kyang mi 'gal/ rdor dril dang / rnga byin rlabs byed par spro na bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs ltar dang / ma byas kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur/ gzar bu gnyis brlab pa ni/ (3ba)rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shesalha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi tshul du bkug ste gzar bu gnyis la thim/ de zhu ba hūṃ las blugs gzar rdo rje dang a las dgang gzar dril bu'i rnam pa can yongs su gyur pa las dbang chen dmar nag be con dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ pad+ma gar dbang mthing nag tsit+ta dang dung khrag 'dzin pa dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu nas blugs gzar dang dgang gzar gyi rnam par bsam/ las bum bsgrub pa ni dbang chu bde chen myu gu ltar byed/ mchod pa sman gtor rak+ta brlab pa las byang ltar bya/ sreg rdzas 'bru gsum byin rlabs bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ g.yasaskor gyis bsang chu dang/ sman phud nas kyang gtor te/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las nyi zla'i gzhong pa ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les —212

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i khoskong sbyin sreg snang ba rab 'bar/ nang ma rtoganabargyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i zeg zas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi zhi ba'i las rab 'byams ma lus pa bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la phyag rgya dang bcas rdzas rnams bkrus par mos te ā+oṃ ā+oṃ swāhā/ yaṃ shing la ā+oṃ āḥswāhā/mar la ā+oṃ shrī swāhā/ 'bru la ā+oṃ dzi swāhā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la ā+oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes nus ldan bdud rtsir brlab/ me bsgrub pa ni/bram ze rgyun bzhag gi me lta bu las sbar ba'i dpal 'bar thal lo kha sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste lan gsum g.yas su bskor ba dang mnyam du bsnyen (4na)sngags bzla zhing / ting lo spar ba dang bcas/ā+oṃ asne raṃ dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ thab bsangs me sbar me srog gzung / /thugs ka'i sgyilas re chad de/ /raṃ las me lha dmar ser ni/ /ra zhen me ngar lcags kyu thogs/ asne dzaḥ/ baṃ ho yis/ /dgug gzhug gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgya yis btab/ /ces pa ltar/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po rgyar gru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba zlum por bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi thugs ga'i saḥlas raṃ yig cig chad pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha dkar po ra skyes la zhen pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas me dar dang g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sma ra ag tshom dang tshangs pa'i skud pa 'chang ba/ sku las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/ snyan gsan ni/ ho/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong khyed sngon lha'i dbang du sbyin sreg mdzad 'tshal te deng bdag cag gi nad gdon bar chad dang / sngags kyi chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi ba'i slad du sbyin sreg gi mchod pa la spyan 'dren/ mchod pa 'bul lags na thugs rje dang dam tshig gi —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po(4bskobang gis 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra sam ya dzaḥ me dar ram rlung g.yab dang bcas nas/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ /— ye de ba raṃ ṣa dziḥdziḥ zhes brjod pas me lha 'khor bcas ri rab kyi me mtshams nas byon pa dam tshig pa la dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bsam/ pad+ma ka ma la ye rto zhes gdan dbul/ lha tsho gos rnams kyi spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par bsam/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ me gso phyir rtswa skam cung zad bcug blugs gzar gsum blug cing rlung dar g.yab/ me pra brtag la lta bas rgyas thebs na ngan pa 'chos mi dgos kyang /gzhan du kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi cho ga byed/ phyi lnga nang gsum brgyad du 'bul/ sreg pa'i rdzas kyang bdun du dbul/ /rtsi thog mar kyang thengs gsum 'bul/ /me lha zhu nas me ru 'bar/ /zhes pa ltar/hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /zhi ba'i don la dam tshig dgongs/ /gzi brjid che zhing thugs rjer ldan/ /bdag cag gus pas khyed phyag 'tshal/ /ā+oṃ asna ye de ba ṛ ṣi a ti pu sngom byu sngos phyag bya/ hūṃ/ bdug spos snang (5na skos la zhugs tag sgra/ /zhal zas dri chab gtsang ma 'di/ /me lha drang srong 'khor bcas la/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ asna ye de wa ṛ ṣi badz+ra/ pe pā dza hūṃ nas/ sha lta pā dza hūṃ gi bar dang / sngags mjug tu sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā bha kla ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sngags mthug tu gha na tsakra pā dza khā hi/ ku sha lag g.yon du bzung ste bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasa3 las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa zhi ba'i las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po —214

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg snang bar ba 'bar/ nang ma rtoganamachog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dge byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dge byed yin/ /'di yis bdag la gegs med cing / /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /badz+ra sa twa a/ zhes ku sha rnams rtse mo g.yasaskor du rim pa bzhin rtsa bas rtse mo mnan la dgram/ byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ dang dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ yig gis mtshan par mos nas/ ā+oṃ asna ye swāhā zhes brjod cing / blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la pusamo'i khongs las lag pa gnyis mi 'da' ba'i rdo rje khu tshur ram byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar zhing g.yas su bskor te/ ā+oṃ asna ye di bya di bya bi shu khye shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag (5ba〉she nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul zhing bla bre brtag /'dir bsnyen pa kha skong gi spel tshig bkod pa yin la/ las ga' na bsgrub na kha sgyur lugs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar byed/ me lha'i thugs nas 'od los pas/ /bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun dud khu dang / /rnag khrag srog chags gzugs brnyan tshul/ /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /phyir thon sreg rdzas rnams la thim/ /zhes brjod/ hūṃ/ drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la/ /rdzas chen sna tsho gis sreg rdzas 'bul/ /tshe dpal bsod nams stobs 'byor dang / /lung rtogs chosasrid legs tshogis la/ /bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs dgra /gtad sel mnan dbye thod gtong byed/ /dbul phongs nad rims dus min 'chi/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung ji snyed pa/ /ma lus byang zhing dag 'gyur ba'i/ /zhi ba'i 'phrin las dus la babs/ /zhes brjod de g.yon pas sreg rdzas kyi snod bzung g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ 'og nas bskor zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas yam shing ni/ ā+oṃ asna ye badz+ra dz+nyā ya bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang gzi brdzid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa sogs nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+ti ku ru swāhā/ ༷ la/ drang srong wo pos sngon ho ma bstar ba'i/ /ting 'dzin dbang sgyur —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gezhal zas bdud rtsi 'di/ /dag cing gtsang mar bshams pa 'bul lags kyis/ /ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ asna ye (6na8 wa ha bya ka bya ti u ma hā ba ya bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes spel tshig thog mtha' gnyis su ci rigs dang rdzas sngags rkyang pas bdun nam bcu bzhi nyer gcig sogs skabs sbyar dbul/ shing byang byed par spro na g.yin nas len/ hūṃ/ sreg rdzas mchode pas me yi lha/ /mnyes te sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /bsgrub bya'i snying gar phog pa yis/ /slar yang sgo gsum sdig sgrib bsregs/ /'od zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ltar/ /sbagasapas nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams rab bkrus te/ /bshang gci'i lam nas thon par gyur/ /zhes brjod/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas rigs kyi sprul pa mchog /me yi lha ni snang mtha' yas/ /me yi lha mo gos dkar mo/ /rgyal bas kun gyi 'od mchog te/ /'byung ba me la dbang sgyur cig /thams cad kun gyi srog bdag yin/ /srid gsum bsreg par zhal gyis bzhes/ /'khor ba bsreg pa'i 'phrin las la/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis yongs mi 'da'/ /me yi las gnyer gtad bya'i phyir/ /me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes bstod de/ me lha drang srong gi rgyal po khyod la 'phrin las su gzhol ba ni/ sngon thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du me 'bar ba dang gnyis su med par bzhugs nas sbyin sreg gi zhal zas rnams khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du gnas ston par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing / blugs gzar gsum dbul/ me lha 'od (6ba)du zhu nas me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ de klong dbang chen dkyil 'khor ni/ /snying po tsam gyi chu sbur tshul/ /dbang bskur spyan drangs phyag rgyas bstim/ /zhes pa'i don me 'bar ba'i dbus su rten brten pa'i sa bon dang snying po brjod pa tsam gyis chu las chu lhar rdol ba'i tshul du bskyed par bshad pa bzhin byas pas chog mod/ 'on kyang las byang gzhung bzhin byas pas 'jug pa bde zhing gsal 'debs kyi rkyen du 'gyur bas/ ye shes me dpung rab —216

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha stong sbyin sreg snang ba rab 'bar/ nang ma rtoganatu 'bar ba'i dbus/ rgyu las thod pa rin chen gzhal yas khang / zhes pa nas/ khrag 'thung rigs lngas dbu yi rgyan du rdzogs/ zhes pa'i bar la gdan steng rgyu ting hūṃ yig babs pa las/ zhes pa dor ba'i rang nyid dpal li zhes pa rang nyid dpal wo du bsgyur/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥ& baṃ nyonas/ dur khrod chas brgyan me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /kyi bar song nas/ gtso 'khor kun kyang sku mdog rtsa ba'i zhal/ /rab dkar zhi ma khro yi 'dzum mdangs can/ /dkar la 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba yi/ /zhi ba'i las kun mdzad pa'i rnam par gyur/ /hrīḥ ye nas ka dag chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ /zhes pa nas/ dzaḥ& baṃ sngos ma ya / gyi bar brjod/ bskyed sngags mchod pas mtha' bsgyur nas/ /phyi lnga nang gsum nyer gcig bgrang / /rdzas re sngags res dbul bar bya/ /zhes dang / rigs bzhi sgo ma bzhi rnams la/ /mchod pa sreg rdzas bdun bdun dbul/ /zhes pa ltar/ saḥ bdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra/ /zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang / /pad+ma (7na ji bang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya sgyi wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra dhū paṃ pā dza me gha sa mu dra skra ra ṇa sam ye āḥ// nas badz+ra sha lta'i bar gyis phyi mchod lnga/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /nas/ ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi'i bar/ gyi khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa mchog /nas/ sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /ma hā bha kla ta kha raṃ ji hi/ 3khu sna tsho gos khrag gi mtsho 'khyil ba'i/ /nas/ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi'i bar rnams kyis nang gi mchod pa gsum/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ /'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /bcom ldan 'das dbang chen pad+ma lha tshogs la/ /gus pas 'bul lo zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya sgyi wa ga ṇa tsakra pā dza khā hi/byon zan ni/ ye shes pa'i lha tsho gos rnams kyi zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ dang / dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ yig gis mtshan par bsams la/ phyag rgya sogs sngar ji lta bas ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya sgyi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa tshar bdun brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar 'geng ba sogs me lha'i skabs ltar byas te oṃ byu ye di bya di bya nas shān+ti ku ru —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geswāhā'i bar gyis sngar bzhin lan gsum 'bul/ 'das lha'i thugs nas 'od 'phros pas/ /sogasabarjod/ saḥ khams gsum za bar byed pa'i rkan sgra can/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad dbang chen lha tshogs la/ /ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du/ /rgyud lnga'i bag chags ma lus bsregs sbyangs (7bskos/ /bdud rtsi sman dang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs/ /dam rdzas gtor ma sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul/ /ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /dam nyams dam skongs mthu dang dngos grub stsol/ /zhes lha so so'i bsnyen sngags brjod pa tsam gyi khyad par las me lha'i skabs ltar dbul zhing / grangs gsog na gtso 'khor gyi khyad par rigs pas dpyod/ bsnyen pa kha skong gi dus yin na/ rdzas chen bcu gnyis kyi tshe rdzas kyi grangs gsog pa til la tshig dril byed pa yin kyang / 'dir de'i tha snyad med pas ril bu rang la byed dgos so/ /sreg rdzas mchode pa ye shes lha/ /zhes sogs brjod/ saḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes pa nas/ yab yum gtso 'khor bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum byon zan ltar dbul/ /dbang chen yang gsang khros pa yab yum dang / /rigs bzhi'i sgo ma dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis la/ /nyer spyod lnga dang sman raka gtor gsum sogs/ /gus pas 'bul gyi brtse bas bzhesasu gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya sgyi wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra zlo pe sogs dang / sarba pañtsa dang / ma hā rak+ta sbyar/ gtor ma las byang ltar brlab/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa mchog /ces sogs gong ltar dang / oṃ badz+ra ta myu la ye swāhās so rtsi dang / ā+oṃ badz+ra wa sta ye swāhās gos zung dbul/ phyi mchod lngas mchode/ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs sgro ka gcig gis bstod/hoḥ na mo dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du/ (sha〉khyom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen 'khor dang bcas pa la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa tshul bzhin du sbyar te phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes te dgyes shing longs spyod par gyur cig /de'i byin rlabs kyis bdag gis kyang chags snang gi sgo nas/ las ngan pa'i bag chags ci bsags pa thams cad dag ste/ bsod nams dang ye —218

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg snang ba rab 'bar/ nang ma rtogadashes kyi tshogs rdzogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi zhal mngon sum du mthong bar gyur cig /de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ yon bdag bsod nams kyis 'dzin zhing / smon lam gyi byed pa rnams kyi 'phrin las su gsol ba ni/ gnas skabs su nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs 'byung po'i gnod pa dang / mthar thug byang chub bsgrub par gegs byed kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag cing / khyad par yang gsang khros pa'i lha tshogs bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi nas 'phrin las thams cad kyi 'bras bu myur du 'byin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis chad lhag kha bkang / rang la dkyil 'khor bsdu/ me lha mchod/ ye shes me lha gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig me lha rang la bsdu/ /thal ba'i dngos grub tshig sngags blangs/ /'byung po lhag ma tshim par bya/ /smon lam btab dang bkra shis brjod/ /thal ba chu yis rgyun la brkyal/ /zhes pa ltar/ā+oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ zhes sogs kyi mjug tu badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su (8ba tshe/zhegs/ /dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsam/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ blugs gzar gang phul bas/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha sngar bzhengs pa la/ bdug spos snang gsal zhugs ga sgra/ /zhes pa nas/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi'i bar brjod/ khyuḥ drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la/ /rdzas chen sna tsho gos sreg rdzas 'bul/ /zhes sogasakyis rdzas rnams sngar ltar dang / gshegs skyems bdun tshar gsum/ so rtsi/ gos zung gtor brlab rnams sngar bzhin bya/ ā+oṃ asna ye de wa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba kla ta pu dza khā hi lan gsum dang /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid 'ong 'dod pa kun grub shog gi bar brjod/gong ltar bstod/ me lha 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor la/ /gnod byed nad gdon dgra bgegs dang / /mthu byad dbul phongs dus min 'chi/ /sdig sgrib nyes nga ma lus pa/ /zhi zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'dod don gsol/ sngar bzhin phyi mchod lngas —219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'amachod/ yig brgya dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis mdzad lags kyi/ /tshim zhing dgyes par mdzad nas kyang / /rang gnasabazang por gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ asna ye de wa ṛ ṣi ya hi ga༈ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa dzaḥ& baṃ sngos rang dang
