gnyis su med par bsam/ gral zlum por bskor zhing srin lag sbrel/ dpal chen thugs kyi (9na po kyil 'khor nas/ /ma rig sha yi phung po la/ /kun mkhyen gsal ba'i bro brdungs pas/ /gti mug mun pa'i tshogs chen bcoms/ /sum bha dang bcas bro brdungs/ thal ba nas cung zad blangs la/ khyoḥ ye shes khro rgyal dbang chen gyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /gnyis med gyur nas brtan pa che/ /kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ lha ska sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes dngos grub blangs/ tshogs lhag /chad mtho/ bstan skyong /mjug chog smon lam shis brjod kyi bar bya/ sbrel nas byed na thal ba nem tsam byas pa'i steng /ong kong brtsigs te cho ga la 'jug /me ma shi'i bar mi bskul zhing rings khyad yod na 'o mas gzhil ba sogs kyang bya/ byin rlabs kyi rdzas su 'jug pa'i thal ba tshags byed rung g.yin chu klung chen por dor/ gnas khang gi gzhi rnams su gad bdar dang chag chag bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de yang gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing / /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byung / /zhes pa ltar/ sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa la sbyin sreg shin tu gal che zhing / bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i man ngag las/bsnyen pa 'bum phrag re re la/ /sbyin sreg khri phrag re re bya/ /zhes bcu cha bya dgos par gsungs shing /bsreg pa'i mtho byang las/ til dang me rtag a skṛ ta/ /rang gi bsod nams bskyed pa yin/ khu byug rtsa yis nor 'phel te/ /byi tang 'bras bus rigs brgyud 'phel/ /ru rta shu dag rgya spos dang / /bri yang ku dang lan tsha dang / /pad+ma ge sar nā ga pus/ /(9ba〉sregs te dud pa rang la bdug /mi yi rgyal po bdag dbang 'gyur/ /dgra kun khros kyang brtse zhing byams/ /bud med kun gyi yid du 'ong / /gcan gzan gdug pa kun kyang byams/ /'dre gdon kun kyang mi gnod bsrung / /zhes rdzas so so'i phan yon —220

pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg snang ba rab 'bar/ nang ma (gdargyas par bshad do/ /e ma pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gtso/ /yang gsang khros pa'i gsang sngags nyer bzlas 'bras/ /dngos su 'byin nus sreg byed cho ga'i rim/ /lo chen gan jag thang ta'i gzhung bzhin bkod/ /phyi 'gyur chog sgrigs dang du ma blangs shing / /snga 'gyur nang gshin tsam la mi re bar/ /rang gzhung tshugs thub smra ba phyogs 'di la/ /cung zad goms pa'i lag rjes mngon sum gsal/ /dge 'dis 'khor rtsa dug lnga'i bud shing tshogs/ /ye shes zhugs kyis bsreg pa bde stong 'od/ /rab 'bar zung 'jug dbang chen kun tu bzang / /tshe 'dir rang ngo 'phrod pa'i skal bzang shog /ces pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i sbyin sreg gi chog sgrigs ye shes snang ba rab 'bar 'di ni zhad sna nam pa chen po'i sprul pa'i zlos gar bya nag gi rigs su gyur pa blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sdes ljags bsnyen skabs rtsoms shig par gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas snga 'gyur spyi bye brag gi rgyud gzhud man ngag la blo gros kyi mig cung zad yangs pa za hor gyi sngags rgan zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis be+e ro'i zhal khrigs dngos grub sdud pa'i dgongs don ltar sa rta nag pa zla ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dmar po ri'i rgyal khab tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sirnyi skul// //sarba maṅga le// //221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge༄gyi/ /dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru tho pa ra ma ha ya snro ba shri ye/ bgrang yas sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /dmod pa drag sngags bka' babs be+e ro'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yongs tshang zur chen rje/ /chos dbyings rang grol zhabs rdul gtsug na bsten/ /pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor kun gyi rtser/ /legs son yang gsang khrag 'thung lha dgu la/ /brten nas dgra bgegs phyer 'thag gtor zor gyi/ /las rim rdo rje pha lam gcig tu mtshar/ /de phyir rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bzhed srol gyi/ /dgongs don ji bzhin 'khrugs sdebs bklags chog tu/ /nye bar 'dri la rtsa gsum lha tsho gis dang / /bka' skyong gter bdag tshogs kyis gnang ba stsol/ /de'ang pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub 'phrin gyi rim pa gter byon mtha' klas pa'i nang nas byin rlabs dang dngos grub kyi tshan kha phul du byung ba yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don du pha ral rig sngags kyi rbod gtong sde brgyad 'byung po'i gdon byad za kha zug pa/ chags che ba/ lha 'dre drag po g.yos pa/ rmi ltas (2na)mtshan ma ngan pa sogs gzugs can dang gzugs med kyi gnod 'tshe bar chad thams cad drag po zor gyi sgo nas bzlog pa'i las rim bya bar 'dod pas thog mar/ pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi spyan sngar smin grol man ngag thams cad legs par nos shing / dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa/ bsnyen sgrub tshad du thengasapa'i sgrub pa pos nyams su bstar ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ /dang po la mngon spyod kyi las sbyor bsgrub pa'i gnas ni/ drag po'i las brtsom gnas btsal ba/ /dur khrod saphug brag phug gam/ /chu klung nags tshal rkang gcig shing / /gnas rengs lha khang gog po sa /gshin rje the brang srin po dang / /klu dang sa bdag gnod sbyin rgyal/ /rim bzhin gnas pa bsgrub par 222

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganabla/ /zhes pa ltar mthun pa'i gnas sam/ /yang na sgrub khang rnying pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan par zor las la nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams tshogs par byas/ drag las la shis pa'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs (2ba)dang bstun/ sa stegs sam zhal ba skyang nul legs par byas/ las byang yongs rdzogs sam dpa' bo rkyang sgrub lta bu'i sgrub thabs rgyas par bsgoms nas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ bzlog dkyil rdul tshon gyis 'dri na/ sa lha nas bzung thig tshon gyi cho ga'i bar rwa chen gyi dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma 'brud byed ltar dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs sam/ bsdu na tshangs zur gyi thig btab pa'i dbus dmar nag gru gsum/ de'i phyi rol na zla gam dmar po gsum/ de'i phyi rol na 'og gzhi nag po thod pa'i phreng ba zlum po dkar po/ phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyogs tshone/ rtsibs mtshan phyogs mdog gam/ mdzes tshoni/ de'i phyi rol tu mu khyud zlum po khrag 'khyams/ de'i phyir rdo ra me ri ma tre mgo lho nub tu blta ba 'dri ba'am/ yang na ras bris kyis rung bas/ thog mar sgrub byang las/ cha gsum bgegs rigs gtor ma btang zhes gsungs pas/ cha gsum sngon du gtong ba ni chos 'di ga'i lugs srol la gsar ma'i rgyas bkab kyi log rtog tu sem mo/ /de nas bzlog dkyil gyi steng du ma sgyu zhi khar lcags slang bug rdol med par dpal gyi gtor ma zur gsum dmar zang nge ba me ri sogs rgyan gyis spras pa zur mdun du bstan pa sum cha gnyis yar bcad pa'i 'og tu/ 'brub khung brus pa'i nang / sbas pa mig 'byed las/ liṅga bca' ba'i rim pa ni/ skra snabs lud pa mchil ma dang / /dri chen dri chu la sogs pa/ khyu drug liṅga sor brgyad bya/ /bgegs la gnod pa'i rdzas dang ni/ /gnod pa'i phyogs nas sa blangs la/ /liṅga sor ni brgyad pa bya/ /gro gar ming rus bla dwags bri/ /(3na)snying dpral lte ba gsang gnas gzhug /pho ris pi pi ling dang sga/ /dug sna rnyed tshad kun gyis byug /ces pa ltar la mthong ba brgyud pa'i man ngag bzhin rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la mgo mjug ldog la gzhug /'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba'i mthar khrag kong mtshe yungs/ rtsang / rgyu lding /sha dzor/ lha rten tsakli/ gtor gdugs sogs rngam zhing brjid chags par byed/ de'i mdun lcagasasnod chung ba zhig tu zor gtor gru gsum me ri khyi mjug ma mtheb skyu yungs dar rtsang gis brgyan pa/de'i phyi rol tu snod rer gtor chung gru gsum bcu re bcug pa'i tshan pa bcus phyogs mtshams bskor/—223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'de dag gi thad kyi phyi rol tu gtor chung re re bshams pa thams cad khrag gis sbags shing mtshe yungs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi g.yas g.yon du khrag zor thod pa mchan ngan du khrag sna dug snas bkang bar/ yungs kar/ skye tshe/ shang tse rnams btab pa/ yungs thun la thod pa mtshan ngan du yungasagar rgyal pos bkang ba/ /drag po'i thun rdzas ni sbas pa mig 'byed las/ dgra bgegs thun gyis bsad pa la/ /rabs chad nag po'i thod pa mā /yungs kar yungs nag skye cha dang / /btsan dug ra dug spyang dug pa/ /re cag rtsa ba dug bzhi tshang / /mi rta khyi phag spyang zhi'i brun/ /mi rus me yis bsregs pa dang / /tsher ma'i rigs gyur tshogs tshad dang / /gcan gzan mche sder tsho gos tshad dang / /zhes bshad pa'i thun rdzas rnams lag len ltar bzos pa rabs chad thod pa'am ma rnyed (3ba)na g.yag 'og can gyi rwa lta bur sdugs/ sman raka gtor gsum/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod/ bka' srung ging lnga gza' gdong / chos skyong beg tse lcam dral/ gzhan yang yul lha gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/tshogs 'khor 'brub khung liṅga/ gser skyems/ chad mtho'i rtsa gsum/ thun gtor/ bgegs gtor/yungs thun/ gu gul/ 'thor nas/ rdor dril/ phur pa sgrol gri/ g.yab dar/ rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad legs par bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sgrub pa po stan bde ba la 'dug ste las byang gi 'dzab la thug gi bar bzlas pa long skabs dang sbyar ba'i rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa gzhung dang man ngag gis brgyan pa'i dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du bya zhing / 'dzab khang dbye ba sogs btang snyoms su bzhag ste bdag mdun me ri 'dab khyar gyi tshul du nyams su bstar/ de nas bzlog pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid dbang chen gsal ba'i thugs ka yi/ /hrīḥlas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs kar 'phog nas rgyud bskul ba spu yi/ /bu ga kun nas khro chung nyi zer gyi/ /rdul ltar sa pas bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod byed pha rol rbod gtong mkhan po dang / /dug mtshon g.yul sogs bsam sbyor ga rtsom pa'i/ /gzugs can dgra dang rbad 'dre lha ma srin/ /sdo brgyad 'byung po spyi dang bye brag sogs/ /lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal gtong / /bsam par bar gcod chags che nyam nga g.yo/ /mdor na 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs brtsom pa'i/ /gzugs med bgegs rnams thal ba'i rdul (4na)—224

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganabazhin rlog /rnam shes bla tshe srog dbugs bcas pa rnams/ /dmigs rten gzugs kyi nya bo 'di nyid la/ /rang dbang med par bkug nas thim par gyur/ /rtsa sngags mjug tu gnod byed ban bon sngags pas btang ba'i mthu byad rbad 'dre dang sde brgyad 'byung po'i gnod pa thams cad a pa na ya bzlog bh+yo/zhes dmigs pa dang bcas ci nus su bzlas/ mthar yungs skar yungs nag dug khrag la phus btab ste bzlog gtor la brab cing bskul/ de nas gtore zor la dmigs te/ rang nyid dbang chen gsal ba'i thugs ka yi/ /hrīḥ las 'od 'phros gtor zor la phog pas/ /dbang chen rol ba'i khro bo skar ltar 'khrug /mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug lta bu mā /'tshub cing 'phros pas bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ gnod byed pha rol rbod gtong mkhan po sogs gong bzhin brjod rjes rtsa sngags sham bur sarba pā paṃ sarba du hri mā ra ya bzlog bzlog bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes ci nus bzlas te sngar bzhin thun gyis brab/ de nas khrag zor la dmigs te/ rang nyid dbang chen thugs ga'i sa bon las/ /'od los khrag zor rdzas la phog pa yis/ /mgar gyi sol mal lcags las zer 'phros ltar/ /dregs pa mo rgyud khro mo phyag gnyis kyis/ /tho ba lcags kyu rab 'dzin lus la me/ /'bar zhing kha nas nad rlangs 'tshub cing 'thul/ /grangs med ri rab bongs tshad me dpung 'bar/ /de las gnam lcags thog mda' char 'bebs pa/ /dgra bgegs yul kun khyab par spros pa yis/ /gzugs phung bla tshe rnam shes yul 'khor dang / /sde (4ba)dpung bcas pa ming tsam brda tsam dang / /tha snyad tsam du mi grag brlag par gyur/ /ces rtsa sngags sham bur ma ma tra ga raka ma tra ru tra snying kha rag thun bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog ces bzlas shing thun brab/ de nas yungs zor la dmigs te/ thugs ga'i gyi las 'od 'phros yungs gar la/ /phog pas dregs pa pho rgyud khro bo'i tshogs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing nyi ther gyi/ /rdul phran lta bur steng du 'phros pa yis/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi thugs dam skong / /'od 'phros ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo bcad/ /dgra bo'i yul song skyob pa'i lha dang phral/ /gzugs phung la brgyab ngan snying dmar po phyung / /nang khrol yan lag dbang po lnga po dang / /rnam par shes pa'i 'bem la brgyab pa yis/ /phyin chad 'khor bar skye ba'i lam bcad de/ /dgra bgegs rjes shul med par brlag par gyur/ /rtsa sngags sham bur shig shig /rdu rdu/ nyil nyil rgyob/ dum bu rul rbad/ dum bu nyal rbad/ ṭaṃ —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po gdan steng na/ /dus gsum dbang sgyur ye shes lha yi lha/ /dbang chen khrag 'thung ha ya gh+ri ba'i sku/ /sku mdog dmar nag dbu gsum phyag drug pa/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum 'gying rngam brjid pa'i sku/ /spyan gsum zhal bgrad dbang gi mche ba gtsigs/ /smin ma sma ra ag tsho mes me ltar 'bar/ /dbu skra khams nag ral pa gyen du 'khyil/ /spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang gu zil gnon rngams/ /rngog ma dmar po dbang gi rta skad 'tsher/ /g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar rngam sgra sgrog /sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi glang chen ko rlon gsol/ /sku smad stag gi sham thabs bdud dpung 'dul/ /thod rlon tshar gsum phreng bas rgyan du byas/ /sbrul rigs bzhi yis sku brgyan phyag zhabs spras/ /dang po pad+ma brgyus dbang du sdud/ /bar pa lcags kyu zhags pas dmigs pa 'gugs/ /tha ma be con ral gris dgra bgegs sgrol/ /dbang drag me dpung klong dkyil rin chen spras/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par ldan/ /dbang chen gdug pa'i spyan rtsa ldog pa yis/ /snang srid dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud/ shangs nas rlud nag 'tshub pa'i bskal pa 'byung / /snang srid kun 'dar mthu chen drag rtsal 'dul/ /snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug stong ldir ba yis/ /srid pa'i che btsan thams cad zil gyis(10bsko non/ /tshems la drag po'i thog chen phab pa yis/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /zhal nas rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'brug cing 'khyil/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la skyin thang phob/ khro rgyal dbang gi rta skad 'tsher re re/ /thugs rje dbang wo che btsan dbang du sdud/ /pad+ma dbang wo khrag 'thung mi bzad pa/ khyod kyi dbang drag 'phrin las dus la bab/ /sdang dgra gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlog /1 khro rgyal dbang chen sku yi g.yon phyogs nas/ khro mo pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /spyan gsum zhal bgrad dbang gi mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra ral ba nag po mun ltar gtibs/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad legs par ldan/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje thogs nas yab la 'byud/ /phyag g.yon dung chen dmar 'khyil gtso la stob/ khro mo kun gyi dbang phyug chen mo khyod/ /rngams pa'i nga ros thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zhal nas mi ro 'phrul/ /snyan nas 'brug sgrog shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub/ khyod kyi / /sdang dgra / /yiḥ yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa dbang chen khro bo'i sku/ shar phyogs 'khor lo 232

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtogana'abar ba'i rtsibs steng nas/ /dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /rdo rje dbang wo dkar po khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche gtsigs mi ro za/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen bsgrengs sprul gyis bcings/ /(11na)phyag g.yas rdo rjesadagra bgegs mgo lus gzhog /phyag g.yon dbyug tos myos shing brgyal bar byed/ /me dpung klong nas 'gying gar stabs tshul du/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir ri ri/ /thugs kyi sprul pas stong gsum khyab par byed/ khyod kyi / /sdang dgra:/ /hrīḥ yab yumaḥ / /thugs kyi ca/ /lho phyogs:/ khrul bum —/ /rin chen dbang chen mthing nag khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyisaḥ/ /spyan gsum ྈ / /dbu skra ཿ/ /phyag g.yas rin cen myu gus dgos 'dod skong / /phyag g.yon lcags kyus bla 'gugs tsit+ta 'byin/ /me dpung / /rngams pa'i / /thugs kyi cha/ khyod kyi / /sdang dgraḥ / /hrīḥ yab yum:/ /thugs kyi / /nub phyogs / /klu dbang ཿ/ /pad+ma dbang chen dmar smug khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig / /spyan gsum / /dbu skra / /phyag g.yas pad+mas che btsun dbang du sdud/ /phyag g.yon zhagasapas lus dang yan lag 'ching / /me dpungaḥ/ /rngams pa'i :/ /thugs kyi / khyod kyi — / /sdang dgra / /gyi yab yum / /thugs kyi —/ /byang phyogs / /gnod sbyin — / /'phrin las dbang chen ljang dmar khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig ཿ/ /spyan gsum / /dbu skra — / /phyag g.yas ral gyis rtsa dang srog gzugs gcod/ /phyag g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum sgrol/ /me dpung / /rngams pa'i / /thugs kyi / /(11bsgo rgyad kyi / /sdang dgra / /hūṃ/ shar phyogs dung gi sgo khyud la/ /bud med nag mo 'jigs tshul can/ khrag gi ral pa shar ra ra/ /phyag na lcags kyu dgra snying 'byin/ /rings par khug cig 'a ku sha /lho phyogs gser / /ser mo nag mo / /g.yu yi ཿ/ /phyag na zhags pa bla tshe 'gugs/ /chings shig sdoms shig pā shu hri/ /nub phyogs ngas kyi / /bud med dmar mo / /mthing gi ral pa / /phyag na lcags sgrog tshe srog bstim/ /rten la bstim zhig sgro ṭa baṃ/ /byang phyogs g.yu yi —/ / bud med sngon mo / /gser gyi / /phyag na dril bus brgyal bar byed/ /myos par gyis shig ghaṇ+ḍi sngo/ /hrīḥ bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ga / /dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po byung / /skyes mchoge 'od kyi mi bo che/ /sku la seng ge'i slog pa gsol/ /dbu la ji le dkar po bcings/ /nam mkha' —233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge'aja' yi ska rags can/ /lcags kyi sder mos dgra snying 'byin/ /g.yas pa ral gris dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pa 'od kyi zhags pa 'phen/ /dgra bo'i tshe srog don snying phyungs/ /drag tu bskul lo dgra srog rdzo/ shar gyi dkar po dam tshig can/ /rta ru dkar po ngang ring smo/ /sku la dar dkar ral ka gsol/ /dbu la dung gi cod pan can/ /phyag na shel gyi zangs gyi thogs/ /phyag g.yon zhags pa dgra la 'debs/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ /dgra bo'i lha phrol khong snying phyungs/ /lho yi dge bsnyen dam tshig can/ /(12na skyo la za 'og sngo khra gsol/ /dbu la brtse men 'gying thod bcings/ /rta ni kham pa lag dkar zhon/ /g.yas na brtse yi rdo rje thogs/ /g.yon pa tsit+ta dmar po thogs/ /gying ོ rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal/ /dgra bo'i snying phyungs srog rtsa chod/ zhub kyi bdud nag dam tshig can/ /sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol/ /dbu la bdud zhwa lding nag gsol/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po bcibs/ /phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing bsnams/ /phyag g.yon zhags pa nag po 'debs/ /nag po gsod byed bdud kyi bu/ /dgra bo'i tshe srog khram la thob/ /byang gi srog bdag dam tshig can/ /sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol/ /dbu la bse glog zangs ring gsol/ /chibs su bse yi ra skyes bcibs/ /phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri ring bsnams/ /g.yon pa zhags pa dgra la 'debs/ /bswo to srog gcod lag dmar gyis/ /dgra bo'i mdangs phyogs srog rtsa chod/ /dam nyams ma btang shor ra re/ /gyi pad+ma rgyal po rta mchog dpal/ khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru gaḥ/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mi bzad pa/ /skyin thang chu 'khyags mnga' bdag khyod/ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /byi t+ta pe te sgra gcan 'dzin/ /drang srong chen po kun tu rgyu/ /gza' rgod drag po skyin thang bdag /dud kha mgo dgu mig gisakhengs/ /ro smad sbrul sa rgya mtsho 'khrug /phyag g.yas skyin thang 'khor lo bsnams/ /phyag g.yon chu srin zhags pa 'phen/ /dgra yul lo tog (11ba〉rgyal du rlag /gyi phyogs bzhi nam mkha' dkyil yangs nas/ /ngan sngags bdag mo skyin thang phob/ shar gyi stag srin zor ba gdong / /lho yi baṃ srin dred mo gdong / /nub kyi kong srin ba lang gdong / /byang gis 'brog srin chu srin gdong / /ga sngagasabadag po bzhi po ni/ /g.yas pa zor ba g.yon nad rkyal/ /skyin thang chu rgad mnga' bdag mo/ /dgra bo'i lo rtag snar ma la/ /chu rgod 'khyags pa'i skyin thang phob/ /dgra yul thal ba rdul du rlog /gnod 234

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma (gnasbyin beg tse rig pa'i lha mo dang / /sgrol gying srog bdag gri thogs bshan pa brgyad/ /ro bshan nyer gcig bdud nag gnod sbyin dang / /btsan dmag pho nya 'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho yis/ /rbod gtong chags che bar gcod ma lus pa/ /gsar sgrigs/ rang gshed rang la phab ste dgra bgegs kyi/ /snying khrag hub 'thung srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gyi badz+ra kro dha ha ya gi ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ mahā kro : shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro : shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ /oṃ rat+na kro : shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma kro dhe shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ rkarma kro : shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra spro ṭa baṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi༄ gi skor/ rā hu la/ ra smo pra ṇa at+pa na/ sa pa ri wā ra ṇa/ mthubyad rbod gtong sdebargyad kyi gnod pa/ nad gdon/ chags che/ nyam nga / bar gcod thams cad dgra bgegs kyi steng du bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog /gser skyems dang gzu dpang gtod/ (13na〉khrub khung du nya po bskyed 'gugs ni/ su bhā bas sbyangs/ gsar gas/ stong pa'i ngang las e las gnam lcagasalas grub pa'i 'brub khung nag po kha dog cing mthil yangs pa kha khyer rim pa gsum dang ldan zhing /'og phyogs 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba phyi nas gti mug gi mun pa thibs shing / nang zhe sdang gi me dpung 'khrug pa/ lha srin sdo brgyad kyi bshas ra 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su/ rtsi dang tri lasaganod byed dgra bgegs de nyid nyam thag cing mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs can yan lag lcags sgrog gisabasdams pa mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ bden brdar nas bzung stob pa'i bar dkyus bzhin bya/ bskang ba chos sku skye med ma gtong / sgrub pa po rnams tsho gos la rol rjes dbang bskur smon lam gdab/ bzlog bsgyur ni/ rtsa brgyud mus da pa dpal ldan sgo ges mdzad/ /bla ma thams cad la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i las 'chol gyis/ / phyir bzlog tshur la bzlog par mchi'o/ /gnyen byas dgra ru song bar mchi'o/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bsgyur ro ltasang na cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur/ bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal rta mgrin la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog goḥ/ /bsgyur roḥ/ /bzlog bsgyur:/ /dus la / /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen (13ba)byasaḥ/ /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / khro rgyal rdo rje dbang r+ṣa la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog : / /—233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geganyen byas:/ /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro:/ /bzlog bsgyur / /dus laḥ/ khro rgyal rin chen dbang chen la/ /do nub : / /phyir bzlog : / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go za/ /bsgyur roḥ/ /bzlog bsgyur ca/ /dus laḥ /khro rgyal pad+ma dbang chen la/ /do nubaḥ/ /phyir bzlog cha/ /gnyen byas / /bzlog goḥ/ /bsgyur ro:/ /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la:/ khro rgyal las kyi dbang chen la/ /do nubaḥ/ /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas:/ /bzlog goḥ/ /bsgyur roḥ/ /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / khar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu ma/ /do nubazo/ /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byasaḥ/ /bzlog go za/ /bsgyur roḥ/ /bzlog bsgyuraḥ/ /dus laḥ/ /lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa ma/ /do nubaḥ/ /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur roḥ / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /nub phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu ma/ /do nub / /phyir bzlogaḥ / /gnyen byas — / /bzlog go —/ /bsgyur roḥ / /bzlog bsgyuraḥ / /dus la:/ /byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu ma/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog —/ /gnyen byas / /bzlog goḥ/ /bsgyur roḥ/ /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /yi dam lha tshogs thams cad la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /(14na po nyen byas dgra ru song bar mchi'o/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bsgyur ro ltasang na cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur/ /bzlog sgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dus la bab bo sam ya/ 91ga bdag 'od kyi rgyal po la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i las lo la gyis/ /phyir bzlog tshur la bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /gtum drag re nag blangs pa la do nub ཿ / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /srog bdud btsan 'khor dmar po la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /gza' rgod khyab 'jug chen po la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /yum chen gdong mo bzhi po la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /dregs byed sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /do nub tsho/ /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byas / /bzlog go / /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la / /(14ba tha stan srung rgya mtsho'i 236

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganatshogs rnams la/ /do nub / /phyir bzlog / /gnyen byasaḥ/ /bzlog goḥ/ /bsgyur ro / /bzlog bsgyur / /dus la:/ /zhes dang / ྅: dang por rang sems zhakhrul pa yis/ /gnyis med don ni ma rtogs pa'i/ /log rtog 'khor ba'i bag chags blangs/ /'bras bu smin byed bskyed rdzogs gsal/ /rang gzhan gnyis med don rtogs nas/ /rnam rtog 'khor bas chags pa rgyas/ /yig ṣi yang bzlog nag tsho bzla ba/ hūṃ/ nga ni dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ /bag chags 'khor ba'i duḥ kha rgyas/ /gnyis med rang gi nga rgyal can/ /ya gi khro bo man chad nas/ /ma gi bsen mo grong rgyu yan/ /thams cad ma lusang la nyon/ /nga ni sems can don re byed/ /nga yis mdos gtor 'di bsngos pas/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i rbod kha bzlog /ya mān+ta kṛ ta dgra la bzlog /sems can don la nga mi yengs/ /snying rjesabasgral ba'i sha khrag gi /tshad med mdos gtor 'di bsngos pas/ /rta mgrin gsung gi rbod gtong bzlog /ha ya gh+ri wa dgra la bzlog /drag po'i drag sngags gnyis med bzlas/ /pha rol rgyas pa'i snying khrag gi /tshad med rak+ta 'di bsngos pas/ /phyag rdor thugs kyi rbod gtong bzlog /badz+ra pā ṇi dgra la bzlog /e yaṃ sa ma ya snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bzlog bzlog /snying rtsa phyungs phyungs/ srog rtsa chod chod/byad ma mā ra ya bzlog bzlog /ce brgya stong bzlas so/ /denas yang 'di skad do/ hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ra mda' slog /(15na tha dam lha tsho gos ra mda' slog /chos skyong srung ma ra mda' slog /byad ma'i steng du dmag 'dren gyis/ /dmag dpon ye shes lhas mdzad do/ /byad ma ma lus thal bar thong / /bdag la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /yun du ma shog srog rtsa chod/ /byad ma shas byer byer sod sod/ /hūṃ/ dgra bo bsod nams zad pa dang / /rnal 'byor yar la 'phel ba gnyis/ /dus gsum lha yisabyin rlobs la/ /rnal 'byor tshe dang bsod nams rnams/ /gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ /dgra bo bsod nams med par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ nyon cig snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor lha med zer nas brnyas/ /lha la mthu med zer nas brnyas/ bh+yo/ dam nyams dgra la gtor zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la yungs zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la btso zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la gri zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la rbab zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la khrag zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la 'ur zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la mtshe zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la phur zor bzlog /dam —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2genyams dgra la mda' zor bzlog /dam nyams dgra la rdo zor bzlog /bh+yo/ shar phyogs mi nag mche ba can/ dam nyams dgra la rbod kha sgyur/ /bh+yo/ lho phyogs mi sngon mche ba can/ /dam nyams dgra larbod kha sgyur/ /bh+yo/ nub phyogs mi dmar mche ba can/ /dam nyams dgra la rbod kha sgyur/ /bh+yo/ byang phyogs mi ser (15ba)mche ba can/ /dam nyams dgra la rbod kha sgyur/ /bh+yo/ khyed la 'phrin lasabacol ba ni/ /bdag dang yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /phur kha zor kha langs pa bzlog /mda' zor 'ur zor 'phen pa bzlog /kong zor 'brub khung bcug pa bzlog /mi dmar zhags pa 'phen pa dang / /mi nag g.yab mo g.yab pa bzlog /bshan pa las la zhugs pa bzlog /mon pa rim pa brjes pa bzlog /skyes pas mda' zor 'phen pa bzlog /bud med dmod zor byed pa bzlog /bdud gcod srog rgud lus kyi na tsha dang / /bla nyams tshe nyams thams cad dgra la bzlog /lha bsgral srog zhud ngan pa bzlog /srog rgal phur pa btab pa bzlog /bdag la brnag pa'i bsam ngan dang / /sbyor ba ngan pa sna tsho gos bzlog /yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /sder mo can gyis snying nas drongs/ /mche ba can gyis klad nas thug /zhags pa can gyis yan lag khyigs/ /lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms/ /dril bu can gyis myos su chug /tho ba can gyis mgo nas rdungs/ /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded/ /mun pa nag pos mdun nas sus/ /yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /las mkhan rnams kyi zhal du thob/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag chod las shog /sa yi rten phur thon las shog /don snying lnga po phyungasalas shog /kha nas khong khrag skyug tu chug /skyob pa'i lha dang phrol las shog /ltasang na brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thong / /ye 'byog sum brgya drug cu thong / /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi thong / /(16na bom nyams las ga sdig can 'di/ /lo dang zla bar ma 'jog par/ /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston/ /bcol ba'i las 'di ma byas na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bslus/ /phyi rabs gsang sngags sun yang phyung / /rigs 'dzin bdag gi re ba chad/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen po nyams/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig 'gal/ /thub pa'i bstan srung ming tsam gyur/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ zhes dang / bh+yo/yig ṣi bzlog pa rnam rgyal stob kyi 4zhi cha/ sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bzhig pa bzlog /dkon mchog —238

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganagasum gyi dbu 'phang dmod pa bzlog /gtsug lag khang chen dkor khang bshig pa bzlog /gsang sngags rgyud la bcas su 'dogs pa bzlog /dge 'dun dkor la rlom zhing 'byer ba bzlog /'gro ba kun la gnod cing 'tshe ba bzlog /dkar po'i chos la brnag cing dmod pa bzlog /bka' las 'da' zhing dam nyams khrims nyams bzlog /bdag la gnod par sems pa'i bsam ngan bzlog /sgrub la bar du gcod pa byed pa bzlog /mtshams kyi khongs su 'jug par byed pa bzlog /tshogs kyi yo byad brku zhing 'phrog pa bzlog /ting 'dzin drod la bar du gcod pa bzlog /dngos grub bgegs dang bar chad byed pa bzlog /dus tshodi phyogs ga bdud btsan thams cad bzlog /tshes brgyad yul gyi gdon 'dre langs pa bzlog /bco lnga'i (16ba)bla la rku bar byed pa bzlog /nyi shu bzhi la thog gcod rtsom pa bzlog /nyer dgu'i gdug la tshe len byed pa bzlog /yid kyis dngangs nas sprug par byed pa bzlog /ting 'dzin gsal khar sgrib tu yong ba bzlog /dngos grub yong khar 'phrog tu yong ba bzlog /lhar brdzus khrung po khyim du 'jug pa bzlog /mir brdzus 'byung po sgo ru rgyu ba bzlog /dgrar brdzus 'byung po srang bar 'khyams pa bzlog /grong rgyu 'gong pa skabs bltar 'tshol ba bzlog /khyi rkun ltar du rgyal bsen phug pa bzlog /rnam rtog slo bur phung 'dre langs pa bzlog /pha mes rgyas pa'i phung 'dre langs pa bzlog /bu lon lan chags phung 'dre langs pa bzlog sha 'khon langs pa'i phung 'dre langs pa bzlog /gsang sngags thog ser thog ltar 'phen pa bzlog /mu stegasarwa zar sprin ltar thabs pa bzlog /rgya nag gtor zor ser ltar 'bebs pa bzlog /zhang zhung btso zor me ltar 'bar ba bzlog /sum pa'i glang zor mtsho ltar 'khyil ba bzlog /phur pa'i dpal zor rta ltar brgyug pa bzlog /yungs zor ri gzar rbab ltar bsgril ba bzlog /mtshe yi zor kha mdung ltar 'dril ba bzlog /khrag zor dpag chen mda' ltar 'phen pa bzlog /drag sngags chu bo'i rgyun ltar 'khrug pa bzlog /'byung ba'i bzhi gshed ki gang gshed bzhi bzlog /bdud gcod rlung nag bdun zur drug khram bzlog /lus srog dbang thang rlung rta gud pa bzlog /'brel ba'i 'khon gzhi gtso dang sgrogasang na bzlog /nyams su snang ba'i chad pa 'bebs pa bzlog /rnam bzhi 'khor la bar chad byed pa bzlog /snga dgra lusang ga yid la dar ba bzlog /phyi dgra sems shing gnod sems 'chang ba —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebazlog /rdzas la brku zhing 'phrog par byed pa bzlog /longs spyod 'khor la gnod par byed pa bzlog /brgyags la brku zhing 'phrog par byed pa bzlog /dpal la 'jab cing 'tshe bar byed pa bzlog /ma nyes nyes zer brjod cing mnar ba bzlog /'khor dang nad 'khrug le po'i 'phang len bzlog /pha khu'i rgan sri ma bu'i gyur sri bzlog /skyes pa'i mda' sri za ma'i 'phang sri bzlog /bu tsha'i chung sri rnal 'byor dam sri bzlog /mtshon sris gtub cing mda' sris 'bug pa bzlog /chu srisa'abyer zhing rdib sris 'tshub pa bzlog /lceb sris 'phyed cing g.yang la lhung ba bzlog /'phung sri langs shing gnam sri lhung ba bzlog /god sri langs shing rkun sri dar ba bzlog /phu na mi kha rta skad 'tsher ba bzlog /mda' na mi kha rlung ltar 'tshub pa bzlog /yul pa'i mi kha khyi ltar zug pa bzlog /glu ltar len zhing sgrog pa'i mi kha bzlog /pho yi mi kha mda' ltar 'ben pa bzlog /mo yi mi kha bal ltar g.yeng ba bzlog /grogs po'i kha dan rbab ltar bsgril ba bzlog /grogs mo'i snying ngan chu rgyun lta bu bzlog /yas kyi bdud g.yos mas kyi sri langs bzlog /bar gyi bdud 'khrugs pha tshan rgya 'dre bzlog /phu nu'i byol kha bzhad ka rbod gtong bzlog khyur du gang che skal du gang ring bzlog /lan du gang chags sha ru (17bsko nyer ba bzlog /bya ru mi rung bkra ru mi shis bzlog /rmi lam mtshan ga ltas ngan brgyad sdig bzlog /mo ngan mthu sdig god kha kha mchu bzlog /gnod cing 'gal byed sku la bsdob bzlog /'thab rtsod tshig rtsub ga smras gtong ba bzlog /lag ga mdzub mo'i rdeg rdung byed pa bzlog /ring la bshad snyom mtho la 'gran sems bzlog /mnyam la 'gran sems bzang la skyon brjod bzlog /mgyogs la bang snyoms ya rabs rgyud pa bzlog /mkhas la smod cing dmangs la bstod pa bzlog /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra bzlog /rnal 'byor sgos dgra sngags pa'i spyi dgra bzlog /mang pos 'thib brdzis kha drag zas zos bzlog /dpung pa'i tshong zor mi ran mas chod bzlog /ma chags bu lon 'ded pa khyad gsod bzlog /brlab tshig gshags 'debs rgyab bstan mna' za bzlog /g.yo sgyu zol zog phra ma 'dzud pa bzlog /ngo tsha khrel 'dzem med pa'i ga rnyog bzlog /lang du shor ba'i za 'dod chud zos bzlog /'dod gtam lta ba'i chung tshad chod pa bzlog /skabs 'chol rkyen snyoms glegs pu re ba bzlog /mtho ba'i la la brgal dbang med pa bzlog /—24()

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganadama' ba'i chu la brgal dbang med pa bzlog /dbang med sdig rdung sdig la byed pa bzlog /gnya' gnon kha la 'gul dbang med pa bzlog /thugs la chags shing bla la nye ba bzlog /dgra la g.yag rdung byed do zer ba bzlog /pha dang mes po rgas su mi ster bzlog /bu dang tsha 'o 'tshar du mi ster bzlog /ngan pa'i sems blo bde ru mi ster (18na〉zlog /g.yog dang 'khor rnams skyid du mi ster bzlog /longs spyod bsod nams rgyas su mi ster bzlog /mnol dang mi dme rigs brgyud 'chal ba bzlog /rta rtod la rgyug lung rgyug zer ba bzlog /la ded 'phrang ded lung 'gegs zer ba bzlog /la rgyug 'phrang bskyil zer ba thams cad bzlog /skabs ltar glags tshol sgo ru srang tshag bzlog /srod kyi 'jab bu gung gi hur thum bzlog /tho rangs rgyu ba'i bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog /thub tshad 'gran 'tshol za 'dod snyad 'tshol bzlog /ku re kyal ka dgug pa'i rngan chan bzlog /'khon gyi bsam pasa'athab kha snyad 'tshol bzlog /mi thub rtsis pa'i brnyas bcos khyad gsod bzlog /mi nad phyugs nad pha rol dmag dpung bzlog /me chu dug mtshon mu ge lce 'bab bzlog /gcan gzan 'jigs pa sgra dang sa g.yos bzlog /lha klu thog ser dus min 'chi ba bzlog /skar mda' rgyal po'i chad pasa'ajigs pa bzlog /gnam gyi bya than sa yi byi than bzlog /sad ser than pa btsa' 'bu kha ba bzlog /drug lhag sho re mi yi than pa bzlog /mna' kha rgyu lug phyugs kyi than pa bzlog /gnam la dal babs sa la sri langs bzlog /gdags la brag ral sribs la shing chag bzlog sha pho ru 'dzings bya rgod sder 'dzings bzlog /g.yag po ru 'dzings nya mo rnga 'dzings bzlog /sreg pa khyim zhugs sprul chen lam nyal bzlog /byi la lam stor sbre mo skad 'tsher bzlog /phugs na ra sbrid sgo na khyi ngu bzlog /srin bya rgod cing (18ba)bya rog 'phral ba bzlog /gla ba'i sbar 'dzings 'ug pa'i gad mo bzlog /rgyud kyi 'khrul 'khor rdzas kyi sbyor ba bzlog /mu stegasang na sngags rgya nag rtsis kha bzlog /nyan thos spar kha sa bdag gtad khram bzlog /lha chen gdug pa'i ngan sngags sprul pa bzlog /ma mo'i dal yamasaganod sbyin khram kha bzlog /'gong po'i god kha rgyal po'i smyo 'bog bzlog /dmu yi 'thibs nad btsan gyi gzer nad bzlog /klu yi mdze nad bdud kyi khram kha bzlog /hor gyi na kha mon gyi khra ma bzlog /bod kyi skyo ma nag mo'i mchu sdur bzlog /bran g.yog 'og mi dpon du gyur pa bzlog /mkhar —241 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gel tog thogs khyim pa dgrar langs bzlog /phyugs la zhags thogs mi la mtshon thogs bzlog /nor dang 'bru la bra dang phad thogs bzlog /zas sbyor dug gsod gnyen byas dgrar langs bzlog /gtsang chu shwa brgal sgo ru 'brug pa bzlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /nad sna brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sprin 'thib bzlog /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rlung g.yos bzlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /rkyen ga nyi khri chig stong tho drug bzlog /gsod thabs brgyad cu rtsa bzhi glog 'byug bzlog /dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad thog ser bzlog /ga dgu sdig bcu bar bcad thams cad bzlog /pho bdud dal kha thams cad g.yas su sgyur/ /mo bdud dal kha thams cad g.yon du sgyur/ /spyi bdud dal kha thams cad mkha' la sgyur/ /bzlog sgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /sarba pā paṃ sarba du tri mā ra ya bzlog bzlog /bh+yo/ gnod (19na)byed rbod zer sarba a pa na ya bzlog bzlog khes brgya la sogs pa bzlas so/ /bdag dmo dpo dug cu kho mi/la gnod byed dgra bgegs ngan pa 'di/ kha drag za zhing dpung pa 'tshong ba 'di/ /rmad po mthebs kyis brdzis nas snang ba 'di/ /mdza' bo slu byed mes su 'dzud pa 'di/ /dmangs kyi bden pa khyad du gsod pa 'di/ rdzun gyi snyad sa bu lon 'phrog pa 'di/ /mnar sems bcangs nas sbyor rtsub byed pa 'di/ /bla ma'i sku dgra sems can spyi dgra 'di/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dmod pa 'di/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /gnod byed 'gal byed sdang zhing gdug pa 'di/ /mdza' bo rnams dang phra ma 'dzud pa 'di/ khro zhing rtsub pas sku la bsdob 'di/ /pha yi zhing bcur gyur pa'i sgos dgra 'di/ /ma nyes sgrog ༅ skur pa 'debs pa 'di/ /mdza' bo'i nor dang gzungs ma brku ba 'di/ /brlang dang tshig rtsub kha gsag smra ba 'di/ /ring la stob cing zas gos 'phrog pa 'di/ /ma nyes nyes zer sgrub la 'tshe byed 'di/ /ngan smras gtong zhing lag ngan rdeg pa 'di/ /nga rgyal gnya' gnon thog rdzis byed pa 'di/ /grags dang longs spyod bsnyen bkur 'dren pa 'di/ /phrag dog kha 'jam zhe nas dmod pa 'di/ /rnam bzhi 'khor la bar du gcod pa 'di/ /ga sems gnod skyel byed pa 'di dag la/ /bden pa rdzun pa gnyis kyi gshags phye zhig /dam tshig rdzas chod legs nyes stangs bzung zhig /smrasapa thams cad (19ba)nyon zhig gtang sar rgyug /ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /—242

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganabacol lo gtad do sngags bdag gnyan po la/ /bskul lo zad do bskor ro mthu ma chung / /bos so g.yab bo srung ma spyan ma brtul/ /dgra bgegs dgu brgyud chod cig rtsal ma zhan/ /dam tshig ltos la sho rde'u dkar nag ltos/ khram la thob la byang mar dkyus la bris/ /thugs nag tshongs la nad rkyal kha phye zhig /klad nad gzer nad mkhris nad mig ser phob/ /'dus rang zhig pa rlung nad g.yo ba phob/khrag nad tsha gzer tsha nad khol ba phob/ /bad gan 'khyil pa mkhal nad su rla phob/ /mgo nad 'khor ba mdze nad skrangs 'bur phob/ /lhog pa gag pa sman lcags yo mo phob/ /rgyu gzer khrag 'jag dum chu skya bab phob/ /tshad pa mgo yor grang nad gzhad 'brum phob/ /smyo nad snying rlung 'bog nad snying 'gasaphob/ /mdze nad ga choge sa skam shu ba g.yan pa phob/ /spus re ther chad g.ya' ri dum bu phob/ /gri sri yu dmar mda' sri stong dmar phob/ /rbab sri bcar phog chu sri 'dar shad phob/ /mtshon sri lcag chen lceb gris 'gyeg pa phob/ /bsrung ba'i rgyab phrol mches pa'i lha dang phrol/ /srung byed le dgu 'go ba'i sman dang phrol/ /sdod pa'i gnas phrol dbang ba'i nor dang phrol/ / rgyu ba'i yul phrol mthun pa'i grogs dang phrol/ /'tsho ba'i zas phrol lus srog gnyis po phrol/ /'og nas grang ba chu ltar 'khyil du chug /steng nas tsha ba nyi ltar sreg tu chug /bar nas tsha grang rlung ltar (20na〉khrug tu chug /gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas cho de la thong / /sa yi rten phur 'og nas phyungs la thong / /dran rig kun gzhi bar dor chug la thong / /lus la gnam lcags me chen spor du chug /kha nas gyod gtam dgra ga 'don du chug /ngu 'bod smre sngags brang lag 'thab tu chug /kyilas rlung gis rgyab nas myur du phul/ /'jigasapa'i mun nag chen pos mdun nas sus/ /lus srog dbang po rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /nor la god kha skyid la rked chod thong / /pho yi dpal phrogs mo yi dbang thang phrol/ /nor gyi g.yang phrol zas kyi bcud phyogs shig /bya ru mi rung bkra ru mi shis thong / /dar bzhi srang gsum bzhi mdor 'khyam du chug sha khrag lhu bzhi khyi yis mur du chug /rkang lag lam 'phrang bzhi mdor 'gom du chug /bka' chad phob cig snying khrag skyug tu chug /yan lag chings shig pags shus mgo bo chod/ /brla bzhi phrol zhig don snying dmar po phyungs/ /rtsa rgyus cho de la khong khrag long du lhug ga zo khrag 'thung rkang ldog lha ba 'jibs/ /klad pa ldag cing rus pa mur du chos/ /pags chen sol zhig bsreg pa'i gsur la —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'asnoms/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod/ /rdo yis sran phung gtor bzhin phyogs bcur gtor/ /me stag chu la yar bzhin tsad med thong / /bya sgro me yis bsregs bzhin brlag par mdzod/ /yon bdag sgyu ma 'di la brnyas ma 'dogs/ khri kyis pa phran tshegs tsam la rtsis ma byed/ /nam mkha' stong pa 'di la tshad (20ba)ma 'dzugs/ /dgra bgegs 'di yi skye shi khungs phyung zhig /dgra dpung thams cad rtsad nas myur du chod/ /bdud dpung thams cad bsgyur zhing rjes med thong / /sdang dgra gnod bgegs 'byung po dam sri rnams/ /thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gser skyems btang lha bteg cing bsdus/ gzugs sgyur byed/ sgo dbye ni/ yig ṣi / bcom ldan khro rgyal rta mgrin la/ /do nub zor gyi las gzhol gyis/ /zor 'phangs slad la log par mchi'o/ /gnyen byasadagra ru song bar mchi'o/ /byas la de nas zor lam dbye ste/ sgo ba rnams ni sgo phye zhig /'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /sgrub pa po la dgra byung gi /khro bo'i rgyal pos ra mda' slog /chos skyong srung mas ra mda' slog /srin po'i yul du dmag 'dren gyis/ /dmag dpon ye shes lha yis mdzod/ /dmag dpon chos skyong srung mas mdzod/ /steng gi lha la mi 'phen no/ /'og gi klu la me 'phen no/ /bar gyi btsan la mi 'phen no/ /mtho ba rnams kyang zhabasasdus shig /dma' ba rnams kyang dbu chus sa shig /bar pa rnams kyang sku gzur zhig /zor lam chen po khyed kyis bye/ /da ni gshegs so shar ra ra/ /zhes sogs brjod/ yas mar mchod pa/ chad mtho btang / zor 'phen sar/ gser skyems gzu dpang / rgyas par spro na gong gi dmod mtsho khol ma byas kyang chog /gtor zor 'phang ba ni/ yig ṣ+ka / dang po gti mug thibs kyis bskyed/ /de nas(21na)zhe sdang pha yis bskyed/ /de nas dri za lte bar 'khor/ /phung lnga rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /lte ba'i dkyil du gtor zor ya/ /rnam rtog rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /snying gi dkyil du gtor zor ya/ /dran pa nyams par bya ba'i phyir/ /klad pa'i rgyas su gtor zor ya/ /lta ba'i rten dang bral ba'i phyir/ /mig gi dkyil du gtor zor ya/ /smra ba'i rten dang bral ba'i phyir/ /mgrin pa'i gnas su gtor zor ya/ /'du byed las dang bral ba'i phyir/ /dpung mgo gnyis la gtor zor ya/ /srid pa rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i gnas su gtor zor ya/ /'gro ba'i rten dang bral ba'i phyir/ /brla 'og gnyis la —244

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganagator zor ya/ /gtor ma dug gi rang bzhin gyis/ /bgegs rnams dran pa nyams par byed/ /gtor ma me yi rang bzhin pas/ /bgegs rnams thams cad thal bar bsreg /bsnyen sngagasang gsham du thum ril ha na ha na tsit+ta la breng shag rbad/ gyi skyo bh+yo/ spu gri ring mo bzla/ mtshan ngan thod pa'i snod nang du/ /dmar chen rak+ta la sbyar ba'i/ khungs yig ṣi / gar zor 'phen shar ra ra/ /mtshe yi zor 'phen sil li li/ /yungs mo zor 'phen thabs se thab/ /sbyor ba ngan pa gtang ba la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod bgegs 'di/ /dang po zhe sdang pha yis bskyed/ /bar du 'dod chags ma yi mngal tha ma dri za lte bar 'khor/ /lnga phung rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /klad pa'i rgyas su khrag zor ya/ /snying (21ba)gi dkyil du:/ /srog gi sgo ruḥ / /srog rtsa'i sbubs su:/ /glo ba'i dpral du:/ /mchin pa'i sbubs suḥ/ /mcher pa'i sgang la —/ /rgyu ma'i dkyil duḥ/ /mkhal ma'i glo rtsa/ /lta ba'i mig la:/ /snam pa'i sna laḥ/ /smra ba'i lte la / /nyan pa'i rna bar:/ /sems pa'i snying —/ /tshor ba'i lus la:/ /'og gi rta la:/ /bar gyi nor la:/ /phugs kyi sris la:/ /sgo yi khyi laḥ/ /'og gi chung mar:/ /mchan gyi bu:/ /yul mkhar khyim laḥ/ /rtsi snar zhing la:/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod/ /sa yi rten phur 'og nas phyungs/ /bka' yi chad pa myur du phob/ /3ha ya gh+ri ba raka rbad/ thud sod/ paṅgān+ta kṛ ta dgra bo'i snying la thun rbad/ ma ma rak+ṣa dgra bo'i snying la thur rbad/ trag mo tshal dun snying la khos rbad/ kro ta rak+ṣa dgra bo'i snying la rbad/ thun mā ra ya rbad/ thum ril ha na ha na bh+yo bh+yo/ thum ril ha na ha na tsit+ta la bram shag rbad hri bh+yo bh+yo/ yungs zor ni/ gnod sbyin rgyal po khros pa'i sogs dkyus ltar/ gtor chen 'phang ba ni/ gsar lhags/ nag po lcags kyi snod yangs par/ / dpal gyi dmar chen gtor ma la/ /mtshe yungs rtsang sogs rgyan gyis spras/ /dbang chen khrag 'thung rol pa'i zor/ /thog mtshon dug nad 'tshub ma 'di/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du brdeg /byad phur chags che bar chad bzlog /gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlog /drag sngags spu gri ring mo dang / /bzlog sngags sogs ci rigs brjod la brdeg /thal mo brdab cing (22na)dmod mo bya/ /me chu'i rgyas 'debs ni/ hūṃ/ yig rnying / dang po chosakyi dbyings kyi rgya/ /gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya/ /gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ /bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya/ /lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya/ /drug pa rigs drug sangs rgyas rgya/ /bdun pa ma mo —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gekun gyi rgya/ /brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya/ /dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya/ /brgya pa khro bo bcu yi rgya/ /nga yi rgya las ma 'da' zhig /bshal chus bstan ma bskyang / sgo drug bro brdung / nang du log nasatshe 'gugs ni/ yig rnying / bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /sku mchog mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /gsung mchog yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /thugs mchog mi rtog pa yi thugs/ /mkha' 'dra'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i lasamadzod cig /rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ puṣ+ṭha pu rtse ma hā puṣ+ṭha a pa ra mi ta ā yu we dz+nyā na sam+bha ro pa tsi te swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūṃ āḥ sa ā yurgan sirnyi du/ hūṃ/ 'gugs pa'i lha mo lcagasakyu ma/ /dkar mo mdzes ma lcags kyu bsnams/ /dri za'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /me lha'i lag nasadapal skyobs shig /sngags 'gre/ hūṃ/ 'ching byed lha mo zhags pa ma/ /sngon mo mdzes ma zhags pa bsnams/ /gshin rje'i:/ /srin po'i / /sngags 'gre/ hūṃ/ sdom byed lha mo lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar mo mdzes ma lcags sgrog bsnams/ /klu dbang / /rlung lha'i / /sngags 'gre/ hūṃ/ 'bebs(22ba)byed lha mo dril bu ma/ /ljang gu mdzes ma dril bu bsnams/ /gnod sbyin:/ /'byung po'i / /sngags 'gre /khro rgyal rngams sogs kyis dngos grub blang / gtang rag nas shis brjod kyi bar las byang gi dkyus bzhi bya'o/ /gsang rgyud snying po rgyal dbang pad+ma dang / / be+e ro'i dgongs don dmar la zor gyi las/ /man ngag thor bur bzhugs pa phyogs 'di la/ / mkhas shing sbyangs pas gsal byed zin bris mdzad/ /'on te 'gro rnams blo gros rim gyis dman/ /phyag len zhabrugs bsdebs man ngag rtogs pa nyung / /gsar ma'i lhad bral rang skad shes pa dkon/ /de phyir 'khrul spong bklags ga tshul du bkod//snga 'gyur bka' gter spyi dang bye brag gi khud dang phyag bzhes man ngag du ma'i gnad/ /yongasa'adzin drin las rnyed phyir legs bkod kyis/ /mgal dum phreng bar spel ba'i zog chos min/ /dge 'dis rta skad thengs gcig ka dag lam/ /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /brten nas skrun las rnam bzhi lhun grub cing / /dbang chen kun bzang tshe 'dir mngon gyur shog /pad+ma gsung gi mthu stobs nyin byed kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tsho gos smag dras mthar byas te/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'od snang gis/ /'jig rten gsum po khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dbang —246

chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje'i pha lam 'di ni mchod dpon (23na)ngag dbang shes rab kyis bsnyen chen btang ba'i tshe chog sgrigs dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis lcags mo bya lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu chen mo'i nyin pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bris pa dgra bgegs kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig / sarba maṅga lo// //

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geno༅༅/ /gter kha 'og ma'i rta nag lcags ral can gyi las byang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /khrag 'thung rta mchog ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /zab gter sgo 'byed gsung sprul chos kyi dbang / /bka' babs nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje sogs/ /dngos brgyud rigs 'dzin rnams la gus btud nas//bde gshegs zhi khro 'dus pa bka' brgyad lha'i/ /rta mgrin dbang gi nang nas yi dam dang / /chos skyong dbyer med bsgrub pa lcags ral can/ /drag rtsal rdo rje'i thog gi rjes su 'gro/ /rgyal bsen klu gnyan 'byung po mun pa'i dpung / /mthu stobs nus pa'i 'od kyis mthar byas nas/ /phan bde'i snang ba ster ba'i lhag pa'i lha'i/ /'phrin las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor deng 'dir shar/ /de la 'dir rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi 'phrin las kyi rim pa nyams su len pa la/ maṇ+ḍal/ rten rdzas/mchod gtor sogs phyag len ltar bsham/ ngag 'don dngos la skyabs sems tshogs gsog ni/rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal sogs brjod/ mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni/ hūṃ/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'du ba'i lha rnams ma gtogs pa mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs (2na)'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: rta mchog rgyal pos rdul du rlog ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭa phyi dbang gi rta skad rab 'tsher zhing / /'khor lo rdo rje me dpung gis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams med gtams pa/ /srung ba'i gur khang chen por gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsakra dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ du sno brda sgo dbye ba ni/ du pra be sha ya phaṭa:brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ a la la sngo na mo dam bca' ba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya skye byin 'bebs ni/hrīḥ dpal chen thugs las rnam sprul ba'i lha dang rigs 'dzin srung ma dang : dam can rgya mtsho ma —248

gter kha 'og ma'i rta nag lcags ral can gyi las byang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ nang ma rtoganalus pa ma g.yel ma g.yel byin phob cig: zho gu ru ha ya shrī wa : ba dha ki nī sa ma ya be sha ya a a:sman raka gtor gsum dang mchod rdzas brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ ṇa tshwa āḥlha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ 〉 tshwa āḥ& rak+ta dz+wa maṇ+ḍal hūṃ khyoḥtha tshwa ma hā ba li ta te dz+wa ba smra ta ba la ba ti gu spo sa ma ya hūṃ khyiḥtha nai āḥ& a:/ pulge dhū pe/ (2ba)ā lo ke /nga/ ni li du/ sha lta phu dza sngo rten brten pa bskyed pa ni/ā+oṃ su bha wa shu rmi sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo ྅ smi snang grag gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus chos rnams kun/ /ye nas ma bcos ka nas dag pa'i klong / /dharma khyu tu badz+ra su bhā wa ād+ma ko3nya/ de don ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje che/ /nag po rta mgrin lcags ral sgrub sems bskyed/ /e dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal rje/ 'jig rten khams 'di keng rus gsar rnying rnams/ /gcal du bkram pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus/ /dri za gshin rje klu dang gnod sbyin bzhi'i/ /thod pa'i rtsig pa mkhar gyi ya khebs la/ /lha chen bzhi'i thod ral pa nag po 'phyang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rgyan rdzogs pa'i/ /gzhal yas khang dbus lcags 'khor rtsibs bzhi pa/ /lte bar e las gru gsum mthing nag nang / /klu gnyan sa bdag phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi/ /dregs pa rgyal bsen pad+ma zla nyi'i steng / /rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo saḥdamar nag /skar chen me stag lta bu'i tsha tsha 'phro/ /de las 'od 'phros rgyal ba zhi khro yi/ /byin rlabs nus mthu tshur bsdus sa bon la/ /thim pa 'od zhu yongs su gyur pa las/ /bdag nyid rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /mthing nag zhal gdangs ljags dril mche ba gtsigs/ /drag po'i sgra sgrog khrag gi tsha tsha 'phro/ /sma ra smin ma me glog ltar 'bar 'khyug /dbu skra gnam lcags ral pa kham nag las/ khro chung grangs med 'phro bas gnod byed 'joms/ /gtsug na rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher/ /rngog ma le brgan dmar po me ltar 'bar/ /spyan gsum sdang mig (3na)'khrug cing me stag 'phro/ /shangs nas bskal ba'i rlung chen dmar nag 'bud/ /phyag g.yas sol me 'bar ral gri 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thugs kar lcags kyu 'dzin pa yi/ /sdigs mdzub rtse la lcags sdig phag thod tsam/ /rno dpal mche gcigs gdug pa'i ngar skad sgrog /thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal dang / /sbrul rigs lngas 249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gebargyan byug pa'i rdzas gsum sbags//dar nag 'jol ber steng na g.yang gzhi dang //glang lpags stod g.yogs stag lpags sham thabs sogs//zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dor stabs bgrad//ba spu'i gseb nas me dpung thog ser dang /khro chung tsha tsha glog stong lta bur 'phro//rgyal bsen sa bdag klu gnyan kun bsreg pa'i//bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs//spyi bor rwa dang mchu ster gnam lcags las//grub pa'i khyung dmar skad sgrog klu chen brgyad//zas su za zhing klu 'bum gdan du bting //g.yas su gru gsum mthing nag me 'bar dbus//rgyal bsen sa bdag klu gnyan bsnol ba'i steng //ya ka me dbal dmar nag me ral can//g.yas g.yon me yi tho ba zhags pa 'dzin//zhabs gnyis dor stabs rang 'dra'i khro tshogs 'phro//gnod byed za zhing brlag nus 'jigs rung can//g.yon phyogs gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang //dgra bgegs ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du//gnod sbyin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can//mon pa'i gzugs ldan lcags rdor rtse lnga g.yas//g.yon pa me yi lcags kyu dmar po bzung //thod pa 3bskam rlon do shal stag sham gsol//spyan gsum zha khas bgrad rang 'dra'i gnod sbyin 'phro//g.yas su sprul pa'i mon pa bdun rgyug cing //bshan pa nag po bdun ni g.yon phyogs rgyug/gnod sbyin gdug pa'i dmag tsho gos 'khor gyis bskor//dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad za zhing brlag/mdun du lcags sdig 'jigs rung khro zhing gtum//gnyer mas lus khyab kha dgu mig dgu bgrad//ba skru'i khung las sdig pa bye ba 'phro//rkang lag gnam sa gang bas rgyal bsen 'dul//snying khrag 'jib cing rtsa rjes gcod par byed//mdun du lcags kyi mi reng mun pa'i mdog/ral nag rked par sleb las mtsho ni cha 'phro//g.yas pa zil gnon phyag rgya'i rtse mo las/khyung 'gyed g.yon pa sbrul zhags dgra bgegs 'ching //rked par spu gri'i 'khor lo drag 'khor bas//dgra bgegs gtub cing lcags spyang nag po bcibs//de yi g.yas su lcags kyi mi reng nag/g.yas pa dgra stas dgra bo'i lus srog gcod//g.yon pa sbul gyi zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching //g.yo/ du lcags kyi mi reng nag po ni//g.yas pa ral

gter kha 'og ma'i rta nag lcags ral can gyi las byang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ nang ma rtog)gri'i 'khor los dgra bgegs gtub/ /g.yon pa thod nang gtor ma gtso la stob/ /snga phyi gnyis na zangs kyi mi reng dmar/ /g.yas pa lcags kyi ber gas dgra bgegs brdung / /g.yon pa tsit+ta dmar po gtso la stob/ /kun kyang gtum 'jigs khro rngams rgod cing dpa'/ /sgeg 'bar gshe ba gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan/ /mthong tshad 'dzin cing zin tshad gsol cing za/ /stong gsum rab gang zhal nas sngags sgra 'ur/ /gzhal yas phyi rol khro bcu sku (4na)mdog dkar/ /nang gzigs g.yas pa 'khor lo g.yon bum las/ /tshe yi bar gcod sel zhing dngos grub stsol/ /de'i phyi gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan/ /phyir bstan g.yas 'khor dregs pa pho rgyud gcod/ /nang bstan g.yon 'khor dregs pa mo rgyud gcod/ /phyi rol gnam lcags rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /ra ba dra ba gur khar sra zhing brtan/ /mi chod mi shigs bser bu'i rlung mi thar/ /phyi nang mtshon cha sna tsho gis bu yug 'tshub/ /dmigs pa'i gnod byed tshal pa dum bur gtor/ /phyi rol ye shes me dpung dmar nag mdog /'ur 'ur 'bar bas sdang dgra gnod byed dang / /byad ma rbod gtong bsregs te brlag par gyur/ /dbang bskur ba ni/ā+oṃ āḥ/ swā hā/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/ /bdag nyid snga rabs sku che yan lag rags/ /lha tshogs kun kyang 'od zer phung por ldan/ khams gsum dus gcig sgrol nus dbang thob gyur/ /spyan 'dren ni/ gnas gsum 'byu gsum mtshan las 'od 'phros pas/ /'og min gnas nas lha tsho gis sa mā dza mi zhugs su gsol ba ni/ sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ /phyag bya ba ni/ a ti pu ho bra tī ts+tsha 〉 phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan rta mchog rgyal po 'khor bcas la yon chab me tog bdug spos mar me dang / /dri chab zhal zas rol mo sgra yi tshogs/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a khra ta/ rak+ta dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyil/ /dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma'i tshogs/ /yab yum mnyam sbyor bde ba chen po sogs/ /phyi (4ba)nang gsang mchod 'bul gyisabazhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a / puṅge 4 pe/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ ne waṃ ju/ sha lda pā dza me gha hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ha ya gi ba sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ ā+oṃ pad+ma kro ta ha ya shrī ba kwa la rū pa i rda ba sla ta kha raṃ khā hi/ badz+ra—231

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (geraka/ya ka kā la /badz+ra ka ru ḍa/ru ra bha sha nag po las mkhan spu gri 'khor bcas kyi zhal du/ma hā mo sa khā hi/ma hā ba su ta/ma hā go ro tsa na/ma hā ke ni ri ti/bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha hoḥbastod pa ni/hrī:snang ba mtha' yas pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal//thugs rje'i zlos gar khro rgyal rta mchog dpal//ya ka me dpal gnod sbyin sdig pa 'byud//zangs lcags mi reng 'khor dang bcasal bstod//'dzab bzla ba ni gzhung nas bshad pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī wa hūṃ phaṭa/ces ci nus bzla zhing /bsnyen pa thengs nas drag sngags ring mo man ngag ltar nyams su len/thugs dam bskul zhing 'phrin las 'chol pa ni/dpal chen rta mgrin nag po sku bzhengs 'tshal//khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//dam rdzas brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes nas//rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la//gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rgyal bsen klu gnyan dang //sa bdag steng 'og bar gyi 'byung po sogs//dgra bgegs kun gyi nus stobs thal bar rlog/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol//tshogs mchod nyin star mi gtong ba'i dbang du byas te lasabyang chen mor gsal bas 'dir ma bkod/ha ya gi ba'i yig ldan ) brgyas lhag chad kha bkang /nongs pa bzod par gsol//dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/snod bcud gzhal yas de yang 'khor la thim//'khor rnams gtso bo de nyid sngags phreng dang //rim gyis gyis par btags nas//nā da'i bar thim ka dag klong nas ldang //smon lam ni/rta mchog bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i mthus//bdag sogs 'gro rnams gnod byed bdud sdo las//rnam par rgyal te rang rig dbang chen lha//gdod ma'i mgon po tshe 'dir mngon gyur shog mas brjod ni//sgeg dpa' mi sdug sku yi bkra shis shog/rgod drag 'jigs rung gsung gi ba po shis shog/snying rje rngam zhi thugs kyi ba po shis shog/he ru ka yis dus kun bkra shis shog/ces sogs bkra shis bya zhing me tog gi char dbab bo//de yang bsnyen pa'i thog mtha' dang sgrub pa dbang sogs kyi skabs las byang rin chen 'phreng ba dang sgrub thabs gcig tu bsdebs nas gter gzhung bcos med /mas su len dgos shing /'dir ni rgyun 'byer

gter kha 'og ma'i rta nag lcags ral can gyi las byang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ nang ma rtoganagyi dbang du byas pa yin no/ /snyigs dus mi bsrun rgyal bsen sa bdag klu/ /'joms byed gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i thog /nag po lcags ral 'phrin las nyin mor byed/ /skal bzang snying gi mun pa sel ba'i dpyid/ /de 'dra skyon mkhan po pad+ma zhes/ /srid pa gsum na che ba'i rigs sngags 'chang / /gang de'i thugs bcud chos kyi dbang phyug la/ /bka' babs 'di ko bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ kha brod snyan po'i tshig gis gzhan gyi blo/ /sgyur byed gdol gtam ma yin nges don du/ /tshul 'di nyams su bstar na (5ba)khams gsum gyi/ /gdon bgegs ma lus 'dus kyang nyam mi nga de skad zhi khro kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha'i/ khyab bdag dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /gdul bya'i snang ngor rdo rje'i slob dpon gzugs/ /rnam rol nyang ston dam pa'i drin las rnyed/ /zla gzhon ltar dkar dge ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /srid zhi'i nyes brgya'i tsha gdung kun bcil nas/ /smin grol ga bur zegs ma'i thigs pa yis/ /snying gi bum bzang rtag tu 'geng bar shog /ces gter kha 'og ma'i rta nag lcags ral can gyi las byang rgyun khyer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di ni mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gnyis kyis bskul ba la brten nas 'dri 'dun yod kyang re zhig 'gyangs pa sngags rams pa blo bzang don grub bcad rgya'i skabs bskul bas rkyen byas te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /sarba maṅga lo// //—253

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ger༅༅/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub chen gyi chog sgrigs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar zhes bya ba bsdos/sa theg/ /dpal ldan zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbang phyug rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /dbyer med drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gus pas btud nas dpal chen phur ba yi/ /sgrub chen sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrigs/ /bka' gter khungs thub phyag bzhes gzhud yig dang / /rigasa'adzin dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ /lha brag gter gyi rgyan du 'di na spel/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhin sa bcad drug /dang po phun sum tsho gos pa lngas 1 / /sgrub pa'i gzhi ni bca' ba dang / /gnyis pa 2 sta gon rnam pa lnga/ /'di yan sngon 'gro'i khrigs su gsal/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor 'dri la 3gsum/ /bzhi pa slob ma 'jug la gsum/ /lnga pa dngos grub sgrub la gsum/ khrug pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ /'di rnams dngos gzhi'i khrigs su nges/ /spyi don dang po sgrub khog tu gsal/ /spyi don gnyis pa sngon 'gro sta gon la/ /sa chog dang zhan byung bsod nams kyi dpung (2na)bskyed ba/ lha sta gon slob dpon sta gon/ dbang rdzas sta gon slob ma sta gon dang lnga/ rtsa ba'i dang po la/ brtag pa/bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba bzhi las/ dang po sa brtag pa gzhan du gsal/ gnyis pa bslang ba la gnyis kyi/ snang ba la bslang ba sgrub khog tu gsal/ gnyis pa mi snang ba la bslang ba ni/ dkar gtor dang dmar gtor phyag len ltar bshams te/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a khru ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ā+oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ā+oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dngas shing thogs pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ//hūṃ/ dgongs shig sa bdag lha klu sde dang dpung / /gangs ri g.ya' ri lu ma skyed mos tshal/ /mtsho rdzing 254

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganalteng ka so so'i gnas rnams nas//lha klu sa bdag gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi//'dzam bu gling bzhi sgrub pa'i sa bslang phyir//gtsang sbyar bdud rtsi 2bskoto me ma 'di bzhes la//rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol//sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pas bdud btul te sangs rgyas/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yang /sa gzhi rin po che'i steng du mdzad pa lags pas/de dang rjes su mthun par/rigs pa 'dzin pa bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis tshogs chen po gnyis rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du/gnas 'dir dpal chen po rdo rje phur pa'i pho brang 'debs par 'tshal bas/sa bdag lha klu/sa yi lha mo bstan ma dang bcas pa thams cad sa glud chen po 'di khyer la bdag gi sgrub pa 'di dbu btsugs nas mjug ma thon gyi bar du gnas gzhan du 'phos la/sa gzhi brtan zhing bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/gsum pa sa sbyang ba la gsum las/lto 'phye gzhan du gsal/gnyis pa sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba ni/rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu bloḥsarba dharmaḥswā bhā wa shurnyo3nya/gsum pa ting nge 'dzin rgyas sbyang ba ni/hūṃ/bdag nyid las kyi he ru gaḥ/rngam brjid khros par rab bsgoms te//spyan mig g.yas g.yon nyi zlar bskyed//rdo rje 'grosakyis rab bskor zhing /khro bo'i sdang mig rab tu blta//'gying bag tshul du rab tu brjid//zhal nasahūṃ phaṭa 'brug sgra sgrog/spyan las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis//ma dag mes bsregs chu yis bkrus//dur khrod 'bar ba'i sa gzhin gyur//ā+oṃ sur+ya tsaṇ+ḍa tha la dzā la hūṃ phaṭa/bzhi pa sa3na〉zung ba ni/gtso 'khor rnams chas su bcug/'am pas dang bcas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sar bskor zhing 'khod de/phyogs rnams su mchod pa bsham/ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha a skṛ ta li kuṇ+ḍa hūṃ/tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las ban+ta 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dngas shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/zhes pas brlab/ā+oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+rad+ku pe hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra pu 〉 hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra ga rnye hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra ut+ta pa la ye hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra bi spu ra ye hūṃ/zhes phyi mchod dang /gdod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2genas rnam dag rtsa brgyad stong sbyar ba/ zhes pa nas/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ zhes sman phul/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ shar nas/ e ma ho/ mchog tu gsang ba yum gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /dus gsum 'du 'bral med par rtag tu sbyor/ /gnyis med thig le byang chub dag pa'i sku/ /byang chub rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sku/ /phyag rgya rdzogs pa kun gyi gnas/ /mtha' gnyis las ni rnam rgyal ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /lho nas/e ma ho/ rol pa'i cho 'phrul che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /bka' yi 'khor lo gsang ba'i yon to ston/ /thugs rje'i cho 'phrul chos kyi char yang 'bebs/ /gsang (3bsngags bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi bdag bdud ni tshar gcod cing / /mi mthun log lta 'joms mdzad pa/ /yon tan rin cen kun gyi gnas/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /nub nas/ e ma ho/gsung gi thigs pa thugs kyi rgya mtsho'i klong / /lung dang man ngag gtan tshigs chos kyi mdzod/ /dus gsum rnal 'byor dbang phyug bgrod pa'i bshul/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam par sbyong / /rdo rje gsung ni kun 'byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /byang nas/ e ma ho/ dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi thugs kyi thugs/ /mi nub chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin byed pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge chen por dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje las mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ khams gsum kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /'byung gnas kun gyi gzhin gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas khro bo'i nga rgyal gsor zhing / rdo rje'i 'gros kyis byang shar du song la/e ma nga ni rang byung ba'i/ dpal chen khro rgyal nyid kyi sku/ /bdag nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku las khro chung thog ser 'phro/ /ye shes me dpung phyogs bcur 'bar/ /'byung po gdon gyi tshogs rnams kun/ /glud gtor byin cing bka' bsgo yang / /mi nyan (4na)'dug pa'i tsho gis yod na/ /lus sems thal ba'i rdul bzhin du/ /brlag par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /de —256

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo na drag po zor gyi wen las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganabs 'di min gzhan du spos/ /gī lā ya brjod cing / rol mo'i sgra dang thun gyis brab/ de nas dpal chen po'i 'gying 'chams/ rigs bzhi'i gyad 'chams/ khro bcu'i stang stabs/ khro mo bcu'i gar 'chams/ sgo ma bzhi'i 'dur 'chams sogs bya/ gī lā ya'i sngags dbyangs stang stabs dang bcas pa'i rjes su phur pa gdab cing / ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ kā ra hūṃ/ bar ho 'byung po gha dzo gha pa / phaṭa/ces pa nas stobs po che'i bar spel tshig sbyor lugs 'dra/ zhar byung bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed pa ni/ sbyin gtong / byu gsung rab klog pa/ gtong ma gtor ba sogs sgrub khog tu gsal/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa lha sta gon la/ phyi mtshams rgyal chen/ bar mtshams dam sri mnan cing sgo byang gdags pa/ma tram bsgral zhing nang gsang gi mtshams bcad pa/ dkyil 'khor bzhengs zhing bsnyen pa bya ba dang bzhi/ dang po phyi mtshams rgyal chen sdo bzhi la gtad pa ni/ phyogs bsnyo mtho brtsigs/ shing ras kyi byang tsag gang bde'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ badz+ra a skṛ tas bsangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya sngags bcas sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis mchod pa dang / gtor ma sa bslang ba ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ /dkar ser dmar ljang hūṃ chen bzhi/ /'phros 'dus 'od du zhu ba las/ /(4bgyi shes rgyal po bzhi ru gyur/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /thogs pa med par 'dir spyon la/ /dam tshig pa dang ro gcig bzhugs/ /gnyis med ngang du gus phyag 'tshal/ /ā+oṃ dz+nyā na rā dza sam ya hūṃ dzaḥ rgyal wo sdo bzhi 'khor bcas la/ /yid 'ong mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /bzhes la mtshams gcod 'phrin lasamadzod/ /〈lha ta rā ma bi ru : ka /bi rū pak+ṣa/ be+e shra wa ṇa ma hā ba li ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ tshar bzhi brjod/gong gi sngags la a lha nas/ sha sna'i bar btags/ / nyu/ ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs na/ /pho brang chen po spos ngad ldan/ /zab cing rgya che gzigs 'phags po/ /rgyal po wo po yul 'khor bsrung / /sku mdog dkar po pi wang 'dzin/ /btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas/ /'bor ni dri za 'bum gyis bskor/ /sdo bo che la stobs po che/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes shar phyogs kyi/ /gdon rnams bzlog —257

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganabagegs snying la:/ khro bo rnams kyis bro brdungs la/ khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs so/ shar du zhi ba'i bro brdungs pas/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar shog /lto ru rgyas pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shog zhub tu dbang gi bro brdungs pas/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud shog /byang du drag po'i bro brdungs pas/ /dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar shog /badz+raki li gī lu ya shan+ti/ puṣ+ṭipā she /mā ra ya phaṭa/ / gnyis pa sgo byang gdags pa ni/ ra sog dang byang ras la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang / rta mgrin/ lug sog dang byang bu sogs la gshin rje'i sku bris pa snga ma sgo gong gi nang dang rjes ma phyi ru btags/ mchod gtor bsham/ byin rlabs rgyal chen gyi skabs ltar bya/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang nag rgya gram dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa dang sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ gshin rje nag po be con dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa rnams skad cig gis badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ sngo rten la thim par gyur/ ā+oṃ a skṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali tshin+ta chitshin+ta dam sri ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya snro wa (6na〉/ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gan ya ma rā tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags gsum po brgya tshar bzla/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kwa ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3hi/ zhes sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs gong gi sngags gsum gyi mjug tu gtor sngagasabatags nas tshar gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ arnya nas/ sha sna'i bar gyis mchode/ hūṃ/ rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku/ /sprul pa'i 'od zer dgra bgegs 'dul/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyil/ /dam sri thal ba'i rdul du rlog /gong gi sngags gnyis brjod/ hūṃ/ gsang chen lhun grub pho brang nas/ /las kyi gshin rje'i rgyal po la/ /bcom ldan chos rjes bka' stsal ltar/ /de bzhin rigs 'dzin sgrub pa pos/ /bka' gsang gzhung chen 'di sgrub pas/ /yang dag don mchog ma thob bar/ /'di la gnod cing bar gcod na/ /lha srin sdebargyad 'byung po'i tshogs/ khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags kyi/ /rnam par smin pa'i chos shod la/ /bla med 'bras bu ma thob bar/ /sa 'di yan chad bgegs ma btang / /phyi khor skyong ba'i mu ran la/ /rdo rje yang dag thub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ya —259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gem ra tsa sa ma ya skye/ zhes brjod/gsum pa ma tre bsgral zhing nang gsang gi mtshams bcad pa la/ ma tre bskal pa dang mtshams gcod gnyis/ dang po la/ ma tre gnas gang la dbang byed pa/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ sngon byung /rjes 'jug gi 'dul (6bzabs/ khog pa ga 'kha yas khang du byin gyis brlab pa/ btul ba'i dgos pa dang drug las/ dang po gsum sgrub khog las shes/ bzhi pa la/ chos nyid kyis ra dul ba dang / cho gas 'dul ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ hūṃ/ ma tre bya ba'i sdig can khyod/ /sngon yang sgrub pa kun nasabasgribs/ /de tshe dpal chen he ru gas/ /bsgral nas dur khrod chen por byas/ khungs dang rtsad bcad gang nas byung / khungs dang rtsad bcad bdag las byung / /bdag med stong pa'i tho bas gzhom/ /ā+oṃ mahā shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ gnyis pa cho gas 'dul ba ni/ ma tre gi gzugs ba khung gi steng du bzhag la/ 'brub khung bskyed/ bden brdar gyi mthar/ ma tre ka ru dra dzaḥ a gar+sha ru dra dzaḥ kha ṭ+wāṃ ka ru dra dzaḥdzaḥ zhes gsum gyis bkug la bstim mo/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ki li gī lwa ya tsit+ta pra pe sha ya shag phaṭa/ ces bsgral/ mgo phyogs ma nor bar 'jog go /hūṃ/ ma tre bya ba'i sdig can khyod/ /rol pa'i stabs kyis mnan pa ni/ /'jigs byed chen po he ru gas/ /mgo ni lho nub mtshams su bstan/ /rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bstan/ khro rgyal zhabs ni g.yas g.yon gyis/ /rgyad kyi dor stabasatshul gyis mnan/ /hūṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka tri ru ka tri sha sngo sa ma ya༈/ ma hā de wa ru dra dzaḥdzaḥ& hūṃ/ gong gi bro 'dir yang byed do/ lnga pa byin gyis brlab pa la dngos dang / sgo dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/༷ dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las ra grangs med pa spros pas/ ma tre gi khog (7na)pa la phog ste/ de nyid dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ ban+ta gsar rnying gi rtsig pa byas pa/ gnam lcags kyi gzer btab pa la rak+ta'i zham chu 'bab pa — lcang lo can gyi kha bad bteg pa/ dregs pa can rnams kyi ka ba btsugs pa/ lha chen brgyad kyis gdung ma byas pa/ lha bran mang pos dral ma byas pa/ zhing lpags kyi thog phub pa/ rin cen rnam bzhis sgo mo —260

dbang ོ yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi tshon las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganabyas pa/rgyan sna tsho gis kyis brgyan pa/nang pho brang rtsibs brgya pa/phyi dur khrod kyi gnas brgyad kyisabargyan pa/de'i phyi rim lcags ri dang me ris bskor bar gyur/gnyis pa sgo dbye ba ni/khu tshur dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bsgreng zhing /༷ pra pe sha ya phaṭa/lan bdun brjod/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ha ha ha/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ces brjod cing bskor ro//drug pa btul ba'i dgos pa sgrub khog las shes/gnyis pa mtshams gcod la gnyis las/dang po nang mtshams ni/hūṃ/bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas//khro rgyal ṭak+ki rā dza 'phros//dmar skya zhal tha ṇi ga phyag gnyis pa//g.yas g.yon tho ba lcags kyu thogs//khros pa phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas//phyogs skyong bcu po bkug nas ni//phyogs bcu kun tu gdan du bting //pho mo gan rkyal kha sbub bsnol//ā+oṃ / bha sogs dang /rjes su/༷ ya ti ra paṃ/byu ye/ya mā ya/ni rdi tu ya/wa ru ṇa ya/bā ya be/ku be rā ya/i sha nā ya/ca brahā ṇi/su rla/tsan+d+ra/a lha 7ba ) bra thi bi ༷ ཿti ra baṃ/dzaḥ& baṃ ho zhes phyag rgya bzhis bgegs rnams bkug/rdo rje slob dpon sogs kyis phur pa bcu po lag tu thogs te/hūṃ/bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas//phyogs skyong bcu yi gdan steng du//'bar ba'i hūṃ bcu lo 5 pa las//'phros 'dus khro bo bcu ru gyur//hūṃ kā ra rnam rgyal dbyug sngon rgyal//gshin rje mi g.yo rta mgrin rgyal//'dod rgyal bdud rtsi khams gsum rgyal//stobs bo che rnams rim bzhin bsgom//kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa//sku stod khro tshul mtshon cha 'dzin//dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan//sku smad lcags phur zur gsum 'bar//phyogs skyong bcu yi snying gar btab//me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na//sprul pa yang sprul bgrang las 'das//bar chad bgegs dpung ma lus pa//rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya//ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ kā ra hūṃ/bar chad 'byung po gha rdza gha rdza hūṃ phaṭa/ces sogs dang /thugs las sprul pa'i khro bcus mi dge bcu//zhes pa nas bzung ste/phur pa'i gur khang mtshams las ma 'da' zhig/ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/gnyis pa gsang mtshams ni/phyi nang /da bcud ma bya/bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bzheng zhing

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebasnyen pa bya ba la bzheng ba/ rgyan dgram pa/ 'phrin las gyer zhing 'dzab bya ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ sbyang ba/ thig tshon byin gyis brlab pa/ thig gdab pa dang gsum/ dang po sbyang ba ni/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod cing dri bzang gi chus gtor/ (8na)bdud rtsi lnga'i snod thogs te/ chos dbyings dag pa'i bdud rtsi mi bskyod pas/ /rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsang med du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /ā+oṃ ma hā mu lha maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ de bzhin du 'dod pa re/ me long dag pa'i bdud rtsi rnam snang 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i sku yi tsha / bka' gsang sogs 'gre /ā+oṃ ma hā bi tra maṇ+ḍal ā+oṃ/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i bdud rtsi rak+ta 'dis/ rgyal ba'i yon tan/ sogs/ ā+oṃ ma hā ru dhi ra maṇ+ḍal swā/ kun rtog dag pa'i bdud rtsi byang sems 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi —/ bka' sogs chu ma hā shukla maṇ+ḍal eḥ bya grub dag pa'i bdud rtsi sha chen 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las / ā+oṃ ma hā rma sa maṇ+ḍal hā/ gnyis pa thig tshon byin rlabs ni/ thig tshon phyag len ltar bsham mchod pa gong ltar brlab/ badz+ra a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ ā+oṃ hūṃ swā e hā lngar gyur pa thig tshon lnga so so'i gnas su babs pa las/ dbus su ā+oṃ dkar po las snurnya gī lā ya dkar po smad zhi ba'i phur bu zlum por bzhugs pa/shar du hūṃ sngon po las badz+ra gī lwa ya mthing kha smad drag po'i phur bu gru gsum du bzhugs pa/ lhor swā ser po las rat+na ki la ya ser po smad rgyas pa phur bu gru bzhir bzhugs pa/ nub tu e dmar po las pad+ma gī la ya dmar po smad dbang gi phur bu zla gam du bzhugs pa/ byang du hā ljang gu las dme ki la ya ljang gu smad las kyi phur bu gru gsum du bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang dur khrod kyi chas sa brgyan pa/ rang 'dra'i yum dang gnyis su med pa'i spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ badz+ra sa ma ya dza/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a: nas/ sha rdi'i bar —262

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2poma'i thig drug gdab par bya/ /de rjes dkyil nas zur thig bzhir/ /dkyil 'khor che chung gang byed dang / /'tshams pa'i dum bu drug bcad pa'i/ /mtshan ma btab la phyi ma gnyis/ /thig gis legs par phye ba yi/ /nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu yin/ /phyi ma phyed gdab phyi ma bgo /dra ba dra phyed mda' yab lo/ /tshangs thig g.yas su cha chen gnyis/ /nang ma phyed gdab phyi ma bgo /sgo dang sgo khyud sgo logs thig /phyi ma bzhin bgos rtsig pa mun/ /ka ba ka rgyan g.yon la'ang 'gre /pu shu'i steng nas cha chen bzhi/ /btab pa'i nang ma gsum po dag /thog mtha' bzhin bgos dbus ma yi/ /dkyil la cha phran gcig gdung ma/ /de lhag mdun rgyab mun pa ste/ /de yang ka rgyan steng nas/ /cha phran gcig then gcig phyir bskyed/ /gsum then nang du gnyis bskum la/ /cha phran gcig then gcig phyir bskyed/ /cha phran gcig then gnyis nang bskum/ /gnyis then gcig bskyed gsum then rjes/ /gnyis bskum gcig bskyed rta babs so/ /glang rgyab dpangs su cha phran brgyad/ tshangs pa'i thig nas g.yas ngos su/ /cha chen gcig gzhal mun steng nas/ /gcig then gnyis bskyed gsum then zhing / /gcig bskum gcig then gcig bskum gcig /then zhing gcig bskum gnyis then gsum/ /bskum de g.yon phyogs la yang 'gre /cha chen bzhi pa dbus dor te/ /mtha' gnyis btab pas pad+ma dang / /'khor lo gdugs (10na)kyi thig tu 'gyur/ /rdo rwa rtsig pa nas brtsams pa'i/ /cha chen gsum gyi steng dag nas/ /g.yas g.yon rwa nang gsum dang ni/ /phyi ma lnga nasabaskor bas tsā ba/ /pad+ma dang ni dam can gnyis/ /tshad la cha phran gsum gsum yin/ /rdo rje'i rwa ba cha phran gcig /dur khrod me ri cha chen re/ /lugs 'di dag la skabs 'gar ni/ /pad+ma sna tsho gos rdo rje'i rwa/ /bzhag nas khrag mtsho byed pa'i tshe/ /'khor lo'i rtse nas mu khyud dag /bskor ba'i khyamasal 'dri ba yin/ /snga 'gyur lugs srol 'ga' zhig la/ /dur khrod nang du cha phran gnyis/ /bskor ba khrag khyams srung ma'i sa/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur lugs srol gyi/ /rta babs snam bu bzhi byed na/ /dngos gzhi sngar dang 'dra ba la/ /mda' yab stong nas cha chen gnyis/ /nang ma bzhin bgos rta —2yo

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganababs dang / /glang rgyab dpangs dang g.yas g.yon du/ /cha phran gsum re dag gis 'grub/ /rdo rwa rtsig pa nas drangs pa'i/ /cha chen gnyis steng g.yas g.yon du/ /gsum dang lnga ni gong ltar bskor/ /dkyil 'khor nang gi thig dag ni/ /dbus nas sgo mtshams bar dag tu/ /zlum thig gcig dang nang cha phran/ /gcig dor bskor ba phyi'i mu khyud/ /nang du cha phran lnga dor nas/ /bskor ba'i zlum thig rtsibasabacu po/ /'chos don yin gyi de rjes dbyi/ /de nas nang du che chung gnyis/ /dor te bskor zhing slar gcig dor/ /bskor bas lte ba'i zlum thig go /lte ba dag nas mu khyud kyi/ /(10bskong mar bya rjesabatsal nas ni/ /phyogs gsum btab pas gru gsum mo/ /cha phran dgu dang bzhi cha gcig /gzhal ba'i tshad kyis lho byang gi /tshangs thig bar du bskor nas ni/ /gzhal te mtshan ma lnga btab pas/ /rtsibs rtse 'byung ngo phyogs gzhan 'gre /tshad nges rtse mo nas brtsams nas/ /sngar gyi zlum skor gsum pa'i steng / /then nas bskor bas rtsibs rnams 'grub/ /de yang rab rdul tshon dang 'bring ras bris su bshad pa ni sgrub khog tu shes shing / bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs sogs su sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma 'jug par gsungs pa gsar ma ba dag gi blor mi chud kyang rtog dpyod kyi gnas ma yin mod/ 'on kyang 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ 'dir bsdus pa rang sngags brjod cing dri bzang gi thig le'i steng du tshom bu bkod do/ /gnyis pa rgyan dgram zhing / mchod pa bya ba ni/ rgyas pa sgrub khog tu shes la/ bsdun sman raka gtor gsum mchod pa sogs phyag len ltar ro/ /gsum pa 'phrin las gyer zhing 'dzab bya ba
