ni/skyabs 'gro nas bzung / phur srung bka' sdod bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pa'i bar las byang ltar btang / 'dzab cung zad bzla/ dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha tsho gis rnams/ /nye bar dgongasashig mchod bstod bsgrub pa'i ched/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri bar bgyi na sta gon la/ /gnas de byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa slob dpon sta gon ni/ sgrub khog tu gsal/ rtsa ba'i bzhi pa dbang rdzas sta (11na tshe gon la bum pa bum rdzas/ zhan la rdzas gzhan gyi sta gon dang gsum/ dang po —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'al phyi nang gsang gsum las/ phyi nang gi bum pa gnyis ni slob ma la dbang mi bskur kyang dngos grub kyi rdzas su dgos pas/ dang po phyi'i bum pa sgrub pa ni/ bum pa bcu gnyis sogs phyag len ltar bsham/ mchod gtor byin rlabs lha sta gon ltar bya/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las : las bum pa gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang a las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen pos gang ba/ der pad+ma'i sdong po lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i steng du/ badz+ra rta pad+ma su rla tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal ru dra du tri e sarba tsho/ lte bar rdo rje brag chen pad nyi'i khri/ zhes pa nas/ 'dzab kyi bar lasabyang ltar dang / de nas bzlas pa grub rjes/ las bum nang du pad+ma nyi ma'i steng / /hūṃ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ni/ /ljang nag g.yas pa rgya gram g.yon dril bu/ /rab 'dzin gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum gyis/ /mtshan pa dag las 'od los ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang gnyis med gyur/ /dbang lha spyan drangs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dbang bskur don yod grub pas dbu brgyan gyur/ /ā+oṃ ji nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchode/ a skṛ ta brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas rjes/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blug ste/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ dang hūṃ lan bdun bzlas/ lha thams cad 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi semasakyi chus gang bar (11ba〉spyar/ gnyis pa nang gi bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ thod pa rdzas bcas phyag len ltar bshams te sgrub tshul lhan cig pa'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i bum pa dbang chog tu gsal/ gnyis pa bum rdzas/ gsum pa dbang rdzas gzhan rnams ni sgrub khog tu shes/ rtsa ba'i lnga pa slob ma sta gon ni/sgrub khog dang dbang gzhung du gsal/spyi don gsum pa dkyil 'khor 'dri zhing sgrub pa la/ tshon bkye ba/ rdzas 'god pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed cing ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang gsum/ rtsa ba'i dang po tshon bkye ba ni/ hūṃ/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /bde 'byung rigs lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems can ma lus sgral ba'i phyir/ /tshon gyi las 'di bdag gis brtsam/ /zhes brjod cing tshon bkye'o/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rdzas 'god pa la rgyan/ mchod rdzas/ dbang rdzas/ dngos grub kyi rdzas/ lha'i rten rdzas dang —266

dbang ོ yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganalnga/ dang po ni/ mtshan ldan brnya phur pa ral gri mda'/ /me long tshon skud dra ba yol ba dang / /zhing lpags bla bre 'phan gdugs rgyu ma'i 'phreng / /mar me dang bcas rgyan rnams bzhugs su gsol/gnyis pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ /phyag len ltar ro/ /gsum pa dbang rdzas ni/ sgrub khog tu gsal/ bzhi pa dngos grub kyi rdzas ni/ rgyan 'god du song / lnga pa lha'i rten rdzas 'god pa la/ rten bsham pa/ gzi byin bskyed cing byin gyis brlab pa/ 'god pa dngos dang gsum/ dang po ni phyag len ltar bsham/ gnyis(12na〉 ni/ sngags bzla zhing byug bdug brab gsum byas la/ 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ phur pa chos sku 'gyur ba med pa las/ /sogs brjod cing rdo rje slob dpon gyis mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi phyag bzhes byang gter phur bu lugs gsum gyi bka' srol ltar byed do/ /gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bde gshegs 'khor lo rab bris thod pa'i sku/ /gsang ba sngags kyi yig 'bru rnam par bkra /gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba rtse lnga pa/ /yon tan bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs su gsol/ /dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa yang / /lha chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+raki li ki lwa ya di lta tsakra badz+ra sa ma ya — / steng nas rang byung ca/ sangs rgyas kun gyi / chos dbyings rdo rje'i / hūṃ mdzad rdo rje sgra 'byin bcas/ /phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /tshangs pa bsnol ba'i / dgyes shing brtan par / ā+oṃ badz+ra / shar nas / sangs rgyas / chos dbyings / rnam rgyal rdo rje rnam bsnyems bcas/ /phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbang dang / /brgya byin / dgyes shing — / ā+oṃ badz+ra / me nas / sangs rgyas /(12ba)chos dbyings / dbyug sngon rdo rje sder mo bcas/ /phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo /dbang dang —/ me lha / dgyes shing brtan / ā+oṃ badz+ra / lho nas / sangs rgyas kun gyi / chos dbyingasaḥ/ gshin rje dur khrod bdag mor bcas/ /phra men sha ba lug pa'i mgo /dbang dang —/ gshin rje / dgyes shing /267

dbang r+pā yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganapo ye shes sems/ /'dzab kyi rgyud bskul rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs/ /a las 'phros pas stong gsum sku yis gang / /ma gsal bar du bskyed cing gsal bar bsgom/ /ma 'grub bar du ting 'dzin mi btang ngo / /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lā ya sarba bi lhan (13bsda hūṃ phaṭa/ dzaḥ& a/ zhes bsnyen sgrub gzhung ltar bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa nyul le bskrad pa ni/ rdzas dmigs pa sogs phyag len rnams gzhus ltar/ hūṃ/ shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas/ khrag mdog dmar mo bse yi lan phran can/ /spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi zla'i zer ltar 'phro/ /smin ma glog 'byug mun pa'i go skabs 'byed/ /bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug /bshad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams/ /rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar/ /ag tsho mes me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa bsreg /snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug sgra ldir ri ri/ /lag pa dmar po spu gri 'bum gyis gtams/ /sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la bskal me 'phro/ /ba skru rdo rje gnam lcags zhun ma zhabrug /smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chu'i char pa 'bebs/ /zhal gyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir/ /ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs/ /mi bzad gtum chen sha za khrag 'thung ma/ /srin po dregs pa'i snying 'byin chang par 'dzin/ man tu mi bzad 'bar ma'i sku gcig ma/ /dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol/khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha/ /sku la na bza' sprin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol/ /phyogasabacur kha bltas phyogs skyong dregs pa mnan/ /bdud la babs na snying za bdud dpung 'jig khra la babs na srog gcod sri phung 'jig /(14na rko gra la babs na dgra rtsa drung nas gcod/ /bgegasal babs na rus pa rdul du rlog /dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul/ /dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po dgra bgegs sogs/ /phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying gsol/ khru bu gru ma a pa tsa/ /ru pa tsi ri ra tsa ṇa thun a/ na sha pre bha yag byi na ya/ phye ma phye ma/ rdul phran rdul phran/ tsit+ta rbad/ ces bskul lo/ /de nas byin 'bebs pa ni/ mi lag gi g.yab dar bshug pa'i sgra dang bcas—269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogete gzhung bzhin no//'di nas dgongs star gyi sgrub pa ma thon bar 'dzab 'bul dgos pa yin no//rtsa ba'i gsum pa dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ni sgrub khog tu gsal/spyi don drug pa dbang bskur ba la/dbang bskur ba dang /dngos grub len pa gnyis/rtsa ba'i dang po gzhung du shes/rtsa ba'i gnyis pa la/bdag don du dngos grub blang ba/gas don du dbang bskur ba/mjug bsdub dang gsum/dang po la/ngo bo ngos gzung ba/blang ba'i cho ga/thob pa'i yon to no//dang po ni sgrub khog tu gsal/gnyisapa blang ba'i cho ga la/rdzas bsham pa/bgegs bskrad pa/dngos grub bsdu ba'i bzlas pa/lha gnad la dbab pa/gtor tsho gis kyi mchod pa bya zhing blang ba/bsdu zhing bstim pa dang drug/dang po ni phyag len ltar bsham/gnyis pa ni/mtshams gcod 14ba7sa byang ltar byed/gsum pa ni phyag len ltar byin phob/bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs/gī lwa ya'i mjug tu/sarba pañtsa a khru ta kuṇ+ḍali sarba sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ/zhes btags pa brgya rtsa dang ā yu rnyi hūṃ btags pa bzla zhing dmigs pa bya/bzhi pa ni/hūṃ/rdo rje gzhen nu'i lha tsho gis gnas 'dir gshegs//dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs dngos grub stsal du gsol/gnas 'dir mi gshegs dngos grub mi ster na///thugs bskyed nyams shing dam tshig 'gal bar mchis//ki lā ya'i mjug tu/sa ma ya dzaḥs ma ya hūṃ/zhes pa lan bdun bzla/lnga pa ni/khrag chang bzed zhal dang bcas pa phyag len ltar bsham/hūṃ ring lan gsum dang bcas te rak+ta 'phyar/de bzhin du chang yang phyar te/hūṃ/rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams//dang por skyabs mgon ye shes lha//bar du bsgrubs pas yi dam lha//da lta gnyis med chos kyi sku//rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul//mchod pa bzhes la dngos grub stsol//sa ma ya hoḥs ma ya ra/gī lā ya'i mjug tu/ma hā rak+ta khā hi/zhes bzla zhing /bzed zhal nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du rak+ta lan gnyis 'bul kho phyag len ltar ro//chang la yang /ma da na yi mchod pa 'bul//zhes tshig rkang lnga pa dang /ma hā rak+ta'i tshab lam hā pañtsa ra 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogos gong bzhin no//15na〉/lhag pa'i ye shes rdo rje phur pa'i lha//rang bzhin dbyings nas rtsol rtog mi mnga' ༷nga //sngon gyi thugs dam rang bzhin byin rlabs

dbang chen yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma (gnani/ /nor bu rin cen dgos 'dod kun 'byung ltar/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gi lha/ /dus las mi g.yel g.yar dam gcig pa'i ngang / /mi zad rin cen rgyan gyi 'khor lo nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /skal ldan rnams la dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khyud 'dzin srid kyi dngosagrub stsal du gsol/ /mi 'dzad gter gyi:/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul2/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i —/ kun bzang mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sman mchod byas pa'i lhag ma nas mtheb srin gyis blang zhing / kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ lha ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes gnas gsum du bzhag /hūṃ/ dgongs shig rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs/ /dpang gyur thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /dang po bsnyen cing bar du bsgrubs/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi las gzhung bsrangs/ /smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud kyang sbyangs/ /zhag dus grangs dang rtags kyang thems/ /ding sang skya rengs dang po'ang shar/ /rdo rje'i nam yang langs la nye/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub rin po che/ /da ni 'gyung ba'i dus la bab/ /rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /lha dang skal ba mnyam par shog /drug pa dngos grub bsdu zhing thim pa ni/ khrag chang rnams phur srung gi gtor mar sbran zhing / ka ṭaṃ ka ṭa ye zhes pa nas bzung ste/ pra ma rna ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar dang / ma ma ba she ku ru nas bzung ste/ ka re ya hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar sbrel ba'i mjug tu rak+ta a mṛ ta la khā hi/ zhes brjod/ slar yang / dgongs shig rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ lha dang skal ba mnyam par shog gi bar brjod/ khrag chang nas gnas gsum du reg pa phyag len ltar ro/ /gsum pa thob pa'i yon tan ni/ sgrub khog tu gsal/ gnyis pa gzhan don du dbang bskur ba la/ slob mas zhu ba dang slob dpon gyis phyin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ hūṃ/ srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung gsol pa/ /rigs 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa la/ khas blangs pa dang / sbyin —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepa dngos/ dang po ni/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /byang chub rdo rjes lam drangs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /skal ldan rnams la sbyin par bya/ /zhes khas blangs so/ /gnyis pa sbyin pa ni/ dbang sgrub (16na khong 'brel ba'i rgyas pa sgrub khog tu gsal/ /skabs 'dir sgrub pa chen po'i mjug tu dngos grub gtso bor blang bar byas te/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams 'brim zhing / /rdo rje gzhen nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams/ /zhes sogs sgro ka gnyis kyi mjug tu/ ki lwa ya dang / kā ya sirnyi sogs brjod/ de nas rdzas bgo ba rgyas pa ni sgrub khog tu gsal zhing /bsdus pa/ dpon slob thams cad kyis longs spyad pa phyag len ltar ro/ /gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ 'bad dang rtsol ba ma dgos par/ /zhes sogs dang / slob dpon mched lcam tsho gos rnamasakyis/ dngos grub rdzas la longs spyad pas/ /tshe ring nad med bar chad zhi/ /mchog thun dngosagrub 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod do/ gter 1 sba sbyin sreg 2 lhag 3 ma zor 4 / /chad mtho 5 bstan skyong 6 gtang rag 7 bsdu ra / /tshon 9 gshegs phur shul 10 bkru ba dang /gshegs 11 yon 12 mar me 13 lus bsrung ba 14 / /phyi nang mtshams srung 15 gtang rag gtong / /smon lam 16 bkra shis 17 gnas srung ba 18 / khyun 19 gyi spyod lam bya ba yis/ /mjug gi las rim rnam par dag /dang po gter sba ni sgrub khog tu shes/gnyis pa ni sbyin sreg gi yi ger gsal/ gsum pa tshogs lhag ni las byang ltar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ zor bsdus pa tsho gis lhag dang 'brel ba'i lugs yod cing / rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bsdus zin nas byed dgos pa yin no/ /(16bsnga pa dang drug pa ho mtho bstan skyong ni las byang ltar ro/ /bdun pa gtang rag ni/ yi dam chos srung rnams la gtong ba lag len gyi zhi dkyus ban no/ /brgyad pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ gtso bo khro bcu khro thabs sgo ba yi/ /ye shes lha yi tsho gis rnams ma lusapa/ /mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /thim pas dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ /snod bcud srung 'khor la thim de dur khrod/ /de nyid gzhal yas khang thim de 'khor dang / /de rnams yum —272

dbang ོ yang gsang lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi tshon las rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma rtoganathim yum yang gtso bor thim/ /gtso bo mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang du gyur/ /bdag nyid skad cig rdo rje srin po'i sku/ /zhes pa nas/ bi du rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ dgu pa rdul tshon gshegs pa ni/ tshangs thig nas brtsams te lte ba'i bar gyi rdul tshon rnams bsub cing bum par blug ste chu bo chen po rol mo sogs dang bcas dor ba phyag len ltar ro/ /bcu pa phur shul bkru ba ni/ gdab phur rnams brtane la/ ā+oṃ ru ru sgru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnya lo tsa ni sarba ar+sha su dha na ye swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing bum chus bkru'o/ /bcu gcig pa mched lcam nang du bshags pa bya ba/ bcu gnyis pa slob dpon la yon dbul ba/ bcu gsum pa mar me'i smon lam rnams ni/ sgrub khog tu gsal/ bcu bzhi pa lus srung ba bsdus pa ni dkyil 'khor bsdu chog gi skabs su song zin cing / rgyas pa (17na〉skrub khog tu gsal/ bco lnga pa nang gi mtshams srung la gtang rag gtong ba ni/ mchod gtor byin rlabs dang / rgyal chen sdebazhi 'khor bcas la/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ bar chad 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar sngar ltar la/mtshams bcad 'phrin las gtang rag tu/ /yid 'ong mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes/ zhes kha bsgyur/ de bzhin du shar phyogs gdon bzlog gtang rag tu/ /mchod gtor 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ lho phyogs sogs la 'gre mchod gtor brlabs la/ sgo byang gdags pa'i sngags gsum gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul ba nas/ sa ma ya sto/ zhes pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ dam sri thal ba'i rdul brlag pa'i/ /gtang rag ched du mchod pa dang / / gtor ma 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ zhes dang / rdo rje yang dag thub mdzad pa'i/ /gtang rag / gtor mcha/ so sor brtan bzhugs bya/ bcu drug pa smon lam dang bkra shis ni/ /las byang ltar ro/ /bco brgyad pa gnas srung ba dang/ bcu dgu pa rgyun gyi spyod lam ni/ sgrub khog tu shes so/ /smras pa/ zab mo'i gnad bsdus tshig gi spros bral ba'i/ /jo lugs lha brag zab mo'i gter kha la/ /'khrul med spros pa'i lag len gyis brgyan pas/ /snga 'gyur chos tshul spel ba'i dga' ston byas/ /gsar rnying bka' gter (17ba)man ngag dang bral zhing / /gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs lhur —273—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gelen phur pa mkhan/ /de 'dra'i gral du 'gying bag ma dgos par/ /pad+ma'i ring lugs mchogo la ngesapa rnyed/ /dge des ma rig tshogs dang bstan pa'i dgra /don dang rtags kyi phur bus yongs bsgral te/ /gnas skabs srid 'byor don kun rab 'grub cing / /mthar thug gdod ma'i lam de mngon gyur shog /sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i phur sgrub dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ /bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub chen dang / gter kha 'og ma/ glisangs rgyasang pa/ rat+na gling pa gsum gyi phur pa nas kha 'geng dgos pa rnams bskang / rtsa 'chams sogs la nyer mkho rnams sa phur lha khra nas btus/ gtso bor lugs 'di ga'i thun mong ma yin pa lha brag gter byon gyi bka' brgyad dang phur pa/ rigs 'dzan chen po yol mo ba'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge sogs la zhib mor dpyad/ bod 'bangasabade thabs sogs dus rim la dgos pa'i sgrub chen ltar khrigs su bsgrigs/ dbang gi sgrub chen la med du mi rung ba'i zhib cha mang tsam 'dug pa rnams sgrub khog dbang chog sogs tshad thub kyi gzhung gzhan du kha 'phangs/ snga rtsom la lha nag bka' ma dang / sa phur lha khra sogs kyi lhad zhugs pa'i go rim cung zad 'khrugs pa rnams bsdebs nas shin tu dag cing yid brtan du rung bar byas pa 'di ni/mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid zur chen rdo rje 'chang (18na)pad+ma dbang gi grong khyer gyi bka' drin las/ thub bstan spyi dang khyad par gsang chen rnying ma'i ring lugs la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba za hor gyi sngags smyon bla med rdo rje bde 2sag4 mas rtsal gyis rang lo zhe gcig pa la zhus dag par byas nas yang skyor gyi tshul du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo// //—274

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganano༅༅/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /thabs shes zung 'jug bla med snying po bdud rtsi'i gter/ grub pa'i rang gzugs kha sbyor bdun ldan nyin mor byed/ /legs lam 'bum sde'i ches dkar snang bas mi mthun smag /mthar mdzad dus kun dge ba'i dpal stsol rdo rje 'chang / /sras bcas rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig bsdus pa/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /skye dgu dga' skyid ljon 'bras mngar po'i ror /spyod phyir bkra shis dge mtshan rgya mtshor bskyil/ /rnam 'dren ye shes mchog gi snang ba yis/ /rmongs pa'i sngo bsangs las rgyal 'dab brgya 'dzum/ /blo gros bzang po'i 'jigs med chos srid sgra/ /grags pas slar yang 'jig rten thams cad 'gong / /med byung rtag zhi'i dpal dang ldan gyur kyang / /gdul dka'i 'gro la khro chags sgyu phrul gzugs/ /lha lam dbang gzhu ltar bkra'i gzi brjid kyis/ /mchog thun dngos grub mi zad char chen phob/ /ma dag lcags khams lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /gser 'gyur rtsi ltar dngos phal ji snyed pa/ /dam ye dbyer med rten 'byung lhun grub pa'i/ /bsod nams zhing gi (2na〉(ga shing che 'di 'dzugs/ /de'ang / sku gang ra btuganas bya ba/ /de la de yi dkyil 'khor bya/ /yang na rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ slob dpon rang gi gang yin pa/ /de ni dbye ba mthong bas bya/ /zhes pa ltar rab tu gnas bya'i lha/ /slob dpon/ dus/ gnas/ dgos pa/ cho ga /yo byad lta gon sogasamatha' dag 'dzom nas bdag mdun gyi sgrub pas mtshon pa rgyas bsdus skabs thob phye ste/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ shā n+ya tā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ sto ba ldir zhing zhabs zhus pa mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang —275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gechu dang so so'i rdzas rnams kyis yongs su gang bar bsam/ khrus sngags/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga rje snu na pu dza me gha sa mu dra skyo ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes pas dri'i bum pa dang / de nas rim pa bzhin du/ga rje'i gnas su mngar gsum gyi bum pa la/ tri ma dhu dang / zho'i bum pa la/ da dhi dang / gos bu la/pha la dang / 'bru la/ bru hi dang / (2ba 〉 lbas yos la/ la byu dang / sman la/ o ṣa dhi dang / rin po che'i bum pa la/ ma ṇi sna na zhes sbyor/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang las thams cad pa yang bzla/ nang rdzas rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/gzungs bum gyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rten 'brel snying po'i sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ de'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug pa dang / bum pa'i chu de sngags kyi 'phreng ba zhu ba dang lhan cig ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ dang swā hā thog mthar sbyar ba'i rten 'brel snying po bzla/ bgegs sbyang ba ni/ gtor ma rten la bskor zhing / oṃ sarba bisdun na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe saḥ sarba thā kho urla te lpa ra ṇa i me ga ga na — ba phywa de swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la/mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig /ces zhi bas sbyangs/ ting lo dang changs bu rten la bskor zhing rdo rje gsor la mdzo ni bzlas pas lan gsum byas la/ 'di bde bar gshegs pa'i sogs gong bzhin las/ gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ changs bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /gtor ma phyir dor ba ni/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs thams (3na༄da badz+ra sa mā dzaX3/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ rig pa'i —276

rang tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganargyal po khro bo bzhugs su 'tshal//log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na//'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//ā+oṃ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shasta'i bar/hūṃ/chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las//'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing //thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/khro chen 'bar ba'i tsho gos la phyag 'tshal lo//ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang //sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can//gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i skus//ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo//lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing //sdig pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams//nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa//sprul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo//bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na//dpa' bo'i stang stabs rkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs//nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la //gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar//glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs//rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog/khro rgyal bgegs tshogos 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/hūṃ/'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing //bgegs rnams ma lus 'dul ba yi//dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha//3ba tha gegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod//rab gnas cho ga'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i//lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig/nga ni gnas 'dir rab gnas cho ga byed/khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis//gal te nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na//ye shes spyan gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis//mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing //bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za//bdag nyid skad cig rdo rje'i srin po'i sku sogs dang /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /sangasargyas kyi/chos /dge 'dun /dpal chen po rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi /dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang /bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/bde bar gshegasapa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas pa la ༷ra du gcod par brtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegang yin pa de thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas rang rang gi gnas su song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /ki lā ya dang khro bo bcu'i sngags bzlas drag sngags gzhan yang bzla rung / sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi rkang pa gnyis su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon kai nag po la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad du 'dus par gyur/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rkang pa'i 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /rlung g.yos pas lte ba'i me sbar te de'i (4na ya(da kyis snying ga'i kai ded nas sna sgo g.yas nas thon te/ 'dod chags las gyur pa thams cad bya'i rnam pa/ zhe sdang las gyur pa thams cad sbrul gyi rnam pa/ gti mug las gyur pa thams cad phag gi rnam pa bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba thams cad sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs kyi rnam par gyur te til gyi phung po la thim par gyur/ me la sngags kyis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang lasahūṃ las zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po rgyar khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu khyud kha khyer sor bzhi pas bskor ba'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ ye shes kyi thab khung de'i nang du raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal gdangs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kur hūṃ/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur oṃ badz+ra ḍā gi sa pa ri wā ra a lha sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis bstod/ rang gi mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi dbus su yi ge hūṃ 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā glo kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na 'e ku ru ye swā hā/ lan bdun tsam brjod/ slar yang mchod bstod byas/ oṃ —278

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtog)khyed kyis (4ba)sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs dang / badz+ra muḥ thab kyi lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ khrus ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnamasakyi ston pa de dag thams cad la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pas snyan gsan phab/ sku rab gnas can la khrus bya zhing / ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /zhes sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de dag sku la sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas rten gsar pa la khrus gsol ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya be sho dha na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing til mar byug /yang 'dag chal gyis mnye zhing gong gi sngags brjod/ de nas dri'i bum pa la/ 'di ni khrus mchogo dpal dang ldan/ /zhes sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga rnye snu na pā dza me grwa sa mu dra pha ra ṇa sam ya shrī hūṃ/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos nas/ kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā'i bar brjod/ yang sngar bzhin sngags brjod/ rdzas gnyis 'asdug pa 'og ma kun la 'gre/ mngar gsum gyi bum pa la ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / tri ma dhu k+ṣiṃn sogs(ldan skong / mjug tu sku dbyi ba yang gong dang 'dra/ de bzhin du zho'i bum pa la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu sogs dang / da dhi sna na sogs dang / gos bu'i bum pa la/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu sogs dang / pha la snu na sogs dang / 'bras bu'i bum pa la/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu sogs dang / bru hi snu na sogs/ 'bras yos kyi bum pa la/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu sogs dang / la dzi snu na sogs/ sman gyi bum pa la/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu sogs dang / oṃ ṣa dhi snu na sogs/ rin po che'i bum pa la/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu sogs —279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2podang / ma ṇi snu na sogs/ yang bum pa dang po bldabs nas/ chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas sogs dang /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod/ ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi/ /yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis bkru/ de bzhin du/ ma rig 'joms pa'i nyi ma ste/ /srid pa'i nad ni sel ba'i sman/ /dam chos rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis khrus ni gsol bar bgyi/ /chos kyi sku yi bdag nyid can/ /mchog gi yon tan gzugs can gyi/ /mchod rten rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gisakhrus 'di gsol bar bgyi/ /bskal pa'i mtha' yi dngos 'joms pa/ /'jigs byed me yi cha byad can/ /mgon po snying rje'i stobs ldan la/ /bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi/ /mchog tu tshim zhing skal pa bzang / /dam pa'i bdud rtsi mdzes cha byad/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku 'di la/ /bdag (5ba〉shes khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi/ /gdul bya'i sems can gang dag la/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku mang po yi/ /cha byad lha yi rnam pa ni/ /snying rje yis ni nges gang ba/ /rtag tu phan dang bde mdzad pa'i/ /mchog tu dul ba de dag la/ /bdag gis khrusaḥ/ /sangs rgyas gzugs can gnas dang ni/ /slob pa'i dge 'dun gnas kyi sa/ /gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhan la/ /bdag gis khrus ཿ/ /zhesapa'i tshig mtshams rnams re re bzhin gyi mtshams su sngags dang bcas te khrus gsol/ smon lam ni/sku mchog rnam dag lta bas mi sgos la/ /ngo mtshar skyon bral mkha' dkyil nyi gsal 'dra/ /chos kyi sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang / /sri zhu bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'o ma 'dag chal chus/ /'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal nad bsal te/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral 'gro ba'i yid 'ong ba/ /dam pa'i sku mchog bdag gis thob par shog /bde gshegs sku gsum mtshan dang dpe mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang gda'/ /rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang / /'jig rten sri zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du/ /sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /ras mchog 'di yi rgyal ba'i sku sa pas/ /nyon mongs dug gsum sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /sku gsum ngang du bdag —280

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganacag 'gyur bar shog /oṃ /lha hrīḥ.āḥsngar bsto ras kyis sku phyi tshul bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur ba'i/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba 'di dag (6na jug par bgyi/ sngar bar dris ma /rmi bedz+ra garnye swā hā/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim yid 'ong bas/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul/ /gos zung 'bul/ oṃ ā thabadz+ra wasta ye swā hā/ bde byang sems dang longs sku'i cha byad 'dzin pa rnams la rgyan gyi bye brag 'bul tshul byed/ sprul sku dang nyan thos sogs kyi sku yin na 'di mngags so/ /tshul de lta bus ni mnga' dbul sogs kyi skas su'ang 'gro shes dgo so/ /gshegs sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad dang / /rin chen 'od chags 'bar bas skur brgyan cing / /byang chub phyogs kyi rgyan gyis mdzes lags kyang / /'jig rten bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /rin cen phreng ba rtse mo do shal dang / /rgyan gyi dam pa khyad par mchog phul bas/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rgyan dang ldan gyur nas/ /bla med theg pa mchog la gnas par shog /oṃ badz+ra a wā ra ṇa wa su ṣa ṇi swā hā/ rten bskyed pa ni/ a khra tas bsangs/ shu n+ya tus sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du khro bo la raṃ las nyi ma dang / zhi ba la āḥlas zla ba sogs kyi gdan gyi steng du rang rang gi sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ thub pa'i dbang po dang rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs rang rang gi sku mdog phyag mtshan ji lta ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ ngos gzung bar ma nus pa'i sku gzugs rnams/ oṃ āḥlha las rdo rje oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje 'chang badz+ra ku mā ra sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis rdo rje dang / g.yon gsum gyis des yu ba byas(5ba tha'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo rdo rje dang dung khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab dur khrod kyi mas brgyad dang dpal gyi chas dgus brgyan cing / yum khro mo'i chas rnams kyis brgyan pa/ lha khang dang gtsug lag khang bye las 'khor lo du gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang badz+ra ku mā ra sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug —281

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pozhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas gsum 'khor lo dang / g.yon gsum des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo zhes pa nas bzung ste/ khro mo'i chas rnams kyis brgyan pa zhesapa'i bar gong bzhin/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten gdan khri/ bang rim/ bum pa/ bre/ chos 'khor/gdugs tog dang bcas pa/ khang pa rnams rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa so so'i dbus su glang po che/ shar du seng ge /lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du mkha' lding gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la/ dbus su dzo las 'khor lo zlo gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang sogs gong bzhin shar du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa badz+ra ku mā rā sku mdog sngon po sogs dang sa gzhi rnam snang ltar la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par phyag g.yas gsum gyis rdo rje dang / g.yon gsum gyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma gi sngon mo zhes pa tsam yin no/ /lhor e las rin po che e gis mtshan pa las rin 'byung badz+ra ku mā ra sku mdog ser po zhes sogs dang / phyag g.yas gsum gyis rin po che dang / g.yon gsum gyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin cen sgrol ma ser (7na)mo sogs/ nub tu dzi las pad+ma dzi gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med badz+ra ku mā ra sku mdog dmar po zhes sogs/ phyag g.yas gsum pad+ma dang / g.yon gsum des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar mo zhes sogs/ byang du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa badz+ra ku mā ra sku mdog ljang gu zhes sogs/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis ral gri dang / g.yon gsum gyis des yu ba byas pa dril bu 'dzin pa yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu sogs/ po ti rnams paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzi las pad+ma sogs kyi 'od dpag med badz+ra ku mā rar bskyed/ lha rnams kyi kun gzhi la sogs pa'i gnas so sor ha brgyad yongs su gyur ba las kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas 'gyur ba ko ri sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas na byis pa'i ro dbyug pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ yid shes gnas 'gyur tso ri ser mo phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'geng ba/ nyon yid —282

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganaganas 'gyur bra mo ha dmar mo chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ lus shes gnas 'gyur pe ta li mthing nag rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mig shes gnas 'gyur puska si sku mdog dmar ser byis pa'i rgyu ma phyag gnyisakyis drangs nas 'dom gyis 'jal ba lta bu/ rna ba'i shes pa gnas 'gyur gha smi rā ljang gu thod skam nang nas khrag 'thung ba/ sna shes gnas 'gyur sma sha ni ste dur khrod ma sku mdog nag mo byis pa'i snying za ba/ lce shes gnas 'gyur tsaṇ+ḍasnyi sku mdog ser skya phyag gnyis kyis mchog chen mi'i lus stod smad 'brel ba/ brgyad ga'ang gar stabs kyis 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ hūṃ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ badzo r+gha ṭa pra be sha ya hūṃ phaṭa kyis sgo dbye/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sdodapung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma sa /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnams sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral bya'i phyir/ /yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /bco ma'i gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ / zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sal bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchogo thamasacad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'di ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang —283—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('phyug dang //mchog rnams legs par stsal du 8na gi sol/phyir 'brang ba'i bgegs bskrad pa ni/rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa nas bzung ste/bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi bar bgegs sbyang ba'i skabs dang 'dra ba la/ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin 'brangs nas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas pa dang /bde ba mchog gi gnas la bar du gcod pa'i bgegasakyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig/ki lā ya dang / bha brjod/thugs las sprul pa'i khro bcus mi dge bcu sogs brjod/bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs//bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan//bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang //thugs la dgongs bzhin gnang bar mdzod//oṃ badz+ra ga ga na sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/zhes mchod yon phul/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni//zhes pa'i tshig gcig gis khrus gsol//bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir//nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni//ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na//de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa a pa ni tiṣ+ṭha na tu/zhes gdan dbul/de nas thal mo sbyar la/bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das//tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol//bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas ni//bdag kyang blo dang ldan par mdzod//ces gsol nas/mchod pa ni/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya pā dza me gha sa mu tra lpa ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye āḥ&/zhes mchode yon dang /de bzhin du zhabs bsil dang me tog nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchode la/oṃ badz+ra ku sha dzaḥ.au badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/oṃbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥrang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren pa ni/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pasaphyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs badz+ra sa ma dzaḥm lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur nas mchode pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni//dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na//lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar//de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu//'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas//byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang //che ge mo yi don slad du//bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni//ci 'byor pa yi mchod 8༷ rnams//me rtag la sogs 'di bzhes shig/

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma dzadabadag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin rlabs shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha sogs brjod/ rgyas gdab pa ni/lha rnams kyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ /thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /sku ni mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje 'khor lo oṃ/ /sku yi gnas su rgyas gdab bo/ /oṃ na ma mi bo ta zhwagata kā ya badz+ra su bhā wa0yi ko3lha/ āḥrgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /gsung dbyangs drug cu tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /mi 'gag rdo rje pad+ma āḥ/ /gsung gi gnas su rgyas gdab bo/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta lha ska badz+ra swa bhā wa 0 ko3lha/ hūṃ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /thugs ni mi g.yo rdo rje (9na po byings/ /ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje hūṃ/ /thugs kyi gnas su rgyas gdab bo/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa snyu ko3nya/ /bdag gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ o pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhes pa nas/ shri ye hūṃ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang rang gi rigs bdag dang rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa rnams rtsa 'am bas kyi dus kyi mchod pa byin rlabs dang / sman rag gtor gsum byin rlabs bya/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma sogs kyi chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'bul/ /sman rag gtor gsum kyang gzhung bzhin 'bul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis spyi la bstod/ /phur pa'i sgos bstod kyang byed/ chos skyong gi gtor ma btang / de nas snyan gsan ni/ thugs rje yi ni bdag can bdag /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod slad du/ /da ltar rab gnas bgyi bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan gus pas bdag la ni/ /de phyir bka' drin mdzad par 'os rdo —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gerje can bdag che ge mo/ /sku gsung thugs rten rab gnas ni/ /yon bdag ci nus yo byad kyi/ /da lta yang dag bgyid par 'gyur/ /de phyir slob mar bcas bdag la/ /rjes(9ba〉kyi brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /'khor bcas kun gyi rab gnas la/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad par 'os/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon cog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyid par 'tshal na/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams sang nang par byon zhing rten byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag la dngos grub kyi mchog stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ mchod bstod bsdusapa zhig byed yi ge brgya pa brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/oṃ badz+ra ud tig rten gyi ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa las logs su phye ste mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byed/ oṃ badz+ra wasta āḥ&/ zhes pas rten dgab/las sngags kyis bsrung / gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs pa dang / brtan bzhugs sogs lag len dkyus bzhin no/ /sang shogs tho rangs dus dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod btang / bum pa bsgrub pa nas bzung khrus gos rgyan yan sta gon ltar/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgongs pa phun sum tsho gis pa dang ldan pa/chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi (10na)phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa/ de'i nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral zhing / bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas —286

ra pa tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganapar bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa/ cho 'phrul gsum dang / ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bslab pa gsum dang /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang / shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes pa nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnams ma lus par spangs pa dang / bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa dang /mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i (10ba tshe/rgyags kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pa/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod cing de thams cad kyi mthar rab tu gnas bya'i rten la me tog 'thor/ spos kyis bdug /rol mo dbul zhing / chan mo bha ga wa te/ shākya mu ni ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te/ sa mya kle budha ya/ ta du thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ oṃ be+e ro tsa na ā+oṃ swā hā/ ā+oṃ a skyo saḥlha swā hā/ ā+oṃ rat+na saṃ bhā wa lha swā hā/ ā+oṃ a mi tā bhā khyuḥswā hā/ oṃ a mo gha sirnyi aḥswā hā/ zhes dang / rab tu gnasabya'i lha gang yin gyi sngags dang / oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ 'di skad ces/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon cog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi bas de'i mthus bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo / /'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobasgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /semasacan thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa thams cad gsal bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo snyil bar bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi skye ba'i (11na〉sdon shing rtsad nas gcad do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang / phyi rol pa dag dang / lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang ngesapa la gzud do/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la cher stsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me dpung zhi bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ /bden pa la gzud do/ /phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigasapa ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /rten bskyed pa nas ye shesapa spyan drangs/ mchod pa'i bar sta gon bzhin/ de nas/ thugs rje yi ni bdag gzhan dang / /zhes so gosakyi snyan gsan phab/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dgug gzhug byed pa nas bzung sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar kyang sngar ltar dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin mchod nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba (11ba〉btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa rig ma dang bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa kyi rnams sa gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi steng phyogs su 'dzin/glu gar mdzad cing rol mo brdung / me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung —288

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ba po shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtogadazad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyis shis pa brjod/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/dzaḥ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang / dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /mi 'gyur ye shes lha tsho gis kyis/ /dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum brjod/ de nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rin po che/ /dpag tu med pa'i 'od dang ldan/ /rigs mchogo phyag rgya lngar ldan pa/ khams gsum bdag por dbang bskur ro/ /rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṇiñtsa saṃ/ / / lha lha — / de nas rdo rje dril bu gtad la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ thabs dang shesarab dbang chen 'di/ /rdo rje dril bu'i rig pa 'dzin/ /mya ngan 'das shing 'khor ba yi/ /skyon rnams dag pa'i dbang thob shog /chabadz+ra bra dz+nya bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ de nas bum pa blangs la/ hūṃ/ thabasakyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol ci/ /oṃ badz+raki li gī lwa ya sarba bi na baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali tsit+ta badz+ra3 kwa ra āḥ ji ltar (12na〉ltams pa nas shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po dang rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ sman rag gtor ma 'bul ba/ bstod pa rnams sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya/ spyan dbye na/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phagasapa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dhi na swā hā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /ā las skyes pa'i me long / /35ga rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ sems —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gecan don ni mnyam med byos/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo sngags mchod kyis 'bul/mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ rten sgyur ni/ rten rnams mi bskyod badz+ra ku mā ra zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa'i sku de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ bla ma/ sangs rgyas/ byang sems/ nyan thos/chos skyong gi sku bris 'bur tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ glegs bam rnams 'od dpag med badz+ra ku mā ra zhu ba las byung ba'i lung rtogs kyi chos dkon cog dbyangs gsal yi ge'i rnam pa glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur/ gtsug lag (12ba)khang bzang rta babs la sogs pa rnams badz+ra ku mā ra zhu ba las byung ba'i rang rang gi dbyibs can du gyur/ de dag kun kyang bdag dang yon bdag dang /sems can thams cad kyi phyag gi gnas mchod pa'i rten bsod nams gsog pa'i dpal mgon dam par gyur te/ zhal dro/ byin che/ bag dro ba skyob pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ chos skyong rnams kyang bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu stobs nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ brtan bzhugs ni/ me rtag lag len ltar grub pa thogs te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa sogs gur zhal gyi gtor chog gi gsham na yod pa ltar/ bde gshegs kun bzang mthong bas bkra shis ltar/ /rgyal ba sras bcas deng 'dir bde legs shog /ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas/ /rgyal sras rigs 'dzin tshogasarnams 'phel dar zhing / /zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas/ /nyi ltar zhal dro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing / /bdag dang 'gro la zhal dro byin chen nas/ /bskal pa'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ /rlung gis bskal pa 'jig bar du/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ yig brgya lan bdun bzlas te/ /mgon po bskal pa ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /de na 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/mnga' dbul la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ chu gnyis nyer spyod (13na 'ab 'byamasargya mtsho ma sogs kyis rol mo'i bar 'bul/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ nye ba'i sna bdun ni/—290

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganagayul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang / /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang / /yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang / /dga' mgu rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /gang 'dod blta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim/ /thags bzang sreg bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos/ /chu la mi bying ngal dub med pa'i lham/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis/ /zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing g.yin rnams/ /bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /sa bha u pa rat+na/ bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /maṅga la a:saḥ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs/ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sogs/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /sna tsho gos rin cen khams las grub pa yi/ /sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /chos sku'i rang bzhin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med sogs/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad bcom ldan (13ba 'das/ /mtshan tsam thos pa'i ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal skyob/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /be+e ḍūrla yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs sogs/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag —/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag cha/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa ste/ /rdo rje gsung laḥ / /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid —291 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gelas byung / /rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyi'i mnga' dbul la brgyad yod pa/ de nas/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhis legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs shing phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra pu re ṣe āḥ/ swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi byed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas dbul par bgyi/ /(14na thad ga kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /dri med mtshan la bgres pa mi mnga' yang / /dad pas ngur smig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba yis/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchag la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra wasta ye āḥ/ swā hā/rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang /rin cen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra laṅka ra wa su ga ṇa āḥ& swā hā/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' sgyur yang / /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis/ /mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ / bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra pā dza me gha āḥ& swā hā/ mi dbang rin cen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bsam bzhin yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ ma hā sa lta rat+na pā dza me gha āḥ/ swā hā/ rgyal ba'i mgon po dpal gyi lham mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pañtsa bi ma la pā dza megha āḥlha swā hā/ brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang / /ting 'dzin bla bres spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā pā dza me gha āḥ& swā hā/ thun mong gi mnga' (14brko bul brgyad do/ /sku gzugs kyi —292

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganadrug ni/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang / /gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spang phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi 'breg gcad phul ba yis/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mu la āḥ/ swā hā/ zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang / /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi/ /sen mo'i 'breg gcad phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra na ga tshe da dza na āḥlha swā hā/ dbu skra rin cen lcang lo ma dkrugs nga / /mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms skyon bral yang / /bdag blo phyi sbyangs ra rkyen dang 'tsham pa 'di/ /phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ba la shwa dha ya āḥ& swā hā/ dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba bsgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang / /mosapas 'dzin dpyad dam pa phul ba yis/ /'gro bas ye shes bla med thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra āḥlha swā hā/ dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang ba'i tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' sgyur yang / /bdag cag dad pas tshems shing 'bul lags kyis/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra das sho dha ya āḥ& swā hā/ bsnyen bsring mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bos dag na yang / /dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyis/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thos par shog /chabadz+ra ka r+ṇa sho dha ya āḥ& swā hā/ khro (15na)bo'i mnga' dbul ni/ hūṃ/ bla ma dpal chen 'khor bcas la/ /thod skam rin chen dbu brgyan pas/ /'khor ba'i rnam rtog zil mnan nas/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga thob shog /oṃ badz+ra ka pā la mu ku ṭa pū dza āḥlha swā hā/ hūṃ/ bla ma dpal chen:/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcur bcas/ /rgyu mas 'brel ba / /'gro kun bdud sde dag par shog /oṃ badz+ra ka pā la ma la pāḥ / /hūṃ/ bla maḥ/ /thod skam tshangs skud nag pos sbrel/ /do shal 'phreng ba / /'gro kun bdag 'dzin bral bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka pā la ni rti gu ca/ /hūṃ/ bla ma / /glang chen ko rlon dbang pos brgyan/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa 'di:/ /'gro kun gti mug dag par shog /oṃ badz+ra hasti wasta pā:/ /hūṃ/ bla maḥ/ /ru tra'i zhing lpags lcang lo can/ /dbyings dang mnyam pa 'di / /—293—

ra btu gnas pa'i cho ga ba po shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganazung 'jug thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pradz+nyā u pa ya a khyu ya āḥ(16na〉〉 swā hā/ spros pa du mas rab tu rgyas gyur kyang / /ye shes chen po ro gcig gyur pa ltar/ /glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad mchog phul bas/ /'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pusta ka bhan+ta āḥshā swā hā/mchod rten gyi mnga' dbul ni/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe swā hā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos mi nub cing yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig /ces zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa dang / yang na pad+ma lcags kyu'i gdugs dkar gyi cho ga las/ sems can shes bcu ldan gyur cig /bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /sems can lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /kun bzang smon lam 'jug par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā yu te swā hā/ zhes pa gang rung bya/ de nas 'khor lo dbul bar bsam zhing / khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /stobs dang ma 'dres chos dang ni/ /dran pa nyer gzhag rnam thar brgyad/ /ye shes lnga sogs ldan 'gyur shog /chabra ma ra da na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod/ cod pan dbul ba ni/ sems can rnams ni ma lus pas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la/ /dar gyi lhab lhub la sogs pas/ /byang chub bar du mchod par shog /oṃ pa ṭaṃ ka lo ba ya swā hā/ zhes brjod/ 'phan 'bul ba ni/ sems can rnams ni ma lus pa'i/ /phyogs bcu snyan pa'i ba dan gyis/ /'tshe ba med cing chos ldan pa'i/ /grags pasargyas par 'gengs par shog /oṃ pa snya ke swā hā/ rgyal mtshan dbul ba ni/ 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni/ /bdud bzhi dag las rab rgyal nas/ /ston pa'i bstan pa zab mo dag /ma nub rgyal mtshan thob par shog /oṃ gzu ra dh+wa dza ya swā hā/ gdugs 'bul (16ba〉ba ni/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /nyen slongs tshad pas gdungs pa la/ /thugs rje byang chub sems kyi gdugs/ /phul ba'i bde bas tshim par shog /oṃ brahā ṇa ya swā hā/ zhes dang / me tog gi 'phreng ba dbul zhing / 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs thob nas/ /lta bas mi sa gzugs —293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pokyis ni/ /sems can don rnams rdzogs byed shog /oṃ rat+na mā le tre swā hā/ zhes dang / gdan dbul ba ni/ sems can ma lus sangs rgyas te/ /stobs bcu ldan pa glang po'i gdan/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan dang ldan/ /rdzu phral rkang pa rta yi gdan/ /dbang bcu thob pa rma bya'i gdan/ /thogs med shugs ldan mkha' lding gdan/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba rin cen gdan/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i gdan/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal nyi zla'i gdan/ /gdan rnams myur du thob par shog /oṃ su na dha ṛ dza ye swā hā/ lha bsgos 'bul ba ni/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ hūṃ las rin po che'i snod sogs kyi byin rlabs dang / /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa sogs brjod/gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i zas mchog 'di/ /bdag gis dad bas 'bul bar bgyi/ /ci bder bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ di bya a ka ni sa mā dhi ju pra ṇa ye swā hā/ zhal zasaro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /rgyal bas bdud bcom byang chub sangs rgyas te/ /rgyal ba'i sku la bsres skyems mi mnga' yang / /bdag cag bsod nams zhing du (17na tshe gyur slad du/ /bshos dang zhal zas sbyar ba 'di phul bas/ /dus kun dge ba'i lo thog 'phel rgyas nas/ /bde ba can du pad+mo las skyes te/ /ting 'dzin zas dang chos la spyod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā 6 pra titsā ye āḥ&/ oṃ badz+ra tasbu la ya āḥlha/ oṃ hūṃ / hrīḥ.āḥ gzungs thag btags la/ sku gzugs/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten la/ o3 gyi: khaṃ/ badzi bhā wa: tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ : kho/ pu ti la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/ oṃ hūṃ hrī:lha thā/ ci 'grub re dang / thams cad kyis thun mong du ye dharmā ci 'grub re bzla/ rab tu gnas pa'i lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la sngagasakyi 'phreng ba/ de'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rab tu gnas pa'i rten de dag dang mthun pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pas byon nas rten so so la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon —296

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtogadapo dri ma gsum spangs pa//sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba//des ni de ring khyed la zhi byed bkra shis shog/de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba//'jig rten gsum na grags shing mi dang lhas mchode pa//chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa//des ni de ring khyed la zhi byed/dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug/mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchode pa'i gnas//tsho gos kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi//des ni de ring khyed la//che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med//chos rje nyi 17bsgo rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis//bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste//rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog/chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchogo bla na med//dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis//nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tsho gis rnams 'phel pa//rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog/dge 'dun yon tan rin cen dpal 'bar ba//rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis//nyen mongs sdug bsngal gdungs pa'i dgra zhi ste//rtag tu dpal gnas//sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba//de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig/ston mchog lha dang mis ni mchod 'os pa//sangasargyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog/sems can gang dag//de dag thams cad /zhi ba chags bral//chos la phyag 'tshal 'gre//sems can gang //tshogs kyi dam pa //dge 'dun phyag 'tshal //nyin mo bde legs nas/nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa//dpal ldan bla mas deng 'dir stsol//yi dam lha yis//dkon cog gsum gyis //chos skyong srung mas//gzhi bdag rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol//'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam//sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa'ang rung //skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing //nyin dang mas du chos la spyod par shog/'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/tshen tu bden pa gsung zhing brdzun med pa//bden pa de yis deng 'dir bde legs shog/de kun 'jigs pa che las thar ni bar cig/deng 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'a// dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang /zla ba dang /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogegaza' sgra gcan gyi gnod pa las grol ba bzhin du bdud dang spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/dza ya dza ya/su dza ya/zhes tshigs bcad re re mtshams su rol mo dang bcas te shis pa brjod/gtor 'bul gyi rjes su srung ba'i phyag rgyas/chabadz+ra rak+ṣa lha/rdo rjesareg ste/rdo rje 'di na rdo rje che//sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis bsas//gal te dam las 'das gyur na//zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med//oṃ ma hwa sam ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra bhan+ta snya/zhes brjod la/'gro ba sems mā don slad du//bde gshegs rnams ni bzhugs kyi bar//bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir//sprul pa'i gzugs ba srung bar mdzod//ra btuganas par byas pa'i rten 'di la khyod kyas bsrung ba dang /skyob pa dang /mar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi ho par gyis shig/bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung ba dang /chos dang mas pa'i bsam pa thams cad yid bzhi du 'grub par mdzod/ces bsgo'o//yon bdag bsko ba ni/khyod kyis nged lagang gsol ba'i//gzugs sku dag ni khyad par du//ji ltar gsungasapa rab gnas pa//de dag don ni ngas byas pas//de rnams don ni grub si gyis/sgyu bde bar ni mar pa byos/khyod kyi nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar sa / bar byas kyis/khyod kyis rten 'di la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgya 'a po gyis shig/de nas kyang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pasargyun mi chad par mchod pa gyis shig/chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/sbyin bdag las sngags kyis bsangs/su bha was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las badz+ra ku mā ra zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis phur pa bsgril ba/dur sgo kyi mas kyis brgyan pa/ye shes kyi me wor ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/rje bsno rtsab nas bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi bar sngar bzhin la rab tu gnas par byas pa'i rten dang /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa ba po shis par byed pa la bar du gcod par brtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tsho gos thams cad sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig/sngags bzla zhing bgegs bskrad/las sngags kyis bsangs sbyangs//nga pa'i ngang las me las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom/ nang ma rtoganabargyad/sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyi byin rlabs dang /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyis gtso byasapa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor sogs srid zhi'i legs tshogos thamasacad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig/de nas ba po shis rdzas brgyad kyi tshig rnams gzhud bzhin byas/tsho gos mchode/mjug chog/bsngo ba smon lam shis pa brjod pa so gos bya'o//bstan 'gro'i 3 bde nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam par//legs byas rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng nam du yang //dus las yol med cho ga bkra shis pa'i//'bum phrag mtha' klas lang tshogs ra pa dngos//mkhyen brtse nus pa 'od zer lcags kyu yis//grangs med 'gro ba'i 19na〉pas nye ne sbyang ba dang //lhan cig srid zhi'i 'byor pa ma lus pa//mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye//ngo mtshar bkod pa sku gsung thugs rten sogs//mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis don ldan du//byin bas brtan g.yo'i dngos kun gyis snyo pa'i//rnam dkar phyogs dus gnas skabs yongs khyab shog/bod 'bangs bde thabs su zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i rten brten par rab gnas byed par 'gro gdong rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legasabashad gling pa'i zhal 'don du reg zigatu btab pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'bum phrag gsar dngom zhes pa'ang za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa bra byu / bha wan+tu/oṃ āḥ& gis sbyang chas rnams byin gyis brlabs/a kā ro sogs/sum bha sogs/sa badz+ra a: swā hā/pulge lha pe/ā lo ke/༷ /ni wi du/oṃ sarba pā paṃ ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/las sngags tshar bcu gag/gtor mnya/mar2/mchod3/me4/spos/mar6/dri /zas8/yugs 9 /༄10/kham11/dur2/zan3/seng 4/nye15/sri6/me7/mar18/'bras19/spos mar20//sarba maṅga lo//kro//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ger༅༅//lha brag gter byon gyi phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje pha lam bzhus/sa//na mo badz+ra ku mā rā ya/gdod nas lhun grub spros bral bde ba 0 por g.yo med ngang nyid las/gtum chen khro bo mig sman gdog can gar dgu'i nyams kyis rab 'gying bas//nag po'i ru mtshon rnam par bstol zhing dkar phyogs rgyal rnga cher sgrog pa'i//'phrin las lha tsho gos 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje phur pas dngos grub stsol//nges gsang mchog 'di'i lam bzang lha lam ngos//phul byung rtags mtshan mngon gyur grub pa'i gzis//rgya bal bod 'dir log 'dren mun pa'i tshogs//'joms mdzad rigs 'dzin sar gshegs tsho gos spyi dang /khyad par yang phur sbrags sgrub la brten nas//mchog gi dngos grub legs thob gangs can 'dir//bka' drin rgyal ba kun gyis zla bral ba'i//pad+mā ka ras tshe rabs kun du skyongs//theg mchog bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi za ma rtag/mi phyed rgyas 'debs bka' yi bsdu ba po//tshul 'di'i bka' babs mi rogaso zhe por slong //ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 2na7khar chen bza'//lcags mdzod zad mi shes pa'i sgrom bu las//'phrin lasachos sde'i spu gri ngar ma'i dpal//zab gter sgo 'byed rgod kyi ldem phru nas//rim brgyud sngagasalang rdo rje 'dzin rnams rgyal//ye nas rang rig gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su//chos kun rnam par grol ba'i sgyu kyi thabs sa//grangs med rgyal ba'i 'khor lo kun gyi gtso//dus gsum kun mkhyen dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs//mi bzad ga song rgyu bsgrub chos spong gi/las ga sgrib pas ma sbags khyod drin na//da dung kun bzang go 'phang ma thob bar//thugs rje'i brtse bas skyongs shig 'khon ston rje//nag phyogs bdud sde'i me dpung /༷ 'joms shing //dngos grub zhing sa bas pas

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtoganamachog thun 'bras/ /stsol mdzad dpal ldan rdo rje phur pa yi/ /'phrin las gru char 'bebs so shesaldan kye/ /de skad du/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug sa yang dag bde chen snying po bsgrubs pa'i tshe bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos (2ba〉spyab gnasader thob rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: zhes pa ltar/ slob dpon wo po mtsho skyes rdo rjes/ rgya bal gyi sa mtshams/ dgun dus kyang me tog rnam par bkra zhing / bkra shis byin chags pa'i yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas mchog gi rigs 'dzin bsgrubs par/ mi bsrun nag po'i phyogs kyis/ slob dpon chen po'i dgongs par tho 'tshams ma thub kyang / rgya bal bod gsum du sad ser mu ge yams nad btang bar/ bar chad 'bul ba'i chos rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnams las len par pho nya mngags pa/ slob dpon pra bha ha stis/bidro t+ta ma la 'bum sde nas dgra 'gegs 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mi khur gnyis brdzangs/ glegs bam phebs pa tsam rgyas bdud sde'i ru mtshon thams cad dus gcig tu bstol ba'i mthu rtsal can gyi rdo rje phur pa 'di nyid la bka' gter gnyis las/ slob dpon chen pos dgongs gzhi du ma'i dbang gisa'ajig pa med pa'i sgrom bur rgyas btab ste/ las ldan la smon lam mdzad pa ni gter ma ste/ de la yang / mnga' bdag gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug dang / rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa sogs gter kha 'ga' zhig yod pa las/ 'dir dus ga snyigs ma mthar thug sleb kha phu ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i shar 'dabs su sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zhig gi smon lam gyis: nga yi gter 'don lha sras gdung rgyud skyob ces dang / rin cen sdong por/ brag ri dug sbrul (3na khongs 'dri dang : ri bo ba po bzang rtsemo la: rgyun chad med par 'ja' 'od 'byung : gnas 'dir thugs kyi lha bzhengs na bod 'dir bstan pa dar zhing bde gnas 'dir brda yi lde mig rnyed: gter chen bton nas 'gro don byed:ces pa ltar gyi rigs 'dzin rgod ldem gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i phur pa che mchog drag sngags dril sgrub spu gri gsum las/ drag sngags la dril sgrub sbyar ba'i las byang bklags ga tu bkod pa la/—301 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (geskyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni//phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha//kun 'dus rtsa gsum chos longs sprul pa'i sku//sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bcas pa la//bdag sogasasems can ma lus skyabs su mchi//rang rig gdod ma'i ye shes 'gro kun gyis//mngon gyur sangasargyas yin kyang ma rig pas//'khor ba'i klong du 'khyams pa'i cho 'phrul kun//rig pa rang ngor rtogs phyir sems bskyed do//bsnyen phur byin gyis brlab pa ni/phur pa chos sku 'gyur ba med pa las//longs sku grangs med khro ba'i skur shar ba//sprul sku'i khro tshogs mi bzad 'phro 'du yis//dgra bgegs bdud sde'i dpung tsho gis tshar gcod gyur//ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya hūṃ/tshogs zhing ni/spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du//rtsa gsum lha tsho gos 'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs//badz+ra sam ya dzaḥdzaḥgus pas phyag 'tshal kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul//ma dag sdig sgrib bshags shing dge tsho gos la//rjes su yi rang zab rgyas dam pa'i chos//'khor lo bskor zhing mi 'gyur rtagasabartan gsol//ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba byang chub tu//bsngo zhing sku gsum 'phrin las byed 3ba thar shog/hūṃ/thugs ka las byung dkar ser dmar ljang hūṃ//yongs gyur rgyal chen sdebazhi 'khor bcas rnams//gtor ma 'di bzhes phyogs kyi gdon srungs la//mthun pa'i rkyen rnams yid bzhin bsgrub par mdzod//ces rgyal chen bzhi'i mtshams gcod byas la bgegs gtor rdo rje slob dpon gyis sngags dang dmigs pas bsngo//phyi mtshams ni/bdag nyid skad cig rdo rje srin po'i sku//rngam brjid gar 'gying hūṃ phaṭa drag po'i sgras//stong gsum gang zhing tshur 'dus steng 'og dang //phyogs mtshams 'jig rten dregs pa'i gdan steng du//oṃ sa bisnan/khro bcu drag po'i gsung gi ngar sgra sgrog/srid gsum gnas pa'i mi bsrun 'byung po'i sde//'di ru ma 'dug 'jig rten gzhan du dengs//gal te mi 'gro lus srog rdul du rlogs//ā+oṃ nga ni byung hūṃ//:sna :sna hūṃ/:: pa ya skṛrti'i pa ya hūṃ/ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bi du rā dzā hūṃ phaṭa/nang mtshams ni/hūṃ/thugs las sprul pa'i khro bcus mi dge bcu//tshar bcad rnam thar lam la ༷god bya'i phyir//ma dag kun bcoms khro bo zhal

phur pa lcag khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtoganaphyir gzigs/ /bskal pa'i me dpung mtshon cha'i gur gyis gtams/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lā ya: ྅ hūṃ hūṃ/gardza gardza/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ la ༷ / hu lu hu lu/ ti sgo tig tshin+ta shā/ ༷ — /h+pho ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ dgra dgegs bar gcod thams cad mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa:gsang mtshams ni/ steng phyogs phur pa'i bla bre bres pa la/ /phur pa'i gnam lcags thog chen shar ra ra/ /'og phyogs phur pa'i sa gzhi brdal ba la/ /phur pa'i 'phro 'du ma ltar 'ur (4na'i mā /phyogs mtshams phur pa'i ra bas bskor ba la/ /phur pa'i tsha tsha glog ltar khyugs se khyug /gang gis 'jig tu med pa'i srung ba yi/ /phur pa'i gur khang mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /ā+oṃ badz+ra ki li gī lā ya/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa snri bshags pa ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang / /spyan drangs bde gshegs zhi khro'i tshogs rnams dgongs/ /grangs med bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams/ /snying nas bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ brda sgo dbye ba ni/gsang ba'i pho brang nang du bdag 'jug gi /sgo ma bzhi yis ye shes sgo phye zhig /zlo bra be sha ya phaṭa:brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pasaphyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho/ bra ti ts+tsha rta tre dam bca' zhu ba ni/ bdag ni mkha' mnyam sems can rnams kyi ched/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed par dam bca'o/ /bho dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya sto: byin dbab pa ni/ 〉ཿ a la la hoḥ bha ga ldan/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya sa: lha/ dpal chen 'phrin las gzhal yas chen po nas/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhen nu yab yum sras/ khro bcu khra thabs sgo ma bka' srung sogs/ /rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams kyis nus mthu'i dpung / /bskyed nas gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rdzas/ /kun la sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob/ /sgrub mchog sngags 'chang bdag la dbang bskur zhig /'phrin las rnam bzhi (4ba〉sgrub pa'i dus la bab/ sam ya a be sha ya āḥ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor 'bar/ /zhing bcu bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rba klong ga thug /'dod yon rnam lnga'i longs spyod rnam par bkra /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'altar rgyas par gyur/ /raṃ yaṃ kho/ ā+oṃ āḥ&/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ pyi ca ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa: chu ka pā la rje/ ma hā bha li ta āḥ ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ gsal stong dbyer med bde chen rang gi sems/ /kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ ris med snying rje'i rtsal gyis ye shes lnga'i/ /'od gsal mngon par 'bar las sprul sku'i rgyu/ khyu'i ting 'dzin ni/ rang gi rig pa yi ge hūṃ du gyur/ /e yaṃ ra su ke raṃ sa hūṃ/ e las mkha' klong yaṃ las rlud dkyil steng / /ra las khrag mtsho su las zhing chen brdal/ /ke las keng rus brtsegs pa'i lhun po brjid/ /raṃ lasabaskal pa'i me 'bar de steng du/ /smug nag ā+oṃ lo 'od du 'tsher ba shar/ /snang srid ma lus phur pa'i gzhal yas te/ /gru gsum dpal la ngan song gnas bcu rdzogs/ /rgya mdud 'og ma 'dod khamasalcum bzhogs kyi/ /zur brgyad smad la gzugs khams zur brgyad stong / /gzugs med mu bzhi rgya mdud gong ma la/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu'i gzhal yas khang / /phyi yi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gnas/ /zlo bi shwa bi shu rje: rat+na — : dz+nyā na e maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ rgya mdud dbus su drag po'i pho brang la/ /zla gam dmar (ldan)po mthing nag gru gsum brgyad/ /yongs bskor gru chad bar khyams sgo bzhir bcas/ /rus sbal gza' dang tshangs pa chu srin sbrul/ /zhing lpags rkang rus rgyu ma don snying sogs/ /'jigs rung las grub ka gdung dral ma gzhu/ /chun 'phyang dra phyed pho long tog la sogs/ /rin cen thod pa spel ba'i rtsig pa la/ /gnam lcags gzer btab dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /rdo rje'i ra ba bskal pa'i me dpung dbus/ /badz+ra rta pad+ma sur+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal ru dra du tri a sarba byu lte bar rdo rje brag chen pad nyi'i khri/ /ru dra dgra bgegs bsnol steng rgyu yig hūṃ/ /hūṃ snya ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsung gi byin rlabs tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ /saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ hūṃ/snying rje chen pos bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan par bya ba ma yin te/ /phung po gnyisamed rdo rjer gtams byas nas/ /rtog bral rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dngos grub kun bsdus bdag la thim/ /sangs rgyas ma lus—304

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtogadakun gyi ye shes sku/ /rang nyid rdo rje chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku yi dbyig tu bdag nyid bskyed par bgyi/ /de las drag po'i 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /bde gshegs sku yi gzi brjid thams cad bsdus/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lā ya sarba bi na baṃ hūṃ phaṭa:bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu'i sku/ /zhal gsum (5ba)phyag drug zhabs bzhi gar gyis bgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngam pa'i zhal/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /g.yon gnyis me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭaṃ bsnams/ /lhag ma'i phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril/ /dur khrod chas brgyad rdo rje'i khyung gshog sogs/ /dpal gyi mas brgyan bskal pa'i me dpung gi /rtsibs stong phyogs bcu ru 'phro zhing srid gsum bsreg /grangs med khro chung mtshon gang rab 'phro zhing / /thugs skar ye shes sems dpa' gzi 'od 'bar/ /hūṃ di lta tsakra ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa:'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing nag phyag gnyis kyis/ /rdo rje thod khrag 'khril sbyor yab la stob/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūṃ ka ra : gha dzo gha ga/ phaṭa: sngags de brjod pa tsam gyis ni: dpal chen gtso bo'i spyi gtsug sa khro bo'i rgyal po hūṃ ka ra yum chen rdo rje sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo:'od dang zer gyi tshul du bsgom swo badz+ra kro ta bi dzā ya sno ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: thugs kar khro bo rnam par rgyal yum chen rdo rje rnam bsnyems ma: sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo: bkrag dang gzi mdangasaldan par bskyed swo badz+ra kro ta nī la byu da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod nu ma g.yas kyi steng : khro bo dbyug pa sngon po dang : yum chen rdo rje sder mo gnyis: sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan par bskyed shī badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka snro pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod dpung pa g.yas kyi steng : khro bo gshin rje gshed po dang : yum (6na thib dur khrod bdag mo gnyis: sprul pa sha ba lug pa'i mgo: las la chas pa lta bur bsam zho badz+ra kro ta ā ya a tsa la snro bhan+ta — hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod sog pa g.yas kyi steng : khro bo mi g.yo mgon po dang : yum chen rdo rje gtun khung ma sprul pa gzig dang khā da'i mgo bka' nyan tshul du bsgom par bya rtswa badz+ra kro ta ha ya spyi ba ྅: hu lu —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'ahu lu hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod rgyab kyi sog sbrag sa khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po dang : yum chen gtum mo dbang sdud ma sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo srung ba'i go cha mdzad par bsgom rma badz+ra kro ta a pa ra dzi ta sno tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod sog pa g.yon pa'i steng : khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang : yum chen rdo rje
