mda' bsnyems ma: sprul pa spyang gi kha yi mgo: bka' sdod pho lha'i tshul du bsam swo badz+rakro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali snro tshin+ta tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod dpung pa g.yon pa'i steng : khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang : yum chen rdo rje rlung 'byin ma: sprul pa seng ge pha wang mgo: dngos grub chen po'i pho nyar bsam chu badz+ra kro ta tri lo kya bi dza ya snro snyin+ta snyin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod nu ma g.yon pa'i steng : khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal dang : yum chen khro mo gsod byed ma sprul pa dred dang sre mo'i mgo: dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i srung mar bsgom tshwa badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la sno sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod 'og gi bcu drug mdor khro bo 'jigs byed stobs po che: yum wo rdo rje skyod (6ba)byed ma sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo bka' sdod tshul du gsal bar bsgom ca badz+ra kro ta skyo ra na hūṃ phaṭa:sku lus rgya khyon thams cad du: ba spu re la khro chung re: 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha thogs nas kyang : srung byed khrab tu gtams par bsgom rtswa badz+ra gha ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa: lte ba'i gnas su sprul pa'i khyung : dung mdog lcags kyi gshog pa can: gser mig 'khyil ba rdo rje'i sku: mchu sder lcags kyis sprul bzung nas: gdug pa can rnams zas su za: de ltar shin tu gsal bar bsgom gtso bo'i thugs las phyag rgya bzhi spros pas/ /phyogs skyong bcu po rang dbang med par bkug /dzaḥlha baṃ r+sā mo gha ya nir dzaḥ e sarba big nan steng 'og phyogs mtshams gru gsum pad nyi zla/ de steng gtso bo'i thugs lasa3 zung bcu/ /'phros pas bde gshegs thugs bskul 'gro don byas/ /badz+ra badz+ra rdo rje 'bar ba bcu/ /phan tshun 'phro 'du khro chung skar ltar 'phro/ /gī lā ya sno ྅ steng phyogs tshangs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ kā ra snro ga dzogaga3 phaṭa: de las〉 mdzad dang ni sgra 'dzin ma/ /sprul pa'i phra men phag dang rmig bu'i mgo gar phyogs brgya byin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya —306

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags skru gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtogan: ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: de las rnam par rgyal dang rnam bsnyems ma/ /sprul pa'i phra men stag dang bya rgod mgog ra lho me lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ni la daṇ+ḍa3: da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa: de las dbyug sngon can dang rdo rje sder/ /sprul pa'i phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo /lho phyogs gshin rje bsnol ba'i (7na gi dan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa: de las gshin rje gshed dang dur khrod bdag /sprul pa'i phra men sha pa 'ug pa'i mgo /lho nub srin po bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la snro bhan+ta 5 hūṃ phaṭa: de las mi g.yo mgon dang gtun khung ma/ /sprul pa'i phra men gzig dang khwa da'i mgo /nub phyogs klu dbang bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya m+bhi wa : hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: de las rta mgrin rgyal dang dbang sdud ma/ sprul pa'i phra men byi la pu shud mgo /nub byang rlung lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta snritiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa: de las ga' na gyis mi thub mda' bsnyems sam/ /sprul pa'i phra men spyang ki khra yi mgo /byang phyogs gnod sbyin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha a skṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali snri tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: de las bdud rtsi 'khyil dang rlung 'byin ma/ /sprul pa'i phra men seng ge pha wang mgo /byang shar dbang ldan bsnol pa'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha tri lo kya bi dza ya / ༷ nga hūṃ phaṭa: de lasakhams gsum rnam rgyal gsod byed ma/ /sprul pa'i phra men dred dang sre mo'i mgo /'og phyogs sabadag bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra krodha ma hā ba la : spro ṭa ya spro ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa: de lasastobs po che dang skyod byed ma/ /sprul pa'i phra men dom dang byi ba'i mgo /yab rnams mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyisang kyis/ /ri rab phur bsgril sku smad (7ba)zur gsum pa/ /drag po'i dpal ldan rdor gshog dur khrod chas/ /phyogs skyong dregs pa thal gyis phyung nas bzhugs/ /yum bcu mthing skya khro mo'i chas kun rdzogs/ /g.yas pa yab 'khyud g.yon kun thod khrag stob/ khra thabs kun kyang lcags kyu phur bu bsgril/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ yig rang dang sngags kyis bskor/ /hūṃ phaṭa drag po'i nga ros srid gsum g.yo/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /sras mchog gi phur pa bskyed pa —307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geni/ sras mchogo badz+ra gī la sku mdog nag /phyag gnyis rgya gram phur bsgril sku smad ni/ /zur gsum rdor gzhog dur khrod mas kyis brgyan/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ badz+raki li gī la ya: shā nga/ pu sna/ pa shang / mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan mthing nag gru gsum gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /sgo ma bka' srung bskyed pa ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya: dha ti ma ma shī gh+ri ka ra ye hūṃ phaṭa: de las dam can ma mo bcu gnyis po/ /rang rang cha lugs yongs rdzogs bar khyams 'khod/ /sgo bzhir dzaḥ/ baṃ ho mi nyi ma dang / /zhing rkyang gdan steng thugs las sprul pa yi/ /dkar mo pu shud mgo can lcags kyu thogs/ /ser mo skya ga'i mgo can zhags pa thogs/ /dmar mo srin bya'i mgo can lcags sgrog thogs/ /ljang nag khra yi mgo can dril bu thogs/ /phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus/ bse lcags dung la sogs pa'i pho nya bzhugs/ /srog ye shes su bskyed nas srog dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje gzhen nu'i (8na)rigs 'dzin rnams/ /srid pa rdo rjer grub mdzod cig /srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas na las rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig /ā+oṃ hūṃ tre hrīḥ.aḥ a bhi ṇiñtsa ྅: bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /sku gsung thugs gyi byin rlabs bsdus/ khams gsum thams cad dusagacig tu/ /bsgral bar nus pa'i dbang thob gyur/ /snyan gsan ni/ 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha yi 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje gzhen nu yum sras khro bo bcu/ khra thabasasprul pa'i gar gyis dbyings nas bzhedas/ /badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ lan gsum brjod/ spyan 'dren pa ni/srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa dang / /ma lus dbang dang dngos grub len pa'i phyir/ /ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin bzhes/ /rtagasadang mtshan ma bzang po ston pa dang / /gī lwa ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya:e gye hi bha ga lhan/ ma hā ka ru ṇi /dṛ shā lho sam ya sngo sam ya sto gnyis med bstim pa ni/ ye —308

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags skru gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma (gnashes khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /dam tshig pa dang gnyis med brtan par bzhugs/ /dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ chos kun bdag dang gnyis su med pa'i don/ /yang dag don gyi phyag dang mchod (8ba)pa 'bul/ s+t+waṃ badz+ra na ma ya: phyag 'tshal ba ni/ srid gsum gdug pa nga rgyal mi dge bcu/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs tshogs rnams gzhom bya'i phyir/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi nus mthu'i bdag wo can/ /bcom ldan 'bor dang yos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho pra ti dza 〉 phyi mchod ni/ dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i me tog gi /phung phung yal 'dab ge sar rnam par ldem/ /mkha' la chu 'dzin ltar 'khrigs bdug spos kyis/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i dri yang skyengs par byed/ /dus kyi me lce'i 'phreng 'dra'i mar me yis/ /nyin mtshan dbye ba med pa'i snang ba ster/ /gting dpag nus dka'i dri chab gzugs pa'i rlabs/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyur ba'i dbu 'phreng 'khrigs/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bas rnams bsdus 'dra ba'i/ /sna tshogs bsgos bu'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rdza rnga yi/ /brjid ldan drag po'i sgra yis phyogs kun 'gengs/ /rno ngar mtshon cha'i ru mtshon drangs pa yis/ /g.yul ngor lha yi dpung tshogs bshams pa ltar/ /ji snyed kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /mkha' dbyings khyone kun bzang ste rnam par 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya pus nas sha lta'i bar brjod/ /sman mar ni/ gdod nas rnam dag rtsa brgyad stong sbyar ba'i/ /myong grol bdud rtsi'i sman gyi mchod pa 'di/ /bla ma rdo rje ga smo nu'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /bka' sdod srung mar bcas pa' tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lī ya: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ (9na so hi: kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga gsang ba'i bdag /mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo tshangs pa'i rgyal/ /brgya byin klu rgyal 'jog po rgyal po dzar/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ shwakya pra bha pad 'byung bi mā la/ shwe la mañdzu 'tsho rgyal sna nam zhad / /rgod ldem se ston nyi bzang mgon bzang la/ /bdud rtsi sman: o na maḥsarbaḥ se ston rin rgyal zla mgon nub dgon rje/ /slar yang rdo rje mgon dang ngag dbang grags/ /—309

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtoganamadzad pa'i/ khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lā ya: ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā sti sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ thod pa zhig tu sman raka bsres pa blug par dmigs te/ mthing nag 'brub khung nang du rtsi tri las/ /dgra bgegs gzugs la zla tshes srog gsum khug /dzaḥlha baṃ hodakar nag snying khrag la/ /mā ra ya rbad dug gsum ngo bo yi/ sha chen khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i tshogs/ /dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya: ma hā me sa rak+ta ke : ti kha raṃ khā rdzi khro mo'i mkha' gsang nang du khro rgyal gyi/ /tho bas brdungs pas gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bsgral/ kha the kha the kha the: ྅ hūṃ (10na) ྅: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gnyis med byang chub sems kyis thugs dam bskang / /rnam shes hūṃ gyur sbyor mtshams gnas su 'phangs/ /badz+ra kro dha bi dzā ya 'a hi khā gi lha rnams dgyes pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /ha ha 〉 〉 hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: 'phrin las rgya mtshor/ sbyor sgrol gyi bsgral mchod la gdab las mi rigs pa'i shes byed/ nyon mongs sgrol ba'i mchod pa yong rgyu yin mod ces gsung na'ang / phur pa che mchog gi las byang las/ zhe sdang chen po'i mchod pa 'dis/ /phyi ltar bsgral ba'i zhing bcu sgrol/ /nang ltar nyon mongs thogs pa'i gzugs/ /ma tre sngo skya bkug la skyel/ /zhes pa'i phyi nang sbyor sgrol gyi don spyan ras su ma btsas pa yin nam snyam/bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag yangs pa'i mkha' klong nas/ /rdo rje gzhen nu mthing nag chu 'dzin che/ /drag po'i 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /nag phyogs sder bcas brag ri 'joms la bstod/ /dus kyi me lte lhab lhub 'bar ba'i dbus/ /gtum drag srin po'i zhal can mi sdug gzugs/ /rdo rje'i khyung gshog nam mkha'i ngos su bgrad/ /rno ngar mtshon chas dgra snying 'bigs la bstod/ /dgra bgegs ru dra 'dam ltar brdzis pa'i khrir/ /dpal chen khro bo'i dbang po gar gyis 'gying / /skye mched rnam dag shes rab gsal ba'i yum/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khril der bstod/ /dgra bgegs glang po'i mgo 'ge mas sa bcu yi/ /bdag nyid 'jigs byed khro bcu (10bsko dong lnga'i dbang / /pha rol phyin bcu'i bdag nyid bde ba che/ /skyed mdzad gnyis med sbyor ba'i
