pa'i lag len che phra mtha' dag nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa ni gnad yin no/ /bskul ba ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung gsob pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin (12bsgoms kyi dus la bab/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnasakyis/ /rgya gar tsan+dan nags tshal la/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrib pa'i grogs mdzod cig /paṇa chen bi mā mi tra yis/ /rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /bal po shī la mañdzu yis/ /maṇ+ḍal yi mkhar gong du/ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /mchims ston shākya bra bha yis/ /yar klungs bgegs kyi phug chung du/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig khud bu dpal gyi seng ge yis/ /'u shang rdo yi brag logs la/ ji ltar rtagasabastan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis/ /—314

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma khoganahas po ri yi yang gong la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /mkhar chen bza' yi 'tsho rgyal gyis/ /nam mkha'i pho rog nag po la/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gis/ /rtsibs kyi spyang ku sngon po la/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /sprul sku gter ston yab sras kyis/ /zang zang ri bo'i brag gi rtser/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /sngags 'chang shākya bzang po yis yol mo gangs kyi ra ba sa /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /sprul sku legs ldan rdo rje yis/ /'bras gzhongs gnas sgo 'byed pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis/ /kong yul gtsang chab gyen bzlog tshe/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /gzhan yang 'khon ston bsod nams dang / /rlangs ston kun bzang rol pa'i zhabs/ /thu ston 'jigs med dpa' bo sogs/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /rang rang so so'i sgrub khang du/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /khyod kyi 'phrin las dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab bcom ldan rdo rje phur pa yab yum sras/ khro bcu khra thabs sgo srung bcas pa yi/ /mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las(13na)du bsal bab/ /dgra bo'i bla srog khug la snying khrag 'thung / /lcags kyi spyang mo g.yu yi khyi mo dang / /gser gyi 'phar ba zangs kyi wa mo bzhi'i/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /drel rta chu glang sha ba rnga mo la/ /zhen nas stong gsum myul ba'i re ma bzhi'i/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /rdo rje yab sbyin rdo rje de sbyin dang / /rdo rje bse sbyin rdo rje phag sbyin bzhi'i/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /phyogs bzhi'i skyes bu bzhi dang bdud mo bzhi/ /zhing chen —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedamag dpon chen po rnam bzhi yi/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /mdor na phur skyong srung ma'i tshogs spyi dang / /bkra bzang lha brag gter gyi srung ma yi/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /dkyil 'khor mu ran las byed gdug pa can/ /ma tsho gis dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /de yang thog mar gser skyems gzu dbang ni/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /deng 'dir dgongs shig sangs rgyas bstan 'jig cing / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku dgra sgrol bgyid na/ /gser skye mas mchode pa 'di bzhes gzu dpang mdzod/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor 'jig cing dge 'dun gsod/ /lus can kun 'tshe mtshams med lngar spyod cing / /rigs 'dzin rnal 'byor sgos dgra sgrol bgyid na/ /gser skyemasaḥ/ /dge bcu'i lugs dmad mi dge'i srol ngan bstod/ /sna tsho gos thabs kyisang na g.yo'i sems 'chang ba'i/ /mi bsrun gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bgyid na/ /gser skyemasaḥ/ phur bsgyur ni/ mi bzad rno ngar ldan pa yi/ /drag byed phur pa gnyan po 'di/ /steng (13ba〉she lha la mi 'debs so/ /phur lam gnyan po da phye zhig /tshig gzhan gsum 'dra ba la/ 'og gi klu la ma 'debs so/ /yang sdebargyad sun la mi 'debs so/ /drag byed phur pa gnyan po 'di/ /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la 'debs/ /gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la 'debs/ /za bar byed pa'i 'dre la 'debs/ /phung bar byed pa'i sri la 'debs/ /las kyi bdud g.yos phur khas bzlog /mas kyi sri langs phur khas bzlog /chags che nyam nga phur khas bzlog /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /de nas 'brub khung bskyed chog ni bka' gter gnyis kar gsal ba mi 'dug pa 'khrugs ba sdebs kha 'gengs la dgongs la/ deng sang lag len du mi byed pa ni/dmigs pa rnon po yang rab la med kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang phyag len 'khrugs pa'i rgyun stims pa yin no/ /rang gi thugs ka nas/ zhes pa nas bzung ste/ khug cig zhes pa'i bar zil gnon gyi las byang dkyus bzhin la/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nas bcas pa'i bar/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu —316

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtoganakhro bcu khra thabs sgo ma bka' srung pas lcags dung la sogs pa'i pho nya dam can dang bcas pa/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /rdo rje ga tho nu'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i rdo rje slob dpon zhwa phod can gyi rnga pa rnams dang lhan cig gam/ rang nyid gcig pus kyang rung ste/ bden bdar dang / dar nag gi g.yab mo/ phyag rgya bzhi sogs byed dgos la/ ding sang gangs khrod sngags 'chang mang po zhig khro bo'i zhal brnyan sogs kyi cha byad dang ldan pas bden pa dang dgug gzhug byed pa ni/ mngon spyod la nang byan tshud pa zhig gis brtags tshe bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /de nas rol mo dang bcas/ sgo ma bskul ba ni/dkyil 'khor shar phyogs sgo srung pu shud mgo /log 'dren 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu thogs/ /'khor bcas khyod kyis dgra bo'i bla srog rnams/ khug cig badz+ra e ku sha ya dzaḥ 'og ma 'gre /dkyil 'khor lho phyogasaḥ skye ga'i mgo: /log 'dren 'ching b.raḥ zhags pa thogs/ /'khor bcas:ske nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /dkyil 'khor nub phyogs: srin bya'i mgo /log 'dren sdom parangulcags sgrog thogs/ /'khor bcasaḥ /yan lag sdo mes shig badz+ra spro ṭa baṃ/ /dkyil 'khor byang phyogs:khra yi mgo /log 'dren myos paraḥ dril bu thogs/ /'khor bcas ca/ myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍahopho lha'i tshogs kyis dgra bo'i skyob byed lha/ phye zhig badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa/ dmigs rten gzugs kyi mtshan ma nya bo la/ /dbyer med stims shig a be sha ya āḥde nas dpal chen khro bcu khra thabs kyi 'chams dang bcas te/ mgyogs phur brdeg pa ni/hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab: phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab:shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab khyed kyi 'phrin las dus la bab: sabadag chen mo'i dus la (14bathab mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab: ma badz+ra ki li gī lwa ya dha ti ma ma /ra ma shī r+ghaṃ ka ra ye/ : tri mā ra ya rbad: de nas gdab phur gdab pa ni/ hūṃ/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : dus gsum rgyal ba 'i gdung gsob pa'i: rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni:gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams: dngos grub 'phrog cing —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge'atshe ba'i rigs: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: yud tsam zhig la 'dir bkug nas mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du brlag nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod snyi lo hūṃ lo sa rna mo lha gha ta ya bha ga wan: lha kṛ bṛ bi kṛ badz+ra3 ka ra hūṃ badz+ra ki li ki lwa ya dzaḥ/ baṃ ho sarba bisnan: badz+raki li gī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa: badz+ra/ kā ra hūṃ phaṭa:nyu kā ra hūṃ a phaṭa: drag po'i thun rdzas brdeg pa ni: ྅/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis rings par khug la smra ru chug phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas ni bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par byos / pa ra birla tshin+da tshin+da hūṃ phaṭa bīrnya bīrnya hūṃ phaṭa: gro hā gro sna hūṃ phaṭa: ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: gan+ta la hūṃ phaṭa: tra sha ya tra sha ya hūṃ phaṭa: ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hrī daṇ+ḍa3 phaṭa shi gh+ri ā na ya hūṃ phaṭa: tha la bha ya dz+wa la bha ya hūṃ phaṭa: a be sha ya a be sha sa ya hūṃ phaṭa: bid+dha ya — ya hūṃ phaṭa:de nas dam can gyi phur pa gdab pa ni/ hūṃ/ bran dang pho nya bka' (15na〉lo tshogs khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab: sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs ba'i mngon spyod 'phrin las myur du mdzod ha na ha na badz+ra da ha da ha badz+ra pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra ma tha ma tha badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra su ru su ru badz+ra mu ru mu ru badz+ra ka ṭaṃ ka ṭa ye: dza ye bi dza ye: a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ma ra se nu pra ma rna ni hūṃ phaṭa: dug khrag gis gsher ba ni/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi: lha'am 'on te bdud kyang rung : nga la bar chad byed pa rnams mthu dang rgya 'phrul med par byos: sarba ā na ya hūṃ phaṭa: ta thā ya ta thā ya hūṃ phaṭa:hom gzar du tho bas brdung ba ni/ hūṃ/ shi rdungs ga rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams: rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas: lusang ga rdul phran bzhin du rlog: ྅ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de nas snying gar mchog phur bsgril ba ni/ hūṃ sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /sku smad zur gsum dpal dang ldan/ khro bo bcu yis rnam par brgyan/ /gdug pa ma lus 'dul bar byos/ /rtsir tri e hur ṭaṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad gyi gug gis bsgral ba ni/ hūṃ/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can —318

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtoganagang zhig 'da' byed na stobs chen khro bo chen po yis klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: lha ma ma wa she ku rbas ma ti e ga ra dad+dha ti ma ma ga me shi dra ka ra ye hūṃ phaṭa: gter gzhud du bsgral mtshams sogs gsal bar med (15ba)pa ni zhakhrugs bsdebs kha 'gengs la dgongs par ma zad bi khyo t+ta ma'i rgyud las/ lha 'bral gzugs la dbab pa dang / /byad du gzhug dang spyo ru gzhug /rdul du brlag dang zhal du stob/ khesanang gses kyi so sor drug tu dbye ba'i zab gnad slob dpon chen po'i thugs kyi brnog chos rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag len du yod kyang thun mong tsam la'ang / grang so gter ston pa'i sgrol byed drag po'i rno mtshon du man ngag gis legs par brgyan par mngon zhing / chos rje bla ma dam pa'i bklags pas don grub dang / sa skyong thams cad mkhyen pa kun bzang rol pa'i rdo rjes kyang der zhal 'phangs mdzad pa'i dgongs pa gcig par/ thog mar snying gar phur bu btab nas bla srog bsgral zhing rnam shes spar bar bzhed rjes/ khro bcu'i phur pa lus kyi gnas rnams su 'debs pa sogs phur 'debs mdzad srol 'dug pa ni/ rol mtshon bsnun pa dang 'dra bas 'thad par ma mthong zhes sngags 'chang mang po'i sgros su thos pa rnam shes mthar spar ba ltar snang la 'char bde zhing lugs srol 'di ga'i bzhed pa dang mthun mod/ sa phur sogs su ma zad chos dbang rin po che'i spu gris mtshon pa'i gter kha mang por de ltar bshad pa bka' brgyad kyi gdab las dang yang mthun zhing thog ma nas sras mchog gi phur ba'am yang na bsnyen phur btab nas rnam shes spar bas lus rten 'di'i bla srog bsgral zin kyang slar 'khor ba la mi ldog pa'i phyir du skye ba'i sgo lnga gcod ched (16na)gdab kha lhag ma rnams mdzad pa dgos gnad che bar mngon la/ lha brag gter byon gyi phyag bzhes su thog mar za gsod kyi mgyogs phur snying dkar nag gi mtshams su 'debs pa rnam shes gnas ngan par mi yar ba'i ched du gzer btab pa ltar byed pas thugs rje rjes 'dzin kyi bshad tshul 'di la sbyor ba yod/gter kha 'og ma'i dgongs pa ltar na phur pa bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed nas 'debs par gsungs —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2popas byang gi phur pa 'debs pa 'thad la/ lugs 'di la mthar gdab pa'i phur pa sras phur ram mchog phur du grags par ngos 'dzin pa drag sngags kyi dgongs pa'i gnad kyis rtogs pas sras mchog rigs lnga'i nang gi bar ki lwa yar ngos 'dzin no/ khro gas phur gdab ni/ bka' gter gnyis kur 'dug pa'i don sngar bshad pa tsam du ma zad sems can thams cad kyi lus la gdod ma nas rang mas su khro bo bcur grub pa de so so'i bdud du 'bebs par sems so/ /mthar liṅga rdo rje gzhen nus gri gug gis sgrol pa smad las kyi dbang sogs kyi skabs phyag len du yod cing / bka' mar sha bas sgrol pa'ang spros bcas kyi skabs 'chams dang bcas mdzad srol tshes lnga rin po cher mnal lam lung bstan gyi tshul du byung pa ltar rtse lugs kyi phyag rgyun du snang ba'ang gshin rje'i phyag brnyan sha ba yin pas 'gal ba med la/ snga rabs kyi yig rnying la lar rnam shes spar tshar ba'i mjug gri gug gis gtub cing dam can gyi phur pa btab nas srung ma bcu (16ba)gnyis kyis phung po dum bur gtub par bshad pa 'di gnas skabs kyi spros bcas gtso bor ston pa ma yin pa'i don gyi phyag bzhes khungs dang mi 'brel ba min pas/ de ltar na shwa na mched bzhi gang rung gis bsgral ba 'thad dam snyam/ rgyas par spro na phur pa mang du byed srol gong du bshad pa ltar kha bskang kyang 'gal ba med cing / rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa lugs 'di ga'i phyag len du dkyus bzhin bde bas/ las phur bskyed chog man ngag bzhin/ lus kyi cha gang dang gang la brdeg sogs zhal shes ltar bya'o/ /de nas zhal stob bya ba ni/ dpal chen 'khor bcas gnam sa lta bu'i zhal/ /gdongs la spu gri ngar ma'i mche ba gtsigs/ /glog stong 'byug 'dra'i ljags khyod dgra bgegs kyi/ sha khrag don snying rus tshogos zhal du stob/ /badz+ra gī li ki lwa ya ma hā mo sa/ rak+ta ke ni ri ti kha raṃ 'a hi: lhag ma ni/ 'jigs rung gnas nas mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad ging chen bco brgyad dang /9'bar ma ma bdun srid bzhi pho lha'i tshogs/ /dam tshig dran par gyis la gnas 'dir gshegs/ /lhag ma'i khrag mtsho 'khyil zhing rus tshogs spungs/ sha dang nang khrol nyil zhing bdud rtsi lnga'i longs spyod 'di bzhes —320

phur pa lcags khang drag sngags gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtoganarnal 'byor dpon slob kyi/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen yid bzhin sgrubs/ /ā+oṃ burnya badz+ra rat+na pad+ma rkarma sarba ḍā gi ni ging ka raḥ ma hā sarba pu tsa khā hi:chad mtho bstan skyong ni/ sngon tshe 'og min (17na sna dbyings pho brang du/ /dpal chen gī lā ya yi sgra bsgrags tshe/ /mkha' 'gro las mkhan chos srung dam can gyis/ /so so'i rang rtags srog snying phul nas kyang / /rang rang gzugs bstan sngags 'chang dam ldan la/ /dngos grub ster zhing tshe srog bsring ba dang / /'phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas khas blangs bzhin/ /gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs/ 'u( ka rjes ma kun la 'gre /de 'og yang ler pad+ma thod 'phreng dang / /shākya de was phur dkyil zhal phye nas/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs/ /phur pa'i srung mar khas blangs srog snying phul/ /rang rang gzugs bstan sngags 'chang dam ldan la/ /dngos grub ster zhing tshe srog bsring ba dang / /'phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas khas blangs bzhin/ /gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs/ /de 'og seng rdzong pad 'byung mkhar chen bza'/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms phur dkyil zhal phye nas/ 'i na bse lcags dung sogs phur srung kun/ /phur pa'i srung mar khas blangs srog snying phul/ /rang rang gzugs bstan sngags 'chang dam ldan la/ /dngos grub ster zhing tshe srog bsring ba dang / /'phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas khas zhi blangs ba na/ /gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs/ /de 'og rang snang chos dbyings dag pa'i ngang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas rgod kyi ldem phru yis/ /phur pa lugs gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /phur skyong bka' yi srung mar bcas pa yi/ /rang rang gzugs bstan sngags 'chang dam ldan la/ /dngos grub ster zhing tshe srog bsring pa dang / /'phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas khas blangs bzhin/ /gtor ma 'di long bcol pa'i las kun sgrubs/ /bod khams skyong bar khas blangs mthu rtsal can/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis bka' sdod bran g.yog bcas/ /ba ling rgyan ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /ces chad mtho bstan skyong gi gtor ma nam mkhar bteg cing —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge'abul la/ /spyir phur pa la khro bo rol pa'i gter bzlog rgyas par 'dug cing / chad mtho'i gtor (17ba)ma zor du byas te zor lam dbye zhing gtor gzhed 'og tu dam sri gnon cing bro brdung ba sogs lho gter byang gter gnyis kar 'dug cing / rgyas par spro na phur pa spu gri'i chos sde las shes par bya'o/ /gtang rag 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'bor lha tshogs la/ /yid 'ong rnam par mdzes pa'i phyi mchod dang / /bdud rtsi sman dang bha ling rak+ta ra bcas/ /bzhes la dngos grub ma lusastsal du gsol/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ gzhal yas dkyil 'khor lha rnams gtso bo yi/ /thugs dar bsdu zhing rdo rje gzhen nu yang / /mi dmigs chos dbyings ngang du gyur pa las/ /slar yang khro bo'i nga rgyal dag gis bsrung / /smon lam ni/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rkadze he ru ga'i/ /zab mo'i 'phrin lasanyams su blangs pa'i dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor lus thob cing / /dge ba'i bshes kyisarjes su 'dzin par shog /theg mchog gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /smin byed dbang gi cho ga legs nos shing / /a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i lam bzang gis/ /tshe gcig nyid la myur du grol bar shog /srid pa phur bur lhun grub rgya mdud du/ /rin cen thod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /rdo rje gzhen nu khro bcu phra phyag gi /gsal snang bskyed rim 'ja' ltar rnam bkra shog /ma rig 'khrul pasabaslad pa'i tha mal sems/ /rtogs na he ru gaḥlas gzhan med phyir/ /rang nyid dpal chen phur bur nges rnyed pa'i/ /nga rgyal brtan (18na)pos bgegs dpung 'joms par shog /zhi bas mi 'thul ma rungs dgra dang bgegs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad nas/ /tshe khrus dgongs pasarnam shes rang sems dang / /bsres nas bde ba chen por rnam grol shog /chos rnams thams cad ngo bo ka nas dag /dag pa'i ngang nas lha skur 'ja' ltar shar/ shar ba las sa sprul skur 'gro don mdzad/ /theg mchog chos kyi don gnyis lhun grub shog /bkra shis ni/ thugs rje chen pos sgo gsum byin gyis brlab/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mthu stobs nus pas dngos grub char ltar 'bebs/ /phur pa 'phrin las lha tshogs bkra shis shog /rno myur rtsal gyis dgra bgegs thal —322

phur pa lcag khang drag sngags spu gri'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam/ nang ma rtoganabar rlog /phur skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang po ltar / /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces phyogs thams cad du me tog sil mas kun tu khyab par bya'o/ /smras pa/ mkhan slob chos rgyal dam pa'i drin las gangs can ljongs 'di'i yol go'i nang / /zab rgyas chos kyi yid bzhin nor bus phyur bur gtams pa'i 'dod 'jo las/ /skal bzang rnams la mchog thun dngos grub 'byor pa'i bgo skal rab thob kyang / /da ni snyigs ma lnga bdo'i shugs kyis dam pa'i lam srol phal cher nyams/ /sa 'dzin dkar pos bskor ba'i bod yul 'dir/ /nor ldan blun po'i gtsug na mngon par (18ba tshe gying / /stobs ldan zog po 'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom/ /rigs rus tsam gyis dregs pa'i nga ro sgrog /skye bar ming btags mthon po'i khri la 'dzegs/ /gang shar skyong la sangs rgyas mdzad par smra/ /mkhas rlom phal cher chos spong sgrib pas sbags/ /blo ldan rnams kyang zab chos skal bas dben/ /de phyir gsang chen zab mo'i legs bshad gtam/ /theg mchog snying po'i bstod 'di'i dgos pa ni/ /'on kyang rang nyid dran pa gso ba dang / /gzur gnas 'ga' la phan snyam bdag gis bris/ /dbang lung cho so kyis phongs pa'i bla chen dang / /tha snyad tshig tsam lhur len rtog ge pa/ /blang dor blta la mig sdongs blun sgom la/ /'di 'dra bstan kyang sprul la gla rtsi bzhin/ zhes bya'i gnas las tha ga pa brin pa'i/ /bod 'dir skyes kyang dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /nges gsang theg pa'i chos la gdengs tshad rnyed/ /bsams shing bka' drin dran no rdo rje 'dzin/ /gangs khrod phur pa'i lugs srol rgyu skar dbus/ /jo lugs lha brag zab gter nyin byed kyi/ /las byang 'byer bder bkod pa'i dge ba'i gzis/ /nag phyogs bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal bar lha/ga /ces lha brag gter byon gyi phur pa lcags khang drag sngags spu gri la dril sgrub sbyar ba'i las byang 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam zhes bya ba 'di yang / rang nyid kyi brjed byang du/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs las/ rdo rje 'chang bshes gnyen dam pa'i gzugs can dpal 'byor lhun grub dang zur thams cad mkhyen pa sogs yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin —323

las/ gsang sngags bka' gter gyi don phyogs tsam rig cing / snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa'i ring lugs pa za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan zil gnon drag rtsal du 'bod pas tshig phrad sgyur bsnan dang gsar du'ang cung zad kha bkang rang lo nyer bdun pa gro zhun can gyi dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang me tog rnam par bkra ba'i lding khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //maṅga lo// //

phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ nang ma rtogan༄༅༅/ /byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las 'khor lo'i lha/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nur legs shar pa/ /bsnyen sgrub bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /'phrin las sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig 'dri/ /de la 'dir bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bar chad kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha rdo rje phur pa zhes sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal skyon chen po'i thugs dam gong khug ma jo mo lugs su grags pa la bka' gter gnyis su bzhugs pa'i phyi ma la gter kha 'ga' zhig yod pa'i lho brag mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i lho gser mdzod dang byang lcags mdzod nag po'i zab gter las byon pa'i phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi man ngag la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/che mchog dang spu gri'i dbang so so'i gter gzhung ltar nod pa'am/ yang lcags khang ma'i dbang shin tu rgyas par ma tshang ba rnams che mchog nas kha bskang ba/ tha ma'ang che mchog dang drag sngags gang yang rung ba'i dbang gi chu bo ma nub cing dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi drung du smin byed kyi dbang legs par mnos pa/ rgyab rten (2na)gyi lung sogs nyams su blang bya'i chos rnams la sgro 'dogs mtha' chod par byas nas sngags gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs kho na lhur blangs pa la re ba 'cha' mi dgos par shog ser gyi dri ma kha chil li ba'i gdeng tshad dang ldan pa zhig gis/ rgyud las/ra bran mang po 'dus pa'i phyir ri pos bskor ba'i lcug phran tshal: ri mtho sa gtsang nags tshal —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geldan: shin tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su: zhes gsungs pa lta bus mtshon te/ sgrub chen gyi sngon 'gro nas bshad pa'i gnas/ grogs/ yo byad sogs sta gon legs par byas/ bsnyen sgrub la shis pa'i gza' skar dus sbyor dang bstun pa'i yar ngo'am/ yang na mar ngo la'ang rung bas bsnyen pa'i dus kyi yun tshad dang gza' tshes sogs la skabs dang sbyar nas gnas khang byi dor bya/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkod pas mdzes shing / rigs 'dzin brgyud pa yi dam chos srung gi bris 'bur gyi sku byin rlabs can dgram/ sgrub rdzas rnams zhal ltor gzigs pa'i dbang du byas pa'i stegs bu'am cog tse lta bu ci rigs pa'i steng du sgrub gtor sku rten tsaka lis brgyan pa steng du dar nag gi gdugs phub pa/ sman raka /phyi nang gi nyer spyod rol mo/ phur srung / (2bsko ter srung / gzhan yang gtor bsngo gang byed kyi chos srung gi mchod gtor/ rgyal chen bzhi dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ tsho gos chas sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bkod/ zhal sprod kyi tshul du byang gzigs kyis sgrub pa po'i stan gyi 'og tu sa'am 'bru dkar po'i g.yung drung ris chos skor du 'dri/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje srin po'i nga rgyal la gnas pas bsnyen phur la byug bdug brab gsum gyi sgo nas gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyag len dmigs pa dang bcas pa dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las ji ltar byung ba ltar lag tu bstar te sgrub gtor gyi mdun du phur gdan la zhal tshur gzigs pa'i tshul gyis btsugs/ bgegs la dkar gtor dmar gtor byin nas bka' bsgo zhing gu gul gyi dud pas gdugs/ yungs thun rol mo dang bcas pa'i tsham ngam gyis bskrad/ mtho bzhi la rgyal po bzhi'i sku dang bcas te rgyal chen mtho 'dzugs gzhung bzhin byed/ srung 'khor bsgom zhing sgo drung du mtho dkar po zhig brtsig go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ srod thun nas 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs/ bzlas pa'i 'gor 'phreng ba byin gyis brlab pa zab gter 'di nyid kyi khyad chos bzhin 'phyugs med du bya/ rang rdo rje phur par gsal ba'i thugs dar nyi ma'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' yab dang tshul mtshungs pa rgyan med pa mtshon gang pa zhig gsal btab pa'i thugs gar rdo rje rtse dgu pa nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar gsung gi ngo bo hūṃ yig sngon —326

phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ nang ma rtoganapo spus bris pa tsam gyi mtha' skor du gsang ba'i yi ge 'bru bcu bzhi pa spu shad tsam gyis bskor bar gsal 'debs pa ni/ rgyud las/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' nyid rgyan med yab dang tshul mthun pa mtshon gang pa zhig bsgom par bya de yi thugs dar phyag mtshan gyi: rdo rje rtse dgu nasa'abras tsam: de yi lte bar gsung gi rtags: ྅ sngon spu yis bris pa tsam: de yi tha mar gī lā ya:gser mdog skra shad tsam gyis bskor zhes pa'i don no/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i mdun du bsnyen phur rdo rje gzhen nu yab yum zhal sprod kyi tshul du skad cig gis bskyed/ bdag mdun gnyis ska'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te sdig sgrib sbyang ba man ngag ltar byed/ yang 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad yi dam lha'i rnam par rong rong gyur pa bdag mdun phur gsum la bstim pa dang / de bzhin du bcud thams cad lha dang /snod thams cad gzhal yas khang du bsgyur nas so/ /so sor byin gyis brlabs pas rten brten pa bkrag dang gzi mdangs rgyas par bsam/ rang gi thugs rka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas nas 'thon/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros/mdun gyi gtso bo'i shangs bug g.yon du zhugs/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon par zhugs te song bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i hūṃ yig la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer phyir 'phros ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas nas 'thon/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud mdun bskyed kyi shangs bug g.yas nas phyir byung ste rang gi g.yon du zhugs/ rim pa bzhin ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas brgyud ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la phog /de lta bu'i dmigs pa mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar bya/ yang (3ba tshe(phren las rnam bzhi'i dmigs pa spyi bye brag thams cad kyang skabs thob kyis phye ba'i zhal shes ltar bya/ snying mdzod las gsungs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor drug po gter gzhung gi rdo rje'i tshig la man ngag gi mdud pa bkrol ba bzhin 'chub che chung dang bstun pa'i nyams su len/ mjug tu rang gi thugs dzi'i 'od zer gyis mdun —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'baskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas mdun bskyed kyi sku de las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du so sor byung nas gcig 'dzab phur la thim cig shos je chung du song ba mthar rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs thugs ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim pas bdag dang phur pa gnyis ka gzi mdangs rgyas par bsam/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal gyi mjug tu spel tshig btags pa lan bdun brjod/ tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum phur srung gter srung mchod cing bskang ba byed/ bsnyen pa la tshogs nub re bzhin gyi spros pa mi dgos pas mi gtong phyin lhag ma chad mtho bstan skyong rnams gzhung bzhin btang / slar bdag bskyed gsal btab ste mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ rten brten pa thams cad skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i sems kyi rol rtsed tsam du thag bcad nas ye stong ka dag gi ngang du lhod kyis glod/ slar yang lhun grub 'od lnga'i rang mdangs 'ja' tshon lta bur lam gyis 'char bcug ste dge ba bsngo/ 'dzab bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas dgung thun la gnyid log thor thun snga thun dgongs thun gsum dang rjes kyi srod thun rnams la 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs kyang rung mod/ sngags gsar ma ba ltar de ltar ma byas na chad lhag tu gyur gyi dogs pa'i the tshom lugs srol 'di la bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i gzhung sgra ji bzhin pa (4na loms len gyi spros bcas la'ang / lhun grub 'dus ma byas 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du rtsis zin pa'i gnad 'gag gis blo 'tshub dang sbubs 'thum ma dgos pas/ mi spro na thun gzan gsum la mngon rtogs bsdus pa zhig gis gsal btab rjes bar chad bsrung dmigs dbyangs gsal la spel tshig btags pa/'dzab kyi bang nas gnyid log pa gsum po spangs pa'i srod thun ji lta ba'i bzlas brjod dang / mchod bstod/ ka dag gi rdzogs rim/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams dkyus bzhin bya/ snga thun pa khyad chos thun 'gor 'bru gsum gyi mjug tu dbyangs gsal la spel tshig zhabs bcad ma btags pa bdun brjod/khams cung zad seng ba sogs kyi dus 'phreng ba la mdud pa rgyab nas gdan steng du 'jog /thun mtshams gang bos shig tu dge sbyor gyi rigs gzhan dang / phur srung / gter srung / gzhi bdag —328

phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ nang ma rtoganamachod pa sogs byed/ bsnyen tshad ni/ rdo rje phur pa thugs gsang sku'i rgyud las/ sa ya drug 'bum bsnyen pa'i tshad: de rdzogs nas ni rtags 'di 'byung : khrag 'thung nga yi zhal mthong zhing : phyag mtshan phur bu gar du 'khrab gtor ma rak+ta bdud rtsi khol: zhes gsungs pas/ yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa'i bsnyen rkyang la drag bo rang byung rang shar las/ brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba bzlas: zhes pa ltar sngagasarnying ma'i lugs su bye ba sngon du btang ba'i sa ya 'dren pas shin tu 'grus pa'i dbang du byas na thun re la khri tsho rer cha bzhag tshe zla ba brgyad 'gor zhing / nyi ma zhag rer khri tsho gsum tsam gyi rtsis byas na lo gcig la bsnyen pa thems so/ /de nas sgrub pa ni/ rgyud las/ sa gzhi nag la gting zab pa:gnam sa gnyis/drag po'i gzugs (4ba)brag nag ngos rgyar bdug pa sa drag po'i sal maṇ+ḍal bya dbus su gru gsum tha ma sa zla gam gsum gyis bskor ba dang : khyams sgo rta babs la sogasate dkyil 'khor rgyan rnams rdzogs par 'dri zhes pa ltar dur khrod kyi sa la sogs pa drag po'i rdzas sna bsres pa'i stegs bu ro sol gyis kha dog nag por byas pa la gri khrag gis chag chag btab/sa brtag bslang sogs sgrub chen nas bshad pa'i spros pa rnams dor/ bgegs gtor/ rgyal chen mtho 'dzugs rnams sngon du bsnyen pa'i skabs song zin pas bsnyen sgrub sbrel ma la go bcad/ thig tshon byin rlabs sogs rdul tshon skabs med du mi rung ba'i cho ga rnams dang bcas dkyil 'khor brisapa'i steng du phur cha dgod/ de tsam ma lcogs na tshon gyi rnam gzhag rnams dor ba'i ras bris la phur cha dgod/ shin tu bsdu na rtsa ba'i thig chen brgyad logs thig dang bcas btab par phur cha dgod/phur cha yongs rdzogs ma rnyed na khro bcu/ phra phyag /sgo ba sogs la rdul tshon gyi skabs tshoni spungs sam phyag mtshan 'dri ba gang rung ras bris la sku dang mtshan ma gang bris de ga dang / bsdu na 'khor rnams la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas rung la/ gtso bo'i phur pa dang las phur gnyis ni med du mi rung ba'o/ /mdun du ma sdi'i khri la sgrub gtor/ g.yas su sman dang g.yon du rak+ta/ byang shar du mtshamasa'adzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog /bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ dri —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gechab/ byang du zhal zas/ khrag gi a lha/ dbang po'i me tog sogs 'dod yon nang gi mchod pa rnamasakyang mthong ba rgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham/ sgrub gtor bka' srung gi mchod pa rnams sngar bsnyen pa'i skabs (5na yog mas pa de ga yod na gsar du ma bzos kyang chog /srod thun nas 'go bzung ste thun bzhir gcod pa sogs bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ 'on kyang dmigs pa'i khyad par bdag bskyed kyi srung 'khor gzhal yas khang bsgom pa dang lhan du gtso bo dang rnam rgyal gyi bar der gzhal yas khang bsgom/de bzhin du lha rnams kyang bdag mdun gnyis ka dus gcig tu me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gsal btab ste bdag mdun gyi gtso bo gnyis zhal sprod kyi tshul gyi las byang gi gzhung bsrangs/ gtso bo dril sgrub ltar bskyed na bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gsum ka tshang bar lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i sngagasagon ral ba can rnams bzhed do/ /chos dbang rin po che'i phur pa spu gri la sras mchog rigasabazhi'i tha snyad ma gsungs kyang / byang gter gyi phur pa 'bring po 'dir sras mchog rigs bzhi'i rnam gzhag mtshan ldan bla ma ngag dbang grags pa sogs mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pas bsgom par spro na rnam rgyal gyi mdun du burnya gī lwa ya/ de bzhin du/ gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsum gyi mdun du rim bzhin/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ dme ki lā ya rnams bsgom/ gzungs thag 'then/ sgrub pa'i sngags ni/ yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa la dza hūṃ āḥgasum bsnan pa'i bcu bdun pa la bsnyen/ bsnyen tshad ni/ gsang rgyud lag grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gsum rtags bsnyen rtags byung bar du bzla zhes bye ba gsum bzla bar gsungs pas thun re la khri phrag re 'gro ba'i dbang du byas na zla ba byed gsum la bsnyen tshad thems/ sgrub pa kho na'i dbang du btang ste thun bzhi ga la las byang gi gzhung bsdus tsam re btang / dgongs (5ba)thun gyi mthar tshogs bsdus pa re btang ba'i tshogs lhag dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar mtshams su spungs pa sogs phyag len ltar byed/ grub rtags ni/ rgyud las/ stong —330

phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ nang ma rtoganagasum zhabs kyis brdzis pa dang : nyi zla khong du mid pa dang : ri rab lag gis bskor ba dang : rgya mtsho hub kyis btungs pa dang : dngos sam nyams sam rmi lam du grub pa'i rtags re nges par 'byung : zhes so/ /de nas las sbyor ni/ rgyud las/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum rim pa gsum: zangs lcagasa'akhar ba'i phye ma la: khrag rgod pa sras la byug par bya: drag po'i shing la zur gsum rtsang : nyer gcig srin mo'i 'gros su bkod rnam shes tshang ba'i liṅga bri: zhes pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phungs sogs drag po ba rdzas kyi 'grub khung kha khyer rtsang sogs phyag len ltar rngam brjid dang ldan par bsham/ lugs srol 'di pa'i man ngag las byung ba'i liṅga sngags can rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi drod rlangs ma yal ba phyag len ltar bris te hom khung du bcug /phur srung bskul ba/dgug 'dren/ lha dbye sogs yid ches par byas/ thun bzhi la las sbyor gyi sngags sgrub sngags kyi mjug tu dha te rnam gsum gyi sngags btags pa 'dren no/ /sngags ni/ drang so gter ston gsum pa yol mo ba chen pos gsungs pa'i bsnyen yig ltar bzla zhing thun bzhi ga'i mjug tu thun brdeg /rtags rdzogs na mdun gcig tsam nas phur gdab sogs bsgral las yongs su rdzogs par byas te/rgyud las/ cha gcig dug gsum me la bsreg cha gcig klu la gtad par bya: cha gcig gtor stegasa'og tu mnan zhes pa ltar mnan sreg gis mjug bsdu/ 'di la zhal shes dang drag sngags spyi sdoms kyi gnad la nang byan (6na mi dgos/ dgra dmigs bsal med cing mtshon don tsam byed na zan ling gis kyang go chod do/ /gdab kha drug 'khrul med du nyams su len par 'dod na mthong rgyud kyi phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid las shes par bya'o/ /mtshams 'grol rgyu'i 'gas las byang rgyas pa tshogasamachod dang bcas pa 'bul/ phur cha/ sgrub gtor sogs sgrub rdzas rnams las bskul tshig gi sgo nasadangos grub len pa snga 'gyur spyi gzhung ltar byed/ sngar gyi tshogs lhag rnams dang bcas te tshogs lhag gtong / chad mtho/ bstan skyong / dkyil 'khor bsdu chog /smon lam/ bkra shis/ rgyal mtho 'grol ba sogs lag len gzhung bzhin bya/ nang mtshams 'grol nyin dam ldan 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad/ mig —331—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2podagra dang nyi zla'i phyogs su lta stangs byed/ gzhan la srung ba sogs byin rlabs kyi rigs byed pa/mtshams nang gi dngos po phyir gtong ba/ skra sen 'breg pa/ mchil ma 'dor ba/ 'phreng ba la reg pa sog bsrung / thog ma nas mtshams khog tu ma bcug pa'i mi/ dngos po/ yi ge sogs mi gtong bsamatshon te bsnyen sgrub kyi dam tshig la gnas pa ni shin tu gces so/ /'di ni phur pa 'bring po sbu gri la sbyar ba'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi dbang du btang ba yin la/ bsnyen tshad ha cang mangs pas skyid lug na gzhom ni gong du bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor phur cha sogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung la sngags kyang 'bru bcu bdun pa bzlas/ thun re re bzhin las byang gtong ba/ dgongs thun la tshogs gtong ba rnams spangs te bsnyen pa ltar nyams su blangs pa'i grangs bsnyen bye ba gsum btang bas bsnyen sgrub zung 'brel du 'grub pa 'jug pa bde ba'i gnad dam pa sprul pa'i sku yol mo ba chen po yang thugs (6bsko tsigs su mdzad do/ /de nas sgrub pa po bsnyen sgrub zung 'brel du song bas go chod mod/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar sa bcad ma stong tsam byed na gsang rgyud le'u rtsa bdun pa nas gsungs pa'i dha ti'i sngags 'bru nyer bdun pa zhag gsum gyi bar bzla zhing / rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdus dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang phur srung rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs te bzla/ de yang rgyud las/ dha ti bos pa'i snying po 'di stong phrag gsum du bzlas par bya: dam can dngos su 'du bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs pas thun re la stong phrag gsum bzla ba'i dbang du yin zhing / de las mang ba byung na legs so/ /las spyor man ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /yang che mchog gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum bya bar 'dod na/ bsnyen pa ni las byang brje ba tsam las khyad par med/ sgrub pa'i skabs sku'i rgyud las/ sku gsung thugs kyi phur pa gsum sku shar gsung lho thugs ni byang : zla gam gsum la dgod par bya: zhes lugs 'di dang chos dbang gi spu gri sogs la sras mchog rigs lnga'i tha snyad mi byed par sku gsung thugs kyi phur pa gsum zla gam gsum la bkod/ phur cha byings 'god lugs 'dra/ mar khu khrag zhag 'o ma bzhin: dkyil 'khor —332

phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ nang ma rtoganabar khyams dag tu bzhag: ces rdzas bzhi po yang dgod/ rang che mchog rdo rje gzhen nu dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs kyi sras phur gsum po gsal gdab/rgyud dang man ngag ltar sgrub sngags gsum ga bsgril nas bzla/ dril sgrub ni bsnyen pa drag sngags lha nag dang 'dra/ sgrub pa'i skabs sgrub sngags la khro bcu'i sngags btags pa'o/ /de ltar 'phrin las dpal chen he ru ka /lugs(7na〉na sum phur bur grags pa lha brag gter/ phyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gong khug ma/ /jo mo lugs srol kun gyi yang rtser son/ /tshul 'di'i smin grol gdams pa'i gnad 'gag rnams/ /rigs 'dzin zhal lung mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ /zur chen 'jam dbyangasabla ma'i bka' drin las/ /legs thob snying gi ze'u 'brur rtag tu bsten/ /la la bdag mdun bca' gzhi'i spros pa sogs/ /mi shes rdzogs chen spros bral lta ba yi/ /ming tsam rgyal brten pa'i zol sbyor gyi/ /zog gis rang gzhan gnyis ka phung ba'ang mthong / kha cig snga 'gyur rnam dbye ma dod par/ /kye rdor la sogs phyi 'gyur cho ga yis/ /rgyas bkab smig rgyus skom nad sel 'dod pa'i/ /mkhas rlom nam mkha'i 'ja' la sbar 'dzin 'dra/ /rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i thugs tig sna nam par/ /legs gdamasargod kyi ldem phyur bka' babs pa'i/ /zab don rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i lugs srol bzhin/ /'di ba'i ngo mtshar skal bzang 'di na rnyed/ /de 'dra snga 'gyur bstan 'dzin kun gyi rje/ /byang bdag rigs 'dzin mchog gi sprul pa'i gar/ /legs bsgyur dam ldan rdo rje'i slob ma yi/ /bzhed skong theg mchog bstan la bsams nas bkod/ /dge des log par 'khu ba'i dgra sde'i dpung / /sras mchogo badz+ra gī las bsgral ba dang / /lhan cig bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra tshogs kun/ /rang rig don gyi phur busasgrol gyur cig /ces lha brag gter byon gyi phur pa lugs gsum ga'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa 'di yang rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba byang pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i (7ba)gar mkhan bya nag gi rigs su 'khrungs pa blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'ablangs te/ gter kha 'di nyid la mes ston chen po'i gdams pa rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa legs ldan rdo rje las nye bar brgyud pa dang / se ston chen po'i man ngag mnyam med nub dgon pa las brgyud pa gnyis tshogs chu bo gcig 'dus dpal chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis stobs rgyal nas gter ston yol mo ba chen po'i bar du byon pa'i smin byed lung phyag bzhes kyi bka' babs zur chen rigs kun khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol la mnos shing / rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po nas bkra bzang pa se ston thugs mtsho 'od 'bar gyi bar du byon pa'i dbang dang man ngag /spyi ston tshe ring dbang po'i zhal shes/ phur pa lnga khra'i chos sde las byung ba'i tshe dbang / lha khrid gsum zur ngag dbang phun tshogs las brgyud pa rnams mkhas grub khra tshang pa chen po las thos te tshad thub kyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams yun du bsten pa'i bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba'i za hor gyi sngags spyon drag po rtsal gyis lcags pho byi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes dgu la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo// //sarba maṅga lo// //—334

byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ nang ma khog da ra༅༅/ /byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar bzhugs so/ /dpal chen phur bu'i lha khyod dran pa'i mod/ /bdud dpung me lces rtobazhin phyer 'thag na/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen rnal 'byor bsnyen sgrub las/ /bstar tshe mchog mthun dngos grub cis mi thob//de phyir lam 'di'i smin grol man ngag rnams/ /lhug par ston mdzad zur chen thams cad mkhyen/khyab bdag nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje'i zhabs/ /rigs kun 'khor lo'i mgon du rtag par bzhugs/ /spyi dang bye brag mi mthun nyes brgya'i mun/ /sel byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'od dkar can/ /sngon byon dam pa'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med bzhin/ khung ngu rnam gsal klags chog deng 'dir spel/ /de yang dpal phyon gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis yang le shod kyi phug par yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bar chad kyis glags bltas par de 'dul ba'i gnyen po dgos tshul rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnams la 'phrin btang bas/ rdo rje phur pa'i glegs bam mi khur gnyis yang le shod du 'byor pa tsam gyis bar gcod zhi bar brten/ yang dag ni tshong pa dang 'dra phur pa ni skyel ma dang 'dra zhes nag po'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar mchog tu bsngags pa'i dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i skor la bka' gter rnam grangs mang du yod pa'i nang nas slob dpon chen po'i thugs kyi brnog (2na)chos/ lha brag gter byon phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa nyams su bstar bar/ thugs sgrub kyi ye shes rang 'bar las/ nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi 'dod na dbyar gyi tho rengs snga dro brtsam zhes pa ltar/ zhi ba'i las bsgrub pa la shis pa'i dus tshod gza' skar sogs dang bstun sngon chad ma dul ba'i sa gsar pa la sgrub chen las 'byung ba'i sa chog dang gnas khang rnying pa sogs la —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebyed par mi spro na/ btang snyoms su bzhag /bgegs gtore/ gzhi bdag gtor ma/ sdebargyad spyir gser skyems btang ste cha bsnyams/ bsnyen mtshams lta bu dang 'brel ba'i rgyal mtho ma bkrol gong yin na/ de dag kyang ched du gnyer mi dgos so/ /gang du byed kyang phyag bdar dang / skyang nul bya/drag shul spyod pa'i cho ga'i rdzas dang ma 'dres pa'i gtsang zhing sa bkra bzang po nas blangs pa'i sa la stegs bu brtsig /ye shes rang 'bar las/ zhi ba'i dbyibs ni zlum po dkar: zhes dang / rang rang lha yi sa bon nam me tog bskor bsahrūb 'gyur nyid: ces pa ltar/ de'i steng du thig chen brgyad btab pa'i lte ba nas mtho gang bskor ba'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ (2ba〉ste bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rtsibs la khro bcu phra phyag dang khyams kyi mtshams bzhir sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan nam sa bon bsdu na tshon spungs/ de'i phyi rol tu sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyi mu khyud zlum po nyis rim du bskor pa la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa bris/ ye shes rang 'bar las/ zhi ba tsan dan dkar po'am shug pa dkar po'i shing gis bkang : zhes pa ltar/ de'i steng du tsan dan dkar po dang shug pa 'o ma can sogs kyi shing la yang mi rung ba min na'ang 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po'i thab zlum po rgyar khru gang pa dpangs su de'i phyed cha brtsigs par 'bras dkar ram sa dkar lta bus kha dog bsgyur/ man ngag ltar me tshang bca' zhing shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba zhig 'jog /me yol gyi ngos la gangasari'i dbyibs dang sa bon gyi yi ge phyogs ma log par bris/ ye shes gsal sgron las/ spos mar byugs pa'i yam shing ni: rigs dang mthun pa'i ring thung tshad: zhi ba lcang ma sor brgyad la: zhes/ 'o ma can dang lcang ma la sogs pa'i shing srin 'bus ma zos shing gas chag gi skyon dang bral ba srid du sor brgyad pa sboms su mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam pa rtsa rtse gnyis la mar dang 'o ma dang sbrang rtsi byugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri zhim po'i chu dkar pos sbags pa ye shes gsal sgron las/ sdig sgrib zhi ba'i sreg rdzas ni: til dang nas 'bras yungs skar gro so sran la sogs hrū sna dang : 'o ma zho dang —336

byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ nang ma (gnamar dkar rdzas: sbrang bur ka ra sman sna dang : rgyan 'brum la sogs shing tog dang : sha tshil dar zab rin cen tshogs chang dang sha khrag btung ba'i tshogs: phye dang lan tsha spong la sogs dur ba ku sha rma bya'i mdongs: (3na ji ngos 'byor tshogs 'khor dpag med dang : dri zhim me tog sna tshogasabasag ces pa ltar/ kha dog dkar po'i mar khu sogs rdzas chen nyer bdun rang rdzas kyis sbagasapa/ rdzas sna brgyad dang ldan zhing rlabs btsos byas pa'i 'bras dkar gyi zas mchoge /khyad par gyi rdzas gu gul dkar po/ tsan dan dkar po/ du rba/ bri ya byu/ thang chu/ 'bras yos/ tsaskra ka /'dod gsol gyi shing byang spel tshig can rnams thun mong ma yin pa'i dam rdzas lngas sbags shing byang bum gtogs pa rnams gcig tu bsres nas ril bu byas kyang rung / de yang rdzas rnams me lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha gnyis la mang nyung gi dbye bas shel dkar po sogs rin po che'am khams dkar po'i snod du bkod nas g.yas phyogs su las mthun gyi stan la go rim ma nor bar bkod/ rang rdzas dmigs bsal bsres pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi nang gi nyer mchod so sor g.yon phyogs su bsgrig /mdun du las bum/ me tog /thod pa ltag sprod kyi rnga chung / rdo rje/ dgang blugs kha sbyar dril bu/ sman raka /ku sha brgyad/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab ri mo can/ so rtsi sbyar ma/ gos zungs sogs yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams/ de nas bsgrub pa po lus la dri zhim po byugs/ zhi ba'i gar chas sam/ ma 'grub na gos rgyan/ thod dkar po bya/ stan nang tshangs can gyi steng du pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis shar phyogs su kha bltas la/ sngar ma zin na las byang nas tsho gos kyi bar bya/ de nasang ga bcad/ rdor dril bcangs te/ de nyid dang rnga byin rlabs gsang rdzogs kyi lhan thabs ltar bya/ gzar bu gnyis(3ba〉brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi tshul du bkug ste gzar bu gnyis la thim/ de zhu ba las/ hūṃ las blugs gzar rdo rje dang / a las dgang gzar dril bu'i rnam pa can yongs su gyur pa las ga rma he ru ka mthing nag phyag gnyis phur bu bsgril —337—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pob dang 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu nas blugs gzar dang dgang gzar gyi rnam par bsam/ las bum ni sgrub khog dngos grub rgya mtsho nas len/ gtor ma brlab pa ni/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs ltar bya/ mchod pa ni g.yas bskor gyis bsangs chu dang sman phud nas kyang gtor te gsang rdzogs ltar brlab/ sreg rdzas ni bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i sreg rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi zhi ba'i las rab 'byams ma lus bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par mos la/ phyag rgya dang bcas te/ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ swā hās rdzas rnams bkru/ ā+oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing / ā+oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ ā+oṃ dzi swā hās 'bru/ ā+oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas/ gzhan rnams brlabs/ ā+oṃ āḥ& 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad shi nyi ku ru swā hā/ zhes nus ldan gyi bdud rtsir mos so/ /me sgrub pa ni/ las sngags brjod cing gzhung bzhin khungs su ldan gyi me las sbar ba'i spor lde thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas lan gsum bskor ba dang mnyam du gī la ya bzla zhing / ting lo sbar ba dang bcas/ chu a gli raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod (4na༄nga rto skam cung zad btsug /rtsa sngags dang bcas blugs gzar gsum gyis me gso rlung g.yab kyis cung zad g.yab/ me bkra brtag cing ngan na gzhil ba'i thabs bya/ thab sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dang raṃ lasanyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru byed pa/ kha khyer ngang mu ran gnyis ka sor bzhi pa rdo rje'i 'phreng bas zlum por bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ dkar po las bgrang 'phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ me lha sku mdog dkar po ra —338

byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ nang ma (gnaskyes la zhen pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gas dang g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa gsus khyim che ba/ral pa'i thor tshugs can/sma ra'i ag tsho mes dang tshangs pa'i skud pa 'phyang ba/sku las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/de'i dpral bar ā+oṃ/mgrin par āḥ/thugs gar hūṃ/de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ri rab kyi me mtshams nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥrdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing dbyu gu de gsum pa'i phyag rgyas rna ba'i drung nas g.yabs te/hūṃ/dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis tshur gshegs tshun gshegs 'byung ba che me lha'i drang srong bram ze mchog:sreg blugs zhal zas bzhesaslad du 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol:a la la ste dgyes par mdzod:e khye hi bha ga wa na ma hā ka ru 4bkaṇi ka tri shu sngos ma ya ste:asni dzaḥdzaḥ/ baṃ ho.a gli : wa shrī hūṃ dza/dzaḥ& baṃ lhos ma ya skye zhes spyan drangs shing gdan 'bul/hūṃ/me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog:zhi ba'i don la dam tshig dgongs gzi brjid che zhing thugs rjer ldan bdag cag gus pas khyod phyag 'tshal:ā+oṃ — ye de wa sa ti pu bra la sngos phyag bya/hūṃ/drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la//mchod yon zhabs bsil me rtag spos//sgron me dri chab zhal zas sgra//'bul gyis zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//ā+oṃ asna ye de wa rā dza ji pā dza hūṃ oṃ pā rdu pā dza hūṃ sogs nas sha lta pā dza hūṃ gi bar gyis phyi mchod 'bul/hūṃ/drang srong chen pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i:ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur zhal zasabadud rtsi 'di dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags kyis:ye shes thugs rje'i sgo nas bzhes su gsol cha a gli de wa rā dza pā dza 'a hi/sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta khā hi/ma hā ba smra ta khā hi/mahā rak+ta khā hi/zhes nang mchod 'bul/hūṃ/gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos//'dod yon mi zad nam mkha' mdzod//longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di//me lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//ā+oṃ asni de wa rā dza ga ṇa tsakra pā dza khā hi zhes tshogis phud 'bul//hūṃ/tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras:me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog 'byung po yongs la skyabs bya'i phyir/thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa:rig sngags

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2posgrub pa'i drang srong tshul nyen mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar mngon shes rdo snyul zhabs dang ldan thabs kyi theg pa ra la bcibs bgrang 'phreng 'dzin cing rig sngags gsung : (ldan〉dud rtsi bcud ldan — bsnams: chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil:nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod 'jig rten tshul 'dzin mya ga 'das zhi ba mnyes shing thugasarje che: de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: zhes bstod/ ku sha brgyad po lag g.yon tu bzung sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa zhi ba'i las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'di yis bdag la bgegs med cing / las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /badz+ra satwa a/zhes ku sha rnams rtse mo g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin rtsa bas rtse mo mnan la dgram/ byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ dang dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ yig gis mtshan par mos nas/ ā+oṃ asna me swā hā/ zhes brjod cing / blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la pus mo'i khongs las lag pa gnyis mi 'da' ba'i rdo rje khu tshur ram byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar zhing g.yas su bskor te/ ā+oṃ asna ye di bya di bya bi shudhe shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul zhing me bkra gsal ba'i sgron me ltar brtag cing ngan na bsrung / me lha'i thugs nas 'od 'phros pas/ /bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ mi mthun phyogs (5ba〉kyin dud khu dang / /rnag khrag srog chags gzugs brnyan tshul/ /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /phyir thon sreg rdzas rnams la thim/ /zhes brjod nas/ hūṃ/ drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la/ /rdzas chen nyer bdun sreg rdzas 'bul/ /tshe dpal bsod nams stobs lor dang / /lung rtogs chos srid legs tsho gos la/ /—340

byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ nang ma rtog)bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs dgra/ /gtad sel mnan dbye rbod gtong byad/ /dbul phongs nad rims dus min 'chi/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung ji snyed pa/ /ma lus byang zhing dag 'gyur pa'i/ /zhi ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab/ /ces brjod de g.yon pas sreg rdzas kyi snod bzung / g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bslangs te/ 'og nas bskor zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas yam shing ni/ ā+oṃ — ye badz+ra yadz+nyā ya/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa sogs nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa thog mtha' gnyis ci rigs dang rdzas sngags rkyang pas bdun nam bcu bzhi nyer gcig sogs skabs sbyar 'bul/ 'dir bsnyen pa kha skong gi spel tshig bkod pa yin la/ lasagazhan sgrub na kha bsgyur lugs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar byed/ lha rdzas kyi sngags gnyis gong ltar la/ me tog sna tsho gos ni gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa'i tshab tu mdangs phun sum tshogs pa la/zhes pas mtshon te las sngags bsgyur mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal byung ba rnams ma ga rta gos 'don pa bsgyur lugs rigs 'gre /dar sna ni kha dog phun sum tsho gos pa/ mar ni/ ā+oṃ asna yes/ lha rdzasaganyis ka'i sngags kyis go bcad de 'byor pa phun sum (6na)tshogs pa la/ til ni/ ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya/ dge ba phun sum tshogs pa la/ sngags gnyis gong ltar gyi/ chang ni nyams rtogs phun sum tshogs pa la/ spos ni dam tshig dang sdom pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ du rba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā yu tshetshe phun sum tshogs pa la/ 'bras ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pu spyo ye/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la/ sob ni/ā+oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la/ zas mchogo ni/ ā+oṃ sarba /bha de/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la/ ku sha ni/ cas pra te ha ta ba dz+nyā ya/ srung ba phun sum tsho gos pa la/ yungs kar dang sha khrag tshil gsum rnams lhan cig tu/ oṃ sarba ar+sha sa ṅgā ya/ gegs med phun sum tsho gos pa la/ sngags gong bzhin gyi/ rma bya'i sgro ni/ 'og gdon gyi 'tshe ba med pa phun sum tsho gos pa la/ lan tsha ni sbyor ba ngan pa med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ nas ni/ ā+oṃ ma hā be ghā ya/ shugs phun sum tshogs —341—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepa la/ sngags gnyis gong ltar gyi/ 'o ma ni longs spyod phun sum tsho gos pa la/ sran ma dang rin po che sna tshogs rnams lhan cig tu/ ā+oṃ ma hā ba lwa ya/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la/ gro ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ghasma re/rims med pa phun sum tsho gos pa la/ dngar gsum ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma le pusta ya/ mos pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ sman sna tshogs ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī yaṃ pa ta ye/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ shing tog sna tsho gis ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sha ba le/ rigs brgyud phun sum tsho gos pa spru/ 'bru mar ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra tshe tā ya/ sa lam gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa la/ khyad par gyi rdzas spyi rnams (6ba)tshwa asna ye bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ shing byang ni/ sngags bshad ma thag pa ltar dang / bdag cag la bar du gcod pa'i me'i 'jigs pa de dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang / nad kyi 'jigs pa dang / mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang / pha rol dmag tsho gis kyi 'jigs pa dang / gdon gyi 'jigs pa dang / mtshon gyi 'jigs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa brgyad po shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i grangs sngar ltar gyis 'bul/ hūṃ/ sreg rdzas mchode pas me yi lha/ /mnyes te sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /bsgrub bya'i snying gar phog pa yis/ /slar yang sgo gsum sdig sgrib bsregs/ /'od zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ltar/ /babs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams rab bkrus te/ /bshang gci'i lam nas thon par gyur/ zhes brjod/ ā+oṃ asna ye de wa rā dza arnya byu dza nas sha lta'i bar gyis sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod pa bya/ ho/ drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la 'phrin las su gsol ba ni/ me 'bar ba'i gdan la gnyis su med par bzhugs nas sbyin sreg gi mchod pa rnams ye shes kyi lha dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du bstab par mdzad cing 'phrin las rnam bzhi gang byed pa rnams grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'phrin las gsol/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ drang srong me lha'i lho ba yangs pa'i nang / /( las byung ba'i drag po'i pho brang la/ /zla gam dmar po mthing nag gru gsum brgyad/ /ces pa nas bzung bsgral bar —342

byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ nang ma rtogananus pa'i dbang 'thob gyur/zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin bya/de yang thugs kyi dngos grub kun bsdusabadag la thim zhes pa rdo rjer 7na ) thim dang /sku yi dbyig tu bskyed par bgyi zhes pa khrag 'thung skyed par bgyi dang /bdag nyid dpal chen zhes pa bcom ldan dpal chen la 'don pa bsgyur/gtso 'khor kun kyang sku mdog rtsa ba'i zhal//rab dkar zhi ma khro yi 'dzum mdangs can//dkar la 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba yi//zhi ba'i las kun mdzad pa'i rnam par gyur//'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid las zhes pa nas bzung ste/phur srung bka' bstod bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod//ces pa'i bar dkyus ltar las rak+ta'i mchod pa'i rjes su/gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs//'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di//dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha tsho gis la//gus pas 'bul lo zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lā ya ga ṇa tsakra pā dza khā hi/zhes tshogos nas kyang 'bul/byon zan ni/ye shes pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i ljagasa3 las/rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ dang /dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ yig gis mtshan par mos nas/phyag rgya sogs sngar ji lta bas gī lā mtshar bdun brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzang 'geng ba sogs me lha'i skabs ltar byas te/ā+oṃ asna ye di bya di bya nas nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shin+ti ku ru swā hā'i bar gyis sngar ltar lan gsum 'bul/me lha'i thugs nas 'od los pas/zhes sogs 'das lha'i thugs rjes 'don pa bsgyur nas brjod/thog mar gtso bo la/hūṃ/khamasagasum za bar byed pa'i rkan sgra can gdug pa 'dul mdzad phur pa'i lha tsho gos la me shes klong yangasa'akhyil ba'i ā+oṃ khung du brgyud lnga'i bag chags ma 7ba lus sregs sbyangs nas bdud rtsi sman dang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs dam rdzas gtore ma sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul:ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol dam nyams dam skong mthu dang dngos grub stsol:zhes brjod nas me lha'i skabasabazhin rdzas chen nyer bdun khyad par gyi rdzas dang bcas pa rnams sngags gsum las 'das ma 'das kyi lha sngags brje ba ma gags khyad par med cing /4nyer tha ṇi ga brgya sogs grangs mang nyung skabs dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gesbyor/ bsnyen pa kha skong gi sgos chos sngags gcig rdzas gcig la chig dril du bya ba'i tshul gyis mtshon te las gang sgrub kyang de ga gtsor 'don gyi gnad 'gag zhal nas shes dgos so/ /khro bcu sogs 'khor rnams las/ hūṃ/ rnam par rgyal dang hūṃ chen kā ra sogs/ khro brgya 'bar ba'i lha tshogs ma lus dang / /snyems sder dur khrod gtun khung rdo rje sdud/ mda' bsnyems la so gos khro mo bcu yi tshogs/ /phag dang dmigs bu'i mgo can la sogs pa/ /phra phyag nyi shu sgo ba bzhi rnamasal/ /ye shes klong yangs sogs brjod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ kā ra hūṃ/ ga dzogardza hūṃ phaṭa: zho badz+ra kro dha bi dza la: ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: zho badz+ra kro dha ni la sgyu da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa rtswa badz+ra krodha ya mān+ta /snro pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa tshwa badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la snro ༷ rna hūṃ phaṭa rtswa badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba : hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: zho badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta snro tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa rtswa badz+ra krodha a mṛ ta li kuṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa two badz+ra krodha tri lo kya bi dza ya snro snyin+ta byu hūṃ phaṭa swo badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la: spro ṭa ya h+pho ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa: zho badz+ra e ku sha dza: badz+ra pā shu ྅: badz+ra (8na〉sgo ṭa rba badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ho: zhes pa'i sngags dang bcas te sreg rdzas rnams bdun nas nyer gcig dang gtso bo'i bcu cha dang mnyam pa'i dmigs bsal gyi rdzas 'bul/ de nas srung ma rnams/ hūṃ/ shwa na mched bzhi re ma mched bzhi dang / /sring mo bzhi dang ming po ging chen bzhi/ /ma tsho gos dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs/ /dpal chen phur pa'i bka' srung tsho gos rnams la/ /ye shes klong yangs sogs brjod pa'i rjes su/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra tha la dz+wa la badz+ra su ru su ru badz+ra mu ru mu ru badz+ra ma ma pa she ku phu ma lha nyag /ra i nan dha dhi ma ma gsashrī tre kur ye ka/ /g.ye dza ye bi dza ye a dzi te a pa ra dzi nya ma ra se n+ya pra ma dhe ni hūṃ phaṭa swo badz+raki li ki lwa ya shrī tre snar ya: ma ra san pra ma dha na: ya hūṃ phaṭa ma nu raka gi bh+yo: pra ma ṇi bh+yoḥro༄ tre bh+yo: be na be bh+yo: ko'u ri ma bh+yo: in+d+ra ni bh+yo: badz+ra sing ga lo bh+yo: a mṛ ta bh+yo: so'u ma bh+yo: dan da lha bh+yo: raka gi sbyo bka gi sbyo: ra ti badz+ra ma bh+yo: ru ti ra mat+ta bh+yo: e na tsa / bh+yoḥ ma no ha raṃ bh+yo: siti /bh+yo: ba ya bya bh+yo: ma hā mā ra na bh+yo: asne bh+yo: bha ra hi bh+yo: tsa murnyi bh+yo: su ta rna bh+yo: wa ru na bh+yo:—344

byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ nang ma rtoganabadz+ra ma hā kā la sto:badz+ra tsa /li bh+yo:badz+ra/ pa da ṇi bh+yo:badz+ra lo bo da ra bh+yo:zhes pa'i sngags dang bcas gong gi sreg rdzas rnams bdun tsam dang dmigs bsal gyi rdzas lor gyi bcu cha 'bul/sreg rdzas mchode pas me yi lha zhes pa'i tshig rkang dang po/sreg rdzas mchode pas ye shes lha zhesapar 'don 8ba pa bsgyur/dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum gshegs skyems su byon zan gyi skabasaltar 'bul/rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis la zhes sogs gtang rag gi blo ka gcig po'i mjug tu ā+oṃ badz+raki li gī lwa ya a lha pra la nas sha lta'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang /sarba pañtsa dang mahā rak+ta sbyar bas sman rag 'bul/ gtor ma bka' brgyad las byang ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gsad pa'i dam rdzas med byung ba kla che/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas 'bul/ā+oṃ badz+ra rta bu la ye swā hās so rdzi dang /ā+oṃ badz+ra wa gi ye swā lhas gos zungs 'bul/bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na gdug pa 'dul phyir mi dus las yol ba'i khro rgyal 'dod pa'i sras mchoge gī lā ya:'phrin lasaphur pa'i lha la phyag la'i bstod ces pas mchode bstod bya//yu brtse nus mnga' rdo rje phur pa'i lhas//bstan pa rgyas dang de 'dzin tsho gos rnams kyi//zhes sogs kyi 'dod gsal bka' brgyad sbyin sreg na yod pa ltar len/he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bkang /ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang :zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol:chu khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad//sogasadang /badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsam/slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ā+oṃ drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la//zhes pa nas/de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod bstod bya/drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la//rdzasachen nyer bdun sreg rdzas 'bul//zhes pa nas/khyad par ba'i rdzas9na〉na sngar ltar dang gshegasaskyems dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum po byon zan ltar phul rjes/ so rtsi dang gos zungs dkyus ltar 'bul/gtor ma las byang ltar brlab/ā+oṃ asne de wa rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba kla ta pā dza khā hi lan gsum dang /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//sa pa nas/yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog gi bar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebarjod/ me lha 'bor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor la/ /gnod byed nad gdon dgra bgegs dang / /mthu byad dbul phongs dus min 'chi/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung ma lus pa/ /zhi zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'dod don gsol/ ā+oṃ asne de wa ra dza sgru nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ yig brgya dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod pa gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don:byin na khyod kyis mdzad lags kyis: tshim zhing dgyes par mdzad nas kyang : rang gzhan bzang por gshegs su gsol: chu asne de wa ྅ dza ya hi gas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥlha baṃ sngos rang dang gnyis su med par mos/ mched rnams srin lag sbrel/ gral zlum por byas te/ ya : raṃ/ ā+oṃ burnya/ he ru ka /burnya kro dhi shwa ri sto/ hūṃ ha he phaṭa raṃ/ ā+oṃ gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: skad cig yud la zhi mdzad de zhi bar ma gyur dbyings su rol: zho snye bha ni lha bha hūṃ/ ji k+ṇi k+ṇi hā hūṃ/ kṛ hā pa ya kṛ hā pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wā na/ bi sdi rā dzā ya hūṃ phaṭa: sto bha ya nan/ shān+ti ku ru swā hā zhes bro brdung / (9ba7sngo ba smon lam ba po shis bya zhing me tog gi char pa phyogs kun tu dbab/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /sbrel nas byed na thal ba rnying pa nim tsam byas pa'i khar ong kong brtsigs cho go gong ltar byed/ me ma shi bar du mi bsgral zhing gnas khang 'pho ba sogs myur ba'i dgos pa yod na 'o mas gzhil la 'bab chu chen por thal ba rnams dor/dgos don gzhan la'ang mkho bas tshags bya bar yang rung ngo / /thab kyi nye 'khor kun tu dri bzang gis chag chag gdab cing / las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya ba sogs phyag len spyi ltar ro/ /bcom ldan don grub bya ba ye shes dbyings/ /bdud sde'i gshed du rab khros khrag 'thung dbang / /dpal chen phur pa'i lha tshogs sbyin sreg gis/ /mnyes ched ngal ba bsten pa don dang ldan/ /ljongs 'dir rgyal dbang pad+mas nyer bstan pa'i/ /phur pa'i lugs srol bka' gter rgyu skar dbus/ /nyi zla ltar gsal lha brag gter byon gyi/ /lam zab mkhar chen 'tsho rgyal gong khug ma/ /gang de'i dbang lung gdams pa se ston dang / /legs ldan rdo rje'i ma dros klung chen las/ /legs 'ongs 'khrul pa'i rnyog bral gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /dam pa'i —346

byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar/ nang ma rtoganadrin las kho bo'i blo mtshor babs/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor kha bsgyur ba'i/ /smin byed stang stabs rol dbyangs 'ur tsam la/ /phur pa mkhan por re ba'i sngags rlome rnams/ /skom 'dod smig rgyur bsnyeg pa'i ngal ba bzhin/ khog ser dri ngad ldang ba'i yi ge'i steng / /smin grol gdams par zhun thar yongs bcad par/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bsnyen sgrub la bcur bas/ /tshad ldan phur pa'i rig pa 'dzin nam snyam/ /de skad smra ba'i spobs mthor nyer son pa/ /zur chen nyang ston khyab (10na thad ga bla ma zung / /yun du bsten pa'i bla med bka' drin gyis/ /nyer 'tsho za hor brnyes yi ger bkod/ /sgrib gnyas bag chags bcas pa'i rdzas kyi tshogs/ /ye shes me dpung klong du rab sbyangs pa'i/ /sngon med sreg blugs mchode pas yid can rnams/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i rang zhal mngon 'gyur shog /ces lha brag gter byon gyi phur pa lugs gsum gang rung la sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mun sel 'od dkar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong blo bzang don grub/ /dge slong tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bde stong chos rje blo bzang pad+ma gsum gyis phur pa'i bsnyen chen dang / sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos bsnyen chen yang bskyar/ sngags ban blo bzang mkhyen brtses ka rna gu ru'i bsnyen pa btang skabs kha skong gi sbyin sreg ngag 'don zhig dgos zhes bskul bas mtshams sbyar/ slad mar yang 'phrin las phur pa'i rig pa 'dzin par 'dod pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du/ thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi sreg chog la gzhi byas/gter kha gong gi bka' brgyad dang dpal 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshe bdag sbyin sreg sogs/ rnying ma rang lugs rnams nas kha 'gangs dgos pa rnams bkang / tshig phrad sogs mi gsal ba'i med du mi rung ba rnams/ mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsung rab kyis brgyan te/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnam gnyis kyi drin las lam srol 'di la blo mig rnam par yangs pa'i za hor sngags ban gyis pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o// //sarba maṅga lo//—347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'a༄7/ /byang gter gyi phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud sde phyer 'thag bzhugs so/ /sgeg dang dpa' ba mi sdug nyams kyi srid gsum ma lus g.yo mdzad cing / /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs rung gsung gis dgra bgegs snying la 'jigs pa ster/ /rngams dang snying rje zhi ba'i thugs kyis 'gro rnams bde ba che la sbyor/ khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid dpal chen phur bus rtag tu skyongs/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /thugs kyi bum par legs gtamasamakhar chen bza'i/ /'phrin las sgrub pa'i yang zab gong khug ma/ /lugs gsum phur par yongs grags lha brag gter/ /gang de'i lugs 'dzin nub dgon chos rje dang / /pad+ma'i gdung gsob rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa'i/ /gdams pa'i chu bo gcig 'dres byang pa rje/ /brgyud bar bcas pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams rgyal/ khyad par kun bzang che mchog he ru da / /theg mchog chos kyi bdag po'i zlos gar can/ /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun ā nan+da/ khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas rtag tu skyongs/ /'phrin las drag po rkarma he ru rka'i/ /dmar chen khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog gi /lasagazhung bdud sde phyer 'thag 'dri byed na/ /kwa ye bdud sde'i tsho gos rnams bag yod byos/ /de la (2na 'dir byang gter gyi lcags mdzod nag po'i chos sde las byung ba'i phur pa la brten pa'i khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog gi sgo nas/ pha rol mi bsrun dgra bgegs kyi dpung tshogs mthu stobs phye mar 'thag pa'i las rim la/ gter gzhung las/ badz+ra ku ma ra la na mo khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog byed par 'dod pas sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las: dang po dkyil 'khor bsham pa ni maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi'am/ ci rigs bshams pa la: 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa mu khyud nag po rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa'am: yang na lte ba'i phyi rol nas: gru gsum rtse mo dbus su bstan pa —348

byang gter phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud sde byer yig/ nang ma rtoganardo ra me ri dang bcas pa bris pa'i steng du ma rje'i khar dpal gtor bcu gcig rgyan dang bcas pa bsham gtso bo dang khro bcu'i tsakli 'dzugs:'og tu dgra bgegs kyi liṅga re bzhag:phyi rol du thun mong gi mchod pa dang :nang du khyad par gyi mchod pa bsham rak+ta g.yas te bdud rtsi g.yon/bsnyen phur mdun/sku'i rten bkram rol mo'i cha byad gsur chen sogs gang dgos bsham:chos skyong gang byed dang gzhi bdag sogs kyi gtor ma gang bder bzhag go/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gser 2bskyoms rgyas par btang :gnas dang yo byad rol mosabyin phab pa skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste yi dam phur pa gzhung bgrangs te:rigs 'dzin bskul pa yan grub pa'i rjes la chos skyong gi bskul dang tshogs tha ma yan chod byas la:rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol gtso bo'i gtor ma ma gtogos gzhan rnams khyer/mda' zor/khrag zor/yungasazor sogs 'phen mkhan skyes pa bud med stag chas can byas la gtor tshogs dkar po'am:dgra phyogs su khyer la/zor mkhan mas kyis brgyan pa dang :rdo rje slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pasarnga brdung zhing rngam dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do:zhes byung ba'i sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi/dang bo sbyor ba la/dkyil 'khor gtor ma/zor/phyi nang gi mchod pa sogs phra rags rnamasamathong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bsham/dngos gzhi las byang gzhung bsrangs/tshogs tha ma yan mdor bsdus tsam dang bcas song grub nas/'phrin las 'chol ba ni/hūṃ/mi mngon dngas na bzhugasapa'i rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs:lha'i zhengs shig bzhengs shig cho ge kyi dbyings nas bzhengs//ā+oṃ bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du bskul//hrīs dzod cig mdzod cig bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//hūṃ phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas//ljang nag gru gsum lha chen bsnol ba'i steng //snang srid phur pas 'debs pa'i lha tshogs ni//bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu dang //gnyis med yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma//sku gsung thugs sras sras mchog nyi shu gcig/bdud 'dul mthu chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu//za byed khra thabs phyag brnyan 4/ shu dang //bstan skyong ldan ) chen mo sha na mched

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobazhi dang / /bdag nyid chen mo re tī mched bzhi dang / /sa bdag chen mo bse yi lha mo bzhi/ /bse lcags dung gsum dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig /ma bdun srid bzhi dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ /phur pa 'phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam can/ /mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku skyod la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhen nu'i sku: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis: yab yum thabs shes rol pa las: khro bo'i tshogs bcas bskor ba ni steng gi phyogs kyi khro bo ni: khro bo chen po hūṃ kā ra sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus zhal sngo: spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs: dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang : bar pa rdo rje dril bu bsnams: tha ma phur bsgril dgra bgegs gzir khro bo'i gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan rdo rje gshog pas bar snang khyab: dur khrod mas brgyad sku la rdzogs zhabs gnyis tshangs pa pho mo gnon me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs rdo rje sgra 'byin sku la 'khril phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: sprul pa yang sprul tsho gis dang bcas: 'dir gshegasargyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcasakyi steng gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs: ྅ mdzad rgyal po nyid kyis bzlog bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog bsgyur ro ltas ga cho 'phrul sgyur bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin (3bsgosamadzod bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis: yab yum thabasashes rol pa las khro bo'i tsho gis chen sprul pa ni: shar gyi phyogs kyi khro bo ni: khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs chen po dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes: rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang : bar pa lcags kyu rnga yab bsnams tha ma phur bsgril dgra bgegs gzir: khro bo'i gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: rdo rje gshog pas bar snang khyab dur khrod —350

byang gter phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud lde phyer 'thag/ nang ma rtoganachas brgyad sku la rdzogs:zhabs gnyis dri za pho mo gnon me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs:rdo rje bsnyems ma sku rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gertsa phyag rdo rje dung khrag dang :bar pa rgya gram be con bsnams tha ma phur bsgril dgra bgegs 4khro bo'i gar dgu'i nyams dang gtor ma :bdag cag:byang gi phyogs kyi dgra dang bgegag nod sbyin dmag tshogs:khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bzlog bzlog go dmar chen phubasgyur ro ltas ga bzlog bsgyur bcom 6na skon rdo rje gzhen nu dang :yum chen :yab yum :khro bo'i :byang shar mtshams kyi khro chen khams gsum rnam par rgyal:sku mdog ser po 'jigasachen po dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad g.yas sngo g.yon ljang dbus ser zhal:spyan gsum zhal bgrad dbu skra kham nag :rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag bar pa rdo rje rtse gsum bsnams tha ma phur bsgril:khro bo'i gar dgu'i rdo rje gshog pas bar snang :dur khrod mas brgyad dgra dang bgegadabang ldan dmag tshogs :khams gsum rnam rgyal khro bos bzlog bzlog go dmar :bsgyur ro:bzlog bsgyur bcom ldan rdo rje:yum chen :yab yum khro bo'i:'og gi khro bo chen po stobs po che:sku mdog dud / 'jigs chen po dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dud ka dbus spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche ba phud bu skra kham nag gyen du rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang :bar pa tho ba gtun shing bsnams tha ma phur bsgril dgra bgegs gzir khro bo'i gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan rdo rje gshog pas bar snang khyab:dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs:zha khas bzhi sa bdag pho mo gnon me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs:rdo rje bskul byed sku la 'khril:phra men dom dang byi ba'i mgo:sprul pa yang sprul tshogs dang bcas:'dir 6bgashegs rgyan gyi mchod gtor bzhes:sha khrag gto/ ma 'di byang gter phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud sde phyer yig / nang ma rtoganabacas ku 'og gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs: sa bdag dmag tshogs byung ba na: stobs chen rgyal po nyid kyis bzlog bzlog go dmar chen gtor masaḥ bsgyur ro ltas nganaḥ: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: ces gtor chung rnams la sman raka sbran te phul:thog mar rig 'dzin bskul ba ni: ྅/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i rigs 'dzin rnams kyi dus la bab: phyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rgya gar tsan+dan nags tshal la: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ni: phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig paṇa chen bi mā mi tra yis rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā la: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig bal po shī la mnyu lis: maṇ+ḍal yi mkhar khongs su: ji ltar :phur bu : mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gis: yar klungs bgegs kyi phu chu la ji ltar:: phur buḥ shud bu dpal gyi seṅge yis lu shang rdo yi brag logs la: ji ltar:: phur bu : sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis: has po ri yi spang khongs la: ji ltar:: phur buḥ : mchims ston shākya pra bha yis rtsibs kyi spyang gi sngon po la ji ltar phur bum mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis nam mkha'i pho rog nag po la: ji ltar:: phur bu phu sprul sku gter ston yab sras kyis zang zang ri bo'i brag gi rtser ji ltar phur bum sngags 'chang shākya bzang po yis yol mo gangs kyi ra ba phu ji ltaramaphur bu : sprul sku legs ldan rdo rje (7na thas 'bras gshongs gnas sgo 'byed pa'i tshe: ji ltar::phur buḥ : shoms rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis gong yal gtsang chab gyen ldog tshe: ji ltar phur bu:: phur bu brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: rang rang so so bsgrub khang du ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: ces bskul lo: de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogasabaskul ba ni: ྅/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu ni: zhe sdang 'joms mdzad khro rgyal dbyingasanas bzhengs yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khril: yab yum khyed kyi 'phrin las dus la bab gnod byed dgra bgegs khug la myur du sgrol0 PROB/ yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las:—355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gephyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du nyi zla phyogs skyong bskyel ba'i khri yi steng :khro bcu yab yum sprul pa'i khra thabs rnams:thugs dam tshul bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:྅/steng gi phyogs nas lha mdzad sgra chun gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men phag dang smigs bu'i mgo:gzigs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab:྅/shar gyi phyogs nas rnam rgyal bsnyems ma gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo:'bebs mdzad chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab:྅/shar lho'i mtshams nas dbyug sngon sder mo gnyis/ sprul pa'i phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo:'joms mdzad chen po'i 'phrin las dus la bab:lha/lho yi phyogs nas gshin rje dur khrod gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo:gsod mdzad chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab:྅/lho nub mtshams nas mi g.yo 7ba〉yis khung gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men gzig dang kha da'i mgo sgrol mdzad chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab:྅/nub kyi phyogs nas rta mgrin gtum mo gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men byi la pu shud mgo 'ching mdzad chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab:lha/nub byang mtshams nas 'dod rgyal mda' bsnyems gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men spyang ki khra yi mgo:bsdigs mdzad chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab:྅/byang gi phyogs nas bdud rtsi rlung 'byin gnyis:sprul pa'i bla men seng ge pha waṃ mgo:bskyod mdzad chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab lha/byang shar mtshams nas khams gsum gsod byed gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men dred dang sre mo'i mgo:stong mdzad chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab:hūṃ/'og gi phyogs nas stobs chen bskyod ma gnyis:sprul pa'i phra men dom dang byi ba'i mgo sbor mdzad
