chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab:gnod byed dgra bgegs khug la myur du sgrol:lha/stong gsum dregs pa 'dul bar zhal bzhes pa'i sras mchog 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dus la bab gnod byed dgra bgegs khug la myur du sgrol/hūṃ/shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi'i gzhal yas su bu shud skya ka srin bya khra mgo bzhi:'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom dbab pa'i dus la bab gnod byed dgra bgegasakhug las myur du sgrol:thugs dam rgyud bskul ba/la ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:de nas dam can srung

byang gter phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud sde phyer 'thag / nang ma rtoganam bskul ba ni: bh+yo: nam gyi srod la dam bcas ma: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la: mi mo lcags kyi mgo can zhen: lag na lcags kyi phur pa bsgril shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab: g.yu yi khyi mo ral can la: mi mo g.yu yi mgo can zhen: phyag na g.yu yi phur (8na)pa bsgril shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab:gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la: me mo gser gyi mgo can zhen: phyag na gser gyi phur pa bsgril shi kha mu kha'i dus la bab zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la: mi mo zangs kyi mgo can zhen: phyag na zangasakyi phur pa sgril sri la mu kha'i dus la bab: bh+yoḥ nam gyi gung gi dam bcas ma nag mo ral pa stong khams khyab phyag na mchong gi phur pa bsgril: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs: re ma tī yi dus la bab ser nag rma bya'i thul pa can: phyag na mchong gi phur pa bsgril: chibs su chu glang sngon po bcibs re ma ti yi dus la bab: dmar nag re lde nag mo gsol: phyag na mchong gi phur pa bsgril:chibs su sha ba yu mo bcibs rdo rje brtse sbyin dus la bab ljang mo g.yu phur ral can ma phyag na g.yu yi phur pa bsgril: chibs su klu rta sngon po bcibs: rdo rje phag sbyin dus la bab ljang nag dar nag go zu gsol: phyag na mchong gi phur pa bsgril: chibs su rnga mo ga pa bcibs re ma dzu yi dusal bab bh+yoḥ nam gyi tho rangs dam bcas ma: mthing nag lcags phur ral pa can phyag na lcagasakyi phur pa bsgril: chibs su bdud rta nag po bcibs: rdo rje ya sbyin dus la bab: ser mo gser phur ral pa can: phyag na gser gyi phur pa bsgril: chibs su gza' rta ser po bcibs: rdo rje bde sbyin dus la bab: dmar mo bse phur ral pa can: phyag na bse yi phur pa bsgril: chibs su btsan rta dmar zhus bcibs: rdo rje bse sbyin dus la bab ljang mo g.yu phur ral pa can: phyag na (8ba tshe na yu yi phur pa bsgril chibs su klu rta sngon po bcibs: rdo rje phag sbyin dus la bab: bh+yoḥshar phyogs srin po'i skyes bu ni: dkar po phyag na dung phyur bsgril: srin po gyad chen dus la bab:lho phyogs gshin rje'i skyes bu ni: nag po phyag na lcags phur bsgril: gshin rje nag po'i dus la bab:nub phyogs ya bdud skyes bu ni: dmar po phyag na zangs phur bsgril sog po mig ring dus la bab:—357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2podabral ba'i gshed du 'khor bca/ /pho sri mo sri chung sri:/ /dam sri dbul sri god sri ཿ / (10na)pha mes dur sri btsan sri tsha/ /bdud kyi than nag phyag brnyan—/ /lo sgeg gi dang gshed bzhiḥ/ /sa la zhag rtsis 'debs pa za/ /gnam la zla grangs 'debs pa:/ /gza' dang skar ma ngan paḥ/ /lo skeg zla sgeg zhag sgegaḥ/ /za sgeg bdun zur thams cad cha/ /dus tshod rtsis nas 'debs paḥ/ /gnam gyi dal kha babs pa:/ /sal dug nad langs paḥ/ /thog babs dal babs thams cad / /byas nyes nyams grib thams cadaḥ/ /yul mi khyim mtshes smod mo:/ /g.yas na pho brgya mda' 'phenaḥ/ /g.yon na mo brgya dug sbyoraḥ/ /mdun na langs shing sdod pa:/ /rgya ba na khyi bzhin 'brang bza/ mo ngan log par bsdigs pa ca/ /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa:/ /srod la bya pho 'tsher bcu/ /tho rangs sgo khyi ngu baḥ / /lug pa ha ha rgod paḥ/ /srin bya thog khar 'tsher ba / /logs la wa spyang brgyal ba / /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi:/ /pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre cha/ /ma'u de ni thor 'dre cha/ /dar tshan nang gi stob 'dreḥ / /pho bdud dal kha g.yas suḥ / /mo bdud dal kha g.yon du / /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la / /phas kyi phung 'dre rbad 'dreḥ / /tshur gyi sna 'dre byed paḥ / /lus la na tsha gtong bca/ /tshe la bar chad byed paḥ / /lkog na 'bu bzhin g.yeng baḥ/ /ngos na til brdungs byed paḥ / kha na dar bzhin 'jam pa:/ /gting na tsher las rtsub pa:/ /lus la sbrul ltar 'khril baḥ / /ngo la sprel ltar 'jig pa:/ /mi kha bram mchu thams cadaḥ/ /spyi ru chags che thams cad / /sgos su nyes pa yod paḥ/ /rbod gtong rbod 'dre thams cad / /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad:/ /pho byol de ni g.yas su byol/ /(10ba〉rgo byol de ni g.yon du byol/khyim mtshes gzhan gyi sa ru byol/ /sdang dgra gdon bgegs de la bh+yo/ /za bar byed pa'i bsris la bh+yo/ /sbyor ngan gtong ba'i ltag tu bh+yo/ /cho 'phrul ༅ pa thams cad dgra la sgyur/ /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /bzlog bsgyur las la khyed rang mkhas/ /lci yang ri bo pang du long / /dka' yang bdud la rgyu zhags thob/ /yas kyi bdud g.yos byed kyis bzlog /mas kyi sri langs:/ /nye ba'i byol zor ngu/ /pha tshan rgya 'dreḥ/ /ma'u byur 'dreḥ/ /btsan gyi ki rkang —/ /sa bdag byad khaḥ/ /rgyal po'i —360

byang gter phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud sde phyer 'thag / nang ma rtog)pad+ma'i thugs kyi snying khu phur pa gong khug ma'i gdams pa bcos lhad dang bral ba la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi zhabs pad yun du bsten pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung bar byos shig /smras pa/ bsams pa tsam gyis mchog thun dngos grub char du 'bebs la yid bzhin nor/ /ma rungs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms la gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i thog /log 'dren dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung la gtum chen shan pa khros pa'i gar/ khyab bdag kun bzang he ru ka dpal dpal chen phur bur grags min nam/ /gang de'i gdams pa'i nying khu lha brag gter/ /bdud dpung phyer 'thag dmar chen gtor ma'i las/ khro bo rol par yongs grags spu gri yis/ /mi mthun dgra sde'i srog rtsa cis mi gcod/ /de phyir tshul 'di'i las rim 'brul med du/ /snga 'gyur chos kyi dgongs don ltar bkod las/ /gsar ma'i rgyas bkab rang bzo'i gzu lum gyis/ /tshad ldan mkhas mang khrel ba'ang 'di na med/ /dge 'dis bstan 'gro'i phan bde rnam par rgyas/ khyab bdag bla ma zung 'jug zhabs pad brtan/ /gsang chen theg pa mchog gi 'od stong gis/ /don gnyis gos bu'i snang ba rgyasagyur cig /rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyi gter ma'i rdo rje phur pa lugs gsum las/'phrin las bcol ba'i tshig rnams lha khrar 'dug kyang / 'bring po spu gri lha nag la sbyor du rung ba'i dbang du byas pa'i khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bdud sde phye mar 'thag pa'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba 'di ni rgya hor gyi rgyal khams (12ba'i la ba'i tshe byang phyogs tal khar yod thog dpal chen po nyid kyi sgrub pa dang gtor bzlog gi chog sgrigs byas na bod kha ba can gyi bde thabs bsgrub pa la gegs byed kyi bdud tshogs rnams myur du zhi bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma gsal po mthong bas rkyen byas te/ 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi rigs las sngags smyon gang shar rang grol lam ming gzhan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos de 'phral du dbu btsugs nas byang phyogs 'bri chu'i 'gram du rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo// //sarba maṅga le//—363—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (geno༅༅//dpal chen phur bu'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs//zhi dang khro sgo 'khor lo kun gyi gtso//dpal ldan rdo rje phur pa la brten pa'i//dmar r+pā drag po'i gtor bzlog las rim dag/go rim ji bzhi yi ge'i phreng bar spel//de yang dkyil 'khor 'dzib ni//ldeb gru gsum mthing nag/zla gam dmar po/'khor lo so po mis tsā/rdo ra tshe ri dang bcas pa lag len ltar 'dri/lcags slang gi nang du 'bru nag ngar btags khrag chang gis sprus pa'i phye la/gtso bo'i dpal gtor che ba gcig la wo ba bdus bskor ba/mthar khrag gi kong bu dang rtsang dmar nyer gcig srin mo 'gros su btsugs pa la rgyu ma'i lda ldi bya/mtshe yungs kyis brgyan/dpal gtor gyi rtser bya khyung dang tshwa mda' dar sogs 'dzugs//mda' zor gos zor gas rnams kyang lis par bya/sman rag gtor gsum phyi nang gi mchod pa sogs legs par bshams/rtse lugs kyi ma wa zhe rtogs 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i las byang gzhung bzhin gyer/tsho gos bar pa yan grub rjes/hūṃ/mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs//āḥbazhengs shig bzhedas shig chos kyi dbyings nas2na7gos//ā+oṃ bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du bskul//lha mdzod go mdzod cig sol ba'i wen las mdzod//hūṃ phur pa rol ba'i dur khrod wo po nas//ljang nag gru gsum lha 0 bsnol ba'i steng //snang srid phur pas 'debs pa'i lha lis ni//yom ldan dpal kho rdo rje ga tho nu dang //gnyis med yum r+ṣa 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma//sku gsung thugs sras sras mag nyi shu gcig/bdud 'du po mthu khro rgyal yab yum bcu//za byed khra thabs phyag bas nyi shu dang //bstan skyong wo mo shwa na mgo bzhi dang //bdag ṣ+ka r+ṣa mo re tī mar bzhi dang //sa bdag r+pā mo brtse yi lha mo bzhi//bselcags dung gsum dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig/ma ba// sring bzhi dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad//phur pa wen

dpal r+ṣa phur bu'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gnam lcags thog mda'/ nang ma rtoganalas lha tsho gos thugs dam can//mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bskyod las//dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la//thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod//ces gtore ma la sman rag sgron zhing thun gtor 'bul//brgyud gsum bla ma rigs 'dzin rnams//zhes so gos2ba〉nyun las rgya mtsho'i kha skong nas byung ba ltar bskul//tsho gos tha ma gzhung bzhin bya/de nas bzlog bsgyur bya ba ni/hūṃ/dbus phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas//ma hā de ba bsnol ba'i steng //bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang //yum r+pā 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/srus mchag nyer gcig 'khor gyis bskor//yang sprul grangs med phyogs bcur 'phro//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la//dbus kyi phyogs nasabadud g.yos pa//bzlog go dmar wo ga kho mas bzlog/bsgyur ro ga go dgra la sgyur//bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod//hūṃ/steng phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na//sgos pho mo'i gdan steng na/khro bo'i rgyal po hūṃ kā ra//yum wo rdo rje sgra chun ma//sprul pa phag dang is bu'i mgo/yang sprul grangs med phyogs bcur 'phro//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang /khyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor thos la//steng phyogs sa pa'i gdon dang bgegs//bzlog go dmar wo gtor//bsgyur ro ga sku dgra//bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i wen las mdzod//hūṃ/shar phyogs//drib pho mo'i/kho bo'i rgyal po rnam par rgyal//yum 'a rdo rje bsnyems mar bcas//sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo/yang sprul//rnal 'byor /khyu sbyor/shar phyogs dri za'i gdon bgegs dang / /hūṃ/shar lho /tshe lha/khro bo'i rgyal po stug pa sngo//yum wo rdo rje sder mo dang //sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo/yang sprul//rnal 'byor/khyu sbyor/shar lho tshe lha'i/ /hūṃ/lho phyogs//gshin rje/khro ldan ) bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed//yum wo rdo rje dur rna ma//sprul pa sha ba lun pa'i mgo/yang sprul/r+sāl 'byor//rgyu sbyor//lho phyogs gshin rje/ /hūṃ/lho nub//srin po/khro bo'i rgyal po migayo mgon//yum wo rdo rje gas khung ma//sprul pa gzig dang khā da'i mgo/yang sprul /r+sāl 'byor/khyu sbyor//lho nub srin po'i/ /hūṃ/nub phyogs//klu bdud pho mo'i6/khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal//yum ོ rdo rje

dpal 'a phur bu'i dmar r+ṣa gtor bzlog gnam lcags thog mda'/ nang ma rtogana'adre cha/ /pho bdud dal kha g.yas suḥ/ /mo bdud dal kha g.yon duḥ/ /spyi (4na〉dud dal kha mkha' laḥ/ /phas kyi phung 'dre rbad 'dre ca/ /tshur gyi sna 'dren byed paḥ/ /lus la na tsha gtong bza/ /tshe la bar chad byed pa ྈ/ /lkog na 'bu bzhin g.yeng bca/ /ngos la til brdung byed pa jo/ kha na dar bzhin 'jam pa:/ /gting na tsher las rtsub pad+ma/ /lus la sprul ltar 'khril baḥ/ /ngo la sprel ltar 'dzeg pa:/ /mi kha bram mchu thams cad : / /spyi ru chags che thams cad:/ /sgos su nyes pa yod pa:/ /rbad stong rbad 'dre thams cad:/ /rmi lam ༅ pa thams cadaḥ/ /pho byol de ni g.yas su byol/ /mo byol de ni g.yon du byol/khyim ma tshes ga' na gyi sa ru byol/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs de la bh+yo/ /za bar byed pa'i 'dre la bh+yo/ /phung bar byed pa'i sri la:/ /sbyor ༅ gtong ba'i ltag tu bh+yo/ /cho 'phrul ga pa thams cad dgra la sgyur/ /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /de nas sgo dbye ni/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tsho gis kyis/ /zhesaso gos brjod/ zor rnams phyi rol tu khyer/ gser skyems bto / gzu dbang rgyas par spro na/ dngosabargyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ khyad par dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /bstan srung rgya mtshor bcasapa'i tsho gis rnams kyis/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis nye bar dgongs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rab zhugasarigs 'dzin bdag khas blangs sdome gsum mig gi 'bras ltar bsrungs/ /bskyed rdzogs zab mo gzhung bzhin nyams len par/ /dgra dang bgegs kyis nye bar 'tshe byed na/ /yi dam zhi khros gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /chos skyong srung mas dkar nag bden shan phye/ /dam can rgya mtshos brnag pa'i dgra bo sgrol/ /(4brkom bca' dus las g.yel lam ra mda' bzlog /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng che thabs rgyang du bsrings/ /snying nas byang chub bsgrub la lhag par gzhol/ /thos bsam sgom pas nyin mtshan 'da' byed pa'i/ /zol med chos bzhin byed pa'i rnal 'byor la/5355/ ngal ba khyad bsad bla ma yun du bsten/ /dka' bar ma rtsegs bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin/ /chos srung lus dang grib ma ltar bsten pa'i/:tsha :::/gzugs byang ming rus btab pa'i dgra bo 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bshig bla ma'i sku dgra byas/ /dge 'dun sdo bcoms skye 'gro yongs la 'tshe/ /rigs 'dzin srung mar bcas la brnyas byas na/ /rtags mtshan mi ston sngon gyi dam —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('bas 'gal//chos dbyings bde ba wo po'i 4 ṣ+ka las/khrag 'thung khro bo'i 'bor lor r+sā mdzad nas//log 'dren gdug pa'i dgra sde mi sgrol na//zhi ba'i tshul las 'gongs la dgos pa ci//dpal chen spyan sngar rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog/skyong bar khas blangs chos srung rgya mtsho rnams//log 'dren gdug pa'i dgra sde mi sgrol na//'gas rung khro bor bstan la ngo re gnong //bden pa'i tshig gis smreng du gsol ba las//ye shes ldan la brdzun gtam su yis nus//de phyir mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung bskyed la//mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las myur du mdzod//de nas zor gzhan rnams rtsi lugs kyi phyag len ltar phyogs su 'phen/gtor zor gom pa zhe dgu'i sar khyer te/gnam lcags 'bar ba'i snod nang du//'bru nag ngar btags dpal gtor la//drag po'i rdzas kyis nyer brgyan pa//dug dag mtshon char byin brlabs pa//log 'dren na rko gra bgegs steng du bh+yo/khrog rtsa cho de la rdul du rlog/byad kha bzlog laphur kha sgyur/khrag po'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/zhes gtore zor 'phang /tshe chu'i rgyas 'debs/wen las rgya mtsho'i srung 'bor rnams brjod/las bzhi'i bro brdung /ho mtho bska skyong sogs mjug chog gzhung ltar bya'o//zhes dpal chen phur bu'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi rim pa gnam lcags thog mda' zhes pa 'di yang pho brang gong ri dkar po'i dkon gnyer dpon 'phrin las phur bu'i rig pa 'dzin pa dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyas bskul ba ltar bka' ma nas gtore bzlog gi yig cha khungs ma zhig sngon chad ma mthong pas/lha brag gter byon gyi bzlog gzhung dang /phyag len gyis kha bkang /rgyal ba spyi sger bskul ba khro rol nas bgyis shing /gzhan sa skyong chos kyi rgyal po grags pa 'byung gnas kyi 'phrin las rgya mtshor kha 'phangs pas/rtse lugs phyag len gyi mdzes rgyan du 'gro bar bgyis te za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so//// 68

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogadar༅༅/ /khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhi khro rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma 'byung / /zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed nyang ral rje/ /bka' babs gnyos dang rigs 'dzin mched gnyis sogs/ /mtshungs med brgyud pa'i tshogasarnams phyag gi yul/ khyad par chos kun ka nas dag pa'i dbyings/ /rang sar rnam grol zur chen thams cad mkhyen/ /bka' gter gnad la blo gros rab yangs pa/ /mchog gi rdo rje'i slob dpon gtsug na mdzes/ /mnga' bdag bla ma'i phyag len gnyos zhig la/ /babs dang legs ldan rdo rje'i gsung rgyun rnams/ /mtshungs par drin can bla ma nyang ston gyi/ /gsung rgyun ji bzhin khro rol reg zig 'dri/ /khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog lag tu bstar ba la bdag mdun gyi rten/ dkyil 'khor/ gtor ma/'khor lo sogs bca' gzhi/ ting nge 'dzin phra rags kyi phyag bzhes mtha' dag dam pa'i zhabs pad yun du bsten nas bde 'dus gtor gzhung gi dgongs don zab gnad dmar khrid du thob pa dang mthong ba brgyud pa la rag lus pas/ tshul de dag tu shes par byas nas 'dir ngag 'don khrigs su bkod pa la/ /nyams len gnad gdams nas bdag (2na〉bdun zung 'jug tu sgrub pa'i tshul dang /chog sgrigs gces pa'i lde mig las/ shes pa rnam pa gsum gyi dbang du btang ba'i logs su sgrub tshul gsungs pa gnyis byung ba las 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te tshogs dang bskang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa yan song nas/ bzlog gtor rnams lhar gsal gdab pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ dpal gtor rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod : las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du hūṃ las dpal gtor gtso bo khrag 'thung lha dgu dang mtheb skyu —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pornams bdun brgya nyer lnga'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor gsal ba zhal phyag sku mdog cha lugs cir yang bsgyur ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur: ྅/ rang byung dkyil 'khor dpal chen rdzogs: zhes pa nas āt+pa ko3rnya gi bar gyi byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ tshogs spyan 'dren nas bskang bzlog gi bar dkyus bzhin/ mchod pa phud skong bde 'dus kyi gter gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du gtong /tshogs phud dang po dang bar pa gnyis dkyus bzhin btang rjes/ nyams chags bshags skong yongs rdzogs gter gzhung ltar bya/ tshogs tha ma (2ba〉sgral las la sbyar ba'i phyir che ba bskyed de snang srid zil gyis gnon pa ni/ sgom khog las/ sngo 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems skye med thig le lhag gcig tu thag chod pas/ phyi snod kyi snang ba thams cad gzhal yas khang du blta nang rig pa bcud du snang ba thams cad yongs rdzogs kyi lhar gsal gdab: dregs pa can pho mo thams cad bran du bkol: sems rtog 'gyu dran thams cad gcer mthong rang grol ye shes su gsal bar gyur: ྅ snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang sogs nas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed/ 'phrin las bskul ba ni/ sngo bdag nyid tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa sna tshogs las la bkye ste/ khro bo skor ltar 'khrugakhro mo sprin ltar btibs/ pho nya glog ltar 'byug /mtshon cha char ltar 'bebs/ thun zor thog ltar zang thal/ de yang lha re re las kyang sprul pa yang sprul tshan bzhi bzhin 'gyed de la las 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi 'phrin las bsgrub la las 'byor drug spel ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub la las mos pa rnam bzhi'i tshul gyis thams cad dbang du sdud: la las drag po tshar gcod kyi las sgrub ste: e gru gsum lcags kyi khang sgrom 'bar ba'i nang du dgra bgegs nang la bya ba thams cad lcags kyu can gyis snying nas 'gugs: zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis spyi nas choms: rdo rje can gyis bdag la srungs: thun zor can gyis brgyal bar byed: mche ba can gyis brdeg par byed: (3na〉lta shog pa can gyi 'jums par byed: sder mo —370

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i ga khul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnacan gyis lā da par byed phur pa can gyis snying la 'debs dug phor can gyis myos par byed:ral gri can gyis lhu sdum 'bral: mda' mdung can gyis zang thal byed 'khor lo can gyis dum bur gtubs tho ba dgra stas rdul du rlog me dpung can gyis thal bar sregs rlung g.yab can gyisarjes med du btang ste chos kyi dbyings su gzhil zhing bzlog par gyur: sno chos sku skye med tsho wo sogs nas rbod zor sarba bzlog /bh+yoḥ zhes las gzhud ltar bya: spyi bskul/ sgos bskul/ dmod byang dang bcas pa ni yongs rdzogs kyi gter gzhung na gsal ba 'di lta ste: 'dir mkha 'gro'i 3 yigazhigabog kyang 'god thabs ra i ma dper gzigs mdzod/ zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs dam bskul ba'i mdo la gsum ste bde gshegs spyir bskul te mchod bshags las bzhi thun mong du bskul ba dang : pho nya sgos su bskul te bsgrub bya la 'bad pa dang : phur thun tshom bur bskul nas dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'o:dang po bde gshegs spyir bskul ba ni: gzhung ltar btang bas mchod bshags las bzhi thun mong du bskul ba'o: gnyis pa pho nya sgos su bskul te bsgrub bya la rbad pa ni: 'dir mkha 'tsho 3 yig zhig 'dug kyang 'god thabs med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/ he ru ka dpal che la 'dud zhi khro yongasardzogs tshom bu dgu'i bka' srung dam can sgos bskul ba shin tu zab gnyan gung 'dir bstan:e ma'o/ dang po che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs kyi bka' srung ce spyang ma brgyad rbad cing bskul ba ni hūṃ/ shar phyogs khyab par rgyug pa yi dpal gyi bka' nyan (3ba7sa byed ma dbu ni seng ge'i mgo bo la shel gyi ral pa shar ra ra shel gyi phur bu sil li yi ral ba re la phur bu re: ral pa 'a sprugs pa 'a skra gseb nas shel gyi seng ge 'bum 'bum 'gyed: ce spyang rgyug tshul zhungs se zhud :lag na shel gyi rde'u chung brdung : dri za'i dmag tshogs dbang sdud cing : dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog lha/ lho phyogs khyab par rgyug pa yi dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed ma dbu ni stag gi mgo bo la gser gyi ral pa shar ra ra gser gyi phur bu sil li yi ral pa re la phur bu —371 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pore: ral pa gsigs pa'i skra gseb nas gser gyi stag mo 'bum 'bum 'gyed ce sbyang rgyug tshul zhungs se zhung : lag na gser gyi rde'u chung brdung : grul bum 'khor tsho gos dbang sdud cing : dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog: ྅/ nub phyogs khyab par rgyug pa yi dpal gyi bka' nyan lasabyed ma: dbu ni gzig gi mgo bo la byu ru'i ral pa shar ra ra: byu ru'i phur bu sil li li ral pa re la phur bu re ral pa gsigs pa'i skra gseb nas byu ru'i gzig mo 'bum 'bum 'gyed ce spyang rgyug tshul zhungs se zhung : lag na byu ru'i rde'u chung brdung : klu gdon dmag tsho gos dbang sdud cing :dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar log: lha/ byang phyogs khyab par rgyug pa yi dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed ma: dbu ni dom gyi mgo bo la: lcags kyi ral pa shar ra ra: lcags kyi phur bu sil li li:ral pa re la phur bu re ral pa gsigs pa'i skra gseb nas lcags kyi dom bu 'bum 'bum 'gyed:ce spyang rgyug tshul zhudas se zhung : (4na〉pag na lcags kyi rde'u chung brdung : gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dbang sdud cing : dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog: ྅/ shar lho khyab par rgyug pa yi: dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed ma dbu ni spyang mo'i mgo bo la g.yu yi ral pa shar ra ra g.yu yi phur bu sil li li: ral pa re la phur bu re: ral pa gsigs pa'i skra gseb nas g.yu yi spyang mo 'bum 'bum 'byed ce spyang rgyug tshul zhungs se zhung : lag na g.yu yi rde'u chung brdung : drang song dmag tsho gis dbang sdud cing : dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog: ྅/ lho nub mtshams nas rgyug pa yi dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed ma dbu ni bse yi gang ga'i mgo bse yi ral pa shar ra ra:bse yi phur bu sil li li ral pa re la phur bu re: ral pa gsigs pa'i skra gseb nas brtse yi rkang ka 'bum 'bum 'gyed: ce spyang rgyug tshul zhungs rtse zhud : lag na bse yi kyi rde'u chung brdung :bden bral dmag tshogs dbang sdud cing : dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog: ྅/ nub byang mtshams nas rgyug pa yi: dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed ma: dbu ni dur bya khā kha'i mgo: khrag gi ral pa shar ra ra: khrag gi phur bu sil li li: ral pa re la phur bu re ral pa gsigs pa'i skra —372

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtog)gseb nas dur bya khā kha 'bum 'bum 'gyed: ce spyang rgyug tshul zhudas rtse zhud : lag na gsang ba'i rde'u chung brdung : rlung lha'i dmag tsho gos dbang sdud cing : dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog hūṃ/ byang shar mtshams nas rgyug pa yi: (4ba'i pa la gyi bka' nyan las byed ma dbu ni zangs kyi dred mo'i mgo zangs kyi ral ba shar ra ra zangs kyi phur bu sil li li: ral pa re la phur bu re:ral pa gsigs pa'i skra gseb nas: zangs kyi dred mo 'bum 'bum 'gyed: ce spyang rgyug tshul zhungs se zhung : lag na zangs kyi rde'u chung brdung : dbang ldan dmag tshogs dbang sdud cing : dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog: hu lu hu lu rak+ta snying 'a hi: ྅ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo/ kha rak+ṣa kha rak+ṣa/ sa ma ya bh+yo: mun ta a be sha na kha rak+ṣa kha sa sa: hu lu hu lu hring : zhesarbad cing bskul lo: yang dag thugs kyi bka' srung srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad bskul ba ni: // smug nag g.yag gi mgo bo can g.yas na zhing gi dbyug to bsnams g.yon na bhan+dha rak+tas bkang : dmar ser sprul gyi mgo bo can: g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams g.yon na bhan da rak+tas bkang : ser nag gzig gi mgo bo can: g.yas na spu gri 'bar ba bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta:: dkar dmar sre mo'i mgo bo can: g.yas na dung chen 'bar ba bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta:: ser nag pha wang mgo bo can g.yas na 'khor lo 'bar ba bsnams:g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas cha dmar ser dred kyi mgo bo can: g.yas na zhing gi dbyug pa bsnams g.yon na ༷ rak+tas dmar nag dom gyi mgo bo can: g.yas na zhing gi rde'u chung bsnams g.yon na bhan+dha rak+tas sngo nag chu srin mgo bo can g.yas na zhing gi baṃ ril 'phyar: g.yon na da sngo skya sdig pa'i mgo bo can g.yas na zhing gi glo snying (5na to1gas g.yon na bhan+ta:: ser nag khra yi mgo bo can g.yas na zhing gi rde'u chung bsnams: g.yon na bhan+ta — ljang nag wa yi mgo bo can: g.yas na dbyug to 'bar ba bsnams: g.yon na bhan+ta:: mthing nag stag gi mgo bo can g.yas ni zhid gi dbyug to bsdams: g.yon na byu:: dmar nag bya rgod mgo bo can g.yas kyi phyag na lcags sgrog bsnams g.yon na 1 :: dmar nag rta yi mgo bo can: g.yas na rdo rje dbyug pa 'phyar g.yon na —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'abhan+ta dmar ser byi la'i mgo bo can g.yas kyi phyag na rdo rje bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas 7dmar nag khyi yi mgo bo can: g.yas na ti ra'i dbyug pa thogs g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas dkar dmar pu shud mgo bo can: g.yas kyi phyag na pad+ma bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas ljang ser sha ba'i mgo bo can: g.yas na zhing chen za ba'i tshul: g.yon na bhan+dha rak+tas — dmar nag khā da'i mgo bo can g.yas na zhing gi rde'u chung bsnams g.yon na bhan+dha rak+tas phu snang nag kyin gyi mgo bo can g.yas na zhing gi rgyu zhags bsnams g.yon na byu rak+tas:: dmar ser phag gi mgo bo can:g.yas na rtse lnga 'bar ba bsnams: g.yon na bhan+dha rak+tas ga dmar nag skya da'i mgo bo can g.yasan zhing gi rgyu zhags bsnams g.yon na bhan+dha rak+tas ljang nag ba lang mgo bo can: g.yas na baṃ chen bum ril bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas sngo skya bya rog mgo bo can g.yas na zangs gri 'bar ba bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta (5badze k+tas nag mo khu byug mgo bo can: g.yas na lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tasaḥ: sngon mo ra yi mgo bo can: g.yas na zhags pa 'bar ba bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas dmar mo spre'u'i mgo bo can g.yas na lcags sgrog 'bar ba bsnams g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas ljang gu spyang mo'i mgo bo can: g.yas na dril bu 'bar ba bsnams:g.yon na bhan+ta rak+tas:: srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam can dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: traka ra spru rag mo kha la kha tshe thun: traka raka kha la kha tshe thun bh+yo bh+yo: zhesarbad do: 'jam dpal sku'i lha tsho gis rnams kyi bka' srung bskul ba ni // gri thogs ging gi thugs dam bskul shar phyogs ging chen dkar po ni sku la dung khrab dkar po gsol phyag na dung gi ral gri bsnams srog chod snying phyungs sha rus gtubs lho phyogasaging chen ser po ni: sku la gser khrab ser po gsol phyag na gser gyi ral gri bsnams srog chod snying phyungs sha rus gtubs nub phyogs ging chen dmar po ni sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol phyag na zangs kyi ral gri bsnams srog chod snying phyungs sha rus gtubs byang phyogs ging chen sngon —374

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul la rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganapo ni sku la g.yu khrab sngon po gsol phyag na g.yu yi ral gri bsnams: srog chod snying byungs sha rus gtubs: ྅ khram thogs bdud kyi thugs dam bskul: shar bdud rol po ral pa can phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams (6na jim nyams dgra bo khram la thob: khram bdag srog bdud mche ba can phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob zla bdud rol po zhags pa can phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams dam nyams dgra po khram la thob: srog bdud gser gyi sta re can: phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob shod thogs rtsis pa'i thugs dam bskul nyi ma dang po'i rtsis byed ging : dkar po lag na shod rde thogs dam nyamasadagra bo rtsis la thob nyi ma gnyis pa'i rtsis byed ging : ser po lag na shod rde thogs dam nyamasadagra bo rtsis la thob nyi ma gsum pa'i rtsis byed ging : dmar po lag na shod rde thogs: dam nyamasadagra bo rtsis la thob nyi ma bzhi pa'i rtsis byed ging : sngon po lag na shod rde thogs dam nyams dgra bo rtsis la thob bshan pa bzhi yi thugs dam bskul: nad gtor ma mo'i bshan pa ni: gsod byed chen mo'i thugs dam bskul bdud dang mkha' 'gro kun gyi bdag nag mo chen mo kha gdangs ma bshan pa dgra la rngams pa'i tshe bshan pa gri thogs zings6zing : ma mo'i zor thogs chil li li thun gyi ser ba shar ra ra khrag gi na bun thul lu lu nad kyi na bun thibs se thib ma mo'i bshan pa dgra la bh+yo myos pa btsan gyi bshan pa ni dmar ba btsan gyi ling pa ste dmar po 'jigs byed khro gtum can spyan ni khrag gi mtshor 'khyil zhing : khrag gi kha chu tsar ra ra dug gi kha rlangs phyur ru sa phyag na btsan gri dmar po (6bathogs btsan gyi bshan pa'i dus la bab glen pa klu yi bshan pa ni sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la sbrul gyi ral pas sa gzhi khengs sku la pal gyi ber chen gsol sbrul nag rlon pa'i rked chings can phyag na sbrul nag zhags pa thogs sbrul gyi kha nas dug mda' rgyob klu yi bshan pa'i dus la bab gdug rtsub gza' yi bshan pa ni sku mdog nag po tser re re g.yas na mdud la dar nag 'phyar g.yon na snying dang zhags pa bsnams —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geru mtshon g.yas na bsnams pa'i tshe bdud kyi dmag tshogs nyer re re: zhags pa nag po nar ra ra:nag po srog la dbang byed pa gza' yi bshan pa'i dus la bab 'jam dpal sku yi bka' srung thugs dam can dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: ya ma ra tsa/ sa twa me ya/ ya me du sa ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya snye ya/ ya snye ya tsha/ ni ra ma ya/ thun ya/ thun ya/ pad+ma gsung gi bga' srung bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ sku las sprul pa'i kham rgya mo: dung gi spyang mo mgo gsum zhen: gsung las sprul pa'i kham rgya mo: zangs kyi 'phar ba lce brgyad zhen: thugs las sprul pa'i kham rgya mo: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu zhen: yon tan sprul pa'i kham rgya mo g.yu yi spyang mo rkang gsum zhen: 'phrin las sprul pa'i kham rgya mo: gser gyi seng ge rngam khri zhen: gnyis med sprul pa'i kham rgya mo dung gi seng ge mgo dgu zhon: shar phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni: 'brug chen sngon po (7na sgo'i sa su bcibs na bza' ne'u le'i dpung rdum gsol lag na lcags kyu dgra sta thogs dbu yi ral pa tshar re la gza' rgod mig dmar tshar du 'bebs sprul pa dmus long bco lngas bskor lho phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni lcags kyi sdig pa chibs su bcibs: phyag na lcags kyi khyung chen bsnams na bza' gsa' yi ral ma gsol dbu yi ral ba tshar re la nyi ma 'bum gyi char ba 'bebs sprul pa dmus long bco lngas bskor nub phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni:ba lang dkar po chibs su bcibs na bza' klu 'brug pags pa gsol lag na sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs dbu yi ral pa tshar re la dug dag me yi char pa 'bebs sprul pa dmus long bco lngasabaskor byang phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni lcags kyi drel rta rkang gsum bcibs na bza' zhing gi g.yang gzhi gsol lag pa phral nas gar stabs byed dbu yi ral pa tshar re la long ba'i sprul pa char du 'bebs sprul pa dmus long bco lngas bskor // shar gyi phyogs nas rgyug pa'i khyi spyo dung gi khyi mo ral pa can lho yi phyogs nas rgyug pa'i khyi khri gser gyi khyi mo ral pa can nub kyi phyogasanas rgyug pa'i khyi zangs kyi khyi mo ral pa can byang gi phyogs nas rgyug pa'i khyi'i g.yu yi khyi mo ral —376

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganapa can shar lho mtshams nas rgyug pa'i khyi byu ru'i khyi mo ral pa can: lho nub mtshams nas rgyug pa'i khyi: mchong gi khyi mo ral pa can nub byang mtshams nas rgyug pa'i khyi: bse yi khyi mo ral pa can:byang shar (7bsgo tshams nas rgyug pa'i gyi shel gyi khyi mo ral pa can: dpal gyi khyi brgyad thugs dam can kun kyang 'jigs tshul rngams pa'i gzugs: mche ba spu gri gtams pa 'dra: mig ni nyi ma'i zer bas 'tsher: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig: shar gyi phyogs nas rgyug pa yi: dung gi spyang mo ral pa can: lho yi phyogs nas rgyug pa yi: gser gyi spyang mo ral pa can: nub kyi phyogs nas rgyug pa yi: zangs kyi spyang mo ral pa can byang gi phyogs nas rgyug pa yi: g.yu yi spyang mo ral pa can: shar lho mtshams nas rgyug pa yi: mthing gi spyang mo ral pa can: lho nub mtshams nas rgyug pa yi: mu men spyang mo ral pa can: nub byang mtshams nas rgyug pa yi: mchong gi spyang mo ral pa can:byang shar mtshams nas rgyug pa yi: ra gan spyang mo ral pa can: spyang mo ro shal thugs dam can:kun kyang spyan gyis dur khrod gzigs las su dur khrod gnas su rgyug: kha nas ro shal dur thag gcod ma thogs myur du las gyis shig shar gyi phyogs kyi pho nya ni: dkar mo zla 'dab 'jigasapa'i gzugs lho yi phyogs kyi pho nya ni: ser mo nyi 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs nub kyi phyogs kyi pho nya ni dmar mo me 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs byang gi phyogs gyi pho nya ni sngon mo chu 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs kun kyang ljags las glog 'gyu bas 'jig rten thams cad sreg par byed zhal nas chu 'bab rba rlabs g.yeng : shangs nas rlung 'thor bu yug 'tshub: spyan nas khro chu'i thog (8na〉ying 'bebs ljags las sprul pa'i pho nya 'gyed mche bas khams gsum sgrol bar byed pho nya chen mo byed rnams kyis ma thogs myur du 'phrin las mdzod rlung 'brug sku mdog sngon mo la:rin cen g.yu yi 'dab gzhog can me 'brug sku mdog dmar mo la 'bar ba me yi 'dab gshog can klu 'brug sku mdog sngon mo la gdug pa sbrul gyi 'da' gshog can gcig ni sna tshogasagazugs can ma rdo rje'i 'dab gshog 'bar bas gtams kun kyang 'brug sgra 'ur ru phu kha nas —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geglog dmar khyugs se khyug dam nyams dgra la mngags pa'i tshe yud tsam gyis ni dgra bgegasasgrol pad+ma gsung gi srung ma thugs dam can dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol:tri pa tri pa hūṃ phaṭa: kha la ro sha kha la ro sha hūṃ phaṭa: ya ka kun baṃ dzaḥ& phaṭa: dza lo dza lo hūṃ phaṭa: sam ya ya ka hūṃ phaṭa: dza la a mo /tre hūṃ phaṭa: cesarbad do phur pa 'phrin las kyi bka' srung bskul ba ni: ྅/ nam gyi srod kyi dam can ma lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la mi mo lcags kyi mgo can zhen: lag na lcags kyi phur bu 'dril shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab:gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la mi mo gser gyi mgo can zhen: lag na gser gyi phur bu 'dril: sri la mu kha'i dus la bab: zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la mi mo zangs kyi mgo can zhen: lag na zangs kyi phur bu 'dril sri la mu kha'i dus(8ba〉pa bab lcags kyi khyi mo ral pa can mi mo lcags kyi mgo can zhen: lag na dung gi phur bu 'dril shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab nam gyi gung gi dam can ma nag mo ral pas stong khams khyab phyag na mchong gi phur bu 'dril chibs su drel rta nag po bcibs re ma ti yi dus la bab ser nag rma bya'i thul ba can phyag na mchog gi phur bu 'dril chibs su drel rta nag po bcibs re ma twe yi dus la bab dmar nag re lde nag po gsol phyag na mchog gi phur bu 'dril chibs su drel rta nag po bcibs re ma dza yi dus la bab ljang nag dar nag gos zung gsol phyag na mchog gi phur bu 'dril chibs su drel rta nag po bcibs re ma dzu yi dus la bab nam gyi tho rangs dam can ma mthing nag lcags phur ral pa can phyag na lcagasakyi phur bu 'dril chibs su bdud rta nag po bcibs rdo rje ya byin dus la bab ser mo gser phur ral pa can phyag na gser gyi phur bu 'dril chibs su gza' rta ser po bcibs rdo rje de byin dus la bab dmar mo bse phur ral pa can phyag na bse yi phur bu 'dril chibs su btsan rta nag po bcibs rdo rje bse byin dus la bab ljang mo g.yu phur ral pa can phyag na g.yu yi phur bu chibs su klu rta sngon po rdo rje phag byin dus la bab shar phyogs srin po'i skyes bu ni dkar —378

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganapo lag na phur bu 'dril srin po'i rgyad chen dus la bab: lho phyogs gshin rje'i skyes bu ni:(9na jig po lag na phur bu:: gshin rje nag po'i dus la bab nub phyogs ya bdud skyes bu ni dmar po lag na phur bu : sog po mi hreng dus la bab byang phyogs gnod sbyin skyes bu ni: sngon po lag na phur bu thogs mon pa mi hrang dus la bab shar bdud dkar po mche ba can phyag na dung gi phur buḥ shar gyi skyes bu'i dus la bab: lto bdud sngon po ral pa can: phyag na g.yu yi phur buḥ: lho yi skyes bu'i dus la bab nub bdud nag po zhags pa can phyag na zhags pa phur bug nub kyi skyes bu'i dus la bab byang bdud ljang nag ral pa can phyag na ral gri phur bu 'dril byang gi skyes bu'i dus la 4 pra ma ra tsa srin po'i gtso dkar po lag na phur bu 'dril: shar gyi dmag dpon dus la bab ya ma rā tsa gshin rje'i ging : sngon po lag na phur bu 'dril: lho yi dmag dpon dus la mu dha sha skyi ba bdud kyi ging : nag po lag na phur bu:: nub kyi dmag dpon dus la bab ya ka lji ba gnod sbyin ging : ser po lag na phur bu 'dril byang gi dmag dpon dus la bab phur pa 'phrin las srung ma thugs dam can dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol ka snya ka te he dza ye bi dza ye a tsi ta a pa ra tsit+ta ma ra pa na bra ma rta na me hūṃ phaṭa cesarbad do ma mo rbod gtong gi bka' srung bskul ba ni // sngon mo 'bum gyi las byed ma mtsho sman rgyal (9ba〉smo dpal mo ldan sku mdog sngon mo me long thogs dkar mo 'bum gyi lasabyed ma dkar mo chen mo dbu dgu ma lag na bhan+ta skam po thogs ser mo 'bum gyi las byed ma srid pa'i bu mo dam tshig can lag na bhan+ta skam po thogs smug po 'bum gyi las byed ma smug nag chen mo dbu lnga ma lag na bhan+ta rlon pa thogs dkar mo stong gi las byed ma khram kha stong gi dbang mo che lag na thod pa skam po thogs ser mo stong gi las byed ma ri rab gling bzhi'i dbang mo che lag na bha ser po thogs smug nag stong gi las byed ma theg chen sa gzhi'i dbang mo che lag na bhan+ta dmar po thogs sngon mo stong gi las byed ma : rgya mtsho gling gi dbang mo che lag na bhan+ta sngon —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepo thogs: gnam gyi ye 'dar chen mo ni: nag mo mun pa'i go zu can lag na — khrag bkang thogs bar gyi glog ma srin mo yang : khrag gi bud med dmar nag la: lag na bhan+dha khrag bkang thogs: sa yi 'phung byed chen mo ni: mun pa'i bud med nag mo la lag na bhan+ta khrag bkang thogs rtsis kyi ma gsum dus la bab: gsang ba'i ma mo sbed byed ma nag mo chen mo lcags kyu thogs: pho nyar lcags kyi khyi mo khrid gsang ba'i ma mo 'khrug byed ma nag mo khrag gi lcags kyu thogs: pho nyar zangs khyi mo khrid gsang ba'i ma mo gsod byed ma nag mo lag na lcags kyu thogs pho nya lcags kyi khyi mo khrid: gsang ba'i ma gsum dus la bab: lcags kyi spyang mo mche (10na tshe ba can zangs kyi wa mo sder mo can: dung gi khyi mo ral pa can ma mo chen mo ro kha mo: nag mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs ma mo chen mo tsa mun tri smug mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs ma mo chen mo nam gru ma nag mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs ro kha mched gsum dus la bab shar gyi stag srin zor ba gdong : dkar mo lag na zor ba thogs lho yi baṃ srin dred mo gdong : ser nag lag na zor ba thogs nub kyi kong srin ba lang gdong : dmar mo lag na zor ba thogs byang gi 'phrog srin chu srin gdong : sngon mo lag na zor ba thogs gdong kha ma bzhi'i dus la bab ma mo thod gtong srung ma thugs dam can dam rdzasabadud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol ma ma ru lu hūṃ bh+yo:trag trag rak+ṣa bh+yo: trag rak+ṣa bh+yo rag mo rag mo sarba bh+yo:rigs 'dzin gyi bka' srung bskul ba ni // rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo rdo rje thod khrag thogs rin cen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin chen thod khrag thogs pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo pad+ma thod khrag thogs las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu rgya gram thod khrag thogs 'jig rten las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sna tsho gis gri gug thod khrag thogs rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo ni sngon po rdo rje thod khrag thogs rin cen rigs kyi dpa' bo ni ser po rin cen thod khrag thogs pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo ni (10brko mar po pad+ma thod khrag thogs las—380

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganakyi rigs kyi dpa' bo ni ljang gu rgya gram thod khrag thogs: 'jig rten las kyi dpa' bo ni: sna tshogs gri dang thod pa thogs dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sil snyan mang po sil li li/rgyan cha mang po pur ru phu mkha' 'gro stong dang spungs se spung : 'dir spyon rigs 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol:bde 'dus las/ 'jig rten pa dang / drag sngags la bka' srung bskul du ma mchis so:re re la'ang 'khor 'bum phrag gnyis gnyis dang ldan no: bka' srung gi bskul rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya:zhes gsungs pa ni sgrub sde drug gi dkyus ltar 'jig rten pa'i sde gnyis sku mdog phyag mtshan gyi sgo nas bskul na ha cang mangs ches pas ma gsungs kyang : yongs rdzogs pho nya sgos bskul dkyus su mdor bsdus gsungs pa 'di lta ste: 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi bka' srung pho nya bskul ba ni: lha/snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs dbang phyug ma hā de ba dang : btsun mo u ma de lte bcas:dgra bgegs khug la myur du sgrol: 'chi bdag ya ma rwa tsa bh+yoḥ skye 'gro srog gi bdag mo bh+yo: dgra bgegs khug phu ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo bh+yo: sngags srung a ke dzā tī bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug za bdud po bskos rje brang dkar bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug : bdud mo chen po rī tī bh+yo: rgyal po chen po pe gar bh+yo: srog bdag tshangs pa dkar po (11na/bh+yo: dgra bgegs khugaḥ skyes mchogo rdo rje legs pa bh+yoḥgaza' bdud chen po rā hu bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug za srin po nag po glog 'phreng bh+yoḥ srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug : gnod sbyin ya spru me dbal bh+yoḥ gnod sbyin mon mo nag mo bh+yoḥdagra bgegs khug : mgon nag ma hā kā la bh+yoḥ bde chen rdo rje bdud 'dul bh+yoḥ dgra bgegasakhug spyo dmu bdud nag po bkrag med bh+yoḥ mu stegs gu lang nag po bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug srid pa'i lha rabs sha bh+yoḥ gnam sman thog gi bu yug bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug spyo ma sangs g.ya' spang skyes gnyig bh+yoḥ khrag btsan srog zan dmar po bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug srog bdag gnam the dkar po bh+yoḥ btsan 'gong yaṃ shud dmar po bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug bgegs rgyal byi na ya kha bh+yoḥ—381

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedapal ldan nag mo mgyogs byed bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khug : klu bdud nag po mgo dgu bh+yoḥ klu mo nag mo gdug byed bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs khugaḥ: sdod pon sum cu gtso 'khor bcas dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol zho badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba du ni na hūṃ phaṭa ging ka ra bdud tri mā ra: a bi bu pa shang mi ki nā ga yak+ṣa raka ma ma dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad: ces bskul lo: dmod pa drag sngags kyi pho nya bka' srung bskul ba ni lha bh+yo dzaḥ lha srin sdo brgyad 'khor dang bcas: dregs pa spyi yi sdod pon bh+yo: dgra srog (11ba)dmar po chod la shog 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po che: gshin rje yongs kyi sdod pon bh+yoḥ dgra srog dmar po chod5 'chi bdag nag po'i btsun mo ste: skye 'gro dbugs kyi bdag mo bh+yo: dgra srog dmar po :'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo ste: snang srid ma mo'i sde dpon bh+yo: dgra srog dmar bo:: bdud po me yi kha rlangs can bdud rnams kun gyi sdod pon bh+yo: dgra srog dmar po bdud mo nag mo khrag 'dzag ma bdud mo yongs kyi sde dpon bh+yo: dgra srog dmar poḥ ma hā de wa lha chen po lha rnams yongs kyi sdod pon bh+yo: dgra srog dmar po za gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po ni gnod sbyin yongs kyi sde dpon bh+yo: dgra srog dmar po she gnod sbyin sha za ral gcig mo gnod sbyin yongs kyi sdod pon bh+yo dgra srog dmar po 〈 mu stegs kā la ya ka ste log 'dren yongs kyi dzi dpon bh+yo dgra srog dmar po sngags pa lta ba log pa can ru dra yongs kyi sde dpon bh+yo dgra srog dmar po : ku le lag dgu zhesabya ba 'gong po yongs kyi sde dpon bh+yo dgra srog dmar po 2rdo rje legs pa zhes bya ba the'u rang yongs kyi sde dpon bh+yo dgra srog dmar po : srog bdag rgyal po'i li byin har: rgyal po yongs kyi sde dpon bh+yoḥ dgra srog dmar po 7 dmu rje btsan po zhes bya ba dmu rnams yongs kyi sdod pon bh+yo dgra srog dmar po 7 khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la gza' rnams yongs kyi sdod pon bh+yo dgra srog dmar po : raka nag po glog 'phreng can srin po yongs kyi (12na tshe gi dpon bh+yoḥ dgra srog dmar po : srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig ma srin mo yongs kyi sdod pon bh+yoḥ dgra srog dmar po 7 yam shud —382

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (ga)dmar po zhes bya ste:btsan rnams yongs kyi sdod pon bh+yoḥdagra srog dmar po klu rgyal gzhon nu gtum po sogs klu brgyad klu yi sdod pon bh+yoḥdagra srog dmar po phu sngags bdag sde dpon bco brgyad po dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la:yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol rtswa badz+ra sarba du/ hūṃ phaṭa:ya ma nā ga de wa rā hu la ya ka raka:dha sha lha wa dgra bgegs mā ra ya bod ces bas bskul zhing rnga brdung 'chams stabs bya:phur thun gyis brab bo/khugs rtags byung byung du rbad do:dam can sgos su bskul te/dgra bgegs bla tshe dgug pa'o:sgrub chen gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi pho nya sgos su bskul ba rdzogs so:: sgo gtad rgya/gter rgya/zab rgya/rgya rgya rgya/gsum pa dmod byang ni:yongs rdzogs gter gzhung las 'dir mtsho 'gro'i 3 yig ṣ+ka khrug kyang 'god thabasamed rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi:phyi rabs sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sku dgra/sgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa rnams:'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa rnams kyi zhal du stob pa'i phyir srung ma la dam bdar zhing dmod pa 'dor ba ni:yongs rdzogs kyi bka' srung yan chad bskul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba'i rjes la:sngo rdo rje slob dpon bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol:gzhan yang pha mes brgyud kyi srung ma/dben gnas12bganyan gyi srung ma/nya stong dus drug gi srung ma//bsten bsten pa bsgrubs bsgrubs pa/gsol gsol ba/mchod mchod pa/sku dang grib ma bzhin du gnas pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs shig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang na gnas pa na/chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no:rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gang na gnas pa na/dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no:gsang ba'i snying po gang na gnas pa na sngags bdag dregs pa'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no:chos skyong bstan pa mi bsrung ci zhig bsrung :dam can dam la mi gnas ci la gnas sngags bdag dgra bgegs mi sgrol ci zhig sgrol su la mi re khyod la re su la mi bltos khyod la bltos rgyal mtshan du khyod 'dzugs/phrag pa la ཿkhyod 'khrur/dmag dpung du khyod bskyed/dpa'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogedar du khyod 'phyar ba yin na:sngon gyi dam tshig yal bar ma 'dor sdang ba'i dgra la mthu ma wo :gnod byed bgegs la rtsal ma zhan:bcol ba'i las la bang ma bul mthudang rtsal byungs la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig yul 'khor khyim dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod cig:mi nor phyugs gsum gyi gnyer ka mdzod cig yul du 'khor srungasashig byes su rkyen zlog cig phyi nang gi bar chad srungs shig:bcol ba'i las kyis shig bsgrubasapa'i rtags spungs shig:'phrin las sngon du gyis shig:rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi bsam pa yid bzhin du 13na tshe grub par mdzod cig:sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/dkon cog gi dbu 'phang dmod pa/snga dgra dar ba/phyi dgra sems pa/da dgra rtsom pa/gzugs can gyi dgra/gzugs med kyi bgegs/bstan pa bshig par byed pa'i dgra bo 'di rnams thal ba'i rdul du rlog cig rnal 'byor ba bdag gis khas ma nyes/lag gis ma nyes/spyod pas ma nyes/dgra bo 'di rnams kyis sku la bdos so:rigs la bsnyegs so:bstan pa bshig go:'di las kyi rlung dmar gyis rgyab nasa'aphul zhig:'jigs pa'i mun nag gis mdun nas bsus shig gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas da cig:sa'i rten phur 'og nas phyungs shig:dkon pa'i tshe srog dang phrol shig:tshe'i 'du byed skumasashig kha ru lag pa rgyug cig mig 'bras thang la lhung zhig:'chi bdag gi bdud thong zhig:'khor bshig cig:tshang dkrugs shig mgo bo khos shig lus gtubs shig sgo yi nor dang phrol zhig:mchan gyi bu dang phrol zhig:yul gyi khang khyim bshig cig zhing gi skye brgyud chod cig/yar gyi pha brgyud rdzo cig mar gyi bu brgyud chod cig rtsad nas ra cig drung nas phyungs shig slo bur dang ye 'byog thong zhig:spyo 'bog dang brgyal nad thong zhig:ltas ga dang cho 'phrul thong zhig:mna' mnol dang dme 'byug thong zhig:lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig zhag dang za mar sgrol cig nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs 'jig rten phyi ma la dus ma 'debs rang bzhin 'gyas grub 3ba ) pa'i skye 'chi la khungs ma 'byin las kyi 8 4 btsan no zhes snyad ma 'dogs par/rtags

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2poba'i don mdzad bcom ldan shāka thub la: sdig can lha sbyin ngan pas brnyas btsugs so che rtags ngur smig na bzas brgyan byas nas: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa don med dam nam mkhar gnas pa'i g.yu 'byug sngon mo la ltas ngan bung ba ngan pas brnyas btsugs so che rtags lce la glog dmar brgyan byas nas stong gsum 'brug sgra bkang ba don med dam mkha' la gnas pa'i bya khyung ga ru la ltasang na srin bya ngan pas brnyas ma che rtags lcags rus dbu la 4 gshog sgro spu grir gtams pa:: gangs la gnas pa'i seng ge dkar mo la dur khrod wa skya 'jol mos ga che rtags g.yu ral sngon pos ba: rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs pa 7 kun la dbang sgyur sa bdag rgyal po la 'bangs 'khor skye bo ngan pas ma che rtags men tri thod (14ba)dmar brgyan : rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs paḥ : grub thob slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la bod khams lha srin ngan pas ma che rtags thod pa'i phreng bas 4 lha srin dam la btags pa don med dam dam chos ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la:dam nyams slob ma ngan pas ma che rtags 'chad cing klad la bskor byas nas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pa de naḥ : da lta sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang la dam nyams dgra bo ngan pas 7 yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i skur bsgoms nas bzlas brjod tshul bzhin byas pa don med dam: ྅ bh+yoḥ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du mi phyed dad pas zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor bdag sgrub pa'i snying po dam du bcas pa la bar chod 'tshe ba dam nyams dgra yis byas da ni ma' spyod drag po'i las rtsom na: lha dang dam can rgya mtsho grogs la spyon bdag gi ma nyes dam nyams dgra yis nyes:nyes byas 'di la chad pa'i las mdzod cig nyes med rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs g.yel na sngon gyi tha tshig 'gal bar gyur ta re: khas blangs gnyan gyi mtha' las ma btang bar do nub gzu dpang gnyan po'i grogs la spyon khyed kyis drangs pa'i sems nyid da lta rang : sdig can dgra bo sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyang byin ma chung : chos skyong srung ma rnams kyang mthu ma chung : bka' srung las mkhan rnams kyang rtsal ma yin: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag —386

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganagi bsam pa sgrubs zhes (15na〉na ser skyems gtor: bden pa brjod: yus pa'i gshags gdab:phyon mahā gu rus mdzad pa mngon spyod drag po'i gzu dpang gnyan zhing shin tu gnyan pa sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya de nas rgyal ba spyi bskul dkyus kyi mjug nas gsungs pa ltar mkhyen par gsol zhing gnad nas bskul ba ni/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ gdod nas ma skyes byang chub sems nyid 'di ma dag skye bo rnams kyis ma gtogs pas: skyes mchog bdag gis drang zhing don bgyid du bdud dang srin pos tshe la bar gcod cing : bgegs dang 'byung pos 'di la glags lta na: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la dpang mdzod cig ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: nges pa'i don rtogs gos bu chung ma gson dam can srung ma med dam ra mda' mdzod: lha bh+yo: thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab rnam pa gsum zhi gnas lhag mthong mnyam zhing 'brel ba yi: ting 'dzin drod mchog skye ba'i rgyu yin yang :gnod byed bgegs kyis sgom du ma ster na kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la dpang mdzod cig ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol nges pa'i don du 'bras bu chud ma gson dam can srung ma med dam ra mda' mdzod: ྅ bh+yo: 'jig rten khams 'dir 'dus byas zas dang nor ārla mchod cing 'gro don bgyid dgongs pas dam nyams dgra bos bgyid du ma ster na kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la dpang mdzod cig ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: nges pa'i (15ba〉don du gos bu chud ma gson: dam can srung ma med dam ra mda' mdzod: ྅ bh+yoḥ bdag ni zog med ngesapa'i rnal 'byor ba byang chub sgrub cing 'gro ba'i don bgyid par: sems kyis thag bcad skyesamachog bdag lta bus: bshags kyang mi tshang smras kyang mi dgongs na byams mgon thugs rje chung bar mi 'gyur ram bcol kyang mi mdzad bskul kyang mi gsan na: sngon gyi dam bca' 'gal bar mi 'gyur ram: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo 'phrin las mdzod: snyi bh+yoḥ thugs nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad nas bstan pa'i ru dra bar chod rnam gnyis so mngon spyod tshul gyis myur sgrol 'phrin las mdzod: ces phud gtor zhing bskul —387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gelo: zhes gsungs pa ltar bskul zhing : nyams len gnad gdams las: zho badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru /snyi phaṭa: sarba skadze yak+ṣa bh+yo dza: zho ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo snro sarba rkarma yak+ṣa bh+yo dza: gshin rje sogs lha g.yin rnams la yang rigs 'gre bar byas te bzlas pas gong gi snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa thams cad sngon gyi thugs dam las bzhengs nas dmag dpung go gsar byed pa lta bu'i dmigs pa rnams bya'o: 'brub khung bskyed pa ni ru dra sarba sha : mā ra ya : dzaḥ mdun du bha3 gru gsum 'bar ba phyi nag la rtsub pa/ nang dmar la tsha ba/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i bcen dong sdig can gyi bshas ra 'jigs shing ya nga ba bar med mun khang chen po'i nang du dgra bgegs kyi rnam par shes pa : sngo (16na)ljang dang tri dmar ser mar me lta bur gnas pa de yongs su gyur pa las nya po 'di rnams dgra bgegs gang yin pa de dag dngos su gyur te mi sdug pa'i gzugs can sngo la ham pa:nag la rid pa gas bu nyam thag pa: 'dar khril li li/ skyi bun bun/ 'gul mi nus pa zhig tu gyur par bsams la: ྅ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas rdo rje dril bu g.yab dar 'dzin pas liṅka'i mgo ngos su langs te 'dug la bden pa bdar ba ni gtor bzlog gi nyams len man ngag gnad gdams las na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tsho gos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : bka' srung pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gzhan yang gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang : gzungs sngags dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags 'chang bdag gi phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag rnal 'byor pa dpon slob yon mchod: dge sde grwa tshan 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs/ bar chad kyi rkyen/ khyad par du byad ma rbod gtang lha dang bcas pa rnams/ mgon byed kyi lha'am/ tshe dang dbang thang ngam/ bsod nams dang dus kyi dbang du ma btang bar/ da lta nyid du liṅga 'di la khug cig: cesabarjod la sgrub khog nas gsungs pa ltar/ drag sngags so lnga pa'i sham bur/ : tri hur ṭaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ/ baṃ —388—

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnasngo a be sha ya a ā:bsad las6ba los pa dang /bsad pa don brgyad kyi gshor las/hūṃ mthing nag me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas dpal chen kho bo khro mo kun bzhengs te:sprul pa yang sprul sna tshogs phyogs bcur khye:pho nya kun gyis drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod:lcags kyu can gyis snying nas bzung :zhags pa can gyis yan lag chings:lcags sgrog can gyis lus kun sdoms:dril bu can gyis rdul du rlog badz+ra e ku sha dza:badz+ra pā sha ho:badz+ra h+pho ṭa baṃ/badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ho:'dir mkha' 'gro'i 3 yig cig 'dug kyang 'god thabs med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo:drag po bsgral ba'i las mtha' la rgyas dang bsdus pa shin tu bsdus:rgyas pa 'phrin las tshar rjes su tsho gos mchode sgrol ba'i skabs su'am mnan sreg 'phang gsum gang yang rung :dgra bgegs li sgo gzhung bzhin bshams bsad las rgyas pa 'di yis bskul:྅/smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas che mchog yon tan lha tsho gos rnams bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs la rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mda' rlog gnas 'dir drag po'i las la yu yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams:drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrol:bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsgral ba'i las la don brgyang/ de bla srog sngun du dgug dang gcig mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dbrog dang gnyis grogs byed lha dang dbral dang gsum rnam shes gzugs la dbab dang bzhi mi 'tshor byad du gzhug dang lnga 17na ba ྂ na med spyo ru gzhug dang drug gas du brdung zhing brlag dang bdun phung po zhal du stob dang brgyad:re re la'ang don brgyad brgyad de/de yang bskul ba'i lha dang gcig:'phrin las dmigs pa dang gnyis gdags pa'i mchod dang gsum bzlas pa'i sngags dang bzhi sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang lnga:brab pa'i rdzas dang drug bca' ba'i phyag rgya dang bdun:zhal gyi dmod pa dang brgyad do:dang po che mchog gis dgugs pa ni:྅/dang po ni/che mchog lha tsho gos thugs dam can:drag po'i gnyis tsho 'phrin las dus la bab yid la brnag pa'i da/ 9bgegs rnams:yud gsum pa ni tsam gcig gis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge'adir khug cig rtswa sto pa ni badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka dgra bgegs: ta ri e ku sha dzaḥ bsad lngaponi khang nang gi gzugs dngos la/ bla srog rnam shes dbyer med bstim rnon drug pa ni po'i mas gyisasnying nas drongs/ /phyag bdun pa ni rgya'i 'phrul gyis nye bar khug /hoḥ brgyad pa ni/ dpal chen po che mchog drag po'i lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo sprul pa dang yang sprul: pho nya las byed/ bka' srung dang bcas pa rnams kyis bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams 'di rnams lcags kyus gnas bzung :zhags pas ske nas chings: rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shog la skad cig gis 'dir khug cig:sgyu 'phrul dang gtor bzlog las thugs dam bskul ba ni: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bskul (17ba)byas na sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig bdud rtsi lnga yi zag rdzas la: mtshan ma ming du bcas pa byas bkug ste rdo rje phur pa btab: rdul du brlag ste tsho gis su 'bul zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis 'jig rten khams ni rab stims kun: thal ba bzhin du brlag nus phyir drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: de nas pho nya btang ste: lha mo blas bya na tsho gos kyi bdag he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhig pa dang : dkon cog dbu 'phang dmod pa dang : slob dpon la ni brnyas byed dang :rdo rje spun la 'khru ba dang : bdag la bar du gcod pa yi: gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs khrag 'thung lha tsho gos 'khor bcas kyis dbang du sdud la rdul du rlog bsad las rgyas par/ hūṃ/ mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs la rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mda' rlog gnas 'dir drag po'i las la yu yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrol gnyisapa yang dag gis mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dbrog pa la'ang brgyad las // yang dang po ni dag lha tshogs thugs dam can drag gnyis pa ni po'i 'phrin las dus la bab: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams:mthu gsum pa ni dang rdo 'phrul brlag par gyis pha nga ni/ ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa dgra bgegs—390

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i gcil las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtog)sarba a ba na ya a ba na ya hūṃ phaṭa: bkrag lnga pa ni mdangs mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul (18na sgoms/ /dbrogs te bdag gi dbang du gyur/ /myos byed drug pa ni 'bru yis rnam par brdung / /phyag tshan pa ni rgya'i 'phrul gyis rab tu phrogs bas pha sngo dpal chen po badz+ra he ru ka drag po'i lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo sprul pa yang sprul pho nya las byed bka' srung dang bcas pa rnams kyis bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams 'di rnams kyi bkrag dang gzi brjid stobs dang nus pa mthu dang rdzu tshil thams cad gtan nas brlag par gyis shig: de nas lha dang dbral ba ni nyams len gnad gdams las:hūṃ/ dam nyams dgra bo sdig can la/ 'go bar byed pa'i lha khyod nyen: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'dis dang por sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig bar du dkon cog dbu 'phang dmad tha mar gsang sngags snying po dbral: dge ba bcu ni khyad du bsad mi dge bcu ni dang du blangs mtshams med lnga po gos bur smin 'di ni bsgral ba'i zhing yin phyir 'di yi mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: ye shesalha ni dbyings su gshegs 'jig rten lha rnams rang gnas song : gal te mi 'gro 'di yi skyabasamadzad na ye shes lha ni thugs dam nyams par 'gyur 'jig rten lha ni rdul du brlag par 'gyur:de bas 'di yi mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig lha hūṃ baṃ shwa kro ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal : sgrub khog nas gsungasapa ltar so lnga pa'i sham bur dgra bo la 'go ba'i lha bra be sha ya phaṭa: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ces brjod pasasprul pa'i pho nyas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten (18ba〉pas 'das pa'i srung ma rnams gtor te lha dang dbye ba'i dmigs pa gsung rgyun ltar byed bsad las rgyas par/ hūṃ/ ser nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs rnams bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs la rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mda' brlog gnas 'dir drag po'i las la ā: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrol bsad pa don brgyad kyi gsum pa gshin rjes lha dang dbral ba la'ang brgyad las // dang po ni gzhin rje'i lha tsho gos thugs dam can:drag gnyi pa ni po'i 'phrin las dus la bab yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams mgon gsumaspu—391 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2poni skyabs grogs dang bral bar gyis: chu pha pa ni a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūṃ phaṭa: dgra bgegs ha san ya ha san ya hūṃ phaṭa: stong lnga pa ni khams gang ba'i dud sprin gyis: mgon skyabs lha 'brug bskrad cing byer/ rdzas drug pa ni kyis bdug byab brab cing brdung / /phyag bon pa ni rgya'i 'phrul gyis rab tu dbye/ sngo bas pa ni dpal chen po 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed drag po'i lha tsho gos khro bo khro mo sprul pa dang yang sprul pho nya las byed bka' srung dang bcas pa rnams kyis bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams pa 'di la 'go ba'i lha rnams bya spu rlung gis gtor ba bzhin thong zhig:mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byed pa kun bya rog rdos bdas pa bzhin du thong zhig: de nas dgug ste gnad gdams las // dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab che mchog (19na sko tshogs dus la bab:sprul pa 'gyed pa'i dus la bab dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: gang la bya ba khyed kyis shes yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs 'di rang dbang med par 'di dra thag dbang du sdud la rdul du rlog lha/ khrag 'thung sku la sprul pa'i pho nya ni: lcags kyu dkar po'i tsho gis ni skar ltar 'khrug zhags pa ser po'i tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs: lcags sgrog dmar po'i tshogs ni glog ltar 'byug dril bu ljang mo'i tshogs ni thog ltar 'babs khyed rnams dpal gyi pho nya ste bod cing btang ba nga yis byed 'gugs shing brdeg pa khyed kyis gyis gang la bya ba khyed kyis shes yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams lcags kyu can gyis snying nas bzung : zhags pa can gyis 'gul nas chings lcags sgrog can gyis dbang po sdoms dril bu can gyis myos su chug rang dbang med par 'dir khug la gzugs dang liṅga 'di la bstim ming byang 'di la gnas par mdzod drag sngags so lnga pa'i sham bur gnod byed dgra bgegs badz+ra ku sha ya dza rat+na pā shwa hūṃ/ pad+ma spro ṭa baṃ/ sa me gaṇ+ḍisngo zhes pas gnod byed 'gyel thabs su gnas pa de sprul pa'i pho nya rnams kyi lcags kyu can gyis snying nas bzung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings lcags sgrog can gyis dbang po sdoms dril bu can gyis myos su chug: mtshon cha can gyis rgyab nas ded las kyi rlung gis zhabs nas —392

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganabateg ste:rang dbang med par bdag gi mdun du 19ba7kug ste:liṅga la bstim mo:bsad las rgyas par/hūṃ/dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas pad+ma gsung gi lha tsho gos rnams:bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs la:rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mda' rlog gnas 'dir drag po'i las la yu:yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams:drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrol bsad pa don brgyad las/bzhi pa rta mgrin gyis rnam shes gzugs la dbab pa la'ang brgyad las dang po ni hūṃ/rta mgrin lha tsho gos thugs dam can gnyis pa ni drag po'i 'phrin las dus la bab yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams:gsum pa ni bla srog rnam shes rten la phob:pha pa ni ā+oṃ pad+man+ta kri ta badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī wa dgra bgegs a be sha ya hūṃ phaṭa:lnga pa ni lcags kyus snying bzung mtshon cha ded las rlud la bskyon gtsug nas bstim drug pa ni rdzas kyis brab cing rnam par g.yab/bdun pa ni phyag rgya'i 'phrul gyis rab tu 'bebs/brgyad pa ni hoḥdapal chen po rta mgrin drag po'i lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo sprul pa dang yang spru la pho nya las byed bka' srung dang bcas pa rnams kyis bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs 'di'i bla srog rnam shes snying nas drangs te liṅga 'di la gnyis su med par gyis shig/phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad bye ma la mar thim pa bzhin du gyur cig lid+ma'i rten 'di la da lta nyid du phob cig bzlog gzhung las bcol dam bya zhes pa ni gab pa don snying du //dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gis rnams dam nyams dgra bgegs 20na〉khyung po 'di bsad cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul bcol lo gtad do gnyer du long :'gugs byed tsho gis kyis snying nas bzung :'ching byed tshogs kyis yan lag chings sgom byed tshogs kyis nying lag sdoms myos byed tshogs kyis lus ngag gnon gtum byed tshogs kyis sha rus gtubs za byed tshogs kyis sha la rol 'thung byed tshogs kyis khrag la 'thung :'cha' byed tsho gis kyis rus pa chos:rnag byed tsho gis kyis rjes shul drongs dam nyams dgra bgegs nga po 'di yul mkhar zhing dang bcas pa 'bul ༷col lo gtad do gnyer du long :bcol bas mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebazhes mi srid do: gtad pas mi thub mi srid do: bzung bas shor ba mi srid do: gsad las rgyasapar: ྅/ ljang nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: phur pa 'phrin las lha tsho gis rnams bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs la rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mda' rlog gnas 'dir drag po'i las la yu yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrol: bsad pa don brgyad kyi lnga pa phur pas mi 'chor byad du gzhug pa la'ang brgyad las dang po ni hūṃ/ phur pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam can gnyis pa ni drag po'i 'phrin las dus la bab: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams gsum pa ni bzung zhig rgyab cig rnam par chings pha pa ni ā+oṃ badz+raki li gī lwa ya sarba byu baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: dgra bgegs shī kṛ ā na ya hūṃ phaṭa lnga pa ni pho lha'i byad kyi thag pa yis dru bu lta bur 'gul mi byed drug pa ni 'ching sgril rdzas kyis bcings shing sgril tshan pa ni phyag rgya'i 'phrul gyis rnam par sdoms bsa' 〉 phur pa drag po'i lha tsho gos khro bo dang khro mo sprul pa dang yang sprul pho nya las byed bka' srung dang bcas pa rnams kyis bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs 'di'i yan lag gzugs phung las kyi zhags pa dang mtshon gyi dru bus chings shig mkhar nag gi khug mar 'gul du med par gyis shig byad kyi dra bar chug la drag po'i btson khang du skyur cig: de nas nyes pa bsgrags te gab pa don snying las lha/ dug lnga 'dus pa'i 'bras bu la/ /phung po lnga yi yan lag rgyas nyon mongs sha khrag rus su smin dug lnga'i dbang gis lus stobs rgyas gzung 'dzin lus la sems brtan nas nyon mongs dbang gis sna khrid pas/ /dkar po'i chos la log lta skyes bstan pa gnyan po'i ru dra byas dkon cog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dmad gsang sngags bstan la skur ba btab: bla ma rnams kyi sku la bsdos dkon cog gsum gyi dkor khang bcoms ser chags yongs la ngan smras byas rnal 'byor bdag dang shin tu 'gras sems can yongs kyi srog kyang gcod ma 'ongs bskal pa phyi ma la bstan pa'i ru drar 'gyur pas na 'di la bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang : da lta nyid du bsgral bar bya gdug pa'i dgra bgegs lasang na khyod khyod la mgon med —394

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaskyabs med pas sngar byas las kyi 'bras bur spyod: lasang na brgyud la 'dzad med pas: sngagasa'achang rgyal po bdag cag gis khyod la brtse ba'i sems kyis ni: sdug bsngal 'di (21na rkong phral bas na dad pa'i sems kyis nga la nyon: gdungs pa'i sems kyisang la stos: khyod la mgon du nga las med: nga yis smras pa'i ngag la nyon: khyod liṅga 'di la 'dug tsam na 'di ni khyod kyi gzhal yas khang : lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bzung ba ni: 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa yin: lcags sgrog dra bas bsdams tsa na : 'khor ba'i dong kha sdom pa yin: sna tshogs thun gyis brab tsa na las ngan rnams dang phral ba yin drag po'i mtshon gyis gtubs tsa na: dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa yin: sha khrag tsho gos su phul tsa na skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa yin: khyod lus ga 'di la ma chags shig las ga 'di la ma chen cig khyod la brtse ba nga yin pas: 'khor ba'i gnas nas bsgral ba yin spyan mig zum pas nga la ltos nyams len gnad gdams las: ྅/ sems can chen po khyod nyon cig khyod ni gti mug dbang gyur pas dge ba spangs nas mi dge bsgrubs khyod ni zhe sdang dbang gyur pas: snying rje med par gsod la dga' khyod ni nga rgyal dbang gyur pas bdag bstod gzhan gyi yon tan dmod: khyed ni 'dod chags dbang gyur pas: ma byin len dang mi tshangs spyod khyod ni phrag dog dbang gyur pas:dus gsum sangs rgyas yon tan dmod las dge ba bcu ni khyad du bsad mi dge ba bcu ni dang du blangs mtshams med lnga po 'bras bur smin dang por sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhig bar du dkon cog dbu 'phang dmad tha ma (21bskosang sngags snying po dbral de nas slob dpon sku la bsdos khyod ni bsgral ba'i zhing yin pas thugs rje thabs kyis bsgral bar bya zhes khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs thams cad ce spyang sha la rngam pa'am khrag la dga' ba ltar zhing bcu bsgral ba'i las la rngam par bsam mo bsad las rgyas par: ྅/ smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas ma mo thod gtong lha tshogs rnams bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs la rnal 'byor —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobadag gi ra mda' rlag: gnas 'dir drag po'i las la yu yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams:drag po'i las kyas myur du sgrol bsad pa don brgyad las/ drug pa ma mos dran med spyo ru gzhug pa la'ang brgyad las/ dang po ni hūṃ/ ma mo'i lha tshogs thugs dam can gnyis pa ni drag po'i 'phrin las dus la bab: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams gsum pa ni rings par khug la spyor chug cig:sto pa ni tswa gu spo dz+nyā na shrī he ru gaḥgu spo dz+nyā na kro ti shwa rī stim: ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo:sno dgra bgegs tha la ya dz+wa la ya hūṃ phaṭa: lnga pa ni dug rlangs char babs na bun ltar/ /drug pa ni gtibs pas rnam shes spyo zhing 'bog /myos byed rdzas kyis rnam par gsher/ bon pa ni phyag rgya'i 'phrul gyis brgyal zhing 'khrugs/ /brgyad pa ni ho khya ma mo drag po'i lha tsho gos ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs 'di la dug khrag nad kyi char phob cig spyo 'bog brgyal nad kyis lus sems zhabrug par gyis (22na shig: dran pa gtan nas brlag par gyur cig:de nas bsgral ba'i las bya ba la: phur pa spu gri'i sgrub 'bum lhan thabs las/ hūṃ/ gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog dam pa 'dis sdang ba'i dgra la 'phog na lha dang 'bral: gnod pa'i bgegs la 'phog na brgyal zhing myos sras mchoge gī lwa ya ni gzi byin bskyed chu badz+raki li ki lā ya/ su ru su sa pra su sa a tiṣ+ṭha mu ga ha la ha la dgra bgegs nga po'i tsit+ta phyogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa snyi/ yungs kar rgyal po'i rdzas mchogo dam pa 'di gser mdog gzi mdangs 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro: dgra dang bgegs ni thal ba rdul du rlog sras mchog gī wā ya ni thugs dam bskul tshwa badz+ra gī li gī wā ya/ma gu ta ya/ ma gu ta ya/ bra ta la pra ta la sha ta ra tsa dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa // rak+ta khol ma'i rdzas mchog dam pa 'di snang ba'i dgra la 'phog na dbang du sdud gnod pa'i bgegs la 'phog na thal bar rlog sras mchog gī wā ya ni gzi mdangs bskyed swo badz+raki li gī wā ya/ rak+ta dz+ra la maṇ+ḍal/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ dgra bgegs ba byu ku ru mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa de ltar rdzi dug gi gseb nas khro chung 'phro ba sogs kyi dmigs pa bya/ rgyud dag sgrub khog las phur pa rigs bzhi gsungs pa'i mtshan —396

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnam rdzas kyi phur pa sras mchogo ya ka kro tar bskyed tshul gsungs pa ni: gdab phur lag tu thogs la:bdag gi lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: zho hūṃ lha hrīḥ.āḥ dpa' bo 'bru lnga las/ rigs kyi yab lngar bskyed: g.yon gyi sor mo lnga hūṃ (22bsko rmā r+bha tī/ dpa' mo 'bru lnga lasarigs kyi yum lngar bskyed/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mtshams su phur pa bzung ste: shā n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par bsam mo: de yang rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba byas pa'i byang chub sems las byung ba'i hūṃ mthing nag las 'od los pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: de dag gi nus pa thams cad tshur 'dus te: ྅ la thim par bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las dus gcig la bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ sras mchog badz+ra ki lā ya/ sku stod zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje'i gshog pa can zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ dbusamathing nag /phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ bar pa na dgra sta/ g.yon dang po me dpung / bar pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ/ tha ma gnyis ri rab kyi phur pa bsgril ba/ dur khrod kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa phyogasabacur brgyangs pas 'jigs su rung ba/ sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa mgar gyi sol mal nasadrangs pa lta bu chu srin gyi kha nas sprul gyi chun po skyug pa zhig tu bskyed do: de'i rgya mdud gong ma la zhi ba rigs lnga'i pho brang dang bcas pa 'chang bzung khrag 'thung lha dgu'i pho brang dang bcas pa/ rgya mdud 'og ma la dpal gyi bka' srung gi pho brang dang bcas pa/ rtse mo zur gsum pa mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi tsha tsha 'phro ba/ bsgril ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar ba/ phyar ba tsam gyis khams gsum dngangs par byed pa/ btab pa tsam gyis stong gsum brlag par byed pa zhig tu bskyed la chu badz+ra gī li ki lā ya kā ya a bhi khiñtsa ā+oṃ (23na〉zhes/ phur pa de las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul 'od zer tshur bsdus bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs phur pa btab pa la thim pas sku 'gying ba tsam gyis khams gsum sgrol nus pa'i dbang thob par bsam mo PROB badz+ra ki li gī wā ya wā ka a bhi ṇiñtsa —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ge.āḥzhes phur pa de las 'od dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegasapa thams cad kyi gsung mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul:'od zer tshur bsdus bde bar gshegs pa thamasacad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs phur pa la thim pas gsung bsgrags pa tsam gyis stong gsum sgrol nus pa'i dbang thob par bsam mo:chu badz+ra gī li gī lā ya tsit+ta a bhi 'i khiñtsa hūṃ/zhes pas phur pa de lasa'od sngon po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul:'od zer tshur bsdus bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs phur pa la thim pas/thugs g.yos pa tsam gyis srid gsum sgrol nus pa'i dbang thob par bsam phur pa bsgril zhing 'di skad do:྅/bdag nyid khrag 'thung he ru da g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin la rigs lnga yab lnga'i ngo bor gsal:g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin la rigs lnga yum lnga'i ngo por gsal thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las mthing nag hūṃ las bskyed pa'i lha srasamachog badz+ra ki lwa ya:lte ba yan chod sku stod ni dbu 23bsko sum phyag drug rdo rje'i gshog pa can dus gsum bde gshegs 'phrin las 'dus pa'i sku:lte ba man chad sku smad ni ye shes phur pa dpal dang ldan dug lnga 'joms mdzad mgo bo rgya mdud ni srid gsum bla med gnas su bsgral ba'i phyir zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs par mnga' gsol nas ma bcos lhun gyis grub par gzi byin bskyed:'chang bzung zur brgyad dur khrod brgyad kyi ngang :rnam shes tshogos brgyad dbyings su sgrol ba'i phyir khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs par mnga' gsol nas bcu drug rol pa chen por gzi byin bskyed rked pa rgya mdud 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i ngang :chu srin kha nas sbrul gyis chun posabargyan 'khor ba cho me kyi dbyings su sgrol ba'i phyir bka' srung pho nya bzhugs par mnga' gsol nas mkha' dbyings yum gyi bha gar gzi byin bskyed rtse mo thur gsum mngon spyod drag po yis dug gsum sku gsum dbyings su sgrol ba'i phyir mthu rtsal med du byung bar mnga' gsol nas 'bras bu sku gsum dbyings su gzi byin bskyed /rdon las rdzogs pa'i rdo rje phur pa 'di bsgril ba

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganatsam gyis srid pa gsum yang 'dar: phyar pa tsam gyis khams gsum dngangs par byed: btab pasakhams gsum skad cig tsam la brlag gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams la smos ci dgos: gdug pa 'dul mdzad badz+raki lā ya: 'gal byed cham la phob cig badz+ra gī lā ya: sgrub pa'i rtags 'byin mdzod cig badz+raki lā ya: las rnams don du gnyer zhig badz+ra kyi lā ya: btab na thebs(24na)par mdzod cig badz+raki lā ya phangs na phyir la bzlog cig badz+ra gī lwa ya: srog dbugs lus dang phye zhig badz+raki lā ya: rnam shes rten dang phrol cig badz+ra gī lwa ya: dgra bgegs rdul du rlog cig badz+ra kyi wā ya na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nī/ kā ya lha ska tsit+ta badz+ra gī li ki lwa ya:phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra gī lwa ya badz+ra dha rod a dzha pa ya ti gnod byed sarba bi snan baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: phur pa de ye shes kyi lha la bstad de bsgril bas:phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad phur pa la 'od du zhu nas thim pas/ phur pa gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur phur pa phyogs mtshams bcur bstad de bsgril bas/ gnod byed rnams 'od du zhu nas phur pa la thim pas phur pa rdzu 'phul dang ldan par gyur:de nas yongs rdzogs bskul byang las: gsum pa phur thun tshom bur bskul te bsgrub bya tshar bcad pa ni/ gdab las la sbyor bar gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas 'di skad do: ྅ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: zhes sogs las byang nas byung ba ltar bskul rnam shes sbar ba'i ched du/ e ma khams gsum sems can rnams ma rtogs 'brul pa snying re rje: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: thugs rje'i thabs kyis sbyor ba yis: phung po bsgral ba'i zhing du bcas: gzugs kyi lha rnams mchod par bya: rnam shes yum gyi mkha' la spar: ye shes sems dpar byin brlabs te: khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed: o badz+raki li gī lwa ya/ (24ba)e raṃ yaṃ raṃ/ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa: bo dhi tsit+ta gyi se ha ra ṇa snro zhes brjod/ drag sngags so lnga pa la yongasardzogs gzhung dang man ngag las byung ba'i gdangs dang bstun te phur bskor bya zhing snying gar phur pa btab ste bsgral lo: 'di'i skabs tshe lung khrus lung gi nyams len zab mo brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gergyun thos pas ma goms par byas pas rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyis rtsis zin par byed pa ni dmigs pa rnon bo rnal 'byor pa'i mtshon cha yin pas ngag 'don gtso mi che yang phaṭa gsum gyi 'og min du 'phang ba'i tshe ngag nas phaṭa shin tu che ba gsum brgyab ste thag chod par bya'o: skye sgo bcad nas phyir mi ldog par bya ba'i ched du dpal dgu'i gdab sngags so sos gdab pa ni/ tshe mchog gi gdab sngags rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na sngags byang skor lde'i rgya can las gsungs pa ltar/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: zho badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya sarba bi na rba dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa:ces che mchog dang / de bzhin du bka' gzhan rnams la so so'i sngags kyi mjug tu badz+ra kyi li man chad sbyar te dpal dgu so so'i phur pa gang du gdab pa'i gnas ma nor ba byas nas gdab bo: de nas spyir btang gdab las la thun dgu'am bdun rgyag pa yin kyang / gtor bzlog skabs su bzlog gzhung du phur skor bya: zhes gsungs pa gab pa don snying las khrung ba ltar/ spro na/ phur bu bsgril zhing 'di skad do kli/ lcags sam gdug pa'i shing rnams la mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum rked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang : : mo zur gsum (25na)dpal dang ldan chu srin kha nasahrūg stong ldir: rgya mdud kha nas glog stong 'khrug mgo bo sum cu rtsa gsum gzhal yas khang : zhed pa gling bzhi 'gro ba mi yi yul rtse mo zur gsum ngan song gsum gyi gnas mgo bo rgya mdud gzhal yas khang : bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tsho gos bzhugs sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i 'phrin las mdzod rked pa gling bzhi mi yul na rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' 'dzin pa phyi nang bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: : mo ga song gsum gnas na: bdag 'dzin dug gi rang dbang gis:'gro ba rigs drug sems can rnams sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs spyod srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis: stong gsum 'jig rten kun gyi bdag: mtho risang na song kun gyi ngang : khyod ni srid pa kun gyi bdag khyod ni zlog byed kun gyi bdag: khyod ni 'byung ba kun gyi rje khyod ni 'gro ba kun gyi lam:khyod ni 'dren pa kun gyi gtso: khyod ni ༅ song gsum gyi rgyud khyod ni 'gro drug kun gyi gnas khyod —400

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganakyi cha la thams cad brten: khyod kyi 'khor du thams cad 'dus: khyod ni dregs pa thams cad 'dul:khyod ni ngan sngags thams cad sgrub: dregs pa lha srin thams cad kyang : khyod kyi sku yi cha la brten:srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud kyang : khyod kyi sku yi cha la brten: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga phu ji ltar
