khasablangs dam bcas ltar dam las ma 'das 'phrin las mdzod: srid (25ba)pa'i phur bu dag gisabaskul zas su nyams pa'i sha la zo: sgom du nyams pa'i khrag la 'thung : ki lā la yi sgra bsgragasapas dam nyams rnams kyi klad pa 'gems: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo dang : bar chad byed pa'i bdud bgegs la: srid pa'i phur bu gī lā ya: sngags yong rgyal po bdag nyid la: phyogs bzhi mtshams dang steng 'og nas: ngan par dmigs nas sngags bzlog dang : log par blta ba'i ༅ sems dang : 'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sbyor ba dang : gtum zhing gdug pa'i sems kyis su mnan sreg thun la sogs pa yis: gdug sems byad mkhan gang yin gyi: snying gi dkyil du ki lā ya: smra byed lce la gī lā ya: dran byed sems la gī lu ya: dbang po lnga la gī lā ya rnam shes lnga la gī lwa ya: skye mched bzhi la gī lā ya: phung po lnga la gī lā ya: nus mthu sngagasang la ki lwa ya skyob byed lha la gī lā ya: 'phangs pa'i srog la gī lwa ya: gsabs pa'i bu la ki lwa ya: mdza' bshes gnyen la gī lwa ya: phur gang lha la gī lwa ya: khyim gang mi la gī lu ya: sgo gang nor la gī lā ya dbang thang lo la ki lu ya: yul dang mkhar la gī lwa ya kli/ zlog byed chen po'i dus la bab: srid pa'i byed zor bzlog tu gsol: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab dam tshig nyams chagasabaskang du gsol: lha chen thugs dam dus la bab: lha klu'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: ྅/ yon tan (26na)rgyud las byung ba yi: che mchog thugs kyi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed gser gyi phur pa 'bum:srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog: srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis: byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: // thugs kyi rgyud las byung ba yi: yang dag thugs kyi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed lcags kyi phur pa 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog: srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis byad zor thams—401 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pocad bzlog tu gsol lha sku yi ngang las byung ba yi 'jam dpal thugs kyi sprul pa ste 'debs byed shel gyi phur pa 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: snyi gsung gi ngang las byung ba yi dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa ste:'debs byed zangs kyi phur pa 'bum srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis: byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: ྅ 'phrin lasang nga las byung ba yi phur pa thugs kyi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed g.yu yi phur pa 'bum srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: ྅/ shes rab ngang las byung ba yi: bla med thugs kyi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed mthing gi phur pa 'bum srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog: srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: ྅ chos nyid phyag rgya'i ngang las byung ba yi: rigs 'dzin thugs kyi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed mu men phur pa 'bum srid gsum (26ba)byad ma'i phur kha bzlog srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: ྅/ gtum zhing dregs pa'i rgyud las byung : dregs pa kun 'dul thugs kyi sprul pa ste:'debs byed mchong gi phur pa 'bum srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis: byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: ྅/ bde gshegs mngon spyod rgyud las byung ba yi:stobs chen nag po'i thugs las sprul 'debs byed rat+na'i phur pa 'bum srid gsum byad ma'i phur kha bzlog srid pa'i phur bu chen po yis byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol sam ya: rgya rgya rgya/yang bh+yos gdab ces pa ni rnal 'byor pa bdag dang : mched lcam rnams kyis nas thogs nas gtor dar nag gis g.yab cing bzlog pa 'di skad do: ྅/ nga ni sngags 'chang rgyal po yin nga ni zlog byed chen po yin/ nga ni stong gsum bdag po yin: snang srid nga yis dbang du sdud: rang byung bstan pa rin cen la: bdag cag zhugs dang skyong lags te: 'gro drug sems can grangs mang bas: log rtog mun pa'i sems kyis su bstan pa'i ru dra byed pa dang : dug lnga rgyas pa'i dbang gis ni: rgyu sbyor yon —402

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnagyi bdag po dang : sngags 'chang rgyal po bdag cag la: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og nas:gdug rtsub gtum pa'i sems kyis su: ngan sngags dmod pa gang byed kyis: stong gsum ma mo'i bh+yo yis thob (27na stong gsum bh+yo sgra dir ri ri snang srid lha 'dre bh+yo yis thob snang srid bh+yo sgra dir ri ri bh+yo: nam mkha' lha yi byad sna yang : nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di la bh+yo: bar snang gnyan gyi byad sna yang : dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di la bh+yo: sa bdag klu yi byad sna yang : nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di la bh+yo bar ho bdud la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i srog la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i sha la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i snying la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i khrag la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i las sku dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog so lnga pa'i rjes la dgra bgegs gnod byed sha nyu hur ṭaṃ dza: : tri mā ra ya rbad: ces phur thun sor bzhi pas brab: ྅/ yungs kar rgyal po shā ri ram:khro mtshe mda' drag po skar ltar 'khrug dregs pa yongs rdzogs rtsal gyi sku: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du —403—

gnad gdams las/hūṃ/rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun:bka' lasa'ada' byed sdig can rnams:rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral nas kyang :lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du:rdo pa ni drag po'i 'phrin las dus la bab yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams gsum pa ni lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog pha pa ni ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba du:na dgra bgegs ta thā ya hūṃ phaṭa:lnga pa bstod dregs pa'i lha tshogs:dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu bka' srung lha srin sdebargyad dang bcas pa rnams kyis bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams 'di tshe'i 'du byed zad cing bsod nams kyi me shir chug cig las ༅ gyi rnam par smin pa'i char 'bab cing :sdug bsngal gyi mtsho 'brub par gyur cig thal ba'i rdul du brlag par gyur cig ces dmod pa bya/de nas stob pa bya ste las kyi sgrol ging gis ling khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganasbyangs 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum sha khrag rus: za byed mi 'gyur chos nyid klong du rol badz+ra yak+ṣa kro ta bi dza ya khā hi: che mchog drag po'i lha tshogs zhal du kha raṃ khā hi: zhes sogs nas dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs zhal du kha raṃ khā hi: bsad las rgyas par/hūṃ/ mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs rnams bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs la rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mda' rlog gnasa'adir drag po'i las la ā: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrol: bsad pa don brgyad ni/ brgyad pa drag sngags kyi zhal du stob pa la'ang brgyad las: dang po ni hūṃ/drag sngags lta tsho gos thugs dam can gnyis pa ni drag po'i 'phrin las dus la bab yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams gsum pa ni gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stob: pha pa ni lha badz+ra sarba du ṣ+ṭi e dza bh+yo dgra bgegs stin+ta ya bhin+dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lnga pa ni sha kham khrag thigs ma lus par/ /hab sgrar bcas te zhal du gsol/ drug pa ni bsgral ba'i gzar bus nye bar blangs/ /bon pa ni phyag rgya'i 'phrul gyis(30ba)zhal du 'debs: brgyad pa ni 'a drag sngags dmod pa'i lha tshogs stobs ldan nag po yab yum sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad bka' srung bshan pa sde brgyad dang bcas pa rnamasakyis bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams 'di'i sha la rol cig: khrag la 'thung zhig: rus pa cho mes cig rkang pa mur cig klad pa la hab kyis thob cig srog gi rtsal 'jibasashig dbang po rnam shes zo zhig: don snying spar gyis thob cig lhag ma ma lus par lha tshogasarnams kyi zhal du thob cig ces dmod mo bya/ gab pa'i sngags brgyad kyi bsad pa gdug pa kun sgrol zhes bya ba'i ṭīk+ka skyon pad+ma bdag gis bod kyi mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan la gdams pa'o:zhes 'byung ngo : 'on kyang ting nge 'dzin rdzas phyag rgya gsum po 'jug pa bde phyir tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa yin no: de nas bzlog gzhung du stob pa bya zhes pa la ni gab don las/ hūṃ/ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos rnams gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs —407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebar snang tsam gyi ljags khyongs la: stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa phu dgra bgegs nga po thams cad zhal du stob zhal du stob pa kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du dril lo a ra li: dbyings su bsgral lo sam ya hūṃ/ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs bar snang tsam gyi ljags khyongs la stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa sa (31na)bstan pa'i dgra bo zhal du stob: zhal du stob bo kha raṃ ji hi: mgul du dril lo a ra li: dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma ya: ྅/ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos rnams: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang tsam gyi ljags khyongs la: stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa phu gnod byed bgegs 'di zhal du stob: zhal du stob po kha raṃ 'a hiḥ mgur du dril lo a ra li dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma ya: // dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang tsam gyi ljags 'dril la: stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa phu bar gcod bdud rnams zhal du stob zhal du stob bo kha raṃ 'a sti mgur du dril lo a ra li dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma ya: ྅/ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gis rnams gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs bar snang tsam gyi ljags 'dril la: stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa phubar gcod bdud rnams zhal du stob zhal du stob bo kha raṃ khā sti mgur du dril lo a ra li dbyingasasu bsgral lo sa ma ya // dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos rnams gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongasal ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs bar snang tsam gi ljags 'dril la stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa phu dmar chen khrag 'di zhal du stob zhal du stob po kha raṃ khā hi mgur du dril lo a ra (31ba tha dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma ya // dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gis rnams gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs bar snang tsam gyi ljags 'dril la stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa sa rba chen tshogs ni zhal du stob zhal du stob bo kha raṃ khā sti mgur du dril lo a ra li dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma yu // dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gis rnams gnam sa tsam gyi zhal —408

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtog)gdongs la ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gcigs bar snang tsam gyi ljags 'dril la:stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa sa bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo las ga 'di phung po lnga ni zhal du stob:dbang po lnga ni zhal du stob skye mched bcu gnyis zhal du stob:sha khrag dmar 'di zhal du stob:zhal du stob bo kha raṃ khā stimagur du bril lo a ra li:dbyings su bsgral lo sam ya:྅/dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams:gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la:ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs:bar snang tsam gyi ljags 'dril la:stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa sa sngags 'chang rgyal po bdag nyid la:nam mkha' lha yi byad byed dang :bar snang gnyan gyi byad byed dang :sa gzhi klu yi byad byed dang :stong gsum mi yi byad byed dang :snang srid lha 'dre'i byad byed dang :gling bzhi bon po mu stegs dang :yul mi rje dang khyim mtshes dang :'tshe ba'i sems kyis bdag nyid la:yid kyis bsams dang ngag tu smra lus kyis byas pa la sogs pa rtsub pas sbyor 32nab sna tshogs spyod:de dag sbyor ba'i las rnams kyi gzhi dang rten dang lus sems rnams:zhal du stob po kha raṃ khā stimagur du dril lo a ra li:dbyingasasu bsgral lo sam ya:྅/dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos rnams:gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongasal ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs bar snang tsam gyi ljags 'dril la stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa phu sngags 'chang rgyal po bdag cag la:'tshe zhing sbyor ba rtsub pa yi nus mthu thams cad zhal du stob pho nya thams cad zhal du stob gzi brjid thams cad zhal du stob rdzu 'phrul thams cad zhal du stob yul mkhar thams cad zhal du stob mi nor thams cad zhal du stob gnyen bdun thamasacad zhal du stob lo tog thams cad zhal du stob zhal du stob bo kha raṃ khā gi mgur du dril lo a ra li dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma ya zhes ka dag gi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag ste:de las mi 'da' bar bya ba ni bzlog pa thams cad kyi mthar thug yin no:de nas bzlog gzhung du gtor ma 'bul zhes pa ni mchod pa rnam pa lnga blug la 'di skad do snyi/'jig rten gtor snod bcud rnamasagator mar bcas snang srid thams cad mchod ༷༷ rda byad de mdzes shing bkram par bshams nas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (gesu rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la:gnyis su med pa'i tshul du 'bul phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas dur khrod gzhal yas khang du mchod pa'i yo byad de mdzes shing bkram par bshams nas su:rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la:gnyis su med pa'i tshul du 'bul:bhan+dha lcang lo 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas:gzugs sgra dri ro la sogs 32ba mar pa rnams:mdzes shing bkram par bshams nas su:rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la gnyis su med pa'i tshul du 'bul:mchog wo mchog phran sna tshogs dang :sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga bza' dang myang ba'i bye brag rnams:mdzes shing bkram par bshams nas su rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tsho gos 'khor bcas la gnyis su med pa'i tshul du 'bul:zhal zas tsho gos kyi mchod pa rnams mdzes shing bkram par bshams nas su rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la gnyis su med pa'i tshul du 'bul bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i rda bha kla ta khā hi:zhes 'bul lo//de nas bzlog gzhung du dmar sbreng zhes gsungs pa ni gab don las/'dir mkha 'tsho 3 yig lngo snyug kyang 'god thabs med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tsho gos la phyag 'tshal lo bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor mas bzlog pa'i gzer kha las gab pa don gyi snying po zhes bya ba la spyi don bdun gyis ston pa las dang por dmar sbreng zhes pa ni:khrag gi gzar busa'aphyar zhing 'di skad do:de yang gter gzhung du bka' so sor 'dug na'ang 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas nas phyag len la 'di ltar mdzad //khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod wo po 'dir gti mug khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la gti mug khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod wo po 'dir zhe sdang khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li yi dpal wo khrag 33na ) 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la zhe sdang khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod wo po 'dir nga rgyal khrag gi rgya ༷/ 'di dpal wo khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogadagashegs la nga rgyal khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod wo po 'dir: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gis 'dir gshegs la: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir phrag dog khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la phrag dog khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol:khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir: 'gro drug khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li yi dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la 'gro drug khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod r+ṣa po 'dir: nyen mongs khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la:nyon mongs khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod wo po 'dir: dug lnga khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la dug lnga khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir khams gsum khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos 'dir gshegs la khams gsum khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i (33ba)dur khrod chen po 'dir srid gsum khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li yi: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la srid gsum khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir gzung 'dzin khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la gzung 'dzin khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir bstan pa'i ru dra'i khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la bstan pa'i ru dra'i khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir gnod byed byad ma'i khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos 'dir gshegs la gnod byed byad ma'i khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir zong mkhan khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li yi dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gis 'dir gshegs la zong mkhan khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol:khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir bar chad bdud rnams khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li dpal —411

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pochen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la bar chad bdud kyi khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol:khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir:dam nyams sdig can khrag gi rgya mtsho khyil li li:dpal r+ṣa khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la dam nyams khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po 'dir dpal chen khrag 'thung lha 34na ) tshogs mkha' dang mnyam:ma tshogs mkha' 'gro dbyings nas sprin ltar gtibs:'phrin las rnam gzhi'i 'gro don char ltar 'bebs gdug pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs glog ltar 'byug rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar ldir ri ri las mkhan gsod byed tshogs rnams khyugs se khyug:pho nya las byed tsho gos rnams thibs se thib glu gar bro brdung tsho gos rnams chems se chem:sgra bas rol mo'i tsho gis rnams sil li li mkha' dbyings pad+ma'i rak+ta shar ra ra dpal r+pā khrag 'thung lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas mkha' dbyings khrag la rol te dgyes par mdzod dmar chen khrag gi sbreng mo shar ra ra dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams dmar chen khrag la rol te dgyes par mdzod bsgral ba'i khrag zhag mdzes pa'i snod du gtam:dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas dmar chen khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la bsrung dang bzlog dang mnan pa dang :dam tshig nyams chags bskang ba dang :dngos grub rnam gsum thob bya'i phyir de sogs 'phrin las bsgrub tu gsol dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnam ma hā me sa khya stim hā rak+ta khā gi zhes rak+ta phyar ro rgya rgya/nya bo che ba gdab las rgyas pa'i dus btab cing :chung ba rnams tshig dang bstun nas phul dmar sbreng gi dus tshig dang bstun nas mi rkang gzar bus rak+ta 'phyar ba sogs phyag len ltar phul bas khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs rnams kyis drag po'i dkan sgra dang bcas 34ba ) gsol te shin tu dgyes nas lha thams cad zhal phyir gzigs te bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam liṅga lhag ma rnams gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i mdun du bzhag ste bzlog gzhung bsrang ba ni sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnamasal phyag 'tshal lo khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog ༵ ba'i thabs la bsangs phye khal gcig la dpal

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganagyi gtor ma bcu bsham yang na snod zangs gzheng la sogs pa chen por dmar gtor dgu'am bcu bya tha ma mtheb skyus dgang zan gyi nya bo bcu bya'o: dmar gyi gtor ma sprin chen kyis kha bcad bam gtsang ma yod na bzang : med na yang srog chags gcig bsgral la bya: de yang med na zan gyi nya bo bcu bya'o: phur bskor yam re bya zhing sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams la bstab pa yam re bya:mi sha la sogs pa'i sha sna tshogs dang : khrag sna tshogs dang : me tog sna tshogs dang : sman phud gtor mar sbreng ngo: de nas mched lcam dral rnams kyang lag tu phud dang nas thogs la bzlog cing bh+yo yig gdab bo rgya rgya rgya/dang po che mchog yon tan lha tsho gos la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: ྅/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ga: sku ni smug nag 'bar ba chen po la dbu ni nyi shu rtsa gcig dag dang ldan g.yas g.yon phyag ni bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis na zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsnams g.yas kyi zhal bdun dkar bar bstan pa ni bag chags med pa'i chos rnams dbang sdud dang :(35na)khro rgyal khrag 'thung sku la rdzogs pa yis dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la:gzhan 'phrul khro bo'i tsho gos rnams bzlog tu gsol: hom chen g.yon gyi zhal bdun dam ra ba ni:bslad pa med pa'i chos rnams dbang sdud dang : ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba yi dam nyamasadagra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la ma mo mkha' 'gro'i thun sngags bzlog tu gsol hom chen dbus kyi zhal bdun mthing ba ni: 'gyur med chos rnams dbang du bsdu ba dang : bdud dang srin po pho lhar 'gyed pa yi dam nyams dgra bgegs klad khrag 'di rol la: bdud dang srin po'i tshogasarnams bzlog tu gsol zhal gyi mche ba dkar por gtsigs pa ni mi bzad srin po 'bum sde skur rdzogs pas dam nyams dgra bgegs rgyu khrag 'di rol la srin po pho nya'i tsho gis rnams bzlog tu gsol spyan rtsa dmar po sdang mig bgrad pa ni dbyings kyi ma mo sku la rdzogs pa dang : dam nyamasadagra bgegs snying la da rol la ye shes ma mo'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog dbu skra kham nag gyen —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedu brdzes pa na rnam thar srid gsum sku la rdzogs pa dang : dgra bgegs gzugs phung 'di la da rol la: srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu la brgyan pa ni: khrag 'thung rigs lnga sku la rdzogs pa yis: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung ba lnga la rol: khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol (35ba/byu lcang los dbu rgyan byas pa ni:dus gsum ston pas dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs bhan+dha 'di la rol: lha yi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: g.yas kyi dbu la lha chen brgyad kyis brgyan: srid pa'i lha rnams dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs glo snying 'di rol la: lha yi pho nya'i tsho gos rnamasabazlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi dbu la klu brgyad mgur chu byas: sa bdag klu srin dbang du sdud pa dang :dam nyams dgra bgegs sha rus 'di rol la: sa bdag klu srin pho lha'i tshogs rnams bzlog dbus kyi dbu la bdud kyis mgur chu byas la bdud bcu gsum dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs dbang po lnga la rol bdud kyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: ma mo bdun gyis mgur chu byas pa ni: dur khrod gnas brgyad dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs nang khrol 'di rol la: ma mo pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol ma bdud stong gis mgur chu byas pa ni: ma bdud 'bum phrag dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs thod rus 'di rol la ma bdud pho nya'i tsho gos rnams bzlog tu gsol g.yon gyi dbu la gza' brgyad mgur chu byas gza' chen nyi zla'i 'od zer dbang sdud dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs don snying 'di rol la gza' skar pho lha'i tsho gis rnams bzlog tu gsol phyag mtshan zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsnams sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med dbang sdud dang : (36na)dam nyams dgra bgegs thugs rjes bsgral ba'i phyir phung po khams dang skye mched 'di rol la: rigs lnga pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol snyi/yum chen khro mo gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad de zhal dgu shin tu 'jigs par gdams pa ni theg pa rim dgu dbang du sdud pa dang : bag chags sgrib pa bcu po —414

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaspangs pa dang : shes bya'i sgrib pa bcu po sbyang ba dang : mi dge bcu po rtsad nas bcad pa dang : dgra bgegs 'di yi phung po dbang por rol: khro rgyal sprul pa'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: bco brgyad phyag rnams gyen du gdengs pa ni: stong pa bco brgyad dbang du sdud pa dang : ma rtogs 'khrul pas mnar ba'i dgra bgegs 'di'i khams dang skye mched 'di la da rol la gnas yul khro bo'i tsho gis rnams bzlog tu gsol: zhabs brgyad thur du stabs kyis bgrad pa ni: rnam thar brgyad po dbang du sdud pa dang : yul brgyad chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bgegs 'di: rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad 'di rol la: lha srin sdo brgyad pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams pa ni: bdud po pho nyar 'gyed cing dgra bgegs gsod: dug lnga'i mtshon chas mnar ba'i dgra bgegs 'di: sha rus bcas pa gtub cing da rol la: gnod byed gdug pa'i tshogasarnams bzlog tu gsol shar gyi phyogs nas raka he ru da: rdo rje (36ba)rigs kyi pho nya dbang sdusal dam nyams dgra bgegs dbang po lnga la rol: rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya'i tsho gis rnams bzlog: lho yi phyogs nas gu spo he ru na rin cen rigs kyi pho nya dbang sdus la: dam nyams dgra bgegs drod la da rol la rin cen rigs kyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog: nub kyi phyogs nas bi shwa he ru ga pad+ma rigs kyi pho nya dbang sdus la dam nyams dgra bgegs 'dod chags mtshan mar rol pad+ma rigs kyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog byang gi phyogs nas ya ka he ru da kyilas rigs kyi pho nya dbang sdus la dgra bgegs 'di yi skye brgyud sha khrag rol las kyi rigs kyi pho nya'i tsho gos rnamasabazlog yum chen raka kro ti shwa rī ma sa yi bskal pas thams cad gzir zhing gnon: sal gnasapa'i lha 'dre dbang sdus la dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi sha la rol: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzlog: yum chen gu h+ya kro ti shwa rī ma me yi bskal pas srid gsum thal bar sregs me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dbang sdus la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi srog la rol:rin cen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzlog: yum chen bi shwa kro ti shwa ri ma chu yi bskal —415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2popas thams cad g.yeng zhing bkru: chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dbang sdus la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi khrag la rol: pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzlog yum chen ya ka kro ti shwa rī ma:rlung gi bskal pas thams cad phyags (37na༄nga gtor: rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dbang sdus la:dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi dbugs la rol: las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnamasabazlog steng phyogs lha gdon 'dul byed khro bo yis: 'dod khams gzugs khams dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi snying la rol: lha yi dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: shar phyogs dri za 'dul byed khro bo yis: dri za'i 'khor tsho gos dbang du bsdub dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs zag pa'i rdzas la rol: dri za'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: shar lho me lha 'dul byed khro bo yis me lha'i 'khor tshogs dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs srog dang drod la rol: me lha'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol lho phyogs gshin rje 'dul byed khro bo yis: gshin rje'i 'khor tsho gos dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: lho nub srin po 'dul byed khro bo yis: sha za srin po dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs khong khrag 'di rol la:srin po'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol nub phyogs klu gdon 'dul byed khro bo yis:klu gnyan 'khor tsho gis dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs mchin khrag 'di rol la klu gnyan dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol nub byang rlung lha 'dul byed khro bo yis: (37ba)rlung lha 'khor bcas dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs srog dang dbugs la rol:rlung lha'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'dul byed khro bo yis gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs dbugs dang glo bar rol:gnod sbyin dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol byang shar dbang ldan 'dul byed khro bo yis dbang ldan 'khor tshogs dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs rkang dang rus la rol —4/6

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtog da bgegs kyi dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: 'og phyogs sa bdag 'dul byed khro bo yis sa bdag 'khor tsho gos dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs klad par da rol la: sabadag dmag tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol: shar nas lcags kyu can gyi sgo ba yis: lcags kyusabazung la phur pas da thob la dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yis snying la rol: lcags kyu can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog lho nas zhags pa can gyi sgo ba yis: khrag zhags dmar pos 'dabs shing 'ching bar byed: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi mgo la rol: zhags pa can gyi pho nya'i tshogasarnams bzlog nub nas lcags sgrog can gyi sgo ba yis: lcags sgrog nag pos yan lag 'ching bar byed dam nyams dgra bgegs yan lag bzhi la rol: lcags sgrog can gyi pho lha'i tsho gos rnamasabazlog byang nas dril bu can gyi sgo ba yis dril bus 'dul zhing mgo (38na)la brdeg par byed:dam nyams dgra bgegs gzugs phung lnga la rol: dril bu can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog:bka' yi bstan srung ce spyang ma brgyud rnams: ce spyang rgyug tshul dgra la 'jab par byed dam nyamasadagra bgegs 'di yi don snying rol: gdon dang dgra dang mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog: ྅/smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas che mchog yon tan lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas:dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā me sa khā stim hā rak+ta khā hi ma hā ke ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣu 'a hi: ma hā ba su ta 'a sti zhes dmar sbreng / phur skor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob la bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yosagadab/ bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs las/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ༅ bzlog bh+yo: zhes gsungs pa sbyar/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: ྅/ bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru ga: rdo rje khrag 'thung dbang du bsdu ba dang : dgra bgegs 'di yi rnam shes da rol la: rdo rje khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog: gti mug dpal chen burnya he ru da: bu d+dha khrag 'thung dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2genyams dgra bgegs gzugs phung da rol la: de bzhin khrag 'thung pho lha'i tsho gos rnams bzlog: nga rgyal dpal chen rat+na he ru ga: (38ba)rin cen khrag 'thung dbang du bsdu ba dang : dgra bgegs 'di yi tshor ba'i phung por rol: rin cen khrag 'thung pho lha'i tshogs rnams bzlog: 'dod chags dpal chen pad+ma he ru ga pad+ma khrag 'thung dbang du bsdu ba dang : dgra bgegs 'di yi 'du shes phung por rol pad+ma khrag 'thung pho nya'i tsho gos rnams bzlog: phrag dog dpal chen rkarma he ru ga las kyi khrag 'thung dbang du bsdu ba dang : dgra bgegs 'di yi 'du byed phung bor rol las kyi khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog: yum chen badz+ra kro ti shwa rī ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi bkrag dang mdangs la rol: rdo rje rigs kyi sprul pa'i tsho gos rnams bzlog: yum chen bu d+dha kro ti shwa rī ma dgra bgegasa'adi yi sha dang rus la rol: de bzhin rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs rnams bzlog yum chen rat+na kro ti shwa rī ma dgra bgegs 'di yi khrag dang chu la rol: rin chen rigs kyi sprul pa'i tsho gos rnams bzlog: yum chen pad+ma kro ti shwa rī ma dgra bgegs 'di yi drod dang me la rol pad+ma rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs rnams bzlog yum chen mdze kro ti shwa rī ma dgra bgegs 'di yi dbugs dang rlung la rol: las kyi rigs kyi sprul pa'i tsho gis rnams bzlog: rdo rje thugs kyi pho nya chen mo ste: phog par rgyob cig ma mo ko'u ri rdo rje can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog rin cen sku yi pho nya r+pā mo ste:snying la gzir cig ma mo tso ri ma: mda' gzhu can gyi pho nya'i tsho gis rnams bzlog pad+ma gsung gi pho nya chen mo ste: dbang (39na)du sdus shig ma mo bra mo nya rgyal mtshan can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog las byed las kyi pho nya chen mo ste: rgyu zhags drongs shig ma mo pe ta li rgyu zhags can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste slo snying drongs shig ma mo pu ka si slo snying thogs pa'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog zhe sdang 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste: rak+ta 'thung zhig ma mo da sma ri: thod khrag can gyi pho nya'i tsho gis rnams bzlog nga rgyal 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste: tsit+ta phyungs shig ma mo sma sha ni: snying chen 'byin pa'i pho nya'i tsho gos rnams bzlog phrag —418—

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganadog 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste:mgo lus phrol cig ma mo tsan+ta li mgo lus 'bral ba'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog phyag na zhing gi mchog phran bsnams pa ste:sha la rol cig phra men sing ha ma:seng mgo can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog:phyag mtshan phyag na ti ra bsnams pa ste rus pa 'chos shig phra men bya gh+ri ma stag mgo can gyi pho nya'i tsho gis rnams bzlog:phyag na lngags chen ldag pa'i phra men ma dgra bo'i lpags chen ldogs shig sri ka ma:wa mgo can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnamasabazlog zas su sha chen za ba'i phra men ma dgra bo'i sha la zo zhig shwa na ma:spyang mgo can gyi pho lha'i tshogs rnams bzlog skom du thod khrag 'thung ba'i phra men ma dgra bo'i dung khrag 'thung zhig kri ta ma bya rgod mgo can pho lha'i tshogs rnams bzlog:zhing chen phrag la 39ba / khur ba'i phra men ma dgra bo'i lngags chen shus shig kai snam kang ga'i mgo can pho lha'i tsho gis rnams bzlog:mig tshil 'byin par byed pa'i phra men ma:dgra bo'i mig tshil brus shig kā ka ma:sha zan bya rog mgo can pho nya bzlog slo ba snying bcas sun pa'i phra men ma dgra bo'i glo snying phyungs shig hu lu ma:lug pa'i mgo can pho nya'i tsho gos rnams bzlog nyen mongs sems can gnas nas 'dren mdzad ma dgra bo'i snying nas drongs shig rta gdong ma:rta gdong can gyi pho lha'i tsho gos rnams bzlog:dgra bgegs yan lag 'ching mdzad zhags pa ma dgra bgegs yan lag chings shig phag gdong ma phag gdong can gyi pho lha'i tshogs rnams bzlog:'khor ba gnas su 'ching zhing sdom byed ma dam nyams dgra bgegs sdoms shig sprel gdong ma:sprel gdong can gyi pho lha'i tsho gos rnams bzlog rnam par rtog pa myos byed dril bu ma dgra la rgyob cing sod cig spyang gdong ma spyang gdong can gyi pho nya'i tshogasarnams bzlog bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzad ma srin mo chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang :dgra bgegs 'di yi sha dang khrag la rol srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad gdug rtsub bzlog //gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la dam nyams 'a/nga 9po 'di la da rol cig:ma hā me sa khā stim hā

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2porak+ta khā hi: ma hā ke : tu ji hi: ma hā tsit+ta (40na lo hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na 'a hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu 'a hi/ ma hā ba su ta 'a hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur skor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yosagadab/ bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs las dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar ho rbod zor ltas ga bzlog bh+yo: zhes gsungs/de nas 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: ྅/ bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: thams cad dbang du bsdu mdzad khro bo'i rje: sha khrag srog la dbang sgyur bdud kyi gtso: dgra bgegs 'di yi sha khrag srog la rol: las kyi gshin rje pho nya'i dmag tshogs bzlog sbyor ba'i yum mchog kro mo pe ta li: ma bdud 'bum gyi gtso mo chen mo ste:dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi khrag la rol ma bdud nag mo'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog:sgrol ba'i yum mchog e ka dzā khyi ma dam can rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha mo dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi snying la rol: sgrol byed sngags kyi pho nya'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog: gshed chen gshin rje ya ma rā tsa khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi mgo bo skor gshin rje pho lha'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog sbyor ba'i yum gcig bdud kyi lcam gcig ma dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi khrag la rol ma bdud pho nya'i dmag tsho gis thams cad bzlog sgrol ba'i yum gcig dpal gyi bka' nyan ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi khong khrag rol: las kyi pho nya'i dmag (40ba)tshogs thams cad bzlog: gshed chen gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba khyod dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi yid dkrugs la: gshin rje srin po pho lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog sbyor ba'i yum gcig gtum mo dug hrul ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs snying rtsa gtso la stob: mkha' 'gro pho nya'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog: sgrol ba'i yum ni chags gzhi khrag gi bdag dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi snying khrag 'thung : khrag bzung ma mo pho lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog: gshed chen bdud po a ya rmi ru khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs khrag tu skyug tu chug: gshin rje bdud kyi pho nya thams —42()

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganacad bzlog sbyor ba'i yum mchog khro mo 'od zer can: dam nyams dgra bgegs chags pa'i khrag la rol/ ma mo pho lha'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog: sgrol ba'i yum ni gling bzhi gtsug 'byams ma:dam nyams dgra bgegs yan lag gtsugs phud rol: srid pa gling bzhi'i gnod byed thams cad bzlog: gshed chen gshin rje ral pa tshar dgu khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi srog chod la:gshin rje gnod sbyin dmag dpung dgra la bzlog: sbyor ba'i yum chen nag mo re ma khri dam nyams dgra bgegs khrag gi mtsho la rol dpal ldan ma yi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog: sgrol ba'i yum ni srin mo mgo 'phyang ma dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsa khrag 'di rol la: srin mo pho lha'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog steng gi phyogs nas gshin rje nag 'joms khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi klad par rol: (41na skong gi phyogs kyi gnod byed thams cad bzlog steng gi phyogs nas gshin rje phya sangs khyod dgra bgegs 'di yi mgo dang srog la rol steng gi phyogs kyi gdon rnams bzlog tu gsol: shar gyi phyogs nas kong rtse khrag 'joms khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegasarus la da rol la: shar gyi phyogs kyi gdon rnams bzlog tu gsol: shar lho mtshams nas a ba glang mgo khyod dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar nas da drongs la: shar lho mtshams kyi dgra bgegs ma lus bzlog: lho yi phyogs nas gshin rje ya ba ti dam nyams dgra bgegs sprugs shing 'thibs su chug lho yi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog: lho nub mtshams nas gshin rje mig dmar khyod dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: lho nub mtshams kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog nub kyi phyogs nas gshin rje rmig pa khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs skye brgyud rtsa ba chod:nub kyi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog: nub byang mtshams nas gshin rje tel pa khyod:dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus zhal du rngubs nub byang mtshams kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog byang gi phyogs nas gshin rje bdud 'joms khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'jigs pa'i gnas su skyol byang gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog: byang shar mtshams nas gshin rje —421 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po chos rgyal ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs khram la 'debs par byed byang shar mtshams kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog: 'og gi phyogs nas gshin rje dmar (41ba〉tho ni dgra bgegs ma lus dbang du sdud par byed 'og gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog 'og gi phyogs nasagashin rje thod dbyug thogs dam nyams dgra bgegs mgo lus 'bral bar byed: 'og gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog steng gi phyogs nas nag mo ral gcig ma dam nyams dgra la bying nad 'thibs po thob nag mo 'bum gyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog steng gi phyogs nas shel gyi gdong dgu ma: dam nyams dgra la rims nad char ltar thob lha srin sdebargyad bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog shar gyi phyogs nas ral gcig shel mig ma dam nyams dgra la snying chu gzer nad thong :dri za pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: shar lho mtshams nas dkar skya mche gtsigs pa dam nyams dgra la mgo nad de thong la: drang srong pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog lto yi phyogs nas dred kyi rngam stabs can: dam nyams dgra la rgyu gzer bshal nad thong : grul bum pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: lho nub mtshams nas khrag gi ral gcig ma dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag da rol la srin po pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog nub kyi phyogs nas klu mo bus 'gros ma dam nyams dgra la mdze nad sna dgu thong : klu rgyal pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: nub byang mtshamasanas rlung lha spyan gsum ma dam nyams dgra la smyo 'bog brgyal nad thong : rlung lha pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog byang gi phyogs nas smug nag ral gcig ma dam nyams dgra la lhog pa skem (42na jid thong : gnod sbyin pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog byang shar mtshams nas dmar mo ral gcig ma dam nyams dgra bgegs dbang po sdom par byed: dbang ldan pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: 'og gi phyogs nas ral gcig shel mig ma dam nyams dgra la bying nad 'thibs pa thong : klu bdud pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog 'og gi phyogs nas nag mo phag mgo ma dgra la dmu chu skran nad gtong bar byed sa bdag pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog shar gyi sgo ba dung —422

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma khoganagi bya rgod mgo: dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar nas da drongs la: 'gugs shing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las dus la bab lho yi sgo ba nag po stag mgo can dam nyams dgra bgegs mgo lus 'ching bar byed:dgra bgegs dgug cing 'ching ba'i dus la bab: nub kyi sgo ba bse yi gang ga'i mgo: dam nyamasadagra bgegs dbang po sdom par byed dgra bo 'ching zhing bzlog pa'i dus la bab byang gi sgo ba lcags kyi spyang zhi'i mgo: dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: bzlog cig bsad pa'i 'phrin las dus la bab bka' yi bstan srung ging bzhi bdud bzhi dang : rtsis pa bzhi dang bshan pa bcu gnyis rnams dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag rus la rol: bzlog cing bsad pa'i 'phrin lasadus la bab: ྅/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogasa'akhor dang bcas dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: (42bskom nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig ma hā me sa hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ska dṛ t+ya 'a hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ mahā tsak+ṣu khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur skor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob ba bya/gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yos gdab/ bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya rgya bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs las/ dusamin 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ga bzlog bh+yo:de nas pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: snyi/ bcom ldan dpal chen dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal khams gsum ma lus dbang du bsdu ba dang : dam nyams dgra bgegs chags pa'i rdzas la rol dbang chen bgegs kyi tsho gos rnams bzlog tu gsol yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan ral gcig ma dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsa khrag snying la rol dbang chen mo gdon tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol las kyi rgyal po byi la'i mgo bo can dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad 'dir khug la bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol las kyi rgyal po pu shud mgo bo can dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung ba'i bcud sdus la gdug pa'i sdang semasang na pa bzlog tu gsol ye shes zil gnon khro bo chen po yis lha yi gdon tsho gos dbang sdus pho nya —423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobazlog las kyi khro bo zil gnon chen po yis: las kyi khro bo dbang sdus pho nya bzlog: ye shes ma mo zil gnon chen mo yis: ma mo thams cad dbang sdus pho nya bzlog: ye shes khyung chen zil gnon chen po yis: (43na)khyung rnams dbang sdus klu yi pho nya bzlog: pho rgyud zil gnon khro bo chen po yis: srid pa pho rgyud dbang sdus pho nya bzlog mo rgyud zil gnon khro bo chen mo yis: srid pa mo rgyud dbang sdus pho nya bzlog klu rnams dbang sdud khro bo chen po yis klu rnams dbang sdus sa bdag klu srin bzlog: gza' rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i khro bo yis gza' rnams dbang sdus gza' bdud ming sring bzlog zil gnon khro mo chen mo mi pham mas ye shes lha mo dbang sdus pho nya bzlog zil gnon khro mo chen mo ral gcig mas: ye shes khro mo dbang sdus pho nya bzlog zil gnon khro mo chen mo za byed mas: ye shes ma mo dbang sdus pho nya bzlog: zil gnon khro mo chen mo khro gnyer mas:klu mo rnams kyi pho nya bzlog tu gsol: thil gnon khro mo rdo rje las byed mas shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya bzlog: zil gnon khro mo gshin rje las byed mas lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol zil gnon khro mo klu mo las byed mas klu rnams dbang sdus pho lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog zil gnon khro mo gnod sbyin las byed mas gnod sbyin gdon rnams dbang sdus pho nya bzlog shar gyi sgo bas dam nyams snying nas drongs shar gyi gdon tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur lho yi sgo bas dgra bgegs yan lag chings lho yi gdon tsho gos bzlog cing dgra la sgyur:nub kyi sgo bas dgra bgegs dbang po sdoms nub kyi gdon tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur byang gi sgo bas dgra (43ba〉bgegs srog lus choms byang gi gdon tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur bka' yi bstan srung kham rgya dmus long dang : dpal gyi khyi spyang me 'brug rlung 'brug rnams dgra bgegs 'di yi sha khrag glo snying rol gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol //dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig ma hā me sa khā hi ma hā 424

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganarak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ska : khya khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta 'a hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur skor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yos gdab/ bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya rgya/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs las/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ga bzlog bh+yo: zhes gsungs pa sbyar/de nas phur pa 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: lha/ khro mchog rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal: rigs kyi khro rgyal thams cad dbang sdus la: dam nyams dgra bgegs gzugs phung rnam shes rol: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcu: kun nas gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog: yum chen khro mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mas 'khor ba'i rgyun chod skye med rgya yis thod: dam nyams dgra bgegs bkrag la da rol la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab shar gyi sras (44nasgo chog badz+ra ki lā yas: dam nyamasadagra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad zhi bas bzlog: lho nas srasamachog rat+na gī lā yas dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: lho yi dgra bgegs thamasacad rgyas pas bzlog nub phyogs sras mchog pad+ma gī lwa yas: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: nub kyi dgra bgegs thams cad dbang gis bzlog byang gi sras mchog gan gī lā yas dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la byang gi dgra bgegs thams cad drag posabazlog rnam par rgyal bas dgra sha 'di rol la: dri za'i dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur dbyug pa sngon pos dgra sha 'di rol la: drang srong dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur: gshin rje gshed pos dgra sha 'di rol la gshin rje'i dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur mi g.yo mgon pos dgra sha 'di rol la srin po'i dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur rta mgrin rgyal pos dgra sha 'di rol la klu yi dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur gzhan gyis mi thub dgra sha 'di rol la rlung lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur bdud rtsi 'khyil pas dgra sha 'di rol la —423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geganod sbyin dmag tsho gos bzlog cing dgra la sgyur khams gsum rnam rgyal dgra sha 'di rol la dbang ldan dmag tsho gos bzlog cing dgra la sgyur / chen rgyal pos dgra sha 'di rol la: tshangs pa'i dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur stobs (44ba thi zha rgyal pos dgra sha 'di rol la sa bdag dmag tshogs bzlog cing dgra la sgyur: rdo rje snyems mas dgra yi khrag la rol: shar gyi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog: rdo rje sder mos dgra yi khrag la rol: shar lho mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog dur khrod bdag mos dgra yi khrag la rol: lho yi phyogs kyi dgra bgegasasgrol zhing bzlog: rdo rje gtun khung dgra yi khrag la rol: lho nub mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog: rdo rje gtum mos dgra yi khrag la rol nub kyi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog:rdo rje mda' snyems dgra yi khrag la rol: nub byang mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog: rdo rje rlung 'byin dgra yi khrag la rol byang gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog rdo rje gsod byed dgra yi khrag la rol byang shar mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog rdo rje sgra 'byin dgra yi khrag la rol steng gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog rdo rje skul byed dgra yi khrag la rol:'og gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog rdo rje phra men stag gi mgo bo can ti ra thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa 'phrin las shar gyi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol rdo rje phra men g.yag gi mgo bo can rgyu ma thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni khro bo'i bka' (45na tha zhin rang gi las byed pa 'phrin las shar lho'i dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol rdo rje phra men sha ba'i mgo bo can zhing chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa 'phrin las lho yi dgra bgegasabazlog tu gsol rdo rje phra men gzig gi mgo bo can tsit+ta thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa 'phrin las lho —426

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnanub dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men byi la'i mgo bo can klad khrag thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa 'phrin las nub phyogs dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol:rdo rje phra men spyang zhi'i mgo bo can: sha chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: 'phrin las nub byang dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men seng ge'i mgo bo can: zhing chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogasanas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: 'phrin las byang gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men dom gyi mgo bo can: rkang gzug thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: (45bsko khyen lasabyang shar dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol rdo rje pha men phag gi mgo bo can lag gzug thogs nasaza zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa 'phrin las steng gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men dred kyi mgo bo can:lhu gzug thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa 'phrin las 'og gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol phra men bya rgod mgo can mgyogs pa'i gzugs shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad sbyar zhing bzlog phra men bya rog mgo can rig pa'i sku shar lho'i dgra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men 'ug pa'i mgo can shes rab can lho phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men khā da'i mgo can sgrib shing can lho nub dgra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men pu shud mgo can mig tshil can nub phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men mgyogs ma khra yi mgo bo can nub byang dgra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men pha wang mgo can thabs la mkhas byang gi dgra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men gsod byed sre mo'i mgo bo can byang shar —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'dagra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men rmigs bu'i mgo can sal spyod steng phyogs dgra bgegs (46na)thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog phra men sgrol byed byi la'i mgo bo can/ 'og phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad sgyur zhing bzlog shar gyi sgo ba pu shud mgo bo can shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur du gsol: lho yi sgo ba skye kha'i mgo bo can: lho phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur du gsol: nub kyi sgo ma srin bya'i mgo bo can nub kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur du gsol: byang gi sgo ba khra yi mgo bo can byang gi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur du gsol bka' yi bstan srung ma mo bcu gnyis kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la dpal gyi bka' bzhin las kyi dgra bgegs sgrol: bse lcags dung gsum gyang chen ging la sogs: bka' yi bstan srung pho bdud bcu gnyis kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: dpal gyi bka' bzhin las kyi dgra bgegs sgrol: ྅ gru gsum ljang nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas phur pa 'phrin las lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig ma hā paṃ sa khā sti ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ka : t+ya khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta 'a hi/ma hā go ro tsa na ji hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu 'a hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur skor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yos gdab bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya rgya/ bka' brgyad yongasardzogs las/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad (46bgi don bar chad rbod zor ltas ngan bzlog bh+yo: zhes gsungs pa sbyar/de nas ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni // bcom ldan dpal chen bla med he ru ga srid pa'i ma mo thams cad zil gyis gnon dam nyams dgra bgegs rnam shes da rol la ma mo mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog gsang ba'i yum chen kun tu bzang mo ni ma mo thams cad dbang sdus dgra sems rol srid pa ma mo'i gdug rtsub dgra la bzlog rtag pa'i rgyal mo ma mo rnam snang gsal dam nyams dgra bgegs sha la da rol la rdo rje 428

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganamakha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog rtag pa'i rgyal mo ma mo 'od gsal 'bar dam nyams dgra bgegs drod la da rol la: rin cen mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog: rtag pa'i rgyal mo ma mo gnyen gsal ma dam nyams dgra bgegs khrag la da rol la: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog rtag pa'i rgyal mo ma mo yang gsal g.yos: dam nyams dgra bgegs dbugs la da rol la las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog rtag pa'i rgyal mo ma mo bkrag gsal mnyam: dam nyams dgra bgegs bkrag la da rol la: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog srid pa bde 'gro khams gsum yum mchog ma phra men rgya mtsho chen mo gsang ba'i yum snang srid lha 'dre'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog: dpag bsam shing gi yal (47na)ga chen po la: ma gcig nyi zla stong gi thod 'phreng can srid pa'i gza' skar dmag dpung dgra la bzlog: rdo rje nyi ma khros pa'i dbang mo che: khams gsum ma lus thams cad gsal mdzad ma: bzlog cig rdo rje rigs kyi pho nyas bzlog: khams gsum 'tsho byed khros pa'i dbang mo che: khams gsum thams cad gsal bar sbyor mdzad ma bzlog cig rin cen rigs kyi pho nyas bzlog pad+ma khrag 'thung khros pa'i dbang mo che khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdu mdzad ma bzlog cig pad+ma rigs kyi pho nyas bzlog srid pa bde sbyor khros pa'i dbang mo che srid pa gsum po thams cad bde la 'khod bzlog cig las kyi rigs kyi pho nyas bzlog snang srid kun gyis rgyan mdzad rgyan gyis brgyan rgyal khams yongs la dbang sgyur mthu mo che rgyan dang sho rde khram kha dgu la sgyur bzlog sgyur byed pa'i bdag nyid chen mo ni bzlog sgyur byed cing bdag nyid lhag lhag bzhad( rgod pa'i stobs kyis bzlog cing sgyur du gsol dbyings nas dbyings phyug rgyal mo chen mo yis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par sbyor dbyings nas bzlog bsgyur chen mo mdzad du gsol khams gsum kun tu rgyug cing 'gro ba mo gcig pu yum mchog rgyal mo chen mo yis mi mthun dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i dus la bab shar gyi phyogs nas dkar mo spyan gcig ma dam nyams dgra yi rus pa 'di rol la (47ba 〉 zhar gyi 429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pophyogs kyi dgra bgegs ma lus bzlog: lho yi phyogs nas nag mo mche ba can dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la lho yi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs ma lus bzlog: nub kyi phyogs nasadamar mo dbang sdud ma dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag da rol la nub kyi phyogs kyi dgra bgegasam lus bzlog byang gi phyogs nas ser mo rkang bldag ma dam nyams dgra bgegs dbugs la da rol la byang gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs ma lus bzlog srid pa gsum po bh+yo bzlog byed pa mo:srid pa chags byed ma mo chen mo yis dam nyams dgra bgegs lte bar da rol la: srid pa lha 'dre'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog srid pa cha snyoms ma mo chen mo ni: srid pa gsum po bskos la 'debasapa mo: dam nyams dgra bo'i pho bar da rol la srid gsum gdug pa'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol:rnal 'byor dgra lha tsa ti ral gcig ma rnal 'byor las kyi dgra bgegs ma lus bzlog bstan srung las byed e ka dzā khyi ma bstan pa'i ru dra thams cad dgra la bzlog bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam gcig ma mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chod la bdud dang gshin rje'i cho 'phrul dgra la bzlog mdog bzang nag mo grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma nag mo'i tsho gis kyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog mdog bzang sngon mo lha mo rnal 'byor ma: sngon mo'i tshogs kyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog mdog bzang dkar (48na yas gling bzhi spyi 'gro ma dkar mo'i tshogs gis dmag dpung dgra la bzlog /mdog bzang srin mo rin cen las byed ma srin mo'i tshogs kyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog dbu brgyan spyan stong ldan pa'i gar dbang ma stong phrag brgyad cu'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog pad+ma gar dbang sa bdag pad ma 'phreng : sa bdag gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog shar gyi ma mo dkar mo mche gtsigs ma dkar mo 'bum sde'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog lho yi nag mo chen mo kha 'phyung ma nag mo 'bum sde'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog nub kyi dmar mo chen mo mchu 'jib ma dmar mo 'bum sde'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog byang gi ser mo chen mo rkang bldag ma ser mo 'bum sde'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog har ting dkar mo byang shar gru 'degs—430

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganam byang shar gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog dun ting nag mo shar lho gru 'degs ma: shar lho gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog: shan ting dmar mo lho nub gru 'degs ma: lho nub gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog grum ting ser mo nub byang gru 'degs ma nub byang gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la bzlog rgya mtsho chen po rab mas dkyil 'khor nas dpal ldan shugs 'gro drug cus dgra bgegs bzlog khro gtum rngams pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: mdzes tshul 'gro byed rnams kyis dgra bgegs bzlog nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas bdud bgegs kun 'dul (48ba)ma yi dgra bgegs bzlog: dbang phyug chen po rngams pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:lcags kyu 'phro 'du ma yis dgra bgegs bzlog: gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha yi sring mo ste: lha chen ma hā de ba'i bka' sgyur la: lha yi chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog: mkha' la khyung lding gshin rje'i sring mo ste: gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' sgyur la gshin rje'i chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog:dmar mo g.yag thod klu yi sring mo ste: klu rgyal 'jog po chen po'i bka' sgyur la klu yi chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog nag mo sder chen gnod sbyin sring mo ste: gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po'i bka' sgyur la gnod sbyin chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog: dkar mo chen mo dbu dgu rgyal po'i srid shar phyogs shing chen srog bdag bka' sgyur la: brgyal nad spyo 'bog dam nyams dgra la thong : mtsho sman rgyal mo chen mo dpal mo ldan sa bdag gnyan gyi gdon tshogs bka' sgyur la: mdze nad sna dgu dam nyams dgra la thod srid pa'i bu mo las mkhan mthu mo che: the'u rang hal po che yi bka' sgyur la rims nad yams nad dam nyams dgra la thod dur khrod gnas pa'i ma mo tsa mun myibatsan rgod yams shud dmar po'i bka' sgyur la mkhris pa sha ya dam nyams dgra la thod semasacan bskyed pa'i ma mo rnam pa bzhi: lus las bskyed pa'i bu mo rnam pa bzhi dam la gnas pa'i sring mo rnam pa bzhi yid la zhugs pa mdza' mo rnam pa bzhi bdud rtsi bsgrub (49na)pa'i rgyal mo rnam pa bzhi phur bu bsgrub pa'i blon po rnam pa bzhi ma mo kun gyi gtso mo rnam pa bzhi ma mo thun gyi —431 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobadag mo rnam pa bzhi las la gshin pa'i bran mo rnam pa bzhi dgra bo'i snying rtsa 'phrog pa'i lha mo bzhi: srid pa'i ma mo'i bka' srung las byed ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag slo snying dang :dbang po nang khrol rnams la da rol la: srid pa ma mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog // sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: ma ma rbod gtong lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig ma hā me sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ma hā ke : kyi khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta ji hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu ji hi/ ma hā ba su ta ji hi/ zhesadamar sbreng / phur skor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yos gdab/ bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya rgya/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs las/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ༅ bzlog bh+yo:de nas rigs 'dzin slob dpon gyi lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: ྅/ che mchog yon to rigs 'dzin chen po rnams yon to gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la:dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: yang dag thugs kyi rigs 'dzin chen po rnams thugs kyi gnas nas sku bzhedas 'dir gshegs la dgra bgegs (49ba〉bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: 'jam dpal sku yi rigs 'dzin chen po rnams sku yi gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod pad+ma gsung gi rigs 'dzin chen po rnams: gsung gi gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: phur pa 'phrin las rigs 'dzin chen po rnams: 'phrin las gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: ma mo thod gtong rigs 'dzin wo po rnams: thod gtong gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: lhun gyis grub pa'i rigs 'dzin chen po rnams: lhun grub gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur —432

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnaba'i 'phrin las mdzod: phyag rgya chen po'i rigs 'dzin chen po rnams: phyag rgya'i gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: sal gnas pa'i rigs 'dzin chen po rnams: rigs 'dzin gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: tshe la dbang pa'i rigs 'dzin chen po rnams:rang bzhin gnas nas sku bzhedas 'dir gshegs la: dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: rigs 'dzin bka' srung dpa' bo dpa' mo'i (50na spros gas: dur khrod gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dgra bgegs bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: ྅/ thugs rje gdung 'tshob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: rigs 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā me sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ska : tu khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta ji hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na ji hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu ji hi/ ma hā ba su ta 'a hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur skor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yos gdab/ bcol dam bya'o/ /rgya rgya rgya/ yongs rdzogs gtor bzlog drag po las/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ngan bzlog bh+yo:de nas 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: ྅/bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs phung po 'di la rol:dregs pa pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: yum chen khro mo khams gsum spyi 'dul ma dam nyamasadagra bgegs skye mched 'di la rol: dregs pa pho mo'i bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog dbang phyug ma hā de ba btsun mor bcas: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: lha srin sde brgyad bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog gshin rje'i sde dpon ya ma rā tsa khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol:gshin rje (50ba)yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: yum chen sgrol byed nag mo chen mo yis: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: gshin rje mo yi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: ma mo'i sge—433—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedapon srid pa'i rgyal mo ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol ma mo yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: sngags srung sdod pon e ka dzā khyi ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: nag mo yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: bdud kyi sde dpon bskos rje brang dkar ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol bdud po yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog bdud mo'i sdod pon nag mo re ma gyi dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol bdud mo yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: rgyal po'i sde dpon pe har dgra lha ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: rgyal po yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog ging gi sdod pon srog bdag tshangs pa ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol ging chen yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: dgra lha'i sde dpon sku lha gsang ba ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: dgra lha yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog gza' yi sde dpon gza' bdud rā hu la dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol gza' bdud yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog srin po'i sdod pon nag po glog 'phreng can: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol srin po yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog:(51na)srin mo'i sde dpon sbal mgo khrag mig ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la:srin mo yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: gnod sbyin sde dpon ya ka me dbal ni dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol gnod sbyin yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog gnod sbyin mo yi sde dpon mon mo nag mo ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol gnod sbyin mo yi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: mgon po'i sdod pon ma hā kā la ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: mgon po yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog ru dra'i sdod pon rdo rje bdud 'dul te:dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: ru dra yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog dmu bdud sdod pon nag po bkrag med de dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol dmu bdud yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog mu stegs sdod pon gu lang nag po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag —434

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gda'adi la rol mu stegs yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: lha yi sde dpon lha rabs she bhu ste dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol lha rnams yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: gnam sman sde dpon thog gi bu yug ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: gnam sman yongasakyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog ma sangs sde dpon spyi bdud gu rum rtse dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: ma sangs yongs kyi bka' (51ba tshe snar dgra la bzlog brag btsan sdod pon srog zan dmar po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: brag btsan yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog the'u rang sde dpon gnam the dkar po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol the'u rang yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: 'gong po'i sde dpon btsan 'gong yam shud dmar dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: btsan 'gong yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog bgegs kyi sde dpon byi na ya ka ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol:bgegs rnams yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog: mkha' 'gro'i sde dpon nag mo mgyogs byed ma dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: mkha' 'gro yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog:klu yi sde dpon klu bdud mgo dgu ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol klu bdud yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog klu mo'i sdod pon ya ka nag mo ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol klu mo yongs kyi bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog bka' yi bstan srung lha srin sdo brgyad rnams dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di la rol: lha srin sde brgyad bka' sgyur dgra la bzlog hūṃ/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig ma hā mo sa 'a hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ke : (52na/t+ya khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na sa hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu ji hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur bskor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yos gdab/ bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya rgya/ yongs rdzogs gto me bzlog drag po las/ dus—435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pomin 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar ho thod zor ltas ngan bzlog bh+yo:de nas dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tsho gos la bzlog pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni: ྅/ lha mchog stobs ldan nag po chen po ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs rnam shes 'di la rol dregs pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad gzir zhing bzlog: yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung ba'i lus 'di rol: dregs pa'i tshogs rnams dbang du bsdus shing bzlog: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dregs pa nag po khyod dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la: gshin rje rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i btsun mo srog bdag mo dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la: gshin rje mo rnams dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog ka la yas mu stegs sngags kyi bdag dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la mu stegs rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog bdud po me yi kha rlangs bdud sngags bdag dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la bdud pho rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog bdud mo'i sngags bdag nag mo khrag 'dzag ma dam nyams dgra (52ba tha gegs snying la da rol la: bdud mo yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog ru dra'i sngags bdag thar pa nag po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la ru dra rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog nag po gsod byed srin po dmod pa'i bdag dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la srin po rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog srin mo'i sngags bdag nag mo gsod byed ma dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la srin mo rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog gza' yi sngags bdag gza' bdud rā hu la dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la gza' bdud rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog gang ba bzang po gnod sbyin sngags kyi bdag dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la: gnod sbyin rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog gnod sbyin mo yi sngags bdag sha za ral gcig ma dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la gnod sbyin mo yi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog ma hā de ba lha yi dmod pa'i bdag —436

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (ga)dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la: lha rnams kun gyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog rgyal po'i sngags bdag li byin ha ra ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la: rgyal po rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog btsun gyi sngags bdag yam shud dmar po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la btsan 'gong rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog: dmu yi sngags bdag dmu rje btsan po ste: (53na rkom nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la: dmu bdud rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog 'gong po'i sngags bdag khu le lag dgu ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la 'gong po rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog: the'u rang sngags bdag rdo rje legs pa ste:dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la: the'u rang rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog : gzhen nu gtum po klu yi sngags bdag ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la da rol la klu rnams yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa: bshan pa dbang chen lha srin sdebargyad kyang : dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da rol la: so so'i dmod pa'i mtshon cha dgra la bzlog 〉/ gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig ma hā rma sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ke: tu khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu khā ha/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur bskor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/bh+yos gdab/ bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya rgya/ yongs rdzogs gtor bzlog drag po las/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ༅ bzlog bh+yo: zhes gsungs pa sbyar bar bya/de nas dpal gyi bka' bstod la bzlog pa'i (53ba〉thun las bcol ba ni: ྅/ dkar mo chen mo zhi ba'i las byed bdun ser mo chen mo rgyas pa'i las byed bdun: dmar mo chen mo dbang gi las byed bdun ljang mo chen mo drag po'i las byed bdun dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang :dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: lha chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad gdug rtsub bzlog: rdo rje —437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2porigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la shar phyogs dri za'i tsho gis kyi bka' sgyur la: dri za'i chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog: rin cen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la lho phyogs gshin rje'i tsho gis kyi bka' sgyur la: gshin rje'i chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: nub phyogs klu yi tshogs kyi bka' sgyur la:klu yi chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la byang phyogs gnod skyen tsho gis kyi bka' sgyur la: gnod sbyin chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog: 'bar ma gnod sbyin chen mo brgyad rnams kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la lha srin sde brgyad tsho gos kyi bka' sgyur la sdebargyad chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog ging dang lang ka chung mar bcas pa rnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la dur khrod bdag mo (54na sgoms kyi bka' sgyur la: srin po pho mo'i chad pa dgra la bzlog sa bdag bdud 'dul chen mo rnam pa brgyad dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la:bdud sna ring po rnams kyi bka' sgyur la bdud kyi chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog sa bdag gza' 'dul chen mo rnam pa brgyad dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la gza' rgod mig dmar chen po'i bka' sgyur la gza' yi chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog sa bdag btsan 'dul chen po rnam pa brgyad dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la zla ba thod dkar zhes bya'i bka' sgyur la btsan gyi chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog sa bdag klu 'dul chen po rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la klu rgyal 'jog po zhes bya'i bka' sgyur la:klu yi chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog rigs bzhi pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi yang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la rigs pa'i pho lha'i tshogs kyi bka' sgyur la rigs bzhi pho nya'i chad pa dgra la bzlog sa bdag chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di —438

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganarol la: phyogs bzhi'i dam sri rnams kyi bka' sgyur la grong rje dkar nag chad pa dgra la bzlog:pho nya 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la snang srid mkha' 'gro yongs kyi bka' sgyur la mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dam nyams dgra la bzlog: bod khams skyong (54ba tha'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la:ma yams nag mo 'bum gyi bka' sgyur la rims nad yams nad thams cad dgra la bzlog: ྅/dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams khor yug nas ci bgyi bka' nyan lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas:dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams khrung po 'di la da rol cig ma hā me sa hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā na: t+ya khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā tsak+ṣu ji hi/ ma hā ba su ta 'a hi/ zhes dmar sbreng / phur bskor bya/ nya bo bsgral/ stob pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ bh+yos gdab/bcol dam bya'o: rgya rgya rgya/ yongs rdzogs gtore bzlog drag po las/ bskul byang kun gyi sham bur dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa nad gdon bar chad thod zor ltas ga bzlog bh+yo: zhes gsungs pa sbyar/sngags bzlog chen mo 'di gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar dkyil 'khor/ mchod rten/ 'brub khung / phur pa sogs la brten nas gzhung btsugs pa'i sgrub pa byas te khro rol gyi gtor bzlog 'di'i cha lag tu 'gro ba 'dra zhig 'dug na'ang snga 'gyur gyi bla ma gong ma mkhas grub tshad ldan mang pos khro rol la sngags bzlog sbyor ba mdzad cing khyad par rtsod dus rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rje 'bri gung zur pa yang phyag len de ltar mdzad pas bka' re re bzhin gyi sngags bzlog gi mthar sngags sgrub nas bshad pa'i so so'i sham bu rnams btags te bzla dmigs pa sngags bzlog gi gzhung bzhin nyams su len/ (55na〉yong med pa'am mdor bsdus kyi tshe man ngag gab pa don snying du bde gshegs spyi dril gyi drag sngags brgyad cu pa sham bu bsgyur ba ni: chu āḥ& swā hā rlu hrī:/ āḥ.ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kro ta hūṃ shrī he ru ga ya mān+ta ka phyi pad+man+ta sku ta/ hūṃ badz+ra kyi li gī lā ya/ ma hā ya ka kā la rū pa/ yak+ṣa kro ta/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sgyu dug e dza bh+yo: khro ga ru ḍa ma ma kro ti shwa rī rkarma raṃ raṃ/ dz+wa la raṃ raṃ/—439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedam sri dang / byad kha dang / phur kha rbod gtong / rbad 'dre thams cad phyir bzlog bzlog sam ya/bzlog bzlog /bh+yo bh+yo/ ces thun la sngags shing brab bo: de nas dmar gtor gyi lcags rir btsugs pa'i las bzhi'i rtsad phur la dmigs te 'di skad do: / lha/ dpal chen khro rgyal che mchog he ru ga'i drag po dpal gyi gtor chen lcags ri la: sprul pa'i pho nya mang po mngags pa'i rten dmar nag rtsang phur zur gsum pa bsnol thabs srin mo 'gros su btsugs pa ni: nyen mongs gdug pa ma lusa'adul ba'i rtags: sprul pa'i phyag brnyan rtags kyi phyag rgya gsal: gdug pa'i rtsang phur zur gsum rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mos chos nyid dbyings su 'bigs mar gyi rtse mos ga song gnas su 'bigs rked pa rgya mdud pho nya 'byung ba'i gnas yar gyi rtse mos lhag mthong yul la 'jug mar gyi rtse mos rgyud drug gnas su zug rked pa rgya mdud khams gsum don dang ldan: stod kyi rtse mo zur gsum gdug pa'i me stag 'bar (55bskyod kyi rtse las gdug pa'i me 'od 'phro: skad pa rgya mdud mtshon cha'i gur du phub yar gyi rtse mos re gyi thog ser 'bebs mar gyi rtse las mtshone cha'i bu yug 'tshub: ned pa rgya mdud lha yi pho brang bcas dmar nag rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs rtsang phur rngam stabs khrigs rtse khrig rtsang phur sha za 'jibs rtse 'jib rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyur ru sa rtsang phur rus 'cha' chems rtse chem: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi thugs dam dus la bab bar chod sol la rkyen rnams bzlog dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du rlog bzlog cing dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog sam ya byad dang rigs sngags bzlog // bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru gas 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kun: skad cig nyid la zhi mdzad de thugs rje zhi ba'i 'phrin las kyis gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma yi rigs sngags rbod gtong zhi bar mdzod zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la zhi ba'i rtsang phur zur gsum rtse mo gnyis dang ldan rked pa rgya mdud zlum po gzhal yas khang : lha ru ka yi skur bsgomasapas dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha za ba shar phyogs gtore chen lcags ri la btsugs pas thams—440

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnacad zhi bar 'gyur zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med gnod byed dgra bgegs bar chod dang : rigasasngags rbod gtong byad stems rnams zhi mdzad bcom ldan he ru gas zhi (56na thar mdzod: zho badz+rashrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: zhi bar gyur cig shān+ti ku ru ye swā lha zhi mdzad rno dbal rtsang phur gyis yar gyi rtse la dung gi seng ge 'gying : sprul pa'i seng ges nam mkha' gang : g.yu ral sngon po sprin ltar gtibs seng ge'i ngar skad lhabs se lhab mar gyi rtse las chu srin mche ba gtsigs: sprul pa'i chu srin bsam mi khyab zhal gdangs mche gtsigs rkan sgra brdab rked pa rgya mdud me 'brug rlung 'brug rgyug sprul pa 'brug gis bar snang gang : 'brug sgra chem chem glog mo 'gyur zhi byed rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs: rtsang phur rngam stabs khrabs se khrab: rtsang phur gar stabs khrigs se khrig rtsang phur sha za 'jibs se 'jib: rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyur ru sa rtsang phur rus 'cha' chems se chem:las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bar chod sol la rgyan rnams bzlog dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du rlog bzlog cing dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog: gsod cig dgra bgegs dmag dpung gsod bzlog cig rigs sngags byad stems bzlog: sam ya: byad ma rigs sngags bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog lha/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru gas 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kun skad cig nyid la rgyas mdzod cig tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i 'phrin las kyis bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod rgyas(56ba)par ma gyur gang yang med gser ram ser po'i shing rnams la rgyas pa'i rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs rked pa rgya mdud gru bzhi gzhal yas khang : he ru ka yi skur bsgoms te: dgra bgegasabyad ma'i sha za ba lho phyogs gtor chen lcags ri la: btsugs pas thams cad rgyas par 'gyur:rgyas par ma gyur gang yang med bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas rgyas mdzad he ru gas rgyas par mdzod zho rat+na shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa thams cad rgyas par gyur cig: punyu ku ru ye swā —441

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po1 rgyas mdzad rno dbal rtsang phur gyi yar gyi rtse la mtshal stag dmar po mchod: stag mchod 'dzum mdangs shigs se shig mar gyi rtse la phag rgod mche ba gtsigs: phag rgod ngur sgra 'ur ru sa rked pa rgya mdud dred mo ral pa gsigs: dred mo'i ral pa yengs se yeng : rgyas mdzad rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs: rtsang phur rngam stabs khrigs se khrig: rtsang phur sha za 'jigs rtse 'jig: rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyur ru sa rtsang phur rus 'cha' chems se chem: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi thugs dam dus la bab bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi bar chod sol la rkyen rnams bzlog dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du rlog: bzlog cig dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog: gsod cig dgra (57na tha gegs byad ma gsod: bzlog cig rigs sngags byad stems bzlog: sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo/bzlog bzlog /hūṃ/ dpal chen che mchog he ru gas: 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kun: skad cig nyid la dbang du sdud: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog rgyal blon rje 'bangs tsā bcud sogs:khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med zangs sam dmar po'i shing rnams la dbang gi rtsang bur zur gsum rtse mo gnyis dang ldan rked pa rgya mdud zla gam gzhal yas khang : he ru ka yi skur bsgoms pas dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha la za nub phyogs gtore chen lcags ri la btsugs pas thams cad dbang du sdud dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rnams dbang mdzad he ru ka dpal gyi dbang du sdus tshwa pad+ma shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: rgyal blon rje 'bangs 'bru bcud thams cad dbang du sdus shig ba shaṃ ku ru ye swā lha dbang mdzad rno dbal rtsang phur gyi yar gyi rtse la gser gyi gzig mo ngur gzig chen nyer sgra 'ur ru phumar gyi rtse la dom nag mche ba gtsigs dom chen mche ba thabs se thab rked pa rgya mdud g.yu yi spyang mo
