ngur: g.yu spyang ngu 'bod lhangs se lhang : dbang gi rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs rtsang phur rngam stabs khrabs se khrab rtsang phur gar stabs khrigs se khrig rtsang phur sha za 'jibs se 'jib: rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyur ru su rtsang phur rus 'chang chems se chem: las(57bsgo khan pho —442

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogananya rnams kyi thugs dam dus la bab bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi bar chod rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du rlog bzlog cig dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog:gsod cig dgra bo byad ma gsod bzlog cig rigs sngags byad stems bzlog sam ya/ bh+yo bh+yo/bzlog bzlog /hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru gas: 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kun: skad cig nyid la brlag par mdzod: sdig can dgra bo byad ma 'di mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las sa thams cad ma lus brlag par byed brlag par ma gyur gang yang med: lcags sam drag po'i shing rnams la: drag po'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan rked pa rgya mdud zur gsum gzhal yas khang : he ru ka yi skur bsgoms pas: dgra bo byad ma'i sha za ba byang phyogs gtor chen lcagasari la: btsugs pas dgra bgegs brlag par byed: brlag par ma gyur gang yang med brlag mdzad he ru gas brlag par mdzod: zho na dze hri he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: dgra bgegs byad ma brlag par mdzod: mā ra ya phaṭa: drag po las kyi rtsang phur 'di yar gyi rtse la bya glag mang po 'dzum bya glag 'dzum chung cungs rtse cung : mar gyi rtse la lcags kyi pho rog 'gyed pho rog 'gyed sgra khrabs rtse khrab: ned pa rgya mdud gser gyi 'ug pa 'khun 'ug pa hūṃ sgra dir ri ri gser mig 'khyil ba kyil li li: gdug pa drag po'i rtsang phur 'di dmar nag srin mo 'gros su (58na)btsugs gsod byed rngam stabasakhrabs se khrab rtsang phur gar stabs khrigs se khrig rtsang phur sha za 'jibs rtse 'jib rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyur ru sa rtsang phur rus 'cha' chems rtse chem: rtsang phur rno dbal zangs rtse zang : lasamakhan pho nya rnams kyi thugs dam dus la bab bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi bar chod sol la rkyen rnams bzlog dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du rlog bzlog cig dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog gsod cig dgra bgegs(byad ma gsod rigs sngags byad ste ma ba(bzlog tu gsol sam ya snro bh+yo/ bzlog bzlog /gdug rtsub drag po'i rtsang phur 'di yar gyi rtse mo gdug la rtsub mar gyi rtse mo dpal dang ldan rked pa rgya mdud du las grub zur gsum sku gsung thugs su grub ngos gsum —443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2porigs gsum ngo bor brdungs rked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang du brdungs: yar gyi rtse mo dar dang ldan: mar gyi rtse mo dpal dang ldan: gdug rtsub drag po'i rtsang phur 'di byad ma gsod pa'i mtshon char brdungs dbang drag rtsang phur yar rtse la: lcags kyi ser ba khral la la: dbang drag rtsang phur mar rtse la: mtshal gyi khu 'phang shar ra ra rked pa rgya mdud zur gsum la: khrag gi char pa sil li li:rno dbal zur gsum yar rtse na g.yu yi dud 'thul phyur ru sa rno dbal zur gsum mar rtse na:sol ba'i mtsho 'khyil mer re re rked pa rgya mdud zur gsum la zangs kyi me 'bar yal la la:dbang drag las kyi rtsang phur (58ba/sna di dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la gdab: chos skyong pho nya'i rten du 'dzugs rtsang phur yar gyi rtse mo na las mkhan tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs rtsang phur mar gyi rtse mo na: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sa gzhi gang : rtsang phur rgya mdud zur gsum la: ྅ phaṭa 'brug sgras stong gsum khengs dmar nag rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs rtsang phur rngam stabs khrabs se khrab: rtsang phur gar stabs khrigs rtse khrig rtsang phur sha za 'jibs se 'jib rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyur ru sa rtsang phur rus wo' chems rtse chem: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi thugasadam dus la bab bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi bar chod sol la rkyen rnams bzlog dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du rlog bzlog ces dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog: gsod cig dgra bgegs byad ma gsod: rig sngags thod gtong thams cad bzlog: sam ya/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bzlog bzlog /de ltar mnga' gsol mchod pa yis da ni bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod bzlog cig mgon po'i mthu byad bzlog: gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog mgon po'i sbyin sreg byed pa bzlog ma mo'i thun zor 'phen pa bzlog yungs rkar khro po'i rbab zor bzlog byad ma lha dang bcas pa bzlog brnye yongs kyi sngags zor bzlog dge slong 'char ga'i par bu bzlog klu bdud nag po'i gtad khram bzlog zhang zhung btso dmar 'phen pa bzlog bon po yongs kyi lta byad bzlog mu stegs ngan sngags thams cad bzlog ma mo'i ngan (59na༄gas dmod pa bzlog rgya gar chos kyi mthu byad —444

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganabazlog drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba bzlog phra men ma yi ga byed bzlog sum pas glang dmar rmo ba bzlog bod kyi rbod bya gtad byed bzlog bram zes ga sngags dmod pa bzlog: dri zas myosashing 'thibs pa bzlog rgyal pos spyo 'bog gtong ba bzlog srin mos shod kha gtong ba bzlog klu yis byad du bcug pa bzlog: bdud kyis khram la btab pa bzlog: btsun gyis zhags pa 'phen pa bzlog gnod sbyin rtsis la 'debs pa bzlog 'byung pos myul le byed pa bzlog tshe zor yungasazor 'phen pa bzlog the'u rang sri la brku ba bzlog slo bur ye 'byog byed pa bzlog 'byung posagod 'dre byed pa bzlog bse rags bsris la brku ba bzlog pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre bzlog ma tshan nang gi stong 'dre bzlog bdud btsan yongs kyi rims nad bzlog nad dang mtshon gyi dru bu bzlog rims nad gag lhog gzer gsum bzlog mi nad yongs dgu thams cad bzlog yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog: mas kyi sri ru langs pa bzlog: pha khu'i sri can langs pa bzlog: ma sru'i sgab 'dre byung ba bzlog byis pa'i chung sri langs pa bzlog gson po'i bdud du g.yos pa bzlog gshin gyi dur sri thams cad bzlog rus la tshig ngan slong ba bzlog gnag la mchin ngan 'thab pa bzlog rta nad nor nad thams cad bzlog lo dgra btsa' dang sad ser bzlog (59brdzi 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog nad rigs bzhi rgya rtsa bzhi bzlog sgeg chen sum brgya drug cu bzlog ltas ga nyis khri tshig stong bzlog bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog phyi yi bar chad phyi ru gzhil: nang gi bar chad nang du gzhil: gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su gzhil: sam ya: bh+yo bh+yo:bzlog bzlog sgyur cig:de dang 'brel bar kha bsgyur bcu gnyis dang chos tshan gcig pa'i gtor bzlog phyi nang gsang gsum las/ phyi'i gtor mas 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das par bzlog pa ni: ྅ hūṃ/ snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa yi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kun ye shes gzhal yas khang du sgyur tha mal rang dga'i 'khrul snang bzlog skye 'gro sems can thams cad kun gnyis med sangs rgyas nyid du —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gesgyur: sems can chags sdang 'khrul ba bzlog: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tsho gos kun gnyis med bde ba chen por sgyur: gnyis snang rtog pa chos skur bzlog: 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun:myang 'das bde ba chen por sgyur: chos sku skye med ngang du bzlog: nang gi gtor mas sems can sangs rgyas su bzlog pa ni: ྅/ skye 'gro'i sems can thams cad kun: lha dang lha mo'i ngang du sgyur tha mal rang rgyud 'dzin pa bzlog skyes pa zhe sdang rang bzhin la: me long ye shes ngang du sgyur gsal stong bde ba chen por bzlog bud med 'dod chags rang bzhin la kun rtog ye shesang nga du sgyur 'dzin zhen med pa'i (60na〉spyong du bzlog: skye 'gro'i sems can thams cad kun: pho ni thabasakyi rang bzhin la mo ni shes rab rang bzhin te: thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med gnyis med sangs rgyas nyid du bzlog gsang ba'i gtor mas dug lnga ye shes lngar bzlog pa ni: lha/ gti mug ma rig 'khrul pa ni: chos dbyings ye shes nyid du sgyur: ma rig zhabrul ba'i rtog pa bzlog zhe sdang brnag pa'i rtog pa ni: me long ye shes nyid du sgyur: 'gran sems ga pa'i rtog pa bzlog: nga rgyal khengs pa'i rtog pa ni: mnyam nyid ye shes nyid du sgyur dman pa khyad gsod rtog pa bzlog 'dod chags chen pa'i rtog pa ni: kun rtog ye shes nyid du sgyur: 'dzin chags med pa'i ngang du bzlog phrag dog mnar ba'i rtog pa ni: nan tan ye shes nyid du sgyur: dman semasang na la bzlog tu gsol: phung po ye shes lnga ru bzlog thabs bstan pa ni: ྅/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur pa rdo rje sems dpa ri nyid du bzlog tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur pa rin cen 'byung ldan nyid du bzlog: 'du shes phung po gnas gyur pa: snang ba mtha' yas nyid du bzlog: 'du byed phung po gnasagyur pa don yod grub pa nyid du bzlog rnam shes phung po gnas gyur pa rnam par snang mdzad nyid du bzlog 'byung ba sa yi gnas gyur pa sangs rgyas spyan ma nyid du (60ba〉zlog 'byung ba me yi gnas gyur pa yum chen gos dkar nyid du bzlog: 'byung ba chu yi gnas gyur pa yum chen mā ma gi ru bzlog: 'byung ba rlung gi gnas gyur pa : dam tshig sgrol ma nyid du bzlog 'byung ba nam mkha'i —446

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaganas gyur pa kun tu bzang po nyid du bzlog: mig gi rnam shes gnas gyur pa sems dpa' sasnying nyid du bzlog rna ba'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa sems dpa' nam snying nyid du bzlog sna yi rnam shes gnas gyur pa sems dpa' 'jam dpal nyid du bzlog: lce yi rnam shes gnas gyur pa:sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs su bzlog: lus kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa sems dpa' phyag rdor nyid du bzlog yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa: sgrib pa rnam sel nyid du bzlog: nyen mongs yid kyi gnas gyur pa: kun tu bzang po nyid du bzlog: kun gzhi'i yid kyi gnas gyur pa byams pa me tri nyid du bzlog lta byed yul gyi gnas gyur pa rdo rje sgeg mo nyid du bzlog: nyan byed yul gyi gnas gyur pa: rdo rje dbyangs can nyid du bzlog: snom byed yul gyi gnas gyur pa rdo rje bdug sposanyid du bzlog myang byed yul gyi gnas gyur pa rdo rje ni li t+ya nyid du bzlog skyong byed yul gyi gnas gyur pa rdo rje gar bsgyur nyid du bzlog: dran byed yul gyi gnas gyur pa rdo rje mar me nyid du bzlog: nyen mongs yul gyi gnas gyur pa: rdo rje dri chab nyid du bzlog: kun gzhi'i yul gyi gnas gyur pa rdo rje phreng ba ma ru bzlog lus kyi bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i phyir: (61na〉/zhin rje gshed po nyid du bzlog ngag gi bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i phyir: rta mgrin rgyal po nyid du bzlog:sems kyi bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i phyir: rnam par rgyal ba nyid du bzlog yon tan bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i phyir bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nyid du bzlog: 'chi 'pho lhung byed 'joms pa'i phyir: thub pa brgya byin nyid du bzlog: 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i phyir: thub pa thags bzang ris su bzlog mi yi skye 'chi 'joms pa'i phyir thub pa shāka thub nyid du bzlog byol song blun lkugasa'ajoms pa'i phyir: shākya seng ge nyid du bzlog yi dwags bkres sgom 'joms pa'i phyir thub pa kha 'bar nyid du bzlog: dmyal ba tsha grang 'joms pa'i phyir: chos kyi rgyal po nyid du bzlog dgra bgegs thams cad 'gugs pa'i phyir: rdo rje lcags kyu nyid du bzlog dgra bgegs thams cad bcing ba'i phyir: rdo rje zhags pa nyid du bzlog dgra bgegs thams cad sdom pa'i phyir: rdo rje —447

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2polcags sgrog nyid du bzlog dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir rdo rje dril bu nyid du bzlog ces brjod cing don bsgom de rnams kyi chog sgrigs gces pa'i lde mig tu/ bzlog dang yang bzlog khyung bzlog bya zhes gsungs pa'i dang po bzlog pa song nas/ gnyis pa yang bzlog ni: 'brug pa pad dkar sogs kyis sgra dang bstun pa'i dag cha byas te sngags chud zos su btang ba'i lugs ngan rnams dug bzhin spangs nas (61ba)yig 'bru so drug pa rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun bzhin brgya'am nyer gcig bzla gsum pa khyung bzlog ni: bya lung rgya mtshor/ da ni ltas ga byung na khyung gis bzlog pas na:dang po ye shes kyi bya khyung spyan drang ba ni: ྅/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis tshur gshegs tshun gshegasabacom ldan 'das: 'dab chags rgyal po ka ru ḍa gser mig 'khyil ba'i bya khyung dkar la khro:gnam lcags ur mo'i mchu sde 'phyar ba yis: sa bdag klu gnyan 'dar zhing 'jigs par byed:gshog pa gser gyi ral gri gdengs pa yis gnam sam lus zil gyis gnon par byed khyung ru nag po gnam du zangs se zang : g.yu yi khal khebs le brgan sprukho ga pas mdzes mthug ma g.yu yi ru mtshon phyogs bcur 'bar: rin chen sna tsho gis rdo rje'i the'u phran mdzes: 'khor lo rin cen 'bar bas dbu la brgyan: rnal 'byor bdag gis bya khyung bos pa'i tshe: spyan nas khrag gi rba klong khyil li li gshog pa g.yas pas nyi zla tsog por 'phen: gshog pa g.yon pas sa gzhi bdar sha gcod bya khyung rgyal po 'bod do snya na ma sra bya khyung rgyal po g.yab bo spyan ma rtul bya khyung rgyal po bsten no rgyang ma ring : bya khyung rgyal po bsgrub bo mthu ma chung : bya khyung rgyal po bskul lo sgab ma lci ltas ga bzlog dang las kun bsgrub pa'i phyir: ri rab rtse yi gnas mchog dam pa nas: bstan pa bsrung phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol (62na jo:྅ baṃ sngo badz+ra kā ru ḍa rā tsa sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥ zhes brjod pas bdag nyid che mchog gi dbu la bya khyung gis brgyan pa bsgom par bya'o: ྅/ khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni med du byung ba'i gtor ma'i mchod pa —448

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma 3)dang : dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa dang : sbyor sgrol rak+ta'i mchod pa wo pos mcho ne: ma hā kā ru ḍa rā tsa ba ling ta kha ri khā gi pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: gha na ta na rak+ta pā tsa me gha hūṃ/ zhesamachod pa 'bul: ྅/ 'dab chags rgyal po bcom ldan ka ru ḍa lcags sder bgrad pas tshangs pa'i yul sa gnon gshog pa brkyang bas gza' klu dbang du sdud spu gri'i mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigasapa yis klu chen brgyad po las la 'khol bar byed: mnyam zhing thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bdag nyid can: khro rgyal bdag dang dgongs pa mnyam par bzhugs: thabs dang ldan pa'i shes rab yum dang sbyor dgra bgegs gshed ma bya khyung rgyal po yis ltas ngan ma lus bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod:ces brjod la khyung zhal phyir bsgyur la bzlog pa drag tu bya ste: gzhung chen dkyus las de nas khyung gis ltas ngan bzlog pa ni: bdag nyid che mchog gsal ba'i dbu gtsug tu khyung chen 'bar bsabargyan par bsgoms la: ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang nas: // bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ga dbu ni nyer gcig phyag ni bzhi bcu gnyis phyag mtshan sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyisabasnams dur khrod mas brgyad sku la rgyan du spras: khro tshul nyi shu rtsa gcig brjid (62ba)par sprul:dbu la khyung chen 'bar bas rab tu brgyan khyung gis ral ba sprugs pa las: yul gyi ma mo bcu gsum skyong : nam mkha' smug nag tshobs pa'i byad: dred mo rang 'dzings ltas bzlog: g.yasakyi gshog ru dang po la steng gi khro bcu 'bar ba sprul seng ge 'brug sngon 'thab pa'i byad gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ltas ngan bzlog gshog ru 'bar ba gnyis pa la gsad pa'i khro bo bcu ru 'bar glang chen rba la 'phyo ba'i byad: stag seng 'dzing ba'i ltas ga bzlog: gzhog ru 'bar ba gsum pa la spyi dpal khro bcu 'bar ba sprul gnam sa sprin dmar mched pa'i byad bud med ral 'dzings ltasang na bzlog g.yas kyi gshog ru bzhi pa la: rdzogs pa chen po'i khro bcu 'bar skar mda' sa la lhung ba'i byad dbyig gi nor bu'i ltasang na bzlog g.yas kyi gshog ru lnga pa la ta kṛ khro bo bcu drug shar: ri rab me chen mched pa'i byad: lci ba'i zas kyi ltas ga bzlog g.yon gyi —449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pogazhog ru dang po la: srog rtse'i ma mo bdun du shar rgya mtsho dug sprul 'khyil ba'i byad me tog bcud nyams ltasang na bzlog g.yon gyi gshog ru gnyis pa la: e ka drag mo spun drug sprul:mkha' la stag mo 'phyo ba'i byad: rdzi bas bskyod pa'i ltas ga bzlog g.yon gyi gshog ru gsum pa la: srin mo 'bar ma bdun du shar mkha' la bya rgod sder 'dzings byed gter gyi bcud nyamasaltasang na bzlog g.yon gyi gshog ru (63na tha zhi pa la gdong ma bzhi dang rgyal mo bzhi g.yu sha rā bcu 'dzing pa'i byad seng ge ngu 'bod ltas ga bzlog g.yon gyi gzhog ru lnga pa la nyi shu rtsabargyad sprul pa byung : rno dbal ngar gyi ltas ngan dang : me bya g.yeng ba'i ltasang na bzlog g.yu sgong sngon po yar ba dang : lcags kyi ser ba 'bab pa dang : shel dkar snod du dug g.yos dang : zangasasgong dmar po 'dril ba dang : mi bzad 'bar ba klad la bskor nyi ma sprin gyis 'khrigs pa dang :'tshub ma mang po'i mig ltas dang : seng ge gangs kyi stongs nas lhung : shel gyi sgo nga yar ba dang :sprin chen yar ba'i rtags bstan dang : dbang po'i bcud chen thags pa dang : dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ltasang na bcu gsum slar la bzlog khyung gi mjug sgro brgyad po la rgyal mo bzhi dang gdong mo bzhi: sprul pa 'od kyi phreng ba shar bse sdong khra bo'i zur bstan te: lhag phran zor gyis 'debs pa dang : gza' skar 'khrug pa'i byad byung ma zor brgyad rtsa la spud pa chags de yi ltas ngan slar la bzlog 'dir gter gzhung zur bkol bya lung rgya mtshor khyung gi ltas ngan bzlog pa'i sham bu gud du sbas pa ni: de yi ltas ga slar la bzlog: ces pa'i mjug tu 'di gdags so bcom ldan che mchog he ru ga: ྅ gi thugs mchog 'bar ba las gser gyi thig le gru gsum nas btso ma gser gyi slog pa las rdo rje ha yi 'phreng bas brgyan: thugs las ye shes 'od gsal (63ba thas khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni: lcags sgong nag po 'bar ba las g.yu yi thig phran 'bar ba 'phro:yum gyi thugs las sprul pa ste mtho yang de ni mi mtho ste: ri rab nyid kyi zom na 'bar dma' yang de ni mi dma' ste: rgya mtsho chen po'i gting na nyal: sgo nga rang gis rang brtol bas sha zan mchu —450

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganabakug rigs su byung : bya chen de yi dpral ba ni: ri rab bum pa'i ltos dang mnyam: dbu la g.yu yi rwa 'bar bas: nam mkha'i khams kyi stongs su sleb: kha nas klu bdud drangs pa ni: 'og gi rgya mtsho'i gting nas 'dren: mig ni nyi zla 'bar ba ste: klu bdud zil gyis gnon par byed kha nas me 'bar rgya mtsho skems: sems ni chags pa lnga dang ldan sder mo g.yu sder 'bar ba yis: chu srin nag po'i snying nas 'dren: kha rlangs na bun bzhin du chags: dung gi gshog rlabs 'bar ba yis: g.yu yi gshog rtser zer 'phros pas thags bzang ris kyi mgo bo gcod: g.yas kyi gshog pa brkyang ba yis: lha yi dbang po'i gnas la sleb: g.yon gyi ba lkog pa brlabs pa yis: gser gyi sa gzhi 'bar ba gshig: lte ba 'brug sngon 'bar ba 'byung : kha nas glog dmar 'jibs se 'jib me yi rtse thog chen po 'babs mig nas lcags kyi ser chen 'bebs: sna nas bu yug 'tshub mar 'tshub:khyod kyi rtsi thog 'bar ba la: mkhal ma han ne 'bar ba ste: mchin pa ro snying chen po la mkhris pa gsod byed (64na)chen po ste: zur phud lnga yi cho 'phrul 'gyed: mcher pa myong byed 'bar ba yi:slo ba skye mched stobs chen te: grong pa sde dpon chen po la: snyim pa dbang chen 'bar ba sprul: sgal tshigs 'khor lo bcu drug la: srid pa'i pho rgyud bcu drug sprul: g.yas kyi 'dab gshog lnga bcu drug:khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa drug sprul: g.yon gyi 'dab gshog lnga bcu drug: sman mo lnga bcu rtsa drug sprul:mdongs kyi thig le bcu gsum la: yul gyi ma mo bcu gsum 'char: dpal be'i thugs sgrom bco brgyad la: sems kyi ma mo bco brgyad gnas: sha sgrom thig le brgyad po la: srid pa'i pho rgyud mo rgyud 'char: ma mor grags pa thams cad kyang : khyung chen sku yi khongs su rdzogs: klu yi rgyal po nor 'dzin dang : srid pa'i bya khyung 'bar ba gnyis: gnod sbyin bu mo rta gdong mas: rgya mtsho chen po'i gting nas dkrugs: kha rlangs nam mkha'i sprin du chags klu dang bya khyung sems 'khrugs pas: srid pa'i ma mo sems 'khrugs te: de phyir bskang dang bzlog pa gsungs: bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang : bya khyung rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : khro rgyal rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : ma mo'i —451 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'tsho gis kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: de nas gzhud gi dkyus ltar: ྅/ khro rgyal khams gsum hūṃ sgra can: sku la zangs(64ba khrib 'od kyis mdzes: phyag na mdung dmar chems se chem: ba dan rtse gsum g.yab mos bdebs:g.yas nas bskor bas lha srin sdud: g.yon nas bskor bas klu srin sdud klad la bskor bas bdud dpung 'joms: srog dbugs dbang byed drod la khyab ltasang na dmigs kyis dral du gsol: ltasangan dmigs kyis gzhig tu gsol: ltas ngan dmigs kyis bsgral du gsol: sto/ bzlog /bsgyur ro: bya khyung bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i sngags ni tshwa badz+ra ma hā kro ta so lnga pa'i sham bur: chu badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍasarba du/ ka ru ḍa sarba ḍā ki ni sa ma ya hri hūṃ phaṭa: ces bsnyen pa bgrang ngo : drag po'i sngags kyi zhabs su btags pa bzlas so: khyung rigs lnga'i sngags bzla bar snang ba yang brtag pa'i gnas yin cing : gong ra ba sogs gnyan lhog gi sngags lhang lhang tser tser bzla zer ba ni nang zong ston pa'i gnas yin no:bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo: khro bo rol pa'i las tshogs lasa'adebs ka dgu'i sngags bzlog 'di: rtsa ba'i sngags la bzlog sngags btags pa brgya rtsa brgyad sogs ci rigs pa bzlas: 'di skad bzlog bsgyur drag tu bya'o: bdud bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni:du ra ke ru ma ma shu ra/ sar tri shi ma gu bha yu ni bzlog: lha/ smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas:dpal chen che mchog sprul pa'i khyung : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog smug: sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs 'gyed: dam rdzas gtor (65nasgo 'di bzhes la: dbus phyogs lha yi gdon tshogs dang : nag po bdud kyi dmag tshogs bzlog: rgyal po bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni: ra tsa pra du ha na phaṭa: ra tsa ye du rbad na chod du bzlog: // mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas badz+ra he ru ka yi sprul pa'i khyung : zhal gcig phyag gnyas sku mdog mthing : sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs 'gyed dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: shar —452

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaphyogs dri za'i gdon tshogs dang : rā tsa rgyal po'i dmag tshogs bzlog: gshin rje'i 'debs ka ni:ya ma mi du ru raka bh+yoḥ ra ga ra pre du ma bzlog cig: ྅/ ser nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas:dpal chen gshin rje'i sprul pa'i khyung : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs tshwad dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: lho phyogasagashin rje'i gdon tsho gos dang : grul bum dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: klu bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni: nā ga shi na sa du raṃ/ nā ga ma ri tra su twa raṃ du shan bzlog: snyi/ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen rta mgrin sprul pa'i khyung : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs 'gyed: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la nub phyogs sa bdag gdon tshogs dang : klu yi dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol btsan bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni: shu k+ṣa (65ba)ra ya du dang she sarba ri bra ni: ra da rtse du dur yu dang ka k+ṣa sa du bzlog:hūṃ/ ljang nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: rdo rje gzhen nu sprul pa'i khyung : 'kha gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang : sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tsho gos tshwad: dam rdzasagator ma 'di bzhes la byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon tshogs dang : dmar po btsun gyi dmag tshogs bzlog ma mo bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni: ma ma ru na du ru bh+yo: ma san dur hre hūṃ bzlog: ྅/ma mo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen bla med sprul pa'i khyung : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog smug: sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs 'gyed: dam rdzas gtar ma 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs me lha'i gdon tshogs dang : ma mo'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol:srin po bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni rak+ṣa sa : wa shaka tu bya ta ri su ma ga ya ra tu mu tre ba bzang skye ra rar sha rig bzlog: ྅/ rigs 'dzin rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rigs 'dzin slob dpon sprul pa'i khyung : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs 'gyed dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la lho nub bden bral gdon tshogs dang :—453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2posrin po'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: gza' bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni: a ya ma pre du k+ṣa gza' kha tra ru tra ye bzlog: ྅/ dregs pa rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal (66na) chen dregs pa kun 'dul byung : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog kham: sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las: sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs tshwad: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs rlung lha'i gdon tsho gis dang :drang srong gza' yi dmag tshogs bzlog: the'u rang bzlog pa'i 'debs ka ni: tri'u a pa rak+ṣa na ya du thog:tri du sa du ra tri mang ka bzlog: ྅/ drag sngags rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen stobasaldan nag po'i khyung : yis gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing : sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa'i bya khyung sna tshogs 'gyed: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byang shar bgegs kyi gdon tshogs dang : the'u rang dmag tshogs dgra la bzlog: ces 'debs ka dgu'i bzlog pa'i smreng shin tu zab pa 'di yang myang sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i phyag bzhes las byung banywa: de nas rgyal mtshan rnam dgu'i smreng ni: che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo gtor bzlog gzer kha'i lhan thabs rgyal mtshan rnam dgu ni: dbus kyi che mchog gi gtor ma'i steng du zhes sogs bcas rnams gter gzhung nas gsal ba ltar byas la: de nas ting nge 'dzin gsar zhing 'di skad do:hūṃ/ dbus kyi dpal chen gtor ma'i steng : che mchog dbu la khyung chen ni mthing nag me yi gshog pa can: gdong bas gdong can ltas ༅ bzlog: gshog pas gshog can ltas ngan dang : sder mosasder can ltas ngan dang : mchu yi mchu can (66bskos ngan dang : rwa yi rwa can ltas ngan rnams:bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog: ྅/ shar gyi yang dag gtor ma'i steng : mi bya mi ro za ba yis:rma bya g.yeng ba'i ltas ngan bzlog mi yi dug sbyor g.yos pa dang : lha 'dre 'khrug pa'i ltas ga dang :gang zos dug tu song ba rnams bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog: ྅/ shar lho ma mo'i gtor ma'i steng : sha pho ngu 'bod btsugs pa yis: nad kha rims kha g.yos pa bzlog: sha pho rwa 'dzingasaltas ngan bzlog: nya mo mngal 'dzings ltas ngan dang : nag mo slar 'dzings ltas ngan dang : dur khrod —454

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma dzadawa mo brgyal ba rnams: bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog: ྅/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i gtor ma'i steng : stag mo mi ro za ba yis: dgra bgegs stag ltar 'phyo ba bzlog: sre mong byi ro khyer ba dang :'dre mo'i kha nas sdom khyer dang : snga dgra bdar dang phyi dgra sems mdun nas 'gugs pa thamasacad dang : mi mthun sbyor rtsub ltasang na rnams bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog lha/ lho nub rigs 'dzin gtor ma'i steng : bud med 'thab cing 'dzing ba yis: nag mo spyo 'dzing ltas ngan bzlog ngan dgu dgu bcu gshom pa dang : rgya 'dre stong 'dre langs pa dang : g.yos tshad dug tu song ba dang : khyo la bud med 'khu ba rnams bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog: ྅/ nub kyi rta mgrin gtor ma'i steng : mi hreng dmar po sbar gdengs kyis: gshin mig gson la blta ba bzlog: dur nas 'o dod 'bod pa dang : pha khu'i rgan (67na khri langs pa dang : ma bu'i byur 'dre langs pa dang :byis pa'i chung sri la sogs pa rkyen ngan gnod 'tshe ltas ngan rnams bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor masabazlog: ྅/ nub byang mchod bstod gtor ma'i steng : seng ge dgra snying za ba yis mi chen dmangasababs ltas ngan bzlog seng ge klungs babs ltas ngan dang : che btsun nang 'khrug ltas ngan dang :rje blon bka' chad ltas ngan rnams: bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog: lha/ byang gi 'phrin lasagator ma'i steng : lcags kyi spyang mo btsugs pa yis: phur pa'i dbal zor 'phen pa bzlog: khrag zor rbod gtor ga pa dang : yungs kar mda' zor 'phen pa dang : sngags pa'i sngags zor rbud pa dang : mu stegs par bu ngan sngags dang : phra men ma yi nye 'byed rnams bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog: ྅/ byang shar drag sngags gtore ma'i steng : me nag spyang gdong bcugs pa yis mi nag 'o dod 'bod pa bzlog: gcan gzan mi ro khyer ba dang : spyang khu 'o dod 'bod pa dang : bdud mos khram la btab pa dang : btsan 'gong za 'dre langs pa rnams bzlog go bsgyur ba gtor masabazlog bh+yo/ dpal gyi bka' sdod gtor ma'i steng : bya rog 'ug pa zhen pa yis bya rgod sder 'dzings ltas bzlog 'ug pa sbo la rgod pa dang : srin bya logs la brgyal ba dang : bya rog brang —455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'abrad bsgyur ba dang :'dab chags gcig la 67ba tshe khog zhen dang :ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig rnams bzlog go bsgyur ro gtor mas bzlog:bh+yo:gzhan yang ltas ga bzlog pa ni:mon nag 'jigs pa'i cha byad can mdze pho'i 'khor gyis bskor ba ni las kyi gshin rje'i cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog:nag mo dred zhon khram bam can bdud bya nag po lding ba sogs:ma mo mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog mi nag khyi nag bya nag tshogs:nag po bdud kyi cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog mi dkar rta dkar seng ge sogs dkar po lha yi cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog bud med bya nag sbra gur sogs ma bdud rgyal mo'i cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog bud med mi sngag gcan gzan zhen:nag mo khros mas bskor ba ni:khrag 'thung srin mo'i cho 'phrul yin:༄de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog bya khyi dkar po bu chung dang :ban nag seng ge btsun pa sogs:chos dkor rgyal po'i cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal ོ gtor mas bzlog mi dmar skyesaphran zhus can dang :rta khyi dmar po bya dmar sogs dmar po btsan gyi cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog 'dab chags phug ron 'phur zhing 6mun pa nag po 'thabs pa ni:nag po dmu yi cho 'phrul yin de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog spyang ki nag 68na ) po nyer zhing rgyug ban+de skyes phran bro ba ni:rdo rje legs pa'i cho 'phrul yin de yang dpal chen gtor masabazlog mi lus gcan gzan pags pa gyon lus las me stag 'phro ba ni gnod sbyin pho mo'i cho 'phrul yin de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog ban nag bon nag dar nag 'phyar mi nag pho mos bskor ba ni chos skyong mgon po'i cho 'phrul yin:de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog sprang po hril po gla dkar can sbra phyi byi bas bskor ba ni the'u rang 'gong po'i cho 'phrul yin de yang dpal chen gtor mas bzlog sbal sbrul sdom sdig 'bu srin dang :rgan rgon khyi phrug byi bla sogs sa bdag klu yi cho 'phrul yin de yang dpal che/ ༷tor mas bzlog khyi dkar rta rgod bong stong dang :

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganamon dang sprang po rgol ba sogs dam sri nag mo'i cho 'phrul yin: de yang dpal chen gtor masabazlog: thog babs sad ser kha ba dang : sgrogs dang mda' rdo shwa rdol dang : dmag dpung mar rtse tshur 'phangs sogs rbod gtong spyi yi cho 'phrul yin: de yang dpal wo gtor mas bzlog: sdobargyad cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang : dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dang :gshis ga 'bum pa bco lnga dang : ye 'byog sum brgya drug cu dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi spyi chags sgos chags ltas ga dang : mo ga pra ga la sogs pa bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog bsgyur ro ltas ༅ dgra la sgyur: zhes bzlog sngags mang du bzlas rjes su khyung lnga bskul lo: gzer kha dgu'i las mtha' slob dpon pad+ma 'byung (68bskonas kyis: ma 'ongasasngags 'chang rnams kyi btsas su bzhag: zab cing gud du bstan pa'i skor rdzogs so: stsogs stsogs:gtad rgya/ rgya rgya rgya/ lho'i mkho lding nas rnam snang sku rgyab gter: sprul sku myang gis brta zhe pa'o: gong du rjes su khyung lnga bskul lo: zhes gsungs pa ltar khyung lnga'i bskul byang ni bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor bzlog gtong ba'i dus su/ bdag che mchog gi dbu la bya khyung gis brgyan par bsgoms la ting nge 'dzin gsal la/ gcig gi lag tu khyung gi gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: ྅/ bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor nas: srid pa'i khyung gis ltas ngan bzlog pa ni: dpal chen che mchog yab kyi rol pa las srid pa'i bya khyung nyi ma'i dbu rgyan can 'od zer bye ba sa ya'i sprul pa 'gyed khyung gshog nam mkha' rlung gi 'ur rgyangs can: 'ur 'ur chem chem phyogs mtshamasamed par lding : bya khyung gshog rdeb khams gsum srid gsum 'dul ri rab gling bzhi 'jig rten zil gyis gnon gshog zer g.yas pa rlung dang bu yug ldang : las ngan dgra bgegs ma lusaphyags mas 'debs: gshog zer g.yon pa lcags kyi ser chen 'dril bdud dang srin po ma lusadabang du sdud sprin gyi spu gtibs snang srid zil gyis gnon g.yu yi bya khyung gser gyi spyan mig can: snang srid phyi nang med par bya ra byed lcags kyi mchu sder dbyings nas 'bar ba yis dam —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2genyams bsgral ba'i don snying sbar gyis 'debs ral nag dgu spugs 'dre srin rdul (69na)du rlog:'dab gshog gra rgyas ye shes mkha' la 'phur: kha yis sprul za klu yi grong khyer 'joms: sa bdag gnyan 'dul ltas ngan dgra la sgyur do nub rgyu sbyor don du srid pa'i bya khyung bskul dgra bgegs 'dul zhing dug lnga zas su za drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad cing mi mthun phyogs rnams sgyur: chags che ltas ngan bzlog cing gnod byed tshar gcod mdzod khyung chen sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:da ni sprul pa'i khyung lnga bskul ba ni: ྅/ srid pa'i bya khyung thabs chen yab kyi bya: khyung sman rlung gshog shes rab yum gyi bya: yab yum thabs dang shes rab sprul pa las: ye shes sprul pa'i sgo nga lnga ru byung : me drod cha bcas 'byung ba drod la phob: thugs rje rol pa'i shugs kyis rdo la ba las ya mtshan che ba'i bya khyung lnga byung ste: rdzu 'phrul bdud las che la rig pa lha bas rno shugs ni thog bas drag la bang ni glog bas mgyogs spyan ni shel bas dngas la snyan ni bya bas gsang : thugs rje'i pho nya shar nas 'gugs par byed: dpal chen che mchog thugs rje'i ngang gi bya: shar du sprul pa'i bya khyung dkar la 'tsher dung gri gshog brkyangs shar gyi nam mkha' gang : shel gyi mchu sder dgra bgegs snying nas 'dren: bskal pa'i klong nas shar phyogs khyab par myul: khyung chen dkar pos gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bzlog: nyin gung lding zhing srid pa khyab par myul khyod ni ltas ngan bzlog pa'i bya khyung yin badz+ra he ru ga'i las kyi pho nya mdzod: shar nas ltas ngan gtong ba thams cad bzlog dam rdzas mthun pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la ltas(69ba yon bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod hūṃ/ thugs rje'i sprul pa lho nas 'gugs byed pa: dpal chen gshin rje dbang sdud las kyi khyung : sku mdog ser po gser ltar 'od du 'bar gser gshog brdabs pas nam mkha' gang bar byed:lcags kyi mchu sder dgra bo'i srog la 'debs: lho phyogs khyab par 'phur zhing mkha' la brgyu: khyung chen ser pos gdug pa'i tsho gos rnams bzlog nam gung rgyug cing dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod: khyod kyi lho yi ltasang na bzlog pa'i khyung : rat+na he ru rka'i las kyi pho nya mdzad lho nas ltasang na byung ba thams —458

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganacad bzlog: dam rdzas mthun pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ltas ngan bzlog bsgyur 'phrin lasadus la bab lha/ thugs rje'i sprul pa nub nas 'gugs byed pa: dpal chen rta mgrin dbang sdud las kyi khyung : nub nas sprul pa'i bya khyung dmar la 'cher: me yi gshog brdeb 'od zer mkha' la 'gyed: zangs kyi mchu sder sha za khrag la 'thung : nub phyogs khyab par 'phur zhing mkha' la brgyu:khyung chen dmar pos gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bzlog: dgongs dang srod la dgra bo'i bla srog len:khyod ni ltas ngan bzlog pa'i bya khyung yin pad+ma he ru ga'i las kyi pho nya mdzad nub nas ltas ngan byung ba thams cad bzlog dam rdzas mthun pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ltas ngan bzlog bsgyur 'phrin las dus la bab: ྅/ thugs rje'i sprul pa byang nas 'gugs byed pa: rdo (70na)rje gzhen nu mkha' klong las kyi khyung : byang du sprul pa'i bya khyung ljang la khros: g.yu yi gshog brgyangs bar snang mkha' la 'gebs gdug byed mchu sder khro bcu 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i khrag dang chu rgyus rtsa ba 'bral: byang du 'phur zhing mkha' la lding zhing rgyug tho rengs rgyug cing dgra srog ma lus gcad: gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong gi khyung yin te: karma he ru ga'i las kyi pho nya mdzad gnod sbyin gdug pa'i nad rnamasakhyod kyis bzlog dam rdzas mthun pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ltas ngan bzlog bsgyur 'phrin las dus la bab: ྅/ thugs rje'i sprul pa dbus nas gshegs pa yi: dpal chen che mchog lhun gyis grub pa'i lha mthing nag sku las 'od zer 'phro ba'i khyung : g.yu gzhog rlabs chen 'od zer kun tu 'phur lcags mchu sder mos dgra bo'i kha gdongs la: 'brad cing snying la hur thum las byed pa dbus na lding zhing phyogs mtshams zil gyis gnon: khra thabs sngon por sprul pa'i bya khyung gis:nam stod dmag la rgyug cing dgra bgegs tshe srog 'phrog khyod ni dbus dang mtshams kyi ltasang na bzlog pa'i khyung : bzhi he ru ga'i las kyi pho nya mdzad dbus dang mtshams kyi ltas ga thams cad bzlog mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la ltas ga bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: ྅/ ye shes sprul pa'i bya khyung rigs lnga yis bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor —459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobacas la: yas kyi bdud g.yos(70bsgos kyi sri langs bzlog logs la btsan khros rgyal po'i bka' chad bzlog: chos zor bon zor dmod mo kha mchu bzlog pho yi rgya 'dre mo yis rtsis kha bzlog dar tshan stong 'dre skye po'i ya ga bzlog: ltas༅ brgyad cu rtsa gcig dgra la bzlog lo sgeg zla sgeg zhag dang za skeg bzlog: mo ngan rtsis ngan than ngan thams cad bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams thams cad bzlog: ye 'byog sum brgya drug cu bzlog slo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad bzlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su bzlog mo bdud dal kha g.yon du bzlog: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la bzlog zlog cig sgyur cig mthu ma chung : rbad na stobs rtsal ma zhan cig do nub rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi chags g.yos thams cad gtor mas bzlog: sgos su ltas ngan khyung gi bzlog nad kha rim kha zor gyis bzlog: chags che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol: zhes bskul la sman rag sbran dmar sbreng / bstod bskul de ltar btang la khyung chen gtor mar gzugs so: de nas gza' lam bdun cu bskul: dgra bgegs kyi phyogs su bskyal lo: khyung gi bstod bskul gud du sbas so: 'dir mkha' 'gro'i 3 yig cig 'dug kyang 'god thabs med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/ rdzogs so: nyin rjes ma pra brtag pa yang zab gnad du mdzad glud rdzong bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi 'chi blu'i glud chog them med ni 'dir mkha' 'gro'i 3 yig cig 'dug kyang 'god thab med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/ 'chi glud yongs rdzogs kyi lto chos chen po 'di la yongs rdzogs gzhung bsrang : rgyas par byed na dpal dgu bshams sto dang rdzas glud las(71na sgoms gzhung bzhin bshams la sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas cho ga bsngo zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ni na mo/ dkon cog rgyal ba'i bka' dang ni: chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs mthus 'jam dpal sprul pa rus sbal dang : gtsug lag 'byung ba'i lha lnga dang : spar kha rus pa'i lha brgyad dang : pho brang gling dgu'i sme ba dang : phyogasakyi lo skor bcu gnyis dang : lo khyim drug cu tham pa dang : sa bdag rje blon bcu bzhi dang : ko long sdom pa'i lha dgu dang : gtsug lag bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang : gab rtse sum brgya drug cu dang : 'byung —460

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaba'i lha tshogs thams cad la:tshe srog glud kyi lto chen 'bul:mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol:lha chen brgyad dang klu wo brgyad:gza' chen brgyad dang phyogs skyong bcu:rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang :dri za grul bum sha za dang :mi'am ci dang lto 'phye dang :mkha' lding 'dab bzang lus srul po:'phrog ma'i bu dang 'brog gnas dang :gtsang rigs sde brgyad thams cad la tshe srog skyob kyi glud kyang 'bul mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol:rab 'jigs gshin rje'i sde tshogs dang :nad bdag ma mo'i sde tshogos dang :mthu — lha yi sde tshogs dang :drag po bdud kyi sdo tshogs dang :dkar po ging gi sde tshogs dang :myur mgyogs btsan gyi sde tshogs dang :spyo 'bog rgyal po'i dzitsho gos dang :zhe gdug klu yi sde tshogs dang :sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs bcas 71bal tshe srog glud kyi lto chen 'bul mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol:'joms byed gza' yi sde tshogos dang :dpa' chen gnod sbyin sde tshogs dang :log lta mu stegs sde tshogs dang :zhe sdang klu bdud sdo tshogos dang :dregs pa klu btsan sde tshogs dang :thom po dmu yi sdo tshogs dang :khro gtum srin po'i sde tshogos dang :'phung dkrugs rgyal 'gong the'u rang dang :dregs pa'i sde tshogs thams cad la:tshe srog glud kyi lto chen 'bul mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog tu gsol:zhe brnag bdud mo'i tshogs bcas dang :bsnyags ring klu mo'i tshogs bcas dang :drag thung gnod sbyin mo yi tsho gos bcas dang :'phrang dam sman mo'i tshogs bcas dang :srog la rngam pa srin mo'i tshogs:nyul le dam sri'i tsho gos rnams dang :srid pa mo rgyud thams cad la:tshe srog glud kyi lto chen 'bul mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol:mtho ba srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas dma' ba na rag dmyal ba yan chad du nga rgyal lha yi sde tshogosadang :'dod chags mi yi sde tshogis dang :phrag dog lha min sdo tshogos dang :gti mug byol song sdotsho gis dang :'jur gegs yi dwags sde tshogis dang :zhe sdang dmyal ba'i sdo tshogos dang :khamasagasum 'gro drug thams cad la tshe srog glud kyi lto chen 'bul mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol:byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang :gdon chen ༷༷ pa bco brgyad dang :bgegs rigs stong phrag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pobargyad cu dang : 'byung po stong phrag drug cu dang : yul bdag ma (72na longs brag srin dang : khyim sgo lam srang rgyu ba dang : lan chags sha 'khon bsnyags pa dang : gnod 'gal bar chad rtsom pa yi:snang srid lha 'dre thams cad la tshe srog glud kyi lto chen 'bul: mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol: 'di ltar glud chen bsgo ba'i rjes ma hā gser gyi rus sbal dang : 'byung ba lnga yi rdzas bcud dang : spar kha brgyad kyi phyag mtshan dang : smi ba dgu yi lto rdzas dang : brgya gnyis lo yi glud chen dang : gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad la: mthun pa'i rdzas dang glud rdzas rnams: tshe srog gnyis kyisablud du 'bul ngar glud rin cen 'bar ba dang : nam mkha' mda' 'phang rkyang bu dang : mkhar thabs shing ris rgyal mtshan dang : dar zab sman dang 'bru sna'i tshogs: gser skyems spyan gzigs bshos bu dang : gtor ma chang bu sha chang dang : bza' btung zas bcud sna tshogs dang : 'dab chags rkang 'gros mang po dang : srog chags skye rgu bsam mi khyab: ngar glud lo grangs brgya rtsa la 'dod yon longs spyod rgyan gyis brgyan tshe srog gnyis kyi glud du 'bul: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi: khyad par tshe srog glud chen 'di: pha ni gnam la ma ni sa gnam sa tshogs pa'i ngar gyi glud:bdag cag rnams kyi rtsol bas bsgrubs rgyu ni rin cen 'bru sna lnga rkyen ni sngags dang phyag rgyas bsgyur: ku ba'i mgo la zer mo'i skra lung thang mig la mgron bu'i so: spri yang sna la le brgan lce zangs ma'i rna ba mtshal chen (72bsgo dngas: zho sha'i snying la dbang po'i lag: sro lo'i glo ba ba mkhal mcher: mkhal ma zho sha bla sgang mcher gro sbos rgyu long tig ta'i mkhris dung rgyus bse sha spu rtse'i rtsa tshos khrag me tog spang mas mdzes rnam shes mar me rdzu phrul rkang : 'di 'dra'i glud mchog ngo mtshar che: pho mo'i glud du mda' 'phang brgyan lo grangs grangs su khram shing btsugs sku la dar zab bya spus brgyan: yul 'khor ri rab gling bzhin bcas 'phangs pa med pa'i sems kyis 'bul:glud bdag 'khor bcas glud bzhes shig: bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol 〉 glud skor g.yas su lan gsum bskor lo skor gsum gyi glud du 'bul glud skor g.yon du lan gsum bskor lo —462

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogadaskor drug gi glud du 'bul glud skor lan gsum 'dur zhing 'bul: lo skor dgu yi glud du 'bul:dkon cog gsum gyi bka' ma bcag: dpal chen he ru'i dam ma 'da' lan chags bu lon da khyer song : khyer cig khyer cig da khyer cig: sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang : dran dang bzung dang bsam dang reg: glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod: kye/ snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis: tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la de ring yon bdag rgyu sbyor la: rang lo'i sgeg dang zla ba'i sgeg: spar kha'i sgeg dang dgu mig sgeg bzhi gshed bdun zur mthun gsum dang : phyogs ngan bdud gcod byur babs dang : bla 'khyams pha khu'i rgan sri dang : sdeg dang byol kha la sogs pa: dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams kun glud chen (73na)'di yis bzlog tu gsol: kye/ snang srid lha srin thams cad kyis:tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la: de dag rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa'i nad:khrag dang chu ser snyigs ma dang : rgyu rkyen 'byung ba'i nad la sogs: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yis dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams kun glud chen 'di yis bzlog tu gsol: kye/ snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis: tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la: deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag la spyo byed brjes byed la sogs pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po dang : bdud dang srin po dam sri dang : phra men yi dwags mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gdon dang bgegs kyi bar gcod kyis: dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams kun glud chen 'di yis bzlog tu gsol kyi/ snang srid lha srin thams cad kyis tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la: deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: rgyu nad mkhris pa rtsa rgyus nad bal nad rgyu gzer khrag 'khrug dang : tshad rims 'brum bu dkar nag dang : gag lhog gzer thung cham rims sogs rims nad sdo lnga la sogs pa: dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams kun glud chen 'di yis bzlog tu gsol: kye/ snang srid lha srin thams cad kyis: tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la: deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: dmu chu skran dang skya bab dang : dreg dang grum bu chu ser dang : 'bras dang phol mig g.yon pa dang : shu thor bal ldags me dbal dang : mdze rigs bco brgyad la sogs pa:—463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2podus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams kun glud chen 'di yis bzlog tu gsol: kye: (73bskong srid lha srin thams cad kyis: tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la: deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: rang bzhin dug dang sbyar ba'i dug: rtsi dug zas dug reg dug dang : 'byung ba'i dug dang rdzi dug dang : gcan gzan mche ba'i dug la sogs: dug rigs sbyor sde mang po yis dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnamasakun glud chen 'di yis bzlog tu gsol: kye/ snang srid lha srin thams cad kyis tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la: deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: me gri chu gri mtshon gri dang : rta gri rbab gri g.yang gri dang : 'thibs gri lcebs gri spyo 'bog dang : mi rgod gcan gzan mun pa sogs gri bas gzer nad mang po yis: dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams kun glud chen 'di yis bzlog tu gsol: kye/snang srid lha srin thams cad kyis: tshe srog glud chen 'di bzhes la: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: glo bur rkyen gyis 'chi ba bzlog phas kyi cad gtong zor kha dag : ngan sngags gtad khram sto bzlog dang : lce 'bab thog dang gza' gdong dang : rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs pa slo bur rkyen dag ye 'brog gis: dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams kun glud chen 'di yis bzlog tu gsol: gal te dus la babs gyur kyang : lo gsum bar du phyir nur cig: sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs mthus:bcu thub pa yang brgya thub shog rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bslu bas mthong chos gos bu smin par gyis dkon cog gsum gyi bka' la nyen: bcol ba'i 'phrin las (74na〉spyab par mdzod: ces lan bdun bskyar nas bya'o: yang glud kyi phyogs bzhir bya'o: tha ma lan gsum brjod: rang gi lo dang spar kha'i dus sam grogs kyi dus su/ 'dre lnga sdod sar bskyal lo: phyi mig mi blta bar log la bkra shis gsol lo: tshe dgug bskrad pa drag tu bya'o: de ltar byas pas phan yon man ngag nas gsungs pa bzhin 'byung ngo ::: rgya rgya rgya/ skal ba can dang 'phrad par shog: 'dir mtsho 'tsho 3 yigatsiga'adug kyang 'god thabs med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod/zhi byed 'chi ba bslu ba'i snying po 'di brgya'am stong du bzla bar bya'o: zho ma hā ka li mo ta ye swā —464

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtog)ga rtswa ma ma raṃ raṃ ye swā ga zho ma ma kho kho yaṃ yaṃ yer pa ye swā 1 tshwa su su ma ma tang tang ye swā ga zho ma ma ka ra ka ra ye swā ga zho ma ma sngo ta sngo ta ye swā ga zho ma ma kha zhu kha zhu swā 1 shi ma gha la swā hā/a trem tre swā 1 a ta na ma hā gra ha na ma bhi dz+nyā na ti su na swā ga zho hūṃ lha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: zho byi sha mi me ye rda swā 1 tshwa dzi mi dzi mi mu dze pa ga she saṃ rbad to: ma hā yag sha bho : par sha yang ki ro gi hūṃ phaṭa: zho sam ya ye mi ye/ ya du ye du ye mi ti ta ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hwa ā na ru she pa dus/ sarba a ya sha gha tsha bha tsha phaṭa: cha dha la ma snyo se ya pad+me hūṃ/ dha li man+ta le swā ga zho a ka ni ni ka ni a byi la me le swāhā gab don las/ yab la brten nas mdos dang : yum la brten nas sgeg bsgyur ba spro tshe 'dir bya na'ang re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag ste: gzer kha bcu'i smreng ni: ྅/ rgyu ni rin cen dar zan la:dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir (74ba/dgra yi gzugs phung nya bo bcus: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs dam sri'i gnod pa rnams: khro rgyal gshin rje gshed pos bzlog: 'og gdon sa bdag 'dul ba'i phyir: zan gyi nya chung ser po bcus: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: sa bdag klu gnyan gnod pa rnams: khro rgyal phyag na rdo rjes bzlog: gnod sbyin rgyal po 'dul ba'i phyir mchod rten sa sna'i btsun chung bcus bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la:dkor bdag rgyal po'i gnod pa rnams: khro rgyal rta mchog dpal gyis bzlog nor gyi god 'dre 'dul ba'i phyir: sha dang zan gyi mtheb kyu bcus: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas: zas dang nor gyi god kha rnams khro rgyal ya ka me dbal gyis bzlog the'u rang sri rkun 'dul ba'i phyir: zan dang kham sa'i sho chung bcus: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la: gnam the dkar po'i gnod pa rnams:khro rgyal ya ka me dbal gyis bzlog: ma mo'i yams nad 'dul ba'i phyir: nag mo zan gyi bud med bcus: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la: rims dang yams nad gnod pa rnams khro rgyal rnam par rgyal bas bzlog: ban bon phur pa bzlog pa'i phyir: drag po skyer ba'i rtsad zor bcus bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la: phur zor rbad gtong gnod pa rnams: khro rgyal rdo rje gzhen nus bzlog:—465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pomi gtsang nyams grib 'dul ba'i phyir: rin cen sna tshogs bum pa bcus: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la: dme grib yugs (75na)grib 'phog pa rnams khro rgyal rnam par 'joms pas bzlog:mi kha smra mchu 'dul ba'i phyir zan dang sbrang ma'i gzheng pa bcus: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la: mi kha rgya 'dre langs pa rnams: khro rgyal hūṃ ka ra yis bzlog: dmu bdud srin mo 'dul ba'i phyir:zan gyi mi ro ral can bcus bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la srin mo dam sri gnod pa rnams:khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bzlog: ces ga' na yang bzlog tshan mang du brjod do: sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/skabs 'di'am lam sogs skabs sbyar du las phran bcu gnyis pa tshan gnyis/ kha bsgyur bcu gsum sogs kyi las la sbyar 'os rnams lus pa med par sbyar zhing / khyung zhen gyi bzlog pa thun mong min pa las bcas rnams 'khrul med du byas te smreng 'di skad do: // dpal chen che mchog he ru ga:bzlog sgyur byed pa'i pho nya ni: sgyur byed rnga mo stobs po che: skyes pa stag chas byas pa dgu: dpral ba'i steng nas su sgra 'debs: gdug pa zil gyis gnon byed cing : rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa la: skyes pa'i mda' zor 'phen pa yi: de yi ltas ngan dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo dpung pa g.yas pa la:sngags pa sngags 'dren thal mo brdeb: sngags pa zor kha 'phen pa yis: yas kyi bdud g.yos dgra la bzlog: de yi ltas ngan dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo dpung pa g.yon pa la btsun pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa dgu: chos pa'i chos zor 'phen pa yis: de yis ltas ga dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo dbyi steng (75bsko yas pa la: byis pa 'ur rdo thogs pa yis chung sri langs pa'i ltas ngan bzlog: de yi ltas ngan dgra la bh+yo:rnga mo dbyi steng g.yon pa la bud med dul nag brdeb pa dgu bud med dul nag brdeb pa yis: za ma bud med ltas ngan bzlog: de yi ltas ngan dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo rtsib logs g.yas pa la: bon po bco dmar 'phen pa yis: dmar chen 'phen pa'i ltas ༅ bzlog: de yi ltas ngan dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo rtsib logs g.yon pa la: ngar glud dkar dmar byas pa yis: de yi ltas ngan dgra la bh+yo: ltas ngan thams cad bzlog pa'i glud: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog: rnga mo'i steng na zhen pa yi: che —466

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma (gnamachog sprul pa'i khyung chen ni:nag po lcags kyi gshog pa can:gnam lcags rdo rje'i rwa gnyis bshibs:gtsug na nor bu 'bar bas brgyan gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder can:nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan mig can:khyung skad 'brug sgras sa bdag 'dul:thams cad 'dul ba'i mthu bo che:thams cad 'dul ba'i dus la bab:khyung gi ral pa sprugs pa las:yul gyi ma mo bcu gsum bskyod:nam mkha' smug nag 'thibs pa'i byad:dred mo ral 'dzings ltasang na bzlog g.yas kyi gshog ru dang po la steng gi khro bcu 'bar ba sprul:seng ge 'brug sngon 'thab pa'i byar:gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ltas ngan bzlog:gzhog ru 'bar ba gnyis pa la:gsang ba'i khro bo bcu ru 'bar:glang chen rba la 'phyo ba'i byad stag seng 'dzing ba'i ltas ngan bzlog:gshog ru 'bar ba 7na sko sum pa la spyi dpal khro bcu 'bar ba sprul chog nam sa sprin dmar mched pa'i byad bud med ral 'dzings ltas ngan bzlog:g.yas kyi gshog ru bzhi pa la:rdzogs pa chen po'i khro bcu 'bar:skar mda' sal lhung ba'i byad :dbyig gi nor bu'i ltas ga bzlog g.yas kyi gzhog ru lnga pa la ta spo ta khro bo bcu drug shar ri rab me chen mched pa'i byad:lci ba'i zas kyis ltas ga bzlog:g.yon gyi gshog ru dang po la:srog rtsa'i ma mo bdun du shar:rgya mtsho dug sprul 'khyil ba'i byad me tog bcud nyams ltas ngan bzlog g.yon gyi gshog ru gnyis pa la:e ka drag me spun drug sprul:mkha' la stag ma 'phyo ba'i byad rdzi yis bskyod pa'i ltas ga bzlog g.yon gyi gshog ru gsum pa la:srin mo 'bar ba bdun du shar mkha' la bya rgod sder 'dzings byad:gter gyi bcud nyams ltas ga bzlog:g.yon gyi gshog ru bzhi pa la gdong mo bzhi dang rgyal mo lnga:g.yu sha ru bcu 'dzings pa'i byad:seng ge ngu 'bod ltas ga bzlog g.yon gyi gshog ru lnga pa la:nyi shu rtsa brgyad sprul pa byung :sno dpal ngar gyi ltas ngan dang :rma bya g.yeng ba'i ltas ngan bzlog g.yu sgang sngon po yar ba dang :lcags kyis ra ba 'bab pa dang :shel dkar snod du dug g.yos dang :zangs sgong dmar po 'dril ba dang :mi bzad 'bar ba rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'ge gangs(76ba)kyi stongs nas lhung : shel gyi sgo nga yar ba dang : sprin chen yar ba'i rtags bstan dang : mang po'i bcud chen zags pa dang : dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ltas ga bcu gsum slar yang bzlog khyung gi mjug sgro brgyad po la: rgyal mo bzhi dang gdong mo bzhi: sprul pa 'od kyi 'phreng ba shar bse sgong khra ba'i zur bstan te: lhag 'phran zor gyis 'debs pa dang : gza' skar 'bug pa'i byad byung ba zor brgyad rtse la sbud pa chags de yi ltasang na slar la bzlog // khro rgyal khamasagasum hūṃ sgra can: sku la zang khrab 'od kyis mdzes phyag na mdung dmar chems se chem: ba dan rtse gsum g.yab mos 'debs g.yas nas bskor bas lha srin sdud: g.yon nas bskor bas klu srin sdud klad la bskor bas bdud dpung 'joms: srog dbugs dbang byed drod la khyab: ltas ngan dmigs kyis gzhig tu gsol ltasang na dmigs kyis bsgral du gsol: 'phung sri rnga mo khyod kyisaltas ga bzlog pa ni: sku mdog dmar bsam mo yongs kyi ltas ga bzlog sha sga gto pas snang srid lha 'dre'i ltas ngan bzlog g.yag gi thod pas 'gong po yongs kyi ltas ga bzlog spre'u'i gdong pas rgyal po yongs kyi ltas ngan bzlog: sprul gyi rked pas klu bdud yongs kyi ltas ga bzlog:sha yi sder mos drang srong gza' yis ltas ga bzlog gzhan yang bde gshegs 'dus pa'i ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i rgyud las: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig byung : gdong (77na)pas gdong can ltas ngan bzlog rwa yis rwa can ltas ngan bzlog:gshog pas 'dab chags ltas ngan bzlog rkang pas sder chags ltas ngan bzlog mchu yis lto 'gro'i ltasang na bzlog: ces gsungs pas: rkang grangs kyis bcad nas dang po gdong can ltasangan bcu drug bzlog pa ni: mi la byol song gcan gzan gzugs skyes pa: 'phung ltas ltasang na chen po babs pa yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro ltas ga thams cad dgra la sgyur rkang lag dbang po mang dang lhag pa skyes pha mes bu mo'i za 'dre byed pa'i ltas ngan yin de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro ltasang na dmigs kyis bsgral du gsol dus —468

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtogan ngan pho mo lha sar mnol shor ba: lha lnga lar nas bdud langs ltasang na yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog bsgyur ro ltas ngan dmigs kyis bsgral du gsol: pha ming sgo ru nal phrug btsas pa ni lha 'phangs mi rabs chad pa'i ltas ngan yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma phubasgyur ro ltasang na dmigs kyis : bu sring btsog mnol byi phrug slag pa ni: klu dang ma mo mi nor brlag pa'i ltasang na yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di yisaḥ: bsgyur ro ltas ga dmigs kyis bsgral 7 mi la mtshe ma zung du bcos pa ni: 'phung sris mi nor 'jig pa'i ltas ga yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di bsgyur ro ltas ngan dmigs byasaḥ: dred mo skra 'bal brang brdung mi ro (77ba)za lha bdud gnam du 'phangs pa'i ltas ngan yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di yisamabasgyur ro ltasang na dmigs kyis:: dred mo bong bu zhen nas grong yul 'grim: gnyan dang ma mosabarlag pa'i ltas ga yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di:: bsgyur ro ltasang na dmigs:: spre'usago sogs gnod pa sna tshogs byed rgyal po gza' klu gsum gyi ltas ngan yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'diḥ bsgyur ro ltas ga dmigs kyis 4 spre'u lag na gram khyer ba: 'phung sri langs pa'i ltasang na yin: de yang dmar chen gtor ma za bsgyur ro ltas ga dmigs kyis:: spre'u gsum rta la zhen pa ni: the'u brang spun dgu'i ltasang na yin: de yang dmar chen gtor bsgyur ro ltasang na dmigasakyis 7 byis pa kha brda ga pa ni nor god yong ba'i ltas ༅ yin: de yang dmar chen gtor::bsgyur ro ltas ༅ dmigasaḥ: gza' mi spyod log ngan dgu byed: nyes dgu 'byung ba'i ltasang na yin:de yang dmar chen gtoraḥ : bsgyur ro ltas ga dmigs kyis:: mna' —ma nye bar ga gshom pa:zas nor bcud 'jib ltas ngan yin: de yang dmar chen gtoraḥ : bsgyur ro ltas ngan dmigs kyis::shang shang dred la zhen pa ni: rje 'bangs 'khrugs pa'i ltas ngan yin: de yang dmar chen gtoraḥ :bsgyur ro ltas ngan dmigs kyisaḥ : bud med 'thab cing 'dzing ba ni ma yams sa srin ltas ngan yin de yang dmar chen gtor:: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dmigs kyis:: (78na)—469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gelog nad kyi bdag mo'i ltasang na yin:de yang dmar 4ltas ga dmigs :lug la 79ba kho khal byung ba ni:'phung sri langs pa'i ltas ga yin:de yang dmar ltas ga dmigs ra la zangs ldan byung ba ni:'phung gsum nag mo'i ltas ngan yin:de yang dmar ltasang na dmigs phuganag la be'u mgo gnyis skyes:dmu bdud nag mo'i ltas ga yin de yang dmar :ltasang na dmigs ri dwags khyim rtsar chags pa spyod lha klu khros pa'i ltas ga yin:de yang dmar ltasangan dmigs :gna' ba khyim du 'ong ba ni klu btsan khros pa'i ltas ngan yin de yang dmar ltas ngan dmigs za sha ba khang par 'jug pa ni:sman mo khros pa'i ltas ga yin de yang dmar 4ltasangan dmigs gdur bya dang ka dur sa spo shi kha 'byed pa'i ltasang na yin:de yang dmar ltasangan dmigs 4byang g.yag rwa 'dzing byed pa ni:'brog srin g.yos pa'i ltasang na yin de yang dmar phultas ga dmigs mtho glang sgo na 'khun pa ni:sa bdag g.yos pa'i ltas ga yin de yang dmar phultas ngan dmigs glang bu rog po lta dkar byung :klu bdud khros pa'i ltasang na yin de yang dmar chen :ltas ngan dmigs :dngos su sdig pa'i char pa 'bebs phung zor gtad khram ltas ngan yin de yang dmar 4ltas ngan dmigs sha pho rā 'dzing byed pa ni:pho bdud g.yos pa'i ltas ga yin:de yang dmar :ltas ngan dmigs:lnga pa lto 'gro'i ltas ngan bcu drug bzlog pa ni 80na〉gil nag khyim du tshang 'cha' ba mdze nad klu yi ltasang na yin:de yang 4ltas phu sbrul dang sbal pa 'dzing ba ni:klu dang ma mo'i ltasangan yin:de yang :ltasang na:nya gnyis chab la rnga 'dzing byed:'phung sri langs pa'i ltas de yang 7ltas ga za sprul dang rtsang pa 'dzing ba ni klu btsan gnyan gyi ltas phu de yang ltas ga phusprul nag kha na nya ro khyer ma bdud klu mo'i ltas ga yin de yang :ltasang na mnya ro mgo med mi la 'bor sa bdag gnod pa'i ltas ༅ yin de yang dmar ltasang na 7nya ro chu yis khyer ba mthong :klu sman gnod pa'i ltas ga yin de ༷༷ 2 ltas ga :sbal ljong nya sbrul khang par byung :

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaklu gnyan sa bdag ltas ngan yin:de yang dmar ltas ngan:sbal sprul thur la rgyug pa ni:ku dang ma mo'i ltas ga yin:de yang dmar 4ltas ga sbal pa rmigs bu zhen pa ni klu bdud nag po'i ltasang na yin:de yang dmar :ltas ngan:'bu srin gson la tshang 'cha' ba:'phung gsum nag pa'i ltas ga yin de yang dmar ltas ga :ldong mo'i kha na mi ro za:ma bdud srin mo'i ltasangan yin de yang dmar 4ltas ga dmigs phu dug sprul mi la 'khril ba ni:mdze dug klu bdud ltas de yang :ltas ngan:srin bu pad ma mi la 'dzug bu tsha gsod pa'i ltas:de yang :ltas ngan zas srin lag na sdom khyer ba shi kha byo ba'i ltas:de yang :ltas80ba ) nga na dmigs kyisabasgral du gsol bong bu dmar po sprul mjug can:klu bdud khros pa'i ltasang na yin:de yang dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog:ltas ngan dmigs kyis bsgral du gsol:lha srin sdebargyad 'khrugs pa las sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab ltasang na bcu phrag bcu dbyung yang :ltasang na chen po zhes bya ba dngos su gang byung de nyid yin:sha khrag klad pa 'di yis bzlog spu dang mchu sder 'di yis bzlog don snying nang khrol 'di yis bzlog:yan lag dbang po 'di yis bzlog:drag po'i khram shing 'di yis bzlog glud dang bdud byang 'di yis bzlog so so'i gzugs byad 'di yis bzlog rang rang bden tshig 'di yis bzlog glud dang bsgyur byad 'di yis bzlog dmar wo gtor ma 'di yis bzlog srid pa'i khyung r+ṣa khyod kyis bzlog:rnga mo gzugs r+sā 'di yisabazlog gang byung dngos su bzlog tu gsol:dmar nag zor r+pā 'di yis bzlog:ltas ga dmigasakyis bsgral du gsol bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:chags che mya ngan dgra la sgyur mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog gtor bzlog gzhung bzhin byas nas kha byang 'di btags na ltasag chags sgo ji ltar che yang mi bzlog mi srid do:de nas dmigs kyis ltas ngan bzlog pa gzhung bde 'dus smad las rigs 'dzin bskul ba'i mjug nas ྅/khro rgyal khams gsum hūṃ sgra caX7sku la zangs khrab 'od kyis mdzes phyag na mdung

'joms: srog la dbang byed drod la khyab ltas ngan dmigs kyis bzlog pa ni: khra gsum kha na sprul khyer ba klu dang rgyal po'i ltasang na yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho langs pa'i ltas ngan yin bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur rgod bzhi gshog 'dzingasabyed pa ni: gnam lha dkar po'i ltasang na yin bzlog go dmar chen gtor bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: dam gsum kha na mi ro khyer dbyings kyi ma mo'i ltas ༅ yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur:sprul nag thur la rgyug pa ni: klu dang ma mo'i ltas(81ba yon yin bzlog go dmar chen gtor masabazlog bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur wa mo dur sar brgyal ba ni: 'phung sri dur sri langs pa'i ltas ngan yin bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur zhe le'i kha na byi ro khyer mo brgyud chung sri langs pa'i ltas ga yin bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog brag ral ba rnams sdebargyad 'byugs pa ltas༅ yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas(83na〉zlog bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur bh+yos gdab pa ni: de nyid kyi mchong las/ bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo gzhung las/ bh+yos gdab/ ces 'byud bas/ bh+yos gdab cing ltas ga bzlog pa ni 'di skad do: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: dang po bh+yo yis mi gdab snya ma mo'i las kha bh+yo la thug bar du bh+yo yis mi gdab tso snang srid lha 'dre bh+yo yis bzlog tha ma bh+yo yis mi gdab snya nad dang ltasang na bh+yo yis bzlog bh+yo ltas ngan kun gyi pha smos pa gnam la bya dkar mche ba can bya la mche ba yong mi srid ltas ngan —476

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtog)dang po pha ru byung : ltas ngan kun gyi ma smos pa: sa la byi dkar gzhog pa can byi bar gshog pa yong mi srid ltas ga dang po ma ru byung : de nyid srid cing sprul pa las: ltas ga brgyad cu byung ba ni:gnam gyi ma bdud ltas ga du nyi zla shi ba'i ltas ga byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog:bar snang stong pa'i ltas ngan ni: srog bdag rgyal po'i ltasang na te: bya dang rgod kyi ltas ga babs:de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog gangs ma de ni dkar gong nas: lha bdud ma bu'i ltas ngan te:dbyings dag mtha' yi ltasang na babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: spang ma de ni snar gong nas sman dang gza' yi ltas ga te: sha ba dgo ba'i ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog brag dmar de ni dmar gong nas brag btsan gnyan gyi ltasang na te: gla ba 'ug pa'i (83bskos ga babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: nags ma de ni mun gong nas:ma bdud gnyan gyi ltasang na te: dom dang dred kyi ltas ngan babs de yang dmar chen gtor masabazlog g.ya' ma de ni sngo gong nas dmu dang bdud kyi ltas ngan te: 'brong bu g.yag gi ltasang na babs de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: gnam nas ltas ngan byung ba ni: gza' skar gnyan gyi ltas ga te rgod po sder 'dzings ltas༅ babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlos rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum nas: sa bdag klu yi ltas ngan te: sbal sbrul nya yi ltas ga babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: sa las ltas ngan 'byung ba ni: sa bdag gnyan gyi ltas ga te: lusal mdze shu g.yan pa byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog ngur dang mchad pa grog po nas:'dre mo nag mo'i ltas ngan te srin bya khu yis 'debs pa 'byung : de yang dmar chen gtor masabazlog brag dang nags kyi shing gseb nas 'dre srin phra mo'i ltas ngan te: gong sreg glu chung len pa byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog phu nas ltas ga byung ba ni: bdud dang gnyan gyi ltasangan te shwa pho rwa 'dzings ltas byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: mda' nas ltas ga byung ba ni klu srin 'khrug pa'i ltas ga te: nya mo mtha' 'dzings ltas byung : de yang dmar chen —477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegator mas bzlog dur nas ltas ga byung ba ni: dur 'dra dur sri'i ltas ga te dur (84na sko wa brgyal wa ro sbram: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: rta la ltas ga byung ba ni drug grum gdong gas gzi mig 'byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog phyugs la ltasang na byung ba ni: 'bri la be'u mche ma byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog lug la ltasang na byung ba ni ro sgal rked skor nag po byung : de yang dmar r+ṣa gtor mas bzlog: ra la ltas ga byung ba ni: zangs ldan spu rtags dmar por byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog khyi la ltas ga byung ba ni tshi ba byung dang tho rengs ngu : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog byis pa chung gi ltas ga te sre mong kha na byi ro khyer: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog bya la ltas ga byung ba ni: rgyal 'gong 'dre yi ltas༅ te: srod la de pho 'tsher ba byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog pho rog 'ug pa sder 'dzings byed dme 'khon bdud kyi ltas ngan babs de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog 'ja' 'khyil lha yi ltas ngan yin: seng ge ngu 'bod gshin rje'i ltas: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog dom dred stag gzig 'thab pa dang : pha spun nang dme byed pa ni: srid pa ma mo'i ltasang na yin: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog sha rkyang btsan gyi ltasang na yin: sprul nag 'khyil pa klu yi ltas:dom nag bdud kyi ltas ga yin: gla ba sman gyi ltas ngan yin de yang dmar chem gtor masabazlog bya rgod rgyal po'i (84bskos ga yin khrung khrung dre mo'i ltas ༅ yin: spyang zhi dge bsnyen ltas ngan yin: bya rgod sder 'dzings byed pa sogs bdud kyi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog: ye 'byog sum brgya drug cu bzlog dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad bzlog glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig bzlog nad rims bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog: rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog: lus la nad du gtong ba bzlog tshe la bar du gcod pa bzlog skeg ga sri ga thams cad bzlog mo ngan gtsug lag ngan pa bzlog: kha brda la nye ngan pa bzlog bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub pa bzlog: 'dun —478

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganangan gros ga gzhom pa bzlog: mi rung ltas ngan thams cad ni: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo za ba'i 'dre la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo 'phung ba'i sri la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog dgra la bzlog bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhes bh+yos gdab cing ltas ga bzlog go: bh+yosagadab cing ltas ga bzlog pa'i las mtha' shin tu gsang ba rdzogs so: sam ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter ma'o: 'dre mo bong zhen gyi gzhung yin zer ba ltas ngan brgya bzlog la gshogs drud pa'i dpe hrul 'dra khams dang e phyogs nas dar bar sngags rlom mang po yid brtan byed na dang /rje 'bri gung pa sogs tshad thub rnams la ma grags shing / smreng de la brjod don lhag po yang med pas/mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni man ngag gab don las/ bca' gzhi (85na skong bong zhen la ltas ngan bstim pa'i dmigs pa zab mo gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ sngags 'di'i thun gyis brab po: zho badz+ra ba tri ka ru ṇa dza le ka ru ṇa dza le ltasang na thams cad u tsa ta la phaṭa: bdud kyi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog btsan gyi ltasang na thams cad bzlog: rgyal po'i ltas ngan thams cad bzlog: ma mo'i ltasangan thams cad bzlog: gshin rje'i ltasang na thams cad bzlog: gza' yi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog klu yi ltas ga thams cad bzlog: dmu yi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog dmu bdud ltas ngan thams cad bzlog sman gyi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog: srin po'i ltas ngan thams cad bzlog:bgegs kyi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog: the'u rang ltas ngan thams cad bzlog dbang phyug ma yi ltas ga bzlog bstan ma'i ltasang na thams cad bzlog: mgar ba'i ltas ga thams cad bzlog mon pa'i ltas ga thams cad bzlog: lha ma srin gyi sde brgyad kyi than dang ltas ngan thams cad bzlog: ces brjod/thun 'dzin pa mang nyung ji ltar 'os pas: sa ma ya zhes sogs kyi sngags zur gsal gyis thun nus ldan du byas te gtor ma dang glud la brab cing 'ded do: gces pa'i lde mig nas bshad pa'i khyung bzlog yan song nas/ de nas nyams len gnad gdams su rjes gtor ma gtang ba'i rim pa la —479—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pogasum ste: dang po srin mo za lam dgra la bstan te dmod mo gdab cing sngags bzlog bya ba dang /gnyis pa gtor ma zor du 'phangs nas dgra bgegs kyi phung po (85bskozhom pa dang / gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba'i las rim mo dang po za lam dgra la bstan cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni mchod pa phud skongs dang lha bsangs rgyags rngan sogs bla gab med pa'i sar gtong ba dang lhan du phyogasabazhi'i lha mo bdun tshan bzhi la bka' bsgo ba'i gser skyems nyi ma shar phyogs ma gtong / sgrub pa po rnams kyis gser skyems bsdus pa bya zhing mdos lam 'then/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la brten nas bla ma'i dbang gtor ma gtogos gtor ma las bsdu ba dang brlag pa phyag len ltar bya/ slob dpon gyis phyogs so sor phyin te sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang dmigs pa man ngag ltar byas nas/ shar phyogs sgo ma rta gdong dkar: zhes sogs kyis sgo dbye/ gtor dril ni gong ra ba sogs gtore ma sgrub khang nas phyir 'don pa'i don yin zer ba sogs rnam dbye ma dod pa'i nang zong phyir ston gyi yod 'dug cing : snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin du rlom pa mang po ni phyogs 'dir mi smra ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog mod rje 'bri gung pa chen po chos kyi grags pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chosadabyings rang grol/ khra tshang pa mkhas grub chen po blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje gsum bzhed pa mthun par gtor ma gzhan rnams gtso bor dril ba'i dgongs don dang phyag len rnams mthong brgyud man ngag ltar byas nasang ga 'don ni/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog byed pa'i skabs su/ gtor bzlog gi gzhung ltas ngan bzlog pa man chod tshar nas srin mo za lam gtong ba'i dus su gtor dril 'di ltar bya'o: (86na)phyogs mtshams kyi gtor ma brgyad po re re bzhin dbus kyi gtor mar dril zhing / 'di ltar bh+yo bzlog gi 'phrin las bya'o: // dbus mtha' med pa'i chos dbyings chen po nas zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: kun bzang rigs lnga yab yum dbyings nas bzhedas sras mchog sems dpa' lcam dral gshegs su gsol sprul sku thub drug 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig mthar byed sgo ba yab yum thugs dam bskul dam rdzas rgyan gyi —480

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganagator ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs: de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yin: bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: ྅/ khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod ོ po nas: smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen che mchog yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs sras mchoge sprul pa'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol bka' srung pho nya'i tshogs rnams las la phyos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi: dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs: de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis: bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: ྅/ khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: badz+ra he ru ka yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs sras mchog ke'u ri'i tshogasarnams gshegs su gsol: (86ba tha ka' srung dbang mo'i tsho gos rnams las la bh+yo: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs: de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis: spyo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: lha/ gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: ya mān+ta ka yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs: gshed bzhi phyogs skyong yab yum gshegs su gsol bka' srung pho nya'i tshogs rnams las la bh+yo: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi: dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs: de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis: bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin lasamadzad du gsol: ྅/ pad+ma rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas dbang gi rgyal po yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs sras zil gnon yab yum gshegs su gsol: bka' srung pho lha'i tshogs rnams las la phyos sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod —48/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gepa'i phyogs:de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis:bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol:lha/phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod wo po nas ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:rdo rje gzhen nu yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs sras 87nasgo cho go khro bcu yab yum gshegs su gsol:bka' srung pho nya'i tshogs rnams las la phyos:sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs:de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis:bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol lha/ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas:sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:bla med he ru ka yab yum dbyings nas bzhedas:ye shes rje mo sman mo'i tshogs rnams gshegs sgo skyong pho nya'i tshogs rnams las la phyos sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs:de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis:bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol:྅/rigs 'dzin rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas:thugs rje gdung 'tshob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas rdo rje slob dpon yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs:sgrub pa'i rigs 'dzin tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol bka' srung pho nya'i tshogs rnams las la phyos sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis:bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol:྅/dregs pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas dug lnga me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 87ba po khor nas dregs pa kun 'dul yab yum dbyings nas bzheng :sde dpon sum cu yab yum gshegs su gsol:sgo skyong drag po'i tshogs rnams las la phyos sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs:de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba/ ༷phrin las mdzad du gsol:྅/drag sngags rol

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganaba'i dur khrod chen po nas: gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas stobs ldan nag po yab yum dbyings nas ba che khas sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad gshegs su gsol: sprul pa'i lha srin sde brgyad las la phyos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi dgra dang bgegs dang mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs: de ring dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: zhes bka' brgyad re re bzhin bskul la gtor ma rnams phyogs mtshams nas rim bzhin du dbus kyi gtor mar dril lo: de nas srin mo za lam bstan: dam bdar/ bh+yos gdab/ bzlog pa bya/ bh+yos gdab pa'i rjes su sgrub pa chen po'i dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'chams stabs su dang po dor stabs bgrad la phyir bzlog tu thal mo gdab cing : dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing 'di skad do: // dgongs shig mkha' 'gro dam can rnams sngon tshe zhal bzhes ma g.yel cig: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po (88na)'di ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang : g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan par sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi: bar tsog tu bzhag ste bkur bar bgyi: de skad khyed kyi dam bcas te: dpal gyi bar khor ba chin bdag bsgrub na ma thogs myur du stobs la byon bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod: sngon ma'i mas stabs kyis bskor ro: zho shrī he ru ka sam ya ste: ma nu raka si bh+yo: pra ma ni bh+yo: ro'u tri bh+yo:be na be bh+yo ko'u ri ma bh+yo: in+d+ra ni bh+yo: badz+ra sing ka li bh+yo: a mṛ ta bh+yo: so'u ma bh+yo: dan da lha bh+yo:raka si bh+yo: bka si bh+yo: ra ti badz+ra ma bh+yo: ru ti ra mat+ta bh+yo: e ka tsa rlo bh+yo: ma no ha raṃ bh+yo: si ti ka bh+yo:ba ya be bh+yo: mahā mā ra na bh+yo: asne bh+yo: bha ra hi bh+yo: tsa mun tri bh+yo: bu ta nai bh+yo: ba ru na bh+yo: badz+ra ma hā kā la bh+yo: badz+ra tsa ga le bh+yo: badz+ra/ ba kurnga bh+yo: badz+ra lo sto da ra bh+yo: badz+ra ni ba ra bh+yo: badz+ra la bar bh+yo: badz+ra du tri ko bh+yo: badz+ra sha ye bh+yo: badz+ra da shing bh+yo dhu ra saṃ bh+yo: badz+ra lan te bh+yo: badz+ra ma hā te bh+yo:badz+ra su tsi ra bh+yo badz+ra ra li bh+yo: badz+ra ra mi bh+yo: ma ma hri lha dza jo tshwa badz+ra kyi lī gī lā ya sarba bi baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces bskul lo: sngags drag tu bzlas so:—483

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2pokhro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog gi las phran/ phyag lan gtor dril shin tu zab cing gnad che ba slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so: drag sngags kyi mdun du bka' sdod kyi gtor ma dpags:dgongs shig mkha' 'gro dam can gyi tshe las gzhan rnams kyang de'i (88bsgo dun du slebs tshar ba byas nas dam can rnams dbang du bsdu ba'i dmigs pa bya/ phud lhag rnams gtso gtor dang nye bar bshams pa la sman raka sbran/ lhag ma dang chad mtho dkyus bzhin btab/ bka' srung rnams kyi sngon gyi tha tshig dran nas gtor ma rnams blangs pa'i rjes su gtor ma rnams dmag dpung du shes pa'i zab gnad zhal las shes sgrub khog nas dar 'phyar/ dung 'bud/ phud btang / mes sna drangs/ chosaskyong gi ru dar lkor/ rnga dang rol mo brtsams te:rdo rje slob dpon gyi lta ba'i rdzong bskyed: lha'i nga rgyal gyis go bca'o: zhes dpa' bo dmag la mas pa'i go gsar ba ltar rnal 'byor pa rnams lta ba'i rgyab dang gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin brtan po'i nga rgyal gyis rig pa hur phyung ste ma badz+ra sarba du / e da bh+yo: dgra bgegs nga po mā ra ya phaṭa ces dir dir bzla zhing phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i brtul zhugs kyi 'gro'o: nyams len gnad gdams las gom pa bdun cu'i sar gtor ma khyer la/gtor ma la rak+ta sbran: sngags bas bdud kyi chas gsar/ rnga brdung / dung 'bud/ zhing lngags gdab/'o dod 'bod/ dmod mo bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar las/ zor 'chams sogs spros pa che bar byed na la la dag bka' brgyad la char ga'i ma gshin nyer brgyad kyi bskul sbyor ba sogs mi mang gi gseb tu ngag 'don byed rgyu yong ba tsam rgyu mtshan du byas te rang gzhan gyi mgo bo mgal me ltar bskor ba'i spyod tshul rnams ring du dor te rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin du bya'o: srin mo za lam ni/gtsang dang (89na〉( rgyud kyi sngags rlom la la dag zhal phyag tsam bzos pa'i rgyug hreng spang la btsugs par shog bu'i phod ka g.yogs pa tsam las rdzas man ngag thams cad dang bral ba'i srol ngan lugs 'dir ye ma shor ba byas te gab don gter gzhung gi dgongs pa dang bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar bcas rnams mngon par 'du byas nas: ting nge 'dzin dang tshig rkang man ngag bzhin bsnan te —484

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganadakyus bzhin bya/ de nas gang du 'phen pa'i sar sgra gcan gyi / thebs dang bstun te phyin nas gser skyems phul/ gces pa'i lde mig dang gnad gdams sogs gter gzhung dang bla ma'i zhal shes sgo bstun te bzhi pa zor du shes pa'i gnad 'gag kun khong du chud par byas nas zor bskul rnamasabatang ste drag sngags so lnga pa sham bu dang bcas pa brjod nas rim pa bzhin du 'phen/ zhing lpagasagadab/ dul mo rdul/ thal mo gdab/ dung dang gling bu 'bud do: bh+yos gdab bo: gtor zor khyung gdong dgra phyogs su bstan 'khor lo mer bsreg pa dang mi sreg pa'i dbye ba nges par bya: mtshamasagacod kyi khyung gi dmigs sngags zab mo nyams su bstar/ gces pa'i lde mig tu/ de nas gtore gzhed bshal chus sbran/ 'bru gsum byin brlabs bstan ma bskyang : gtor gzhed mnan la rta brosagazir drag sngags bzla zhing lha khyung sgom zhes pa ltar bstan ma gzhung bzhin bskyangs:rdo rje slob dpon gyis phyir snyeg bzlog pa'i phyir man
