ngag zab mo dang bcas sgo drung du slebs nas las phran gyi rdzas mnan pa'i steng du bro brdung : me chu'i rgyas 'debs/ nang du slebs nas tshe (89bsko gugs nasabazung shis brjod kyi bar las byang gi dkyus bzhin bya ba ni/gces pa'i lde mig las/ bkra shis brjod cing smon lam gdab: ye shes lha gshegs dam tshig bsdu spros med phyag rgya chen po bsgom lhar langs spyod lam ci bder bya bka' brgyad drag sngags gtor bzlog 'di: ru dra bsgral dang nang dme bzlog bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i phyir:pad+ma bdag gis btsas su bzhag: ces gsungs pa ltar ro: phan yon ni/ nyams len gnad gdams las/ 'di lta bu'i bzlog pa 'di shin tu gnyan pas: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku'i rim gro'am/ sngags pa nang 'gras sam byad dang rbod gtong bzlog pa la sogs pa'am kyi dus 'khrug pa mang ba'am/ nad yams chen po langs pa'am/ nyams chags chen po byung ba'am/ rgyal po'i chad pa'am/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs byung ba la bya ba las gar thod thod du gnyan pas mi bya'o: las 'di ni sngags pa nang 'gras sam rbod gtong dang phur kha drag po thug pa'am/ lha 'dre'i g.yos drag po byung ba'am: chags—485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khorachen bo byung ba'am nad tshabs po che ci byas kyang mi gsol ba la bya'o:gang rung rung la byas na rang la gnod pas gnyan no slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi las mtha'/bzlog pa thun mong ma yin pa shin tu zab pa'i las mtha' rdzogs so:rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi phyag dpe rgyas btab nas gter du sbas pa'o:gter 90nargya/sbas rgya/zab rgya/sa ma ya/rgya rgya rgya/smras pa/chos kyi byidangs nas du ga lnga'i gnyen po sa/mi bzad khro bo yis rngams rol pa'i mtshon//'jigs rung gtor zor dbang phyug mig gi mes//dgra bgegs yid srubs ming gi lhag mar byed//bdud las rgyal ba'i snyan grags rnga bo che//thos pas tshulu 'dir 'jug pa ches mang yang //bde 'dus gter gzhung dgongs don snyan brgyud kyis//bkrol ba'i zab gnad shes pa nyin skar bzhin//mon sngags dpe hrul mthong la yid ston dang /khungs med zer sgros tsam la tshad mar 'dzin//phal cher gab dkrugs ma gtogs gter gzhung gi/tshig rigs smra zin skyon rnamasang la gso mdzod//sna tsho gis gter kha'i bka' brgyad glegs bam kun//pad 'byung gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i bas yin kyang :bde 'dus gzhud la ma brten rang gter gyis/khro rol byed rlom chu 'dod smig rgyur bsnyegs/kho bo sngon bsags las mi dman pas//mnga' bdag nyang ral zab gter chos dang mjal//gnyos zhig legs ldan rdo rje 'bri gung pa/khungs btsun brgyud pa'i gsung bgros zhib mor thos///tshig tshogs lo mas dngos don mi sgrib cing //ga kho byon nges rnyed lung khungs 'khri shing rtser khrigs chags ngag 'don gos bu g.yur za ba//byin rlabs 'dod 'jo'i yongs 'du deng 'dir bskrun//dge tshogs rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis//nad mug 'khrug sogs nyes brgya lha min dpung //rab bcom bdud 90bsgos rgyal ba'i ba dan dkar gangs can phan bde'i khang bzang rtser bsgreng shog/de ltar khro bo rol ba'i gtor bzlog gi gzhung le lag dang bcas pa bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gter byon du kha 'thor ba'i ༷༷ gyis bzhugs shing /de dag la gsung rgyun dang

khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ nang ma rtoganachog sgrigs sogs rnam grangs sna tshogs 'dug pa phan tshun zhus dag mi pher ba'i dpyad bzod mi bzod sna tshogs snang ba nas bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs dang spyi sgos kyi rim gror zur drin can bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi dgongs gtad ltar rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi las byang btsugs pa'i cha lag tu khro bo rol pa'i ngag 'don bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni 'khon rigs grub pa'i dpa' bo rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs snying la 'phos pas theg pa mchog la 'jug pa'i blo mig rnam par yangs shing zur chen 'jam dbyangs bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi drung du bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang lung man ngag khyad par rje 'bri gung pa'i bzhed srol gyi khro bo rol pa'i phyag len rdzogs par mnos la/ khra tshang pa mkhas grub chen po blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje'i drung du gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung man ngag dpyis phyin pa dang / mnga' bdag myang gi bu chen byang las kyi mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa gung ru ba gnyos zhig chen po'i phyag len gyi khro bo rol pa'i phra zhib mtha' dag thos pas chos tshul 'di la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan sngags smyon gang shar rang grol du 'bod pas gter gzhung dngos dang bla ma'i man ngag la gzhi byas/ rje zur pa'i chog sgrigs de yid ches kyi gnas yin na'ang dmar sbreng nas bcol dam gyi bar rnams bka' so sor sbyar nas mdzad pas ha cang mang skyon gyis khyongs dka' ba'i skyon tsam mchis la/ spyos zhig gi bzhed srol de 'jug pa bde zhing khungs btsun par ma zad pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po'i zin tho dang yang phyogs mthun pa nas de don bzhin mdzes byed ces pa chu yos hor zla dgu pa'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / khu bha ri sarba dza ga snya// //—487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ger༅khya//khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan bzhugs so//gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/'dir khro rol gyi phyag len reg zig tu bkod par/sgrub chen dang mi 'brel na/sgrub dkyil ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la khyad par rten dgu bzhugs/sman raka gtor mchod kyis bskor/bsdun tshom bu/shin tu bsdun bris 'bur sku dang sgrub gtor gyis tshos/gtor bzlog gi dkyil 'khor la/sngon du cha gsum mam bgegs gtore btang /lha sta gon/ma tre bsgral ba thig tshon byin rlabs/dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la rgyas pa pho brang nyi ma dgu zhal dbang gi skabs ltar bri/'bring gling dgu ru bcad pa'i gling so sor dbang drag gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa gru gsum mthing nag zla gam dmar po sum ldan/gling gi gcod mtshams rdo rje'i gdung ser gzhi sngon po gling dgu'i phyi rol thod rwa bzhi pa phyi nang gi khyams phyogs mdog/phyi rol du rdor me ri 'dri/bsdus pa gru gsum mthing zla gam dmar/thod rwa dkar/rtsibs brgyad mthing /rdo ra me ri bya/'bring bsdus gnyis la dur khrod kyi tshab la ma tre 'dri ba legs/slang gcig ma la dbus ma dpal gtor 'khor zur gsum/slang dgu la gtso bo dgu ka dpal gtor 'khor bzhi po zur gsum/ma rdzodang dregs / la lnga byed/bka' srung gi gtor ma sgrub pa'i rang bkang srung gi gtor ma rgyal ba spyi bskul dang pho nya sgos bskul gyi dus 'bral ba ma gtogos lha mi bskyed pas/rdor dril logs na7 ma gsungs kyang /'phen dus dmag dpung du shes dgos/ni rgyas bsdus gnyis skar dgos pa yongs rdzogs kyi bka' srung mchod byang ltar bya/dkyil 'khor byang shar gyi me ri'i thang tsam 'jog/de dgu ka la 'og 'khor mu khyud gsum pa/lte bar gru gsum bsnol ba la bzlog/rtsibs la hūṃ mu khyud la sgrub pa po la gnod pa'i 'byung po sogs dang ma ri can da zan cung zad tsam gyi steng nas kha yar ston de'i steng zan sor gang tsam gyi steng ༷༷/ 'khor rtsibs rtse nang bstan/lte bar liṅga lte ba

khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ nang ma rtoganadang rtsibs la bka' so so'i sngags/ mchan la phyag mtshan/ gri gug /rtsa gsum/ be con/ thod dbyug /ral gri/ tho ba/ phur pa/ lcags kyu rnams ma nor ba dgos/ dpe'u ris tshore sna tshogs 'dug khu khyud nang mar byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i gur shig sogs phyi mar rjo sha ya sogs yod pa der ngos 'dzin/ rtsibs rtse phyir bstan pa'i man ngag bsad 'khor la gtsigs su mi mdzad/ slang dgu'i skabs che mchog la bka' brgyad spu'i sngags phyag mtshan tshang ba de ga mdzad/ yang dag la bsad 'khor rtsibs bzhi lte bar ru lu rtsibs la sras yab bzhi/ ma mo la bkra gags la ma wa dang dregs pa la dbangagagi sngags gtso bo'i sngags spag ma du btags nas lte bar 'god pa legs/ mchan la gri gug kho na 'dri ba yin/ bsad 'khor mu kha ga ga ne pā shu la/ bzlog 'khor lte bar che mchog rtsibs la bka' so so/ mchan (2ba)la phyag mtshan/ mu khyud nang mar nang pa sangs rgyas pa sogs/ phyi mar oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs yod pa de mu khu bhū mo srin byas te yo ga byed/ bsad 'khor ltar bzlog 'khor yang che mchog la rtsibs brgyad dkyus ma las zur khyad mi byed/ yang dag sogs la mu khyud bzhi sogs byed lugs rig pas dpag /slang dgu'i skabs/ khyung dbus mthing / shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / mtshams bzhi dbus dang mthun/ dregs 'joms sku 'khor lte bar drag sngags so lnga pa/ rtsibs dkar brgyad la a kro /mchan la sha ri bh+yo/ mu khyud nang mar/ oṃ myags mā ra ya sogs phyi mar ā+oṃ khro ma ri sogs bris pa spyi bo/ ye shes bskyed pa gsung 'khor ni/ lte bar so lnga ba/ rtsibs dmar drug la paṅgān+ta kṛ ta/ mchan la bh+yo bzlog /mu khyud nang mar oṃ ha he sogs/ phyi mar oṃ ga ru ḍa sogs bris pa mgrin pa/ bong 'bre bzlog pa thugs 'khor ni/ lte bar so lnga pa/ rtsibs mthing bzhi la ru lu/ mchan la i ka du na sogs/ mu khyud nang ma la bh+yo bzlog sogs/ phyi ma la ga ru ḍa sogs bris pa snying ga /bya khyung 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo lte bar so lnga pa/ rtsibs ljang lnga la gī lwa ya/ mchan la byad kha bzlog khu khyud nang mar hūṃ ha he sogs/ phyi mar oṃ ga ru ḍa sogs bris pa gsang gnas/ sto 'khor rgyas pa lte bar badz+rakro dha/ rtsibs brgyad la so lnga pa/ mchan la sarba duṣ+ṭhan sogs/ rtsibs bcu drug la ( 4 ཿ/ swā hā —489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gesogs/ mchan la hūṃ/ rtsibs brgyad la bka' brgyad/ ling tshe bgragasum la seng ge gangs stongasalhung ba sogs/ zur la rdo rje pad+ma ral gri bha kla yod pa de dang 'khor lo chung ba/ lte bar burnya ga sartsibs bzhi la badz+ra ga ru sogs/ mchan la 'jig rten khyung gi sogs/ mu khyud la rwa yis rwa can sogs bris pa de 'khor lo che ba'i khar brtsegs nas lte bar 'jug ma shong na sku gsung thugs lto 'khor (3na ji ba 'phrin las 'khor lo lnga mdun mas rgyab ma'i phyed tsam non pa byas nas khyung gi rgyab nas 'dzugs/ lte 'khor chung ba lto ba'i nang du shong nges byed dgos/ gshog pa g.yas la sto bar srid pa pho brgyud sogs mgo nang du bstan/ khrom ga ru ḍa sogs phyir bstan/ rtsibs la e hur thum sogs/ mchan la oṃ e ka sogs/ mu khyud la hūṃ ha he sogs bris/ phyag mtshan shar nas brtsams te rdo rje/ mdung / 'khor lo/ mda'/ ral gri/ tho ba/ phur pa/ lcags kyu/ gshog pa g.yon la yang pho mo khyad tsam/ mjug ma la lte ba drag sngags brgyad cu pa/ rtsibs dang rtsibs mchan brgyad la sdebargyad bzlog pa/ mu khyud la khrom ga ru ḍa ha ra sogs phyi phyag mtshan yang dag sogs la sto 'khor chung ba dang shog dzor dgos/ lto 'khor che mchog ltar las sgyur kha mi dgos/ 'khor lo gzhan tsho ma byung kyang yong / khyung la khram 'dzugs pa lugs 'di la med kyang yod pa legs/ sprin chen 'khor lo lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ba'i dbus su oṃ āḥ/ dkar dmar mthing / zur drug la bzlog /rtsibs brgyad la phaṭa ser/ rtsibs bcu drug la hūṃ hri spel bar mthing dmar me ri/ mu khyud la/ sgrub pa pa la sogs me ri can/ g.yang gzhi'i lto bar bri ba de gtor steng nas 'gram/ yang dag sogs la sger du mi dgosapa mdzad kyang 'khor brgyad la lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ba'i dbus 'byu gsum/ rtsibs bzhi la phaṭa brgyad la hūṃ/ mu khyud la sngags 'chang bdag cag yod pa de 'thad pa yin gsung / shar du zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi zlum gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa yong rdzog dril ma thub na lhag ma rnams logs shig tu 'jog /lhor bla ma gsang 'dus kyi gtor ma/ ga 'a dril gyi sngon tsas du sgrub dkyil gyi khon du skye la/ nub tu dpal dgu'i gtor dril byed mchod rang gi yi dam gyi lha drag po gshin rje sogs gzhan yod na de'i gtor ma 'dir bshams nas gdago—490

khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ nang ma rtogan las kyi mjug gi 3ba 'jig rten gtor snod sogs kyi 'bul ba'i gtor ma logs su bsham dgos la 'di khar dpal dgu'i gtor ma bzham na 'ag rten snod bas kyi ga sto ma logs su mi dgos so//dpal dgu'i mar ga sto yongs rdzogs dril ma thub na lhag ga rnams tshogs lhag/za lam ma/mi kha'i rdzas sogs gang 'os su blug nas phyir khyer/gtor snying gzugs gcig gam kha phral na dgu/byang du ma ning sogs chos skyong gi bskang gtor/gzhi bdag kha' srung gi ga' modang lhan du spag/dang bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi dkar gtor zlum po mdun/khyung ga dril byed/gtor snying bzo gtso 'khor dgu'am slang gcig skabs rigs lnga'i dbang du byas nas 'khor lnga pa mdun/mchod pa sman rag rdzas sogs cho go sgrigs gces pa'i lde mig na gsal/gces pa'i lde mig ltar na/lasabyang btang nas 'dzab bzla ring gtor ma dgu pa ru dra'i snying la don snying lngas bskor ba ste mchod rdzas su bsam/tsho gos byin rlabs dang bskang rdzas byin rlabs zin nas skad cig sne dang hūṃ gi sa bon las/gis gtor ma lhar bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol tshogs kyi tshig gis byed dam/bde 'dus kyi rgyal ba spyi bskul 'dus pas kyang byed/yang na nyams len gnad gdams ltar las byang gzhung bsrang dusatshig gcig gi bdag mdun so sor gsal gdab pa gang rung 'dem kha yin/gang ltar rgyas pa 'grub na dam rdzas mdangs skongs/mchod pa phud skongs/nyams chags bshags bskongs byed pa/mdangs skongs dang bshags skongs gnyis bde gshegs 'dus pa nas blangs na ha cang mangs pas 'jug pa bde ba gsang rdzogs kyi yi ba'i nang gi zhi khro rgyal ba yongs rdzogs lha/zhes sogs nas bskang rdzasarang rtags rnams song rjes/rgyal ba spyi bskul gyi zhi ba la kha bsgyur tshig lhug 'jog/nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod sogs btags/de nas bskang rdzas rang rtags kyi mjug tu che mchog sogs re re nas spyi bskul kha bsgyur ba zhi pa ltar/zhi khro thams 4na༄da kyi bskang ba rdzogasanas rkyen bzlog gi bh+yos gdab/bshags skongs mi pa'i nang gi phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che sogs gto me /yang bshags skongs dang ye shes sku mchog las byang gi bshags pa'i skabasagatong ba yang yod/mchod pa phud skongs phyogaXbacu nam mkha' zhes pa nas dngos grub stsal du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('gasol gyi bar bde 'dus ltar gtong ba tshogs sam yang na kha shas kyis thog tu gtong /yang na mdangs skangs dang bshags skongs bsdus pa bka' ma ltar na mo hūṃ bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang shong nga gnyi na byed na 'di sngon la byed/nas e ho shudhe sogs kyi bar ro//tshogs phud dang gnyisaphul/de nas bdag mdun sogs kyi khrigs bcad bzhag nas snod gzhal yas khang bcud khrag 'thung lha dgur bsgyur ba thams cad mthong na zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur bu bsgril bar bsam/las byang nas snang srid thams cad gzhal yas sogs kyis che ba bskyed/ma hā yo ga'i sgom khog 'khor lo'i rgya can nas 'phrin las bcol ba'i dmigs pa bdag nyid tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sogs tshig lhug pa gtong zhing dmigs pa tshig dang bstun nas bya/las byang gi bskul chung chos sku skye med ngang nyid las sogs nas rbod zor sarba bzlog blo'i bar dang /yang dusamin 'chi ba nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ga sarba bzlog bh+yo zer ba'i sham bu 'di spyi bskul sgos bskul thams cad kyi mjug re re nas sbyor/bde gshegs spyi bskul btang nas de'i mjug gi mkhyen gsol bzhag nas pho nya sgos bskul/dmod byang lhug pa/sgrub khog rin po che 'bar ba'i rgya can gyi so drug pa nas dmigs pa blangs/dmigs pa 'di gdang las kyi du sgos go la bya/drag sngags so lnga pa brgya tsam bzla/gser skyems byed/dpang 'dzugs ni/bh+yoḥphyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegasartsa ba gsum ma g.yel ma g.yel gzu dang dpang mdzod cig 'gro ba'i don 4bsgo dzad bcom ldan shākya thub la sogs dang /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di zhes pa nas/sngagasa'achang rnal 'byor bdag gis bsam pa bsgrubs kyi bar/spyi bskul mjug gi gdod nas rnam dag byang chub sems mchogo 'di nas/mngon spyod tshul gyis myur sgrol 'phrin las mdzod kyi bar/oṃ badz+rakro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa:sarba rkarma yak+ṣa bh+yo dza yang dag sogs gtso bo dgu la sbyar nas bzla bar nyams len gnad gdams las gsungs/dang po che mchog ni nyams len gnad gdams nasaru tso sarba sha byu mā ra ya : dzadang 'brub khung ༷skyed/nyams len gnad gdams kyi na mo sangs

khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ nang ma rtoganargyas kyi bka' bden pa nas khug cig gi bar/ sgrub khog nas so lnga pa'i mjug tu skṛ tri hur ṭaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ/ baṃ sngos be sha sogs/ don brgyad kyi gzhor nas mthing nag me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas zhes pa nas badz+ra gad+dhaḥho'i bar don brgyad ma'i smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrol gyi bar blo ka gnyis/ de nas don brgyad kyi dang po/ bla srog sngon du 'gugs pa la nang gses kyi brgyad yod pa las/ che mchog lha tsho gos thugs dam can sogs glo ka gcig gi /bskul ba'i lha dang gcig /tshig rkang dang po/ tshon las kyi dmigs pa dang gnyis/ gnyis pa dang gsum gdagasapa'i ma rdzo dang gsum/ pa bzhi pa/ oṃ bzlas pa'i sngags dang bzhi/ badz+ra kro te sogs/ sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang lnga/ nya bo la thim pa/ lcags kyus brang pa'i rdzas dang drug 'gugs pa/ lcags kyu'i bca' ba'i phyag rgya dang bdun/ phyag rgya/ ho dpal chen po spyo gyi dmod pa dang brgyad do/ /nas khug cig gi bar ro/ /gnyis pa yang dag ni gnad gdams nas/ e yi tsho gos kyi dkyil 'khor du nas/ drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ de nyid las/ lha mo slas byan tsho gos kyi bdag nas/ dbang du sdus la rdul du rlog gi bar/ mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas sogs che mchog dang 'don pa bsgyur ba las glo ka gnyis (ldan)po rigs 'gre/ sa bcad gnyis pa mthu dang rdzu phrul rlob pa la/ yang dag lha tsho gos sogs glo ka gcig po'i thog mtha' bsgyur ba'i/ tshig rkang bzhi la gcod mtshams dang nang gses kyis bcad gsum lha dmigasagadags/ 'gro lugs 'dra/ ru lu bzla sngags/ sogs/ rdzu snyul kho 'dzin bdag la thim pas nag ham sogs/ rdzas/thang khrom/ sor mo kha sbub gzings phyag rgya/ te 'drad pa'i tshul/ ho da mo dponas brlag par gyis kyi bar/ gsum pa gshin rje ni/ gnad gdams nas/ dam nyams dgra bo sdig can la nas/ ma dha la hūṃ phaṭa/ sgrub khog nas so lnga pa'i mjug tu 'go ba'i lha bra de sha ya phaṭa/ u tsa ḍa ya phaṭa dang gnad gdams nas/ lha dbye'i dmigs pa bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha sogs/ ser nag gru gsum sogs blo ka gnyis po 'don pa bsgyur/ sa bcad gsum pa lha dang bral ba la gshin rje lha tsho gis sogs blo ka gcig po'i thog mtha' bsgyur ba'i gcod lha dmigs gdags/mtshams yang dag ltar/—493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge.a sngags/ kro/ skyob to nge lon/ byed 'thor ba/ gu rdzas/ gul sogs/ thal mo phyag rgya/ rgyab sprad sor mo bsnol ba yang yang phral ba'i tshul/ hoḥ dpal chen sogs dmod pa/bzhi pa rta mgrin ni/ gnad gdams kyi dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ dbang du sdus la rdul du rlag: yang khrag 'thung sku las sprul pa'i pho nya ni nas/ ming byang 'di la gnas par mdzod/ solnga pa/ dgra bgegs badz+ra a du sha dza: rat+na spar+sha/ pad ma sa sgo ṭa/ ga rma da sogs/ gnad gdams kyi gnod byed 'gyel thabs su sogs/ dmar nag gru gsum sogs blo ka gnyis/ sa bcad bzhi pa rnam shes gzugs la dbab pa'i/ lha dmigs gdags/ rta mgrin lha tshogs glo ka gcig /sngags pa ṅgān+ta spo ta/ khore lon/ spyi gtsug nas bstim pa/ rdzas/ yungs kar mi lag /mthe bo sbrel ba'i thal mo kha sbub/ phyag rgya/ ho dpal chen po lnga pa phur ma ni/ yang (5bshon snying nas/ che mchog sol dam zer ba 'di yin/ yon tan lha tshogs wor bcas dpal sto tso tshong zhes 'don pa skur na 4mi dgu go go tu byed/ kyi nas/rlag byed dogs kyi rjes dam skas dgra bgegs29 po 'di'i/yul mkhar zhing dang sa ga 'bul/ bcol lo gto do gnyer du long / /lol bas mi sgo'i mi srid do/ /gto ba mi thub mi srid do/ /tshong pas shor nga mi srid do/ khul drongs/ljang nag gru gsum sogs blo ka gnyis/sa bcad lnga pa byad du gzhug pa ni/ phur pa'i lha tsho gis blo ka gcig /gī wā sngags ya/ byad thag gi tore yon/ dru bu ltar/ rdzas khugs skra tshon skud sngo dmar/ dru bu'i lag phyag rgya dogs lta bu/ ho phur pa drag po/ drug pa 'di nye pa skug pa yin pas/ mtsho khrab du 'dus kyang yo lam 'dus kyang sa / ma mo ni/gab sbas don snying las/ dug lnga 'dus pa'i 'bras bu la nas/ spyan mig zlum por nga la ltos/ gnad gdams nas/ sems can chen po khyod nyen cig nas thugs rje'i thabs kyis bsgral bar bya/ smug nag gru gsum sogs gle ka gnyis/ sa bcad drug pa spyo ru gzhug pa ni/ dmod pa/ ma mo'i lha tshogs sogs lha dmigs gdags/ blo ka gcig /sngags/ gu spo dz+nyā na/ dug rtang nge lon/ char gyi 'bog pa/ btsan dug rdzas ra dug thang khrom spyon khrig /sor mo phyag rgya gzings pa mkhrig ma sprad la 'khor lo ltar bskor/—494

khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ nang ma rtoganaho ma dmod pa ma mo drag po/ bka' phyi ma gnyis kyi gong du bsgral ba la/ gsang rdzogs sgrub khog ltar byas kyang rung rgyas pa phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i sgrub 'bum lhan thabs ltar gu gul sbyar ba nas mā ra ya phaṭa/ yungs kar rgyal po nas mā ra ya phaṭa/ rak+ta khol ma nas/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rdzi dug gi dud sprin khrod nas khro chung skar ltar 'khrug pas dgra bgegs brlag par bsam/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa/ sbyor mtshams byang sems kyi phur pa/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa dang bzhi phyi la ba kha ma bskyed pa ni/ nyams len gnad gdams/ bdag gi lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga nas/ srid gsum (6na〉sgrol nus pa'i dbang thob par bsam/ phur pa dril zhing gnad gdams nas/hūṃ bdag nyid khrag 'thung he ru ka /g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin la nas/ phur pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan par bsam mo/ /bdag dpal chen/ phur pa ya ka kro ta/ liṅga dgra bgegs su gsol ba sum ldan gyis/ bde gshegs kyi bskul/ pho nya sgos bskul phur thun chom bskul te bskul/ gsum la chosatshan so sor yod pa'i/ phur thun tshom bskul nas/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha nas/gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /rnam shes sbar ba la/ gnad gdams nas e ma khams gsum sems can rnams nas/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ oṃ srung phyir klad la lan gsum g.yas su bskor/ badz+ra ma hā kro dha/ pad+ma mi bzlog pa'i phyir sked pa la lan gsum g.yon du bskor/ kro tā shwa rī/ badz+ra gī li gzir phyir lan gsum mdun du bsgril/gī lwa ya/ ma pho brgyud 'gug phyir g.yas su cha rngam hā ya ka/ kā dbang du sdud phyir mdun du lan gsum bsgril/ la 〈co pa/skam raṃ raṃ mo brgyud 'gugs phyir g.yon du cha rngam/ dz+wa la raṃ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra snying gar 'debs/ ya phaṭa/dmigs pa gzas po'i snying gar tshe'i ngo bo a'i rnam pa thig le dkar po ba thag gi rnam pa'i dbus nas rnam shes : ljang gu yod pa phur rtses 'phral nas : phur rtser phaṭa gsum hūṃ gsum yod pa'i hūṃ la thim/ phur rtse rang la ya tsam byas pas tshe snying gar bsdu/ ngag nas phaṭa gsum drag tu brjod pas bskul te hūṃ gsum 'og min gyi dpal chen gyi gnas gsum du thim/ de yang thugs dar/ de mgrin par/ de spyi bor thim pa byang chub sems su gyur pa sgru ti'i lam nas brgyud de yum gyi mkhar phab pa —495

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'argyal ba'i sras su bskrun no/ /dgra bo'i skye ba 'di'i 'khor ba rtsad bcad zin kyang / 'khor ba lasaphyir mi bzlog pa'i phyir du/ sgrub khog gi gdab sngags rgyas pa'am/ yang bka' so so'i sngags gsham du/ phur po la mi ra/ badz+raki li gī lā ya (6ba tshesarba bi na baṃ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa sbyar nas/che mchog /sreg rtsa 'og / yang dag /snying steng / gshin rje/ stol ba/ rta mgrin/ mgrin pa/ phur pa/ lte ba/ma mo gsang gnas/ rigs 'dzin/ spyi bo/ dregs pa/ brlag yas/ stobs ldan brlag yon/ gyi phur pa 'debs pa gtor bzlog la phur pa gcig po gnas dgur 'debs/ de rjes phur thun tshom bskul las/ thun bdun nam dgu 'debs pa yin kyang khro rol gyi gtor bzlog la rgyas par byed pa'i phur bu dril zhing /gab pa don snying nas/ lcags sam gdug phur pa skor rgyu med kyang bud skor nyams len gnad gdams na lcags sam nag pho shing zer pa yod pa de 'dir don gyis sgo 45byed mi dgos/ pa'i shing rnams nas/ byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol gyi bar la bka' so so la brten nas phur bzlog sbyar ba rnams byed/ bh+yos gdab pa ni gab pa don snying nas/ nga ni sngags 'chang rgyal po yin nas bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i thog tu bh+yo/ phur thun tshom bskul gyi/ rdo rje phur pa ki lwa ya sogs/ de bzhin du/ yungs kar tshe4ba /rak+ta/ ma mo/ mtshe mda'/ dregs pa/ 'byung ba'i/ yang dag /thogs med/ gshin rje/ dmod pa/ stobs chen gsang rdzogs na bdun las mi 'dug kyang / bde 'dus nas kha bkang che/ zangs phyes lus rta ma'/ sems dbang du sdud/ dbang chen yongs rdzogs gar gyi sku/ dgra bgegs rdo rje rigs yon/ thal chen thabs kyisaganon/ dpa' bo yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku/ dgra bgegs sogs 'di gnyis bsnon/ phur pas gtub pa'i tshul gyis gdab cing / nyams len gnad gdams nas/ nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi nas/mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ ral gris gtub cing / gab pa don snying nas/ che mchog sprul pa'i bshan pa 'bum nas drag byed shugs kyis 'phrin las mdzod kyi bar bka' brgyad bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i bar thams cad la yod pa chang bar byed/ so lnga pa la : tri mā ra ya rbad sbyor/ mchod bstod ni nyams len gnad (7na skod mas nas rungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun nas/ kro ta ya kha tham/ mthing nag gru —496

khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ nang ma (gnagasum sogs glo ka gnyis/ sa bcad bdun pa gtun du brdung ba ni/ dregs pa'i lha dmigs gdags/ lha tshogs la blo ka gcig /sngag badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa/ thun tshar gyi kho nge won dmar nyog song / tho ba mgo dgu zur gsum/ sor mo phyag rgya/nang bsdams kyi rtse bsnol bas mthil gnyis/ ho mchod dmod pa/ bstod/dmod pa drag sngags gsang rdzogs las byang gi dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phye zhig nas/zhal du ling0 stod na byed k+ṣe stob/ kha raṃ khā hi/ mthing nag gru gsum sogs blo ka gnyis/ sa bcad brgyad pa zhal du stob pa ni drag ling ro gas pa'i lhag gang yod son 'di yan la spyi stob zar/ po'i lha tshogs sogs blo ka lha dmigs gdags/ gcig badz+ra sngags/khi nge4na sarba rjes med du gsol ba/ mi rkang gi gzar bu wal mo gzings phyag rgya/pa/ ho dmod 0drag sngags dmod pa/ gab pa don snying nas/ hūṃ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gos rnams/ gnam sa tsam gyi zhal 'di la stong pa'i li mang po yod pa re re bsto ling sa mo skul ba re 'bul zhing / de rjes mig dang bas nas sman dang rak+ta 'bul/ de man gyi stab pa'i tshig cha la dngos su liṅga 'bul rgyu med/gdongasal nas ma hā bha su ta khā hi/ rgyas pa bka' so so bsdu na/ che mchog thams cad dpal chen khrag 'thung du bsgyur nas/ lhan cig tu 'gro ba bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni gab pa don snying nas/ 'jig rten snod bcud gtor mar bcas nas/ bha lin+ta khā hi/ dmar sbreng ba thog mar ga' mas lar lta sbreng wo / de nasakhrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol zer ba'i tshig byung res kyis bzed zhal nang du rak+ta 'phyar/ rak+ta shar ra sogs la ra ro/ /ni/ gab pa don snying nas/ smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ gti mug khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil li li nas/ de sogs 'phrin las sgrub tu gsol/ che mchog yon tan lha tshogs kyi zhal du ma hā mo sa khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ bka' gzhan tshor bsgyur rtsis ha cang mangs pas/ smug nag gru gsum gyi tshab tu/ khro bo rol pa'i dur (7bcud chen po nas che mchog gi tshab tu dpal chen khrag 'thung byed rak+tas dgyes te rkan sgra dang bcas gsol bar mos/ liṅkar lhag mar sman raka sbran pa gtor ma'i mdun du bzhag /sngags bzlog gzhung nas dmigs pa blangs te bzlog gzhung bka' brgyad bas sgoso'i bzlog pa re re bzhin gyi mjug tu/ dam nyams yang po 'di la da rol cig gi tshig gi skabs ling re stob/ ka dkyus gcig —497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2getu bka' srung yan rdzogs par gtong / de nas sngags bzlog /zor 'phen sto bsdun drag sngags so lnga pas go ra mdzad/ che mchog gi gtso 'khor kun gyi sngags re re bzhin gyi gsham du rbod gtong bh+yo btags nasamathar sngags sgrub nas che mchog gi sham bu'i sngags rnams 'dogs des yang dag sogs la 'gre/gtong / de nas sngags bzlog nas dmigs pa len/ rtsang gyer byed/ snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa yi nas/ chos dbyings skye med ngang du bzlog gi /phyi'i gtor mas 'khor ba myang 'das su bzlog /skye 'gro sems can thams cad kun nas/ gnyis med sangs rgyas nyid du bzlog gi nang gi gtor mas sems can sangs rgyas su bzlog /gti mug ma rig 'phrul ba ni nas/ dman sems ngan pa bzlog tu gsol gyi gsang ba'i gtor mas dug lnga ye shes lngar bzlog /gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i/zhes pa nas bzung ste rdo rje dril bu nyid du bzlog ces pas phung po ye shes lnga du bzlog go /yang bzlog trig khro ma/ bya lung rgya mtsho 'di nas khyung bzlog rdzog pa'i bar bdag mdun dbyer med dbu la khyung gis bas par bsgom/ nas dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi nas/ sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ'i bar gyi khyung spyan 'dren/ bya khyung rgyal po ga ru ḍa nas/ pā dza me gha hūṃ gis mchode pa 'bul/ 'dab chags rgyal po bya khyung ga ru ḍa nas/ ltasangan ma lus bzlog pa'i 'phrin las kyis bstod cing phrin las bcol/ bka' brgyad ga'i bzlog gzhung zin pa'i mjug tu khyung bzlog yod pa ni/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /dbu ni nyer gcig phyag ni bzhi bcu gnyis nas de yi ltas ngan slar la bzlog cig /bya lung rgya mtsho (8na)nas gud du sbas pa'i/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru yi/ /thugs kyi thugs mchoge 'phar ba la nas/de phyir bskang dang bzlog pa gsung bskang ngo skal ba sogs kyi rdzo lhag phran bu 'dug /bzlog gzhung dngos gzhi'i 'phro'i khyung bzlog mjug na/ khro rgyal khams gsum hūṃ sgra can nas/ ltasang na dmigs kyisabasgral du gsol gyi bar tshig dgu yod pa de byed/ 'debs bya khyung bsgrubasngags bzla cha byung na thun yang byed/byang bu khyung so sor 'dogs lugs man ngag ltar bya/ ka dgu'i dur ke du sogs sngags re'i gsham du/ smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas sogs kyi smreng gtong dbus kyi dpal rgyal mas dgu'i sngags bri rgyu man sha ltar —498

khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ nang ma rtoganabya/ chen gtor ma'i steng nas/ bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur gyi rgyal mtshan dgu'i bzlog pa byed/'di yan nyin ster gtong / bya lung nas bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du/ sprul pa'i khyung gi ltas ngan bzlog pa ni nas/ chags che ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol gyis khyung zor 'phen nyin khyung rnamasagator ma nas btone khyung bra brtag pa'i sngags bzla zhing nas chag gis brabs nas brtag pa byed pa yang 'dug /lnga bskal/ glud rdzongs byed las phran bcu/ nya bo/ nya btsun sogs so so'i rdzas dag bcas zhabs dkris kyi mtha' skor du bsham smreng / rgyu ni rin cen ngar zan la nas/ khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bzlog gi gzhung tshig dang bstun ka ṭo ra lta bur nya bo sogs sde tshan re re nas sdug pa sgo bar du bskyal/ tshur lam mnan pa'i steng nas gtor gzheng sbub nas bro brdung / rnga mo khyung zhon gyi sto bar khyung 'khor bsdus pa 'jug khog dzor tshar ma 'dogs/ ral pa la bud med sder 'dzings sogs gzhog pa'i ltas ngan gyi gzugs tsho shog bur dpe chung dang gzhung bstun pa bris la rgyab nas slong / rnga mo'i dpral ba dpung pa sogs la skyes pa sngags pa sogs 'dzugs rgyu zan par ram/ tsakli gang rung / rtsibs g.yon la ngar glud bzos pa smyug ma phra mor 'dzugs/ rdzas sogs gzhan na gsal/ grod (8ba)pa la khrag blud yan bdag gi lo grangs kyi rde'u sdug kha la mig bris pa ske la 'dogs/ zor kong bcu gsum gyi bskor g.yang gzhi'i gdan sogs bsham/ rnga mo khyung zhen gyi smreng / thun mong ma yin pa zer ba nas/ dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /bzlog bsgyur byed pa'i pho nya mo nas/ ltas ga brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog dang / de'i mjug tu/ rnga mo steng na zhen pa yi nas/ thams cad 'dul ba'i dus la bab kyi bar/ khyung gi ral pa sprugs pa yi nas/ de yi ltas ga slar la bzlog gi bar dang / khro rgyal khams gsum gnyis po gong gi khyung bzlog ni bod pa 'dir len/ yang rnga mong steng na zhen pa yi nas/ ltas g.yi mi r+sāg pa rgyas pa 'di tsā zhig kyang 'dug /da lta mdzad mi yi byed na khro rgyal khas gsum song nas byed/ ngan gnod sdig dgra la bzlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu'i bzlog thabs yod pa'i/ rnga mo khyung zhon nas rgyud nas gdong gzhog rwa/ /rkang mchu sogs kyi ltas ༅ brgyad cu'i bzlog pa/ mi byol song gcan gzan gzugs skyes pa nas/ rnga mong gzugs chen 'di yis —499

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogebazlog/gang byung dngos su bzlog tu gsol/dmar chen/ltas ga/spu gri ka ma la nas ma ga ga ltas ngan bzlog pa smreng /khro rgyal khams gsum hūṃ sgra can nas/sdeb 'byug pa'i ltasang na yin/bzlog go /bsgyur ro/brgya bzlog gi/dang por bh+yo yis mi gdab tu nas/bsgyur ro ltas ga dgra la sgyur/'dre mo bong zhen la smreng khungs thub mi 'dug pas 'os ltas kha 'di la sngags dang dmigs ga man ngag gang pa don snying na gsal sngags dra nas thag khar kha shas kyis gto/bsgyur nas byed/bcas sogs gab pa don bdun nas byed/rjes ni/thog tu mar pa phud skongs gser skyem rgya po nyi gshar phyogs ma yang de dang lhan du byed/dang bsangs gtong /gser 'dir gser skyes sa bsdus pa zhig bo kho yang yo mod bka' dpe ma ma dgos/skyems btang /mdos lam 'then/bde 'dus rnam bshad lasa3 ha he phaṭa bh+yo ri zhes gtore ma'i ye shes pa bdag dbyer med du khyung spyan tshon na tshong 'dang mngan dbyer 9na〉da yin nas/'di'i dus3ga mdun dbyer med la gtor ma logs su byed na sha khrag tu byin gyis brlabs nas 'phul pa'i don/bsdus/gtor ma sha khrag tu brlabs/shar phyogs sgo ma rta gdong dkar sogs kyi sgo dbye/gtor dril ni dbus mtha' med pa'i chos dbyings chen po nas zhes pa nas/bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i/dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la'i tshig byung dus thog mar zhi ba'i zlum gtor gyi skru gu gtso gtor la bsgril/des ga' na la dgongs shig mkha' 'gro dam༅rnam kyi tshig slebs pa dang 4 kha srung gi gtor ma drag sngags kyi mdun du spags/de'i mdun du glud yas lam ma bskyal rigs dper na yang dag gi gtor ma smyu gu gcig che mchog la dral/'gre/yang dag gi gtor mche mchog gi mdun du sbags/des kun la 'gre/gtor dril gyi go don tha dad du zhen pa dag pa'i phyir ga kho ma thams cad r+sāg tu dril nas lha tshogs rnams la 'bul ba'i don no//gtor ma'i ci phyogs gang 'osasu tshogs lhag kyang bshams nas phud lhag gnyis ka la sman raka sbreng /tsho gos lhag btang /tshogs lhag ro ma nas zor gtor dang /srin mo za lam mar sdugs/chad mtho btang bas tshig tha gas lhag nas ga'agro ra la blug pa' stab kyi sman raka sbreng /ma'i tshe bka' srung rnams kyi gtor ma khyer bar bsam zhing /skad cig la gtor ma bka' srung dmag daX du shes par denas dar stir dung tshod gas go/gas

khro bo rol pa'i zin bris rigs 'dzin dgongs rgyan/ nang ma rtoganare lam du 'jug /bya/ mthil du slab nas dmod byang byed/ gser skyems gzu dpang / 'brub khung bskyed/dgugs 'dren/ mthing nag me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas bzung / badz+ra gharnye hoḥs sgo ma rgyug /lha dbye byed/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha sogs dang / nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi rje sogs kyi mthar sgo lnga pas phur pa gdab/ zor la lcags phur yan pa gcig /gtor chung / mda'/ 'ur rdo/dang zor du thun blug pa/ kong zor du dug blug pa/ mi bsad pa'i gri rnams sgrub pa'i dus nas tshogosabar byas pa 'dir liṅga la brdeg cing / bskul gsang rdzogs sgrub khog (9bskos/ hūṃ/ bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra bgegs dam sri 'di nas yongs rdzogs zor gyis rdul du rlog gis bsgral/ dpal chen rngams pa'i zhal du stob sogs kyis stob pa bya/ srin mo za lam ma'i sham thabs sogs gab pa don bdun yod cing / bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ bzlog byed ma gcig spyan 'dren no/ /sgyur byed ma gcig spyan 'dren no/ /zhesapa'i tshig rkang gnyis nas smreng / bzlog gzhung nas/ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun du 'das pa'i pha rol na nas/ bsgyur ro ma mo'i khram sna dgra la sgyur gyi bar btang nas gtor ma 'phen sar 'gro /'di'i du sbyin bdag gtor rgyang pa sogs kyis thun brab/ bon pos shang dkrol/ byis pas 'ur rdo'i ljag sgra sogs byed srol yod/phyi rol tu slebs nas gser skyems/ rgyas par byed na las byang gi ma nyes dpang du dkon cog bzhugs sogs blo kagacig /gong gi gti mug gzhol mda' zor rgya spunas bzung / lnga phung lus la gri zor rgyob kyi bar dang / bde 'dus zor las 'bring po nas/ khrag gi gong bu la chang 'dis zhes pa nas bzung ste/ rbad 'dre rbod gtong gnod pa bzlog gi bar dang / srin mo za lam masagazhan yang bzlogacig bsgyur ba ni/ zhes pa nas/ phye ༷ ma/ brlag brlag /skyo skyo'i bar dang bams te gtor ma sogs rgyab/chosakyi dbyings nas rang nga sogs kyi bskul 'dir mi dgos/ gtor ma zor du bsgyur/ gong gi chos kyi dbyings rang byung sogs kyi bskul nas sgrub khog dang sngags sgrub nas bshad pa'i dmigs pa bya/ gtor gzhong du khrag chang 'bru blug ste bstan ma bskyang / khyung nag gshog pa brkyang pa zhal phyir gzigs pas zor tshur mi bzlog cing phar song bar bsams nas/ khrom bstan skyong gi sngon la khyung gi mtshams gcod 'di byas na legs/ gha ru sogs sgrub khog ltar bya/ sgo drung du slebs nas phyir bsnyegs bzlog phyir bdud pra ma sogs—501 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('barjod thal mo brdab/las phran bcu'i gzugs tsho mnan pa'i steng nas bro brdung /me chu'i rgyasa'adebs/nang du slebs nas tshe gtor ram tsho ru'i gtor ma la brten nas tshe 'gugs/sgrub khog gi nyer drug pa'i bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dam dang sogs tshig 10na sgong drug gis tshe nang zang kyis sa chang dang gtor zan 'gyed/mdun bskyed kyi dkyil ga gi spyan tshon na bdag bon dbyer med du song zin pas/nang du laganas bdag mdun dbyer med mar pa ma gtogs mdun du gsal mi 'debs/'khor gsal 'debs/mchod bstod/ā li/kā li/yig brgya brjod/sgrub khog gi sogacig pa nas ca āḥ& rgyal ba zhi khro rdo rje slob dpon dang sogs kyi rgyun bshags/dkyil 'khor bsdu chog rgyun spyod las byang ltar dang /sgrub khog gi bcu drug pa rang lus bsrung ba/smon lam bkra shis brjod/gshin rje'i khram kha bzlog pa sogs 'debs ka dgu dang /nya bo/nya sogs las phran bcu po rgyun du byed/sri'u gso/shwa bzlog ma kha gcod pa/gses bcings pa/smyo bzlog/ser bsrung /nad yams gcod pa/tshe bsrings/nad pa bsrung ba/zho chang srung ba/'o zho srung ba snyelas phran brgya gtsig/nad rims/sgo chags/nad pa 'chi shan ma phyed pa/kha smras na da ba/nad yams/phur kha/ltas ga/dkar mdzod mi 'phel/la nyes/g.yang shor/sri'u rta phyugs mi 'phel ba rnam bzlog bsrung ste kha bsgyur bgragasum mi phyugs lo tog gsum bsrung ba/rbod gtong g.yul shwa gsum bzlog/dgra bsad gnon bsad gnyis med du rtogs pa bsad pa gsum/dgra gdon ngag mnan pa dang bcas pa'i kha bsgyur bcu gnyis/yab la brten nas mdos/yum la brten nas/sgeg bsgyur pa sogs rgyun du mi dgosal gal te dmigs bsal dgos pa byung na bca' gzhi sgrub pa'i dus nas bsgrigs te byed pa phyag len yin no//nges gsang chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bur zab/gnad 'gag gab dkrugs rgya yis rnam par spras//gsal bar bstan kyang dpyod par ma shes sogs//blo chung phal cher 'byul pa'i dra bar chud//de phyir tshul 'dir 'bad pas rab sbyangs kyang /khre bar brtson sa ches dman le lo sogs//rnam 0ba ) g.yeng khol po za hor sngagaXbatsun gyis//brjed ngas dgra las rgyal phyir cung

zad bkod/ /pha mes rigs kyi yi dam zhi khro yi/ /smin grol gdams par mos pa'i blo ldan kyang / /sbyang stobs goms 'dris chud bas nor zhabrul dag /mchos na rtsa ba gsum la mthol lo bshags/ /gnam skas klu bdud sto ba'i zab gter rgyun/ /nyang ston dam pa'i phyag len dri ma med/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i tam bu ra yi rgyud/ /bkra shis snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog gyur cig / //

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtoge༄༅༅//gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa'i las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar bzhugs so//na ma sma spru burnya sa mā dze na pad+mā gas rā ya ā sirnyi pra yas 'chi med tshe dbang rigs 'dzin sa brnyes gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje'i sku//mtha' yas gdul byar 'tsham pa'i chos ston yan lag drug cu nā da'i gsung /shes byar srid tshon shel la ji bzhin rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs//yon tan bye ba'i gter gyur skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa rgyal//mgon khyod gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang gi sems//nges pa don gyi pad+ma thod 'phreng du//gnas lugs rang ngo sprod pa'i bka' drin can/khyab bdag bla ma rnam gnyis gtsug na bsten//de phyir snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser//rtag tu 'du 'bral med pa'i rigs kyi bdag/mtsho skyes rdo rje snang gsum zad pa'i mthar//'byol min de srid slu med gtan gyi skyabs//ra gan gser chus byugs pa'i gter brdzus mkhan//ma zhig zhig por brdzu ba'i rigs min pa//'byul med gter ston rgyal po chos kyi dbang //sras slob brgyud pa'i 2na〉sprags rnams phyag gi yul//gang gi thugs gter yang zab bla ma'i skor//kun gyi kha skong lasabyang le'u brgyad//gsang 'dus gzhung dag man ngag gsung rgyun bzhin//spel legs phreng mdzes blo gsal thod du chings/ /de yang bka' rtsis las/bla ma'i thugs sgrub thugs dam khyad 'phags skor gtsor bton dgos pa kun 'byung thugs gter gcig lto brag gnam skas can gyi brag la mchis thugs gter lnga las khyad 'phags 'di kho na ci phyirang yi snying nor mig 'bras yin mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs:zhes mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi gsung gi sprul pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis gnam skas brag nas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos kyi gtso bo ni/de nyid 04

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dug gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganalas/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs sgrub pa'i chos mang gi: rang dang dbyer med sgrub chos 'di na mchis: de gang zhe na bla ma'i thugs sgrub skor: mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs: zhes bla ma'i sgrub skor mang (2ba〉du bzhugs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ ji skad du/ 'on kyang kun gyi mthar thug pa thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa yin:zhes gsungs pa ltar thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor nas le'u brgyad par mi gsal ba rnams kha bkang ste tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i nyams len chog khrigs su bkod pa la/ / dpal 1 ldan 2 sangs rgyas 3 pad+ma skyes 4 kun mkhyen 5 ye shes khyi mdzod 'dzin 7 pa ra: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin can: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud:bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byang chub phyir/ /sgrub pa'i las byang le'u brgyad de/ /sngon 1 'gro sgrub na rdzas spyan 3 drang mchod/ /'dzab sgru bzlas 6 bkang bskul 7 mtha' 8 rgyas so/ /zhes byung ba'i las byang dang gzhung du mi gsal yang dkyil 'khor 'dri ba sogs gshoms kyi sngon du mi snang ba la sa bslang ba ni bla ma yongs rdzogs las zhi ba byang chub sems kyi ngang nas rang yi dam du bsgoms te bya bar gsungs pas dkar gtor zhig bshams la/ raṃ yaṃ kho/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur/bhū mi la ti sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥs mgron spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā ṭ+wāṃ a ju nut+pa sno tad/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ ji ltar sngon gyi dbang mdzad ltar/ /bdag ni byang chub nges bsgrub phyir/ /sa bdag khyed la gtor ma 'bul sa 'di bdag slong sbyin du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol nas/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra la sa rang gnas (3na tshe/ gshegs su gsol lo: de nas dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i le'u la gsum las/ lasabyang du mtshams gcod kyi rjes la skyabs sems mdzad pa khrid dang 'brel ba'i skabs lags kyang sprul sku chos ldan pa'i chog khrigs bzhin thog mar skyabs sems mdzad pa spyi dang mthun pa sprosabacas kyi skabs 'dun pa bde ba yin no/ /dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dusapa'i sku dkon cog gsum gyi rang bzhin la bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams byang chub bar du —505

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geskyabs su mchi gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyasabasgrubs nas ni gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca'o gsum pa mtshams bcad pa ni: gter kha gong ma las/ hūṃ khyiḥbla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i bgegs:log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: de nas mtshams gcod kyi stang stabs dang bcas rang gter las/ hūṃ/ nga ni ye nasang nga gi khro mtshams gcod khro bosanam mkha' gang : bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig zho āḥshā hrīḥgu ru de wa ḍā ki ni badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa le'u gnyis pa sgrub rdzas la gsum gyi dang po sgrub rdzas dngos ni/ gong gis bslang ba dang 'brel bar stegs bu (3ba)brtsig pa/ chag chag gdab pa/ thig tshon lhag gnas thig gdab/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba bum pa/ — / sku 'bag /phyi nang gsang mchod/ sman raka gtor gsum/ tshe/ gal/ dung chen/ rnga/ dril bu/ dha ri/ gling bu/ bla bre/ rin cen sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ zla khrom/ zla rgyas/ dza gad/ dza ti/ 'jam des/ kun tu rgyu/ spang na skyes/ tsha ba gsum/ shel sgong / thang pa/ tsham po/ si thog /bya dkar ma/ kur sha ni/ bi shu d+dha sogs yo byad rnams gzhung dang las byang brgyad ldan dam pa'i gsung 'gros mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bya/ bsdu na ras bris/ tshom bu/ gter ma la'ang brten du rung zhing sa bcad kyi dbang gis 'dir bris pa las lag len gyi skabs thog mar dgos pa'i gnad kyi rim pa 'phrul shes dgos so/ /mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa sngags rkyang gis rung yang / las dang po ba rnams la gsal 'debasakyi tshig gal che bas gtore dbang gnad kyi shog gcig ma/ sman lung cho ge ldan pa dang / rigs 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pa'i thugs sgrub 'bru 'grel gyi dgongs pa dang bstun nas ngag 'don tshigs bcad du bsdebs ba legs par mngon pas/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa bi shu sarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa ba shu 〉 lha'i raṃ yaṃ —506

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganakhaṃ gis mchod rdzas skyon rnams sbyangs/ /yaṃ raṃ ke las rlung me mi mgo yis/ /skyed po'i steng du a las thod pa'i nang / /'bru gsum rigs lnga yab yum sa bon rnams/ /'phros las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ /sman gtor (4na)rak+ta'i ngo bo rgya mtsho che/ /sman gyi thod pa nyi zla'i kha gcod can/ /zla bar dbyangs dang nyi mar gsal byed mtshan/ /de dbus rdo rje'i rtser āḥzhe bar hūṃ/ /yar mar rwa la ā+oṃ hūṃ swā e snri / lī māṃ māṃ two las rigs lngar gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta hūṃ hrī yos ā+oṃ āḥ/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrī lus ā+oṃ āḥ/ ma hā ba smra ta te dzo ba kla ta ba la ba te gu ༅ sa ma ye hūṃ hrīḥlabarjod pas rlung gis me sbar rdzas rnams khol/ /'chi med ra sa ya na nyer zhu ba'i/ /rlangs pa rdo rje'i khong gsang la thon pas/ /rgyal ba kun mchod mdun byon sbyor mtshams nas/ /byang chub rdo rje'i rtser babs āḥ'od zhu/ /de 'od rigs lngar phog zhu hūṃ la 'dus/ /de zhu dbyangs gsal nyi zla kun 'dres pas/ /bdud rtsi phyi nang gsang ba'i rtsa ba brgyad/ /lnga chen brgyud dang yan lag stong 'dus pa'i/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin 'o ma'i mtshor/ /zla ba'i 'od zer shar ba lta bur gyur/ /gtor snod lcags ri mu khyud gtor ma'i rjes/ /gling bzhi ri rab rnam rgyal khang bzang mdzes/ /rgyan rnams 'dod lha dam rdzas bcud kyi 'gro/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin ro brgya'i zas/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan 'phan dar legs bkod pa/ /kun bzang mchod sprin dgos 'dod re ba skong / /raṃ yig yongs gyur lha mo gi twe dmar/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas mkha' gsang las babs pa'i/ /byang sems dmar po'i rang bzhin rak+ta'i mtsho/ /nyi ma stong gi gzi 'od lta bur 'bar/ /me tog spos khang (4ba)dung chos snang gsal bskos/ /sil snyan 'dzin pa'i mchod lha sgeg ldem can/ /rtog med rang byung lus las yongs grub pa'i/ /nang mchod dur khrod rdzas kyi nyer spyod tshogs/ /mnyam sbyor bcu drug dga' bzhi rab spel ba/ /gsang mchod bde stong zung du 'jug par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ ri dhū pe/ ā lo ke /garnye/ ni li du/shasta/ sarba pā dza ā+oṃ āḥshu ca āḥ& ma hā mo sa/ rak+ta ke: ti/ ma hā pañtsa ā+oṃ āḥX 'o āḥsnyi bodhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu gra gu dza ho sman raka gtor gsum gyi rgyu snod bkol ba sogs thun mong du dgos pa dang so —507

rgyal dbang lnga pyong ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (geso'i dmigs bsal rnams ma 'dres par gnad shes pa'i dmigs rim spro bsdu dgos so//gnyis pa bshags pa bya ba ni/hūṃ/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs khyed ni rnam dag dri ma med bdag ni nyon mongs sgrib pas bsgribs nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags:badz+ra sam ya bi shu d+dha ya:ye shes sku mchog ma'ang bya/gzhung du mchod pa/gsol gdab/dbang bzhi sogs gsungs pa nyams len kho na gtso bor 'don na gal che mod/gar mas sogs spros pa che ba'i dus chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bas btang snyoms su bzhag go/gsum pa bskyed rim sgom pa ni/gter gzhung sor bzhag legs par mngon zhing /sprul sku chos ldan pas phyon za hor ma bskyed par gsungs pa ni rat+na gling pa dang pad+ma gling pa sogs kyi gter chos tshad ldan tshor yang snang la ldan ) dran pa'i gsol 'debs su yod pa skabs su babs pas dkyus su bcug cing sku lnga mtshan brgyad mdor bsdus pa so so'i mngon rtogs dang bstun nas gsung rgyun ltar kha bkang ba 'di ltar/ā+oṃ/chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje sems pad+ma rgyal po 'di skad smra dang por chos rnams dmigs med cing :smra brjod bral bar rdzogs pa che:blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom blo bral de yi ngang nyid las sems can kun la khyab pa yi brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom stong nyid snying rje'i ngang nyid las 'gro don dpag med byed pa'i slad rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer bsgom rdo rje'i 'od las gzhal yas khang :pad+ma rin cen 'bar ba spel 'ja' tshon bres pa lta bu'i nang :lte dbus nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan rdo rje gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su rta mgrin dbang wo sku mdog dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu yi gtsug:rta mgo rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog phyag g.yas dbang sdud gri gug 'phyar phyag g.yon thod pa khrag bkang gsol rus pa'i rgyan drug kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud bzhi brdzis nyi zla pad steng 'gying zhing brjid g.yon nas rdo rje phag mos 'khyud cha lugs yab 'dra spyi bo'i gtsug phag zhal mthing kha ngur sgra sgrog gzhen tshul nu ma bha ga rgyas bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs /da zer rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro:de nyid spyi gtsug nyi

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhud dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganazla'i steng : pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: bdag (5ba)nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ā tsar+ya gar+sha ne dkar smug zhal: rdo rje — kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: gsang gos zab ber chos gos dmar pad zhwa sgro dar me long mtshan:snyan rgyan mgul rgyan skyil krung bzhugs: de nyid gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: rang rig bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs su mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs gar 'dzin: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khrud:zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: de yi phang g.yon rig ma ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal ma:bcu drug lon pa gzhen tshul can pad mdog nu ma bha ga rgyas: rin cen rus rgyan cod pan can:phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud phyag g.yon thod pa'i bdud rtsi stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked pa 'khril: sku mdog dkar dmar 'dzum mdangs can skra grol gcer bu 'od ldan bsam:khor yug 'ja' 'dra'i dra bar bsgom bdag nyid chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer dkar po hūṃ los pas/ /zhi ba'i las mdzad thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sku mdog dkar po dar dkar gsol/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ḍā dril bsnams/ /bdag nyid / 'od zer ser po swā 'phros pas/ /rgyas pa'i / sku mdog ser po dar ser gsol/ /rin cen zhags pa ḍā dril bsnams/ /bdag nyidaḥ/ 'od zer dmar po e los pas/ /dbang gi / sku mdog dmar po dar dmar (6na)gsol/ /pad+ma lcags sgrog ḍā dril bsnams/ /bdag nyid—/ 'od zer ljang gu hā los pas/ /mngon spyodaḥ/ sku mdog ljang gu dar ljang gsol/ /rgya gram dril bu ḍā dril bsnams/ /bdag nyidaḥ / 'od zer sna lnga ā+oṃ 'phros pas/ /thamasacad lhun grub / sku mdog smug po zab ber gsol/ /'khor lo dril bu ḍā dril bsnams/ /phyogasamatshams rin cen zur brgyad kyi/ /'dzum steng bar snang 'ja' 'od klong / shar du pad+ma 'byung gnasamathing / /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub yum la 'byud/ /rgyan drug gisaspras skyil krung bzhugs/ shar lhor pad+ma /bha wa/ /dkar smug mdangs can g.yas thod pa/ /rin cen dang ldan g.yon mchog sbyin/ /dge slong chas mdzes gzhone nu'i tshul/ /lto phyogs blo ldan mchog —58

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gesred dkar/ /thod rnga g.yas la bad phor g.yon/ /bdud rtsi ldan pa rin cen rgyan/ /dar dkar lhab lhub na bza' gsol/ /lho nub pad+ma rgyal po dmar/ /lcags sgrog ḍā ru g.yas na bsnams/ /me long yig drug g.yon na 'dzin/ /dar dmar na bza' mdzes par klubs/ /nub phyogs nyi ma 'od zer ser/ /phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /nyi zer zhags 'dzin stag sham can/ /rin cen rus pa'i rgyan drug ldan/ zhub byang shākya seng ge ser/ /phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon lhung bzed/ /bdud rtsi ldan pa chos gos dmar/ /rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ /byang phyogs seng ge sgra (6ba)sgrog mthing / /phyag g.yas lcags rdor g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /thor tshugs dar dmar dor stabs bgrad/ /seng ge'i stod slog stag sham gsol/ /byang shar rdo rje gro lod smug /stag steng rab khros spyan gsum bgrad/ /am gcigs ag tshom g.yas rdo rje/ /g.yon pa phur pas dgra snying gzir/ /gzhan yang nyi dang zer bzhin du/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /dbang bskur byin rlabasalung thob cing / /man ngag ston dang shes rgyud grol/ /'dren byed la sogs bla ma yis/ /steng phyogasabar snang sprin ltar gtibs/ /'od phung dkyil du bzhugs nas kyang / /bdag la byin gyis brlab par gyur/ /pho brang phyogs bzhi pad 'dab bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang rin cen 'bru'i nang khongs zhing gi gdan bzhi la rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : rin cen mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams sku mdog rigs kyi kha dog la: 'khril sbyor rgyan dang cha lugs rnams gtso bo yab yum gnyis ltar bskyed sna tsho gos pad khor phyi ma la bdag skyob lha dang rigs 'dzin dang : rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams dngosagrub ster zhing bar chad sel glu len gar byed rol mo sgrog 'dod yon mchod pa sna tsho gis stob char sprin gtibs pa lta bur gyur zho āḥlha gis gnas gsum mtshan: spyi dpral rna gong g.yas ltag g.yon/ /hūṃ41 swā sgo hā yig rnams/ rab (7na tshe nas la rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs nas/ /ye shes lnga yi dbang rdzogs shog /le'u gsum pa spyan drang ba la gsum —510

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganagyi dang po spyan 'dren pa dngos ni/ gzhung du so so'i yul gyi ming sogs rgyas par 'dug pa sprul sku sman lung pas khyer bder mdzad pa don la tshang zhing legs par snang ba 'di ltar/ hūṃ/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la phyon yul gyi nub byang mtshams pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: yon tan sna tsho gos dngos grub brnyes pad+ma saṃ bha zhes su grags: byin gyis: rā ga rak+ta'i gnas mchoge tso thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub brnyes: blo ldan mchog sred ces su grags: byin gyis ca dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma rgyal po zhes su grags:byin gyisaḥ sos gling gi dur khrod du: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: nyi ma 'od zer zhes su grags byin gyis: za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su: bdud 'dul drag po'i dngos grub brnyes:sha kya seng ge zhes su grags byin gyis: ma ga dha yi grong khyer du: mu stegs bol ba'i dngos grub brnyes: seng ge sgra sgrog ces su grags: byin gyis: (7ba)stag tshang seng ge'i bsam grub tu dregasapa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: rdo rje gro lod ces su grags: byin gyis: // yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling : zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtser pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: grub pa mthar phyin dngos grub brnyes slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la pad+ma thod phreng rtsal du grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi byin gyis snang gnas mchag 'di ru byin phob la sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: byin 'bebs kyi 'gros dang bstun pa'i 'dzab dang bcas/ hrīḥ bde chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal:rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas dngosagrub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gzhal yas nas: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: bdud 'dul ging bzhi gshegs su gsol dpa' bo dpa' mo —511

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gegashegs su gsol:dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ma lus dang :rigs 'dzin r+yā skyong thams cad spyon dbu la thor sa ldems se ldem dar gyi cod pan pur ru sa glu len gar byed khyugs rtse khyug:sil snyan mang po sil li yi:rgyan cha mang bo khrol lo lo rol mo mang po dir ri ri:dpa' bo'i bro brdung khrigs rtse khrig dpa' zha ) 0 glu len kyur ru phu dam lha tshogs yal la la:mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thibs se thib chos skyong las byed thigs se khyug zhub can stong sgra sil li li:lha srin sdebargyad shar ra ra g.yas nas pho rgyud thibs se thib g.yon nasamo rgyud thibs se thib dpal gyi ru mtshon lhabs se lhab mkha' 'gro'i brda skad dir ri ri dpa' bo'i bzhug pa kyur ru phud pa' mo'i gar byed shigs se shig lha gi snang glu dir ri ri phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sang :byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol gnas ma ga 'di ru byin phob la:sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur:bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi 'dzab spel tshig can bzlas pas byin thibs kyis byin par bsam/gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/nyang gter las/hūṃ/rin cen pho brang nyams re dga':dur khrod gzhal yas byin re che pad+ma 'dab bzhi mdangs re gsal:rtog med ro gdan bag re dro nyi zla brtsegs pa 'od re gsal 'i bzhugs pa gnas su dang re spro:gu ru yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dgyes shing byin gyis brlab phyir bzhugs:mos pa'i bu la zhal bstan 'tshal:gsung gi gdams pa'i gnad bsgrag 'tshal:thugs kyi dgongs pa'i sgo dbye 'tshal:'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal:gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī/sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni rang yagazhung las/e ma ho/skye 'gag 'gyur med 'phrin las rdzogs:rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnamasasgrol:yid bzhin dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i thod 'phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo:spros bral bde chen kun bzang mo:rdo rje sman gcig 'tsho rgyal yum bde stong gnyis med thabs shes sbyor yab yum

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganaganyis med phyag 'tshal lo bya byed 'di chos rnam par dag:rang byung thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul:dbang chen rta mchog yab yum la gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo:snang ba yab la stong pa yum:mkha' 'gro ging la phyag 'tshal lo:thams cad chos kyi dbyings su rol:chos srung tsho gos la phyag 'tshal lo:a ti pu ho:spru ti dza ho:bzhi pa mchod pa'i le'u la gsum las/dang po phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/gzhung du mchod pa sngon 'gror mdzad cing las byang du tshogs kyi khongs su bsdus kyang sprul sku chos ldan pa'i phyag len ltar 'dir skabs su babs pas/saḥbla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la:lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni me tog bdug spos mar me dri:zhal zas sil snyan yid 'ong rnams:spyan shangs thugs ka sku lus dang :zhal dang snyan du mchod par 'bul:gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni:put+pa dhū pe/ā lo ke/tho/ni li du/sha lta phu dza ho:hrīḥbla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la:rang byung nang mchod 'dul ba ni:dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog mchod:gsur chen bdug spos dri 9na ) yis mchod:zhun chen snang gsal mar mes chod:rdo rje dri chu'i byugs pas mchod:bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchode:rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod:dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod:dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod:snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod:gu ru de wa ḍa gi nī ma hā sarba pū dza ho〉bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la:'ganyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni:yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun bde ba'i ro mnyam mchod par 'bul:sku lus phyi rgyas ra bzhesasu gsol gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni bo dhi tsit+ta ga na gu tho pā dza ho:zhan byung sman raka 'bul ba rtse lugs gsung rgyun brgyud mchod kyi mjug rnams mos gus gtsor bton gyi bla ma grags che che sna tshogs bkod pa las smin grol gdams pa'i brgyud pa mthar chags med pa'i da lta'i sde gog dang cher rlom tsho'i rnam thar du 'dug pas btang snyoms su bzhag nas 'di ltar/ā+oṃ/rigs 'dzin gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor kun 'dus par//rtsa brgyad stong sbyar ye shes lnga rdzogs rdzas//myong bas 'gro kun grol ba'i bdud rtsi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogeche//sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol//gu ru de wa ḍā gi nī sarba pañtsa a khru ta khā hi//chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs//sprul sku bad 'byung jo mo mkhar chen bza'//khri srong lde btsan gter ston cho ge dbang la//sman mchod4gu ru de wa yar klungs sprul sku dgas 9bskon dbang phyug mtshan//gnyan ston chen po se sdings yab sras gnyis//chos sku 'od zer dpal 'byor dbang phyug la//sman mchod /gu ru de wa /chos kyi dbang po skadze gu ru'i zhabs//thugasasras dbang 'byor khyab bdag khra tshang pa//rigs 'dzin blo gros mchog gi rdo rje la//sman mchod/gu ru de wa/slar yang chos dbang bsam grub kun bzang rje//rigs kun bdag po mgon po bsod nams zhabs//kun mkhyen zur chen chos dbyings rang grol la//sman mchod/gu ru de wa /'gros 'chams dbyangs rol gsal byed kun bzang rtse//bsod nams rgyal mtshan kun bzang rol pa dang //ye shes dbang po chos kyi dbang phyug la//sman mchod/gu ru de wa/rta phag yab yum mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi shing //bdag skyob lha dang rigs 'dzin ḍa zhi'i tshogs//dpal mgon ma ning dam can 'gater srung la//sman mchod/gu ru de wa/rang gter bla ma dngos grub bstan gzigs las/āḥ'adod chags rnam dag pad+ma rak+ta 'di rgyud drug kun sgrol khams gsum dbang du sdud bde mchog bde spyod rak+ta'i mchod pa 'dis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang :gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni mahā rak+ta dz+wa la kha raṃ khā hi:gnyis pa dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/las byang du bskul gyi khongs su bsdus kyang chos ldan pa'i phyag len ltar/hūṃ/rje btsun bla ma gshegs su gsol gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs kyis 'dod yon lnga 0na skon mchod pa 'bul ba kla rgyan gyi sman raka bdud rtsi ཿ zhal zas tshogs kyi jo ting 'dzin rtse gcig bla ma rigs 'dzin mchod pa bzhes:yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams chagang gi tshogs cad pa' bo'i tshogs dpa' mo'i tshogs hūṃ/rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang :mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang re spro dur khrod gnas mchog nyams re dga':zhing chen bla bre rgyan dang ldan:/ sna snying sna bsam mi khyab:spro dga' gnas kyi

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganamachod pa 'bul lha/ snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzheng du srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyar dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'gying ba 'di: ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs re mtho:ma mo'i gtor ma pad+mas bskor ba 'di gling bzhi gling phran pas kyang bkod re legs: dkar gyi thig btab dmar gyi gur phub pas gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che: rak+ta dmar gyi a lha sbreng ba 'di: rgya mtsho'i mching nam bas kyang rgya re che: bdud rtsi sman gyis gtor ma bran pa 'di lha yi zhal zas bas kyang ro ro bda' dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha chen dri chen dang : dri chu byug pa'i rdzas te rnam pa lnga: seng ge rta dang glang chen ba lang dang : mchog chen mi la sogs te rnam pa lnga: ma hā mo sal sogs sha sna stong : ma hā tsi ta la sogs snying sna stong : dbang po lnga dang go ro tsa na dang : ba su ta dang nang khrol rnam pa lnga shing tog me tog 'bru sna sman sna dang : zan dang 'khur ba (10ba)thug pa'i bye brag dang : mar thud phrum dang zho dang 'o mar bcas: tsi dang tsa ru tsi r+pā go stod dang : sga dang lan tshwa spod kyi bye brag dang : ri sgog klungs sgog sha mo sna tshogs dang : bza' dang bca' ba btung ba'i bye brag dang : gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tshogs kun:thogs med blo yis thams cad kun bsdus nas: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs te:bdud rtsir gyur pa'i gtor ma chen po 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam skongs gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro sdebazhi'i tsha dpa' bo ging bzhi'i pa dam can srung ma'i mchod par 'os pa'iḥ gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni ma hā ba kla ta 'a hi gsum pa tshogs mchod ni/ ā+oṃ sarba dri bye saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa:bdud rtsi tsho gis la gtor zhing ma dag pa rnams bsangs nas sbyang bar/ hūṃ/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tsho gis 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge spro re raṃ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: tha yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtar: zhe kho las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkru: spel ba ni: ྅/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas byin gyis brlab pa'i yi ge spro: ྅ hūṃ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyangs: ā āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsi bsgyur: zho ā+oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid gang : hrī:hrī:yis mthong snang lha tshogs dgyes: de nas —515

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2potsho gis kyi yo byad rnams: kye gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: 'di la the tshom byar mi rung :bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag: rang (11na lnga zhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: zhes drangs/ a la lahorin thang med las legs 'ong chos: 'dod chags dri ma rnam par dag gzung dang 'dzin pa kun spangs pa'i de bzhin nyid ni bdag kyang 'tshal: a ho ma hā su kha lho zhes blang / gter gzhung du rtog pa bsal ba 'di'i gong du mchod pa dang / sprul sku chos ldan pa'i las byang sgom rim du bskang ba bya bar gsungs shing / rtse lugs chos ldan pa'i chog sgrigs la mtshams 'dir 'dzab dang bskang ba bya zer ba 'dug rung mchod pa gong du song zin cing / 'dzab bskang 'og tu 'byung bas btang snyoms su bzhag la/ de nas tshogos phud spros te/ dang po ni/ hūṃ/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das sangasargyas kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogis kyi mchod pa bzhes:sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni ga ṇa tsakra sarba gu dza la khā 〉 bar pa ni/hūṃ/ sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar ma rig bdag cag lusang ga sems rtsab yan lag dam nyamasapa 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags badz+ra sa ma ya tha ma ni/ ye las lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang / :ra tri yongs gyur dgra dang bgegs kyi gzungs/ /nyam thag bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag /yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings gsal bar gyur/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon cog rtsa gsum lha/ /snying po phyag rgya gsang sngags rig sngags dang / khyad par dbang (11bskreg pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /lha tshogs bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs mthus/ /bstan 'gro yongs la 'tshe ba spyi yi dgra /rigs 'dzin bdag la bsdob sgos kyi dgra /bod khams 'phung byed dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs/ /dmigs rten gzugs kyi nya pho 'di la khug /ā+oṃ badz+ra ku sha dza rtswa badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra gharnye sngo zhes dgug gzhug byas la/ zil gnon 'don dang bcas/ hūṃ/ che mchog pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs g.yon pa phur bus dgra snying gzir gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog rtswa badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra gī li ki lī ya ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rā ya ga me ra ra dza ya —516

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganaraṃ dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa rtswa āḥ&/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: badz+ra sa mā dza:snar ni sha/ dgra bgegs nga po mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa: a yaṃ rbad: ces cha lung khrus lung gi sgo nas phur pa gtab la bsgral te rnam shes spar/ de yang nyang ston chen po'i bstan pa dar dus gtun rngam gyi rjes su bka' brgyad bsgral 'chams mdzad srol yod 'dug kyang / rin po che kun bzang rtse nas kyis bsgral 'chams yongs rdzogs bzhag ste drag sngags so lnga par brten nas mdor bsdus tsam mdzad cing / bka' brgyad rang gi skabs drag sngags la phyag rgya las zhabs kyi stang stabs mi 'dug rung / stang stabs 'di kun bzang rtse ba'i dgongs gter lta bu 'chams dbyangs gnyis ka shugs che zhid legs par snang la/ zhal gdams gsang thems las/ (12na〉nga bsgrubs sangs rgyas thamasacad 'grub nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong : nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yin: zhes bde gshegs ni khro rab mas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir bka' brgyad kyi bsgral las sbyar ba khungs dang 'brel gyi/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi sgos bka' la bka' brgyad dzi'i thun brdeg pa sogs sbyar ba'i mu cor gyi gtam dang 'dra ba ni min no/ /slar nan gyis bsgral ba thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i tshogs tha ma'i dbyangs tshig yin cing / 'di'i sngon du ma mo spyan drangs nas/ der mos pa ni/ rigs 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pa'i 'bru 'grel du/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i sku dang / phur pa ya ka kro ta ra gsal bar gsung ba gzhan dag gis gsan gzigs ma byung ba'i skyon du sems so/ /des na tshogs len gyi stang stabs dang bcas skye ba'i sgo lnga rtsad bcad phyir gnas lngar phur bu gdab/ de rjes ma mo spyan 'dren dang bcas pa'i 'gros kyis tshogs brgyad bsgral te phyir mi ldog pa'i ched du gnas dgur phur bug dab cing mtshon chas gtubs nas/ rtsa brgyud rigs 'dzin kun 'dus thod 'phreng rtsal/ /bde gshegs zhi khro yongs rdzogs 'khor lo'i lha/ /mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas rnams la/ /dug gsum dbyings su bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dgra —517—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebagegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ 'a hi 1 ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces zhal stob bya/ rgyu gnyis rkyan sbyar 'bru bcud (12ba 'di/ /dug lnga sman gyur dam pa'i rdzas/ /dza gad dpa' bo'i bdud rtsi 'dis/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam bskang / /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta dza gad 'a hi/ 'di sman gtor rak+ta'i rjes su bdud rtsi gsang ba nan tan gyi tshul du tshar lnga 'bul bar bshad pa'i bka' brgyad kyi tshig yin la/ bla ma'i las gzhung rnams dang rigs 'dzin rat+na'i 'bru 'grel du mi gsal yang ling ro la bdud rtsi sbran pa 'bul chad du sman lung chos ldan pas sbyar ba ni/ bka' ma'i gsung rgyun du/ 'chi med pañtsa a skṛ ta/ /ro yi khams rnams slong bar byed/ /dug gi khams rnams 'joms par byed/ /rtsi mchog sman gyi mchod pa bzhes/ /zhes dang / khro rol gyi stob pa'i skabs bdud rtsi sman 'di zhal du stob ces pa yod pas khungs btsun pa'o/ /de nas tsho gos kham gcig bcad la/ ho/ zhal zas tshogis kyi mchod pa 'di/ /'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod rgyan/ /dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las dbyung / /tsho gos kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol/ a la la ho gter gzhung dang chos ldan pa'i der tshig rkang phyi ma ma gtogs mi 'dug kyang /rgyal sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi cho ga khrigs su bka' brgyad nas kha bkang ba ltar byas pa yin no/ /lnga pa 'dzab kyi le'u la gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa yiPROB PROB āḥ// badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ ā+oṃ āḥ// badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phrong rtsal/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā:gsum pa las la sbyor ba ni/ khyuḥm hā ri ni sar tsa hri ya tsit+ta hri hri dzaḥ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi dmigs (13na)pa gter gzhung dang brgyud ldan dam pa'i zhal lung las blangs te nyams su len dgos la/ sdor dkar du tshul 'chos pa'i sgrib shing du sha chang phung por spungs pa'i chas bcu mkhan po cher rlom stong 'ur can rnams kyi spyod yul ni ma yin no/ /'phrin sgrub/ dgongs bskyang /rtags rnams kyang gzhung dang zhal gdams las len dgos pa'i dbang du byas shing / khyad par dgongasapa bskyang ba ni man ngag gi snying po yin pas khyab gdal du 'dri ba sogs kun gyi spyod yul ma yin no/ /drug pa thugs dam bskang ba'i le'u la gsum las/ dang po rdzas kyis sku la bskang ba ni/ mchod —518

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganapa'i rdzas su gyur 3 dang /khyad par mar me dang bdud rtsi thogs la/mdun gyi rten la skor ba 'chams stabs bya'o//gnyis pa bshags tshig gis gsung la bskang ba ni/hūṃ/dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir:gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang :sgrub rdzas gnyan po gzhung bzhin bshams lags na:bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam gnyan skongs te rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol zhig/nai ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo :le'u brgyad rtsa bar/zhes pa lan bdun bskyar zhing bskang :bskang gso'i cho ga gzhan yang bya:rjes su na rag la sogs te:rus gzungs bzhi yi bshags pa bya:zhes byung bas ru lu lan bdun bskyar:bskang gso gzhan sgyu 'phrul skong bshags ltar ram:nyang lugs gu ru zhi ba dang ཿ13ba ) bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi bskang ba/na rag dong sprug wo mo dang /brjod med kyi bshags pa/rdo rje dpal wo/ye shes mkha' 'gro ste rus gzungs bzhi po spro na bya/gsum pa lta bas thugs la bskang ba ni/kun gzhi ma bcos klong yangasanas rang rig rang gsal kun tu bzang :gdod nas ma skyes kun bzang mo:gnyis med bde ba r+pā po la bskang dang bshags bya bshags pa'i yul:rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku:chos kyi sku la gnyis su med gnyis med rtogs pas thugs dam bskang :de ltar rtogs na bskang bshags mchog:bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba'i le'u la gsum las/dang po gtor ma sman raka gi mchod pa ni/dam rdzas gtor chen bshags pa yang :rtsa gsum lha tshogs bsnyen phyir 'bul:bdud rtsi sman mchod sbreng ba yang :rtsa gsum byu rak+tas bkang ba yang :rtsa gsumang du ra khrod rdzas chen bkram pa yang :rtsagasum rkang gling thod rnga sgrog pa yang :rtsa gsum zhun chen snang gsal gtams pa yang :rtsa gsum mo sa'i gsur dud btang ba yang :rtsa gsum 'dod yon ro mchog spungs pa yang :rtsa gsum thugs dam gnyan po skongs gyur la g.yar dam nyams chags sor stsol zhig:gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni ma hā ba kla ta la khā stim hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la ji stim hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi khā gi ho/dam rdzas mchode pa 'di dag kun gnyis med mnyam paX 14na jing du 'bul lags na:blang dor med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (popa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang :thim pa'i tshul gyis dgyes pa chen por rol phyon rdo rje 'chang gtso 'khor rnams phyag len ltar spyan drangs par bka' drin can ma'i gsol 'debs bya/gnyis pa bla ma yi dam ḍā ki la bstod pa ni/gyim bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku:gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung :thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das:sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstod:'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med:bkra shis yon to du mas brgyan ba'i sku 'jig rten dbang sgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal:rgyasapa'i las mdzad rat+na thod 'phreng rtsal dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal mngon spyod las mdzad ga rma thod 'phreng rtsal thams cad lhun grub brnya thod 'phreng rtsal 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod dpa' mo'i 'gros/mtshan brgyad kyi bstod gar rnams tshig dang bstun dgos pa/hrī la chags skyon gyis ma gos pa'i pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la bstod yon tan thams cad rab rdzogasapa'i pad+ma saṃ bha'i shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i blo ldan mchog sred khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud pad+ma 14na ) rgyal po'i rmonges pa'i mun sel 'gro ba 'dul nyi ma 'od zeralog 'dren bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa'i shākya seng ge'i pa mu stegs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa'i seng ge sgra sgrogang dregs pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i rdo rje gro lod las byang gi brjod don dang bstun na gang rnams skabs 'dir bya ba 'thad cing /deng sang 'chams dbyangs bde chen gling pa'i lugs yin zer ba'i bskal me mar sbyar ba ni gter gzhung 'di ga'i snang ba ma 'gags sogs yod bzhin du gzhan nas yin pa mtshal dang btsag gi dpe dang /ging zhes pa zur chag ste legs sbyar du kiṅka ra'i sgras las ci bgyi zhes pho nya bka' sdod kyi spyi ming yin la/bskal me ma rta mgrin gcig pur sbyar bas shes bya mtha' bkag pa gu dog ches/nga /rang gter du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang dam

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'du sogazhud dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma (ga)can srung ma tshang ma yod pas tshig don 'brel chags pa'i phyir shes ldan yod tshe rig pa'i dngas snyigs 'byed par rigs so//gyi snang ba ma 'gags thugs rje chen po'i sku rta mgrin dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i klong :rdo rje phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las thugs rje ma 'gagasacir yang ston cing sprul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam can srung ma'i tsho gos la phyag 'tshal bstod:phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu gar ba la snon ma dang bcasakhyed 'dir tshogs sogs kyi glu gar bya bas mtshon te ldan〉gong 'og gi gar 'chams la dgos pa'i gdangs dbyangs kyi 'don cha zur pa rnams 'chams yig tu gsal bas dkyus su ma bkod de/mjug gi cho ge drug gi bstod pa tsam ma gtogs ma bkod cing /spro na dkyus dang zhib cha zhal lasashes so//gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba dngos ni rgyas par byed na gter gzhung bzhin grags mtshan grub pa thob tshul sogs byed kyang ha cang mangs pas rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa sprul sku chos ldan pa'i chog sgrigs ltar/hūṃ/ma g.yel ma g.yel rigs 'dzin tshogs:ma g.yel ma g.yel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ma g.yel ma g.yel ging gi tshogs ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can tshogs:྅/rje btsun pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal rang bzhin gnas nas sku skyod la:mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos rnams gshegs su gsol ging gi tshogs dpa' bo'i tshogs cad pa' mo'i dam ho ཿ chos kyi dbyings nas sku skyod la:rdo rje phag mos byin gyis rlomes dur khrod gnas nas sku skyod la:mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis byinanam mkha'i dbyings nas sku skyod la rdo rje phra men cha rgya mtsho'i klong nas sku skyod la:mtsho gling mkha' 'gros phyogs bzhi'i gnas nas sku skyod la las byed mkha' 'gros ཿ gangs dkar rtse la sku skyod la rdo rje ging chen ཿ / hūṃ/lho nub rnga yab gling phran na pad+ma 'od kye gzhal yas khang :gnas mchog dam pa nyams re dga' gnas mchogo nyams su ldan spra dga' phu rje btsun pad+ma thod 'phreng dang :ye shes mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal gnyis skye 'chi med pa'i skur bzhengs nas srin po rnams la dam chos ston:

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'amakha' 'gro sde bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor ging chen sde bzhi bran du 'khol lha srin sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis 'dul dbu la rin cen rgyan gyis spras rus pa'i rgyan cha khrol lo lo: sil snyan mang po sil li li: rgyan cha mang po pur ru sa rol mo mang po dir ri ri glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur mos pa'i bu ldobyin gyis rlomes: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag so so yi: 'phrin las myur du khyed kyis sgrubs bsgral ba'i zhing bcu khyed kyisasgrol: sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs: dkon cog dbu 'phang khyed kyis bstod rnal 'byor sgos dgra khyed kyis thul lha 'dre mi gsum khyed kyis sdus: 'byung bzhi'i bar chad khyed kyis sol: dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi bar mdzod brgyad pa mthar rgyas kyi le'u la gsum las/ dang po dngos grub blang ba ni/ rtse lus mchogo sgrigs su mjug na 'dug rung / gter gzhung du gral mchod las dngos grub lan pa ma byung / sprul sku chos ldan pa'i sgom khog dang rgyal sras kyi le'u gsum (16na sgor yang chad mtho'i gong du byung la/ thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa dang / nor bu rgya mtsho sogs gter kha gzhan gyi le'u brgyad ma tshor yang de dang mthun pas go rim dkyus bzhin 'thad par mngon/ de yang gtor ma shes pa rnam pa gsum gyi skabs 'dir lhar shes nas rang gis dbang len pa dang g.yin la bskur ba rgyal sras dbang chen gyi le'u gsum ma ltar gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig ma bskur bar gsungs pa shin tu legs shing / spro na bla ma'am/ de min mdun bskyed la slob dpon gsol btab/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon 'dren pa'i gtso bdag cag las 'phro skal ba can rang gzhan don kun bsgrub bya'i phyir dbang chen yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab ste dbang bskur ba dngos ni: e ma ngo mtshar med du byung : bla ma rnams dang gcig pa dang : yi dam lha dang dbyer med cing : mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas rtsa ba gsum gyi —522

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtogadabyin rlabs kyi sku gsung thugs dbang yongs rdzogs pa skal ldan 'di la bskur thob shog zho āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: gu ru de wā ḍā gi ni: dzo gi ni kā ya a bhi khiñtsa 'o: lha ka a bhi sa ṣañtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṇiñtsa snro ka ya wā ka tsita a bhi ṇiñtsa ā+oṃ āḥ/ lha kā ya wā ka tsit+ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ye swā ༈ zhes pa dang / (16bti tsam ma grub kyang nyang chorme ldan pa'i sgom rim dang thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i 'bru 'grel ltar thog nas 'byung ba'i gu ru de wa sogs sngags tshig gis bskur te dbang bzhi dmigs pas blangs nas mthar gtor ma dngos grub tu shes dgos kyi cher rlom bla dpon yi 'dun sa mang por shes pa rnam pa gsum gyi brda chad ma chags pa'i zan gong mgo la bzhag nas badz+ra gu ru brjod pa ni bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ zab mo thugs sgrub las/ bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i klong yangs nas rgyal ba'i 'khor lo sras bcas thugs dam can: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng gi: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dngos grub mchog: 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal:bum pa bzang po dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul: da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol 'di man sprul sku chos ldan pa'i kha stong ste/ 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gag med gsung giḥ 'khrul med thugs kyiḥ yon to re skong 5 'phrin las 'gro 'dulaḥ 'chi med tshe yi 'dzad med longs spyod pa thun mong yid bzhinaḥ bla med mchog gi cha ṅgā skuḥ/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phrong rtsal: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sirnyi pha la hūṃ/ zhes phyag len rnams mthong brgyud ltar bya/ gtor phud/ sreg rdzas su dbul ba dang / gralamachod ni ma byas kyang skyon du mi 'gyur la byed par spro na gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /ma ning dang gter srung gi bskang ba (17na po sol mchod/ sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la gtor bsngo byed dgos kyi rigasakyang 'dir bya ba'am yang na bstod pa'i mjug lta bur byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /gsang 'dusagater gzhung du tsho gis lhag gi gsol kha ma byung zhing / gter kha 'di ga'i thams cad kyi bla sgrub rang rkya pher ba bdun yod pa'i bla ma gsang ba yongs rdzogs su 'dug pa 'brel chags kyang ha cang mangs —523
