rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (geskyon nas to chos ldan pa'i las byang ltar/hūṃ/dang po phud kyis mi mar du pad+ma he ru ka nyid gnyan bar du lhag mas mi mchod du ma dang mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes tha mar gcig tu mi bsre phuganyis med cho ge sku gcig las byung :྅/bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ga yum chen rdo rje phag mo la bka' yi lhag sdud tshogs kyis bskor:lhag ma'i tsho gos la rol pa rnams:'dir spyon bka' yi lhag gtor bzhes:bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod:ces gtore ma gtsang sar 'bul/gnyis pa gtor ma gzhan la btang ba ni/chos skyong gi gtor ma sogs phyir bsdud la/chad mtho bya ba bla ma yongs rdzogs dkar chag tu stod smad las kyi mde kha nyi shu rtsa gcig ces byung ba'i chad mtho'i mde kha yum gyis mdzad pa las/hūṃ bh+yoḥsngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la 'og min gnasamachog bde chen pho brang du:bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru gas rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags nas snang srid ma mo btul:tha tshig gsum gyis dam la btags pa'i tshe rdo rje phag mo la sogasamakha' 'gro bye ba brgyas so 17ba〉so'i gzugs mchogo dam pa bstan nas kyang :yal gam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang :bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la brag dmar bsam yas ārla pā gling du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang :shesarab yum chen mkhar chen 'tsho rgyal gyis dbang chen yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe dur khrod gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang :dregs nga sde brgyad bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis so so'i gzugs mchag dam pa bstan nas kyang :yal gam bka' yi gtor pa bcol ba'i sngon tshe sha khrag pa thugs dam de 'og bskal pa tha ma'i dus kyi tshe:rnga yab gling phran zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser:slob dpon wo po pad+ma thod phreng dang :rigs 'dzin chos dbang laṅka'i lis cas kyis gsang ba sgrub chen dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe bse ༷ma mkha' 'gro bka' sdod sgrol ging bzhes so

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhud dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa la byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganaso'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : yal gamaḥ bka' yi bcol ba'iḥ sngon tshe: sha khrag: thugs dam: de yang mgon po dus mtshan/ shel ging dkar po/ bse ging dmar po/ nag po skra than te sgrol ging bzhi dang re ma tī mched bzhi 'khril sbyor du yod cing gter gzhung sor (18na)gnas su dkyus ltar yin rung deng sang 'dus che ba'i dbang du byas nas dam can rgya mtsho chos skyong srung ma yis zhes pa so so'i gzugs mchog gi gong du 'jug srol 'dug pa byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /hūṃ/ mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs ā mi zhedas shig bzhedasashig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs rtswa/ bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du bskul gyi mdzod cig mdzod cig bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: ces pa 'di bka' brgyad gtor mar ma zad bka' ma'i spyi bskul gnyags kyis mdzad pa la'ang yod cing rin po che kun bzang rtse ba'i phyag rgyun du 'dug pas byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /bshal chus bstan ma bskyang ba 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir bka' brgyad ltar bkod pa ni/ bstan pa skyong mdzad ma dang sring : dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma me stag zla 'od byang rgyal ma gser thang kun bzang shan+ti dpal klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis gtor ma long : mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnamasabazlog rtswa āḥlha badz+ra a skṛ ta khā sti ma ma hri ma ma hri 'a hi khā hi: zhes bshal chu dor nas gtore gzhed kha sbub la rtswa lo hūṃ lo dgra bgegs sha / nga ya nan: zhes rta bro bya ste/ hūṃ gyi rta yi brtulazhugs chen po ni bdag nyid chen po'i skur bsgoms te: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i phung po la: gtum wo rngams pa'i sgra sgrog cing : dbang byu rta skad tser re re: khro po'i bro brdung 'ur ru phu dpal gyi rta (14)skad dir ri ri rol ba'i rta gro chems se chem: gsang ba'i bzhug pa kyur ru phu bskal pa'i glog dmar ldibs se ljib: rdo rje'i thog 'bebs lams se lam / gis dbang sgyur khamasagasum g.yo phaṭa kyi sprul pas 'jig rten khyab re gis me 'bar thams cad bsregs gcan gzan mu kha sprin ltar gtibs: ga sko 'dab chags skar ltar 'khrug: sngon gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i —525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogephyir:kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings su khams gsum yongs sgrol mdzad pa'i tshe za byed wo po'i dkyil 'khor du dug lnga 'dus pa'i phung po la:gcan gzan chen po'i bro brdungs pas:bdag tu lta ba'i zhe sdang bcoms:khrag 'thung chen po'i dkyil 'khor du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba la:ma tshogs ḍa zhi'i kun tu chen pa'i 'dod chags bcoms:rngam chen 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor du:gti mug sha chen spungs pa la:sder chags 'dus pa'i rmonges pa'i gti mug ngo bo bcoms:gtum chen khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du:dbang ba yan lag rdzogs pa la:gshog pa rdo rje'i cha kun tu rmongasapa'i phrag dog bcoms 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbus kyi khri rkang zlum po la:rdo rje mchu yi rnga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal bcoms sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dug gsum 'joms pa'i las byas pas sngon gyi dam tshig byu po skongs ma tshogs shā zhi'i dkyil 'khor du:to gan sprul pa'i las byas pas:rnal 'byor bskang ba'i cho ga rdzogs dbang 19na skosko gar gyi dkyil 'khor du bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i las byas pas khams gsum bsgral ba'i cho ga rdzogasaphyag brnyan chen po'i dkyil 'khor du:bka' 'das bsgral ba'i las byas pas ru dra mnan pa'i cho ga rdzogs:zho ba dza kro dha sirnyi hūṃ/ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa:gtor gzheng kha snyen nas/rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi tshe dpal 'byor pa thams cad zla ba yar gyi de bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig/pusti ku ru ye swā hā/zor 'phen gtor mnan sogasakyi rjes tshe 'gugs pa snga 'gyur gyi spyi lugs yin pas chos dbang rin po che'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi le'u bdun pa las/hrī:mkha' mnyam tshe bdag 'od dpag med//chos kyi dbyings nas tshe khug la//tshe yi dngos grub 'dir stsol zhig/bdud rtsi'i byu 'bebs bdud rtsi che//longs sku'i ṣ+ka nas /tshe yi dngos grub/snang srid dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal//'byung lnga'i klong nas/tshe yi dngos grub /ye shes 'tsho rgyal tshe yi lha//srid pa gsum gyi /tshe yi dngos grub/rtsa brgyud bla ma tshe dbang rgyal//ye shes lnga yi tshe yi dngos grub /rang byung ye shes skye ༷chi med//'khor 'das gnyis kyi/tshe yi dngos

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganagrubaḥ/ ye shes mkha' 'gro tshe yi lha/ /mkha' la sprin tshogs gtibs pa bzhin/ /tshe dang bsod nams gtib tu gsol/ /bdud 'dul ging bzhi tshe yi lha/ /nags la me chen sbar ba bzhin/ /tshe dang bsod nams sbar du gsol/ /dpa' bo yab (19ba〉kyim pho nya mo/ /sdebargyad lag na tshe khug la/ /tshe dang bsod nams gtib tu gsol/ /ā+oṃ tshe ra g.yu zlo g.yu tshe zlo ā rkang g.yu tshe sne/ zhes brjod/ dbang bskur ba bskul gyi rjes su byed pa gtso che zhing zab kyang dngos grub tsam len na skabs 'dir mdzad pa mang la dbang yang len mi rung ba min pas khro rol gyi gces pa'i lde mig tu/ nang du log la tshe 'gugs bya: gu ru'i dngos grub gtor ma yis: bdag gzhan kun la dbang bskur bya 'dzab bzlas dngos grub rdzas la rol: zhes pa dang 'brel lo: le'u brgyad gter gzhung dang chos ldan pa'i sgom rim chog khrigs rnams su dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i gsal kha ma byung ba/ sras pad dbang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu mi dgos pa'i shes byed mdzad pa dang dgongs pa gcig pa thog mtha' bar du rang sems dang bla ma dbyer med kho na'i ngang nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba las spros pa g.yin la rag ma lus par rang sems ka dag don gyi bla mar gnas pa ni dkyil 'khor bsdu chog yin pas/ de'i don gsang 'dus gzhung gi rjes chag nyams chags bskang ba ni/ spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: sku mdog shel 'dra'i thugs ka nas: zla steng hūṃ las yig brgyas bskor: de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs: bdag gi nyams chags sgrib dag gyur ces brjod cing gtor mgron sogs mdun bskyed rnams kyang thugs ga'i hūṃ la bsdus/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /dgyes pa chen pos rang la thim/ /(20na〉nga yang kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i/ /ngang la yid ni 'dzin pa bral rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku: zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa smon lam gdab cing shis pa brjod pa ni: e ma ho: bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du bskal pa dpag med tshun chad nas tha ma da lta thug gi bar bdag gi lusang ga yid gsum —527—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegyis: bla ma skyes mchogo yi dam lha: sangs rgyas byang sems ḍā ki'i tshogs sgom sgrub mchod cing bstod pa dang : bris bklag bcangs shing kun chub bgyis: lha sgom la sogs dge spyad pa'i 'brasabu dus 'dir smin gyur nas: kun mkhyen ye shes mchog thob shog: gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi: bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs shing : dus gsum pha mas sna drangs pa'i 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun: bla ma mchog gi rjes bzung nas yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog shesabya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog gang la bsams pa de 'grub pa'i: don grub mchog gi bkra shis shog: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga nas phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog:ces shis pa brjod cing me tog sil ma phyogs kun tu gtor te phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston gyi dpal la rol bar bya'o/ /bla ma sgrub pa'i las byang le'u brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ rang gzhung tshugs shing sgrub thabs kun gyis kha skongs rdzogs so/ /'dir mkha' 'gro'i bde yig tsig 'dug kyang 'god thabs med rkyen ma dper gzigs mdzod// de'ang gter kha gong 'og gi bla ma zhi drag gi skor la snga 'gyur (20ba〉spyo'i las byang dang mi 'dra ba'i rang skad zur pa yod par rgyal sras pad+ma dbang chen gyis las byang le'u gsum pa'i chog bsgrigs mdzad pa khrigs kyi rim pa gter gzhung 'di ga'i lugs dang mi 'dra ba'i rnying ma spyi gzhung dang mthun shas che ba sogs kyi snon phri 'ga' zhig byung ba/ gter ston gyi thugs sras dang lang 'gro lo tsā ba'i skye brgyud sogs nas khungs mi btsun pa ma yin rung / ka thog rdor bzang gis/gter gzhung le'u brgyad la brten nas/ /dbang chen le'u gsum pa mdzad/ /des kyang dgongs pa cung ma lon/ /gsang 'dus gzhung dang 'gal ba mang / /zhes dpyad pa mdzad cing le'u gsum ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po 'phrin las rnam rgyal mtsho skyes ba 'ad pa'i dbang pos chog bsgrigs mdzad 'dug pa sogs gsang chen rnying ma'i ring lugs la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i gsung yin pas bzhed pa mi 'dra'ang log rtog gi yul min la/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas bzung / zi na chos kyi dbang phyug gi bar du byon pa'i sngags —528

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtogada'achang grub brnyes mkhyen dpyod can rnams kyi gsung rgyun phyag bzhes yid rton pa'i gnas yin na'ang /rtse lugs su grags pa'i chog sgrigs la'ang rjes 'jug 'dras lhad cung zad bcug par mngon zhing / skar lugs pa dag las 'brel rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro 'bum bskul snon pa/ 'brug lugs pa 'dres gter kha gong 'og bsre ba sogs gang dran lag tu len pa ni stobs 'byor sgyu thabs kyi phu 'khyer dang bcas phyogs 'dir ma 'dris pa'i mun pa'i mda' 'phen du zad (21na〉sgod/ 'on kyang bde mchog dang bka' brgyad kyi rten brten par dpe blangs te rna bar thos tshad kyi srung ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mgon mang dang / lus phyed gdong la gdong phyed kha'i tshad du byed pa'i srung ma dang / yum la yab kyis phar 'khril ba'i zhal gzigs ma sogs mgal dum 'phrong bar bsgrigs pa'i spun zlar mthong bas tshes bcu'i las byang du ming btags pa tsam la yid brtan du ma bzung bar gter byon gyi gsang 'dus gzhung dang las byang / sprul sku chos ldan pa'i sgom rim dang chog bsgrigs rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun rnams tshad thub kyi dbang por byas pa yin no/ /dusagasum rgyal kun mkhyen brtse 'i nus pa gzugs/ /sprul sku'i sgyu 'phrul gar bsgyur pad+ma 'byung / /yang zab thugs sgrub kun gyi rtser son pa/ /gnam skas klu bdud sku stod bla ma'i skor/ /zab zab dbyangs su len pa'i chos mang yang / /mngon sum zhal mjal byin rlabs lung ston par/ /byed nus mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs dngar po'i ro/ /'thul 'di skal bzang kun da bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /zog rdzun 'ug pa ltar sbos cher rlom 'ga'i/ /blos byas lag len mu rta'i phye 'gam par/ /gtan bde'i bcud du re rnams tho ba yis/ /pha mgo bcoms pas sangs rgyas thob sems bzhin/ /rang gzhung dngos bstan dor nas gter gzhan len/ /la la phyes 'gyur cho ga'i rgyas 'gebs byed/ /gna' bo'i sgros dang dpe hrul rjes 'jug pa/ /tshad ldan bstan pa'i grangs (21ba)su 'dren rnams rmongs/ kho bo mdo rgyud gtsug lag mang du thos/ /yang dag ltar snang 'byed pa'i blo mig gsal/ /de phyir grags skam cal sgrog rjes rgyug dang / /gzhan zer tshig gi 'khar bar ga la brten/ /tshad ldan rdo rje'i slob dpon yun du —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gebasten/ /smin grol gdams pa'i gnad kyi 'phreng la bcur/ /rang rig bla mar shes pa'i nyams len bskyangs/ /rigs 'dzin sgrub por rlom yang mi gnod tsam/ /snga 'gyur bka' gter gzhung lugs mang mang thos/ /thos tsam ma yin 'bad pas ngal ngal bsams/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'khrul med yang yang bsgoms/ /bsgoms don smra ba'i brtul zhugs brtan brtan rnyed/ /de 'dra khyab bdag kun tu bzang po dang / /dbyer med chos bzhin spyod mdzad yongs 'dzin 'ga'i/ /zla med bka' drin dran pa'i mod nyid la/ /snying dbus dad pa'i 'dab brgya ci yang bzhad/ /dge 'dis skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa yi/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar ba'i gzis/ /gangs can rgyad pa'i mun pa mthar sangs nas/ /phan bde'i snang ba rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang las byang le'u brgyad pa 'khrugs pa sdebs su tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i dus bklags pas don kun lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar zhes pa 'di ni zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi drung du khro chu'i klu bdud kyi sku stod dang rked pa nas bla ma'i sgrub skor thems can bdun byon pa'i lnga tsam gyi lung rags rim/ pad+ma (22na cud 'phreng gsang mtshan gyi sgrub pa'i smin byed kyi bka' drin mnos shing / rigs kun khyab bdag khra tshang ba blo mchog rdo rje'i drung du gter kha 'di'i bla sgrub thems can thems med yod do cog gi dbang khrid lung man ngag yongs su rdzogs par thob pa la brten nas smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho ba za hor gyi rigs las sngags smyon gang shar rang grol gyis zhi ba zhes pa sa mo bya'i lo chu shel gyi dbang po mgos nya ba'i rgyal ba'i tshes la rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams la dpal ldan kun bzang rtse ba'i phyag bzhes kyi gar 'chams dbyangs rol dang 'brel ba'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa 'dzugs pa'i sta gon gyi tshe mchod gtor brlab pa/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ dbang bskur/ sman phud/ rgyun mchod/ tshogs tha ma'i bsgral las stob pa rnams tshig sbyor gsar du bsdebs/ mtshan brgyad mngon rtogs gsung rgyun ma'i tshig zur bsgyur/ de phyin gter gzhung dang gong ma'i gsung 'phros rnams byin —530

gter kha 'og ma'i gsang 'dus gzhung dang le'u brgyad pa bsdebs pa las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganarlabs kyi tshan kha che ba'i phyir rang sor bzhag ste sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin dang 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang gnyis kyis ci rigs par bgyis pa sirnyi ra sdu/ / gaṅgā'i rdul snyed grangs kyi cha tsam du/ /bskrun par mi nus zhi khro'i rten brten pa/ /kun kyang rang rig khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /gcig las du mar 'char ba 'phrul po che/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /yid srubs sde las rnam par rab rgyas pa'i/ /gzhan phan lhun grub zung 'jug bde chen gar/ /legs bsgyur rig sngags 'chang ba'i bshad sgrub gling / /gang bde'i rgyun gyi nyams bzhes zhal 'don rnams/ /phyogs gcig yi ger nyer bkod pusti gaḥ/ mchod sbyin 'dzad med par gyi sgo 'byed pa/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i lde mig deng 'dir bskrun/ /gangs ri brgya phrag zla zhun gyis byugs las/ /ches dkar rnam dag bsam pas phyogs 'di la/ /sgo gsum 'bad dang mthun rkyen nyer sbyor ba'i/ /byed por gtogs so cog gi lus can rnams/ /rdzogs ldan dus kyi tshe 'byor bde skyid kun/ /mngon sum nyams myong skye bar dal 'byor rnyed/ /nges gsang theg mchog chos la longs spyad nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa der myur bgrod shog /spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs de 'dzin sde rnams phyogs bcur 'phel/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon g.yung drung ltar brtan nas/ /smin grol 'khor lo chad med bskor bar shog /dga' ba brgya ba'i dpal ldan pho brang che'i/ /chos srid gyen 'degs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i lha/ /zhabs brtan mnga' thang rab rgyas lugs gnyis khrims/ /mchog dman phrag par khur du lci bar shog /rang gzhan phan bde'i rtsa lag theg chen lam/ /legs par bshad don nyams su bstar ba'i gling / /srid mtha'i bar du rnam gsum 'khor lo rnams/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /'jig rten spyi dang bye brag rgya hor bod/ /dus kyi chad pa brnag dka'i zug rngu rnams/ /ming mthar byas nas lus ngag yid gsum la/ /sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong bar shog /rtsa gsum byin rlabs dam can mthu stobs rtsal/ /chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa rnam par dag /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang mthus/ /ji ltar yongs smon 'dod don lhun grub shog /rgyal —531 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gesras slob mar bcas pas mgrin gcig tu/ /bden tshig dbyangs snyan len dang phyogs mthun du/ /mkha' la 'chi (23na)med tshogs kyis gom bkod de/ /bkra shis man+ta ra yi char 'bebs shog /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa rnams mi 'chal zhing khungs dag pa'i ched par du 'khod pa zhig byung na zhes gra dmangs rnams gleng brjod mdzad pa sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bskyar bar brten sa lug mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ma yang yang byung bas rkyen byas/ sgra mdo chen po bzhi la phul du phyin pa'i 'dar ba lo chen/ mon khar rnam gling paṇa chen/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum gyis dpe khungs stub mang po dang bstun zhing nged rang la dogs dpyad nas zhus dag par byas pa'i shog grangs lnga brgyar nye ba lcags bya lo sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dgos byed mthun rkyen gyi bkod pa dang bcas sngags rams pa mkhas btsun rgya mtsho do dam du btang nas dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par yig gi ma dpe dang mthun mi mthun gyi zhus chen yar 'brog pa dge slong blo gros brtan pa/ dge slong smra ba'i dbang phyug /rtse skor ba dge slong blo gsal mkhas pa gsum dang / yig mkhan blo bzang dam chos can dgu /par brkos pa dbu mdzad dgos slebs can sum cu so brgyad/ shing bzo ba bsod nams/ gnyer pa khang ser ma shes rab dpal bzang / ka bzhi smad pa bsod nams nor bu gnyis dang bcas pas gang dgos kyi rkyen sbyar nas par du brkos pa'i smon lam za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa dza yan+tu// sarba maṅga lo// //—532

dpal kun tu bzang po'i la sgos kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma khoganano༅༅/ /dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar bzhugs so/ /zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ khyab bdag gdod ma'i kun bzang he ru ka /sna tsho gos sprul pa'i gar mkhan pad+ma 'byung / /dbyer med drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /mig sman khu bas sbags pa'i lhun po la/ /dus mtha me dpung 'bar ba'i gos gyon pa/ /khro bo'i dbang po dpal chen phur pa yi/ /lha tshogs rnams kyis dngos grub char ltar phob/ /gar thig dbyangs zhes gsang sngags 'chang kun la/ /rlung ltar grags pa'i khrag 'thung khro bo'i 'chams/ /stang stabs tsam gyis bdud sde tshar gcod pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i lugs srol ji bzhin 'dri/ /de'ang rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la/ /sngon 'gro'i skabs blos bzung ba dang / stang stabs kyis bzung ba gnyis las/ phyi ma'i skabs gsang sngags gsar ma la/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur dang / yo ga las bshad pa'i gar thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje sogs kyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa dang /gsang sngags rnying ma la khrag 'thung gi 'chams zhes bka' gter gnyis ga'i rig sngags 'chang ba rgyu skar gyi 'phreng ba lta (2na)bu la yongs su grags pa'i nang nas/ dpal chen phur bu'i bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bzhes mchod dpon shes rab snang bas brjed byang du bkod pa lus 'gyur snang ba dang sgo bstun/ sa skyong thams cad mkhyen pa grags pa 'byung gnas dang / dpal kun bzang rtse ba'i phyag bzhes mthong brgyud ltar bri bar bya'o/ /spyir dpal kun tu bzang po dang / rgyal ba rigs lnga las brgyud de/ rdo rje sems dpasache mchog he ru ka la gsungs/ des rigs gsum mgon po la gsungs te/ lha klu gnod sbyin gyi yul du dar ba dang / khyad par skal ldan rgyal po dzas mkhas pa mi gsum la bshad/ de nas brgyud de slob —533—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2podapon pad+ma sam+bha wa/ bi mā la mi tra/ shī la ma lha lo tsā ba dz+nyā na ku mā ra sogs la brten nas/ skyon/ rgya gar/ bal yul/ bod sogs su dar rgyas che bar byung la/ dgos pa'i gtso bo/ badz+ra he ru gas/ ru dra 'dul ba'i ched du/ glu drug blangs pas don drug rdzogs/ stabs drug bskyod pas 'gro drug sgrol/ /zhes stang stabs drug (2ba)gam brgyad kyi sgo nas mdzad cing / rigs 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ dpal bsam yas kyi sa 'dul 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid la brten nas gar 'chams mdzad pas/ lha srin gyis gdug rtsub zhi ba sogs dgos pa khyad par can byung bas/ sa chog dang / 'phrin las kyi kha skong ba dang / bsgral ba dang / mdos zor gyi skabs su nyams su bstar ba/ rgyud kyi khungs dang 'brel zhing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba yin no/ /de yang lag stabs gtso che ba la gar/ rkang stabs gtso che ba la 'chams/ de gnyis ka gtso che ba stang stabs zhes bshad pas/ gnas skabs su mi 'dra ba 'dra zhig mchis kyang / don lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas 'phrin las bsgrub pa la mi 'gal lo/ /lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ 'gying ba/ sprug pa sogs phyag rgya mkhas pa'i man ngag dang ldan zhing / ngag sngags kyi bzlas pa rgyun mi chad pa dang /yid lha gang dang gang gi nga rgyal brtan po 'dzin cing / de thams cad kyang gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa lta bas rgyas thebs pa zhig dgos pas/ tshe 'di'i rnyed grags chos brgyad kyi ched kho na dang / ltad mo dang rtsed mo tsam gyi ched du bya ba'i tha mal gyi spyod tshul dang mtshungs pa ni ma yin no/ /'on kyang 'og nas 'byung ba'i chas gos rgyan spyod sogs ni khungs dag 'brel ngos/ shin tu rgyas pa bya ba ma gtogs/ ras su bor zhing spang bar mi bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams spros pa'i mtshan ma kun dang bral yang / spros pa sna tshogs sa brgyan pas so/ /'og nas 'byung ba rnams la thun mong du (3na8gos pa'i yan lag ni/ khrung chen nam mkha' la lding ba ltar phod ga'i thang sha bcad/ seng ge g.yu ral sprug pa ltar ma ral gyi 'khyil ba shig /rgya stag nags ma'i tshal du 'gying ba ltar lus kyi 'dzum bstan/ lus stod la seng chags/ rked pa la 'khril chags/ skyid pa la ldem chags/ tshigs —534

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 44sa kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganabazhi la 'phrul chags/rkang mgo la bde chags/bzhag sha la lhod chags/rnam 'gyur la 'gying chags/sha 'gyur la mer chags/spyod pa dal la dod/phyag rgya g.yas su 'cha' zhing 'grol na g.yon du blta/g.yon du de las ldog/dbus su thad gar lta zhing 'gying ba rnams yin no//'dir rdo rje phur pa'i 'chams spyir bstan pa dang /bye brag 'chams kyi rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa gnyis/dang po la/stod las byang chub bsgrub pa'i yan lag tu rtsa ba'i 'chams bshad/smad las gdug pa sgrol ba'i yan lag tu brub 'chams bshad pa gnyis/dang po la sngon 'gro/dngosagazhi/mjug dang gsum/dang po rang lus chas su 'jug pa ni/phod ka/rus rgyan/sor la kha/skra brdzus/bse theb la zhwa dar dang /me long ni med du mi rung ste/spyir sngags 'chang rnams kyis gyon pa'i zhwa nag la srid pa spyi lugs kyi zhwa zhes bshad cing /de'i don srid pa zhes pa/'jig rten gyi khams dang /khams spyi'i dbyibs lugs la dpe byas la/byas tshul ni/pad+ma'i gdung tshab sngagasa'achang bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsung las/mgul sgrog chos dbyings gdengs ka gyen bstan dbyibs//de 3bskong rgyab bsnol rlung dkyil rgya gram tshul//de steng gru gsum kun nas 'bar ba'i me//phan tshun bsnol ma rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrug/sa chen gru bzhi'i dbyibs su rtsa ba brtan//mu khyud khor yug kun nas bskor ba'i dbus//lhun po ltar brjid rked par nyi zla'i rgyan//nang gi ru shing keng rus lhun sdug brjid//mtsho steng mtshon skud pañtsa sa zur brgyad du//dris pa gling chen bzhi dang gling phran bcas//sbas don nam mkhar rgyas btab thog ris bkod//tog phod dar da phyangasayongs brtol dpag bsam shing //gdod nas 'gyur med bung ba'am stang zil mdog/las bzhi gang bsgrub thod bcings kha dog bsgyur//nus ldan rdzas kun mdzes pa'i rgyun du bkod//cesaso//gtso bor zhwa 'di nyid dgos rgyu yin na'ang //'chams yun ring ba dang bcas 'jug pa bde ba'i go du zhwa theb 'di nyid mdzad cing /de ltar mdzad pa khungs dang mi 'brel ba'i skyon med de/dbang po'i sdes/rgya bzo'i rgyun gyi zhwa dmar dar so che//dbang drag sgo mthun don gyi las zhwar mdzad/ces

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geso/ /rgyas par spro na/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs nor bu'i dbyibs la gzung mo bye thur g.yas g.yon du glang po'i mche ba ltar mdzes pa dang / dar gyi sprul mgo lnga'am gsum gang 'os/ /ban+ta skra can/ phur pa dar gyi cod pan can sogs 'tshogs par bya zhing mas gos rnams/ g.yas nas brngam par blangs te g.yon phyogs nas gyon/ ban phur pad kor gyi tshul gyi lan pa sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa gser skyems ni/ lha'i phyag rgya mi bzod pa'i yul lha dang / sdebargyad rnams la gtong ba ste/ rnga pa rnams(4na)masasu mi 'jug kyang / ber sogs rang chas gang legs byas nas gser skyems 'bul zhid / phur bsgyur bya/ de nas 'chams dpon gyis sna drangs te/ phyogs kyi gsol gdab rnams kyang go rim mi 'phyugs pa yod par bsgrigs nas 'chams gral phreng ba mnyam par byas/ lag pa rgod ba 'ug ga ltar brgyangs pa'i g.yas phur pa mkhrig ma nang du bkug pas bzung ba cung mtho/ g.yon bas cung zad gzhol bar bzung ste/ rkang g.yon bteg nas sbram zhes rol mo che ba 1 la rkang g.yas rting gsig byas pa'i g.yon 'gro phyogs phab/ 'gying ba'i ngang nas rol mo thengs brdung chung ngu gsum bzhi rkang g.yas g.yon phyogs su bskor ba'i bzhag thad g.yon drung nas/ rkang g.yas bteg pa'i sbram zhes rol mo che ba gcig la rkang g.yon rting gsig byas/ rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs su phab 'gying ba'i ngang nas rol mo theng brdung chung ngu gsum bzhi la rkang g.yon g.yas phyogs su bzhag thad g.yas drud pa bya/ 'don de ga re mos kyi do ra 'khor ba dang / 'chams dpon dbus su sleb par byas nas/ gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po sa gzhi 'khod snyoms par bya ba ni/ rkang g.yon bteg sbram zhes g.yas pa'i rting gsig byas/ rkang g.yas g.yon phyogs su bskor ba'i bar der/ dang po dang gnyis pa song nasagasum pa nas ston par byed pa ni 'di ltar/ zhes 'chams skad kyi brda' sbyar mtshams/ sbram zhes rkang g.yas mdun du phab/ g.yon de dang mnyam par drud nas/ sbram gcig ces pa'i 1 de la rol mo chung tsam yong ba'i sgam la ban phur (4bskoyon phyogs bskor nas/ 1 la g.yas su gzhol ba bya/sbram gnyis zhes pa de dang 'dra/ sbram sbram chung ngu gsum bzhi la ban phur nang du bskor ba'i 'og nas —536

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 44sa kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganayar steng du 'phyar/'di la chig brdung rol ba zhes bya ste 'og tu'ang rigs 'gre/lag gnyis 'phyar ba dang rkang g.yas bteg nas rkang g.yon pa'i rtser lcags mda' rigs su phab/sbram zhes che bar rkang gnyis ka rting gsig dang lus g.yas phyogs 'gying gsig/yang sbram zhes rting gsig lus g.yon phyogs bgying gsig/yang sbram zhes par g.yas gong ltar 'gying gsig bya/de nas 'chamasadapon khri'u'i steng du bzhugs/phyogs kyi mchod 'bul ram 'degs dang bcas pa phyogs so sor 'khod/gsol bto sogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rol gar ltar ro//de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi rol mo dang bstun/'og nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje phyed 'gros kyi byang shar du 'gro/de rjes phyogs dpon bzhi slob dpon gyi g.yas g.yon du 'khod/smir sbram/sbir sbram gnyis rjes dgu brdungs 1 byas bsgral mchod kyi dbyangs bkab ste/e ma nga ni zhes pa'i skabs rkang g.yas bteg cing g.yon cung zad 'gying /rang zhes pa'i skabs su g.yas 'gro phyogs su 'dzugs/'byung zhes dbyings dang 'dra ba la lag gnyis dkur brten pa'i rol 'gros la 'jug /gnyis pa ni/ yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ ces dang / che gsum gyi rol 'gying bya/ de nas rol mo lnga brdung che chung spel mar bsgyur/ bzhi pad brjod/ lnga tshan che la yangs pad lan —545—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (27/tshul/ dang por pad kor/ gnyis par lag g.yas pus(11na〉steng / gsum par phur dar g.yug /bzhi par 1 ra phur pa gtad/ lnga par g.yas su cung zad gcus nas ban phur kha gyen du bstan nas ji bya/ de nas lnga tshan drug pa la dang po la lag gnyis brgyangs nas rkang g.yas bteg g.yon pas rting gsig gi g.yon 'gro phyogs su bskor/ gnyis par g.yon bteg g.yas rting gsig gi g.yas yong phyogs bskor/ gsum par rkang g.yas bteg pa'i gnas skor du mdun gyi bar dang bzhi par g.yon bteg pa'i g.yon skor du mdun bar bskor/ lnga par yangs pad gong ltar blangs pa'i mchongs pad bya/ /drug par 1 2la g.yas/ gsum la g.yon/ bzhi la g.yas rnams la lag pa rkang pa phyogs mthun bya/ lnga par rkang g.yon bteg ban phur nang du bskor ba'i bskyod 'gros dkur brten sngar bzhin rol 'gros so/ /gsum pa ni/ de steng paṃ las chu yi dkyil 'khor dkar/ zhes brjod/ lnga tshan gnyis pa rlung dkyil dang 'dra/ de nas lnga tshan drug la/ dang po la lag g.yas mchan khung nas bskor nas brgyangs/ rkang g.yas bteg g.yon 'gro phyogs par dang / gnyis par rkang g.yon bteg g.yon skor du g.yas yong phyogs bar dang / gsum pa'i 1la rkang g.yas rgyab tu phab rkang g.yon bteg g.yas skor du mdun du bskor/ bzhi par yangs pad bya/ lnga par g.yas zur du mchonges pa da dang / yangs pad bya/ drug par rlung dkyil ltar bskyod 'gros rol 'gros sogs bya/ bzhi pa ni/ raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi ched/ /ces dang / bzhi pa de brjod pa ma gtogos bzhi tshan (11bsko nyis pa yan rdo rje phyed 'gros dang 'dra/ de nas me dkyil gru gsum rtsa mo yong phyogs su bstan pa gnyis yod pas/ bzhi tshan gsum gyi dang po la 'gro phyogs su blta ba'i mdun nas g.yas zur du rkang g.yas kyi gom pa gnyis spo dus lag rjo kha phyir bstan la phur rtse gtod/ gnyis par g.yon zur du rkang g.yon gyi gom pa gnyis spo dus rjo kha khyer bstan la phur rtse gtod/ gsum pa'i 1la g.yas kyi gom gang mdun zur du spo ba dang phur dar g.yas su g.yug /gnyis gsum la rkang g.yon bteg 'jog bya/—546

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganabazhi la rkang g.yas bteg nas/ 1ces chem rgyag la rkang g.yas g.yon pa'i rtser 'jog pa dang lag gnyis dkur brten gyi ldem/ 2 2 zhes par de gar 'dug /yang bzhi tshan gsum la snga ma go ldog pa'i rkang g.yon g.yon zur du/ g.yas g.yas zur/ g.yon gyi gcig la mdun zur du/ lhag ma gsum la g.yas su bskor nas mdun du/ lag gnyis dkur brten/ 1ces chem rgyag la ldem 'grosabarjod/ 2 2la rkang g.yon nas brtsam pa'i bzhi 'gros la 'jug go /lnga pa ni/ bzhi 'gros g.yon pa'i gsum thog nas/ lo las sa dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ ces/ bzhi tshan bzhi pa rdo rje rkyang 'gros bzhi byas nas/ bzhi pad brjod de/ chu dkyil gru bzhi pa'i dbang du byas/ bzhi tshan drug gi dang po la rkang g.yas mdun zur g.yon du phab nas ban phur sprod/ gnyis par rkang g.yas g.yas zur du phab cing yangs pad kyi phur dar g.yas su g.yug /gsum pa'i 1 2la g.yas su cung zad phab nas gsig /rol mo che ba'i 3 4la rkang g.yas bteg g.yon (12na〉du bskor nas/ rgyab tu bzhi par rkang g.yas kyi g.yon zur du lag stabs gong ltar/ lnga par rkang g.yas g.yas zur du/ drug pa'i 1la rkang g.yon phab/ 2la rkang g.yas bteg /3 la rkang g.yas g.yas phyogs phab/ 4la rkang g.yon bteg mdun du/ 1ces chem rgyag la 'bebs pa dang bstun ldem 'gros dkur brten bya/ 2 rnal bzhi 'gros gong bzhin bya/drug pa ni/ de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /ces dang / mcho mes pad brjod bzhi tshan bzhi pa yan rdo rje rkyang 'gros ltar byas nas/ bzhi tshan drug gi /dang po la rkang g.yas g.yon pa'i pus thad bteg /lag gnyis g.yon du bskor rting gsig dang bcas g.yas su gzhal ba rim gyisamatho ba/ bzhi tshan 2pa'i 1dang 2la rba klong gi tshul gyi nang du lag gnyis g.yab pa dang rkang g.yasamadun du phab/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa la 'gying / bzhi tshan gsum pa dang bzhi pa la rkang g.yon bteg /lag gnyis g.yas su bskor ba nas bzung g.yas go ldog pa'i len bzhi tshan lnga par g.yasaji lta ba dang / bzhi tshan drug pa'i 1 2la rkang g.yas 'bebs/ /gsum la rkang g.yon shugs cung che —547

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geb re bteg /bzhi la phab nas mcho mes pad brjod nas/ yangs pad 1dang rol pa bskyod 'gros kyi 'gying dang / nyanas brtsams pa'i rkang g.yon pa'i bzhi 'gros la 'jug /bdun pa ni/ dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / zhes brjod/ bzhi tshan bzhi pa yan rak+ta dang mtshungs/ de nas bzhi tshan dgu'i dang bo la/ rkang g.yas bteg /lag gnyis nang du bskor ba'i gar gyi rkang g.yon pa'i rting gsig (12ba〉gis g.yon du bskor nas 'gro phyogs su lag g.yas ma chog sbyin g.yon dkur brten nas/ bzhi tshan gnyis pa'i 1la rkang g.yas phab/ gnyis la de gar 'dug /gsum bzhi la lag gnyis gyen du bstan rkang g.yon bteg /bzhi tshan gsum par g.yon nas lag gnyis nang du nang bskor ba'i gar dang rkang g.yas pa'i rting gsig gi g.yas su bskor/ yong phyogs su lag g.yon mchog sbyin g.yas dkur brten nas/ bzhi tshan bzhi pa'i 1la g.yon phab gnyis la de gar 'dug /gsum bzhi la lag gnyis gyen bstan rkang g.yas bteg /bzhi tshan lnga par gong gi g.yas ji lta ba nas/ g.yas 'gro phyogs su shugs che bas drug pa'i 1la rkang g.yas phab/ gnyis par rkang g.yon g.yas kyi mdun du spos/ gsum par rkang g.yas mdun dang / bzhi par rkang g.yon mdun du mnyam par phab/ bdun par lag gnyis thal sbyar bus mo cung zad phab nas lan gnyis gsib/ brgyad par lag gnyis g.yas su gzhol nas yangs pad kyi 'go brtsams pa'i/ dgu par yangs pad nas bzung bzhi 'gros la 'jug pa yan rak+ta dang 'dra'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ bzhi 'gros de'i ngang nas rkang g.yas pa'i bzhi 'gros kyi gsum pa'i thog nas/ sne las rin cen sna lnga'i rang bzhin las/ /legasagrub dngas shing thogs med gzhal yas khang / zhes brjod/ bzhi tshan gsum gyi phur dar g.yug pa yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas:ra sbram la phur rtse brgyur gtad de g.yas su gzhol/ sbir sbram lan gsum la rol ba byas pa'i gsum pa'i skabs rkang gnyis g.yas(13na〉kyi drud tsam byas/ rol mo theng brdung la rkang g.yas g.yon 'degs 'jog re mos dang bstun lag gnyis g.yas g.yon re mos su 'phyar ba ni bshud 'gros tshig rdeg ces bya/ 'gros 'dis phyogs bzhi ga'am phyogs 1tu re kha —548

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtogana'athen pa'i tshul dang / sgo 'byog sgo 'gram sgo logs ya phub sogs kyi dod re byas te grub rjes/mchonges pa da bya/ rol mo che chung thengs brdung re la yangs pad kyi len g.yug gtod pa re re bya/ rol pa dang bcas blangs rjes/ sbram sbram zhes chung ngu kha shas la lag gnyis nang du bskor nas bskyod 'gros byas te rol 'gros la 'jug /de ltar rten gyi rim pa rnams/ /mig la bde ba'i stang stabasakyi/ /'dzin med stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar shar/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la brgyad las/ dang po gtso bo bskyed pa la dgu ste/ 'di nas sgo ma'i bar yoms skad gtong mtshams chos dbyings dang 'dra'o/ /brten pa lha bskyed pa la dgu'i dang po dpal chen po'i 'gying chen/ ces brjod/ dzo chung yan bla 'gugs ji lta ba nas cud dal/ lag gnyis brgyangs pa'i ngos lag g.yas cung zad mthu bar bya/ sbram )sbram 2sbram 2sbram4la rkang g.yas brkyang gi yong phyogasasu 'gro ba spos phral de'i rting pa'i thad rkang g.yon sleb pa la dpa' bskyed dang 'dra ba byed/ /sbram 4pa'i 4de la rol mo chung ba zhig yong bas de la g.yas pa'i rting pa'i rtsar g.yon mi 'gro bar g.yon 'gro phyogs su cung zad 'then cing / g.yas bteg sbram zhes par phur dar g.yon du g.yug /sbir la g.yas phyar (13ba)phur dar rgyab tu g.yug /sbram zhes par rkang g.yas phab yang sbram sbir sbram la g.yon la go ldog /'di grol bsdu'am 'gros bsdu zhes bya ste steng bar 'og dang 'dra/ gsum brdung gnyis kyi dang po la yangs pad/ gnyis pa la rdza chung / de nas rkang g.yon brkyang gi g.yon 'gro phyogasal che bzhi la gong gi g.yas go ldog dang 'gros bsdu rjo chung bya/ dbus su cha bzhi pa g.yas g.yon re mos dang / 'gros bsdu/ mchongs pad/ rol pa/ bskyod 'gros dang / 'di nas stag sham gyi bar bskyod 'gros dkur brten gyi rol 'gros bya/gnyis pa ni/ dpal chen po'i 'gying chung / zhes brjod/ ṭ+wāṃ chung yan 'gying chen dang 'dra/de nas lag gnyis dkur brten nas 'gying chen gyi dbus ma nas gzung bskyod 'gros rnams bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dbu gsum rdzogs su bskyed pa/ zhes brjod/ rjo chung yan 'gying chen dang 'dra ba las/—549

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2poṭ+wāṃ chung gi rol mo gsum gyi re rer tshig rkang gsum re brjod pas/ zhal g.yas dkar la bzhad pas rgod rgod 'dra zhes bya/ lag gnyis thal mo khong stong rna ba g.yas thad du g.yas zhal mtshon byed steng 'og tu gcu tsam re bya ba ma gags che bzhi la sig yas gag 'gying bzhin bya/ des mtsho ni/ rjo chung la/ zhal g.yon dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra/ zhes brjod/ che bzhi la g.yon 'gro rkang lag g.yas go ldog gi g.yon zhal mtshon par bya/ ṭ+wāṃ chung la/ zhal dbus mthing la rngams pas 'jigasapar ston/ zhes brjod/ dbus su re mos kyi gcu bas dbus zhal mtshon par byas nas gzhan ma rol 'gros par 'gying (14na skor ji lta ba bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ phyag drug rdzogs su bskyed pa/ zhes brjod/ yangs pad yan 'gying chen dang 'dra/ rdza chung dang bstun/ rdo rje rtsedagu'i sa dgus rtog pa 'joms/ /zhes brjod nas/ che bzhi la lag g.yon dkur brten g.yas mtho bar 'phyar/ g.yas yong phyogs su rkang g.yas bteg g.yon rting gsig /g.yas phab mtshams g.yon sleb pa bya/ sbram bzhi zhes pa'i bzhi der rol mo chung ba zhig yong bas rkang g.yon bteg g.yon 'gro phyogs su g.yas g.yon gnyis ga'i gzhol bya/ de nas yangs pad dang / ji chung dus/ rdo rje rtse lngas dug lnga dbyings su dag /ces brjod/ lag g.yas thad gar brgyad pa ma shes gtags yangs bad yan snga ma ji lta ba bya/ rdza chung dang bstun/ me dpung 'bar bas 'khor ba'i nyon mongs bsreg /ces brjod/ lag g.yas dkur brten/ g.yon pa'i srin lag dang mthe'u chung gnyas bskum gzan gsum brkyang nas mtho bar brkyangs/ rkang g.yon bteg g.yon 'gro phyogs su/g.yas go ldog pa'i gzhol dang bcas pa bya/ rdza chung dang bstun/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nasagacod/ /ces brjod/ lag g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan gzhan gsum brgyad pa thad gar brgyang ba ma gtogos snga ma dang 'dra/ rjo chung la/ ri rab phur bus dgra bgegs gzir bar byed/ces brjod lag gnyis phur pa sgril tshul bya ba ma gtogs gzhan ma rol 'gros yan dbus zhal dang mtshungs so/ /—550

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'am pas kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma (gnalnga pa ni/zhabs bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa/zhes brjod/rdza 4bskos yan 'gying chen dang 'dra/de nas lag gnyis pus mo'i thad skar brkyang //rkang gnyis g.yon brkyang du bsgrad pa'i g.yas g.yon nang du gcu zhing gsig cing gzhol sogs nas rol 'gros bar dpa' bskyed bzhin bya/drug pa'i dang po ni/btags pa'i rgyan gnyis kyi thog mar mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan/zhesabarjod/ṭ+wāṃ chung yan 'gying chen bzhin bya/de nas sbram 1nas sbram lnga'i bar che lnga yi bzhi yan la rkang g.yas g.yon re mos kyi gcu/lnga par rang sar 'dug/lag gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba/dpral ba'i dbus/rna ltag g.yas/de gnyis kyi bar/rna ltag g.yon/de dang dpral dbus kyi bar rnams su thod skam lnga'i tshul bya/de rjes 'gros bsdu nas rol 'gros par 'gying chen dang 'dra/gnyis pa/thod lho lnga gas do shal/ces brjod/yangs pad yan skrung byu dang wa/ji dang bstun nas skra lag g.yas kyi bzung /rna ltag g.yon thad du 'phyar nas/sbram nas sbram drug gi bar rim gyis bsus pa'i mtha' skor nas rna ltag g.yas thad du 'phyar nas/sbram sbir sbram gsum la 'gying /sbram 1nas lnga'i bar snga ma go ldog tu bskor ba'i/drug la skra bzhag rkang g.yon bteg nasagazhol byed pa nas rol 'gros rnams dpa' bskyed bzhin no//bdun pa'i dang po ni byug pa'i rtsi gsum gyi thog mar rak+ta'i thig le/zhes brjod/yangasapad yan 'gying chen dang 'dra/rjo chung gi 2 la gong mdzub srin gsum ban nang du bzhi/gsum par ston te/sbram ras/sbram bzhi'i bar rkang g.yas g.yon re mos su mdun 15na'i spo zhing gcu ba dang /byug pa'i rgyan ni dang po la gong mo'i rtses smin dbrag/gnyis par mdzub srin gyi mkhur tshosagayas g.yon/gsum par sna rtse/bzhi par yog ma rnams su rak+ta'i thig le bya/de nas rnga gsum la phur rtse phyir bstan g.yas su bskor nas/'gros bsdudang /yangs pad dang bstun/gnyis pa/thalachen gyi tshom bu/zhes brjod/rjo chung man dngos gzhi snga ma dang tsā ba la/phyag rgya thal wo gyi tshom bu byug tshul/dang po dpul mtshams kyi dbus/gnyis par de'i g.yas/gsum par g.yon/bzhi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepar dbus kyi 'og tu bya/ gsum pa/ zhag gi zo ris/ zhes brjod/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ phyag rgya byug tshul lus mi gcu bar lag g.yas kyi sor mos/ nu ma g.yon 'og nas bzung lte ba dang / nu ma g.yas pa'i 'og gi bar byug tshul byas rjes phur rtse mi bskor bar 'gros bsdu nas bzung rol 'gros bar 'gying chen bzhin bya/brgyad pa'i dang po ni/ bgo ba'i gos gsum gyi thog mar glang chen gyi ko rlon/ zhes brjod/yangs pad yan 'gying chen bzhin dang / ji chung dang bstun pa'i dang po gnyis par lag g.yon pasaphur dar gyi sne nas bzung gsum par glang lpags gyon tshul byas nas/ g.yas g.yon du 'gro lugs/dbus su re mos rnams kyis mtshams su sbram smir sbram gsum la lus mi gcu bar 'gying ste sdod pa ma ga rta gos dpa' bskyed ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ zhes brjod/ phur dar gyi sne 'dzin pa yan glang lpags dang 'dra/ gsum par gyon (15ba)tshul dang bstun rkang g.yon bteg pa g.yon zur phab g.yon du bskor nas do ra'i phyir kha phyogs pas rkang g.yas kyi 'gro phyogs su gsig pa/ sbram sbir sbram gsum la de gar 'gying gsum par rkang g.yon bteg pa'i g.yon skor du mdun du phyogs pa'i g.yas yong phyogs su gsig /gsum la 'gying nas dbus su gsig pa man nas rol 'gros par dpa' bskyed dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa/ stag lhags kyi sham thabs/ zhes brjod/phur dar gyi sne 'dzin pa yan glang lpags dang 'dra/ de nas lag gnyis brla steng brkyang nas stag sham gyi tshul byas/ rkang g.yas g.yon re mosanasarol 'gros rnams dpa' bskyed bzhin no/ /dgu pa ni/khams gsum zil gyis gnon ba rdo rje'i khyung gzhog /ces brjod/ 'di'i dngos gzhi 'gying chen dang 'dra ba la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gyi mtshams su 'gros bsdu'i tshab tu gzhol bya/ rjes bskyod 'gros kyi 'gying la dkur brten mi bya bar lag gnyis brgyangs pa'i mtshams chan byas nas rol 'gros so/ /gnyis pa yum bskyed pa ni/ 'khril sbyor yum gyi phyag rgya/ zhes brjod/ rdza chung yan 'gying —552

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 44sa kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganachen dang 'dra/ de nas rol mo che bzhi la gtso bo'i dbus zhal ji lta ba byas nas 'gros bsdu yangs pad sna chung bya/ che bzhi la lag g.yon dku la brten/ lag g.yas brkyangs te rkang g.yas kyi 'gro ba 'gying chen gyi g.yas 'gro ltar bya/ 'gros bsdu yangs pad rjo chung byas nas/ che bzhi la lag g.yasadaku la brten g.yon mdun du brkyang / rkang g.yon bteg nas bya/ 'gros bsdu yangs pad ṭ+wāṃ chung bya/yang che bzhi la/ rkang (16na)g.yon bteg /lag gnyis 'khyud pa'i tshul gyi bya/ 'gros bsdumacho mesapad rol pa bskyod 'gros kyi 'gying / lag gnyis brgyangs pa'i mtshams chen byas te rol 'gros so/ /de ltar chos dbyings bde ba'i ngang / he ru ka dpal yab yum gyi/ sna tsho gos gzugs sku'i gar mkhan ma/ /stang stabs me long ngos la shar/ gsum pa ni/ khro bcu rol pa'i stang stabs/ zhes brjod/g.yas g.yon du gcu ba'i 'gying gnyis kyi rjes/ ban phur kha gyen bstan byas sbram sbram zhes chem brdung chung ngur phab ste rol mo bzhag /dbyangs dang bcas te/ oṃ ma'i la lus bsrangs lag gnyisabargyangs/ hūṃ nga'i la rkang g.yas bteg /chen )la rkang g.yas mdun du phab/ lag gnyis kyang cung zad phab/ nā'i la rting gsig /ka ba'i la rkang g.yon bteg g.yas skor du/ ra'i la rkang g.yon g.yas yong phyogs su phab/ ya'i la rting gsig phyag /ga'i la rkang g.yas bteg nas rim gyi/ rgya la rkang g.yas g.yon 'gro phyogs su phab/ pa'i la rting gsig rkang g.yon bteg nas/ ni la g.yon mdun du phab/ ya ba zhes par 'gying / 'a'i wa'i la lus g.yas su gcu zhing / rkang g.yas bteg tsam byas pa'i yangs pad kyi 'go brtsam/ lag /ga 'a zhes par pad skar len/ gnyis la phud dar mdun nas yar 'then/ thal nyer )pa phur pa pus steng / sbyar la phur dar rgyab tu g.yug /ra 'a zhes par rkang g.yas bteg tsam gyi/ gyen/ na'i la g.yas su yangs pad len/ du'i wo la phur pa pus steng / bsgreng nga 'a la phur dar rgyab tu (16ba)g.yugs nas lag thal sbyar bya/ 'a'i/ wa'i la lus g.yas su cung zad gcu zhing rkang g.yas bteg pa'i yangs pad brtsam/ rkang nga'i/ gnyis la yangs pad g.yon zur du blangs/ mthil nyer phur pa pus steng / sbyar la phur dar rgyab tu g.yug thur/ ra'i/ du wo zhes—553

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepar lag thal sbyar/ rkang gnyis rting pa sbyar/ zug la pus mo cung zad phab/ wa 'a'i wa'i/ tshigs/ga'i/ chen/ na'i/ zhi'i nyer rnams kyi tshigs dang lhu rer bstun lag gnyis sbyar ba g.yas su/ rkang g.yas bteg 'babs kyi rting gsig bcas lan gsum gsig /yang la rkang lag gnyis mdun du mnyam/ bcag /ga /bar/ ra 'a/ bya zhes bar g.yas go ldog tu g.yon phyogs la na gsum ga smo /wa'i/ wa' zhes par ban phur kha gyen bstan mdun du mnyam/ oṃ ma'i zhes par rkang g.yas bteg tsam gyi yangs pad/ badz+ra la phur pa mdun nas yar ban+ta ra bskor/ kro la pus steng / dha la phur dar g.yug /hūṃ/ngo la rkang g.yas bteg tsam nas g.yon du yangs pad/ ka la phur pa pus steng / ra la phur dar g.yug /hūṃ/ ngo la g.yon bteg g.yas su yangs pad/ gar la phur pa pus steng / dza la rkang g.yon drud pa'i rting gsig dang sa sa phur dar g.yug /gardza la lag gnyis brkyangs rkang g.yon bteg nas/ hūṃ la phab lag gnyis ban phur nang du bskor/ rkang g.yas bteg g.yon 'gro phyogs su phaṭa la bskor ba'i mdun du phab/ ṭa la rkang g.yon brkyang / lag g.yas 'phyar/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub bya/ khro bo g.yin rnams kyi phyag rgya tshig dang mthun par bya zhing / sngags la phyogs bzhi'i khro bo steng (17na)dang mthun par/ oṃ la lag gnyis brgyangs rkang g.yon bteg nas/ badz+ra la phab/kro dha nas bzung g.yon skor du rim gyis bskor nas/ mdun du hūṃ dpal kun tu bzang po'i 44sa kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganasbir sbram la rol sogs dam can spyi'i 'chams ltar bya/lcags ris mi byed par bshud 'gros dang /lag g.yas 'phyar g.yon dkur brten pa'i ngos rkang g.yas pa'i thog nas/shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun//khyod kyis zhi ba 'i las mdzod cig/ces brjod g.yas pa nas bzung shugs che bar 'phar ba'i zlum skor gyi tshul la 'gros sngar ltar/mchongs pad rol pa gong bzhin nas/lag g.yon 'phyar g.yas dkur brten/rkang g.yon pa'i thog nas/lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/khyod kyis rgyas ba'i las mdzod cig/g.yon nas bzung shugs che tsam gru bzhi'i tshul bya/mchonges pa da rol pa/lag g.yas wor g.yon dku zhub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun//khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig/g.yas nas shugs che tsam zla gam gyi tshul/mchongs pad rol pa/lag g.yon 'phyar g.yas dku/byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig/g.yon nas bzung shugs che'i gru gsum du bskor ba'i tshul bya/de rnams kyi dngosagazhi rnams song nas/rjes kyi bya ba bcu gcig la/dang po ni/bzhud 'gros de ga'i rkang g.yas pa'i thog nas/bam rol pas 'tshol ba/mchonges pa da song nas brtsam/zhes brjod/yangs pad dang rol pa gsum gong ltar nas bshud 'gros g.yas g.yon dang bstun lag gnyis rol pa 22na ) bya ba ji ltar rigs pa nas/gnyis pa ni/bam sprul nag gis 'tshol ba/mchongs pad song nas brtsam/zhes brjod/yangs pad rol pa sngar ltar byas nas/bshud 'gros kyi sprul 'khor ba ltar 'khyog 'khor bya zhing /'gugs mtshams rol mo drag pa dang /lus gcum nas 'phar ba'i mthar skor lam du 'khod pa'i ngang nas/la a sa dpon gyis ban skra nas bzung snar ba'i/rol dpon gyi mdun du sleb pa dang rkang g.yon pa mdun du cung dor bas brgyu kha sbub tu bzhag nas/'chams pa dmangs rnams kyi ban skra nas bzung snar nas mid 'gros de ga bya/'chams dpon gyi/ 223344557gi theng brdung la lag g.yas mchan khung nas bskor te ༷rgyang ba dang /rkang g.yas bteg g.yas skor du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ge11la 'gro phyogs su phab/ g.yon bteg 22la g.yas skor 'gro phyogs la phab/ g.yas bteg yong phyogs la bltas nas33la rgyab tu 'gro phyogs la 'then/ g.yon bteg 44la g.yon zur du 'then g.yas bteg phur dar g.yas skor du g.yugs nas55la 'gro phyogs su phab/ g.yon bteg g.yon skor 66la 'gro phyogs su phab 6tshan de gas skor ba 1song ba'i rol dpon mdun du 'chams dpon gyis sleb pa dang / 'chams pa dmangs kyis bas so so'i mdun du kha sbub tu bzhag nas/ 6tshan gyi skor 'gros 'chams dpon dang bstun nas skor ba 1bya/gsum pa ni/ rkang g.yon pa'i thog nas/ bam rde'u sa brtag pa/ mcho mes pad song nasabartsam/ zhes brjod/ sbram sbram g.yas 'bebs(22ba)'phar dang / sbram sbram la g.yon 'babs/'phar bya/ sbram sbi sbram sbram zhes chem brdung gsum la yangs pad dang chung ba khong 'dren du byas pa sngar bzhin byas/ g.yas kyi rgya bzur du lag g.yas brgyangs/ g.yon dku la brten nas/ 10 2233 la rkang g.yas 1snga mar phab/ g.yon 1rjes mar spo ba gsum gyi bar rigs 'gre bas chung gsum dang / mdun du bam phyogs la snga ma ltar/ 11 22la ji bya/ 33la shugs che bas dang po la rkang g.yas phab/ gnyis par g.yon bteg tsam bya/ de nas chem rgyag gsum dang chung ba 1la gong ltar bya/ de rjes lag gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub sprad de rde'u 'dzin tshul bya/ lus g.yon bsar bstan/ mig zur gyi blta zhing / rol mo 11 22 33la rde'u rgyag pa'i stangs ka tshar gcig dang bcas/ rting pa cung zad bteg tsam gyis 'phar chung byas te shi ma shi the tshom zos pa btag pa'i phyir/༷ phyogs su cung zhig nye bar 'gro tshul byed/ gsum rjes mar lag g.yon mkhrig mar phur dar drangs te/ bred tshul gyi/ 12 34yi gsum la g.yas su phyir brgyangs te zur 'then byas bzhi la de gar 'dug /de bzhin lan gsum dgos par rjes ma gnyis la bam la blta mi nus bzhi du/ 1122 33 44 la snga mar rde'u rgyag pa/ nye bar 'gro tshul byas nas bzhi par gong gi gsum pa dang 'dra bar phur dar drangs nas zur 'then snga ma dang 'dra ba byas te/ drug tshan gyi skor 'gros de gas dor —562

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganabaskor nas/ rde'u rgyag pa sogs snying kham cher gtong ba'i rgyag tshul ma gtogs snga ma ji lta ba byas te/rang (23na)rang gi ban+ta la skor 'gros kyis skor ba 1byas rjes/ yang snga ma bzhin snying kham che ba'i rgyag tshul rnams byas te/ do rar skor 'gros kyis skor ba 1bya'o/ /bzhi pa/ bam rdo rje'i 'gros kyi mchongs pad song nas brtsam/ zhes brjod nas/ thu gsham bsdus nas tsog pur 'dug nas g.yom gsum byas nas/ g.yas ngos su rdo rje'i 'gros gsum bya bzhi la de gar 'dug nas/ yang g.yom gsum byas te/ rdo rje'i 'gros gsum gyi ban+ta'i rtsar 'gro bzhi la de gar 'dug /bzhi tshan 1gi dang po la ༷ la lag reg gnyis pa la brnya kha sgyel/ 34la langs nas sngar bzhin do rar skor ba byas nas/ 0 dang 'dom gang gi sar tsog pur bsdad g.yom gsum bya/ 4grangs1la rdo rje'i 'gros kyis ban+ta'i rtsar phyin/ phyed skyil du sdad/lnga pa bam 'dod yon du byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rol mo lnga brdung che chung spel mar bsgyur te/ bzhi pad yongs rdzogs 1bya/ lnga tshan chung ba nyal yangs pad thol 1byas nas 'dod yon tu byin gyis brlab pa nas bzung / rang gi am brag tu 'jug pa yan la/ lnga tshan che ba gang yin la phyag rgya rnams rim par bya zhing / lnga tshan chung ba gang yin la yangs pad kho na byed pas/ de ltar shes par byas te/ lag g.yon khu tshur steng g.yas skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas gzugs kyi me long mtshon/ lag g.yon khu tshur rna ba g.yon thad du mkhrig ma nang du bkug g.yas pa'i gong mdzub kyis rgyud brdung tshul te sgra/ lag mthil gnyis phyir bstan pa'i phyag rgya dri/ lag gnyis rdor thal kha phye ba'i phyag rgya ro (23ba)phur dar 'phyar ba reg bya'o/ /drug pa mgron spyan 'dren ni/ lag g.yas kyi g.yas ngos nas smin mtshams kyi bar g.yob cing zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ lag g.yon g.yon phyogs nas g.yob cing khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs gnyis smin mtshams kyi mdun ngos nas g.yob ste/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rigs 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud/ las 'phro gter brgyud/—563

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gesmon lam gtad rgya'i brgyud pa rnams spyan drangs/ slar lag g.yas g.yas zur nas g.yab ste chosaskyong srung ma'i tsho gis rnams spyan drangs/ lag g.yon g.yon zur nas g.yo ba ste phur pa bka' gter gyi srung ma rnams spyan drangs/bdun pa bsgral ba ni phur pa phrag pa g.yas pa'i thad du bsgril/ phrag pa g.yon/ dpral ba'i thad nas kyang bsgril phur pa g.yas phyogs su brdar tshul bya/ brgyad pa bsgral mchod ni phur pa btab ste lag gnyis g.yas ngos su gyen du phyogs pas zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams mchod/ phur pa btab ste lag gnyis g.yon ngos su gyen du phyogs pas khro po'i lha tshogs rnams mchode/ phur pa btab ste lag gnyis mdun ngos su gyen du btab ste bla ma rigs 'dzin rnams mchode/ phur pa 'dabs pa sogs snga ma bzhin g.yas zur du chos skyong rnams mchod/ g.yon zur du srung ma rnams mchod/ g.yas phyogs su grogs la 'dren/ g.yon phyogs su grogs la 'dren/ rang nyid za ba'i tshul dang / rang gi am phrag tu 'jug pa'i tshul rnams byas te/ rol mo chem brdung du phab/ dgu pa lhag ma khur nas rgyug pa ste/ lag g.yon gyis ban+ta'i skra nas bzung / sha pags rus pa sogs lhag ma rnamasakhur ba'i tshul gyis pus mo btsugs/ lag g.yas kyis phur pa sal btsugs te cung zad mi theg pa ltar 'dar ba'i tshul byed/ de nas lus cung zad bsrangs te har langs rkang g.yon bteg pa dang mnyam du brgya phrag pa la sbram zhes bkal rol mo ther brdung gis bshud 'gros kyis mgyogs par skor ba gsum mam 1gang rung song rjes/ sbram zhes rkang g.yon yong phyogs su bskor nas/bcu pa dpal chen po'i stob 'chams ni/ yong phyogs la rkang g.yon gyi bzhi 'gros/g.yas kyi bzhi 'gros g.yon gyi bzhi 'gros gsum pa la rkang g.yon rgyab tu phab/ mdun du bzhi la g.yas nur nas/ 1ces chem rgyag la de gar nem/ 22la rkang g.yas bteg 'bebs dang / rkang g.yon bteg /4tshan gsum pa'i dang po'i 1la g.yon nas brtsam/ 'chams lugs sgo ma'i bzhi tshan gsum po dang 'dra ba'i rdzogs mtshams/ 1ces chem rgyag la g.yon du nem/ 22la rkang g.yas phyir —564

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtogana'athen g.yon bteg pa'i 'bebs byas/ rkang g.yas bteg ste 4tshan gsum po snga ma go ldog dang /'gro phyogs la rkang g.yas g.yon gyi bzhi 'gros re dang / slar g.yas pa'i bzhi 'gros dang gsum par rkang g.yas rgyab tu 'then mdun du rkang g.yon nur nas/ 1ces chem rgyag la mdun du nem/22la g.yon bteg 'bebs dang g.yas bteg /bzhi tshan gsum po sgo ma bzhi dang 'dra ba snga ma go ldog /rdzogs mtshams do ra'i nang du g.yon zar btsugs te/ 1ces chem rgyag la g.yon (24ba)du rnam/ 22la rkang g.yas phyir 'then/ g.yon bteg 'bebs byas nas mdun phyogs su/ rkang g.yasagayon gyi bzhi 'gros re/ slar g.yas kyi bzhi 'gros 1rdzogs nas chem brdung chung ngur phab ste rol mo bzhag /bcu gcig pa bgegs la phur bus btab pa ni/ 'chams dpon dbus nas shar du phyogasapas g.yas rdo rje'i tho ba g.yon phur bu bzung ste/ oṃ ma'i zhes par rkang g.yas g.yas phyogs 'then lag g.yas 'phyar/ badz+ra la rkang g.yas bteg /g.yon phyogs su 'debs pa dang lag gnyis phur bu brdung ba'i tshul bya/ gī li la rkang g.yas bteg g.yas su phab lag gong ltar/ gī lwa la de gnyis kyi dbus su rkang g.yas bteg 'bebs dang lag gong ltar/ ya la rkang g.yas rang sar 'then lag gnyis brgyangs pa'i 'gying / wa'i sarba la lag gnyis brla'i thad phyir gzhol te/ mdun pos yar lag gyen bstan par bsnol phyi brgyangs nas brla steng phab pa dang / be lha yong bar bya/ baṃ ma'i la rkang g.yas g.yas su 'then/ lag g.yas brgyangs/ hūṃ nga'i phaṭa la rkang g.yas g.yon gom pa ra dang phur bu brdung tshul bya/ de lta bu slar lan 1bldabs nas khro bo bcu so so'i phur bu rang rang gi sngags rjesaphur gdab kyi sngags kyis 'debs pa'o/ /bsngo smon shis brjod byas te/ sbram ) sbram 2la rol mo dag rol ba bya/ sbram sbram zhes bzhi lnga la ban phur gnyis nang du bskor nas lag gnyis brgyangs te/chem rgyag bzhi la/ dang po la rkang g.yas mdun du phab/ slar g.yas pa 'ba' zhig bzhi pa'i bar do ra'i bar 'gro tshul/ gnyis par g.yas phyogs su/ gsum par rgyab (25na)tu/ bzhi par mdun phyogs su/ de nas mchongs pad brjod nas/ rdo rje phyed pa lan gsum sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'di —565

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geskabs kyi gsum pa rkang g.yas pas len cing / 122zhes pa'i skabs/ 1snga mar g.yas bteg nas 'gro phyogs su 'dzugs/ gnyis snga mar rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs su 'dzugs pa'i khyad par tsam mo/ /de nas bzhi 'gros kho nas sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros byas te rdogs nas/ chas zhugs khang par song ste chas rnams so sor bzhag /lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal stong gi lta ba'i ngang nas cho ga'i khrigs rim dang / thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /dpal ldan gsang chen rgyud sde'i man ngag las/ /bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams ngo mtshar gnad/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin du/ /bkod 'di sngags 'chang rnams kyi dga' ston gnas/stod las byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /nyer mkho khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i 'chams/ /brgyud ldan mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes ltar/ /'khrul pa med par bkod zin nas/ /ma rungs gdug can dgra sde'i dpung / /don dam dbyings su ro gcig kyang / /kun rdzob zhabrul ngor sgrol byed pa'i/ /brub 'chamasalag len 'di na'o/ /gnyis pa smad las gdug pa sgrol ba'i yan lag tu brum mas bshad pa la/sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ dang po la bsgral las kyi sa der/ sa tshoni gyi brub khung nag po me ri dang bcas pa/ dbus su dgra'i sa bon : dang / bgegs kyi sa bon ti bris pa/ de'i steng liṅga nyams dod cing / klad pa snying khrag rgyu ma sogs bam dngos lta bu gdab (25ba)ka'i che skrag rngam dang zil chen po yong ba bsham/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi g.yas ngos su stegs ji tsam 'os pa'i khar/mgyogs phur/ gdab phur/ dam can gyi phur pa/ las phur/ skam thun/ rlon thun/ tho ba/ hom gzar/gri khug /sgrol gri rnams bsham/ rnga pa rnams zhu nag phod ka /mgo dar skabs dar/ rus rgyan/ skra tshab/ rnga/ rnga g.yog /de dag la 'dogs rgyu'i dar/ sna zhur/ gdab las dus dkrol rgyu'i sbug chol/de'i gdan/ rnga gdan/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bzhes pa'i rdo rje gzhen nu'i zhal bas/ ma ral dar tshon sna lngas bcings par nor bu 'bar ba'i rtse rgyan can/ gzhan phra phyag nyi shu sgo ma bzhi rnams so so'i zhal brnyan/ phod ka rus rgyan/ ma ral mgo dang / g.yas so so'i phyag mtshan/ g.yon phur pa dar gyi —566

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganacod pan can zhe gcig /dung chen/ rkang gling / spos phor/ gser skyems sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la snga 'chams dang / brub 'chams dngos gnyis/ dang po la brgyad las/ dang bo 'jam 'gros ni/ rnga yu brla la brten cing / rnga'i logs rang gi gdong thad du bstan par steng brdung zhes bya/ rkang g.yas bteg g.yon rting gsig dang bcas/ rnga dbyug sdigs mdzub kyis bzung ste steng brdung sgra thos tsam gyi chung ngur brdung zhing gom pa chung ba 'ga' zhig 'gro phyogs su spos pa'i ngang nas nang du kha bsgir/ do ra'i nang du kha blta ba'i rkang gnyis rting gsig cung zad byed pa dang mnyam du rnga drang thad du blang ste lag gnyis brgyangs ngos mdun du phab/ rnga yu brla la brten nas rnga'i ri rang gi gdong (26na)thad du yong ba byas/ rkang g.yon bteg rting gsig dang bcas rnga 'og brdung byas te gom pa chung ba 'ga' zhig spos/ de'i ngang nas rnga steng brdung du bsgyur cing / rkang g.yas bteg nas 'gro ba sogs g.yas g.yon re mos spel bas ngor 'khor ba dang / do ra'i nang du phyogs pas lag gnyis brgyangs te rkang g.yon bteg rnga mdun du 'bebs pa dang bstun/ rnga dpon gyis 'og brdung gi rnga brda che ba gcig bya/ chung ba gsum gyi dang por steng brdung / gnyis par 'og brdung / gsum par steng brdung byed/gnyis pa rtse gsum ni/ lnga bzhi brdung gi bzhi tshan bcu gsum las/ do rar mdun phyogasapa'i bzhi tshan dang po g.yas ngos su 'og brdung bya/ bzhi tshan gnyis pa'i 12la steng brdung 3par steng brdung dang mnyam du nem rjes 4par rnga mdun du bsgrengs te blangs pa'i 'og brdung bya/ 4tshan 3par rnga g.yas su steng brdung bde khyer ngos 1la rkang g.yas phab 2la g.yon bteg 3la phab 4la g.yas bteg steng brdung de ga'i ngang nas 'gro phyogs su/ 4tshan 4par rkang g.yas/ 4tshan lnga par rkang g.yon par 'og brdung / 4tshan drug par de gnyis kyi dbus su rkang g.yas la rnga mdun du bsgrengs te bslang ba'i 'og brdung rnams kyi rkang pa'i 'bebs lugs dang rnga brdung ba sogs rdo rje phyed pa ltar —567—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gero/ /4tshan 7par rnga yu brla khugs su brten/ g.yas su rnga steng brdung bde khyer gyis ga stob ma gtogs rkang pa rdo rje phyed pa ltar byas pa'i/ de rjes rkang g.yas mdun 'gro phyogs su 'bebs pa dang lus bsrangs/ rnga bsgrengs te 'dzin cing 1ces rig brdung chung bar bya/ 2 khong 'dren byas ngos rnga steng brdung du bsgyur te/ 3 4la rnga chung brdung bya/ de nas rkang g.yon bteg g.yas su 4tshan brgyad pa/g.yon du 4 tshan dgu pa/ de gnyis kyi dbus su 4tshan 10(26ba)rnams dang / 4tshan 11par g.yon du rnga steng brdung bde khyer gyi gcu ba sogs g.yas go ldog bya/ 4tshan 12par g.yas su 'og brdung /4tshan 13par mdun du steng brdung ngo / / gsum pa yongs bsgyur ni/ rnga yu brla la brten nas g.yas su nye bar/ 12zhes nyis brdung bcu gcig las/ dang po g.yas su 'og brdung / 2par mdun du steng brdung nem pa byas pa'i 3par rnga bsgrengs te 'og brdung bya ba dang rkang g.yon bteg g.yon du phab/ 4par rkang g.yas bteg g.yon phyogs phab/ lnga par rgyab tu rnga steng brdung nem pa bya/ drug par rnga bsgrengs te rkang g.yas bteg g.yas su bskor nas phab/ bdun par rkang g.yon bteg g.yas su bskor ba phab pa'i/ brgyad par mdun du rnga steng brdung nem pa bya/ gong ltar gcig bldabs pa'i rjes ma'i brgyad kyi nem pa'i tshab/dgu pa'i nyal rnga brda bya/ 2par chud pa byas ngos g.yas su 10par 'og brdung / 11par mdun du steng brdung bya'o/ /bzhi pa me byung ni/ bzhi brdung drug las/ 4brdung 3gyi len lugs rtsegasum ji lta ba dang / de nas4tshan 3la ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi logs gsum rtsa 'chams dang 'dra ba'i dang por 'og brdung / 2bar steng brdung / 3par yang steng brdung bya/ de rjes/ 12 12 12 3 4zhes pa'i dang po'i g.yon mdun du phab pa'i steng brdung / 3pa'i 4brdung la rkang g.yas mdun du 'bebs pa dang mnyam du rnga bsgrengs te 'og brdung bya/ de nas rkang g.yon me dkyil ltar logs gsum gyi dang por steng brdung / 2par 'og brdung / gsum par steng brdung / de nas/ 12 12 12 34 la snga ma go ldog —568

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganapa'i nyis brdung dang por rkang g.yon mdun du 'bebs pa dang 27na ) lus cung zad skur ba bcas 'og brdung /2par rkang g.yas mdun du 'bebs pa dang steng brdung /3pa'i bzhi brdung la rkang g.yon mdun du 'bebs pa dang rnga bsgrengs te 'og brdung gi bzhi brdung bya/de nas g.yas su gcus te 'og brdung de ga'i bzhi brdung 1dang /mdun du steng brdung gi bzhi brdung 1bya'o//lnga pa ngar 'dzin ni/sbir sbram mam/12zhes pa'i nyis brdung drug las/dang po g.yas su gcus te steng brdung /2 phar g.yon du bcus te 'og brdung /de ltar lan gsum song rjes/yang nyis brdung drug gi dang po'i 11la rnga bsgrengs te rkang g.yas mdun du phab/22la rkang g.yas rgyab tu 'then pa dang rnga steng brdung /de ltar lan gsum song rjes/de nas 11la rnga bsgrengs te 'og brdung ngos rkang g.yas mdun du 'bebs pa dang 22la rkang g.yon 'bebs pa sogs g.yas skor gyis/1122334455677zhes pa'i bar rkang gnyis re mos kyis phab mdun du/82ces par rnga brda bya zhing /de nas g.yas su gcus pa'i steng brdung gi nyis brdung 1g.yon du gcus pa'i 'og brdung nyis brdung 1/mdun du steng brdung bya'o/khrug pa shang shang ni/rnga yu brla la brten te/steng brdung gi/123la rnga brda che ba bya zhing /de'i 3bar lus cud zad nem tsam byas nas rnga bsgrengs te 'dzin zhing /chig brdung gi 123/12zhes pa'i gsum la grangs par thag ran pa/12la chig brdung dal ba yod pa'i/lnga tshan dang po'i la rkang g.yon phab/2la rkang g.yas bteg nas bar snang /gsum par phab/1la rkang g.yon bteg nas phab/2la rkang g.yas bteg phab 27ba ) rnams 'gro phyogs su spo/2pa'i tshe rnga yu brla la brten nas steng brdung ngos rgyab la phyi then byed pa ma gtogs snga ma gshin 'bebs lugs bya/2par snga ma ji lta ba bzhin 'gro phyogs su'o//4pa la 2pa ji lta ba'i rgyab then ngos rjes ma'i 2zhes par rnga brda che ba 1bya/de nas rnga bsgrengs te 'dzin zhing /lnga pa'i 1la rkang g.yon g.yon du phab/3par rkang g.yas bteg cing cung shugs che bas g.yon skor du bskor ngos yong phyogs su sleb rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gegayas su cung zad 'phyar/mchod 'o 'a zhes par nang g.yon bteg lag gnyis g.yon du gzhol ba'i 'gro phyogs34ba phab/pa la rkang rting gsig dang /lag gnyis g.yon phyogs bteg nas stob tshul bya/rgya zhes par rkang g.yas g.yon du bskor nas 'gro phyogs phab/ma lil rkang rting gsig lag mdun mnyam/mtsho'i zhes par rkang g.yas rgyab phyogs kyi g.yon du bteg 'bebs/'o 'a zhes par rtig gsig/tsho gos la rkang g.yas rgyab phyogs kyi g.yon ngos su phab cing lag gnyis kyang g.yon du phyogs/wa' zhes par rkang g.yon drud pa dang /'a'i la rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs su bteg 'bebs/wa'i la rting gsig gi g.yas su cung zad bskor/dang /nga'i la rkang g.yon mdun du bteg 'bebasadang lag mdun mnyam/wa'i la rting gsig/sems/ma'i zhes par rkang g.yas yong phyogs su 'then/kyi la rting gsig dang lag gnyis g.yas su 'phyar/'bul 'u zhes par rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs su bteg 'bebs lag gnyis g.yon du gzhol/lo zhes par rkang rting gsig/lag gnyisagayon phyogs bteg pa'i stob tshul/bzhes la rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs phab lag gnyis g.yon du phyogs/ya'i la rkang g.yon bteg tsam/su la rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs phab/'u zhes par rting gsig gi g.yas su cung zad bskor/gsol la rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs phab/la zhes par rting gsig/'a'i la rkang g.yon bteg 'bebs/la'i la rkang g.yas bteg nas bzhi 'gros gsum gyi rjes rnal rkang g.yon mdun du phab nas/stob dbyangs gnyis pa sngun ma ji lta ba bzhin rdzogs rdzas kyi rkang g.yas bteg ste/tri shu 'gros gsum bya ba ni/rtsa ba'i 'chams kyi rdo rje phyed 'gros/rkang g.yas len kho na lan gsum bya ba yin cing /de nas bzhi 35na 'gros nyid sa sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros byas te 'chams khang du rim bzhin brdog pa'o//de ltar dpal chen rdo rje phur bu yi//stod las byang chub bsgrub dang smad las kyi//'chams kyi gsal byed bklags pas kun shes pa//rig sngags yong ba'i dga' ston bla na med//lusa'agyur snang sogs sngon rabs mkhas pa yi//gaX bzhi wo byed dbang po'i dkyil 'khor dag/

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'am pas kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma (gnartogs dka'i chu 'dzin sgrib g.yogs kun bsal nas/ /mthong grol snang ba'i 'od stong 'di na 'bar ces so/ /sa skyong grags pa g.yas g.yas su phab/ 2la g.yon bteg g.yas 'phar te lag mdun mnyam dang / 3la rkang g.yon bteg g.yas 'phar ba'i g.yon phyogs phab ste/ 4la rkang g.yon 'phar zhing g.yon du bskor/ yong phyogs su 1la rkang g.yas phab ste bzhi 'gros byas shing 'chamasakhang mtshams su brdog /de nas slar bzhi 'gros brtsam ste 'chams dmangs kyang rim 'don ngos rkang g.yas g.yon gyi bzhi 'gros gnyis re dang / bshad ma thag pa'i 4tshan gnyis po'i len spel ba'i 'don gyi do ra 'khor ba dang / g.yon pa'i bzhi 'gros 3thog phaṭa ces pas bsgyur/gnyis pa ni/ gong gi grangs lhag 4la yangs pad kyi 'go brtsams te/ de nas rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedagag bad dang / rol pa 1bya ba ma gtogs/ rkang g.yas g.yon 'degs 'jog /lag nang du bskor nas lag brgyang ba/ chem rgyag bzhi la phab/ 2par g.yon go ldog bya ba ni dga' ba yongs bsgyur 'thol bcas zhes bya/ gsum pa ni/ rkang g.yon g.yon du 'bebs dang phaṭa je/ sbir sbram 4la dgag par rol pa 1/ (36na 'ag gnyis nang du bskor nas/ 2gang 'os bldab pa 'di la klu pa zhes bya/ yang phan ces bsgyur nas/drug pa ni/ gong gi sbram sbram la yangs pad kyi 'go brtsams te/ dgag pad dang / 'di la rol pa 3bya ba'i rjes mar g.yas su gsig pa'i dgu skor chung ba g.yon g.yas kyi rjo nas bzhi 'gros rnams brub 'chams ltar ro/ /bdun pa ni/ bzhi 'gros g.yon gsum pa'i thog phaṭa kyis bsgyur te/gong gi 4la yangs pad/ de nas4brdung 2kyi dang po'i 1la lag g.yas phyag mtshan bus steng / 2la g.yas steng du 'phyar ba dang mnyam du rkang g.yon bteg g.yas 'bar ba'i yong phyogs su 3la phab/4la g.yas bteg g.yon 'phar ba'i/ 2pa'i 1la lag g.yas su phab ste/ g.yon bteg rnal g.yasa'aphar nas/ 3la g.yon du phab/ 4la g.yas bteg nas yong phyogs la blta bas/ 1 1 (36ba)2 rnal g.yas su rkang bteg 'bebs dang lag g.yas 'phyar gyi ṭ+wāṃ nas/ 4tshan 2kyi dang po'i 1la rkang —582

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'am pas kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganagayas bteg g.yon du bskor mdun du mchod stabs kyis g.yas zur bstan lhag ma 3la gsig pa dang / lag g.yas nang du bskor nas
