2la g.yas bteg g.yon 'phar ba'i 3la phab bstun lag g.yas bus steng / 4la 'gro phyogs blta ba'i rkang g.yon bteg lag g.yon 'phyar nas/g.yon phyogs su ji gnyis dang / 4tshan 2kyi dang por g.yas su bskor g.yon zur bstan nas gsig pa sogs snga ma go ldog /2pa'i 1 2la rang sa/ 3la rkang g.yas mdun du spo/ 4la yangs pad/ slar 4tshan 1gi dang po lag g.yas pus steng / 2la lag g.yas steng du 'phyar/ 3la g.yas su cung zad gzhol/ 4la rkang g.yon mdun du spos nas g.yon g.yas su rdza bya/ 'di la g.yas g.yob g.yon g.yob bo/ /brgyad pa ni/ gong gi g.yas thog phaṭa kyis bsgyur te/ sbir sbram zhes pa gnyis kyi sbir la rol mo chem rgyan che ba'i bar thag ring ba dang / sbram la bar thag cung thung ba yod pas dang po'i sbir la rkang g.yas bteg g.yon 'phar ba dang lag g.yas phyir nas mchan khung nas bskor te phyir brgyad pa'i 'gro phyogs su phab/ sbram zhes par lag g.yon 'phyar rkang gnyis rting gsig bya/ 2 pa la g.yas ji lta ba g.yon go ldog /'di la gros gsar zhes bya lan (37na)1gam 2bldab cing / ma ha dang bcas zhal brnyan rwa can gyi rwa khyer dang / zhal brnyan ngom pa zhes pa ni/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi 'khyer la mig bltas pas yong ba yin te/ 'don nas brtsams te rnam bshad bar kun la 'gre'o/ /dgu pa ni/ gong gi g.yon res kyi rting gsig thog phaṭa kyis bsgyur nas/ sbir sbram zhes pa bzhi la rol mo gros gsar dang len lugs 'dra bas/ dang po'i sbir la yangs pad len skyur bya ste/rkang g.yon bteg g.yas su bskor yong phyogs g.yas 'phar ba'i sbram zhes phab/ g.yas bteg g.yon 'phar bas yangs pad len skyur byas te 2pa'i sbir la phab rjes rkang g.yon g.yas su drud de/g.yas bteg g.yon du cung zad bskor sbram la phab/ g.yon bteg g.yon 'phar ba'i yangs pad —583

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogelen skyur byas nas 3pa'i sbir la phab rjes/g.yas g.yon phyogs drud de/g.yon bteg g.yas su cung zad bskor yong phyogs la sbram la phab rjes/g.yas bteg g.yon 'phar bas yangs pad len skyur byas te 4pa'i sbir la phab rjes/g.yas 'degs 'jog la sbram sbram zhes rjes ma chung bar g.yon bteg tsam nas stib khung la g.yon zur bstan te/ 22zhes pa'i le tshan drug dang /rol pa/dgu brdung /4tshan 2kyi/ pa'i pa yan brub 'chams dang mtshungs/lhag ma'i 34la rkang g.yas bteg 'bebs bya/de nas:ra sbram 3la dang po la g.yon/ pa bdun/3pa g.yon 'gro phyogs rnams la snga ma go ldog/de bzhin du 2zhes pa drug dang /rol ba/dgu brdung /4tshan kyi dang po yan kyang snga ma go ldog byas te/4tshan 2pa rang sar bsdad de g.yon 37bsko yas su rjo nas/gnyis pa gdab kha dngos gzhi la gsum las/dang po'i bskul tshig la loms dang dbyangasaganyas ka/brub 'chams kyi dam tshig chen po bzhin dang /g.yas g.yab kyang bya/gnyis pa'i tshe/chos rgyal gyi zhal bas dus/dbyangs gong bzhin dang 'chams gros gsar bya ste tshig rkang rer g.yas g.yon gyi 'gros re 'gro ba'i rdzogs mtshams kyi tshig lhad gnyis la rkang g.yon 'degasa'ajog byas/de nas4brdung 2kyi dang po'i la/rkang g.yas bteg lag g.yas mdun brkyang byasarkang g.yon 'phar te mdun 'brub khung phyogs su phab rjes/g.yon bteg gnyis la rkang g.yas 'phar lag g.yon mdun brkyang nas3la 'brub khung mdun du phab rjes/g.yas bteg 4la g.yon 'phar/2pa'i la rkang g.yas mi 'bebs par lag mdun mnyam bya zhing 'gying /2la rkang g.yas kyi rtse 'bebs pa dang lus cung gug tsam nas/3la rkang rting gsig dang bcas lag gnyis steng du 'phyar/4la rkang g.yon mdun du drud de/sbir sbram gyi g.yon g.yas su ṭ+wāṃ zhing bsdad nas rol mo 'bebs byas bsgral ba'o//lha mo'i zhal brnyan 'cham dus/gnyis pa'i tshe drug brdung gi 'gros ni/'chams dbyangasagong ltar gyi tshig rkang rer/13456ces pa / 4dang po'i 23re rer 'gro phyogs su rkang g.yas

dpal kun tu bzang po'i la smras kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganabateg 'bebs re rer g.yon 'phar chung re byas te 'gro/ 4la rang g.yon yong phyogs su 'then nas/56la lag gnyis g.yon 'phyar gdong yong phyogs la bltas te 'gying / 2pa la rkang g.yon bteg nas 'gro phyogs la rkang g.yas g.yon dang lag go ldog bya/ phyag mtshan so so brdeg dus/ g.yon pa'i drug tshan gyi/ 1la (38na)rkang g.yon mdun bskor te 'bebs pa dang lus kyi g.yon nam zhing g.yas su blta/ 2la g.yon 'phar ba dang g.yas gom rkun byas te 'brub khung mdun du rkang g.yas bteg 'bebs dang bstun 3la phyag mtshan btab ste/ 4la rkang g.yon phyir 'then/ 56la g.yas su lag gnyis 'phyar zhing 'gyings nas/ de nas g.yas bteg pa'i 'gros gong ltar bya/ mtshams kyi bsgral lugs rnams mthong brgyud ltar bya dgos pa rdzogs nas/ rjes kyi bya ba gsum las dang po sbir sbram gyi rol pa 3gyi rjes mar langs te/ dgu skor chung ba/ g.yon g.yas kyi rdza nas/ dgu skor 'dzag gnyis ma 4dang / bzhi 'gros 3rjes 12la rkang g.yon mdun du 'bebs rnams brub 'tshamasaltar bya/ gnyis pa stob dbyangs la/ hūṃ/ 4nga'i/ phyi/ ya'i/ nang / gsang zhes par lag gyen bstan mdun mnyam/ ba'i la lag gnyis g.yas su 'phyar rkang rting gsig bya/ mchod/ 'o' zhes par lag gnyis g.yon phyogs gzhol nas/ pa' zhes par lag gnyis g.yon phyogs mtho bar bteg nas stob tshul bya ste/ rkang g.yon rang sa/ rkang g.yas brkyang gi rting pa btsugs te rkang mgo bteg /spyir mgo cung zad phab/ gdong g.yas su bstan nas/ rgya ma'i/ mcho'/ 'os/ tshogs/ wa'/ 'a'i/ wa'i/dang / nga 'a/ ba'i/ sems bar de kha rang sa/ kyi la lag gnyis g.yon phyogs tsor rkang rting gsiga'abul 'ul lag gnyis g.yas su gzhol nas/ lo zhes par lag gnyis g.yas su bteg ste stob tshul la rkang / lag /spyi/ gdong rnams snga mgo ldog nas/ bzhes/ ya'i/ su'u rnams la rang sa/ gsolal rkang g.yon mdun du 'degs(38ba 'jog dang / la zhes par rkang g.yas bteg tsam bya/ 'a'i rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs su 'degs 'jog byas nas/ la'i la rkang g.yas bteg nas bzhi 'gros 3byas te/ mdun 12zhes par rkang g.yon phab/ 22la slar rkang g.yon bteg g.yon 'phar te phab —585

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegayas bteg /4brdung gsum la g.yas pas brtsams te/ rtsa ba'i 'chams dpal chen po'i stob 'chams ltar byas nas 12la rkang g.yon mdun du phab nas/ stob dbyangs gnyis snga ma ji lta ba snga phyi go ldog pa rdzogs mtshams kyi gsol la rkang g.yas mdun du 'degs 'jog nas/ tshig lhad gsum dang / bzhi 'gros gsum yang snga ma go ldog byas te/ 1la rkang g.yas mdun du phab/ 22la slar rkang g.yas 'degs 'jog byas/ 4tshan 3la g.yon nas brtsam ste stob 'chams bzhin no/ /de nas 1la rkang g.yon mdun du phab/ 2la g.yas phyir 'then tsam/ 2rjes mar g.yon bteg 'jog nas/g.yas nas brtsams pa'i bzhi 'gros gsum mdun phyogs su byas te/ 12la rkang g.yon mdun du phab nas chem brdung chung ngur bya/ de nas chem rgyag bzhi la/ dang po la lag g.yas g.yas phyogs nasanang du bskor te phyir brgyang ba dang mnyam du rkang g.yas phyir 'then/ 2par lag g.yon g.yon phyogs nas nang du bskor te phyir brgyang ba dang mnyam du rkang g.yon phyir 'then/ phyi ma 2la'ang de ga bldab/de nas phaṭa kyis bsgyur/ sbram sbir sbram 3la dang po yangs pad/ 2pa la lag g.yas steng du 'phyar/3par g.yas su gzhes/ de rjes rol gsum gyis rjes mar g.yas su gsigs nas/ sbir sbram gyisarol mo thang brdung la rkang g.yas bteg g.yon 'phar te smir la 'bebs pa dang bstun lag g.yas mdun du brkyang / rkang g.yon bteg sbram la g.yon 'phar ba dang lag g.yas dkur brten/ sbir la lag g.yon mdun brkyang ba dang / slar rkang g.yas 'phar ba'i g.yon 'bebs/ g.yas btegs sbram la g.yon 'phar te lag g.yon dkur brten pa 'di la rnam bshad 'gros sam sbar bsnol zhes bya/'di gas sprul nag 'byog 'gros byas te 'chams khang du brdog pa'o/ /de ltar bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams kyi rim pa mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bshad zin to/ /spyir bzo la lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzo gsum du stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs la/ phyag rgya'i gar 'chams 'di nyid la lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzo gsum ga tshang ba yin te/ lus kyi bzo ni mngon sum du grub cing / ngag gi bzo ni gsang sngags kyi sgra grag stong —586

dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'chams kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar/ nang ma rtoganaskye ba med pa'i tshul du bzla/ying/ kyi bzo ri/ lnga'i bskyed rim gyi nga rgyal gsal snang dang ma bral bas so//gsang sngags rnying ma la zhi khro sgyu 'phrul dang /sgrub chen bka' brgyad/rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor/bstan srung chos skyong gi skor sogs la 'chams kyi rim pa rnam grangs mang zhing /khyad par gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug dang /'bri khung zhabs drung rin cen phun tshogs sogs gter bton mang po zhig gis mnal lam bzung nas zangs mdog dpal rir byon te/der gar 'chams mdzad kyi 'dug pa rnams gzigs pa la brten/lus 'gyur gyi rim pa mang du 'dug pa'ang ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su snang zhing /bka' brgyad bye brag pa phur pa'i 'chams 'khon klu'i dbang po srungs nasanye bar brgyud de dpal ldan sa skya pa yab sras 39bkyi phyag len du nye bar bstar ba/mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun ji lta bar mchod dpon shes rab snang bas bkod pa'i lus 'gyur snang ba'i lugs bzhin gnam bskos rgyal po'i pho brang sne'u sdong rtser sa skyong thams cad mkhyen pa grags pa 'byung gnas dang /dkon gnyer dpon rin po che kun bzang rtse ba rnams kyi phyag bzhes su mdzad pa dag rang nyid kyis sbyangs shing nyams su myong ba yi ger bkod pa yin no//sa skya nas bdag po sngags long chen pos phur pa smad las kyi 'chams la dur khrod bdag po'i 'chams bcug nas gzigs mo 'bul phyir nged rang gi blo la shar nas byas gsung ba/bdag chen pa 'phreng po gter bton pa'i lung bstan na slob dpon be+e ro tsa na'i sprul par bstan yod 'dug pas dam pa'i gzigs snang la shar ba dag khungs dang 'brel ba'i gnas yin shas che na'ang /gong ma'i phyag len la med pa gsar du bcug pa 'brel ma chags shing /gzigs mo 'bul phyir gsung ba/ding sang gsang sngags kyi phyag len sogs mi shes par lto phyir du snang ba la gang shar gyi 'chams byas nas gzhan mgo bskor ba rnams kyi ngang tshul la brten/'chams ltad mo dang rtsed mo lta bu yin snyam pa'i phal tshig shor 'dug pas rdzob rtags kyi gsung du 'duX ḍi/lus ni lha yi rnam 'gyur rol gar can//ngag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogeni gsang sngags dbyar rnga lta bur sgrol/yid ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ṣi lon ro//ṣ+ka ldan rig sngags 'amang ba de lo byung /khri med rgyud sde'i phyag len ji bzhi du//ho med rigs 'dzin tsho gis la nyer 'ongs pa'i//sngon med 'chams kyi lus 'gyur gsal 40na ) byed 'di//'khrul med kun bzang rtse ba'i lugs srol yin//ṣ+ka ldan lag len bor nas rang bzo yi//gang shar khrom gyi dbus su 'chams pa rnams//gsang chen bstan pa nyams pa'i byed po mā/g.yin 'phrul dbang byed gnas nas 'ongs min nam//de phyir 'gong po'i gdon gyis ma zin pa'i//rnam dpyod ldan rnams sngon byon dam pa yi//ring lugs nyams pa med la bslabs byas nas//rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyisagrub par byos//de ltar cher 'bad dge tsho gis yid bzhi dbang //bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser//bkod pa'i mthu yis gar thig dbyangs la sogs//gsang chen bstan pa'i phyag len rgyas gyur cig/ces dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'am pas kyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar zhes pa 'di'ang rnam bar rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa sogs rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'dus pa'i gdu ma la phan par ba4 pa'i blos/za sto gyi ban+de ngag da/bang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ming gas bla med rdo rje rtsal du 'bod pas me phag hor zla bzhi pa'i nang du 'go btsugs te/rtsa 'chams yongs su rdzogs pa dang /brub woms kyi phal cher grub skabs rnam g.yeng gi khol por song nas 'phro lus/de nas glang nang du pho brang po ta lar sne'u sdong rtse nasaXs drung rin po che ma wo phebs skabs/spyan lam du phab nas zhusadag gnang zhing /slar pho brang gong ri dkar po'i dkon gnyer dpon dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyis zhugadag dang /cung zad lus pa rnams gong dang cha mtshungs su yi ger bkod bcug pa'i mjug sdom dang bcas yongs su rdzogs par chu 'brug nag pa zla ba'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du bkod pa sirnyi ra stu// //88

rje bzhi bsam gto gling pa'i a ti'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin chen do shal/ nang ma rtoganar༅༅/ /rje btsun bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin cen do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs tres/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas phyon sprul pa'i sku/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin paṇa chen bi ma la/ /rgya bod rigs 'dzin mu rtag ka 'phreng ltar/ /tshad med tsho gis rnams snying dbus ze'u tsor brten/ /'jam mgon 'khon rigs zab don gaṅgā'i klung / /sdong ston rim byon thugs mtshor 'khyil ba'i 'jings /legs bzhugs rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa/ /de'i dbon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mchag rtag tu bsngags/ /rang rig snyan brgyud gdams pas rab myos shing / khyad par bad 'byung gter ston chos dbang sogs/ /mkhas grub du mas dngos nyams byin brlabs pa/ /zab lam gsal mdzad bsam gtan gling par 'dud/ /mgon khyod thugs kyi klong brdol yang phur gyi/ /ga dmasang ga a ti ston mkhas zha lu pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rin cen bsod na mas mchoge grub gtsug na mdzes/ /dam pa'i drin las thos pa'i glegs bam 'di'i/ /dkar chag sgrigs zhes rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis/ /(2na tha ka' stsal mi bzlog gzhan phan rang yid la/ /goms phyir 'dri bar chosasrung gnang ba stsol/ /de yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rnams dang bla res slob res kyi tshul du byon nas snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa ldong ston rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug sogs rim par byon pa'i gdung las mnyam med rje btsun bsam gtan gling pa nam mkha' bsod nams de nyid rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ldong ston seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs/ dpon 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog gis gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gdams pa rnams gnang zhing rjes su bzung ba'i mkhas shing grub pa'i 'bor los sgyur ba chen por gyur/ khyad par a ti rdzogs pa —589

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gechen po ka dag snang bzhi'i lam la ring brgyud la ltos mi dgos par dus gsum sangs rgyas dpal phyon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dngos dang mnal lam du byin gyis brlabs pas man ngag rnams thugs kyi klong nas rang brdol ba lta bur gyur la/ gzhan yang gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho sprul pa'i gter ston gu ru (2ba)chos kyi dbang phyug /mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ bla chen 'brog mi/zhang dgon pa ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ 'khon rigs 'jam dpal rdo rje sa skya pa gong ma lnga/ dpal ldan bla ma dam ba sogs kyis rjes su bzung ba la brten nas man ngag 'di nyid yi ger bkod cing skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la gnang bas bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti zhes zab pa'i snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab cing / gsang sngags gsar rnying spyi dang / khyad par sngags rnying ma'i phyogs la bar skabs su dar rgyas shin tu che na'ang / dus dbang gis rang gzhan kun la gal chung chos su byed pa 'di ches mang bsarim gyi 'grib ste rgyun dkon par snang ba/ kho bo sngon gyi bsags rgyab dang smon lam gyi 'tshams sbyor mi dman pas zab chos 'di nyid thos pa'i skal ba can du gyur pas glegs bam gang 'di'i dkar chag 'dri ba la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa brgyud pa dang lo rgyus kyi skor/ man ngag nyamasalen dngos kyi skor/ khungs dang rgyab rten gyi skor/ rtsa gsum las byang chos srung gi skor dang bzhi/dang po ni/ shin tu nye brgyud kun tu bzang po la rje bsam gtan gling pas gsan pa/ nye brgyud slob dpon chen po pad+ma la gsan pa/ ring brgyud yang phur slong bshags rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus pa rtsa ba'i brgyud pa rin po che don grub dpal 'byor la gsan pa dang / phur pa rtsa dum/ yang phur rtsa dum lta ba'i slong bshags dang bcas pa/ bi ma la'i bsam gtan mig gi sgron ma/ phur pa lcam lugs su grags pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang rnams kyi brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba so so rang gi khu bo mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal (3na〉5 cho go la gsan pa/ gnyan lo nas brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams kyi mjug tu/ stong nyid ma rtogs thar pa gang gis thob/ /rdzogs chen med na stong nyid ci phyir go /bsod nams dman pas rdzogs chen ga la rnyed/ /de la kho bo min pa su yis —590

rje bas bsam gto gling pa'i a ti'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin chen do shal/ nang ma rtoganabasngags/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad ltar na mnyam med chen po'i gsung 'dra yang / 'di'i 'gor pha chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bsam gtan gling pa zhes pa'i tshig rigasal dpags na dngos slob zhig gis mdzad dam snyam mo/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen rtsod spong gi yi ge rnams las rje btsun bsam gtan gling pas snying po bsdus te tshig nyung don rgyas su mdzad pa 'di'i sbyar byang du/ de skad 'di ni 'dri ba po/ /cho ge sku kun bzang rol pa sa /'char bar re ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gdod nas rang grol ma yin nam/ /zhes gsungs pasagadod nas rang grol de mtshan gyi rnam grangs su nges so/ /rtsod spong 'dis 'gos lhas btsas/ pho brang zhi ba 'od sogs sngon byon mang po'i 'jam yig dang / phyis kyi 'bri gung dpal 'dzin/ mi me pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs du ma'i rtsod yig mtha' dag bye ma'i changs bu ltar gyur nas bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis ded pa'i tshul 'di ni shin tu ngo mtshar bar snang bas dpyod ldan rnams snying la 'chang bar bya'o/ /bi ma la'i bsam gtan mig gi sgron ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs spyi gtsug nyi zla ma/ yang phur thun mong gi gdams pa'i rdzogs chen bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'gyur mang thig lam/ brgyud 'debs gong 'og gnyis ka'i mjug tu blo ka re gnyis tsam rjes 'jug gis bcug pa (3ba7sa dngos gzhi rje btsun chen po nyid kyi gsung du nges shing / khyad par 'gyur med thig le ma'i gsham na/ byar mang bsam gtan gling pa yis/ /dad pa'i char sprin g.yos lags so/ /zhes pasakyang shes nus/ brgyud 'debs phyi ma 'di chos 'di la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnams bsdus pa lasagacig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ni min no/ /mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa'i bstod pa dad pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba sde snod 'dzin pa sangs rgyas lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ mnyam med chen po nyid kyis nyam nga ba'i rtsar rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis dngos nyams su khu 'khrig gi mtshan ma byung bar brten gnas lugs mngon sum du ston pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa gnas spyi bo bde chen ma/ mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa nyid kyi mnal lam brda chos kyi tshul du 'jam dbyangs/—591—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2po'abyog mi/ zhang / ba ri ba/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga dang / drung chos rje pa/ /skyon chen po/ gter ston chos dbang / gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho sogs kyis rjes su bzung tshul gyi rnam thar tshig nyung zhing don zab pa mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i sbu long g.yo bar nus pa rje btsun rang nyid kyis mdzad pa/ yang dag dang phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bdud rtsi khungs 'byin rje btsun bsam gtan gling pas mdzad pa/ bram ze mi thod can sogs kyis bskul ba la brten nas kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi gong nas brtol ba'i yang phur gyi glegs bam pra bha hasti dang hūṃ ka ra la bka' babs pa/ slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar las brtsams te bka' gter gyi byung tshul/ bi ma la dang gnubs kyi lo rgyus sogs chos 'dir mkho ba'i chos 'byung (4na khrig nyung don rgyas pa zhig snang ngo / /gnyis pa man ngag nyams len dngos kyi skor la/ a ti yo ga'i zab 'khrid kyi sa gcad 'gro kun dga' bskyed ces bya ba mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa chen po'i gsung rgyun bla ma sangs rgyas lhun grub kyis zin bris su btab pa/ 'di 'khrid 'chad pa la shin tu mkho ba'i gces gnad yin/ yang phur gnyis kyi thun mong gi rdzogs rim rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i 'khrid yig lam rim thar pa'i sgo gcig ces bya ba rje btsun bsam gtan gling pas mdzad pa/ 'di la sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs dang 'og gsal snang ba bzhi'i lam gyi rim pa rdzogs chen spyi skad dang mthun pa la rlung sbyor dang rigs drug gi sa bon sbyong ba phur pa dang sbyar ba/ gcig du bral gyis gtan la phab pa rnams las khyad zhugs pa'i zhi lhag dang sbyor tshul sogs man ngag zur khyad can ngo mtshar ba'i gnad gsang tshes shin tu zab pas/ ji skad du/ dbyibs dang kha dog cha tshad nges na yang / khyu 'bras ngo bo gsum gyis stong bas na/ /gnyen pos mi 'jig rkyen gyis mi 'gyur ba'i/ /don gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa kho bo tsam/ /zhes gsung ba'ang don la gnas shing mthug tu sngags bdag ging chen bco brgyad dang dab la sngags kyi srung ma la gnyer gtad shin tu 'jigs pa yod do/ /sems 'dzin gyi man ngag cung zad tsam zur du phye ba rje btsun nyid kyis gsungs te/ zhi —592

rje gzha bsam gto gling pa'i a ti'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin chen do shal/ nang ma rtoganaganas bsgom pa'i tshul skabs don 'grub pa zhig sngar bstan zin ces pas kyang shes so/ /bsam gtan gyi gol sa gcod pa rje btsun bsam gtan gling pas mdzad pa/ gong gi mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang lnga po ri bo rtse lngar chos rje paṇ+ḍi tas ye shes (4ba)kyi sku 'phags pa rin po cher bstan nas rtogs pa dpe'i phyag chen ngo sprad pa'i tshe 'phags pas mdzad par 'dug /'di'i nang du rgya nag hwa shang gi lta ba ngan pa ka ma las bkag la/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang por lo zla bdun gyi bar du rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas lteng po yod par mkhas pa bi ma las de 'dras 'tshang mi rgya zhes rdzogs chen bstan pa/ phyis phyag chen mtshan nyid pa ma yin par lta ba la phyag chen du ming btags pa'i zog chos rnams sdom gsum du bkag pa dang / sems gnas tsam gyi phyag chen bka' bstan bcos kyi lung khungs rnams dang mi 'grel tshul snying po bsdus te bstan pas a ti sgom pa la nye bar mkho zhing lam log par mi 'khyam pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gsum pa khungs dang rgyab rten gyi skor la/ snang bzhi'i don ston pa'i bsam gtan mig gi sgron pa paṇa chen bi ma las mdzad pa/ tshig drug drug gis rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong bar byed pa spros pa gcod pa'i sgron ma/ rig pa tshad la 'bebs pa'i snang ba ston pa/ me'i log gnon zhan byung du rmi lam sbyang ba/ rim pa gnyis la 'jug pa'i sgo mnyam med bsam gtan gling pas mdzad pa/ 'dir bskyed rdzogs kyi skabs gsang 'dus dus 'khor gnyis dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ de bzhin mdo sngags kyi lta ba la rtogs lugs kyi sgo nas myur bul sogs gnad 'gag yod do/ /rlung sbyor la mkho ba rin po che lung gi phra thig /'di zab pa pod bzhir yod pa dang 'dra min zhig 'dug rung dri med bshes gnyen gyi gsung 'gros/ sgron ma drug gi gnad ston pa gsang ba'i thigs pa yang gsang sbas pa'i dum bu/ rgyud bcu bdun gyi khong snying (na loms su len tshul snod min la mi ster ba'i bka' rgya can/ 'di gnyis lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug gis mdzad/ gdod nas dag pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs ston pa'i rtsa ba slob dpon bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa don drug pa —593—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogeganubs yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa/thig le gsang skor gyi gnad chog bzhi ma/gdams pa tshig gcig ma/gnad gsum gyi man ngag tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi thugs gter/lta sgom spyod gos kyi gnad slob dpon rin po ches gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug la mnal lam gyi tshul du gsungs pa/a ti yo ga'i lam gyi rim pa la nye bar mkho ba mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa'i gsung 'gros thor bu zhal slob rnams kyis zin bris su btab pa tshogs chen stan gcig dpal 'byor bzang pos 'khrid yig gi go rim dang bstun nas bsgrigs par mnyam med chen po'i dngos slob gsang phu ba chos rgyal bas zhus dag mdzad pa/'di la mdo sngags bstan bcos kyi lung 'dren gyi rgyab chos mang du yod do//glang po che rab 'bogs nas bkol ba'i dri med bshags rgyud kyi ye shes lha dang 'khon gcugs bshags pa'i le'u zur du phyung ba lta ba'i klong bshags ye shes sku mchog lta ba'i klong bshags kyi bshad thabs mnyam med chen po'i dngos slob zhal phub nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/rdzogs pa chen po phyi skor nang skor gsang ba bla na med pa rnams kyi rnam par dbye ba gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar rje dpal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa/rdzogs pa chen 5ba ) po'i phyi skor gyi gzhung don gsal byed/'di'i mjug na/gangs ri'i khrod kyi lam rdzogs pa//dam pa'i drin thob gang yin des//dpal ldan dwags po'i ring lugs pa//skal ldan skyes bu zhig la gdams//zhes pa la dpags na mnyam med chen po'i gsung yin pa 'dra'o//re ga nag po dang dri med 'od zer gyi 'char tshul mnyam med chen po'i gsung rgyun/a ti phyi skor gyi 'khrid yig tshigs bcad ma mi me pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rje rang thong rdo rje 'di nyid mkha' 'gro snying thig gi chos bdag dang bi ma las byin gyis brlabs pas snying thig gnyis la mnga' brnyes nasardzogs chen gyi bstan 'dzin yin na'ang /gang gi sprul par grags pa'i mi bskyod rdo rjes gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi phyogs la snying nas smod cing /zab mo nang don gyi brgyud par bzhugs pa'i grwa phyi rgyal ba g.yung ston pas bal yul nas gsang ba snying po'i ṭ+wāṃ dpe rdzus ma bzos zhes skur pa gdab pa sogs

rje btsun bsam gto:nga pa'i a rta'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin chen do shal/ nang ma rtoganal dpags na khyed rang gis sne'u gdong gong ma chen por phul ba'i chab shog tu/ deng dus dbu ru byang phyogs rgyud 'di na/ /gter ston lcang lo can sogs bdud sprul 'gas/ zhes lha sras rgyal po'i rnam 'phrul 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs la zur za bar mdzad 'dug kyang bdud de khyed rang gi shangs su mdzub mo 'dzugs par rigs sam/ zab chos 'di nyid kyi bshad khungs yang dag rtsa ba/ ru lu 'bru brgyad gser 'phreng thugs kyi lde mig slob dpon hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ zab chos 'di nyid kyi bshad khungs phur pa rtsa dum/ de yang gong du yang phur gnyis kyi rtsa ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang phur ni (6nasgo rgyas 'di nyams su len pa'i yi dam yin cing / der ma zad lta ba'i skabs kyang yang dag rtsa ba nas yig 'bru bcu bzhi dang / phur pa rtsa dum nas yig 'bru gsum gyi dgongs pa dang sbyor la/ snang bzhi sgron drug gi skor la bsam gtan mig sgron dang / nyams chags skong bar lta ba'i klong bshagasarnams la rtsa ba lta bur mdzad pa yin no/ /sdo pa snang rtse bas yang phur gnyis la smin byed dgosapa yin/ zhes kho rang gi blos dpyad kyis byin rlabs nyung ngu zhig brtsams nas rgyun spel ba ni rang gter rnams kyang shog ser la ma ltos par thogs med du brtsams pa'i lang shor dang / khyad par chos 'di'i gnad ma rtogs pa'i mun nag 'dom 'jal te a ti 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur gnyis kyi rdzogs rim zab pa'i mthar thug yin pas/ smin byed kyi dbang sa lugs yang phur gyi dbang las gzhan du mi dgos la/ gal te de nyid ma thob na bka' gter gang yang rung ba'i yang phur gyi smin byed thob bas mi rung ba ma yin no/ /phur pa rtsa dum gyi bshad rgyud kyi zin bris rje btsun bsam gtan gling pa'i gsung rgyun bzhin gsang phu chos rgyal bas mdzad pa/ phur pa stod las kyi don 'grel mnyam med chen po'i gsung rgyun/ rtsa ba gsum gyi bstod pa mnal lam du lhas gnang ba byin pa la brten nas mnyam med chen pos mdzad pa/ bum skrug lung dum dpal yang gsang sgrub pa'i bkol byang siṅga la'i slob dpon hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ zab don 'di la 'jug pa'i skyes bu yid tshes slad lung tshad ma bka' bstan bcos kun —593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gelas mnyam med (6ba)chen pos btus pa bar bar du gnad 'gag cung zad kyis 'tshams sbyar ba'i zab mo lung gi 'phreng ba 'di lung sbyor chung bar ngos 'dzin/ rje btsun bsam gtan gling pa'i gsung rgyun bka' bstan bcos kyi lung dang de dag gi dka' gnad bstan pa rang nyid kyis gsan pa dang zhal slob gzhan gyis zin bris su btab pa rnams stan gcig pa dpal 'byor bzang pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa 'di lung sbyor che ba yin/bzhi pa rtsa gsum las byang dang chos srung gi skor la/ rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang zhes pa rang nyid gza' rgod skyid rengs su bsgoms nas bstan ma bcu gnyis dang mon bu pu tra spun gnyis la 'phrin las 'chol ba/ 'khor lo rnam lnga'i gnad gal che tshul gnubs chen gyi gsung bgros gur mgon gyi bskang ba las nye bar btus pa cig /na ga ka la'i gnad kyi man ngag /ma mo rbod gtong gi rnam bshad gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma yid kyi mun sel tshogs chen pa dpal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa/ rtsa gsum las byang gi gsal byed mnyam med bsam gtan gling pas lag len mdo ru dril ba/ yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs la ma mo rbod gtong ngam sdebargyad 'o dod ma'am bde gshegs 'dus pa zhes bya ba/ gong gi rtsa ba gsum gyi skor 'di rnams bla ma gu ru pad ma 'byung gnas/ yi dam yang phur/ chos skyong la yang phur srung / la lar bstan ma bcu gnyis dang pu tra ming sring / la lar gdong zla sde brgyad thams cad tshang ba lta bu man ngag gab pa'i nyams kyis ha cang mi gsal zhing / gza' rgod skyid rengs sbrul zhags 'dzin pa de (7na rkong yi dam rnams ngo bo gcig pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa rdzogs chen gyi skabs 'dir rtsa gsum mtha' dag rtogs na kun tu bzang po ma rtogs na dregs pa rgyud gsum gyi rnam par 'char zhing / don rang gi rig par thag chod pa'i bzang ngan dang dgag bsgrub med pa zhig gnad du che ba la dgongs sam snyam/ de yang gza' rgod sbrul zhags 'dzin pa dmar nag 'di gnyis la gnod sbyin dmar nag tu yang 'bod cing chos nyid kyi srung par grags la/ khri srong rnam 'phrul chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis skyid smad chu shur du brag ston 596

rje gas bsam gto gling pa'i a ti'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin chen do shal/ nang ma rtoganapo'i sngags 'chang legs ldan rdo rje la chos 'di gsan pa'i lo rgyus su gtor sgam gyi logs la srung ma gnod sbyin dmar nag gi thang sku bkram 'dug tshul gnad pas kyang shes nus so/ /rje btsun mi las/ rong ston dang lha dga' yan chad du/ /spyir drin chen gyi bla ma bcu tsam bzhugs/ /khyad par lha rje gnubs chung la/ /drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zhus zhes gsungasapa'i gza' gdong dmar nag de phal cher las 'brel stsal dang / rat+na gling pa'i gza' gdong dmar nag dang dbyibs 'dra ba la de las rgyas pa zhig gnubs lugs la yod pa de yin par 'dod/ 'bri gung phyogs su gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag la ngos 'dzin/ 'ga' zhig gnod sbyin dmar nag 'di nyid yin zhes smra ba sogs mi mthun pa snang ngo / /dam can spyi'i gnad sdod ston mnyam med bsam gling pas mdzad pa 'dir pu tra'i lo rgyus ni yongs grags dang / de min khyab 'jug gi zhing gang las phur srung gi bse mo bzhi dang dpe har byung ba/ glog ma srin gnas tshul gyi sgo nas gdong mo bzhir bstan pa/ sde brgyad (7ba)ging chen bco brgyad/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs kyi 'byung khungs dang ngos 'dzin lo rgyus byings la ma grags pa'i legs bshad ngo mtshar can snang ngo / /gtum po khyi gzugs can gyi lo rgyus 'di'i brjod byar ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas gnod sbyin khol por bsgrubs tshul/ de'i mjug tu na mgon po zhal gyi bstod pa srin gzugs ma dang paṇ+ḍita dang gnyan lo gro mo sha dkar du mjal tshul 'dug pa la dpags na gtum po khyi gzugs de zhal dang rgyud gcig gam snyam/ pu tra ming sring bka' gter nas byung ba'i lo rgyus/ gnod sbyin dmar po'i nyamasalen 'di srung ma gnod sbyin dmar nag gnyis su grags pa'i dmar po'i skor ro/ /mjug tu rnam sras la brten nas mi nor zas gsum dbang du byed pa zhig snang / zang zang lha brag gi gter byon gyi srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ lo rgyus/ mchod 'phreng rnams/ bdud rgyal 'di la legasaldan dang stong dpon sogs ming sna tshogs yod kyang don du rgyal po dpe har nyid la ngos 'dzin pa yin no/ /zab chos 'di nyid kyi bla ma brgyud pa la/ shin tu nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun bsam gling pa nyid —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gekyi thugs kyi klong nas brdol bas ston pa kun tu bzang po dngos la gsan pa yin/nye brgyud ni/slob dpon bad ma 'byung gnas kyis dngos nyams su byin gyis brlabs pas phyon chen po la gsan pa dang /de las cung zad ring tsam ni/gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis gsungs pa yin/rdzogs wo bsam gtan mig sgron gyi ring brgyud ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che/slob dpon hūṃ ka ra/skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/paṇa chen zha tha ma la mi tra/bal po shrī la ma lha chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug/sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/mchims ston shākya bra bha/shud bu dpal gyi seng ge/nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/sba sgom blo gros dbang phyug/ldang ba lhun gyi rgyal mtshan/lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug/grub thob lce sgom chen po/slob dpon gnyer sgom chen po/gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug/mtshungasamed shes rab rin cen/'bri phyug pa rin cen 'bum/rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog/mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa nam mkha' bsod nams/zhal phug nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rin po che nam mkha' rdo rje/grub mchog ngag dbang chos rgyal/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod namasagrags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /de sras 'khon ston ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gragasapa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /zha lu mkhan chen rigs kun bdag po rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal ba ni byang chub kyi bar du bka' drin gzhal bar dka' ba yin no//yang dag rtsa ba'i brgyud pa ni/ston pa kun tu bzang po/mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che/slob dpon hūṃ ka ra/mkhas pa bi ma la mi lhag lhags sko na kumā ra/'o bran yang pa la gyi gzhen nu/'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug/'o bran chos kyi khrung gnas/'o bran grags pa rgya mtsho/'o bran dbang gi rgyal po/'o bran rta mchog rgyal po/'o bran ri rab brtan pa/ rin po che don grub dpal 'byor/98

rje bas ba4 gto gling pa'i ma lta'i chos skor gyi dkar ga theg mchog rin byu do shal/ nang ma rtoganamanyam med bsam gto gling pa man gong ltar/phur pa rtsa dum slong bshags dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/kun tu bzang po/las kyi dbang mo che/bra hasti/lha lcam u pa dwa na/skyon sangs rgyas gnyisapa/jo mo 'tsho rgyal/ā sto rla nu sa jo bo lang 'ang/khyi gyang 'gyel/stong gsum sgom chen/thag btsun shes rab 'od/gnubs chen grub thob kyi rnam thar las tshong mi bog kyang 4 la bar lo/mi la sogs du mchas shing /mi la skabs sa pa'i slong ma yin pas 'di yabs kyi zhal ngo phyi ma snyag dang nor sgo snyam dpyad do//sangasargyas me shes/rgya chos grags/yol lcags rgya ston 'bar/rnal 'byor gzhung smon/pho rog mdo sdemagon/yol lcags sangs rgyas nyi 'bum/rje don grub gzhen nu/dpyal 'phags pa dpal/dpyal kun dga' nyi ma/dpyal kun mkhyen/'jam dbyangs rgyal mchog/mnyam med chen po man gong ltar/yang na skyon chen po nas/sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/khams pa sgom chen/mchog gi legasapa/shes rab tshul khrims/mchog gi sems dpa'/'khon dkon cog rgyal po/mtha' bzhi ston pa/rdo rje drag rtsal/rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/rol pa'i rdo rje/glo bo lo tsā ba/9na 'phags pa rin po che/mang mkhar lo mchog pa/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge srung chos rje pa/rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa/mkhan chen rgyal mchog man gong ltar/phur pa lcam lugs su grags pa rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang gza' gdong dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/skyon r+pā po nas/cog ro dpal gyi mchod gnas/'khon rdo rje rin cen/'khon shes rab yon to/'khon yon to 'byung gnas/'khon tshul khrims rgyal bo/ 'khon rdo rje gtsugator/ 'khon dge skyabs/ 'khon dge mthong / 'khon bal po/'khon shākya blo gros/'khon shes rab tshul khrims/'khon dkon cog rgyal po/brtseb chen po/rje bas rin po che/sa paṇa/slob dpon 'od zer shākya/rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug/mkhas pa yon to khri/mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa man gong ltar/yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas dga' ldan pa kun bsod/gan pa rin rgyal/drung chos rje pa/yar klungs pa man gong bawo no// 99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('a.a ho bskal brgyar rnyed dka' theg pa'i rtse//tshe gcig 'ja' lusahrūb pa snang bzhi'i lam//zab don bsam gtan gling pa'i thugs kyi bcud//mngon sum myong 'di bsod nams phung pos rnyed//stobs 'byor dam pa'i ming gis bzang rdzu 'debs//tha snyad rtog ge'i khengs pa'i nges don spong //phal cher tshe 'di'i sto gos 'khol por song //rnyed dka'i 9bskol 'byor stong par 'dzad pa mang /kho bo'i sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar la//yar bltas tshad ldan bshes gnyen mang bstan pas//grangs med zab rgyas chos tshul thos pa yis//rang zhe rang la mi khrel spobs mthor son//chos dkon yid bzhin nor 'dra'i glegs bam gyi//chos kyi bzhugs tshulu zhabrul med rin cen 'phreng //dkar chag srad bur brgyus pa snod ldan ched//yin gyis dam can ma 'khren stong grogs mdzod//kun bzang rang ngo ma 'phrod 'khor 'khyams 'gro//dge 'dis sgrib gnyis pha mthar rdo rje sems//gdod nas snying dbus bzhugs pa'i rang rig mgon//dbul pos skyed rdo'i gser bzhin rnyed par shog/spyi dang khyad par nges gsang theg pa yi//smin grol chos kyis rgyal bstan spel mdzad pa'i//rdo rje 'dzin rnams bskal brgyar zhabs brtan zhing //thub bstan srid mtha'i bar du gnas par shog/sgo gsum rnam dag lha sngags ting 'dzin chus//'khrul tshogs rtog pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs te//ka dag dbyings las lhun grub 'od lnga'i mdangs//legs shar don gnyis bsam 'phel bkra shis shog/ces mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti'i chos skor gyi dkar chag theg mchog rin cen do shal zhes bya ba 'di ni/zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba dpal 10na tshe ltor lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las/gsang chen rnying ma'i smin grol gdams pa'i tshul la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad dkar ba za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos zil gnon gyi lo smin drug can gyi dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes ༷ snyo/ra ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs
dpal bzang gis bgyis pa 'dis kyang theg mchog snying po'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / //chos sbyin rgya cher spel phyir dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du bsgrubs/ maṅga lo//
